2025-11.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang got up a bit later, keeping with his weekend routine, and went downstairs for a morning run at exactly six o'clock, then took care of family matters. In the morning, he prepared rheumatism plasters for his mother and booked the banquet for his parents' ruby wedding anniversary. In the afternoon, he focused on reviewing PLC control theory at home. In the evening, he played with building blocks with his child and organized his wine bottle collection. Before bed, he did core stretches.

events.name: Morning run at Wanlv Garden.
events.description: Got up at 6:00 in the morning, warmed up briefly, and drove to Wanlv Garden. He ran into his running friend Chen Bin, and the two chatted while running 5 kilometers at a pace of about 6:40 per kilometer. Chen Bin encouraged him to relax about the exam, and Lu Mingqiang felt his exam-preparation stress ease.

events.name: Buying medicated plasters for his mother
events.description: After finishing my run and returning home to wash up, I walked to a nearby pharmacy to buy three boxes of rheumatism plasters for my mother, Chen Xiuying, and called to remind her to apply hot compresses to her knees before the weather turned cold.

events.name: Reserve a dinner for my parents' wedding anniversary
events.description: Drove to the time-honored restaurant on Bo'ai South Road, reserved a 12-person private room, and finalized the menu. He specially chose Wenchang chicken, which his father loved, and braised fish, which his mother liked. After paying the deposit, he bought a few traditional pastries on the way home.

events.name: Review and exam preparation
events.description: In the afternoon, in the study, I reviewed the difficult points of PLC ladder diagrams against the online course notes. I marked them with a red pen and redrew several typical circuit diagrams. I felt the logic was much clearer than last week.

events.name: Parent-child time and sorting through collections
events.description: In the evening, he played with his two children on the floor, assembling electronic building blocks. His elder son, Zixuan, was very interested in circuit assembly. After the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang wiped clean the old electric meter he had recently picked up, placed it in the glass cabinet, and re-categorized his baijiu bottle collection.

events.name: Core and stretching
events.description: Before bed, he completed 15 minutes of core training and shoulder and neck stretching in the living room, combined with soaking his feet in warm water, and felt physically relaxed.

start_state.mood: Calm and clear-headed; it's a holiday, but I still have plans.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and satisfying; family affairs are progressing smoothly.

2025-11.daily_overview: Early Sunday morning, Lu Mingqiang met his running buddy Chen Bin at Wanlv Garden for a 6 km morning run, then hurried to the secondhand market on Bo'ai Road to go treasure hunting, picking up an old-style electric meter and porcelain insulators. Later in the morning, the whole family attended the parent-child sports meet at his second son's kindergarten and won the Best Cooperation Award with coordinated teamwork. In the afternoon, after taking the family home, he organized his new collectibles and called his elder brother to confirm the dinner details. In the evening, he went to bed early as his son excitedly shared the day's highlights.

events.name: Morning run at Wanlv Garden.
events.description: At 6:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang met Chen Bin at Evergreen Park and ran an easy 6 kilometers at a pace of 6:35 per kilometer. Lu Mingqiang shared his exam preparation insights and studio plans, and Chen Bin encouraged him to keep up the morning runs after the exam.

events.name: Treasure hunting at the second-hand market.
events.description: After the morning run, he went home and had a quick breakfast, then drove alone to the secondhand market on Bo'ai Road. At a hardware stall, he found old electric meters from the 1960s and 1970s and several high-voltage porcelain insulators. He bought them at a reasonable price and planned to use them to decorate his studio later.

events.name: Prepare items for the sports meeting.
events.description: After returning from the market, he and his wife Wang Lijuan prepared sports shoes, a water bottle, and spare clothes for their second son Zihan for the parent-child sports meeting.

events.name: Attend the parent-child sports meet at the kindergarten.
events.description: The family of four drove to Jinmao Kindergarten for the sports meet. Lu Mingqiang set aside his exam preparation for the moment and enjoyed the relaxing time with his family.

events.name: Participate in parent-child games
events.description: The whole family took part in games such as the kangaroo jump and little feet stepping on big feet. Lu Mingqiang and his wife fully cooperated with Zihan, and laughter filled the scene.

events.name: Won the Best Cooperation Award
events.description: At the award ceremony, Lu Mingqiang's family won the "Best Cooperation Award" for their tacit teamwork. Zihan held the certificate high, and the whole family took a group photo. Lu Mingqiang felt that this was a precious emotional replenishment during the exam preparation period.

events.name: Returned home to organize his collection and contact his older brother
events.description: After the sports meet, Lu Mingqiang went home and carefully wiped the old electric meter he had newly acquired. In the evening, he called his elder brother Lu Minghua to reconfirm the details of next Saturday's dinner get-together and chatted about recent news.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: Completed 15 minutes of core and shoulder-neck stretching before bed and felt physically relaxed.

end_state.mood: Warm and joyful; family activities bring great satisfaction.

2025-11.daily_overview: The new week began with overcast and rainy weather. Lu Mingqiang got up early as usual and went to work, handling routine maintenance. During the lunch break, his coworker Chen Jianguo invited him to go for Hainanese-style tea, but he politely declined and stayed at his workstation doing practice questions. After work, he made phone calls to notify relatives about the gathering, and his wife helped confirm the list. In the evening, because he was tired from the day, his review was not very efficient, so he ended his study session early. While soaking his feet, he chatted with his wife about the children's education and felt at ease.

events.name: Routine electrical maintenance
events.description: Routine workday: in the morning, went to a small processing factory to repair the distribution box and replace old switches; in the afternoon, handled a low-voltage line fault in a residential area. He kept relating the work to theory as he went.

events.name: Did practice questions during the lunch break and politely declined socializing.
events.description: During the lunch break, co-worker Chen Jianguo invited him to a nearby tea shop to have some laoba tea. Lu Mingqiang awkwardly said he needed to cram for the exam, so he stayed alone in the break room and did 20 theory questions on his phone.

events.name: Notify relatives about the dinner arrangements.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, he called close relatives one by one, including Aunt Wang Xiuying and his older brother Lu Minghua, and confirmed that a total of 12 people could attend the dinner. His wife Wang Lijuan helped record the list by his side.

events.name: Evening review and family communication.
events.description: He opened the textbook to review electric drive control, but because of the heavy physical exertion during the day, he felt a bit lightheaded and closed the book after only half an hour. While soaking his feet, he chatted with his wife about funny things at his eldest son's school, and his mood relaxed.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: Do 15 minutes of stretching before bed to ease shoulder and neck fatigue.

end_state.mood: Slightly tired, but family arrangements are in order.

2025-11.daily_overview: Outdoor work was suspended due to rain. The crew organized tools and performed equipment maintenance in the workshop. Lu Mingqiang guided apprentice Zhao Qiang in identifying faults in old tools, taking the opportunity to pass on experience. In the evening, he used the time he would normally have spent playing squash to organize his liquor bottle collection at home and listen to an electrical knowledge podcast. While reviewing at night, he hit a bottleneck, so he called his master, Master Li, for a brief consultation and received encouragement. Before bed, he felt his review progress was not as expected and decided to get up early and study hard the next day.

events.name: Workshop tool organization and equipment maintenance.
events.description: Because light rain made outdoor work impossible, shift leader Zhang arranged for the team members to maintain electric tools in the workshop. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo added lubricating oil to the cutting machine, and Lu taught Zhao Qiang how to judge motor faults by sound.

events.name: Organizing the wine bottle collection
events.description: After getting off work and returning home, instead of going to the squash court (training has been suspended), he wiped clean several bottles of local Hainan liquor he had recently bought, rearranged the display cabinet, and took notes on the origin of each bottle.

events.name: Review setback and asking the master for guidance.
events.description: While studying PLC programming in the evening, he got stuck on the analog processing module and felt a bit frustrated. He called Master Li, and after a brief consultation, everything became clear. Master Li reminded him to focus on the big picture and not sweat the small stuff before the exam.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: While stretching before bed, he reflected on the day's review efficiency and decided to get up early the next day to study after his morning run.

start_state.mood: Everyday feeling, but the urgency of exam preparation is gradually increasing.

end_state.mood: Slightly anxious, but the problem has been resolved.

2025-11.daily_overview: In the early morning, Lu Mingqiang jogged 4 kilometers near the residential area to wake up his body, and then a milestone day at work began. He led his team in installing distribution cabinets at a commercial complex, creatively applied PLC theory to optimize the neutral wire layout, and guided apprentices on site to troubleshoot faults, earning public praise from Manager Liu. After work, he was energized, and his review efficiency that evening was extremely high. He compiled the day's practical insights into case notes, greatly boosting his confidence in the exam.

events.name: Morning run
events.description: Got up at 5:50 in the morning, jogged 4 km on the streets around the neighborhood at a slower pace, just to stay in shape. After the run, he felt refreshed.

events.name: Preparation for installation of power distribution cabinets in a commercial complex.
events.description: In the morning, checked the drawings with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang on the site of the new commercial complex in Xiuying District, counted accessories, and reconfirmed the safety measures.

events.name: Positioning and wiring of the distribution cabinet.
events.description: He led the team to complete the fixing of the low-voltage distribution cabinet and the introduction of cables, and then carried out the internal wiring. As he worked, Lu Mingqiang explained the key technical points to Zhao Qiang.

events.name: Apply PLC theory to optimize the neutral wire arrangement.
events.description: While wiring, Lu Mingqiang applied the PLC input/output logic he had studied for the exam to plan the routing of the neutral wires, making the wiring neater and easier to maintain. This innovative approach caught the attention of his colleagues present.

events.name: Guide the apprentice in solving complex circuits.
events.description: Zhao Qiang was confused while connecting the control circuit. Lu Mingqiang drew a simple diagram on the spot and explained the PLC principles. Zhao Qiang finished the job smoothly and said gratefully, "The moment you explained it, master, I understood."

events.name: Comprehensive commissioning and praise from Manager Liu
events.description: In the afternoon, after completing all the wiring, a power-on test was conducted and all indicators were normal. Manager Liu inspected it and expressed satisfaction with the installation quality and the innovative layout, praising Lu Mingqiang on the spot and recording it as an excellent case.

events.name: Evening review and note-taking.
events.description: After returning home, he was excited and wrote down the day's PLC application examples in detail in his exam-preparation notebook, no longer afraid of the theory exam. His wife could see he was in a good mood and specially made his favorite grilled fish.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: Persisted in stretching before bed and felt both body and mind were in peak state

start_state.mood: In high spirits, with a feeling that there will be progress today.

end_state.mood: Full of a sense of accomplishment, work received recognition, and confidence in the exam greatly increased.

2025-11.daily_overview: The workday went smoothly. After work, Lu Mingqiang began making a family photo album as a gift for his parents' ruby wedding anniversary. His wife helped select the photos, and the two children gathered around laughing at pictures of their younger selves. He worked on the album layout late into the night. His shoulders and neck were a bit stiff, but he persisted and finished it. Before bed, his wife reminded him to rest, and he realized he needed to balance his energy during the exam preparation period.

events.name: Daily electrical maintenance and workshop work
events.description: In the morning, the team replaced the main switch of the distribution box in an old residential community; in the afternoon, he repaired a returned electric hydraulic pliers in the company workshop. During the lunch break, he squeezed in a few wrong theoretical questions.

events.name: Making a family photo album
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang sat at his computer selecting family photos. From old photos of his parents' wedding to recent pictures of his sons, he chose nearly fifty, edited them with layout software, and added brief captions. His wife helped him choose at his side, and the two children giggled when they saw their baby photos.

events.name: Shoulder and neck discomfort and his wife's concern.
events.description: After two consecutive hours of looking down while typesetting, Lu Mingqiang's shoulders and neck ached. His wife massaged him and urged him to rest early. After moving around a bit, he insisted on finishing the photo album layout and prepared to send it to print the next day.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: Before going to bed, I did shoulder and neck stretches and core training with extra care to relieve fatigue from sitting for long periods.

After work, he went to the photo printing shop and picked up the finished photo albums, satisfied with the quality. At night, he briefly looked through his notes and went to bed early, saving his energy for the next day's gathering. Before sleeping, he confirmed the preparations for the gathering with his wife and felt at ease.

events.name: Handling repair work orders.
events.description: Went to the food processing plant with fellow worker Chen Jianguo, repaired the control cabinet that had tripped due to overload, replaced the burnt-out contactor, and restored power in the afternoon. The customer expressed gratitude.

events.name: Elder brother returned early
events.description: In the evening, Lu Minghua flew from Shenzhen to Haikou and called. The two agreed to meet directly at the restaurant the next day.

events.name: Pick up the souvenir photo album
events.description: After work, on the way home, went to the digital printing shop to pick up the bound photo album, carefully checked that there were no color differences or loose pages, and took it home satisfied.

events.name: Review before the exam and go to bed early
events.description: In the evening, he briefly looked through the mistake notebook and then closed it. He turned off the lights and went to sleep at 10:30 to conserve energy for tomorrow's important family gathering.

2025-11.daily_overview: Parents' 40th wedding anniversary. Lu Mingqiang and his wife arrived at the restaurant early to decorate the private room and set out a photo album as a surprise. Twelve close relatives gathered; his father gave an emotional speech, and his mother's eyes moistened when she saw the album. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang had an in-depth conversation with his elder brother about future plans and received practical advice. After the banquet, they saw off the relatives, and when they returned home and tidied up, he felt that family ties were the strongest at this moment. Due to the hearty meal and drinking as an exception, his weight rose slightly, but he was deeply gratified.

events.name: Set up the restaurant's private room in advance.
events.description: In the morning, he and his wife arrived at the private room of the restaurant. He placed the photo album beside the head seat and checked the air-conditioning temperature and the dish arrangement.

events.name: Parents' 40th wedding anniversary dinner gathering.
events.description: The whole family, including his parents, his older brother who rushed back from Shenzhen, and his aunt, 12 people in all, gathered together. His father raised a glass and reflected on the family's changes. Lu Mingqiang presented the photo album, and his mother shed tears while looking through it and praised it repeatedly. The gathering was filled with emotion and laughter.

events.name: Discussed business startup ideas with his older brother
events.description: During the dinner gathering, Lu Minghua asked in detail about the certification exam and studio plans, and suggested taking private jobs on weekends in the early stage to test the waters and control fixed costs. Lu Mingqiang carefully noted down the advice.

events.name: Seeing off relatives and tidying up
events.description: After the family gathering, he saw off relatives at the entrance of the restaurant, especially his elder brother, whom he saw into the car. After returning home, he and his wife organized the photo albums and red envelopes. Lu Mingqiang felt that a major life event had been completed.

start_state.mood: Anticipatory and slightly nervous, hoping the gathering goes smoothly

end_state.mood: Felt deeply gratified and happy; the family bond became even stronger

2025-11.daily_overview: On National Fire Prevention Day, Lu Mingqiang went alone to Wanlv Park in the early morning for a 7 km run to work off the fullness from the group meal. He reviewed briefly in the morning, and in the afternoon took his older son to the community fire drill, where he learned to use a fire extinguisher and personally put out an oil pan fire. During the drill, he proactively pointed out and fixed a safety hazard in a neighbor's charging power strip and was praised by the community director. After returning home, he used the opportunity to conduct a self-check of home electrical safety and gave his son a vivid safety lesson. The whole day was fulfilling, and his community prestige and sense of security increased.

events.name: Morning run at Wanlv Garden.
events.description: Woke up at 6:00 in the morning, drove to Wanlv Garden, and ran 7 kilometers alone at a pace of 6 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he felt light, and the greasiness from the dinner party was completely gone.

events.name: Pre-exam review
events.description: In the morning at home, he did a final review of the motor control circuit and recopied the key points from his master's notes.

events.name: Check the fire drill notice
events.description: After lunch, checked the community notice board and confirmed that the 2:30 p.m. fire drill would take place at the central plaza.

events.name: Participate in a fire drill.
events.description: In the afternoon he took his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to the square for a fire drill. The father and son listened carefully as the firefighters explained fire prevention and how to use fire extinguishers, and then operated a dry powder extinguisher themselves to put out an oil pan fire. Encouraged, Zixuan successfully extinguished the fire, his little face flushed with excitement.

events.name: Pointing out a neighbor's electrical hazard
events.description: During a break in the drill, Lu Mingqiang noticed that the wire end of the charging power strip on Uncle Li's tricycle was exposed. He immediately pointed out the risk, went back home to get some tools, reconnected it properly, and wrapped it in insulating tape.

events.name: Received praise from the community director.
events.description: Property manager Wang Jianguo witnessed Lu Mingqiang proactively eliminating a hazard, praised him in person for his excellent technical skills and dedication to community safety, and invited him to give a safety lecture to residents in the future.

events.name: Home electrical safety self-check
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang took Zixuan to check the pressure gauge on the home fire extinguisher, opened the meter box to explain the principles of the main switch and leakage protection, and tested all the residual current circuit breakers in the house.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: As usual, I stretched before bed; reviewing the day gave me a strong sense of fulfillment.

start_state.mood: Energy recovered, planning today's exercise and family activities.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and proud that my professional competence is recognized in the community

When his wife came home, she praised him for being thoughtful, and the lighting was brighter and warmer. events.name: Assist with inspecting the community fire safety facilities

events.description: During the day, he went with his work crew to install power distribution boxes in a new factory building. At noon, while eating fast food, he chatted with Chen Jianguo about household electrical safety basics.

events.name: Prepared repair tools and accessories
events.description: After getting off work, he took out a screwdriver, a voltage tester, and the newly purchased socket panels and LED bulbs from the toolbox to prepare for the home circuit upgrade.

events.name: Replaced the worn-out kitchen outlet
events.description: Noticed that a socket panel in the kitchen had aged and turned yellow. After turning off the main breaker, I carefully replaced it and tested it with power on. My eldest son Zixuan watched attentively from the side.

events.name: Replace light bulbs in the bedroom and bathroom
events.description: Replace the incandescent bulbs in the bedroom with LED energy-saving bulbs, and explain the principle of saving electricity to Zixuan. Also replace the two ordinary bulbs in the bathroom with waterproof LED bulbs, emphasizing electrical safety rules for damp environments.

events.name: Explained electric meter box basics.
events.description: After finishing, he opened the meter box and explained in detail to his son the functions of the main switch, the leakage protector, and the safe operation steps. Zixuan nodded repeatedly.

events.name: Wrapping up and receiving praise from his wife
events.description: Cleaned up the site and tidied the tools. When his wife came home from work and saw the bright lights and the new panel, she smiled and praised him. The family ate dinner together in the warm light, with a cozy atmosphere.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: Evening stretching before bed; although my body is a bit tired from work, I feel mentally fulfilled.

start_state.mood: Driven by a sense of responsibility, planning today's home safety upgrade

Before bed, he packed the list of questions to take with him, with anxiety mixed with anticipation.

events.name: Evening review and meeting with master
events.description: In the evening, while studying motor forward-reverse and star-delta starting, I ran into some difficulties. I called Master Li to ask if I could visit him tomorrow evening for advice. Then I made a list of the specific difficult points and prepared to bring my notebook.

Drawing on years of work notes, Master Li patiently explained the difficulties of motor control circuits and PLC programming to him and gave him solid encouragement. The master and apprentice talked in depth until nine o'clock. Lu Mingqiang returned fully rewarded, and after arriving home he organized his master's guidance into his notes, greatly boosting his confidence before the exam. Before bed, he felt calm inside, and his anxiety had almost disappeared.

events.name: Routine power inspection

events.name: Preparing a thank-you gift for the teacher.

events.name: Visited Master Li at home for advice

Master said: "Your years of hands-on experience are your greatest confidence. Relax during the exam; you will definitely pass." Lu Mingqiang thanked him repeatedly and felt suddenly enlightened.

events.name: Review and consolidation, with greatly increased confidence.
events.description: After returning home, he rewrote the key points from his master's explanation in his notes, feeling that his knowledge system had become coherent. His wife asked how it went, and he said with a smile, “One talk from the master is worth a week of my review.”

events.description: Did serious stretching before bed; both body and mind were in excellent condition.

In the afternoon, he knocked off early and filled up the car with gas to ensure a smooth trip to the exam the next day. After returning home, he completely put aside his books and played with his two sons using building blocks and puzzles, fully enjoying the parent-child time. After dinner, his wife helped him check his exam supplies. He went to bed at ten, ready to meet the next day's big exam in the best state. Before sleeping, he silently recited his master's advice in his heart and fell asleep peacefully.

events.name: Light work and exam preparation
events.description: Shift leader Zhang took care of Lu Mingqiang and arranged for him to stay in the workshop to organize the warehouse ledgers. He left work early at 3 p.m. and filled up the car on the way home.

events.description: After dinner, his wife helped him check his admission ticket, ID card, calculator, and pens once more, and put the items on the shoe cabinet by the door. Lu Mingqiang went to bed at ten o'clock, silently reviewing the knowledge framework in his mind, and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but trying hard to stay calm.

end_state.mood: Relax and get ready to go.

2025-11.daily_overview: The day of the senior electrician technician qualification certificate exam. In the early morning, Lu Mingqiang got up early and rushed to the exam center. He found the theoretical section difficult because of his weak educational background, but still did his best to answer. In the afternoon practical assessment, he performed excellently with his years of experience and finished ahead of time. After the exam, he felt relieved and sighed that he had "shed a layer of skin." To decompress, he took the whole family to Wanlv Garden to fly kites, enjoying a long-missed relaxation. In the evening, his wife prepared a late-night snack, and the couple talked late into the night about the exam and future plans. The tension that had gripped them for months finally loosened, and he fell asleep peacefully with hope.

events.name: Set off for the exam
events.description: Woke up at 6:00 in the morning. After a simple breakfast, drove to the examination site in Xiuying District. On the way, he opened the car window to let the morning breeze wake him up, and silently repeated the master's key exam points.

events.name: Theory exam
events.description: In the morning written test, the questions covered a wide range and were in-depth. Lu Mingqiang found it difficult because of his educational background, but he tried his best to finish relying on memory and frontline experience.

events.name: Practical skills assessment
events.description: The afternoon hands-on task was to design and install a motor forward-reverse circuit with PLC control and troubleshoot faults. Lu Mingqiang operated skillfully, with neat wiring, and finished 15 minutes early. As he walked out of the exam room, he let out a long sigh.

events.name: Post-exam reflections and relaxation
events.description: After the exam, he went home. Faced with questions from his wife and children, he said with a wry smile, 'This exam is a real killer, even for a middle school student! But I'm confident in the hands-on part.' To celebrate and let off steam, he suggested flying kites.

events.name: Flying kites at Wanlv Garden
events.description: A family of four went to Wanlv Garden. Lu Mingqiang took out his treasured traditional eagle kite. Zixuan succeeded in flying it independently for the first time, Zihan clapped and cheered, and his wife took photos. Lu Mingqiang watched the kite in the blue sky, and months of stress drifted away with the wind.

events.name: His wife prepared a late-night snack.
events.description: After returning from kite flying, Wang Lijuan had prepared home-style dishes such as qingbuliang and grilled fish. The family ate together to celebrate the end of the exams.

events.name: A long late-night talk between the couple
events.description: After the children went to sleep, the couple shared a late-night snack and had a deep conversation in the living room. Lu Mingqiang shared the exam process in detail, while his wife talked about a new client in her housekeeping business. They planned to buy new clothes at the end of the year and visit relatives during the Spring Festival, and also had a preliminary discussion about starting the studio. His wife expressed support and said they would discuss it further after his results came out.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: Before bed, did some simple stretching to relax after a day full of travel and excitement.

start_state.mood: Nervous and excited, ready to face the challenge.

end_state.mood: Relieved, warm and content, and full of anticipation for the future.

2025-11.daily_overview: On the first Sunday after the exam, Lu Mingqiang felt completely relaxed in body and mind. In the early morning, he arranged to meet his running friend Chen Bin for a 5 km morning run at Wanlv Garden, and rediscovered the joy of flying kites. During the day, he sorted out the family finances at home and had a clear picture of the household economy. His wife's new housekeeping client was good news, making the family budget more comfortable. The overall pace shifted from tense to relaxed, setting the tone for post-exam life recovery.

events.name: Morning recovery jog and rediscovering the joy of kite flying
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang got up, did a brief stretch, and arranged to meet running friend Chen Bin at Evergreen Park, resuming the morning running habit that had been interrupted for nearly two weeks. The two jogged 5 kilometers along the seaside track at a pace of 6 minutes 35 seconds per kilometer. Chen Bin praised him for being much faster than at the beginning of the year. Lu Mingqiang attributed it to consistent stretching and correct running form. After stretching following the run, he took out a traditional kite that had been idle for months from the car, adjusted the bridle, trotted on the lawn and flew the kite into the sky. Feeling the long-missed pull, he felt relaxed both physically and mentally.

events.name: Organizing family finances and reviewing outstanding loans
events.description: After finishing his morning run and showering at home, Lu Mingqiang sat down with his wife Wang Lijuan in the living room and took out the accounting book to sort out recent family income and expenses. He specifically turned to the March page, on which was written a record of lending 10,000 yuan to fellow worker Chen Jianguo, with repayment agreed for the end of the year. The couple calculated the main expenses before the end of the year and their current savings, and confirmed that even if this money were not repaid for now, they could still have a stable New Year without financial pressure. Wang Lijuan also took this opportunity to tell her husband that she had just landed a regular housekeeping client.

events.name: Wife gained a new regular housekeeping client
events.description: While Wang Lijuan was reviewing income and expenses with her husband, she shared some good news: through an acquaintance in the community, she had found a regular housekeeping client living in Longhua District, going twice a week to clean, which would stably increase their monthly income by 600 yuan. She had started working at the client's home a few days earlier, and the client was very satisfied with her work. Lu Mingqiang was very happy, saying this income could just be set aside as extra family savings. His wife proactively suggested that in the future they could save more for the island-tour special fund, and the couple felt optimistic about the family's financial outlook.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and expectant; the first day after the exam felt like a release.

end_state.mood: Calm and content, relaxed in body and mind, and financially secure.

2025-11.daily_overview: The workweek returned to normal. In the early morning, he resumed his regular morning run. During the day shift, he handled routine installation tasks at the electric power engineering company in Xiuying District. After work, Lu Mingqiang kept his promise to his eldest son and took him to buy electronic building blocks as a reward for his improvement on the midterm math exam. That evening, the father and son built a windmill model together, and the son's confidence in learning grew greatly. The good news that his wife's income had increased also made the family atmosphere more relaxed.

events.name: Morning recovery run
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang met his running buddy Chen Bin at Wanlv Garden and resumed their daily morning run routine. The two jogged 5 kilometers at a pace of 6 minutes 35 seconds per kilometer, deliberately keeping the intensity moderate as it was the first workday morning run after the exam. After the run they stretched thoroughly. Lu Mingqiang felt his physical condition improving and planned to run twice more this week.

events.name: Redeeming the reward, he took his eldest son to pick out an electronic building block set.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang drove his eldest son Lu Zixuan to a toy store on Jinlong Road in Longhua District. He let his son choose freely in the electronic building blocks section. Lu Zixuan finally selected an intermediate set with a motor and windmill assembly plan. When paying, Lu Mingqiang patted his son's head and said this was a reward for his math progress, so keep it up. On the way home, his son held the building block box in the passenger seat, flipping through the instruction manual and excitedly planning what model to build.

events.name: Father and son built a windmill model together, turning academic confidence into enthusiasm for hands-on practice.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and his son spread out the electronic building blocks on the living room table and, following the manual, built a windmill model step by step. The father explained the principles of circuit connections, while the son assembled the gears and blades. After about 40 minutes, the windmill turned successfully under battery power. Lu Zixuan proudly held up his work to show his mother and younger brother, and said excitedly that math wasn't hard after all, and he would do even better next time. Lu Mingqiang was gratified to see his son so naturally combining confidence in schoolwork with hands-on practice.

events.name: Wife shares good news of increased income from housekeeping work
events.description: After cleaning up the kitchen in the evening, Wang Lijuan formally confirmed the arrangement with her husband for the regular housekeeping client: going for 3 hours on Tuesday and Thursday mornings, with a monthly salary of 600 yuan agreed on. She smiled and did the math, saying that with the previous odd housekeeping jobs, her monthly income would be a bit over 1,000 yuan. Lu Mingqiang praised her for being capable and said the family would be much more comfortable financially, and they wouldn't have to scrimp on buying new clothes for the kids at year-end. The couple chatted on the sofa for a while and planned to carefully calculate the monthly budget over the weekend.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, ready to get back into the normal work rhythm.

end_state.mood: Gratified and content, seeing his son's growth and the family income rise

2025-11.daily_overview: In the morning, he carried out routine high-voltage line inspections in Xiuying District, which was physically demanding. After work, Lu Mingqiang sorted out his entrepreneurial ideas and had a video call of about 40 minutes with his childhood friend Wang Hai, who lives far away in Shenzhen. He gained valuable information about the Shenzhen market and agreed to meet during the Spring Festival. Relaxed after the exam, his entrepreneurial thinking began to shift from vague to concrete. In the evening, because his mind was active after the call, he went to bed a little later.

events.name: Organize entrepreneurial ideas and confirm the call time
events.description: After getting off work and having dinner at home, Lu Mingqiang went to his study and opened his notebook to sort out his initial ideas for a smart-home repair studio. He listed several key questions: market demand for smart locks and smart lighting controls, equipment procurement channels, and roughly how much startup capital would be needed. He sent these questions to Wang Hai via WeChat, and the two confirmed a video call at 8:30 p.m.

events.name: Had a video call with childhood friend Wang Hai, got market information and encouragement.
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang had a video call in his study with Wang Hai, who was far away in Shenzhen. He first excitedly shared his experience taking the senior technician exam on the 15th, saying the practical operation was fine, but the theory was a bit tough and he had done his best. Then he got down to business and talked about his idea of starting a smart home repair studio. Based on his experience in Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen, Wang Hai gave a detailed introduction to the current mainstream brands and wholesale price ranges of smart locks, and mentioned that the smart lighting control system market was growing rapidly in Shenzhen's turnkey housing market. He promised to help look for reliable equipment supply channels and encouraged Lu Mingqiang: "Your skills are solid, and this market in Haikou isn't saturated yet, so there's definitely opportunity." The two also talked about how their children were doing and agreed to discuss the business details in person when Wang Hai returns to Haikou during the Spring Festival.

events.name: Sort out the key points from the phone call and prepare for the next day's plan.
events.description: After the call ended, Lu Mingqiang struck while the iron was hot and quickly jotted down in his notebook a few key points Wang Hai mentioned: mainstream smart lock brands in Shenzhen, lighting control system categories, and the names of several larger suppliers in Huaqiangbei. He planned to organize this information into a more systematic draft of his business plan during tomorrow's lunch break, and specifically marked the items that needed further confirmation during the Spring Festival interview. In the evening, because his thoughts were active, he didn't go to bed until 23:15.

start_state.mood: Energetic, work rhythm back to normal.

end_state.mood: Excited and encouraged; the entrepreneurial idea now has market information support

2025-11.daily_overview: In the early morning, he completed a 7 km morning run in light rain with a pace of 6:25. In the morning, he handled routine maintenance of distribution boxes at a construction site in Xiuying District, but finished early because of the rain. After getting home from work in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang used a solid block of evening time in his study to organize the market information provided by his childhood friend into the first draft of the 'Initial Startup Plan for a Smart Home Repair Studio,' marking the entrepreneurial idea moving from casual conversation to a written document. Later, he continued searching online for smart lock repair cases to build up his technical knowledge.

events.name: Morning jog of 7 km in light rain.
events.description: At 6 in the morning, a light rain began to fall, but Lu Mingqiang still went to Evergreen Park as planned. Wearing a waterproof windbreaker, he completed a 7 km jog along the track in the gradually easing rain, with an average pace of 6:25/km. The air was fresh after the rain, and he felt his heart and lungs had recovered well. After a quick stretch, he went home to shower and then went to work.

events.name: Organize the preliminary startup plan and define the key research focus
events.description: After finishing work in the afternoon, going home, and having dinner, Lu Mingqiang went to his study and began to systematically draft a business plan based on the key points of last night's phone call with Wang Hai. He listed three sections: First, the skills he needed to focus on self-learning — smart lock installation and debugging, principles of smart lighting control systems, and troubleshooting WiFi/Bluetooth modules; Second, equipment procurement channels — first try contacting the Shenzhen supplier recommended by Wang Hai, while also checking out local distributors in Haikou; Third, startup capital estimate — about 5,000 yuan for tool upgrades, about 3,000 yuan for the first batch of spare parts, plus promotional costs, conservatively preparing 15,000 yuan. He called this plan the first draft of the preliminary business plan and planned to refine it after the exam results came out.

events.name: In the evening, looked up smart home repair materials to expand his knowledge.
events.description: After completing the first draft of the plan, Lu Mingqiang continued in his study to use his phone to look up common smart lock failure cases and basic repair tutorials for smart lighting control systems. He focused on several hands-on videos about fingerprint lock malfunctions and gateway connection errors, taking notes in his notebook as he watched, and added this useful information to the draft plan, making the learning path and equipment list clearer. When his wife passed by the study and saw him so focused, she asked what he was busy doing, and Lu Mingqiang smiled and said he was recharging his batteries.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed, went for a morning run as planned, with a slight drizzle adding to the fun.

end_state.mood: Feeling fulfilled and determined; for the first time, his business idea was put down on paper.

2025-11.daily_overview: During the day, he completed routine electrical maintenance tasks. In the evening, he did the monthly financial planning with his wife and decided to set up a special fund for an island-ring road trip. Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang was introduced by fellow collector Chen Jianguo to join the Haikou Wine Bottle Collectors Association WeChat group. Sharing his hand-drawn map sparked lively discussions among group members, causing him to go to bed very late. His collection hobby officially entered the community-building stage.

events.name: The couple jointly reviewed their monthly income and expenses and set up a round-island trip fund.
events.description: After dinner, while the children were playing in the living room, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan took out the account book and pay slips to calculate income and expenses since November. After confirming that his wife's monthly housekeeping income had increased steadily by 600 yuan, they decided that from this month on they would set aside 200 yuan each month from the additional income into a dedicated envelope as a special fund for a round-island self-drive trip within five years. Wang Lijuan wrote "Island Road Trip Fund" on the new envelope with a pen and placed it carefully in the drawer. Lu Mingqiang looked at the clearly marked goal and felt the future held more promise.

events.name: Joined the local liquor bottle collecting association’s WeChat group and chatted enthusiastically until late at night.
events.description: After the financial planning session ended, Lu Mingqiang organized his liquor bottle collection and hand-drew a Brief Map of the Distribution Changes of Major Hainan Distilleries. At 9 pm, fellow collector Chen Jianguo pulled him via WeChat into the Haikou local liquor bottle collectors association group. The group had more than 40 members. Lu Mingqiang posted photos of his collection shelves and the hand-drawn distribution map, which drew many likes and comments from group members. Someone immediately recognized several bottles from old Haikou distilleries and said they were now hard to obtain. The discussion was lively that night. Lu Mingqiang exchanged collection information with everyone and listened to veteran collectors tell old stories. Before they knew it, they had chatted until nearly midnight. He remarked that life after the exam was much richer than during exam preparation, but it also directly pushed his bedtime back to 23:45.

start_state.mood: Thoughts are clear, ready to move forward with all tasks according to plan

end_state.mood: Excited and fulfilled—my hobby has brought a social circle, but I feel a bit sleepy.

2025-11.daily_overview: On Friday, after finishing routine work, he had some free time and knocked off early in the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang used the entire evening to complete a long-contemplated essay, “My Hainan in My Wine Bottles,” putting to paper his years of collecting wine bottles and his plain affection for his hometown culture. Excited by the writing, he kept mulling it over before bed, but this time, after putting down his pen, he added 10 minutes of core stretching and neck-shoulder relaxation to ease the strain of desk work, and then went to sleep.

events.name: Finished the essay "Hainan in My Wine Bottle".
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang opened his diary, which he had not used for a long time, in his study and began to write the essay Hainan in My Wine Bottles that he had conceived earlier. He started with the first bottle he had collected and wrote about the specific memories behind each bottle: the celadon bottle was picked up at a street stall in 2012 when he went on a business trip to Qionghai with Chen Jianguo, and the small-mouthed bottle was picked up as scrap in 2015, the year his eldest son was born, when he passed by the entrance of Wenchang Old Distillery. He wrote, "Every bottle has held wine, and also holds a small slice of life, and people like me." By the time he had written about 2,000 characters, it was already past 10 p.m. When he put down his pen, he felt an indescribable clarity in his heart. He planned to set this handwritten draft aside for now and copy it over later when he had the chance.

events.name: Core stretching
events.description: After putting down his pen, Lu Mingqiang felt some stiffness in his shoulders and neck from sitting at his desk for a long time, so he did 10 minutes of core training and shoulder-neck stretches in the living room, then soaked his feet in warm water before going to sleep.

start_state.mood: Stable, easy work pace, looking forward to the weekend

end_state.mood: Feeling clear-minded; the hobby of writing brings spiritual satisfaction.

2025-11.daily_overview: A productive Saturday. In the morning, I took my son to observe the cherry tomatoes growing on the balcony, continuing our nature education. In the afternoon, I met with fellow collector Chen Jianguo at Dad's Tea House, where we exchanged collections and planned a trip to Wenchang next month to visit the old distillery. In the evening, I booked the annual physical exam for the 25th as planned, making preparations for health management.

events.name: Parent-child balcony planting observation record
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang took his eldest son Lu Zixuan to the balcony and started the weekly observation record of the cherry tomato plant. Zixuan skillfully took out a ruler to measure the plant height (it had grown to 23 cm), counted the newly opened small yellow flowers (7 flowers), and took several photos with his phone. Then he sat on a small stool on the balcony and drew the cherry tomato plant with colored pens in his journal. Lu Mingqiang guided him to pay attention to the leaf shapes and color gradations. His younger son Lu Zihan also came over to watch and learned to water a pot of pothos nearby with a small watering can. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to say to his eldest son, "You see, plants change very little every day. Only by observing consistently can you discover how it grows. The same is true for studying."

events.name: Had tea with fellow collector Chen Jianguo and planned a visit to Wenchang.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang took a hand-drawn map titled 'A Simplified Map of Changes in the Distribution of Major Distilleries in Hainan' and two 1980s Yedao-brand liquor bottles that he thought were representative, and went to the old man's tea shop in Fucheng, Qiongshan District, to meet Chen Jianguo. Chen Jianguo carefully took out from his bag a white porcelain Yedao-brand liquor bottle produced by Haikou Distillery in the 1980s. The two discussed everything from the bottle shape, glaze color, and bottom mark to the distillery's supply and marketing range back then. Lu Mingqiang unfolded his hand-drawn distribution map, and Chen Jianguo was full of praise after seeing it. The two enthusiastically made preliminary plans to find a weekend in the middle of next month to go to Wenchang together to visit the old distillery site and nearby old supply and marketing cooperatives. The tea gathering lasted nearly two hours.

events.name: Book annual physical exam.
events.description: After returning home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang remembered his previous plan to have a comprehensive physical examination before the end of the year. He called the Physical Examination Center of the Longhua Branch of Haikou People's Hospital and booked the annual health checkup package for the morning of the 25th, costing 199 yuan. The customer service reminded him to fast after 8 p.m. on the 24th and to go on an empty stomach on the morning of the 25th. He recorded the appointment information in his phone memo and told his wife.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to weekend family and hobby time

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and content; the exchange of collectibles was rewarding, and the trip to Wenchang is taking shape.

2025-11.daily_overview: Sunday was fulfilling and packed. In the early morning, he did a 5 km recovery run near home; in the morning, he went to the antique stalls at East Lake and picked up a Republic-era terminal block and an old electrician's toolbox; in the evening, he took the initiative to help his neighbor Uncle Wang fix a circuit breaker problem at home, declined payment, and word of mouth spread quickly in the neighborhood.

events.name: 5 km recovery run near home.
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang went downstairs in his running shoes and did a 5 km recovery run on the streets around Jinmao Middle Road at a pace of 6:40/km. Considering yesterday's tea gathering and the recent frequency of morning runs, he deliberately slowed down and focused on proper running form and deep breathing. After finishing, he stretched thoroughly in the community garden.

events.name: Treasure hunting at the Donghu antique stalls, coming away with old electrician items
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang rode an electric bike to the street-stall area of Donghu Antique Market. He squatted in front of a sundry stall for over half an hour, dug out a Republic of China period copper terminal post from a pile of old hardware (well preserved, the terminal screws could still be turned), and then found an almost new old-style wooden electrician's toolbox in a corner; the leather strap was worn, but the box was sturdy overall. He haggled back and forth with the stall owner and finally bought the two items for 150 yuan. As Lu Mingqiang walked away carrying the toolbox, he thought about conditioning the box with wood wax oil when he got home, and placing the terminal post on the bookshelf as an ornament.

events.name: Volunteered to repair the electrical circuit fault for his neighbor, Uncle Wang.
events.description: A little after 6 p.m., Lu Mingqiang had just parked his car after returning home when Uncle Wang from the neighboring unit (Wang Jianguo) hurried downstairs saying that the circuit breaker in his house had tripped three times in half an hour and asked him to take a look. Without a word, Lu Mingqiang got his tool bag. At Uncle Wang's house, he tested each circuit with a multimeter and quickly identified low insulation resistance on the kitchen circuit. Inspection revealed that the insulation layer of an old wall wiring had been damaged, causing leakage. He skillfully cut out the damaged section, replaced it with new wire, reinforced the joint, and wrapped the insulation. Half an hour later, the breaker stayed closed successfully. Uncle Wang insisted on giving him 200 yuan, but Lu Mingqiang smiled and pushed it away, saying, "Just treat me to some laoba tea next time." That evening, Uncle Wang praised Lu Mingqiang's skill and warm-heartedness to everyone in the neighborhood.

start_state.mood: Awake, planning to browse Taobao after the morning run.

end_state.mood: Gratified and fulfilled; mutual help among neighbors brings human warmth.

2025-11.daily_overview: Monday was a workday with little physical exertion. After getting off work in the evening, Lu Mingqiang strictly fasted for the next day's physical examination and went online to learn about pre-examination precautions. In the evening, while chatting with his wife, he mentioned that Uncle Wang had been spreading the word about him in the neighborhood, and neighborly relations warmed up.

events.name: Fasting preparation for the health checkup and reviewing precautions
events.description: After returning home from work in the evening, Lu Mingqiang followed the hospital's reminder and stopped eating from 8 p.m., drinking only a little plain water. He also searched online for things to note before the physical exam, such as avoiding strenuous exercise and staying fasting. He put his ID card, medical insurance card, and appointment confirmation into his small carry bag and set the alarm for 6:40 a.m.

events.name: Word of mouth among neighbors brings little joys.
events.description: In the evening, his wife Wang Lijuan came back from the community supermarket and, smiling, told Lu Mingqiang that several aunties downstairs were all praising his skill and helpfulness, saying that Uncle Wang told anyone he met about how Lu Mingqiang solved a big problem in half an hour. After hearing this, Lu Mingqiang felt a little embarrassed, but his heart was warm, and he felt the sincerity of the neighbors.

start_state.mood: The usual mood for going to work, slightly concerned about tomorrow's physical exam.

end_state.mood: Calm with the delight of being recognized.

2025-11.daily_overview: In the morning, he went to Haikou People’s Hospital as scheduled for the annual physical exam. Some routine results came out on the spot: his weight was 71 kg and his BMI of 23.9 had entered the normal range, but the doctor reminded him to pay attention to his blood lipids. In the evening, he discussed opening an education savings account for his eldest son with his wife, taking the family’s future planning a step further. Word of mouth continued to spread in the community, and Lu Mingqiang became known as the dependable man in the neighborhood.

events.name: Annual physical exam in progress.
events.description: At 7:30 a.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived at the Longhua Branch Physical Examination Center on an empty stomach. He completed the routine items in order: blood draw, electrocardiogram, ultrasound, chest X-ray, and, on the doctor's advice, paid out of pocket for an additional four-item lipid panel. The examination took about one and a half hours. Some routine results were available on the spot: weight 71 kg (about 1.5 kg less than last year), BMI 23.9, and normal blood pressure. The doctor briefly told him he was basically healthy, but the detailed report would need to be viewed online the next day. After the examination, Lu Mingqiang had a breakfast of white congee with eggs in the hospital cafeteria, then drove to work in Xiuying District.

events.name: Word of mouth in the neighborhood continues to build.
events.description: In the afternoon, when Lu Mingqiang returned to the residential community after work, he ran into a few retired elderly men playing chess at the gate. One of them greeted him and said, 'Mingqiang, your skills are great! Uncle Wang boasts about you to everyone.' It turned out that Uncle Wang had been telling everyone in the community these past few days about how Lu Mingqiang was skillful and warm-hearted, and had solved a big problem in half an hour without charging anything. This made Lu Mingqiang, previously an unknown professional resident in the community, start to be recognized by more neighbors as a reliable and kind person.

events.name: The couple discussed opening an education savings account for their eldest son
events.description: At 9 p.m., the children were all asleep. Lu Mingqiang and his wife discussed plans in the living room for their eldest son Lu Zixuan's future education. He searched online for the interest rates and account-opening requirements for bank education savings. The two decided to go to the Bank of China Longhua Sub-branch the next afternoon to open a dedicated education savings account, with an initial deposit of 500 yuan and fixed monthly deposits afterward. Wang Lijuan put the household register, both of their ID cards, and 500 yuan in cash into an envelope. Lu Mingqiang said: 'Zixuan is improving in math now. We need to prepare for his future college education in advance. Even if we save a little each month, it adds up after ten years.'

start_state.mood: Felt slight discomfort from fasting but maintained a positive attitude and looked forward to learning about his physical condition.

end_state.mood: Satisfied; preliminary physical exam results are good, and education planning is about to begin.
