2025-11.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang's health management achieved an important upgrade that day. In the morning, he checked his detailed physical examination report online and found that his blood lipids and other indicators were elevated, and immediately resolved to make adjustments in both diet and exercise. After a 5-kilometer morning run, he communicated with his wife and received full support. After work, he bought healthy ingredients and cleared out high-fat snacks. In the evening, he had his weekly squash training session with his playing partner Lin Feng and strengthened his core. Starting with dinner that day, the low-fat diet plan officially began; he gave up late-night snacks and switched to unsweetened tea.

events.name: Morning jog and review of the physical examination report.
events.description: At 6:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang ran 5 kilometers with Chen Bin in Wanlv Park at a pace of 6:30 per kilometer. After the run, he went home and logged into the hospital's official account on his phone to check the detailed physical exam report: total cholesterol and low-density lipoprotein were elevated. The doctor advised him to reduce high-fat foods, increase aerobic exercise, and keep his weight below 70 kilograms. Lu Mingqiang sat on the edge of the bed and read it carefully, decided to strictly follow the diet and exercise plan starting that day, and set an alarm for morning runs three times a week.

events.name: Discussing the health adjustment plan with his wife
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang specifically called Wang Lijuan to tell her about the physical examination report and his thoughts. He said that although high blood lipids were not a big problem, he should make adjustments now before it became serious—health is the foundation for the future. After hearing this, Wang Lijuan immediately expressed support, saying she would start cooking light dishes tonight, use less oil in stir-fry dishes from now on, and cook fish a few more times a week. She also offered to stop making late-night snacks and said, "Whatever you want to drink, I'll make you sugar-free Laoba tea."

events.name: Purchase healthy ingredients and clear out high-fat snacks
events.description: After getting off work in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang stopped by the vegetable market near Jinmao Middle Road and, as planned, bought two fresh sea bass, a large bag of lettuce and broccoli, and ingredients for a box of multigrain rice; he also bought half a jin of sugar-free Laoba tea leaves from the tea stall. When he got home, he put away the peanuts, potato chips and other high-fat snacks that had been on the coffee table into the cabinet, and told his wife to buy fewer of these in the future, saying that drinking tea while watching TV would be enough.

events.name: Squash training and core strength reinforcement
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang drove to the squash court for his weekly regular squash training with his playing partner Lin Feng. They first did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up, then played three intense games. Although his stamina had dropped slightly due to recent adjustments, Lu Mingqiang's core strength and touch remained solid. After the match, he added 20 minutes of core strength training (planks, crunches, etc.). Lin Feng praised his noticeable improvement in endurance and suggested he try HIIT training. Lu Mingqiang recorded the workout data on his phone.

events.name: Day 1 of the low-fat diet
events.description: At 7 p.m., Wang Lijuan served the adjusted dinner: blanched broccoli and lettuce, steamed sea bass (only with ginger, scallions, and a little steamed fish soy sauce), and multigrain rice. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to eat only fish and vegetables, and his rice was a third less than usual. After tasting it, he said that light food actually has its own fragrance. After dinner, he brewed a cup of sugar-free Laoba tea and felt refreshed in body and mind. Before bed, he wrote in his diary: 'First day of low fat, my body feels light, my spirits are good, keep it up.'

start_state.mood: Slightly worried but determined to make positive adjustments.

end_state.mood: Positive and determined, with a clear action plan for health management

state.daily_exercise: 5 km morning run, 45 minutes of squash training, 20 minutes of core strength training

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, temperature 19–23°C, light showers in the evening

2025-11.daily_overview: During the day, he did cable trench laying work in Xiuying District, which was physically demanding. At 7 p.m., he suddenly received an emergency call from an old client, Boss Li Jianguo, whose electrical appliance repair shop had lost power due to the main line being overloaded and burned out. Lu Mingqiang quickly contacted his coworker Chen Jianguo, and the two drove to Meilan District, completing the emergency repair and restoring power within 30 minutes. This was the first emergency repair after the exam, once again proving his excellent skills and efficient emergency response capability. He continued his low-fat diet for the second day.

events.name: Received an urgent call from a client in the evening.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lu Mingqiang had just finished a low-fat dinner (steamed fish and stir-fried greens) and was playing with building blocks with his youngest son in the living room. His phone rang. It was his regular customer, Boss Li Jianguo, who runs an electrical appliance repair shop on Haifu Road, Meilan District. Boss Li sounded anxious and said the shop had suddenly lost power, and there were still several air conditioners waiting to be repaired the next day. He asked if Lu Mingqiang could come over now to take a look. While still on the phone, Lu Mingqiang walked toward the tool room. After asking about what had happened before and after the power outage, he judged that the main line at the main switch was probably overloaded. He told Boss Li to turn off the main switch first to ensure safety, and said he would be there in half an hour. After hanging up, he immediately contacted his fellow worker Chen Jianguo and agreed to meet downstairs in 15 minutes.

events.name: Efficiently completed the emergency repair and restored power to the shop.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang drove his private car with Chen Jianguo and arrived at Haifu Road, Meilan District, 20 minutes later. The two went straight to the main switch after entering the shop. Lu Mingqiang measured the incoming terminal voltage with a multimeter and found it to be zero. When he opened the main switch cover, he found obvious burn marks on the main circuit and the insulation layer charred black. The two divided the work: Lu Mingqiang cut the burnt main wire, reconnected it, and reinforced the joint; Chen Jianguo helped secure the cable and wrap it with insulating tape. After about 30 minutes, the replacement was complete. They closed the switch and tested the power supply, and all the lights in the shop came on. Lu Mingqiang checked each device one by one to confirm normal operation. Boss Li thanked them repeatedly and paid the on-site service fee and material fee on the spot according to company standards, saying that after all these years, every time he asked for Lu Mingqiang, he had never been disappointed. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo packed up their tools and drove back, arriving home at nearly 9:30.

events.name: Continue following a low-fat diet
events.description: After returning from the emergency repair, Lu Mingqiang did not eat again, only brewing a cup of sugar-free Laoba tea to relieve fatigue. His wife had already set aside his lunch for tomorrow: multigrain rice with blanched greens and steamed chicken breast.

start_state.mood: Regular work pace, with a slight feeling of lightness in the body due to dietary adjustments.

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled; the sense of accomplishment from emergency repairs and the clients' trust are satisfying.

state.daily_exercise: Work involved considerable physical exertion.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to cloudy, temperature 18-22°C, feels cool

2025-11.daily_overview: In the afternoon, went to the bank with his wife to open an education savings account for his eldest son Lu Zixuan and deposited the first 500 yuan, completing a key step in turning family education from a wish into institutionalized savings. In the evening, attended the year-end gathering of junior high school classmates, meeting 8 old classmates including Wu Gang, and talked about midlife situations and the changes in Haikou. Because he came home late from the gathering, his bedtime was delayed to nearly midnight.

events.name: Open an education savings account for the eldest son.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang took two hours off and went with his wife Wang Lijuan to the Bank of China in Longhua District. Guided by a teller, they opened a dedicated education savings account in Lu Mingqiang's name for his eldest son Lu Zixuan and filled out an agreement for an automatic monthly transfer of 200 yuan. Wang Lijuan handed 500 yuan in cash through the window as the initial deposit. After it was done, the teller handed out the passbook with Lu Zixuan's name printed on it. Lu Mingqiang carefully put the passbook away and said to his wife: “No matter how our income changes in the future, this money will be transferred every month without fail; after ten years, it will be enough for Zixuan to use for college.” After returning home, he called his son over and explained the meaning of the passbook, and Lu Zixuan nodded seriously.

events.name: Attend the year-end gathering of junior high school classmates.
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to a food stall on Binhai Avenue for a year-end gathering of middle school classmates. Wu Gang had invited eight old classmates, including Zhou Wei. They sat around eating grilled fish and drinking beer (Lu Mingqiang only had sugar-free tea). The conversation ranged from work pressure and children's education to the changes in Haikou's old industrial area. Several classmates who had grown up in the factory family compound sighed that the old factory buildings were either demolished or converted, and their childhood memories were becoming increasingly blurred. Lu Mingqiang was calm and composed, and told everyone they could visit the former site of the old industrial area with their families during the Spring Festival. The gathering ended at 10:30 p.m., and after returning home, he washed up and got into bed at nearly 23:40.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed, looking forward to making institutional arrangements for my son's education.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and calm, education savings secured, classmates gathered to renew old friendships

state.daily_exercise: None

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, temperature 20-26°C, plenty of sunshine, suitable for outdoor activities

2025-11.daily_overview: Because of the busy year-end work in December, Lu Mingqiang and his wife celebrated their second son Lu Zihan's 4th birthday at home ahead of time. In the morning they bought gifts and a cake, in the afternoon they decorated the living room, and in the evening the whole family sat together to celebrate. After receiving large-particle electric building blocks, Lu Zihan and his father assembled a toy car that could run, showing a leap in his hands-on ability. The simple yet warm family ceremony warmed everyone's hearts.

events.name: Purchasing birthday gift and cake for the second son.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan went together to the community supermarket and a nearby toy store. At the toy store, they picked out a set of brightly colored large-piece electric building blocks (with a motor and wheels to assemble a small car) for their second son, Lu Zihan. Then they went to the cake shop next to the supermarket and ordered a 6-inch fresh milk fruit cake, agreeing to pick it up at 3 p.m. Wang Lijuan also bought a pack of colorful balloons and a string of small colored lights.

events.name: Decorate the living room to create a birthday atmosphere
events.description: After picking up the cake at 3:30 p.m., the family began decorating the living room. Wang Lijuan blew up a dozen or so colorful balloons and stuck them on the walls and chairs; Lu Mingqiang wrapped a string of small colored lights around the edge of the TV cabinet; his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, took the initiative to help blow up balloons, while his younger son, Lu Zihan, curiously patted the floating balloons. The simple decorations immediately gave the living room a warm birthday atmosphere.

events.name: Family birthday celebration and parent-child assembly activity
events.description: At 6 p.m., the whole family sat around the coffee table, with 4 candles on the cake. Everyone clapped and sang the birthday song. Lu Zihan blew out the candles with encouragement and clapped happily. After cutting the cake, Lu Mingqiang gave the electric building blocks to his younger son, and the father and son assembled them directly on the carpet. Guided by his father, Lu Zihan aligned and snapped the large-piece building blocks together one by one, and after about half an hour they successfully built a small car that could run. When the car moved across the floor, Lu Zihan chased it all around the living room while his older brother Lu Zixuan helped nearby. The family atmosphere was warm and joyful. Wang Lijuan took several group photos with her phone.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to celebrating a special day for my youngest son.

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilled; the family ritual made everyone feel warm at heart.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-11.daily_overview: On the last day of November, Lu Mingqiang completed an 8 km long-distance morning run at a pace of 6:20/km. His running buddy Chen Bin praised him for returning to peak form. He then took the whole family to Wanlv Park to enjoy the first pure family leisure after the exams: they resumed the fun of kite flying, and a self-made eagle kite soared in the blue sky; the family had a picnic on the grass, sharing Hainanese chicken rice and qingbuliang, while the children ran and played. In the evening, the family sat around sharing interesting stories. Afterward, Lu Mingqiang checked his tool bag, looked over next week's work schedule, and briefly discussed the family's December to-do list with his wife. He felt life was well organized and confident about the coming December.

events.name: Long-distance morning run of 8 km
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang met his running partner Chen Bin at Wanlv Park, aiming for an 8-kilometer long run. He maintained a steady pace of 6:20/km, about 10 seconds faster than at the end of October. As they ran, Chen Bin praised him, saying "you're much faster than at the beginning of the year." Lu Mingqiang attributed the improvement to consistent stretching and core training. After a full post-run stretch, he felt his cardiorespiratory fitness was excellent, putting a perfect finish on his post-exam recovery.

events.name: The whole family drove to Wanlv Garden to fly kites.
events.description: At 9 AM, Lu Mingqiang put a picnic basket, a homemade eagle kite, and a ground mat into the trunk, then drove the whole family from Middle Jinmao Road and arrived at Wanlu Garden in 15 minutes. He chose a lawn with a wide view to settle down. Lu Mingqiang took out the eagle kite, adjusted the bridle line, and handed the line wheel to his eldest son, Lu Zixuan. Under his father's guidance, Lu Zixuan ran into the wind, and the kite rose steadily, flying higher and higher. His second son, Lu Zihan, looked up and cheered, clapping. Lu Mingqiang took the line wheel back to demonstrate how to control the kite's posture and briefly explained the principle of lift. Wang Lijuan sat on the mat and recorded video with a smile. Watching the soaring kite, Lu Mingqiang sighed, "It's been over a month; I finally get to take you all out to have fun properly."

events.name: Family lawn picnic and parent-child time
events.description: After flying kites for more than an hour, the family returned to the picnic blanket to rest. Wang Lijuan took out Hainanese chicken rice, Qingbuliang, fruit, and mineral water. Lu Mingqiang picked up some chicken rice and felt it tasted especially good outdoors. The two children ate with great relish. After finishing the Qingbuliang, Lu Zihan lay contentedly on the blanket watching the clouds. While resting, Lu Mingqiang lay on the grass and felt his body and mood were unprecedentedly relaxed—exam pressure and work fatigue were dissolved by the sunshine and green lawn. At 4 p.m., the family packed up and Lu Mingqiang carefully put away the kite. On the way back, Lu Zixuan still excitedly talked about the details of kite flying. In the evening, the family shared amusing stories in the living room, and Lu Mingqiang brought November to a perfect close: life had smoothly shifted from a high-pressure, focused state to a track of moving calmly forward with new goals.

events.name: Prepare for work in December
events.description: After the family sharing session ended, Lu Mingqiang habitually checked the tool bag by the door and added a few commonly used screws and a roll of insulating tape. He opened his phone and looked at the advance work schedule for next week posted by Team Leader Zhang in the team group chat, confirming that on Monday he would need to go to a newly built community in Xiuying District to install electric meter boxes. Then he briefly went over the family's December to-do list with his wife, and the two agreed to buy a new pair of sports shoes for Zixuan next weekend. With everything arranged, he felt that life was busy but organized, and he was full of confidence about the coming December.

start_state.mood: Filled with anticipation, the planned morning run and family outing day have finally arrived.

end_state.mood: Completely relaxed and joyful in both body and mind; the happiness and sense of life balance brought by family time reached a recent high. At the same time, he made plans for the upcoming December and felt that everything was well organized and he was full of confidence.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 8 km, pace 6:20/km

2025-02.daily_overview: On the fourth day of the Chinese New Year, Lu Mingqiang completed his first 5-kilometer morning run after the holiday with his running buddy Chen Bin at Baishamen Park, and they talked about recent fitness routines and Spring Festival plans. In the morning, he organized his toolbox at home to prepare for returning to work after the holiday, and continued writing the liquor bottle culture stories. At noon, his wife cooked authentic Hainanese chicken rice, and the family enjoyed a warm lunch together. After a short rest in the afternoon, he kept up his Senior Technician theory studies in the evening, then went to bed on time before 23:00. His holiday life was well balanced between work and rest.

events.name: Morning run with Chen Bin and lower back rehabilitation training.
events.description: Got up at 6:20 in the morning, arrived at Baishamen Park at 6:40 to meet running partner Chen Bin. First did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching, then jogged 5 kilometers side by side at a 6:30-per-kilometer pace, chatting about Spring Festival plans and post-holiday work outlook. After the run, the two did two sets each of superman exercise and glute bridges on a bench. Lu Mingqiang put on a new lumbar support belt for extra protection. He got home at 7:55 and showered.

events.name: Organize the toolbox and write the liquor bottle story.
events.description: After breakfast at 9:00, Lu Mingqiang cleaned and oiled the tools used before the holiday, rearranged them by frequency of use, and got ready for work. Then he went into the study and continued writing the third liquor bottle story, describing the origin of a bottle of 1980s Haikou Daqu in connection with Junpo Festival customs, and wrote a short essay of about 400 characters based on childhood memories.

events.name: Family lunch: Hainanese chicken rice
events.description: At 12:00 noon, his wife Wang Lijuan was busy in the kitchen. Lu Mingqiang helped by cutting ginger and scallions, and the two children helped set out the bowls and chopsticks. A plate of sliced Wenchang chicken, a dish of chicken-oil rice, and several small dishes were served. The elder son Lu Zixuan ate two bowls, the younger son Lu Zihan tried dipping chicken legs in sauce, and the whole family talked and laughed.

events.name: Noon break and simple parent-child interaction.
events.description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang leaned back on the sofa watching the two children build with blocks. Half an hour later, he got up to clear the table, then chatted with his wife about plans for the rest of the holiday.

events.name: Studying for the senior technician theory exam.
events.description: From 20:30 to 21:30 in the evening, Lu Mingqiang logged into the electrical engineering forum in his study, and in conjunction with the power systems chapter of the textbook, studied two cases on transformer differential protection, noted down the fault diagnosis process, and had a brief online discussion with peers.

start_state.mood: Energetic and looking forward to a holiday morning run

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied—exercise, creative work, and family time all covered.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the fifth day of the Chinese New Year, a Sunday, Lu Mingqiang's family drove to his parents' home in the morning for New Year greetings and a reunion. His father, Lu Jianguo, recounted the origins and stories behind three treasured baijiu bottles at the dinner table, and Lu Mingqiang took careful notes. After returning home in the afternoon, he organized the oral accounts into an initial draft of notes. In the evening, he continued his core rehabilitation training and advanced technician studies. Family affection and hobbies were intertwined, making the last day of the holiday fulfilling and warm.

events.name: Morning lower back rehabilitation training
events.description: After getting up at 8:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang did 15 minutes of superman, glute bridge, and cat-cow stretches on the yoga mat in the bedroom, moving slowly and focusing on breathing to stretch his body.

events.name: Went to his parents’ home to pay New Year’s greetings and have lunch together.
events.description: At 9:30, Lu Mingqiang drove his wife and children to his parents' home in Meilan District. His mother, Chen Xiuying, served Ching Bo Leung and snacks, while his father pulled his grandson over for a game of chess. At noon, the table was filled with Hainanese chicken rice, braised fish, and other dishes. Lu Mingqiang went back for two more bowls of rice, and three generations raised their glasses to toast one another's health.

events.name: Father's oral account of the wine bottle history.
events.description: After the meal, at 13:00, Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room with his father. In front of them were a 1970s Haikou Daqu liquor bottle, a 1990s Yedao Lujiu wine bottle, and a Li ethnic totem commemorative bottle. Lu Jianguo put on his reading glasses and talked about each liquor's production background, its connection to local festivals, and amusing stories from the power supply bureau back then. Lu Mingqiang listened and took notes, asking questions from time to time, for an hour and a half.

events.name: Compile a draft of the dictated notes
events.description: Returning home at 15:30, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and organized his father's account by timeline and theme into an initial draft of about 600 characters, marking several years that needed verification.

events.name: Senior Technician theory study
events.description: From 20:30 to 21:15 in the evening, he studied the relay protection chapter, drew a time coordination diagram for overcurrent protection, and briefly reviewed what he had learned that day.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to reuniting with parents, feeling relaxed.

end_state.mood: The heart is full; memories of his father add depth to the hobby.

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation training, 15 minutes

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the holiday, Lu Mingqiang's family went to his aunt Wang Xiuying's home in the morning to pay New Year's greetings and were warmly received. In the afternoon, he focused on combining the three liquor bottle stories with his father's materials from the previous day, organizing them into complete cultural notes, and took photos to share in the collector friends group, which drew widespread praise. In the evening he completed rehabilitation training, and at night studied for the senior technician qualification, settling down to get ready to return to work the next day.

events.name: The whole family went to Aunt's house to pay a New Year call.
events.description: At 9:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang drove to his aunt's home in Meilan District. His aunt had prepared a table of Laobaicha snacks and qingbuliang. Holding Lu Mingqiang's hand, she urged him to pay attention to safety at work. The two children played with lanterns in the courtyard. When they left, the aunt pressed a red envelope into each child's hand.

events.name: Organized and merged notes on wine bottle culture.
events.description: At 14:00 in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang gathered the three previously written wine bottle stories and his father's dictated notes in the study, polished them paragraph by paragraph, supplemented them with local folklore materials, and finally produced a complete cultural note of about 1,200 characters.

events.name: Took photos for archival and shared them in the collector friends group
events.description: At 15:30 he photographed his notes, took detail shots of the three liquor bottles from multiple angles, and organized them into electronic documents for archiving. Then he selected some images and text and posted them to the liquor bottle collecting WeChat group. Group members liked the post one after another, and someone even recognized the number of an old distillery; the interaction was lively. Chen Jianguo privately messaged him on WeChat to invite him to have laobaicha the next afternoon and exchange newly collected bottles, and Lu Mingqiang readily agreed.

events.name: Lower back rehabilitation exercises
events.description: At 18:00, he did 15 minutes of glute bridges and superman exercises in the bedroom to warm up for the heavy physical work resuming tomorrow.

events.name: Studying for the Senior Technician exam
events.description: 20:30-21:15, studied the transformer protection chapter, recorded a case of gas protection maloperation, and wrote down measures to prevent misoperation.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, the last day of visiting relatives and friends.

end_state.mood: Achieved great results, gained recognition from sharing his hobby, and feels positively about returning to work.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the last day of the holiday, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the Spring Festival expenses with his wife in the morning and saved 500 yuan. In the afternoon, as promised, he exchanged newly acquired liquor bottles with his collector friend Chen Jianguo at the Laoba tea shop and gained a lot. In the evening he did bodyweight strength training, and at night continued studying for the senior technician certificate and organized his tool bag, fully preparing for the next day's work.

events.name: Family Spring Festival expense accounting
events.description: At 9:00 after breakfast, the couple checked the phone records and the red envelope list item by item. The actual expenditure was 2,500 yuan, 500 less than the budget. Lu Mingqiang transferred the surplus to the daily account via mobile banking, and his wife noted it in the account book.

events.name: Drink Laoba tea with Chen Jianguo and exchange collectibles
events.description: At 14:00, Lu Mingqiang met Chen Jianguo at the tea shop on Qilou Old Street. Chen Jianguo brought a blue-and-white porcelain wine bottle made in Jingdezhen in the 1980s. The two admired and appraised it, exchanged maintenance tips, and also talked about family and the upcoming work. They left after having a good time.

events.name: Bodyweight strength training
events.description: He got home at 17:00, spread out his mat in the living room, and completed 3 sets of 20 push-ups and 3 sets of 20 bodyweight squats as his regular Tuesday strength training. He felt slight soreness in his arms and legs.

events.name: Advanced technician study and preparation for tomorrow.
events.description: In the evening from 20:30 to 21:15, he studied power system fault analysis and noted down a ground short-circuit handling method. After studying, he placed his work clothes, safety helmet, and tool bag by the door in advance and set the alarm.

start_state.mood: Steady and organized, enjoying the final days of leisure.

end_state.mood: Fully focused and ready to face work with confidence.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of bodyweight strength training (push-ups, squats).

2025-02.daily_overview: On the first working day after the holiday, Lu Mingqiang efficiently completed the emergency repair of a high-voltage ring main unit. His technical performance won praise from both the team leader and the client. In the evening, he went to the squash court for the first regular training session of the new year with Lin Feng, and he was in good form. After returning home, he continued studying for the senior technician qualification and turned his hands-on experience into notes. The first day back at work was wonderful and fulfilling.

events.name: Morning lower back rehabilitation training
events.description: After getting up at 5:50, did 15 minutes of superman exercises and glute bridges in the living room, and used a foam roller to relax the lower back, providing ample protection for the day's work.

events.name: Emergency repair of high-voltage ring main unit
events.description: Reported to work at 7:50. At 8:10, Team Leader Zhang called an emergency assembly regarding a power outage caused by a faulty ring main unit in a residential community, and Lu Mingqiang was named the lead repairman. He and Chen Jianguo took all their equipment and headed straight to the scene. Referring to the schematic stored on his phone, he accurately identified and replaced the component that had suffered insulation breakdown within 30 minutes, and power was restored successfully on the first attempt.

events.name: Record practical cases
events.description: Back at the team, Lu Mingqiang recorded in detail the fault symptoms, troubleshooting steps, and repair methods in the work log, and took photos of the fault point for his personal technical archive, planning to use them as a case for the senior technician defense.

events.name: Regular squash training
events.description: At 18:00 in the evening, he went to the squash court at Power Fitness Club and did a one-hour practice session with Lin Feng. The two had intense forehand rallies. Lu Mingqiang moved actively and generated power smoothly from his core. Lin Feng praised him for quickly regaining his form.

events.name: Studying for the Senior Technician exam
events.description: 21:00-21:45, studied the insulation coordination chapter of the textbook in connection with today's ring main unit fault, compared similar cases on the forum, wrote a 300-character experience summary, and marked important exam points.

start_state.mood: In high spirits, looking forward to the first match of the new year

end_state.mood: Strong sense of achievement; excellent in both hands-on work and sports.

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation training for 15 minutes, squash for 1 hour

2025-02.daily_overview: The next day's work was mainly routine inspections at a steady pace. After coming home from work, the eldest son expressed a wish to join a programming class. Lu Mingqiang immediately supported it, completed the enrollment and payment, and watched introductory videos with his son. Together, father and son opened a new bond in learning technology. In the evening, he continued strength training and preparation for the senior technician exam, and life moved forward steadily.

events.name: Morning lower back rehabilitation training
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, did 15 minutes of cat-cow and bird-dog exercises on the bedroom floor to strengthen dynamic stability of the lumbar spine.

events.name: Equipment inspection and communication with co-workers
events.description: 8:00-12:00 accompanied the work crew to the switching station in Xiuying District, performed temperature, sound, and visual inspections on high-voltage cabinets and transformers, tightened several loose screws, and discussed yesterday's emergency repair experience with Chen Jianguo on the way.

events.name: Support Zixuan in signing up for the programming class
events.description: During dinner, Lu Zixuan took the initiative to say he wanted to join the school's Scratch programming class, which cost 800 yuan. After Lu Mingqiang asked for details, he agreed immediately, and his wife also approved. After dinner at 19:00, he contacted the teacher through the class group to confirm, then transferred the fee from the Spring Festival savings, completed the payment online, and sent the receipt to the family group.

events.name: Father and son watched introductory programming videos together.
events.description: At 20:00, father and son watched Lesson 1 together at the computer. Dragging block commands to make the cat move excited Lu Zixuan. Lu Mingqiang encouraged him to try it himself, and they agreed to practice together every week.

events.name: Bodyweight strength training
events.description: At 21:00, Lu Mingqiang completed 3×20 push-ups and 3×20 squats in the living room as his regular Thursday strength workout, with an obvious muscle pump.

events.name: Studying for the Senior Technician exam
events.description: 21:30-22:10, continued the transformer protection chapter and organized excerpts of differential protection misoperation cases into notes.

start_state.mood: Calm and gradual

end_state.mood: Gratified, feeling a new starting point in my son's growth.

2025-02.daily_overview: On the third day after the holiday, Lu Mingqiang spent the entire day repairing transformers, which was physically demanding. After work, he treasured family time and played games with the children, using simple parent-child interaction to relieve work fatigue. In the evening, after a brief review, he went to bed early to recharge for the weekend.

events.name: Morning lower back rehabilitation
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, did 15 minutes of superman exercises and glute bridges with proper form, maintaining the core habit.

events.name: Transformer repair work
events.description: From 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, he replaced transformer oil and sealing rings at a factory in Xiuying District. In the afternoon he dealt with a cooling fan fault, standing and working continuously for hours, with his work clothes soaked through.

events.name: Parent-child games after work

events.name: Organizing notes for the Senior Technician certificate.

events.name: Parent-child reading time.

events.name: Learn PLC instructions

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday, he combined activity with rest. In the morning, Lu Mingqiang took his sons to Wanlv Garden to fly kites. When his second son fell, he encouraged him warmly with the philosophy of kites. In the afternoon, he briefly visited his parents. In the evening, he hurried to Dongli Fitness Club to play squash with Lin Feng, who pointed out his backhand weakness. That night, he searched for videos and practiced hard. Late at night, he still kept up his advanced technician studies. The whole day was a perfect blend of family, sports, and self-improvement.

events.name: Systematic lumbar rehabilitation and strengthening.
events.description: Got up at 8:30 and completed a 40-minute rehabilitation routine in the living room: warm-up, bird dog, plank, superman, glute bridge, and cat-cow. Performed each movement slowly to feel it, and finished with foam rolling.

events.name: Flying kites at Wanlv Garden and the younger son's minor injury
events.description: At 10:00, the family arrived at Wanlv Garden. Lu Mingqiang taught the eldest son to launch the kite, while the younger son chased behind. At around 11:00, Lu Zihan accidentally tripped and fell, scraping his knee and crying loudly. Lu Mingqiang quickly treated the wound and, pointing at the high-flying kite, said: 'If the kite string breaks, it can be tied back together; if you fall, you can stand up and fly even higher!' The eldest son also came over to help comfort him, and Zihan's tears turned into a smile. At 12:00, they reeled in the kite and went home.

events.name: Visiting parents
events.description: 14:00, he drove alone to his parents' home in Meilan District (his wife stayed home to take care of the child's nap), sat and chatted with his parents for an hour, and his mother gave him some homemade rice cakes. He returned at 15:30.

events.name: Squash match and backhand weakness
events.description: At 18:00, he played a match against Lin Feng at the squash court. Lin Feng scored frequently with his agile backhand and directly pointed out after the match that Lu Mingqiang's backhand side was weak. Lu Mingqiang was a bit unconvinced at first, but after calming down he admitted the shortcoming and immediately agreed to a rematch next month.

events.name: Search for backhand instructional videos
events.description: Arrived home at 19:30, immediately searched for the national coach's squash backhand tutorial, watched it, then sent the link to Lin Feng with a message: "Next month I won't let you score easily."

events.name: Studying relay protection for the senior technician exam.
events.description: 21:00-21:45, studied impedance calculation for distance protection, supplemented notes, while still recalling squash footwork in his mind.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to an eventful family day.

end_state.mood: Recharged by both family warmth and the flame of competition

events.name: Routine maintenance of the power distribution cabinet.

Chen Jianguo suggested practicing cable terminations more often, and Lu Mingqiang kept that in mind.

events.name: Studying motor control circuits

events.name: Parent-child reading

events.name: Morning waist stretches

2025-02.daily_overview: On the Lantern Festival, Lu Mingqiang completed the box-type substation inspection in the morning and left work early in the afternoon to prepare for the holiday. In the evening, the family went to Fucheng to attend the Flower Exchange Festival, enjoying lanterns, guessing lantern riddles, and eating tangyuan. The eldest son guessed a riddle and won a small prize, and the family was immersed in the festive reunion of traditional customs.

events.name: Morning core training.

events.name: Box transformer inspection work

events.name: Study power system fault analysis
events.description: During the lunch break 13:00-13:30, I reviewed the fault analysis process in the textbook and, combined with a low-voltage phase-loss case from last month, sorted out the standard troubleshooting steps.

events.name: Prepare items for the Lantern Festival outing
events.description: At 17:00, the couple packed small lanterns for the children, prepared snacks and water, and planned the route to Fucheng.

events.name: The whole family at the Fucheng Flower Exchange Festival
events.description: At 18:00, he drove to Qiongshan District. The streets were crowded with people and colorful lanterns hung high. Lu Mingqiang shielded his wife and children as they made their way through the crowd, watching lion dances and admiring the lanterns.

events.name: Eldest son won a prize for solving lantern riddles.
events.description: In the lantern riddle area, Lu Zixuan got two riddles right in a row and won a delicate little lantern. Lu Mingqiang took photos to record it, and his wife kept praising how smart he was.

events.name: Tasting sweet rice balls for the Lantern Festival.
events.description: On the road they came across a tangyuan stall. Lu Mingqiang bought two bowls and shared them. The children asked about the custom, Wang Lijuan teased Lu Mingqiang for not knowing enough culture, and the whole family laughed and joked.

events.name: Return home and rest

events.name: Wife preparing dinner.

After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to wash the dishes, his wife wiped the table, and the children played with puzzles in the living room.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lu Mingqiang completed his routine 5 km morning run with Chen Bin in the early morning and did full recovery after the run. In the morning, he studied the relay protection chapter in depth; after receiving his salary, he allocated family funds as usual. Later, he eagerly helped his neighbor Uncle Wang inspect and repair the electrical circuit, winning praise from the neighbors. In the evening, he first studied for the senior technician exam, and then his second son asked to do parent-child reading on his own initiative; the habit has taken root in the child's heart.

events.name: Morning run and rehabilitation training
events.description: Got up at 6:15, and at 6:40 jogged 5 kilometers side by side with Chen Bin in Baishamen Park (pace 6:10 per kilometer). After the run, the two exchanged updates on their recent fitness. Then he did 30 minutes of systematic rehabilitation: superman exercises, glute bridges, side bridges, and cat-cow pose, and wore a new lumbar support belt.

events.name: In-depth study of relay protection.
events.description: 9:30-10:30, in the study, used the forum's busbar differential protection case to break down the protection action logic and deepen understanding.

events.name: Salary arrival and financial allocation
events.description: At 10:40 he received a salary of 4,000 yuan. Using mobile banking, he transferred 2,000 yuan to the daily account, 1,000 yuan to the education fund, and kept the rest as flexible funds. After checking, his wife confirmed it in the account book.

events.name: Helped neighbor Uncle Wang check and repair the electrical circuit
events.description: 11:00 Uncle Wang next door asked for help because his socket had no power. Lu Mingqiang went over with his tool bag, used a multimeter to find the aged connector, quickly cleaned and rewired it, and restored power. Uncle Wang wanted to treat him to Hainan-style tea, but he smiled and declined.

events.name: Evening study for the senior technician exam
events.description: From 20:00 to 20:45, after dinner Lu Mingqiang studied in his study for 45 minutes, reviewing the difficult points in the relay protection chapter and previewing the automatic devices content to be studied the next day.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, looking forward to starting Saturday with a morning run.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling; exercise, learning, helping others, and parent-child time blended perfectly.

2025-02.daily_overview: Early Sunday morning, Lu Mingqiang enjoyed some rare time alone, savoring laoba tea in the old street. In the morning, he focused on preparing for the senior technician exam and studied the chapter on automatic devices in depth. At noon, the whole family went to his parents’ home for a meal; he took the initiative to help inspect and repair the electrical circuits, and the bond between generations warmed amid the food and care. After returning home in the afternoon, he spent the evening helping the children prepare their school supplies for the start of the coming week.

events.name: Enjoying a reading session over Laoba tea alone in the early morning.
events.description: Woke up at 6 a.m., washed up, and changed into comfortable casual clothes. At 7:10 he left home on Jinmao Middle Road and walked to his usual Laoba Teahouse. After arriving at 7:30, he chose a corner seat and ordered a pot of Tieguanyin tea and a serving of qingbuliang. He took out his phone to read an electrical engineering e-book, focusing on the case analyses in the automatic devices chapter for senior technicians, and occasionally watched the elderly patrons in the teahouse playing chess and chatting leisurely. Around 9 a.m. he paid and left, feeling happy and refreshed.

events.name: In the morning, he studied the automatic devices chapter of the senior technician course in depth.
events.description: After getting home at 9:30, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and continued studying the automatic devices chapter for the senior technician qualification. He carefully studied the working principles and commissioning essentials of the automatic reclosing device and took notes.

events.name: Carry out waist rehabilitation training as planned
events.description: After a short break from studying, Lu Mingqiang did 15 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation training on the living room mat, focusing on bridging and cat-cow stretches, feeling his lumbar spine stretch segment by segment and his core activate, maintaining spinal stability.

events.name: The whole family drove to my parents' house for lunch.
events.description: At 11 a.m., Lu Mingqiang drove his private car, carrying his wife Wang Lijuan, his eldest son Lu Zixuan, and his second son Lu Zihan, from their home in Longhua District to his parents' home on Haifu Road, Meilan District. After arriving, his mother Chen Xiuying had already prepared a meal, including Hainanese chicken rice, braised fish, and garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves. His father Lu Jianguo asked about the two grandsons' winter vacation homework and interest classes. Before the meal, Lu Mingqiang helped set the table, and his wife helped serve the soup.

events.name: Helped his father inspect the home's electrical circuits to eliminate hidden dangers.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to take out his portable test pen and multimeter and thoroughly checked the home electrical circuits for his father, Lu Jianguo. He started from the main breaker and tested each circuit one by one. He found that a socket in the kitchen had loose wiring and a worn-out casing, and immediately tightened and replaced it. He also explained to his father simple ways to identify aging wiring and reminded him to be careful during the summer peak electricity usage. His father nodded in approval.

events.name: Drove back home in the afternoon.
events.description: At 4 p.m., after the visit, Lu Mingqiang drove his family back home on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District. The children had fallen asleep in the back seat, and his wife gently woke them when they arrived. Lu Mingqiang took a short rest and organized his toolbox.

events.name: In the evening, accompanied the children in organizing their school supplies for the start of the term.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and his wife helped their two children organize their school supplies: washing schoolbags, sharpening pencils, and covering textbooks. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, checked his winter break homework, while the younger son, Lu Zihan, imitated his brother's movements. At 10:30 p.m., the family turned off the lights and went to bed.

start_state.mood: Calm and peaceful.

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Walk to and from the teahouse; lower back rehabilitation training (bridge exercise, cat-cow pose)

2025-02.daily_overview: On Monday, a workday, Lu Mingqiang quickly switched into a busy but orderly routine. During the day, he teamed up with co-workers Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to perform the annual maintenance of power distribution cabinets at a commercial plaza; he was responsible for inspecting key parts and carefully identified hidden defects. After work, he continued preparing for the senior technician exam and doing lower back rehabilitation, and before bed he read a picture book with his younger son — life was compact and full. In the evening, he received photos of wine bottles shared by a friend from his collection circle, and he found time to reply and exchange messages.

events.name: Reported for duty and began the annual maintenance of the power distribution cabinet.
events.description: Got up at 6:30 in the morning, and after a simple breakfast drove 10 minutes to the company in Xiuying District. At the pre-shift meeting, Team Leader Zhang assigned the task: annual maintenance of the power distribution cabinets at Hongchenghu Commercial Plaza. Lu Mingqiang formed a team with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang, and arrived at the site at 8 o'clock with tools and drawings. He mainly used a multimeter and an insulation resistance tester to check circuits and switches section by section. Chen Jianguo was in charge of recording, and Zhao Qiang assisted in removing and installing panels. During the process, a control circuit connection was found loose due to vibration, posing a risk of poor contact. It was immediately re-tightened and lock washers were added.

events.name: During the lunch break, chatted with fellow workers about family matters.
events.description: At noon, the three of them squatted in a corner of the mall and quickly finished their boxed lunches. Chen Jianguo talked about how his child would sign up for a football class after school started, Zhao Qiang brought up the topic of his parents back home urging him to get married, and Lu Mingqiang smiled as he shared how his eldest son had changed since joining a programming class. The short break was full of the flavor of everyday life.

events.name: Completed maintenance and tested the power-on in the afternoon
events.description: Work resumed at 2 p.m. Replaced several sets of slightly corroded terminal blocks and performed open-close tests on all switches. At 4:30, all work orders were completed, and power was energized successfully in one go. The mall property manager thanked us repeatedly. After returning to the company to submit the work orders, Team Leader Zhang praised the team's efficiency.

events.name: Got off work, went home, and had dinner with family
events.description: Arrived home at 5:40 p.m. My wife Wang Lijuan had already cooked dinner, including braised hairtail, stir-fried water spinach with shrimp paste, and seaweed egg drop soup. At the dinner table, Wang Lijuan talked about an elderly person she had met while doing part-time housekeeping who lived alone and had trouble moving around. We all sighed and said we should visit Grandma and Grandpa more often.

events.name: Evening study of the high-voltage electrical equipment chapter
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang went into his study and, as planned, studied the high-voltage electrical equipment chapter for senior electrician technicians, focusing on the structure of high-voltage circuit breakers and maintenance standards. Combining this with the actual maintenance work he did during the day, he participated in a forum discussion about excessive moisture in SF6 circuit breakers, which deepened his understanding.

events.name: Perform lower back rehabilitation exercises to strengthen lateral stability
events.description: At 8:40 I started a 15-minute lower back rehabilitation session, doing side planks and bird-dog exercises to strengthen the muscles on both sides of the lower back and abdomen and improve pelvic stability. During the exercises, I felt that my right-side support time was about 10 seconds longer than last week.

events.name: Before bed, he read animal picture books with his second son and replied to messages in the collectibles circle
events.description: At 9:30, Lu Mingqiang went to the children's room. His second son, Lu Zihan, was still awake and ran over holding Guess How Much I Love You. He picked up his younger son, leaned against the headboard, and softly read a few pages. The boy imitated the little rabbit spreading its arms, which amused him. At 9:45 the child fell asleep peacefully. Then he opened WeChat and saw that his friend Chen Jianguo from the liquor bottle collecting circle had sent a set of photos of newly acquired 1990s Hainan Daqu liquor bottles. He replied and exchanged collecting insights.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: Fulfilling but slightly tired.

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation training (side plank, bird-dog).

date_attribute.weather: Overcast, turning sunny in the afternoon

2025-02.daily_overview: On Tuesday morning, Lu Mingqiang and his team completed the final acceptance of the distribution cabinet at the commercial plaza. In the afternoon, they attended the company's safety production learning session, which strengthened safety awareness through accident warnings. In the evening, after studying power system analysis, he proactively looked up the Madame Xian Cultural Festival schedule, planning to take the whole family to experience folk customs. The video call with his childhood friend Wang Hai renewed their bond across the distance and gave him spiritual encouragement.

events.name: Complete the remaining maintenance work at the commercial plaza.
events.description: After arriving at work in the morning, the team went again to Hongcheng Lake Commercial Plaza to finish up yesterday's maintenance work — replacing the last batch of switch labels with unclear markings and cleaning the dust inside the distribution cabinets. Lu Mingqiang guided Zhao Qiang while working, showing him how to quickly identify the rated parameters of various switches. Everything was done by 10:30. The property management signed to confirm, and the work order was filed.

events.name: Attended the company's monthly safety production learning meeting.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the company's Engineering Service Department organized the monthly safety production study session in the conference room. Manager Liu presided over it and focused on explaining the clauses on working at heights and temporary electricity use in the newly revised "Safety Regulations for Electric Power Work". Then a warning video was played showing an accident in which an arc burn was caused by illegal operation. Lu Mingqiang watched intently and was deeply affected by the miserable condition of the injured person in the video.

events.name: Organize meeting notes to deepen memory
events.description: After the study session ended, Lu Mingqiang returned to his workstation and, in his dedicated work notebook, recorded item by item the key revisions to the new regulations and the accident chain analysis. In red pen he marked the three operational changes that must be immediately implemented in the team: verifying the voltage tester is intact before testing for voltage, double-hook protection for work at height, and daily leakage protection tests for temporary power use.

events.name: Discussed implementation measures for the new regulations with colleagues.
events.description: After sorting out the notes, Lu Mingqiang proactively called Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to discuss how to put the new clauses into practice in the team rest area. After discussion, the three posted a tip sheet for the three-step electric verification confirmation in a prominent spot on the toolbox, and agreed to supervise each other's use of safety harnesses for working at heights starting tomorrow.

events.name: After work, he looked up information about the Lady Xian Cultural Festival.
events.description: After arriving home in the evening and having dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa and used his phone to look up the detailed schedule of the Lady Xian Cultural Festival (Junpo Festival) in Meilan District. He found the schedule published on the official public account, noted the time slots for the lion dance, bayin performance, and military parade starting at 7 p.m. on February 19, and forwarded it to his wife. The couple decided that the whole family would attend tomorrow.

events.name: Video call with childhood friend Wang Hai to maintain their friendship
events.description: At 7:30 p.m., received a WeChat video call from childhood friend Wang Hai in Shenzhen. After connecting, they chatted for about half an hour. Wang Hai shared the opening of his new store in Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen, lamenting that brick-and-mortar business is not easy but the momentum is still good. Lu Mingqiang talked about his post-holiday troubleshooting of a ring main unit fault and his awkward backhand practice in squash. Wang Hai laughed and encouraged him to keep improving his skills and also relax properly in life. They agreed to go have laoba tea and grilled fish together next time they return to Haikou.

events.name: In the evening, studied the power system analysis chapter.
events.description: After the phone call, Lu Mingqiang entered the study at 20:30 to study the power system analysis chapter for senior technicians, focusing on short-circuit current calculation and relay protection coordination. He saw a case on a forum about distribution network power flow analysis and carried out a simulated calculation based on the community distribution room he had encountered.

events.name: Do lower back stretching and bodyweight strength training
events.description: Training started at 21:10, focusing today on stretching and isometric contractions to relieve the stiffness caused by sitting through meetings during the day. First I did supine knee-hug stretches and dead bug static holds, then completed bodyweight strength training: push-ups 3×20 reps, bodyweight squats 3×20 reps. My lower back felt very relaxed.

start_state.mood: In an orderly manner

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Lower back stretching and isometric exercises, bodyweight strength training (push-ups, squats)

2025-02.daily_overview: Wednesday: Lu Mingqiang handled two low-voltage faults in the morning. After the lunch break, he asked for leave and went home early to prepare for the whole family to attend the Madame Xian Cultural Festival. In the evening, he took his wife and children to the Cultural Square in Meilan District, where they were immersed in the lively atmosphere of lion dances and eight-tone music. The children put on Tang suits and joined the Zhuangjun parade, deeply experiencing local folk customs. After returning home, they shared videos with the elders, and the joy lasted late into the night.

events.name: In the morning, handled low-voltage faults in the residential area and mentored the apprentice
events.description: At 8 a.m., he received a dispatch order from the dispatching center: two old residential communities on Jinmao Street had problems with unstable voltage and tripped switches respectively. Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang and quickly rode an electric bike to the scenes. In the first community, they found poor contact caused by oxidation of the outgoing wires in the meter box. While sanding the wire ends, he explained to Zhao Qiang how to identify oxidation and heating. In the second community, they found that the aging residual current device was tripping falsely; after replacing it with a new one, power was restored. Zhao Qiang said he learned a lot of hands-on experience.

events.name: After the lunch break, took leave to go home early to prepare for the folk custom activity.
events.description: At noon, after returning to the company to submit the work order, he asked Team Leader Zhang for two hours of compensatory leave that afternoon (using overtime comp time from before), and the supervisor approved. Lu Mingqiang got home at 12:30 and, together with his wife Wang Lijuan, changed their two sons into the little Tang-style outfits bought before the New Year, and prepared hot water, biscuits, wet wipes, and two portable folding stools. His wife also took out a miniature gold-gilded paper armor prop of a guardian general for the eldest son Lu Zixuan to wear, and the younger son Lu Zihan was given a small sachet embroidered with an auspicious lion.

events.name: In the evening, drove to the main venue of the cultural festival.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove the family car, carrying his wife and children, from their home in Longhua District. It was rush hour, so the roads were a bit congested. The children in the back seat asked questions excitedly without stopping. Lu Mingqiang patiently told the historical stories of Lady Xian defending the territory and protecting the people. About 50 minutes later, they arrived at the Cultural Plaza in Meilan District, found a parking space, and walked into the venue.

events.name: Watch lion dance and bayin performances.
events.description: At 7 p.m., the main stage lights came on, and a professional lion dance troupe leaped and tumbled to the beating of drums and gongs. Lu Zixuan, the elder son, sat on Lu Mingqiang's shoulders waving a small flag, while the younger son, held in his mother's arms, watched without blinking. Then the Bayin ensemble played loud, passionate traditional tunes with instruments such as the suona and yehu, building to one climax after another. Lu Mingqiang recorded a few videos on his phone to send to his parents.

events.name: Family participation in the Zhuangjun parade experience
events.description: After the performance, the parade began moving from the square down the streets. Lu Zixuan put on his little armor and walked in the children's soldier formation with a serious air, head high and chest out. Lu Mingqiang followed beside the formation carrying their younger son, while his wife took photos from the side. Residents along the route tossed popcorn and candy to the parade, and children eagerly picked them up. The whole neighborhood was immersed in the carnival of local culture.

events.name: Returned home late at night and shared via video call with grandparents.
events.description: At 9 p.m., the parade ended. Lu Mingqiang drove the family back to their home in Longhua District. After arriving home, the children were still very excited. Lu Zixuan took Lu Mingqiang's phone and video-called his grandparents, chattering on about his experience marching in the parade. Lu Mingqiang organized photos on the computer and briefly shared his feelings about the day's activities with his wife, feeling that this kind of folk heritage was very beneficial to the children's growth.

events.name: Brief study and rehabilitation training before bedtime
events.description: Because the activity took up a lot of time, Lu Mingqiang only skimmed the chapter on fault diagnosis technology for senior technicians for 15 minutes and marked a few key pages. Then he did 10 minutes of beginner-level lower back rehabilitation exercises on a mat, mainly glute bridges and dead bugs, to maintain activation.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation

end_state.mood: Excited and exhausted

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation exercises (glute bridges, dead bug), walking patrol of about 2 kilometers.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Thursday, after completing maintenance on the factory transformer, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to call his mentor, Master Li, during his lunch break to ask in detail about the senior technician exam, and received valuable guidance on the process and review direction. In the evening, he systematically studied the safety regulations and recorded exam-preparation information, and made a breakthrough in the core strength circuit of his rehabilitation training. Before going to bed, he also discussed setting aside the exam registration fee with his wife. After work, he stopped by a hardware store on the way and bought some craft materials for his son.

events.name: Completed factory transformer maintenance in the morning
events.description: In the morning, the team went to a food processing factory near Haisheng Road in Xiuying District to perform quarterly maintenance on its 200kVA transformer. Lu Mingqiang partnered with Chen Jianguo to carry out insulation resistance tests, oil level checks, and terminal tightening. He used his phone to photograph the tap changer position and compared it with the previous record to confirm there was no abnormal shift. The whole process was standardized and quick, completed at 10:30, ensuring the reliability of the factory's power supply.

events.name: Called my mentor during the lunch break to consult about the senior technician exam.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang took out his phone under the factory rest shed, took a deep breath, and called Master Li. He respectfully asked about the registration time for the senior technician theory exam, the operational assessment process, and the key review scope. Master Li answered in detail, emphasizing that he should focus on automatic devices and fault diagnosis, and that the defense session should focus on practical case analysis. He encouraged him to sign up boldly and promised to look for the review papers he had used before in the next couple of days.

events.name: Record key exam-preparation information and express gratitude
events.description: After the call, Lu Mingqiang immediately wrote in his notebook: registration requires an ID card, the original and photocopy of the electrician certificate, and three 2-inch blue-background photos; the preliminary review is in mid-March, and the theory exam is in April. Then he sent Master Li a voice message of thanks via WeChat, saying he would definitely work hard.

events.name: In the afternoon, finish the maintenance report and return to the company.
events.description: Back at the company in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang entered the transformer maintenance data into the electronic work order system and attached the test photos. He then helped Chen Jianguo organize the tool warehouse and scrapped a batch of expired insulating gloves.

events.name: After work, went to a hardware store to buy craft materials.
events.description: After getting off work at 5:00, Lu Mingqiang stopped by a hardware store on Haisheng Road to buy a new digital multimeter (the old one's backlight no longer worked), along with some small screws, wooden boards, and glue, planning to make a simple electric-powered car model with his sons over the weekend. The shop owner, Old Li, chatted about business, and Lu Mingqiang also shared some interesting stories from recent community inspections.

events.name: Evening study of safety regulations and construction management
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang was in the study concentrating on the safety regulations and construction management chapters for the senior technician exam. Comparing the new clauses from the work safety study session the day before yesterday, he systematically organized the writing standards for construction organization measures and technical measures, and used a red pen to mark the division of responsibilities among the work ticket issuer, the person in charge, and the permit issuer.

events.name: Core strength circuit training and bodyweight training
events.description: Training started at 8:50. Today he did a continuous core strength circuit: 30-second plank, 20-second side bridge per side, 10 bird-dogs, for 3 rounds. Then he completed bodyweight strength training: 3×15 narrow push-ups and 3×20 bodyweight squats. He felt his control of the sacroiliac area had noticeably improved.

events.name: Discussed the exam registration budget with his wife.
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan sat on the edge of the bed and briefly discussed that the senior technician exam fee was expected to be about 800 yuan, to be set aside from April's salary without affecting daily expenses. His wife expressed support and told him to focus on preparing for the exam.

start_state.mood: Clear sense of purpose

end_state.mood: Determined and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Core strength circuit training, bodyweight strength training (close-grip push-ups, squats)

2025-02.daily_overview: On Friday, Lu Mingqiang completed the week's maintenance wrap-up and tool inventory. In the evening, he reviewed his study achievements for the week, identified difficult questions, and planned to ask his master for further guidance. After completing one cycle of waist rehabilitation training and an evaluation, he planned to increase the weight next week. Before bed, he used fun experiments to explain mechanical principles to his two sons, igniting their curiosity and making the parent-child time especially lively.

events.name: In the morning, organized this week's maintenance report.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang helped Team Leader Zhang sort out the five maintenance reports completed this week for the commercial plaza and the factory, checked the data item by item, and scanned and archived the paper work orders. He also added the safety measure records from the study session on the 18th, ensuring that every task left a trace.

events.name: Afternoon: take inventory of tools and apply for consumables.
events.description: In the afternoon, the company warehouse carried out a monthly tool inventory. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for counting his team's power tools and protective equipment. He found that the power cord sheath of an impact drill was cracked, and immediately put a repair-needed tag on it. Meanwhile, he filled out a requisition form for 25 rolls of insulating tape and 100 wire connectors of different specifications to replenish commonly used consumables.

events.name: In the evening, received the review materials sent by my mentor.
events.description: When he got home from work, his wife handed him a courier package sent by Master Li. When he opened it, inside were several old editions of electrician handbooks and photocopies of his review notes from the year he took the technician exam. Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved and immediately called Master Li to thank him for his support and discussed a few specific questions.

events.name: In the evening, organize study notes and mark difficult points.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang reviewed and reorganized the notes from the four chapters he studied this week: automatic devices, high-voltage equipment, system analysis, and safety regulations. He marked the knowledge points he kept getting wrong (such as harmonic analysis and differential protection setting) with red sticky notes, planning to ask Master Li for help intensively next week.

events.name: Completed this week's final lower back rehabilitation assessment
events.description: At 8:40 did 15 minutes of lumbar rehabilitation training, integrating all the movements from this week, doing the entire sequence and observing myself. Compared with the beginning of the month, lumbar mobility in Cat-Cow pose has noticeably increased, but the right side is still somewhat weaker in side plank, so I decided to introduce resistance band training next week.

events.name: Use a model to explain the principle of the wooden ox and flowing horse
events.description: At 9 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang took out old gears, chains, and a self-made trolley model and demonstrated on the living room floor to his two sons the movement principle of the wooden ox and flowing horse from the Three Kingdoms. He used a wrench to analogize the crank-rod mechanism, explaining how rotary motion is turned into walking. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, was fascinated and even drew a sketch, while the younger son pushed the trolley back and forth on the tea table. The room was filled with exclamations and laughter.

start_state.mood: Organized

end_state.mood: Satisfied and full of a sense of achievement.

state.daily_exercise: Waist rehabilitation training (integrated training and assessment).

date_attribute.weather: Light fog in the early morning, then turning sunny.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang and his running partner Chen Bin enjoyed a refreshing 5-kilometer morning run in Baishamen Park. However, in the afternoon he was dragged by a coworker to a mahjong social gathering, and because he was out of practice, he lost money. The unpleasant experience made him deeply realize that such activities ran counter to his interests, and that night he resolved to firmly refuse from then on. Evening study and rehabilitation continued as usual, and his wife went to borrow new picture books, enriching the family's reading resources.

events.name: Early morning run with running buddy Chen Bin at Baishamen Park
events.description: Got up at 6:30, left at 6:50, and met Chen Bin at the gate of Baishamen Park in Haikou at 7:00. They first did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching and joint activation, then jogged 5 kilometers along the coastal running track. During the run, Chen Bin shared his training plan for preparing for the Sanya Half Marathon, while Lu Mingqiang mentioned that his running landing stability had improved after his recent lower back recovery. After the run, they did cool-down stretching, and Chen Bin specially reminded Lu Mingqiang to bring his lumbar support gear to protect his back. After returning home, he wrote in his diary: pace 6:10 per kilometer, no lower back discomfort, can try increasing distance next week.

events.name: In the morning, I contacted my squash partner to schedule a focused practice session.
events.description: After returning from his run, showering, and eating breakfast, Lu Mingqiang contacted his squash partner Lin Feng via WeChat and arranged a targeted backhand technique practice session at their usual squash court at 3 p.m. tomorrow (Sunday). Lin Feng replied that he looked forward to seeing the progress Lu Mingqiang had made over the past two weeks.

events.name: Agreed to the mahjong invitation reluctantly to save face
events.description: A little after 10 a.m., his coworker Chen Jianguo called, saying that Zhao Qiang and another colleague were three players short of a fourth and asking him to go to a street-side teahouse to play mahjong that afternoon. Lu Mingqiang hesitated, but then remembered that he hadn't gotten together privately with the brothers since the Spring Festival, and reluctantly agreed for the sake of their friendship.

events.name: Felt unwell after losing money at the afternoon mahjong social engagement
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang walked to a street-side teahouse in Jinmao Community. Four people sat down and began playing Haikou mahjong. He rarely played, so his skills were rusty. After a few rounds, he couldn't keep track of the scoring and kept dealing into others' winning hands. In less than two hours, he lost more than 80 yuan and felt increasingly uneasy, thinking it was both a waste of time and meaningless.

events.name: Left early on the pretext of picking up the child and reflected.
events.description: At 5 p.m., Lu Mingqiang used the excuse of having to pick up his child from an interest class and got up from the card table to leave. Although Chen Jianguo smiled and tried to keep him there, he firmly put on his coat and left. Walking out of the teahouse, he felt as if a heavy burden had been lifted, and he became even more determined to steer clear of such occasions. On the way home, he sent Chen Jianguo a WeChat message: "Don't invite me to this kind of event in the future. I still prefer having tea and going for runs with you."

events.name: Wife borrowed new picture books to enrich the reading corner
events.description: While Lu Mingqiang was out for a social engagement, his wife Wang Lijuan went to the community library in the morning and borrowed a batch of new picture books for the children, including a children's edition of Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Fabre's Insect Stories, and several picture books on emotion management, planning to use them as parent-child reading material for the coming week.

events.name: Evening study of circuit analysis and fault diagnosis.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang studied as planned, opening the senior technician textbook and reviewing the circuit analysis and fault diagnosis modules. He focused on practicing the logic tree for deducing fault points from symptoms and completed two accompanying mock tests with an accuracy rate of about 80%.

events.name: Perform lower back stretching and core training as planned
events.description: At 8:40, I started a 15-minute rehabilitation training session. Today I did the Monday category of the strengthening plan, including a 30-second plank, side-lying leg raises, and pelvic tilts, combined with deep diaphragmatic breathing. I felt the deep core muscles being completely activated.

start_state.mood: Full of energy.

end_state.mood: Even more determined after reflection

state.daily_exercise: 5 km morning run, lower back rehabilitation training (core strengthening)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with an afternoon high of 26°C.

2025-02.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang spent the morning doing crafts with the children. In the afternoon, he focused on improving his squash backhand technique, practicing with Lin Feng at the court for about two hours and recording videos. In the evening, he reviewed the videos at home and gained a deeper understanding of the movements. The evening family reading time was warm; the eldest son tried reading aloud to his younger brother to practice his expression skills, and the whole family reviewed this week's picture books together, as the reading habit took root in daily life. Study and rehabilitation were not neglected either.

events.name: Prepare squash gear in the morning.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang packed his squash racket, sports shoes, spare grip, and a water bottle filled with water into his sports bag, and also stuffed a towel and pain relief cream (in case of lower back discomfort) into the small bag. For breakfast he ate the steamed dumplings and soy milk his wife had made.

events.name: Spent the morning doing crafts with the children
events.description: From 9:30 to 10:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang took out the wooden boards and motor models he had bought before and tried to assemble a simple toy car with his two sons in the living room. The children were very excited and enjoyed it.

events.name: Drive to the squash court for backhand-specific practice
events.description: At 2:30 pm, Lu Mingqiang drove alone to the squash court in Guomao. At exactly 3:00, Lin Feng arrived, and after a brief warm-up, the two began practicing. Lin Feng, addressing Lu's problem of inconsistent backhand power, broke down and demonstrated the whipping power-generation movement. Lu Mingqiang repeatedly hit target points on the glass wall while Lin Feng used his phone to film his side-on movements. Later they played a light rally, with Lin Feng deliberately sending more balls to the backhand side, and Lu Mingqiang gradually found the right timing to hit the ball.

events.name: Sharing insights in the rest area and agreeing to a rematch
events.description: After about an hour and a half of practice, the two drank Pocari Sweat in the rest area. Lin Feng played back the video and pointed out that Lu Mingqiang's shoulder turn was too slow, and suggested hanging from a horizontal bar to increase shoulder girdle flexibility. Lu Mingqiang said he would practice that specifically, and the two agreed to play a complete match on the first weekend of next month.

events.name: Reviewing videos at home to reinforce memory of the movements.
events.description: Returned home at 5:30 p.m. In his study, Lu Mingqiang watched the video sent by Lin Feng on his computer and compared it with slow-motion backhand clips of professional players online.
