He noted three key points: turn sideways into position before hitting, delay the wrist release, and shift the weight forward. He planned to practice swinging the racket at home next.

events.name: Evening family parent-child reading and sharing.
events.description: After dinner, around 7:30, the family sat together in the reading corner of the living room. The wife brought out a newly borrowed picture book. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, volunteered to read The Three Little Pigs to his younger brother. Although he didn't recognize some characters, he finished it smoothly with the help of pinyin and memory, and his younger brother clapped happily. Then Lu Mingqiang read the Empty City Stratagem section from the picture book Romance of the Three Kingdoms to the two children, which led his elder son to keep asking about Zhuge Liang's wisdom.

events.name: The family reviewed this week's picture books to encourage reading
events.description: After the shared reading, the family of four briefly reviewed all the storybooks they had read this week, and the two sons competed to retell their favorite parts. Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan each gave the children sticker rewards to encourage them to continue next week. The reading corner was tidied up to make room for new books.

events.name: Studied motor principles and maintenance in the evening.
events.description: At 8 PM, Lu Mingqiang studied the motor principles and maintenance chapter for the senior technician exam in his study, focusing on the structural characteristics and common faults of asynchronous motors. He completed the supporting exercises from the textbook and marked the wrong questions so that he could review them next week.

events.name: Do lower back flexibility and strength training.
events.description: At 8:45, I started 15 minutes of rehabilitation training, doing the planned Tuesday lower back flexibility and strength routine: supine twist stretches, bridge variations, and light-weight loaded bird dog. I felt my dynamic stability improve.

start_state.mood: Lively and positive.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and gratified

state.daily_exercise: Squash backhand specialized practice for about 1.5 hours; waist rehabilitation training (flexibility and strength)

2025-02.daily_overview: On Monday, at the team meeting, Chen Jianguo joked about Lu Mingqiang losing at mahjong on Saturday. He laughed it off, but inwardly became even more determined in his refusal. All day he went with the team to old residential communities to survey the wiring and collect data for the upcoming renovation project. Though tired from climbing stairs, the work was solid. In the evening, study and rehabilitation training proceeded as planned, and before bed he used a foam roller to relax his lower back. After work, he also helped his neighbor Old Wang repair a tripped leakage circuit breaker.

events.name: Joked and made a firm statement at the pre-shift meeting.
events.description: At the 8 a.m. pre-shift meeting, Team Leader Zhang assigned the week's tasks: coordinate with the power supply bureau to conduct a pre-renovation survey of the low-voltage lines in three old residential communities in Longhua District. Chen Jianguo suddenly brought up Lu Mingqiang losing at mahjong on Saturday, saying he didn't expect a technical expert to stumble at the card table. The group burst into laughter. Lu Mingqiang smiled and shook his head, saying he would never play mahjong again. His tone was relaxed but his attitude was serious, and Chen Jianguo tactfully patted him on the shoulder as a sign of respect.

events.name: Morning inspection of old residential area power lines
events.description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang took the drawings and a rangefinder, and rode electric bikes to the first target residential community, Binhai New Village. They checked the electricity meters and service entrance lines building by building, and recorded more than ten instances of aging wiring and unauthorized connections. As he surveyed, Lu Mingqiang marked the cable routing paths on the sketch, providing a basis for designing the renovation plan later.

events.name: Simple lunch and brief exchange at noon
events.description: At 1 o'clock, he ate garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves with white-cut duck rice at a small eatery near the community. Chen Jianguo brought up the funny incidents from yesterday's mahjong game again, but this time his tone was teasing Lu Mingqiang's serious personality. Lu Mingqiang added a few words in agreement, and the topic shifted to the spider-web-like wiring in the old residential communities; both agreed that the renovation workload would be considerable.

events.name: Continue surveying and recording hazards in the afternoon
events.description: In the afternoon, they moved to the second residential compound, where the buildings were taller. Lu Mingqiang climbed several seven-story walk-up buildings back and forth, carefully inspecting the distribution boxes in the corridors. The blazing sun shone through the gaps between buildings, making him sweat, and his lower back felt a little tight. He adjusted the way he used his strength, trying to climb with his legs as much as possible. At 4:30, he finished the field work and returned to the company to start organizing the data.

events.name: After work, helped neighbor Old Wang fix a tripped circuit breaker.
events.description: In the evening, when he got home, Uncle Wang Jianguo from the next unit was waiting downstairs, saying his home kept tripping the circuit breaker. Lu Mingqiang took his tools over and found that the electric water heater was leaking electricity, causing the leakage protector to trip. He suggested replacing the heating element and temporarily restored the other circuits. Uncle Wang thanked him repeatedly, and Lu Mingqiang only accepted a pack of cigarettes.

events.name: Studying high-voltage power distribution system knowledge in the evening
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang, based on the aging power distribution conditions he observed during the daytime inspection, studied high-voltage power distribution system knowledge for senior technicians, focusing on reading the appendix to the technical guidelines for distribution renovation in old residential communities. Through actual comparison, he gained a deeper understanding of line loss reduction and short-circuit capacity calculation.

events.name: Lower back stability and balance training.
events.description: At 8:45, did 15 minutes of rehabilitation training. Today's focus was single-leg balance pad standing, side bridge holds, and slow bird-dog exercises, emphasizing coordination of the multifidus and transversus abdominis muscles. After training, the feeling of fatigue in his lower back was noticeably reduced.

events.name: Foam rolling relaxation before bed
events.description: At 10:30, Lu Mingqiang took out a foam roller and used it on his lower back and gluteal muscles in the living room to relax them. His wife also pressed a few tense spots for him, which made him feel much better.

start_state.mood: Calm and firm

end_state.mood: Fulfilling but somewhat tiring.

state.daily_exercise: Inspect stair climbing, lumbar rehabilitation training (stability and balance)

2025-02.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lu Mingqiang continued the survey work in the residential area. In the afternoon, he received a reminder text message about the renewal of his special operation certificate. He immediately set a calendar reminder, called his master to ask about the process, and completed the online pre-registration, efficiently handling his occupational compliance matters. In the evening, he studied safety regulations and organized a question bank for the re-examination, fully preparing for the training on March 1.

events.name: Morning inspection of wiring in the old residential community.
events.description: Early in the morning, the team went to the third old residential community, which was built in the early 1990s. The wire gauge was too small, and the aluminum wires were severely oxidized. Lu Mingqiang used an infrared thermometer to check several joints and found three with clearly elevated temperatures. He took photos, recorded the detailed locations, and listed them as top-priority replacement points.

events.name: Received the review reminder and set it on the calendar.
events.description: At 2 p.m., his phone vibrated with a text message from the Haikou Work Safety Qualification Examination Center, reminding him that his high-voltage electrician special operation certificate would expire in early March and that he needed to attend refresher training. Lu Mingqiang immediately opened his phone calendar, marked March 1 as a high-priority event, and added a reminder.

events.name: Called my master to ask about the reexamination process
events.description: After updating the calendar, he immediately called Master Li. Master Li told him to register online one day in advance, then go to the designated test center at the specified time for a one-day refresher training and computer-based exam, bringing his ID and old operation certificate. He also reminded him to review electric shock first aid and fire extinguisher operation questions. Lu Mingqiang noted it all down.

events.name: Submit online pre-registration for re-examination
events.description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang directly logged on to the Haikou Safety Production Qualification Examination Center website, filled in his personal information and certificate number as instructed, selected the March 1 training class session, and received a confirmation receipt after submitting. He saved a screenshot of the receipt and set an alarm for 7 o'clock on the training day.

events.name: Continue surveying and organizing data in the afternoon.
events.description: At 4 p.m., he returned to the company with his colleagues and entered all the hazard points from the three-day survey into an Excel spreadsheet, forming preliminary renovation suggestions. He reported the key findings to Team Leader Zhang and coordinated the purchase of insulated wires of appropriate specifications.

events.name: Evening study of electrical safety regulations and emergency handling
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang studied the emergency response module for the senior technician exam in the study, focusing on electric shock first aid procedures and CPR key points. Then he went through the recertification question bank and did 50 multiple-choice questions; the ones he got wrong were mainly about wire color coding and fire separation distances.

events.name: Do bodyweight strength training and lower back stretching.
events.description: Training started at 8:50. First completed bodyweight strength training: push-ups 3 sets of 20 reps, bodyweight squats 3 sets of 20 reps. Then performed lower back stretching: Cat-Cow Pose and Child's Pose to relax, and felt a slight pump in the muscles.

events.name: Reviewed the key points for the re-examination before bed.
events.description: At 10 o'clock, I lay in bed and spent 10 minutes on my phone going through the recertification question bank, focusing on memorizing CPR compression depth and rate. Only after confirming there were no problems did I rest.

start_state.mood: Alert and focused

end_state.mood: In an orderly manner

state.daily_exercise: Bodyweight strength training (push-ups, squats) and lower back stretching

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, turning to thundershowers (brief heavy rain in the afternoon)

2025-02.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Lu Mingqiang went through an emergency repair, handling a capacitor short-circuit fault in the residential area's power distribution cabinet, intense but efficient. After work, he persisted with backhand training in squash, applying the newly mastered power techniques while practicing with Lin Feng, and made obvious progress. During family reading time, his eldest son developed a strong interest in the characters of the Three Kingdoms, and Lu Mingqiang patiently answered his philosophical questions, teaching through entertainment. In the evening, automation control study and waist training went smoothly, and he applied a hot compress to his waist before bed to cope with the damp cold after the rain.

events.name: Emergency repair of a capacitor short circuit in the power distribution cabinet in the morning.
events.description: At 9 a.m., the dispatch office relayed an urgent work order: thick smoke was coming from a low-voltage distribution cabinet in Binhai New Village. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo quickly grabbed tools and fire extinguishers and drove to the scene in the light rain. After cutting off the upstream power supply, they opened the cabinet door and found that an old capacitor had burned out and short-circuited, igniting the surrounding insulating paper. The two decisively put out the fire, removed the damaged components, replaced it with a high-temperature-resistant capacitor, and restored power within one hour, without causing a widespread power outage. The surrounding residents applauded and expressed their gratitude.

events.name: Return to the company at noon to rest and record.
events.description: At noon, he returned to the company for lunch. Lu Mingqiang recorded the emergency repair process in detail in the incident handling log and suggested carrying out a special inspection of old capacitors. Team Leader Zhang praised his decisive handling and how it protected other equipment.

events.name: Helped with moving goods in the afternoon and took care to protect the lower back
events.description: In the afternoon, a batch of new cables and distribution boxes arrived at the company, and Lu Mingqiang helped move them. Mindful of his back, he took the initiative to use a hand truck, avoided bending down or lifting suddenly, and left the heavier boxes to Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to carry together.

events.name: In the evening, go to the squash court for backhand-specific training.
events.description: After work, went home and had a quick dinner, then left at 6:30 for the squash court at Power Fitness Club. Met Lin Feng at 7:00. After a 20-minute warm-up, began backhand-specific practice. Lin Feng fed balls to fixed positions, and Lu Mingqiang practiced the stroke repeatedly, focusing on feeling the shoulder rotation and delayed wrist release. After an hour of practice, they played a game. Lu Mingqiang's backhand returns improved noticeably, and Lin Feng also gave his approval. It ended around 9:00 and he went home.

events.name: Family picture book reading and a discussion about the Three Kingdoms.
events.description: After squash training, he got home at 9:20. The children were still awake. Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower and joined reading time. This time it was his turn to read "Borrowing Arrows with Straw Boats" from the children's edition of Romance of the Three Kingdoms to the kids. His elder son, Lu Zixuan, was mesmerized and kept asking why Zhuge Liang knew there would be fog and why Cao Cao was so suspicious. Lu Mingqiang explained fog formation using weather forecast examples, and compared trust to the children's experience of making friends, answering as plainly as possible. The younger brother, Lu Zihan, imitated his brother and held up a fire truck picture book while mumbling softly.

events.name: Study the basics of automation control
events.description: At 10 p.m., Lu Mingqiang briefly studied the basics of automation control for 15 minutes in his study, reviewing relay interlock control and introductory PLC logic. He took out an old relay module, compared it with the book, and observed the contact action to deepen his understanding of normally open and normally closed contacts.

events.name: Lower back core strength and endurance training
events.description: At 10:20 he started 15 minutes of rehabilitation training. Today, as planned, he focused on strengthening endurance and control: weighted farmer's walk, 30 meters x 3, side-lying leg raise hold, slow dead bug, with emphasis on core anti-rotation strength. He was drenched in sweat when he finished.

events.name: Applied a hot compress to his lower back before bed to relieve discomfort.
events.description: Because of the damp and cold afternoon weather and some discomfort after training, before bed Lu Mingqiang soaked a towel in hot water, wrung it out, and applied it to his lower back for 15 minutes. His muscles relaxed, and he fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Calm before the busy period.

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled.

state.daily_exercise: About 2 hours of squash backhand-specific training, plus lower back core strength and endurance training

2025-02.daily_overview: On Thursday, after completing the survey report, Lu Mingqiang spent his lunch break doing practice questions to prepare for the renewal review. In the afternoon, the company organized an online training session on high-voltage switchgear fault handling, led by Master Li, from which he gained a lot. In the evening, he systematically reviewed the week's knowledge points and completed a full lower back functional training session and bodyweight strength training. Before bed, he checked his training certificates to prepare for the busy weekend ahead.

events.name: In the morning, organize the survey report and draw up drafts
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang worked together to compile the survey data of three old residential communities into a formal report, using CAD software to sketch a floor plan of the line renovation and mark the wire diameter and load estimate of each branch. After review, Team Leader Zhang proposed two revisions, and Lu Mingqiang corrected them one by one.

events.name: During lunch break, worked on re-certification practice questions to reinforce safety knowledge.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang sat at his workstation and went through the re-examination question bank on his phone, focusing on the electrical safety operating procedures and electric shock first-aid sections. When he came across a question about the compression rate for CPR that he couldn't remember well, he immediately checked the book to confirm and reinforced his memory by talking to himself.

events.name: Attend Master Li's online technical training in the afternoon.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the company organized a video training session, inviting retired Master Li to explain common faults and troubleshooting of 10kV high-voltage switchgear cabinets. Master Li used a circuit breaker failure-to-close case he had experienced to gradually analyze the fault-finding methods for secondary circuits. Lu Mingqiang took careful notes and, during the interactive session, asked about preventing condensation inside the cabinet. Master Li answered in detail and praised him for being thoughtful.

events.name: After work, buy new electrician tools and visit a friend.
events.description: After the training ended and he got off work, Lu Mingqiang stopped by a hardware store on the way and bought a new digital multimeter (the old one's backlight no longer worked) and an induction test pen. Then he went to a nearby tea shop to meet his friend Chen Jianguo from the collecting circle. The two exchanged views on the recent market trends for wine bottle collections. Chen Jianguo said a batch of old wine bottles would arrive next week and invited him to go take a look together.

events.name: In the evening, he encouraged his eldest son's programming project.
events.description: After dinner, his eldest son Lu Zixuan excitedly showed off a small animation he had made in his programming class of a cat chasing a mouse cursor. Lu Mingqiang watched seriously and praised it, then helped his son modify the background color. The father and son were full of laughter.

events.name: Systematically review this week's learning points.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang reviewed the week's study chapters in his study — high-voltage power distribution, safety regulations, fault diagnosis, automation control, etc. — by going through them in sequence and drawing a simple knowledge framework diagram. He used different colors to mark what he had mastered and what was still unclear, preparing to ask Master Li on Saturday.

events.name: Comprehensive lower back functional training and bodyweight strength
events.description: Training started at 8:50 with comprehensive stretching and strength integration: starting with foam roller release, then Cat-Cow, Bird-Dog, and dynamic side bridge. Then bodyweight strength training: close-grip push-ups 3×15 reps, split squats 3×15 reps per side, and finally ending with diaphragmatic breathing relaxation. The whole session was smooth, and lumbar mobility improved noticeably.

events.name: Check tomorrow's training certificates and materials
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang took out his ID card, electrician operation certificate, a 2-inch photo, and the printed renewal confirmation receipt from the drawer, neatly placed them in a transparent document folder, and put it on the shoe cabinet to make sure he wouldn't forget them the next morning.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but orderly

end_state.mood: Peace of mind from being fully prepared

state.daily_exercise: Comprehensive lumbar functional training and bodyweight strength training (close-grip push-ups, split squats)

2025-02.daily_overview: On Friday, Lu Mingqiang wrapped up the week's survey work and submitted the draft plan. After work, he prepared materials for the weekend parent-child handicraft session. The family warmly reviewed the month's reading, and the eldest son made a Three Kingdoms painting as the monthly memento. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang summarized the month's learning results, marked unresolved questions, and completed the final core strength training session, breaking 60 seconds in the plank. Before bed, he reviewed the recertification training materials once more, fully prepared for tomorrow's training.

events.name: Submit the first draft of the renovation plan in the morning.
events.description: Early in the morning at the company, Lu Mingqiang submitted the integrated draft of the old residential community renovation plan (including drawings and bill of materials) to Team Leader Zhang and Manager Liu via the OA system, along with survey photos. After reviewing it, Team Leader Zhang thought the plan was meticulous and arranged a meeting with the power supply bureau next week.

events.name: At noon: final review of the key points for the re-audit training.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the key notes for the re-examination again in the company break room, going over several easily confused points such as electric shock first aid procedures, fire extinguisher selection, and wire color codes, to reinforce short-term memory. When Chen Jianguo passed by, he wished him good luck on tomorrow's exam.

events.name: Handled a temporary repair request in the afternoon
events.description: At 3 p.m., they received a repair request from a lighting store about frequent circuit breaker trips. Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang went to handle it, found that a newly installed display cabinet in the store caused three-phase imbalance, and solved it by redistributing the load. The clean and skilled work earned repeated thanks from the store owner.

events.name: Return books and prepare for crafts after work
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Lu Mingqiang first went to the community library to return some picture books and also borrowed a few popular science books for the children. Back home, he found a large cardboard box, plastic bottles, waste wires, a glue gun, and a motor model from the balcony storage cabinet, planning to make a simple electric-powered small car model with his sons over the weekend. He sorted the materials and put them in a corner.

events.name: Monthly family reading review and craft activity preview.
events.description: After dinner, the family of four sat on the floor in the reading corner, spreading out about 20 picture books they had read this month on the ground. The two children vied to retell snippets from the stories of the wooden ox and flowing horse and borrowing arrows with straw boats. The elder son, Lu Zixuan, gave his father a drawing he had made of Zhuge Liang waving a fan, while the younger son, Lu Zihan, hopped around imitating the little rabbit from a picture book. Lu Mingqiang held both sons, and together with his wife clapped and encouraged them, emphasizing the value of accumulating a little bit of reading every day, and previewed the weekend craft plan, making the children even more excited.

events.name: Lu Mingqiang read aloud to the children and led the discussion.
events.description: After the review, Lu Mingqiang opened the last chapter of Romance of the Three Kingdoms and read aloud to the children a passage about Zhuge Liang's Six Expeditions from Qishan. The elder son excitedly asked why Zhuge Liang had not succeeded. Lu Mingqiang patiently explained the principle of doing one's best and encouraged his son to learn from Zhuge Liang's wisdom and perseverance.

events.name: In the evening, complete the last theoretical study and summary of this month
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang did his final formal study session in his study for this month's senior technician exam preparation. He connected the knowledge frameworks of the four key chapters—automatic devices, high-voltage equipment, system analysis, and safety regulations—and hand-drew a comprehensive mind map on an A3 sheet of paper, circling in red a few points he still had not fully mastered and planning to tackle them next month. Finally, he contentedly drew a big check mark on his monthly plan sheet.

events.name: Undertook core-strengthening training and broke past 60 seconds in the plank.
events.description: At 8:50, he began a 15-minute core strengthening session. He did a self-designed routine: 3 sets of planks — the first held for 62 seconds, the next two for 55 seconds each; side bridges for 25 seconds per side; 15 dynamic bird-dog reps; and finished with cat-cow. When recording the workout log, he found that his plank had exceeded 60 seconds for the first time, achieving the phase goal.

events.name: Final check of training certificate materials before going to bed
events.description: At 10 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang checked the transparent document bag again: ID card, operation certificate, 2-inch photo, renewal receipt, pen, and notebook were all there. He set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow, turned off the lights, and rested, to get enough energy for the next day's training.

start_state.mood: Steadfast with clear goals.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and expectant

state.daily_exercise: Core strengthening training (plank over 60 seconds, side bridge, bird-dog)

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with occasional showers in the afternoon.

2025-03.daily_overview: Early Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang went to the examination center for the renewal training for the Special Operation Certificate. The full-day course was tightly scheduled, with detailed content covering everything from new safety regulations to first-aid procedures. Although it took up a day off, renewing the certificate for another three years and clearing obstacles for his career development made him feel the day was well worth it. In the evening he went home, had a simple dinner with his family, and went to bed early to recharge for the next day's training assessment.

events.name: Attended the first day of the refresher training for the Special Operations Certificate
events.description: According to the pre-registration notice, Lu Mingqiang drove early in the morning to the Work Safety Qualification Examination Center on the outskirts of Haikou to attend the two-day refresher training for the renewal of his Special Operation Certificate. The morning classes focused mainly on the newly revised work safety regulations; he listened attentively and wrote down key points in his notebook. In the afternoon, the session moved to practical explanation and simulation of electric shock first aid. The instructor demonstrated the latest CPR procedure and the use of an AED. Lu Mingqiang watched especially carefully, because in his view these skills could save lives in critical moments.

events.name: Keep up core training in the morning and evening.
events.description: Even after a full day of training, Lu Mingqiang did not break his routine. Before going out in the morning and before going to bed at night, he completed a set of core exercises in the living room each time: 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 20 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 60-second planks. Since his lower back rehabilitation, this has been an unshakable ritual that makes him feel his body is stable and under control.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed and focused, slightly looking forward to the training

end_state.mood: Slightly tired but fully rewarded, and confident about tomorrow's assessment

state.daily_exercise: One set of core training each morning and evening (superman exercise, glute bridge, plank)

2025-03.daily_overview: Sunday was the key day of the training assessment. Lu Mingqiang got up early, once again organized his documents and notes, and drove to the exam center to complete the final half day of training and the afternoon theory computer-based exam. Thanks to his years of experience and the serious study over the past two days, he passed the exam smoothly. The moment he received the receipt slip, he let out a long sigh of relief; this professional pass had finally been securely renewed. He returned home early in the afternoon, and for once had a relaxing Sunday evening. He played with building blocks with his two sons, giving his tense nerves a chance to unwind.

events.name: Organized and checked the materials required for the training assessment.
events.description: After a simple breakfast, Lu Mingqiang did a final check at his home desk of the personal materials needed for the training exam: he carefully put his ID card, old electrician operation certificate, pen, and a notebook full of key points into a document folder. He specifically checked the number and validity period on the old certificate to ensure the registration information was correct, making full preparations for the day's schedule.

events.name: Drove to the exam center to attend the last half-day training.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang set off from his home on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, and drove along the ring expressway to the Safety Production Qualification Examination Center on the outskirts of Haikou. Sunday traffic was much smoother than on weekdays, so he arrived at the exam center nearly 20 minutes early.

events.name: Carefully listen to safety regulations and first aid key points and take notes.
events.description: The morning training was drawing to an end. The instructor focused on the details of changes between the old and new safety regulations and the operating standards for electric shock first aid. While listening, Lu Mingqiang quickly noted the key points in his notebook with simple diagrams and keywords. He marked the safety hazards easily overlooked in routine electrical maintenance with a red pen, reminding himself to emphasize them in the team when he returned.

events.name: Exchanged practical tips with fellow electricians over lunch.
events.description: Using the lunch break provided by the training center, Lu Mingqiang sat at a table with several fellow electricians from other power companies. They chatted while eating, covering topics from cable joint handling to common faults in high-voltage cabinets. Lu Mingqiang shared his experience dealing with complex wiring in old residential areas, and also heard others introduce tips on using new cable stripping tools. He felt it was very rewarding.

events.name: Took the theory computer-based test and successfully passed the review.
events.description: At 2 PM, Lu Mingqiang took the theoretical computer-based test for the renewal of his electrician operation certificate in the computer room of the examination center. Facing the multiple-choice and true-false questions scrolling on the screen, he proceeded steadily. For questions he was unsure about, he reasoned through them using the instructor's morning explanations and his own experience. He finally completed all the questions and confirmed his pass on the spot, successfully extending the validity of his special operation certificate to 2028.

events.name: Drove home and spent a relaxed evening.
events.description: After the exam, Lu Mingqiang left the training center in a relaxed mood and drove home to Longhua District, Haikou. After dinner, instead of arranging study time as he usually did, he sat on the living room floor with his two sons, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and played with building blocks for half an hour. He helped his younger son build a big bridge and explained the simple principles of bridge load-bearing to his elder son, ending a busy day in a warm atmosphere.

events.name: Core training
events.description: Before bed, he didn't forget to do core training, but considering he was already very tired that day, he adjusted the plank duration to 3 sets of 45 seconds and kept the other exercises as usual.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed, full of confidence, ready for the assessment

end_state.mood: A huge weight lifted off my shoulders, and I felt completely relaxed.

state.daily_exercise: Core training (plank time reduced because of fatigue; the rest as usual)

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, temperature warmed up to 26 degrees

2025-03.daily_overview: On Monday when work started, at the pre-shift meeting in the early morning, a piece of news casually revealed by Team Leader Zhang made Lu Mingqiang's heart suddenly tighten — the senior technician exam registration might be moved forward. The private encouragement after the meeting made him both excited and burdened. That evening, home, he made up his mind and sat down at the desk. But when he opened the thick theoretical textbook, the pages full of complex circuit formulas looked like a heavenly script to him. He realized his foundation was weak and found reading very difficult; he had to frequently use his phone to look things up. The first night of exam preparation started painfully amid a sense of frustration.

events.name: Learned at the pre-shift meeting that the exam registration might be moved up, and was privately encouraged by the shift leader
events.description: At the 7:30 pre-shift meeting, after assigning this week's tasks, Team Leader Zhang revealed an important development: according to industry contacts, the registration period for this year's senior technician exam might come earlier than in previous years. After the meeting, Team Leader Zhang specifically stopped Lu Mingqiang and, patting him on the shoulder, said privately, “Mingqiang, you have the strongest technical skills in our team. Don't wait until next year—try a year earlier. I believe you can do it.” These words made Lu Mingqiang feel both the warmth of being recognized and a sudden increase in pressure.

events.name: Made up my mind to prepare for the exam in advance and studied the theory textbook with difficulty.
events.description: That evening, after helping his eldest son Lu Zixuan with half an hour of homework and getting both children settled in bed, Lu Mingqiang sat down at his desk at 9:00 sharp and made up his mind to start preparing for the Senior Technician certification a year ahead of schedule. He took out the theory textbooks he had bought months earlier and was stunned when he turned to the first chapter—complex circuit calculus formulas and electromagnetic field theory lay before him like an incomprehensible script. He spent nearly half an hour searching on his phone for explanations of the unfamiliar symbols and formulas, but the more he searched, the more confused he became. On the first night, his effective study time was less than forty minutes, and the intense frustration made him realize for the first time that being excellent at practical work did not mean he could easily pass the theory exam.

events.name: Evening core workout
events.description: Despite the setback in exam preparation, he still persisted in completing the evening core training. He gritted his teeth through 3 sets of 60-second planks. Sweat dripped onto the yoga mat, accompanied by a low growl, as if trying to expel the frustration along with it.

start_state.mood: Full of drive, ready for the new work week.

end_state.mood: Feeling low due to academic setbacks, somewhat anxious and stressed

state.daily_exercise: Morning and evening core training (plank 60 seconds × 3)

2025-03.daily_overview: Tuesday's work was a routine inspection of the electrical distribution room, not too tiring. But after dinner, sitting down at the desk to continue working through the senior technician textbook was still a difficult battle for Lu Mingqiang. The circuit formula he got stuck on in the first chapter was like a roadblock. He spent most of the evening searching for videos and articles on his phone to understand it, but by the time more than half of his planned study time had passed, he had written only a few lines of notes. This feeling of being unable to put his strength to use frustrated him, but it also stirred his determination not to give in.

events.name: After dinner, he struggled through the first chapter of the theory textbook.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang started studying Chapter 1 of the senior technician theory textbook again. The mountain of formulas from last night still stood in front of him. Instead of trying to break through it directly, he changed his approach. He first searched for instructional videos on basic electrical knowledge on his phone, trying to fill the knowledge gap caused by his middle-school educational background. He found a short video with relatively intuitive explanations and watched it three times before he finally got a rough idea of what each symbol in the formula meant. He spent less than an hour actually reading the textbook; most of the time was spent searching for and digesting basic knowledge. Progress was very slow, but at least he now had a vague understanding of that formula.

events.name: Tuesday bodyweight strength training
events.description: Following the fixed plan, he did bodyweight strength training tonight. He completed 3 sets of 20 push-ups and 3 sets of 20 bodyweight squats, and also tried close-grip push-ups for extra stimulation. Sweat flowed, and the soreness in his muscles temporarily made him forget his study worries.

events.name: Neighbor Wang Jianguo's nighttime request for help
events.description: At ten o'clock in the evening, Lu Mingqiang had just finished strength training and was about to wash up when his neighbor Wang Jianguo suddenly knocked on the door, saying that the socket in his kitchen was sparking and he didn't dare use it. Lu Mingqiang went over with his tool bag without a word. He found that the neutral wire had poor contact and was arcing. He quickly reconnected and reinforced the wiring, finishing in ten minutes. Uncle Wang thanked him repeatedly and offered a pack of cigarettes, but Lu Mingqiang smiled and declined.

start_state.mood: Calm, preparing for work

end_state.mood: A little tired, but the difficulty of the theory roused a stubborn determination, and helping my neighbor was satisfying.

state.daily_exercise: Core training in the morning and evening; bodyweight strength training in the evening (push-ups, squats).

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, with spring in the air.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Wednesday evening, his wife Wang Lijuan reported a new problem to Lu Mingqiang: school had been back for a week, and their eldest son Lu Zixuan was always procrastinating on his homework. Lu Mingqiang immediately realized that he had been buried in exam preparation these past few days and had indeed neglected accompanying and guiding the child. He felt secretly guilty. That night, he took the initiative to sit beside his son and had a long, calm conversation. In the end, the father and son reached a warm agreement: the whole family would study together for half an hour after dinner every evening. This agreement not only solved the child's problem, but also made him realize that exam preparation was no excuse for neglecting the family. After handling the family matters, he still hurried to the squash court to complete his regular Wednesday training.

events.name: Wife reported that the eldest son is procrastinating on his homework
events.description: After dinner, while clearing the dishes, his wife Wang Lijuan said to Lu Mingqiang with some worry: "These first few days since Zixuan started school, he has been dawdling over his homework until very late. I've urged him several times, but it doesn't work well. You've been absorbed in reading lately; you need to find time to discipline him too." Hearing this, Lu Mingqiang's heart skipped a beat. He put down the teacup in his hand, looked at his eldest son playing in the living room, and felt deeply guilty.

events.name: Had an honest talk with eldest son and agreed to study together every evening
events.description: After realizing the problem, Lu Mingqiang deliberately did not immediately retreat into the study to prepare for the exam that evening. Instead, he took the initiative to sit by the desk of his eldest son, Lu Zixuan. He calmly asked his son whether he was having any difficulties, and patiently listened to the child's complaints about math problems becoming harder and hard to understand. After listening, Lu Mingqiang did not blame him, but shared his own experience of being slow to learn as a child and only catching up later through repeated practice. In the end, father and son reached a new family pact: starting tomorrow, the whole family would study together for 30 minutes after dinner every day. Lu Mingqiang would be responsible for tutoring Lu Zixuan in math, his wife Wang Lijuan would handle Chinese, and the younger son Lu Zihan could sit nearby quietly looking at picture books or playing with building blocks. Lu Zixuan nodded seriously in agreement, and the light returned to his eyes. This conversation also successfully defused the tension in the parent-child relationship that might have been caused by exam preparation.

events.name: Keep up squash training and add more backhand practice.
events.description: Seeing that the agreed joint study time had passed, Lu Mingqiang calmed his son down, changed into his sportswear, and drove to Power Fitness Club. His playing partner Lin Feng was already waiting for him. He briefly explained the situation at home, and Lin Feng said he understood. The two had their usual rally practice, then Lu Mingqiang added an extra 20 minutes of backhand multi-ball drills. Recently he had found the joy of improving his backhand, and after playing, his mood was much better.

events.name: Core training before bed
events.description: It was late when he got home after playing ball, but he insisted on doing the evening core workout, doing 3 sets of 63-second planks. He felt his core stability had improved again.

start_state.mood: Calm, getting into the workday rhythm

end_state.mood: Felt gratified by reaching a consensus with his son; felt relaxed after squash; the sense of achievement from parent-child communication eased the pressure of exam preparation.

state.daily_exercise: Morning and evening core training (plank 63 seconds × 3), squash training (including backhand multi-ball practice).

2025-03.daily_overview: The heaviest physical work of the week was on Thursday. Lu Mingqiang, his fellow worker Chen Jianguo, and his apprentice Zhao Qiang formed a three-person team and entered an old residential community to renovate the power supply lines. All day they moved between tall ladders and narrow corridors, tearing out aged aluminum wires and cleaning dust-filled cable channels. This was work that required both physical strength and skill, but Lu Mingqiang did it with extra enthusiasm, because this kind of large renovation project best reflected his value. Although he came home covered in dust, he felt very grounded. In the evening, as agreed, he tutored Lu Zixuan in math and completed bodyweight training.

events.name: A three-person team carried out power supply line renovation in an old residential community.
events.description: The three-person team of Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang arrived at an old residential community early in the morning with tools and materials to begin a two-day power supply line renovation task. The core work that day was removing the old aluminum wires. These wires had been in service for over twenty years, and their outer sheaths had long hardened and become brittle, crumbling into powder at the slightest force. The three divided the work: Zhao Qiang carefully removed the old wires from a ladder, Chen Jianguo collected and sorted the wires on the ground, and Lu Mingqiang surveyed and cleared the new line channels in preparation for laying copper-core cables. They worked floor by floor for 35 households. Some elderly residents in the building occasionally opened their doors and peered out, and Lu Mingqiang patiently explained things to reassure them.

events.name: Tutor eldest son in math and evening bodyweight training
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang kept his new promise and tutored Lu Zixuan in math homework for half an hour, patiently explaining two word problems. Afterward he did bodyweight strength training. Since he had already expended a lot of energy during the day, he reduced push-ups and squats to 2 sets of 20 reps each, but did his core training as usual.

start_state.mood: Energetic and ready to dive into the major renovation task

end_state.mood: Physically tired but mentally fulfilled, satisfied with the project's progress

state.daily_exercise: High-intensity physical labor, morning and evening core training, bodyweight strength training (reduced volume)

2025-03.daily_overview: Friday was the final day of the old residential community renovation project. After laying all the new cables and installing brand-new distribution boxes, the most critical step arrived - Lu Mingqiang personally performed the wiring and insulation tests. When the megohmmeter needle firmly pointed to a passing value, he knew the electrical safety of the 35 households was secured. Two days of high-intensity work came to a successful end. As the actual technical core of the project, his sense of achievement was self-evident. After work, he received an urgent call from a client, Li Jianguo, and hurried to handle a shop's circuit-breaker tripping problem, working late before returning home.

events.name: Completed the core wiring and testing for the renovation of the community power supply lines.
events.description: The three-man team continued to work hard and completed the laying of the remaining new copper-core cables. With the old distribution box replaced by a brand-new stainless steel one, the entire renovation entered a critical stage. Lu Mingqiang personally took charge, handling the wiring of all key nodes and the final comprehensive commissioning. He carefully crimped each wire securely and repeatedly checked the ground wires and phase wires. When everything was ready, he took out an insulation resistance tester and conducted strict insulation resistance tests on all renovated circuits. As the instrument showed a stable high reading, he nodded with satisfaction — the renovation project that ensured the safe and stable electricity use of 35 households was declared successfully completed. His co-worker Chen Jianguo joked, "Only when you do this job can everyone feel at ease."

events.name: Emergency handling of a tripped circuit at a regular customer's appliance repair shop
events.description: Just after he got home from work, Li Jianguo, a long-time client, called to say that the shop's main circuit breaker kept tripping and would trip again as soon as it was reset, and asked him to come over. Without a second word, Lu Mingqiang grabbed his tool bag and drove to the repair shop in Meilan District. After checking, he found that the wiring of the air conditioner outdoor unit was aging and leaking electricity, which caused the residual current device to trip. He did temporary insulation treatment and advised Boss Li to replace the outdoor unit wiring as soon as possible. Li Jianguo wanted to keep him for dinner, but he politely declined, saying he had family plans. In fact, he wanted to rush back to tutor the children and finish his own studying.

events.name: Continued theoretical study after tutoring the child.
events.description: When he got home it was nearly eight o'clock, and his wife had saved him some dinner. He ate quickly, then hurriedly tutored Lu Zixuan in math and read picture books to Lu Zihan for 10 minutes. Only then did he take a shower. Afterwards he sat at the desk and continued to grind through the textbook, barely managing to study for 40 minutes.

start_state.mood: Full of motivation, looking forward to the project wrapping up perfectly.

end_state.mood: Full of professional achievement. Although he worked overtime to troubleshoot faults, his abilities were recognized—tired but happy.

state.daily_exercise: High-intensity physical labor, morning and evening core training (plank 60 seconds x 3)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny in the morning, turning cloudy with scattered light rain in the afternoon.

2025-03.daily_overview: After a busy week, on Saturday Lu Mingqiang chose to keep the day entirely for himself and his hobbies. In the morning, he completed his weekly 5 km morning run, this time deliberately controlling his pace and enjoying the process more. In the afternoon, he carefully wiped a few old liquor bottles that carried stories, then went to meet his fellow collector Chen Jianguo at a teahouse. The two sipped tea and talked about bottles, moving from the evolution of labels to local culture, chatting happily. Chen Jianguo also recommended several invaluable learning resources. Back home, Lu Mingqiang could not suppress his curiosity; he searched online and printed out related articles before feeling completely satisfied. The process of delving into his hobby swept away the work fatigue and exam anxiety of the past days. In the evening, he picked up the textbook again, and the enthusiasm for research from the day seemed to carry over, making the formulas feel a bit smoother.

events.name: Saturday morning 5-kilometer run at Baishamen Park.
events.description: After getting up at 6:30, Lu Mingqiang changed into his running gear and drove to Baishamen Park to meet his running friend Chen Bin. The two did thorough dynamic stretches and then started a 5-kilometer jog at a pace of about 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. In the latter part of the run, Lu Mingqiang felt his legs a bit heavy, probably because he had expended a lot of energy this week, so he stopped chasing speed and focused on breathing and cadence. After the run, he added core training and wore a lumbar support belt. Chen Bin asked with concern about his review progress, and the two chatted while stretching, agreeing to continue next Saturday.

events.name: Selected and polished cherished liquor bottles to prepare for the gathering with fellow collectors
events.description: After finishing his morning run and breakfast at home, Lu Mingqiang carefully selected three wine bottles with special historical marks from the glass display cabinet in the corner of the living room: a Coconut Island brand deer-turtle wine bottle from a Haikou beverage factory in the 1990s, a sugarcane wine bottle from an early local Hainan sugar factory, and a Li-style Shanlan wine bottle with hand-painted decoration on the body. Using a soft cotton cloth, he carefully wiped the bottles, removing the accumulated dust one by one, and checked carefully for chips or cracks. Looking at the bottles restored to a fresh state, he felt eager for the afternoon gathering with collector friends.

events.name: Go to a Cantonese teahouse for a liquor bottle culture exchange with collector friend Chen Jianguo
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang carefully packed the polished bottles into his backpack and drove to a long-established Cantonese teahouse on Bo'ai South Road in Haikou. After meeting his fellow collector Chen Jianguo, the two ordered a pot of Pu'er tea and a few baskets of dim sum before eagerly exchanging their treasures. Lu Mingqiang took out those three bottles and told the stories behind each one; Chen Jianguo then carefully showed an internal commemorative liquor bottle from the 1980s that had come out of the home of a Qiongya Column veteran. The bottle was plain in appearance but rich with historical weight. The two had a lively discussion about the evolution of the trademarks on the bottles, the glass factory codes, and the changes of the vanished local Hainan distilleries.

events.name: Discovering new information channels and sustaining interest in learning
events.description: When the afternoon gathering ended, fellow collector Chen Jianguo noticed that Lu Mingqiang was especially interested in the local history behind the liquor bottles, so he enthusiastically recommended two sections of the "Hainan Wine Culture" forum that he often browsed, as well as a WeChat public account dedicated to introducing Hainan's local culture and history. He said, "These places have a lot of background on old distilleries, and some veteran craftsmen even publish articles there." After the gathering ended, Lu Mingqiang drove home, put the bottles back in place one by one, and kept turning over the brilliant conversations of the afternoon in his mind.

events.name: Go online to check bookmarked forums and print local cultural and historical materials
events.description: That evening, after settling the children down, Lu Mingqiang couldn't wait to sit at his desk and turn on the computer. Following Chen Jianguo's recommendation from earlier in the day, he logged into the collector forum focused on Hainan liquor culture and also followed the history-and-literature public account on WeChat. In the public account, he found an article titled 'A Study of Traditional Hainan Brewing Techniques.' After reading closely, he felt the content was detailed and valuable, with significance far beyond an ordinary online article. He decisively clicked print, carefully bound the dozen or so A4 pages, and tucked them into his notebook for future reference and study.

events.name: Continue tackling the remaining formulas in the theoretical textbook in the evening
events.description: After finishing the collected materials, it was still not yet ten o'clock. The exchange with Chen Jianguo during the day had put him in a good mood, and his interest in studying was unexpectedly high. He simply continued to open the senior technician theory textbook and returned to the circuit formula that had been troubling him for several days. This time he was not so impatient. While consulting the textbook, he also opened the notes he had previously searched and organized, reading and drawing as he went. Although his understanding was still slow and he needed to repeatedly consult different materials for verification and deduction, he felt he was getting closer to the core concept inch by inch.

start_state.mood: Lazy and relaxed, looking forward to today's hobby exchange and morning run.

end_state.mood: Feeling fulfilled inside, content with the dual rewards of hobbies and study

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 kilometers, core training after the run; core training in the morning and evening

2025-03.daily_overview: This Sunday was rich and warm. Encouraged by his wife, Lu Mingqiang completed his first voluntary blood donation, feeling nervous but proud. After getting home, he spent the whole afternoon with his two sons making a battery-powered model car with lights from scrap materials, while his wife recorded the warm father-son collaboration. After the project, he and his wife held a serious family budget meeting and decided to tighten spending starting this month. In the evening, he took the whole family for a walk in Wanlv Garden and tried a short bout of brisk walking to warm up for the upcoming weight loss plan. That day, he offered his heart to society, to his family, and to the future.

events.name: Participated in a community voluntary blood donation for the first time and overcame nervousness to complete the donation.
events.description: After getting up in the morning, his wife Wang Lijuan saw a notice in the community group and encouraged Lu Mingqiang to take part in the Learn from Lei Feng voluntary blood donation event held in the community square. Lu Mingqiang was a little hesitant at first, but urged on by his wife, he ate some bread and milk, took his ID card, and walked over. At the physical examination area beside the blood donation bus, he had his blood pressure measured and a finger-prick blood sample taken. All indicators were normal. But when he actually stepped onto the bus and saw the thick needles on the arms of other donors, his heart tightened and he clenched his fists. When it was his turn, the nurse saw how nervous he was, comforted him gently, and guided him to adjust his breathing. As the dark red blood flowed out slowly, he actually relaxed and smoothly completed a donation of 400 ml of whole blood. While drinking tea in the rest area, he rubbed the bright red blood donation certificate and the small souvenir he had just received, and laughed at himself: "After all that, I was more nervous than when repairing a 10,000-volt high-voltage line."

events.name: Returned home and shared the nervousness and pride of donating blood with his wife
events.description: After donating blood, Lu Mingqiang returned home holding the blood donation certificate. His wife Wang Lijuan greeted him with a smile. He handed the certificate to his wife and vividly described his nervousness when he first got on the bus, and his inner thoughts at the moment the needle entered his vein. Wang Lijuan was amused by his lively description and looked at him with admiration, carefully putting the certificate into the drawer where the family keeps important documents. This small certificate carried his kindness to society and also made him feel that his world had grown a little bigger.

events.name: Led his two sons to make an electric vehicle model using scrap materials
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang called his second son Lu Zihan aside in a ceremonious way. He took out an old shoebox, a few plastic bottle caps, some waste wires, a battery box, and small light bulbs, and explained to his younger son in extremely simple and vivid language the basic principle of a series circuit — electricity flows from the battery and lights up the bulb — and told him the environmental significance of reusing waste. Then hands-on time began. Lu Mingqiang guided Lu Zihan in cutting the cardboard box to make the body and using plastic bottle caps as wheels. At this point, his eldest son Lu Zixuan, who had been playing nearby, was also drawn over and volunteered to help fix the axles and paste colored decorative paper. The three of them lay on the floor, heads together, busily enjoying themselves. His wife Wang Lijuan, meanwhile, kept her phone in hand throughout, recording the precious moments of their explanation, cutting, and cooperation. She selected several clips, edited them into a short video, and sent it to the family relatives and friends group, which soon drew a long string of likes and praise.

events.name: The electric car model lit up successfully, and the whole family shared a warm sense of accomplishment.
events.description: After nearly two hours of effort, a crooked but one-of-a-kind eco-friendly electric car model was completed. When Lu Mingqiang connected the last piece of wire and the small bulb on the car glowed with warm yellow light, Lu Zihan excitedly shouted, held it up, and ran around the living room, while Lu Mingqiang and his eldest son proudly applauded their younger brother. His wife captured this bright moment. At that moment, the family shared not only the relief of finishing the craft project, but also the warm satisfaction of working together in harmony.

events.name: Organize February household income and expenses and create a tight budget for March.
events.description: After dinner, the children played in the living room while Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan sat at the dining table for a serious family finance meeting. Lu Mingqiang took out the ledger and the payment records on his phone, and summarized the February expenses for dining out, entertainment, daily shopping, and other items. They found that unnecessary dining out and small miscellaneous purchases had been relatively high in the past two months. In the end, after discussion, the two jointly made a tight budget plan for March: strictly limiting how often they ate out and bought snacks and drinks, and choosing mainly free places such as parks for entertainment, with the goal of saving 500 yuan in March and explicitly setting aside an emergency reserve fund. Lu Mingqiang carefully wrote the new budget plan on the flyleaf of the family ledger as a solemn commitment to the whole family.

events.name: In the evening, take the whole family to Wanlv Garden for a walk and try brisk walking.
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang suggested taking the whole family to Evergreen Park for a walk. He deliberately changed into sports shoes and let his wife take the two children to play slowly, while he tried a 2-kilometer brisk walk on the park's rubber track, taking about 20 minutes and feeling relaxed. He realized this could become a workout routine during weekday lunch breaks.

events.name: Reduced evening core training.
events.description: Considering that he had donated blood earlier in the day, Lu Mingqiang halved his evening core workout: 2 sets of Superman exercise, 2 sets of glute bridges, and 2 sets of 45-second planks, to avoid fatigue.

start_state.mood: Slightly curious, a bit nervous about blood donation

end_state.mood: Highly satisfied, filled with family warmth and a sense of responsibility.

state.daily_exercise: Walk to and from the blood donation point, brisk walk 2 km in the afternoon, core training (reduced)

2025-03.daily_overview: In Monday's work, Lu Mingqiang put the safety regulations learned a few days earlier in training to critical use. He promptly corrected his apprentice Zhao Qiang's improper operation and led by example in demonstrating safety first. When he got home in the evening, while reviewing for the exam, a flash of inspiration led him to take out the maintenance logs from the recent renovation projects and study them alongside the textbook. He found that combining the cases he had personally handled with those abstract formulas instantly made the once obscure theories vivid and substantial. His learning efficiency improved dramatically, and he was as excited as if he had suddenly seen the light.

events.name: At work, corrected coworker Zhao Qiang's unsafe behavior and personally demonstrated the correct method.
events.description: During the day, Lu Mingqiang carried out a maintenance task on a distribution box with Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang. As they were preparing to operate, Lu Mingqiang noticed that the apprentice Zhao Qiang, in order to save trouble, was about to start working without wearing insulating gloves. He immediately stopped him and warned him sternly, 'Don't complain about the hassle—your life is your own.' Then he not only made Zhao Qiang step back and put on his gloves, but also slowed down and personally demonstrated the complete standard procedure of power cutoff, voltage testing, and discharging, explaining the purpose of each step in detail. This behavior was a manifestation of his internalizing what he had learned in the recertification training a few days earlier, and it invisibly established him as a safety role model in the team.

events.name: Deepen advanced technician theory study based on recent maintenance logs
events.description: At nine in the evening, after the children had settled down, Lu Mingqiang began his exam preparation review. This time he tried a different approach. Instead of opening the textbook that had seemed incomprehensible, he took out the maintenance log book from the past month and the records from last week's community renovation project, and carefully went through them. He focused on reviewing several typical cases in the records, such as the transformer overload protection misoperation and the line grounding resistance exceeding the standard, and replayed the operation process, phenomena, and judgments in his mind like a movie. Then he opened the senior technician theory textbook and found the chapters corresponding to the fault principles. When he substituted the measured data from the log into the formulas that had previously felt abstract and verified the calculations, the symbols on the paper suddenly came to life—theory and practice connected precisely at that moment. Excitedly, he filled his notebook with calculation processes and insights, feeling that the learning bottleneck that had troubled him for days had finally been broken.

events.name: Tutoring his eldest son in math and core training.
events.description: As agreed, after dinner he tutored Lu Zixuan in math for 30 minutes. Today's topic was multiplying two-digit numbers, and his son picked it up quickly. Afterward, he completed his regular core training; plank time increased to 3 sets of 65 seconds, and he tried side plank for 15 seconds for the first time.

start_state.mood: The sleepiness had not faded, but his professional discipline made his whole body tense and ready to start work.

end_state.mood: Extremely excited and encouraged after finding an efficient study method

state.daily_exercise: Morning and evening core workout (65-second planks x3, plus side plank).

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to cloudy, light breeze.

2025-03.daily_overview: On Tuesday, a set of text messages and one medical checkup set Lu Mingqiang's life on a healthier course. During the lunch break, he reviewed the safety manual and voluntarily signed up for the Arbor Day activity. However, the annual physical examination report he received that afternoon was a significant warning: his BMI was in the overweight range. Although he felt fine physically, the cold number reminded him of the lower back pain he had suffered earlier in the year. That evening he told his wife, and the two decided to start adjusting their diet from the next day, using less oil and less salt, and formally put health management on the agenda.

events.name: Review safety manual during lunch break and sign up for Tree Planting Day activity
events.description: During his lunch break, Lu Mingqiang sat in a corner of the construction site rest room and took out the safety operation manual from last week's training. He focused on reviewing the sections on insulation protection and standard discharge procedures. He silently repeated the key steps several times, determined to turn these rules into muscle memory. Later, he saw the trade union's Tree Planting Day activity notice on the company bulletin board. Thinking it would be good to get some outdoor exercise and that he could bring his apprentice Zhao Qiang, he took the initiative to sign up with shift leader Zhang Tou and confirmed that he would partner with fellow worker Chen Jianguo.

events.name: Learned that his physical exam results showed a BMI in the overweight range and decided to lose weight.
events.description: In the afternoon, the company distributed the annual physical examination report from last month. Lu Mingqiang looked through his own report and saw his weight was 72.0 kg, height 171 cm, and the BMI column was marked 24.8, which bluntly read “borderline overweight.” In the doctor’s advice column, there was a gentle but cutting message: “It is recommended to control your diet, increase aerobic exercise, and guard against further weight gain.” He recalled the back pain from a few months ago that had kept him in bed for several days, and his heart missed a beat. After work, he went home and showed the report to his wife, Wang Lijuan, and said with some helplessness, “It seems I really need to watch my mouth and get moving.” The two reached a consensus: start with their daily diet, reduce greasy dishes such as braised pork, and increase steamed and cold-dressed dishes, with his wife in charge of the oil bottle and salt shaker.

events.name: Evening study and core training
events.description: After dinner (which he had already started making with less oil), he tutored Lu Zixuan in math, then continued studying the senior technician textbook, using a new method to combine and analyze a work fault encountered today with theory. After that, he completed core training and held a plank for 3 sets of 68 seconds.

start_state.mood: Daily status, preparing for work.

end_state.mood: Feeling a bit stressed; the physical exam results were like a wake-up call, but he is determined to face the problem directly.

state.daily_exercise: Morning and evening core training (plank 68 seconds × 3).

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy in the morning, clearing in the afternoon, with pleasant temperatures.

2025-03.daily_overview: Wednesday's Tree Planting Day activity brought a breath of fresh air to the dull exam preparation. Lu Mingqiang and his coworkers took a bus to a wasteland on the outskirts and planted several casuarina saplings with their own hands. Doing farm work was different from working on a construction site; although it was tiring, he felt unusually calm and content inside. However, behind the joy lurked a faint worry. The weather was cloudy, rainy, and humid, and his mother Chen Xiuying's chronic rheumatism seemed to have flared up again, but she silently applied a hot water bottle to the area, not wanting to disturb her busy son. Through this group activity, Lu Mingqiang also began to consciously increase his level of activity, using his evening squash sessions to focus more on preparing for next month's small competition.

events.name: Participated in the company-organized Arbor Day activity and planted a sapling.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and the other colleagues who had signed up gathered at the company gate and took the company bus together to a wasteland in the outer suburbs of Haikou for tree planting. After arriving, everyone picked up shovels, buckets, and bundles of drought-tolerant, wind-resistant Casuarina saplings from the supply area. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo divided the work clearly: one dug pits, the other held the saplings and filled in soil, and they worked in tacit coordination to plant five saplings. At noon, the company handed out boxed lunches uniformly. Lu Mingqiang and his co-workers sat on the ground under the shade, eating heartily with salted duck eggs and greens. He wiped his sweat and said to Chen Jianguo: 'This kind of tiredness is different from emergency line repair; it feels quite reassuring.' After the activity ended in the afternoon, everyone cleaned up the tools, took a group photo, and then took the bus back to the company. Although Lu Mingqiang was covered in sweat and dust, he felt extremely relaxed in spirit.

events.name: Mother Chen Xiuying, suffering from rheumatic aches, applied hot compresses alone and kept the condition to herself.
events.description: Several days of continuous rainy weather made the rheumatic cold-induced joint pain in her knees quietly flare up for Chen Xiuying, who lives in an old house on Xinbu Island. She felt her knees cold and stabbing, but she didn't want to add trouble to her son, who had just finished training and was busy preparing for exams. She secretly took out the family hot water bottle, filled it with boiling water, sat on a small stool in the kitchen, and applied it over her trousers to warm her knees. Whenever she heard movement at the door, she quickly put it away and pretended nothing had happened. This secret, she planned to keep for as long as she could.

events.name: On squash activity day, focus on practicing the backhand in preparation for the internal mini tournament
events.description: This day was Wednesday, also Lu Mingqiang's regular weekly squash day. During warm-up, his fellow player Lin Feng casually suggested that the two of them could hold a small internal match next month. This suggestion immediately stirred Lu Mingqiang's competitive spirit. Throughout the evening's games, he deliberately reduced hard drives and instead practiced more on his weakness — backhand shots. He repeatedly adjusted his grip and turning posture, asked Lin Feng to feed him dozens of balls to refine his movements, and sweated profusely. His backhand returns could now sustain more than 10 consecutive rallies, showing clear improvement. Since the daytime tree planting had already consumed a lot of physical energy, tonight's squash training intensity was slightly reduced, with more focus on refining technical movements rather than high-intensity competition.

events.name: Evening core workout
events.description: After playing ball and going home, he did his usual core training, completing three 70-second planks and two 20-second side planks on each side.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to outdoor activities

end_state.mood: Feeling refreshed in body and mind, and also aware of the necessity of actively managing one's health.

state.daily_exercise: Physical exertion from tree-planting labor, evening squash practice, core training (70-second plank).

2025-03.daily_overview: On Thursday, the drizzle lingered, and mother Chen Xiuying's knee pain had not eased at all. She still chose to rub on medicated oil and tough it out. At the other end of the city, Lu Mingqiang officially started the first step of his weight-loss plan—braving the light rain, he went for his first 30-minute nighttime run in the park, opening the running app to record data, feeling like he was fighting middle-age spread. After running home, he persisted with an hour of theoretical study. Although his body was a bit tired, his mind was especially clear. He tried using the mnemonic app on his phone to memorize key parameters. New tools and new habits were slowly shaping him.

events.name: Mother Chen Xiuying applied medication herself to relieve rheumatic pain
events.description: Yesterday, the hot compress with a hot water bottle was not very effective; her mother's knee still ached. She didn't want her family to worry, so while her husband was out playing chess, she took out the rheumatic medicinal oil kept at home from the drawer, poured some into her palm, rubbed it warm, and gently applied it to her swollen knee. To keep the pain from getting worse, she did not go out for her usual after-meal walk. Instead, she sat a little longer, rested her leg flat on a small stool, and silently endured the torment brought on by the weather.

events.name: Start running for weight loss three times a week (first session).
events.description: Following the plan he had set for himself, Lu Mingqiang settled the children for the night in the evening, changed into running shoes, and went to the park near his home for his first formal running workout. He set a goal on the running app and jogged for a full 30 minutes following the audio prompts, at a pace of about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. His legs felt a bit heavy at first, but once he got into his stride his body became lighter and lighter. His T-shirt was soaked with sweat, and he felt completely invigorated. This was the first time since being discouraged by his medical checkup report that he felt he had regained control over his body.

events.name: After running, use the evening break to work through the frequently tested chapters of the textbook.
events.description: After a short rest and a shower, Lu Mingqiang used the hour before bed to continue working through the textbook for senior technician certification. Tonight he focused on the key chapters that frequently appear in the computer-based exam and tried using a mobile memory app to turn the dry key parameters and requirements into mnemonics for memorization. Although some complex parameters still required frequent flipping back to earlier explanations for comparison and understanding, the new study method combined with practice logs and the memory app made him feel that exam preparation was no longer a hopeless crawl through a dark tunnel.

events.name: Core training
events.description: Post-run core training: 3 sets of superman exercises, 3 sets of glute bridges, 3 sets of 70-second planks, and side planks for 20 seconds on each side to strengthen the lower back.

start_state.mood: Feeling a bit heavy and somewhat depressed due to the humid weather.

end_state.mood: Completely relaxed; the fullness of having completed both exercise and study washed away the fatigue.

state.daily_exercise: Running 30 minutes, core training (70-second plank)

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with light rain; the ground was slippery

2025-03.daily_overview: The Friday evening extra squash training session began to bring Lu Mingqiang and his playing partner Lin Feng closer. The two focused on refining their backhand technique. After working up a sweat, they rarely left immediately; instead, they sat by the court drinking beverages, talking about everything from squash to their jobs and families. This conversation turned Lin Feng from a purely athletic partner into a friend with whom he could share the pressures of life. Meanwhile, his mother Chen Xiuying was already limping due to leg pain, yet on the phone she still put on a brave front, afraid of affecting her son's work.

events.name: Mother has trouble walking but hid her condition from her son on the phone.
events.description: Pain had been building up for a few days, and his mother Chen Xiuying was already noticeably limping when she walked. In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang called as usual to check on her. On the other end of the line, his mother's voice sounded as cheerful as ever: "Everything's fine, don't worry, just focus on your work." She did not mention her leg at all, only telling her son to stay safe and not get too tired. After hanging up, she supported herself against the wall and slowly moved back to the sofa.

events.name: Extra squash practice with squash buddy Lin Feng and deepening friendship.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang got his gear ready and headed to the squash court for his weekly appointment with Lin Feng. Since the two had agreed to add extra practice for next month's small internal competition, tonight's training was especially targeted. Lin Feng stood at the side of the court, watching carefully, pointed out that Lu Mingqiang's footwork was too slow on his backhand, and demonstrated for him. Lu Mingqiang humbly accepted the pointer like a student and practiced over and over. After the extra training, the two sat on a bench beside the court, drenched in sweat, drinking sports drinks.
