This time they weren't in a hurry to pack up and leave. Lin Feng complained a little about annoying things at work, and Lu Mingqiang talked about his anxiety over the exam and his two sons at home. As they chatted, the two saw similar life pressures in each other's eyes. This deep conversation made Lu Mingqiang feel that Lin Feng was no longer just a practice partner but a trustworthy friend he could confide in.

events.name: Core training and tutoring the kids
events.description: Before the extra squash practice, he had already tutored Lu Zixuan in math and read picture books with Lu Zihan; after playing ball and returning home, he still kept up core training, doing 3 sets of 70-second planks, and added 15 superman holds.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the weekend and the evening squash match.

end_state.mood: Relieved, the warming friendship opened a new emotional outlet for the high-pressure life.

state.daily_exercise: Targeted squash backhand technique extra practice, core training (70-second plank + Superman exercise)

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy in the morning, clearing up in the afternoon with bright sunshine.

2025-03.daily_overview: The third Saturday of this month unexpectedly became a day intertwined with emotion and responsibility. In the early morning, Lu Mingqiang completed his 5 km morning run as promised, his pace slightly dropping to 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer due to recent fluctuations in fitness. In the morning, he took his wife and children to the building materials market to buy materials for a planting shelf for the balcony at home. During the midday visit to his mother, he finally uncovered the secret she had been hiding for days—seeing her visibly limping leg, his heart tightened. This normally strong-willed man immediately turned the car around and took her to the doctor. Only after it was confirmed to be an old injury did he feel relieved, and he silently added the long-term responsibilities of regularly buying medicine for his mother and reminding her to keep warm when the weather turned cold. In the afternoon, back home, he turned his care for his mother into enthusiasm for building his small family, personally setting up a vegetable planter with automatic drip irrigation on the balcony. This shelf was both a surprise for his wife and a small epitome of his dream of a future workshop. In the evening, the whole family gathered for a light dinner. After tutoring the children, he persisted in studying for an hour and completed core training, finally going to bed at 23:30 with a whirlwind of thoughts.

events.name: Run 5 kilometers early on Saturday morning.
events.description: Got up at 6:15, Lu Mingqiang went alone to Baishamen Park for his regular Saturday morning run. Since his stamina had not fully recovered after donating blood recently, and with the increased training volume this week, he felt his steps were somewhat heavy, and his 5 km pace ended up at 6 minutes 25 seconds. After the run, he did stretching and core training carefully. His running friend Chen Bin did not come today because he had other things to do, so he finished the run by himself and went home early.

events.name: Go to the building materials market to buy materials for the balcony planting rack.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove with the list his wife Wang Lijuan had given him to the building materials market on Heping South Road, Haikou. Following the family plan the couple had discussed a few days earlier, he bought three medium-sized storage bins, several large compressed coconut coir bricks, and seeds for scallions, lettuce, and peppers. At the same time, using his electrician expertise, he carefully selected a simple timer and drip irrigation pipes, planning to use technology to upgrade the balcony at home.

events.name: Take the whole family to visit his parents and discover that his mother has a leg condition.
events.description: At ten in the morning, Lu Mingqiang brought his wife and two children, carried fruit, and drove to his parents' home on Haifu Road, Meilan District. As soon as he entered, he noticed his mother's walking posture was off; she seemed to be dragging her left leg, and her expression was a bit unnatural. His heart skipped a beat, and he immediately went up to ask. At first she was evasive, but after he kept pressing, she finally admitted that her knee had been hurting for several days, and last night the pain had been so bad she hadn't slept well all night.

events.name: Rush mother to the hospital and establish a care plan for her.
events.description: When he learned that his mother had been tormented by severe pain for several days, Lu Mingqiang felt both heartbroken and guilty. Without a word, he grabbed his car keys, carefully helped his mother downstairs, and drove straight to the nearby community health service center. At the center, after a detailed examination, the doctor diagnosed an acute attack of senile rheumatic cold-damp joint pain caused by the recent cold and wet weather. The doctor prescribed topical medicated plasters and oral anti-inflammatory painkillers, and urged her to keep warm and avoid dampness. Standing to the side, Lu Mingqiang, like a primary school student, clearly recorded the usage, dosage, and precautions in his phone's memo app, then hurried back and forth with the form to pay and pick up the medicine. After sending his mother home, he personally applied the plasters for her, repeatedly reminded her to take the medicine on time, and decided to stock these medicines for her every month from then on, and to remind her in advance to apply hot compresses whenever the weather turned cold or rainy. The warmth between mother and son felt especially profound at that moment.

events.name: Returned home and hand-built a vegetable planting rack on the balcony
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and his family returned home from his parents' house. Although he had spent most of the day fussing over his mother's illness, he still decided to complete another family plan. On the balcony, he spread out all the materials, took out a tape measure and tools, and began to build a three-tier vegetable planting stand. He used storage bins as containers, soaked coconut coir as the growing medium, laid soil and sowed seeds as planned. The most impressive part was that, using his technical skills, he connected the bought timer and drip irrigation tubes to the balcony faucet. After several adjustments, he successfully achieved automatic timed watering at the press of a switch. Standing in front of this newly born balcony oasis, he suddenly felt that creating life with his own hands and skills was more satisfying than simply repairing things. It also seemed to add a new footnote to his idea of a future workshop.

events.name: Evening family life and study wrap-up.
events.description: Dinner was steamed fish and cold mixed vegetables made by his wife, fully following the principle of weight loss and oil control. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang tutored Lu Zixuan in math; Lu Zixuan was very interested in geometry problems today. He read the picture book "Cloud Bread" to Lu Zihan. After the children fell asleep, he continued studying the advanced technician textbook, spending 30 minutes reviewing the fault analysis questions in Chapter 3, and did two comprehensive problems based on this week's maintenance logs. Finally, he completed core training: 3 sets of superman exercises, 3 sets of glute bridges, and 3 sets of 70-second planks. He canceled tonight's strength training because he was already tired enough.

start_state.mood: Calm; planning the weekend's family schedule.

events.description: During the lunch break, I walked briskly around the construction site for 35 minutes, about 3.6 kilometers, at a steady pace. It has become a habit.

events.name: After work, I tidied up the balcony vegetables with my wife.
events.description: Went home and loosened the soil with his wife, pulled out weak seedlings, applied organic fertilizer to the scallions, and discussed the plan to fly a kite tomorrow.

events.name: Organize the liquor bottle collection and communicate online with Chen Jianguo
events.description: In the evening, he wiped the old liquor bottle and took a photo to share the 1980s Haikou Daqu bottle with Chen Jianguo, and the two exchanged views on the old liquor market.

events.name: Briefly browsed the tech forum and rested early.
events.description: Before bed, he spent ten minutes browsing an electrician forum, bookmarked a post about cable temperature measurement, and lay down early at 10:30.

events.name: Evening core workout
events.description: Despite going to bed early and having less evening time, I still completed 3 sets of glute bridges (24 reps) and a 78-second plank.

start_state.mood: It's Friday and the weekend is near, so I naturally feel a bit more relaxed.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to tomorrow's family activity, ending the work week with a calm mindset.

state.daily_exercise: Lower back and core training, 35-minute brisk walk during lunch break

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, gentle breeze, ideal for outdoor activities.

2025-03.daily_overview: On a fine Saturday, after an early-morning run, Lu Mingqiang took the whole family to Wanlv Park to fly kites. He happened to meet his kite friend Chen Jie and exchanged tips, taught the children how to fly kites, and his wife shot a video that got likes in the family group chat, filling them with happiness.

events.name: Early morning run at Baishamen Park.
events.description: After getting up at 6:15, he did morning core training (glute bridges upgraded to 3 sets of 25, planks to 3 sets of 80 seconds), then drove to Baishamen Park and completed a 5 km morning run with a pace of 6:15 per kilometer, feeling good.

events.name: In the morning, check the improved kite and prepare items for going out.
events.description: After breakfast, checked the bridle line and tail of the homemade sand-swallow kite again, packed the string reel, picnic mat, water, and snacks, and prepared for the family activity.

events.name: The whole family drove to Evergreen Park.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, he drove along Binhai Avenue and arrived at Wanlv Garden in 20 minutes, parking by an open lawn near the lake.

events.name: Ran into fellow kite enthusiast Chen Jie and discussed making new kites.
events.description: While flying kites, Lu Mingqiang happened to run into his friend Chen Jie. Lu Mingqiang showed his improved bridle-line adjustment method for the sand swallow kite, and Chen Jie shared a new frame material. The two agreed to do a test flight together next month.

events.name: Teach the children kite-flying skills on the grass
events.description: Lu Mingqiang taught his eldest son Lu Zixuan to feel the wind and let out the line. After the kite took off, he let his younger son experience holding the spool. As the three of them ran, the kite flew higher and higher.

events.name: The wife shot a video and shared it to the family group, earning likes.
events.description: Wang Lijuan recorded the heartwarming scene and sent it to the family group. Lu Minghua in Shenzhen immediately replied with three thumbs-up. Her mother sent a voice message saying she was happy to see the video.

events.name: Packed up my things and drove home
events.description: Packed up the kite, shared the fruit and water, and the children dozed in the car. After getting home, he hung up the kite, and Lu Mingqiang savored the happy afternoon.

events.name: Evening core workout
events.description: The kite flying was moderately active, and in the evening he still completed core training: 3×20 prone back extensions, 3×25 glute bridges, and 3×80-second planks, to consolidate and improve.

start_state.mood: The weather is good, so I decided to give the whole afternoon to the family.

end_state.mood: Overflowing with happiness; seeing the happy smiling faces of my family makes all the hard work worthwhile.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for the lower back, 5 km morning run, and moderate-intensity kite flying

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with brief sunshine in the afternoon

2025-03.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang practiced squash extra in the morning to prepare for the internal competition. Afterwards, he renewed his car insurance, organized his March study notes and did an in-depth summary, discussed April expenses with his wife and mentioned the loan. In the evening, the family took a walk, and at night he reviewed the technical forum. His mindset was calm.

events.name: Morning core training.
events.description: Got up at 6:15. Core training is now stable: Superman exercise 3×20, glute bridges 3×25, planks 3×80 seconds; I feel my core strength has significantly increased.

events.name: Weekend extra practice at the squash club.
events.description: In the morning he went to the sports hall and practiced for an extra hour with Lin Feng, focusing on simulating match rhythm. His backhand attacking success rate improved, and he felt more confident.

events.name: Use the mobile app to renew the car's compulsory traffic insurance and vehicle and vessel tax.
events.description: After training, at home he used the app to pay online for compulsory traffic insurance of 665 yuan and vehicle and vessel tax of 285 yuan, totaling 950 yuan. He was given two free roadside assistance services and took a screenshot and sent it to his wife.

events.name: Organize the March study notes and make a monthly summary.
events.description: Before lunch, Lu Mingqiang spread all of March's study notes out on the desk and read through them from beginning to end. With a red pen, he added a few easily confused knowledge points in the margins, and also browsed the technical articles saved on his phone. Looking back over the month, from initially finding the formulas as baffling as a heavenly script to now being able to use practical cases to aid understanding, the progress was slow, but the direction was right. On the summary page he wrote: “In April, I will focus on PLC basics and motor control, ensuring 45 minutes of effective study time every day.” He thought for a moment and added another sentence: “Exam preparation can't be rushed, but it can't stop either.” Then he closed the notebook, feeling an unprecedented sense of groundedness.

events.name: Discussed April expenses with his wife during lunch.
events.description: Wang Lijuan brought out the April budget table and pointed out that after lending out 10,000 yuan, they would need to save 800 yuan each month. Lu Mingqiang agreed to keep the monthly squash fee and reduce other group meals. After discussing expenses, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to mention the 10,000 yuan he had lent to Chen Jianguo this month. Wang Lijuan said, “Helping friends is what we should do. Jianguo’s family has encountered trouble, so we’ll just tighten our belts.” Lu Mingqiang nodded, grateful for his wife’s understanding.

events.name: In the evening, the whole family took a walk near the community.
events.description: After dinner, the family of four took a walk on the street. The eldest son reported that the chili peppers had grown taller; the younger son asked for a story about Chang'e. Lu Mingqiang made up a story about an electrician repairing the moon lamp, making the whole family laugh.

events.name: Evening review of bookmarked posts on the tech forum
events.description: Using the upgraded data plan, he browsed cable temperature measurement posts with ease and replied with his practical experience, then turned off his phone at ten o'clock.

events.name: Evening core workout
events.description: Body slightly tired after extra squash practice, but core training as usual: glute bridges 3×25, planks 3×80 seconds, supermans 3×20.

start_state.mood: Slept enough; Sunday plan is relaxed.

end_state.mood: Satisfied with learning progress, the new data plan solved the data traffic anxiety; though family finances are tight, there is a plan, and his mindset is steady.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for the lower back, 1 hour of squash training, and a 1.5-kilometer walk.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning clear, quite sunny at midday

2025-03.daily_overview: On the last day of the month, Lu Mingqiang upgraded his phone plan and then threw himself into work. A brisk walk during lunch break had become a habit. In the evening he studied regularly and browsed collecting forums. Before bed, he strengthened core training and stretching. Looking back on the fulfilling March, his confidence in the future was growing.

events.name: Upgraded his mobile phone plan on the way to work to resolve data overage
events.description: In the morning he received a text message about exceeding data usage, and directly upgraded to the 30GB plan in the app for an extra 30 yuan per month, considering it a necessary expense.

events.name: Morning core training (target intensity reached)
events.description: Up at 6:15, core training stably reached the end-state level: 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 80-second planks, with a stronger feeling of lumbar support.

events.name: Brisk walking during lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, I brisk-walked for about 3.5 km in 35 minutes near the construction site, with a pace of 9 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. It was easy and has become a daily habit.

events.name: Recorded the electrical room renovation requirements for the old residential community
events.description: In the morning, he and Zhao Qiang surveyed the electrical room to be renovated, recording switch models, cable routes, and load data to prepare for next week's renovation plan.

events.name: Fixed evening study routine: dedicate 9 to 10 o'clock exclusively to study.
events.description: After dinner, he consciously went to the desk. In the first half of the session he studied sensor theory, and in the second half he browsed the liquor bottle collecting forum and left messages with Chen Jianguo to discuss restoration of old bottles. The rhythm gave him a sense of stability.

events.name: Stretching before bed and reviewing the month
events.description: Before falling asleep, he did lower back stretches and reviewed March's vegetable planting, car repair, loan, and exam preparation. Though there were small setbacks, the family was safe and studies were improving, so he fell asleep with a sense of security.

events.name: Evening core training for consolidation
events.description: Before going to bed, I completed the full core training routine again (glute bridges 25×3, plank 80 seconds×3), reinforcing the day's results.

start_state.mood: Monday routine startup; he was a bit fussy about the newly adjusted plan but felt it was worth it.

end_state.mood: The pace is manageable. Although financial pressure remains, his solid study habits give him more confidence in passing the senior technician certification.

state.daily_exercise: Core back and waist training (at target intensity), 35-minute brisk walk during lunch break, and evening stretching

2025-12.daily_overview: A new week begins. Lu Mingqiang maintains the post-exam recovery morning jog routine. During the day he handles routine maintenance tasks. After work he buys medicated patches for his mother. In the evening he continues his walk and low-fat diet. His weight has rebounded slightly compared to late November, but his overall healthy habits have returned.

events.name: Morning run and routine maintenance work
events.description: Getting up at 5:55 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang jogged 3 kilometers along Jinmao Middle Road, maintaining the morning exercise habit he had just resumed after the exam. After breakfast, he drove 10 minutes to the company. At the pre-shift meeting, he accepted the arrangement from Squad Leader Zhang and partnered with fellow worker Chen Jianguo to go to an old residential community in Xiuying District to replace a distribution cabinet switch. The two worked well together and finished smoothly in the afternoon.

events.name: Buying medicated plasters for his mother
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang drove out of his way to Baoshoutang Pharmacy near his home to buy medicated patches to relieve his mother Chen Xiuying's knee rheumatism. He bought a one-month supply at once to ensure the medicine would not run out. He also bought an extra bottle of medicated oil, intending to bring it to his father to rub on his lower back when he went home on the weekend.

events.name: Family dinner and evening leisure.
events.description: Dinner was prepared by his wife Wang Lijuan, continuing the low-fat meal plan, with steamed fish, stir-fried choy sum, and multigrain rice. Lu Mingqiang chatted with the two children while eating. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, excitedly said he wanted to use his pocket money to buy a small dinosaur eraser. After dinner, the family took a half-hour walk around the neighborhood. Lu Mingqiang used his phone to browse fault-handling cases shared by peers on a local electric power forum. At 22:45, he washed up and went to bed.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: Peaceful and content.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 3 kilometers, evening walk of 30 minutes.

2025-12.daily_overview: The number on the scale alarmed Lu Mingqiang, and a transfer message in the collector friends group at noon tempted him. He solemnly held a family meeting on health management with his wife, and they decided to more strictly follow a low-fat diet and add evening walks. His wife volunteered to take charge of preparing healthy meals, and life took a new turn.

events.name: Morning weigh-in and BMI calculation.
events.description: After washing up in the morning, Lu Mingqiang stood on the electronic scale in the corner of the bathroom, the red digits stopping at 72.5 kg. He turned and quickly calculated with his phone calculator: 171 cm height, 72.5 kg, BMI equal to 24.8. Opening his browser to search for healthy weight range, the orange-yellow warning box that popped up on the screen made him frown — on the edge of overweight; one more step and it would be obesity. He realized that although he had started a low-fat diet at the end of November, recent social engagements had caused his weight to rebound, so he must be more strict.

events.name: Browse the bottle collecting group during lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang opened the wine bottle collecting WeChat group on his phone and saw a fellow collector message offering to transfer a set of baijiu bottles produced by an old Hainan distillery in the 1990s. The set was in good condition, asking price 500 yuan. Lu Mingqiang was quite tempted, but considering the recent increase in family expenses, he replied in the group that he would check out the actual item on the weekend if he had time.

events.name: Husband and wife discuss a health adjustment plan
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang did not slump onto the sofa as he usually did. Instead, he pulled his wife Wang Lijuan over to the dining table and seriously told her about the morning’s weighing results. He said that from today on he would completely give up late-night snacks, increase the proportion of blanched vegetables at dinner, and insist on taking a half-hour walk along Jinmao Middle Road after dinner every day. Wang Lijuan nodded immediately and volunteered to take charge of preparing healthy meals, deciding to go to the vegetable market early the next morning to buy more broccoli and corn.

events.name: Workday routine and chatting with colleagues.
events.description: The daytime work involved motor maintenance at a small factory in Xiuying District. Lu Mingqiang taught Zhao Qiang the basics of disassembly and assembly. The young man was a bit clumsy and nearly snapped a screw, so Lu Mingqiang patiently demonstrated it again. During a break, he met Chen Jianguo in the cafeteria, and the two grumbled about the recent rise in oil prices. Lu Mingqiang did not mention losing weight; he only said he planned to walk more in the evening.

start_state.mood: Daily status

end_state.mood: Slightly stressed but with a clear goal

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: A light drizzle fell. Lu Mingqiang spent the day on indoor work orders and squash training. He was soaked through during emergency repairs, and during squash he lacked endurance but gritted his teeth and kept going. When he got home, the light vegetable noodles his wife had left warmed his empty stomach. The smart home company mentioned by a squash partner he silently kept in mind.

events.name: Rushing to repair aging electrical lines in the rain
events.description: In the morning a light rain began to fall. Lu Mingqiang received a call from Wang Jianguo, the property management director, saying that the streetlight circuit in Building 3 of the residential complex had short-circuited due to dampness. He put on a raincoat and hurried to the scene, used a test pen to check the circuit section by section, and together with a colleague replaced the water-soaked connectors. Half his body got wet. After finishing, Director Wang handed him hot tea and thanked him repeatedly.

events.name: Simple dinner at the cafeteria and squash training in the evening.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang did not go home. He had a bowl of winter melon soup with rice in the company cafeteria, then drove to the squash club he often visited. At exactly 7:00, his squash partner Lin Feng had already finished warming up. The two played for one hour. Lu Mingqiang clearly felt his stamina declining — the low-fat dinner had weakened his endurance, but he gritted his teeth and held on. Afterward, Lin Feng teased him about whether he had lost weight recently. Lu Mingqiang smiled wryly and told him about his weight-loss plan. Lin Feng mentioned that a smart home company was recruiting technicians who knew electrical work, and suggested Lu Mingqiang try it. Lu Mingqiang noted it in his mind, but for now he preferred to make his own way.

events.name: Reviewed electrical theory to prepare for the next stage of study.
events.description: After showering, Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room, turned on the wall lamp, and leafed through the textbooks he had used while studying for the senior technician exam, hoping to expand his knowledge of automation. But after a while, his eyelids grew heavy, so he had to close the books and planned to systematically work out a study path when he had time on the weekend.

start_state.mood: Plain

end_state.mood: Post-workout fulfillment

state.daily_exercise: Evening squash for 1 hour, plus walking during work breaks.

2025-12.daily_overview: Thursday's emergency transformer repair ran into overtime, and Lu Mingqiang didn't get home until after dark. Though exhausted, he still held an umbrella to complete his walking task. His wife, feeling for him, added seaweed soup. Before bed, he had a voice chat with his older brother about plans to go home for the New Year. Too tired, he soaked his feet and went straight to bed, skipping core training.

events.name: Overtime emergency repair of a transformer
events.description: In the afternoon, a transformer at an industrial park in Xiuying District suddenly developed an oil leak. Lu Mingqiang's work crew rushed out and worked in the sweltering electrical distribution room until evening. He climbed up to disassemble the oil conservator, his face covered in oil, and finally, under Team Leader Zhang's direction, replaced the sealing gasket and restored power. By the time they finished, it was completely dark. Lu Mingqiang felt a dull ache in his lower back and decided to rest well tonight.

events.name: Voice call with older brother Lu Minghua.
events.description: After the meal, Lu Mingqiang saw a WeChat message from his older brother Lu Minghua. When he opened it, it was a long voice message. His brother said business in Shenzhen was good at year-end, and he planned to return to Haikou on the 28th of the twelfth lunar month and could help bring some New Year goods. Lu Mingqiang also told him about his weight loss and physical exam. His brother urged him not to push himself too hard and to take care of his health.

events.name: Insisted on taking an evening walk in the rain.
events.description: Despite the light rain, Lu Mingqiang completed a 30-minute walk with an umbrella, walking along Jinmao Middle Road to Longhua Road and then turning back. He deliberately quickened his pace and his back was slightly sweaty, thinking that the results of tomorrow's senior technician exam might be announced, and felt a wave of anxiety.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired

end_state.mood: Tired but relaxed

state.daily_exercise: Evening 30-minute walk in the rain

2025-12.daily_overview: Once the advanced technician exam results were announced, Lu Mingqiang passed both the theory and practical portions, marking a highlight in his career. He shared the good news with his family and mentor. He went home after enjoying himself thoroughly at the team celebration, but catching a chill late at night brought on a stuffy nose, setting the stage for a small setback for the weekend activities.

events.name: Checked the Senior Technician exam results and reported the good news.
events.description: At 7:30 a.m., Lu Mingqiang logged on to the Electric Power Skills Assessment Center website with his phone at his workstation to check his scores. Seeing 82 in theory and 85 in practical, he confirmed he had passed. Unable to hide his excitement, he immediately called his wife Wang Lijuan. On the other end of the line, Wang Lijuan paused for two seconds and said in a trembling voice that these months had not been suffered in vain. He then called his master, Master Li, to thank him for his strict training back then, and Master Li laughed loudly on the phone.

events.name: Public praise at the pre-shift meeting and congratulations from the manager.
events.description: At the 8 o'clock pre-shift meeting, Team Leader Zhang loudly announced in front of more than a dozen team members that Lu Mingqiang had passed the senior technician exam, and his coworkers applauded warmly. Half an hour later, Manager Liu sent a congratulatory message via WeChat and revealed that the company planned to have him participate in technical guidance for the new project in Xiuying District. Holding his phone, Lu Mingqiang felt his back straighter than ever.

events.name: Celebration meal at the grilled fish restaurant
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang invited seven colleagues from the team to the usual food stall for grilled fish. He deliberately ordered two extra-spicy fish and also several bottles of beer. Chen Jianguo ate while remarking that Brother Qiang was skilled and upright. Zhao Qiang toasted with an admiring look, and even Squad Leader Zhang made an exception to drink a glass. Everyone had a great time until after nine. Lu Mingqiang got into the designated driver's car with a warm heart, but the night wind made him shiver, and he felt a little congested.

start_state.mood: Nervous anticipation

end_state.mood: Relieved pride

state.daily_exercise: Had a lot of walking at work; no additional exercise

2025-12.daily_overview: Despite a slight stuffy nose, Lu Mingqiang browsed the flea market in the morning and found a beloved old item. In the afternoon, the whole family returned to his parents' home to celebrate. His father raised a glass and sighed with emotion that the electrician family legacy had continued for three generations. Lu Mingqiang felt the weight of inheritance in the warmth. His mother specially made ginger tea for him to ward off the cold.

events.name: Wrapping up the treasure hunt at the Bo'ai Road flea market
events.description: On Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike alone to the second-hand market on Bo'ai Road to pick up the last batch of goods. At a stall in a dim old warehouse, he found several well-preserved vintage porcelain cleats and a set of fuse boxes with copper buckles. The stall owner asked for 120 yuan, and he bought them without much bargaining, bringing a stage-closing end to this year's collection of bottles and old electrical items.

events.name: Bought gifts and drove back to parents' home
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang and his wife bought mangoes, dragon fruit, and two bottles of calcium tablets from the supermarket, took their two children Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and drove 20 minutes to his parents' home at No. 42 Haifu Road, Meilan District. The two children played noisily along the way, and the younger son Lu Zihan called out in a sweet voice that he wanted to see Grandpa's old toolbox.

events.name: Family Celebration Banquet and Three Generations of Heritage
events.description: Mother Chen Xiuying had prepared a table full of dishes, including Lu Mingqiang's favorites: Hainanese chicken rice and braised pork belly. Father Lu Jianguo took out a bottle of aged wine from deep in the cabinet. Raising his glass, he said solemnly, 'This electrician trade has continued for three generations in our family. From your grandfather on, who was a distribution worker, and now you've become a technician—my heart is truly at ease.' During the meal, his father recalled the hardships of leading apprentices when he was young, and Lu Mingqiang's eyes grew hot. Seeing his stuffy nose, his mother specially brought a pot of hot ginger tea and told him to take care and rest.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and cheerful

end_state.mood: Fulfillment in family warmth.

state.daily_exercise: Walked about 8,000 steps around the market; no dedicated exercise

2025-12.daily_overview: Sunday at Evergreen Park was filled with the family's laughter. After the morning run, his stuffy nose got better, and a conversation with Chen Bin sparked awareness of insurance. They flew kites in the morning and had qingbuliang in the afternoon. After returning home, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to research insurance products online, taking the first step toward family protection.

events.name: Morning run with running buddy Chen Bin inspires an insurance idea.
events.description: At 6:40 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang hurried to Evergreen Park to meet his running partner Chen Bin, and the two jogged 5 kilometers. During a break, Chen Bin mentioned that he had sprained his leg while running last month, and his commercial accident insurance reimbursed more than 800 yuan in physical therapy costs. He suggested that Lu Mingqiang could also get coverage for his family. Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved. After running home, he immediately told his wife Wang Lijuan about it, and Wang Lijuan also felt they should learn more about it.

events.name: The family of four flew kites at Wanlv Park
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang checked the traditional oil-paper kite he had made by hand, while his wife prepared a large bottle of water and cut fruit. The family of four drove to Wanlv Park. The wind was just right on the wide lawn. Lu Mingqiang guided his second son, Lu Zihan, to slowly let out the line hand by hand; his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, ran wildly across the grass holding the reel, and the kite rose steadily into the blue sky. Wang Lijuan squatted on the ground, clicking the shutter of her phone nonstop, unable to keep from laughing.

events.name: Family time at the Qingbuliang stall
events.description: In the afternoon, the sun was a bit strong, so the family packed up the kites and walked to the qingbuliang stall at the park entrance, ordering four bowls with added taro and barley. The children scooped up the dessert with small spoons, their mouths full of coconut fragrance. Lu Zixuan also asked for an extra coconut cake.

events.name: Researched insurance products in the evening.
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang sat in front of the computer and started searching for accident and medical insurance suitable for the family. He copied the summaries of cost-effective products onto sticky notes, and sent a WeChat message to his classmate Wu Gang, who works at an insurance company, to arrange a phone consultation tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: Satisfaction after parent-child time

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog 5 km, walking about 6,000 steps while flying kites

2025-12.daily_overview: On Monday, his wallet was well padded: a recovered loan and year-end bonus arrived at the same time. Lu Mingqiang showed his financial savvy by going to the bank, opening a dedicated account, asking about fixed deposits, and also making a preliminary inquiry with Wu Gang about insurance. In the evening he continued comparing online, and the family financial plan quietly upgraded.

events.name: Received loan repayment and year-end bonus credited.
events.description: In the morning, when the work team was taking a break, coworker Chen Jianguo slipped a kraft paper envelope to Lu Mingqiang. Inside was the 10,000 yuan in cash he had borrowed earlier. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said it was just the right time to settle the matter before the year ended. Around ten o'clock, a text message notification told him that an 8,000 yuan year-end bonus had been credited to his salary card. He was overjoyed and immediately began planning in his mind how to use the money.

events.name: Quickly consulted Wu Gang during the lunch break
events.description: During his lunch break, Lu Mingqiang called Wu Gang, briefly asking about the coverage and premium of family accident insurance. Wu Gang answered enthusiastically and suggested comparing other companies, and they agreed to discuss it in detail another day.

events.name: Handle a bank deposit and open an Around-the-Island account.
events.description: In the afternoon, taking advantage of an outside repair opportunity, Lu Mingqiang made a detour to the bank. After depositing 18,000 yuan into a current account, he asked the teller directly about the one-year fixed deposit interest rate. After calculating, he converted 10,000 yuan into a one-year time deposit with automatic rollover, and then used the remaining 8,000 yuan to open a new savings account named Family Watching the Sea, specifically for the 2026 island road trip fund. He also set up an automatic monthly transfer of 500 yuan from his salary card on the spot.

events.name: In the evening, compare insurance and go for a walk
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang showed the bank receipt to his wife, and together they confirmed the monthly 500 yuan around-the-island savings plan. After dinner and an evening walk, while his wife tutored their child on homework, Lu Mingqiang sat at the computer continuing to compare insurance plans from various companies, jotting down the key points in his notebook.

start_state.mood: Secretly pleased that the money had arrived.

end_state.mood: A sense of stability after financial planning

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: Insurance consultation became the main focus. In the morning, Lu Mingqiang consulted Wu Gang in detail and called the insurance company, filling his notebook with key points; in the afternoon, he prepared materials for the first aid demonstration. Because he had stayed up late for several consecutive nights researching, he felt sleepy in the morning and drank strong tea to refresh himself. After some simple stretching in the evening, he went to bed early.

events.name: Call classmate Wu Gang and the insurance company for details.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang contacted Wu Gang on his phone at his workstation and fired off the prepared list of questions one by one—coverage, sum insured, premium, and claims process. Wu Gang answered enthusiastically and suggested comparing other companies. In the afternoon, he called the customer service numbers of two companies, compiled their family comprehensive accident insurance plans into a table, and initially preferred a product from an established company.

events.name: Prepare first aid demonstration materials
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang did not go straight home but went into the company tool room and reviewed the mannequin model, protective pads, and simple PPT used for electric shock first aid demonstration. He focused on practicing the compression rhythm of CPR and looked back at the construction site accident news saved a couple of days earlier, determined to explain the procedure more thoroughly at the safety meeting. Although he was sleepy during the day, he was highly focused while practicing the first aid procedure, and only after finishing did he feel deep fatigue wash over him.

events.name: Adjusted evening plan due to sleepiness
events.description: Because he had stayed up late the night before, he felt dizzy and groggy when he got up in the morning. Lu Mingqiang brewed a cup of strong tea and managed to get through the morning. After dinner, he had wanted to continue studying electrical safety knowledge, but his eyelids were heavy, so he simply did 15 minutes of stretching and foam roller relaxation and, as an exception, went to bed at 22:00 after soaking his feet.

start_state.mood: Somewhat drowsy but forcing himself to stay alert

end_state.mood: Fatigue and peace of mind after completing the preparations.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk canceled due to drowsiness; only did stretching.

2025-12.daily_overview: The younger son's fourth birthday coincided with squash day. Lu Mingqiang took the afternoon off, completed his squash training, and bought a cake. After the family celebrated in the evening, the couple discussed and finalized the insurance plan, and the family's risk protection was about to be completed.

events.name: Afternoon time off in lieu for squash training.
events.description: After finishing the work orders in the morning, Lu Mingqiang asked Team Leader Zhang for the afternoon off to handle 'family matters,' but in fact he rushed to the squash club. At 3 p.m., he practiced with his squash partner Lin Feng for an hour. He was in good form, and his core strength remained good. Lin Feng again suggested that he consider the smart home field, and Lu Mingqiang revealed that he had a plan.

events.name: Bought a birthday cake.
events.description: After squash training, Lu Mingqiang made a special detour to the best cake shop on Longhua Road and picked out a cream cake in the shape of a cartoon excavator, because Lu Zihan especially liked construction vehicles.

events.name: Family birthday celebration
events.description: In the evening, the family sat around the dining table, lit candles, and sang the birthday song. Lu Zihan puffed out his cheeks and blew several times before putting out the candles; the whole family laughed. Wang Lijuan recorded the whole time with her phone, and Lu Mingqiang picked up his younger son and kissed him again and again.

events.name: Burn a disc of growth videos
events.description: After the celebration, Lu Mingqiang copied the video files from his phone and walked to a digital imaging shop near the community. He spent 20 yuan to burn the full birthday video onto a DVD. The shop owner said few people burn discs nowadays, but Lu Mingqiang felt this was a more reliable way to preserve it. When he got home, he placed the DVD side by side with the disc from his eldest son's earlier birthday on the top shelf of the bookcase.

events.name: The couple finalized the insurance plan
events.description: After settling the children down, Lu Mingqiang showed Wang Lijuan the insurance comparison table he had put together a few days ago, and they discussed it item by item. Wang Lijuan calculated the premiums and reimbursement rates carefully. In the end, they chose the similar product recommended by Wu Gang - a family comprehensive accident insurance plan with medical coverage from a large company, with an annual premium of 2,600 yuan. Lu Mingqiang decided to apply for it tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Happy about my son's birthday

end_state.mood: Warmth after a family ceremony.

state.daily_exercise: Squash training for 1 hour, light evening activity.

2025-12.daily_overview: In the morning, he rushed around booking the farewell banquet for his master; in the afternoon, his electric shock first aid demonstration at the safety meeting won resounding applause. In the evening, he thoroughly convinced his wife with accident news, and carefully prepared a toolbox to give to his master. Major progress in both career and family was made on this day.

events.name: Reserve a restaurant for the farewell dinner and notify his fellow students.
events.description: During the morning work break, Lu Mingqiang called a seafood restaurant in Xiuying District and booked a private room for noon on December 13, ordering several signature dishes his master liked. He also sent a notice in the team WeChat group and the small group of fellow apprentices; Zhao Qiang and a few young colleagues all replied that they would definitely come. While talking with his senior fellow apprentice on the phone, the latter casually mentioned that their master's blood pressure had been a bit high recently. Lu Mingqiang's heart sank, and he silently prayed that his master would stay well.

events.name: First aid demonstration at the year-end safety meeting
events.description: At three in the afternoon, the company's large meeting room was packed. Dressed in work clothes, Lu Mingqiang brought up a mannequin and a simple PPT and calmly demonstrated the entire electric shock first aid procedure: cut off the power, check consciousness, perform chest compressions, give rescue breathing... Each step was accompanied by clear explanations. After it ended, Manager Liu publicly praised Lu Mingqiang as a benchmark of employee skills and asked him to consider recording the demonstration as a training video for new employees.

events.name: Use accident cases to convince his wife.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang showed Wang Lijuan the three news reports about electric shock and fall injuries at construction sites that he had saved on his phone, and earnestly explained that there are indeed potential risks in his work, and that insurance is not a waste but a safety rope for the whole family. After reading, Wang Lijuan was silent for a moment, then finally nodded in agreement to take care of it as soon as possible. The two agreed to buy the insurance early the next morning.

events.name: Mounting the tool box to give to the master.
events.description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang polished the vintage fuse box he had picked up at the flea market, fixed it to the lining of a wooden tool box with hot-melt glue, and embossed a set of blessings on the inside of the lid. Imagining the look on his mentor's face when he received it, he felt both excited and reluctant to part with it.

start_state.mood: Busy but full of drive.

end_state.mood: Satisfaction from career achievement and family consensus together

state.daily_exercise: Stood for 2 hours during meeting presentation, only did simple stretching in the evening

2025-12.daily_overview: The insurance policy was officially completed, and the annual physical examination was booked. However, a doubled electricity bill broke the calm of the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang checked the household appliances one by one without finding the cause, and decided to get to the bottom of it on the weekend. After checking, he discussed the pre-holiday cleaning arrangements with his wife, then canceled the evening activities due to fatigue, soaked his feet, and went to bed.

events.name: Completed comprehensive accident insurance for the whole family
events.description: At eight in the morning, Lu Mingqiang used mobile banking to transfer the annual premium of 2,600 yuan to the selected insurance company, and filled out the health declarations for the whole family of four online. Five minutes after submitting, he received the electronic policy. At his workstation he printed out a paper policy with a dot-matrix printer. After work, he locked it together with the property deed in the bedroom safe and told his wife where it was. Wang Lijuan said she felt much more relieved.

events.name: Schedule the annual physical exam and request compensatory leave.
events.description: After the insurance was successfully purchased, Lu Mingqiang struck while the iron was hot and booked a routine physical examination package for the afternoon of December 15 via the WeChat official account of Haikou People's Hospital. He then found Squad Leader Zhang and orally requested half a day off for the afternoon of the 15th. The squad leader readily signed and told him to rest assured and go to the hospital.

events.name: Discovered abnormal electricity bill and conducted preliminary checks.
events.description: At three in the afternoon, the property management posted last month's bill at the entrance. Lu Mingqiang found that his family's electricity bill was as high as 600 yuan, double the usual amount. After returning home, he checked the air conditioner, refrigerator, and water heater one by one, and even unplugged idle sockets to test the current, but found nothing abnormal. He stood at the door staring at the meter box, deep in thought, and decided to thoroughly inspect the outdoor wiring after dawn the next morning.

events.name: Discussing the pre-festival thorough cleaning arrangements with his wife.
events.description: After the troubleshooting was done, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan sat on the sofa to rest. They briefly discussed plans for a thorough house cleaning before New Year's Day, decided to do it together on Sunday, and listed the storage room and balcony areas that needed special attention.

events.name: Went to bed early because he was tired from the troubleshooting.
events.description: After working on troubleshooting electrical appliances until nine o'clock, Lu Mingqiang felt exhausted. After a brief exchange with his wife, he made an exception and skipped the evening workout. He only soaked his feet and went to bed at 22:40.

start_state.mood: Decisiveness with thoroughness

end_state.mood: Reassurance after buying insurance mixed with electricity bill worries

state.daily_exercise: Canceled evening activity due to electrical appliance troubleshooting

2025-12.daily_overview: In the morning, investigating the electric meter uncovered the mix-up of a neighbor's wrong wiring, and the neighbors turned a mishap into a blessing. At noon, at the master's retirement farewell banquet, Lu Mingqiang gave a choked-up speech and presented a framed toolbox, and the master promised to serve as an advisor for a future studio. In one day, he resolved the electricity bill problem and gained a promise of wisdom for the road ahead.

events.name: Troubleshooting the electric meter exposed a neighbor's wrong wiring
events.description: Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang took out a tool ladder and carefully inspected his outdoor electricity meter box. With years of experience, he found that the wiring of the newly renovated downstairs neighbor's air conditioner outdoor unit had been incorrectly connected to his own meter circuit at some point. He immediately called Director Wang of the property management office and knocked on the neighbor's door to calmly explain the situation. The neighbor quickly apologized, promised to pay the extra electricity bill, and immediately called an electrician to rewire the lines. An hour later, the circuit was restored. The neighbor then came to his door with a box of mangoes to apologize. Lu Mingqiang accepted them with a smile, and the two became well acquainted from then on.

events.name: Host a retirement farewell banquet for Master.
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang arrived early at the seafood restaurant in Xiuying District to set things up. When Master Li entered the private room, the large screen was playing on a loop the work photos of the master and apprentices that Lu Mingqiang had secretly collected over the years. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang spoke as the apprentice representative; when he mentioned the scene in 2007 when the master taught him hand-by-hand to connect his first cable, his voice trembled. He handed the master a tool box with an old fuse box mounted in it. Master Li patted his shoulder and said that if Lu Mingqiang opened a studio in the future, he would definitely come and serve as a consultant. He then gave Lu Mingqiang a set of electrician tools and several notebooks he had treasured as startup resources on the spot. All the apprentices present were deeply moved.

events.name: Organize photos of the gathering and share gratitude
events.description: After the farewell banquet ended, it was past three by the time he got home. Lu Mingqiang organized the group photos and the video of the master's speech from his phone into an album, shared it in the fellow apprentices' chat group, and also sent Master Li a solo photo of the two of them holding a tool box, with the message: "One day as my master, forever like a father. Your disciple will always remember your teaching."

start_state.mood: Determined to get to the bottom of the electricity bill issue.

end_state.mood: Gratitude and reluctance intertwined.

state.daily_exercise: Inspect the electric meter, go up and down stairs, and walk about 5,000 steps at the banquet.

2025-12.daily_overview: On Sunday, he had tea with the neighbor to make peace, officially accepted the electricity compensation, and gained a potential business opportunity. In the afternoon, he downloaded the automation course and completed the payment. In the evening, he organized the annual work log. Lu Mingqiang gradually settled down from the celebration and turned his attention to longer-term learning and entrepreneurship.

events.name: Drank tea with neighbor to reconcile and obtained business information.
events.description: In the morning, the neighbor downstairs transferred the 400 yuan electricity fee difference to Lu Mingqiang via WeChat, apologized again, and invited him downstairs for laobaicha. The two sat down at a tea shop near the community. The neighbor said that the small company he ran happened to need to rewire the office area, and wanted to ask Lu Mingqiang to come and take a look on the weekend. Lu Mingqiang readily agreed, and they arranged to discuss it in detail next week.

events.name: Downloaded and purchased an automation control course
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang downloaded a well-known electrician training app from the mobile app store, searched for the basic PLC automation control course, watched a sample, felt the explanation was clear, and paid 99 yuan to purchase the full course. He plans to start formal study tomorrow evening to lay the foundation for his studio to take on smart home projects in the future.

events.name: Organize the annual work log.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang took out a thick stack of work logs from the bottom of the bookcase, circled the marked typical fault cases with a red pen, and planned to compile them into a technical case collection by the end of the year. His wife Wang Lijuan was knitting beside him, occasionally looking up to ask whether he needed help sorting them. Lu Mingqiang waved his hand and said these were all his treasures.

start_state.mood: A relaxed weekend morning

end_state.mood: The future direction became increasingly clear.

state.daily_exercise: Evening walk for 30 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: An ordinary Monday became fulfilling due to morning running, a physical exam, and study. Lu Mingqiang did a 5 km recovery run in the early morning, worked as usual in the morning, took compensatory leave in the afternoon to complete the annual physical exam. The indicators were basically normal, but the doctor advised controlling weight. In the evening, he started an automation course to build strength for his studio.

events.name: Morning recovery run of 5 km.
events.description: Got up at 6:15 in the morning. Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and went to Wanlv Park, jogged 5 kilometers at a pace of about 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer, did a full dynamic warm-up before the run, and stretched for ten minutes afterward. The morning breeze was cool, and he was slightly sweaty after the run, feeling full of energy for the whole day.

events.name: Remind mother to apply a hot compress to her knees on rainy and overcast days.
events.description: On the way home after his run, he saw in the weather forecast that rain was coming. Lu Mingqiang called his mother and reminded her to put the plaster on her knees before the weather changed and to apply a hot towel. His mother laughed on the other end of the line and said he was getting more and more naggy, telling him not to worry.

events.name: Morning work at the company
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang went to the company. In the morning, he handled two routine work orders and, working with Zhao Qiang, replaced the indicator light of an old switchgear cabinet. The process went smoothly.

events.name: Took compensatory leave in the afternoon to go to the hospital for a physical examination.
events.description: After lunch at the company canteen, Lu Mingqiang left the factory with the compensatory leave slip signed by Team Leader Zhang and drove 30 minutes to the physical examination center at Haikou People's Hospital. As required, he had blood drawn, an electrocardiogram, a chest X-ray, and a lung capacity test. The whole process took about two hours. The doctor said he was generally in good shape, but his weight was in the overweight range, and advised him to keep exercising and control his diet. He was asked to pick up the full report in about a week.

events.name: Started learning the autonomous driving control course in the evening.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang opened the purchased automation control course and carefully finished the first two lessons. In his newly bought leather notebook, he drew a PLC input/output wiring diagram and marked several key ports. His second son, Lu Zihan, ran over curiously to look. Lu Mingqiang sat his son on his lap and, pointing at the diagram, said it was Dad's secret weapon for opening a personal repair shop in the future.

events.name: Evening routine stretching and a walk
events.description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang took a 30-minute walk around the neighborhood with his wife. After returning home, he completed 15 minutes of core training, full-body stretching, and foam rolling. At 22:50 he soaked his feet, and at 23:00 he turned off the lights on time.

start_state.mood: Calm and organized

end_state.mood: The calm certainty of having the goal in hand.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, evening walk 30 minutes, core training 15 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: Year-end tasks progressed steadily. During the day, handled the transformer inspection and repair task in the commercial district. In the evening, had a video call with childhood friend Wang Hai, sharing the joy of the senior technician certificate and family updates. Afterwards, discussed Spring Festival reception arrangements with his wife, and before bed studied PLC lessons 3 to 4 and took notes. Weight stayed at 71.5 kg, and the low-fat diet and morning running habit were consolidated.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, I went for a 5-kilometer morning run in Wanlv Garden, with a pace of 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. I warmed up thoroughly before starting and stretched for 10 minutes after the run.

events.name: Transformer maintenance
events.description: In the morning, he performed transformer maintenance and inspection at a commercial complex in Xiuying District, partnering with fellow worker Chen Jianguo, and completed the task smoothly.

events.name: Dinner with family
events.description: After getting off work and coming home, Wang Lijuan had already made Hainanese chicken rice. During dinner, the family of four discussed the plan to go to Grandma's house for the Winter Solstice meal.

events.name: Video call with childhood friend Wang Hai
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang had a video call via WeChat with his childhood friend Wang Hai in Shenzhen from his living room. He shared the joy of obtaining his senior technician certificate, family updates, and his plan to take the family on an island road trip after the Spring Festival. Wang Hai also talked about his progress in electronics product sales in Shenzhen. They chatted for about half an hour, recalled childhood memories, and agreed to meet up when they returned to Haikou for the Spring Festival.

events.name: Shared the content of the phone call with his wife and discussed plans for the Spring Festival.
events.description: After the video call ended, Lu Mingqiang excitedly told his wife Wang Lijuan about his conversation with Wang Hai, especially the agreement to meet during the Spring Festival, and they discussed the arrangements for hosting the Spring Festival gathering.

events.name: Recorded a memo for the Spring Festival gathering
events.description: Lu Mingqiang jotted down in his phone's memo app the details of the Spring Festival gathering arranged with his childhood friend Wang Hai, including the approximate time and initial ideas, so he wouldn't forget.

events.name: Studied lessons 3 and 4 of PLC and took notes.
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang opened the PLC course he had just bought on his phone and studied lessons 3 to 4, which involved input/output interfaces. Although the content was somewhat dry, he persisted in drawing wiring diagrams in his notebook and planned to review them during daytime work breaks.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: Satisfied and pleased

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-12.daily_overview: As year-end emergency repair tasks increased, I spent almost all day outdoors handling line faults. I finished work early in the afternoon, and in the evening went to the club for routine squash training; my touch felt good. Before bed, too tired to study PLC, I canceled that and instead had a brief talk with my wife.

events.name: Morning run with running partner Chen Bin
events.description: At 6:20 in the morning, he and his running partner Chen Bin met for a 5 km morning run at Evergreen Park, maintaining a steady pace of 6:25 per kilometer. After the run, they talked about their recent training experiences.

events.name: Emergency cable repair
events.description: In the morning, I received an emergency repair call. A cable on Haisheng Road had been cut by construction. I went to the scene with the work crew and worked continuously for 4 hours to restore power.

events.name: Lunch break
events.description: At noon, he simply had a serving of Hainan rice noodles near the construction site and took the chance to rest in a shaded spot beside the site.

events.name: Finalizing the line inspection
events.description: In the afternoon, they continued line inspection and restoration wrap-up, tested voltage with the power supply bureau, and finished 1 hour earlier than expected.

events.name: Regular squash training
events.description: In the evening went to the squash club for the weekly Wednesday routine training, practiced with fellow player Lin Feng for one hour, focusing on backhand volleys, in good form.

events.name: Casual chat with his wife
events.description: After returning home from training, he chatted with his wife in the living room about interesting incidents during the day's emergency repair. Wang Lijuan had prepared some Qingbuliang as a late-night snack, but Lu Mingqiang only ate a small amount to control calories.

start_state.mood: In good spirits

end_state.mood: Fulfilling but slightly tired.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, squash training 1 hour

2025-12.daily_overview: In my spare time during the day, I began organizing the year's technical case studies. In the evening, I made a last-minute trip to the squash court for extra practice but sprained my left ankle on the slippery floor. I iced it and went home to rest. I decided to suspend running for two days and focus on recovery.

events.name: Taking the children to school
events.description: In the morning, he drove the two children to school on the way; his younger son recited a Tang poem in the car.

events.name: Warehouse tool inventory
events.description: In the morning, assisted in organizing the annual tool inventory in the warehouse and found two old impact drills that needed to be registered for scrapping.

events.name: Going through maintenance work orders.
events.description: In the afternoon there were no field tasks; in the team rest room, I went through the year's maintenance work orders, tallied high-frequency faults, and gathered material for a case compilation.

events.name: Sprained ankle during squash training
events.description: In the evening, he received a notice from the club that the court was available, so he went for one hour of competitive training. While moving sideways to save the ball, he accidentally sprained his left ankle because the floor was slightly wet. Mild swelling and pain appeared immediately. His playing partner Lin Feng helped him apply an ice pack and advised him to rest right away.

events.name: Go home and treat the injury
events.description: After returning home, he continued applying ice, and his wife helped wrap the area with an elastic bandage. Lu Mingqiang assessed that the injury was not serious, did not go to the hospital, and decided to suspend running the next day.

events.name: Upper body and core training
events.description: Because his ankle could not bear weight, he did 20 minutes of upper-body strength (dumbbell curls, bent-over rows) and core (plank, lying leg raises) training in the living room to stay active.

events.name: Record the injury and plan adjustment
events.description: Before going to bed, recorded the ankle sprain in the diary and planned to do only upper-body and core training for the next two days, then try jogging again after the swelling goes down.

start_state.mood: Awake

end_state.mood: Slightly frustrated but optimistic.

state.daily_exercise: Squash training (sprain), upper-body and core training for 20 minutes.

2025-12.daily_overview: The ankle swelling has reduced somewhat, so he paused his morning runs and switched to upper-body strength training. During the day, the team carried out a thorough cleaning; after work, he bought materials for the compilation. In the evening, he organized documents and studied the PLC course. The ankle injury did not dampen his enthusiasm for learning.

events.name: Upper body strength training
events.description: In the morning, completed 20 minutes of upper-body training on the balcony, including push-ups, resistance band rows, etc. The ankle was protected with an elastic bandage, and it did not cause pain.

events.name: Team safety and hygiene cleanup
events.description: As the year-end approached, the team carried out a safety and sanitation cleanup. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for organizing the tool cabinet and wiping all the tools until they shone.

events.name: Team leader announced the year-end summary meeting
events.description: At noon, while eating in the cafeteria, Team Leader Zhang informed everyone about next Monday's team year-end summary meeting and asked everyone to prepare brief remarks.

events.name: Purchase assembly materials.
events.description: After work in the afternoon, he went to a stationery store to buy printing paper, file folders, and binder clips, preparing to organize a compilation of technical cases. He chose heavy-weight printing paper and transparent covers.

events.name: Pack up the laobaicha snacks
events.description: On the way home, he ordered several coconut shred buns and egg tarts to take away from a Laobaicha tea shop in Longhua District for the kids.

events.name: Organizing electronic documents and studying PLC
events.description: In the evening, continued studying PLC course lessons 5 to 6, focusing on understanding timer and counter instructions. Sitting at the desk with his injured left foot propped on a low stool beside him, he watched the video and marked the manual with a red pen, studying very efficiently.

events.name: Apply an ice pack before bed
events.description: After a day of rest, the swelling in the ankle has mostly subsided. Before bed, he applied ice to the ankle for another 10 minutes. He noticed the swelling area had shrunk and the pain was mild, which increased his confidence in recovery.

start_state.mood: Normal

end_state.mood: Looking forward to the weekend; the ankle is getting better.

state.daily_exercise: Upper body training for 20 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: Tried jogging 2 kilometers on the ankle without pain, restoring confidence. In the morning, mastered PLC programming logic (lessons 7 to 9); in the afternoon, studied old tools with co-workers and tutored his eldest son in programming homework; in the evening, preliminarily bound the year's technical cases into a volume, one step closer to his dream workshop.

events.name: Try jogging 2 km
events.description: After getting up in the morning, I did a very slow 2-kilometer test run around the neighborhood. My ankle had no pain, so I then did 10 minutes of stretching and confirmed I could gradually resume running.

events.name: Upper body and core supplementary training.
events.description: After the jog, he went home and completed a 15-minute upper-body dumbbell workout and a 10-minute core workout to keep his strength from regressing.

events.name: Studied PLC lessons 7 through 9.
events.description: In the morning, I studied lessons 7 to 9 in a row, gained a deeper understanding of PLC programming logic, and drew several ladder diagram examples in my notebook. During a break, I made a cup of Hainan coffee to refresh myself.

events.name: Studying old tools with workmates.
events.description: In the afternoon, he took several old electrical repair tools he had collected and met his workmate Chen Jianguo at a tea shop. The two of them drank tea while taking apart a 1960s oil-immersed switch, analyzing the mechanical principles and recalling the skills passed down by the old master craftsmen.

events.name: Tutor eldest son's programming homework
events.description: After parting with Chen Jianguo, Lu Mingqiang returned home and saw Lu Zixuan struggling with his children's programming homework. He sat down beside his son, used the principle of relay circuits as an analogy for programming logic, and spent half an hour helping him understand loop instructions. Lu Zixuan suddenly saw the light and finished the homework successfully.

events.name: Arrange to fly kites.
events.description: After chatting at the tea shop, the two agreed to go kite flying at Baishamen Park after New Year's Day. Chen Jianguo said he would bring a centipede kite made at home.

events.name: Selecting and binding case files
events.description: In the evening in his home study, he sorted out 20 typical cases selected from the whole year's work logs, categorizing them by fault type, solution, and so on. He printed them with the home printer, bound them simply into a booklet with a binder clip, and made a simple cover.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and full of anticipation

end_state.mood: Proud and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Jogging 2 kilometers, upper body and core exercises for 25 minutes

2025-12.daily_overview: In the morning, I picked up the physical examination report. All indicators were basically normal, and the doctor advised controlling weight, which strengthened my determination to lose weight. In the morning, I jogged 3 kilometers and felt good, and my ankle was basically fine. During the day, I filed the case compilation, played with my second son, and studied PLC in the evening.

events.name: Jog 3 kilometers.
events.description: At 7 a.m., jogged 3 km at an easy pace in the community. Stretched after the run. No discomfort in the ankle, so he decided to resume his regular running tomorrow.

events.name: Collected the physical examination report.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang went to Haikou People's Hospital to pick up his physical examination report from a week earlier. The results showed that indicators such as blood routine and electrocardiogram were basically normal. The doctor verbally advised him to control his weight and increase aerobic exercise, and gave him a fat-loss meal plan.

events.name: Archive the case compilation.
events.description: Put the bound case compilation into a dedicated folder in the bookcase, label it "Studio Technical Reference Materials," and place it next to the electrician's manual.

events.name: Played with his second son on a scooter.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., he drove his second son Lu Zihan to the community square to ride a scooter. They enjoyed some sunshine for a while, and the boy was soon drenched in sweat.

events.name: The whole family went out for lunch
events.description: At noon, he took the whole family out to eat the rice noodle rolls and pork rib rice that his younger son likes. The family chatted and laughed.

events.name: Studied PLC lessons 8 to 9
events.description: On Sunday evening, Lu Mingqiang studied lessons 8 to 9, which covered simple programming instructions. He watched repeatedly and tried writing small programs in his notebook.

events.name: Recorded an audio explanation of the program.
events.description: After studying, he used his phone to record a voice memo of himself explaining the program logic, planning to ask his colleague Zhang Jianguo for advice the next day.

start_state.mood: Calm

end_state.mood: Clear goals

state.daily_exercise: Jog 3 kilometers.

2025-12.daily_overview: In the early morning, went for a run to welcome the Winter Solstice; in the morning, attended the team's year-end summary; in the afternoon, handled a resident's electrical circuit fault. Before leaving work, flew a kite with the child in the community open area. After that, the whole family went to the wife's parents' home to spend the Winter Solstice together, warm and harmonious.

events.name: Team year-end summary meeting
events.description: In the morning, attended the team's year-end summary meeting. Team Leader Zhang praised the year's safety performance and mentioned that Lu Mingqiang had obtained the Senior Technician certificate, bringing honor to the team. His colleagues applauded and congratulated him.

events.name: Lunch gathering with colleagues.
events.description: At noon, had lunch with colleagues at a small restaurant near the construction site and discussed year-end work wrap-up. Chen Jianguo said he planned to take his family to Sanya during the Spring Festival holiday.

events.name: Handle a tripped circuit breaker in a residential community
events.description: In the afternoon, handled a repair for a tripped circuit breaker in a residential community. Found that the household's overloaded electricity use had caused the air switch to age, and after replacing it, power was restored.

events.name: Winter Solstice 5 km morning run
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and completed a 5 km morning run to welcome the winter solstice. During the run, he deliberately checked the stability of his ankle on landing. After confirming there was no pain, he felt completely at ease and decided to gradually restore his running distance to the pre-injury level within the week.

events.name: Flying kites in the residential community.
events.description: In the late afternoon, while the sky was still bright, he took the two children to the open ground in the residential area to fly a small kite and enjoyed half an hour of parent-child time. The younger son ran after the kite happily.

events.name: Preparing Winter Solstice gifts and going to the wife's parents' home.
events.description: After flying kites and returning home, the family of four packed up the gifts (Feizixiao dried lychees and rice cakes). Lu Mingqiang drove the family to his wife's parents' home in Meilan District, and the evening rush hour took 40 minutes.

events.name: Spent the Winter Solstice at his wife's parents' home.
events.description: After arriving, the eldest son, Lu Zixuan, used a tablet to show the electronic greeting card he had programmed, earning praise from his grandparents. The whole family sat down together for the Winter Solstice reunion dinner, and the main dishes were Wenchang chicken and a family-reunion hotpot.

events.name: Heartwarming moments on the way back

events.name: Regular early-morning run

He strictly performed the pre-run warm-up and post-run stretching, felt light on his feet, and kept up the good exercise form from last month. After finishing the run, he ate Hainan noodles at a breakfast stall by the park gate, and on the way home brought steamed buns and soy milk for the family.

events.name: After work, made a detour to the pharmacy to buy medicated patches for his mother.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike on a detour to the pharmacy near his home to buy the pain-relief patches for his mother Chen Xiuying's chronic cold-leg pain needed this month. He carefully checked the brand and specifications to make sure the medicine would not run out, and also asked the clerk whether there were breathable patches suitable for summer use. After paying, he called his mother to confirm he would deliver them after dinner tomorrow; his mother told him to ride carefully.

events.name: First day of tutoring eldest son in math after dinner.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang asked his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to sit at the dining table, took out the grid paper and cardboard models he had made over the weekend, and began explaining how to calculate the area of rectangles and squares. Zixuan was curious and played with the teaching aids at first, but after a few minutes his attention began to wander, and his eyes drifted to the TV in the living room, which was playing cartoons. Lu Mingqiang reminded him three times, and his tone gradually changed from gentle to stern. Zixuan managed to stay seated, but was clearly distracted. The first day of tutoring ended with little progress.

events.name: Studying advanced electrician technician theory before bedtime
events.description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang finished washing up and leaned against the headboard. Using his phone browser, he watched the basic circuit analysis section of an advanced electrician technician theory teaching video. Wearing earphones to avoid disturbing his sleeping wife, he held a notebook in one hand and carefully copied down key formulas such as Kirchhoff's laws and the node voltage method. When he encountered complicated derivations, he paused and rewatched. After studying for about 40 minutes, he turned off the light and went to sleep.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and looking forward to the new week's work and study plans

end_state.mood: Slightly tired, a bit worried about his son's attitude toward studying.
