2025-07.daily_overview: On Wednesday, with high temperatures, Lu Mingqiang carried out outdoor distribution cabinet renovation work during the day. After dinner, he continued tutoring math. Zixuan, overwhelmed by accumulated homework, talked back. Lu Mingqiang restrained his temper and switched to listening and guiding to resolve the conflict. The tutoring was completed with some bumps.

events.name: Outdoor work in high-temperature weather
events.description: Lu Mingqiang spent the whole day at an outdoor power distribution cabinet in Xiuying District, Haikou, carrying out renovation and installation. Under the scorching sun, the equipment casing was hot to the touch. Wearing the sun-protective arm sleeves and wide-brimmed hat issued by the company, he worked with sweat soaking the back of his work uniform. During the lunch break, he and his coworkers Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang ate boxed meals in the shade under a tree. Zhao Qiang complained that the weather was too hot, and Lu Mingqiang reminded him to drink more Huoxiang Zhengqi oral liquid to prevent heatstroke. At the end of the afternoon shift, team leader Zhang gathered everyone to emphasize the next day's high-temperature protection precautions.

events.name: Conflict and emotional management while tutoring eldest son in math
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang continued helping Zixuan with area formulas. Because of the pile of summer homework, Zixuan was strongly resistant, and when his father pointed out a calculation error, he directly talked back: "Everything the teacher says in class, I already understand! You don't need to teach me!" Lu Mingqiang's anger surged immediately. He had planned to continue the teaching-aid explanation from last night, but his son's resistance completely disrupted it. He slapped the table with his palm, but remembering the "understand children's emotions" idea the psychologist had talked about at last year's company safety training, he took three deep breaths, slowly sat down beside Zixuan, suppressed his anger, and asked Zixuan to first explain his own understanding. After listening, he discovered Zixuan's confusion about area units, patiently pointed out the misunderstanding, and helped him establish the correct problem-solving steps. Although Zixuan was still pouting, he gradually cooperated and finished the homework.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired, worried about whether tonight's tutoring will go smoothly.

end_state.mood: Calmed down after emotional fluctuations, feeling surprised and satisfied with my restraint.

2025-07.daily_overview: Thursday's work was steady. Lu Mingqiang changed his tutoring strategy, adopting a guided teaching approach of letting him try first and then explaining. Zixuan's resistance lessened. In the evening he attended his weekly squash training, but because his focus had been divided by days of tutoring, he made more mistakes.

events.name: Adjust the math tutoring strategy
events.description: After reflecting on the problems of the past two days, Lu Mingqiang decided to change his strategy. After dinner, instead of explaining directly, he had Zixuan first work independently on an area calculation problem, then guide his thinking step by step based on his mistakes. When Zixuan got stuck and wanted to give up, Lu Mingqiang resisted the urge to interrupt and waited until he had laid out his complete thought process before adding corrections. Zixuan sensed that his father was no longer as impatient as before and gradually became more cooperative. That evening, the tutoring session extended by 15 minutes without him throwing a tantrum; although efficiency was still not high, the atmosphere had clearly eased.

He played a practice match with his squash partner Lin Feng, but he felt his footwork was not as agile as usual. Several times he was a half-step slow to react, and he made too many unforced errors. Lin Feng noticed his fatigue and asked why after the match. Lu Mingqiang briefly mentioned that tutoring his child in the evenings had been mentally draining lately. The two agreed to adjust the training intensity next week and focus on practicing backhand cross-court shots.

The two chatted about their children's summer vacation plans. Chen Jianguo complained that his son played mobile games all day. Lu Mingqiang shared his experience of being talked back to while tutoring Zixuan in math, and Chen Jianguo laughed and said it was the same in his family. The two agreed to take both families to Baishamen Park to fly kites on the weekend if they were free.

His father Lu Jianguo came back from the community chess and card room, and the family sat around the table for dinner. Lu Mingqiang handed the medicated plaster to his mother and told her to warm her knees with it before rainy weather. His father asked about his recent work, and Lu Mingqiang briefly mentioned the emergency repair preparations for typhoon season. His father nodded in approval. After dinner, his mother gave Zixuan a few mangoes, and father and son rode home in the evening breeze.

events.name: Played with building blocks with his two sons.
events.description: After returning from his parents' house, Lu Mingqiang asked to suspend the tutoring for the evening. His second son Lu Zihan took out his bucket of building blocks and asked his father to build a house together. Zixuan also joined in, and the three of them built a crooked "castle" on the living room floor. Lu Mingqiang saw Zixuan use the blocks to demonstrate the idea that "the area of a rectangle is just layers of blocks filling it up," and secretly felt pleased, thinking it was a good approach. His wife Wang Lijuan watched from the side and smiled, saying it was rare to see the father and two sons getting along so harmoniously.

events.name: Organized his liquor bottle collection notes and studied.
events.description: After the children were asleep, Lu Mingqiang first took out his liquor bottle collection notebook, filled in complete information for the two new baijiu bottles added last month, and photographed them for the record. He then continued studying the theory for the senior electrician technician qualification, focusing on complex example problems in circuit analysis, and wrote out the detailed derivations of three examples in his notebook. After studying for about an hour, he rested.

start_state.mood: Feeling good, looking forward to having dinner at my parents' house.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and content, family time is reassuring

state.daily_exercise: Normal work with physical labor; rode electric bike to and from parents' home

2025-07.daily_overview: Saturday was a rest day. Lu Mingqiang got up early and went for a morning run in Baishamen Park, enjoying some time alone. During the day he stayed home with the children and helped his wife with housework. After dinner, there was a turning point in tutoring: Zixuan actively cooperated and understood the area formula through a demonstration with teaching aids, and the parent-child rapport improved significantly.

events.name: Weekend morning run
events.description: Lu Mingqiang got up at 6:30 a.m., put on his professional running shoes, and went for a morning run at Baishamen Park. He jogged 5 kilometers along his familiar route, maintaining a pace of around 6:00 per kilometer. The morning breeze was cool, and there were many elderly people and fellow runners exercising in the park. He met his running buddy Chen Bin, and the two ran side by side for a while. Chen Bin asked how often he had been running lately. Lu Mingqiang said that since he had been helping his children with homework in the evenings, he might only be able to run on weekends. After the run, he had a bowl of Hainan noodles at a breakfast stall outside the park and brought home steamed buns and soy milk on the way.

events.name: A turning point in math tutoring.
events.description: After a few days of getting used to the routine, Zixuan took out his textbooks and homework on his own after dinner and sat at the dining table waiting for his father. Lu Mingqiang felt a warm glow inside but kept a calm expression. He first used teaching aids to demonstrate step by step how the area formula was derived, then asked Zixuan to repeat it and operate the teaching aids himself. After Zixuan successfully solved a word problem independently, Lu Mingqiang patted him on the shoulder and said approvingly, “That’s right! Exactly like that!” The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, and the father-and-son teamwork was clearly in sync; the tutoring session was completed efficiently within half an hour. When his wife Wang Lijuan came over to clear the table and saw this, she smiled with relief.

events.name: Continue studying circuit analysis before bed.
events.description: The tutoring session ended smoothly and early, so Lu Mingqiang had time to prepare for the exam by ten. He focused on understanding the calculation methods for complex circuits, including the superposition theorem and Thevenin's theorem, and organized the detailed derivation processes of three examples in his notebook. After studying for about an hour, he turned off the light.

start_state.mood: In high spirits, looking forward to a weekend morning run.

end_state.mood: Feeling happy and relaxed, having seen the obvious results of the tutoring and the child's proactive changes.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km at a pace of about 6 minutes 00 seconds per kilometer.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, brief showers in the afternoon, temperature 28-33°C

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang went for a morning run with his running buddy Chen Bin. In the morning, he organized electrical materials at home to prepare for next week's technical sharing session. In the afternoon, he took the whole family to Evergreen Park to fly kites and enjoy family time. In the evening, he continued studying for the exam and rehearsed a trial lecture for the upcoming online exchange session.

events.name: Morning run with running partner Chen Bin
events.description: As agreed yesterday, Lu Mingqiang met Chen Bin at 6:30 in the morning at Baishamen Park for a morning run. They chatted while running. Chen Bin shared his experience from recent half-marathon training. Lu Mingqiang said he didn't have time for systematic training for now and that it was enough to keep running twice a week. After finishing the five kilometers, they went to breakfast, and Chen Bin insisted on paying.

events.name: Organized technical materials and rehearsed the trial lecture.
events.description: In the morning at home, Lu Mingqiang turned on his computer and organized the documents he had accumulated over the years on electrical and mechanical installation experience and common fault cases, including common problems on the low-voltage side of transformers and treatment of overheated cable joints. He categorized and archived the documents, and tested the home network and the microphone and screen-sharing functions of the computer conferencing software. In the afternoon, while the children were napping, he practiced lecturing again in front of the camera, adjusting his speaking speed and expressions. His wife Wang Lijuan sat nearby as an audience member and offered several suggestions.

events.name: Flying kites with the whole family at Wanlv Garden
events.description: After the afternoon shower, Lu Mingqiang drove the whole family to Wanlv Garden to fly kites. He brought the traditional paper kite he had recently made. Zixuan and Zihan ran excitedly on the grass. Chen Jie also came with his children, and the two exchanged new kite-flying techniques. Lu Mingqiang enjoyed this rare moment of relaxation, temporarily putting work and study pressure out of his mind.

start_state.mood: A little nervous and excited, making final preparations for next week's sharing session

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and satisfying, with both family and technical preparation taken care of.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, pace about 6 min 10 sec per km, and about 1 hour of walking to fly the kite

2025-07.daily_overview: On Monday, a workday, the heat continued. Lu Mingqiang went to work normally during the day. After dinner, he gave the final quiz of the tutoring session. Zixuan answered all the questions correctly and proactively asked to continue tutoring next week. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to emphasize the practicality of mathematics, achieving the first positive result after changing his educational approach.

events.name: Tutoring for the end-of-term quiz and a proactive agreement
events.description: After a week of getting used to it, Lu Mingqiang decided to do a small test that evening. He asked Zixuan to draw rectangles of different lengths and widths on a homemade teaching aid with a whiteboard marker and calculate their areas. Zixuan carefully drew three sets of rectangles and got them all right. He happily held up the teaching aid for his father to see. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to use an example from his own work of calculating cable length to emphasize the practicality of math: “When Dad measures the dimensions of a distribution cabinet, it's the same principle as drawing these rectangles.” Zixuan nodded and promised to keep working hard, and even voluntarily asked to continue the tutoring next week. Lu Mingqiang felt gratified, patted his son's head and said, “Okay, we'll continue next week.” It was the most satisfying evening since the tutoring began.

events.name: Sharing the tutoring results with his wife
events.description: After the children went to bed, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan chatted in the living room. He mentioned that Zixuan had gotten everything right tonight and even asked for tutoring again next week, with unmistakable pride in his voice. Wang Lijuan smiled and said he had become much more patient with their son lately, no longer yelling at the slightest thing like before. Lu Mingqiang admitted that the psychology teacher's lecture during the safety training had made a difference, and that he would pay more attention in the future.

start_state.mood: In good spirits, looking forward to the final assessment of the tutoring.

end_state.mood: Gratified and content; the parent-child relationship has clearly improved, and the transformation of the parenting approach is beginning to show results.

state.daily_exercise: Normal work physical exertion, walked 20 minutes near the construction site during lunch break.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, with thundershowers in the afternoon, temperature 27-32°C

2025-07.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lu Mingqiang was on duty during the day handling routine maintenance. After dinner, he continued to tutor Zixuan on his summer homework, and the atmosphere was harmonious. This was the start of the second week of tutoring; Zixuan was positive, asked questions proactively, and the father-son interaction went smoothly. In the evening, they did simple indoor stretching.

events.name: A New Chapter in Tutoring Summer Homework
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang, as usual, used math teaching aids at the dining table to help Zixuan finish his summer homework. Today they moved on to an introduction to geometry. He used building blocks to demonstrate different geometric shapes. Zixuan showed interest and actively asked several questions. Lu Mingqiang answered patiently and guided Zixuan to assemble rectangles and triangles by himself. The learning atmosphere was good, Zixuan was in a positive mood, and the tutoring ended with pleasant interaction. His wife was folding clothes in the living room and occasionally glanced toward the dining table with a smile.

events.name: Evening indoor stretching and relaxation
events.description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang felt a little stiff in his shoulders and back. He spread a yoga mat on the living room floor—one his wife had bought last year and rarely used—and followed a set of shoulder and neck relaxation videos saved on his phone for fifteen minutes of stretching. Zihan thought Dad was playing a game and cheerfully climbed onto his back. Lu Mingqiang simply had his two sons do some simple stretching together as well, and the living room was filled with laughter.

start_state.mood: In fairly good spirits, optimistic about tonight's tutoring session.

end_state.mood: Body and mind relaxed, family interaction warm and pleasant.

state.daily_exercise: Normal work physical exertion; 15 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching in the evening.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the showery weather reduced outdoor workload. After dinner, I continued tutoring Zixuan, focusing on consolidating the wrong questions from the day before. Zixuan asked questions proactively, and the interaction went smoothly. Afterward, Lu Mingqiang spent 40 minutes studying the theory for senior electrician technician using a mobile app. Then I went to Dynamic Fitness Club for squash training, and my condition recovered somewhat. Later, I received an investment recommendation from my childhood friend Wang Hai, felt suspicious, and decided to consult my older brother.

events.name: Math tutoring and consolidation practice
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang continued to tutor Zixuan at the dining table using teaching aids, focusing on consolidating the geometry mistakes from the previous day. He first demonstrated with the teaching aids, then let Zixuan operate on his own. Zixuan made obvious progress and actively asked several questions about triangles, which Lu Mingqiang answered one by one. The father-son interaction went smoothly, and the tutoring was highly efficient—they completed the day's learning tasks in less than half an hour.

events.name: Study the theory for the senior electrician technician
events.description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang leaned back on the sofa and spent 40 minutes studying advanced electrician technician theory on a mobile app, focusing on reviewing complex circuit fault troubleshooting to make up for the study progress he may have missed due to the weekend typhoon emergency repairs.

events.name: Squash training and chatting with squash buddies.
events.description: After studying electrical theory, Lu Mingqiang went to the squash court at Power Fitness Club. He arrived early and did a thorough warm-up, then played three practice matches with Lin Feng. His form had recovered somewhat compared to last week, and his movement speed and reactions had improved, but he still seemed impatient in handling key points. Lin Feng suggested he do 10 minutes of jump rope before the match to activate his body. Lu Mingqiang accepted the suggestion and agreed to try it next week.

events.name: Received an investment recommendation from a childhood friend and felt doubtful.
events.description: After training, Lu Mingqiang returned home and saw several long messages sent by his childhood friend Wang Hai via WeChat, recommending an online investment platform for electronic components and claiming that the annualized return could reach 15%, along with a platform introduction and several screenshots of returns. Wang Hai said that many of his friends in Shenzhen were investing in it and suggested Lu Mingqiang consider it too. Although Lu Mingqiang was close to Wang Hai, he felt alert — his years of conservative financial habits made him very sensitive to such high-yield promises. He did not reply immediately and decided to ask his older brother Lu Minghua, who works in the securities industry, first the next day.

start_state.mood: Calm and emotionally stable

end_state.mood: A little thoughtful; his childhood friend's investment recommendation made him wary

state.daily_exercise: Squash training for 1.5 hours (including warm-up and stretching), riding an electric bike round trip.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Thursday, Lu Mingqiang worked normally during the day. After dinner, he tutored Zixuan on a new chapter, and Zixuan became increasingly interested. In the evening, he first participated in and hosted the first online sharing session of a cross-company technical exchange group, and was elected group administrator, boosting his professional influence. Afterwards, after consulting his brother by phone, he decisively replied to Wang Hai rejecting the investment, adhering to conservative financial principles. Then he went to the squash court for night training with Lin Feng, and his form recovered.

events.name: Tutoring a new math chapter
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat at the dining table and helped Zixuan study a new math chapter, Understanding Fractions, using building blocks as teaching aids and the analogy of cutting apples. Zixuan showed sustained concentration, proactively tried to piece together 1/2 and 1/4 with the blocks, and drew sketches on paper. The father-son interaction was natural and smooth; Zixuan had completely shifted from resistance to active participation.

events.name: Hosted the first online technical exchange meeting and became an administrator.
events.description: After the tutoring session, Lu Mingqiang tested the equipment in advance. At 8 p.m., as the organizer, he started the first online meeting in the cross-company technical exchange group right on time. More than a dozen peers from several electric power engineering companies in Haikou joined one after another. Through screen sharing, Lu Mingqiang displayed typical fault case images he had compiled, shared practical tips on electrical machinery installation and repair, and answered participants' questions. The meeting lasted about an hour with a lively atmosphere. After the meeting, group members unanimously recommended him as the group administrator, responsible for subsequent organization and technical review. He felt his professional value had been recognized and was filled with a sense of achievement.

events.name: Consulted his elder brother and decisively rejected the investment.
events.description: After the online sharing ended, Lu Mingqiang immediately called his brother Lu Minghua, who works in a securities company in Shenzhen, and described in detail the investment platform Wang Hai had recommended. Lu Minghua said bluntly, Annualized 15% on electronic components? No need to think—it's mostly a money game; you'd better not touch it. He reminded Lu Mingqiang that returns on legitimate wealth-management products are within 4%, and such high returns carry extremely high risk. Lu Mingqiang felt reassured. After the call, he immediately replied to Wang Hai via WeChat, clearly telling him that he would not participate in the investment because the risk was too high and it didn't match his saving habits. His tone was firm but calm, and he added, When you have time, come back to Haikou and have some Laobaicha, so as not to hurt their childhood friendship.

events.name: Evening squash training
events.description: After the online sharing session and phone call ended, Lu Mingqiang rested briefly, then went to the squash court at 9:30 p.m. for an hour of regular training with Lin Feng. He had adjusted the training to the evening to fit today’s schedule, focusing on forehand volleys. His form picked up somewhat, and he returned home before midnight.

start_state.mood: There are concerns in mind, but the goal is clear — first handle the sharing, then address the investment issue.

end_state.mood: Felt a sense of accomplishment as the sharing session and training went smoothly, and put the investment issue aside for now.

state.daily_exercise: Normal work physical exertion, 15-minute walk during lunch break, 1 hour of evening squash training.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Friday, Lu Mingqiang deliberately made a detour to the post office in the morning to send Wuzhishan green tea to Wang Hai, who was far away in Shenzhen, using the actual item and a handwritten note to tactfully bridge their difference in opinion. During the lunch break, he called his elder brother to ask about the investment platform. After confirming it was a money scheme, he formally replied to Wang Hai via WeChat declining to participate and invited him to have old man tea. Wang Hai replied with a smiley face to show he understood. In the evening, he organized a small math competition game. Zixuan participated enthusiastically, and the father-son relationship became even more harmonious.

events.name: Sending tea to keep up a childhood friendship
events.description: Before work the next morning, Lu Mingqiang deliberately took a detour on his electric bike to the post office near his home and mailed two carefully selected packs of Hainan Wuzhishan green tea to his childhood friend Wang Hai, who was far away in Shenzhen. He handwrote a note and put it in the package: [Brother, tea clears the mind, money should be steady. I'll wait for you in Haikou with Hainan-style tea.] This was meant to express his appreciation for their friendship and to subtly make up for the awkwardness caused by his rejection of the investment the day before. After sending the package, he took a photo of the receipt and sent it to Wang Hai.

events.name: Called his older brother during the lunch break and replied to Wang Hai.
events.description: During the noon break, Lu Mingqiang remembered last night's agreement and called his elder brother Lu Minghua to ask in detail about the investment platform recommended by Wang Hai. After receiving a clear warning that 'it was most likely a capital pool scheme, don't touch it,' he felt reassured and then formally replied to Wang Hai via WeChat, declining to participate in a firm but calm tone, adding, 'Come back to Haikou sometime for some Laoba tea.' Wang Hai quickly replied with a smiley face and a message: '[Got it, waiting for you for tea.]' Lu Mingqiang breathed a sigh of relief, and their friendship was unharmed.

events.name: Organize a math competition mini-game
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang organized a small math competition game by the dining table. He used teaching prop cards to ask questions, letting Zixuan answer quickly on addition, subtraction, and simple multiplication. For every correct answer, he drew a star on a white paper. Zixuan participated actively and even called his younger brother Zihan to be the "referee". The atmosphere was lively, and the father-son relationship became even closer. After the game, Lu Mingqiang kept his promise and took the brothers to eat Qingbuliang on the weekend.

start_state.mood: In a good mood, figured out how to maintain the friendship with a childhood friend.

end_state.mood: All the burdens in my heart were gone, friendship had stood the test, and the family atmosphere was warm

state.daily_exercise: Normal physical exertion at work; commuting by electric bike.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, scattered thunderstorms in the afternoon, temperature 28-34°C.

2025-07.daily_overview: On the weekend, Lu Mingqiang got up early for a morning run. During the day, he took his family to the supermarket for shopping; in the afternoon, he accompanied the children to play downstairs in the residential area. In the evening, he kept his promise and took the children to eat qingbuliang. After dinner, he tutored Zixuan to finish the weekend math homework and explained the concept of fractions, and the learning efficiency was high.

events.name: Weekend morning run
events.description: Lu Mingqiang went to Baishamen Park at 6:30 in the morning for a five-kilometer morning run. Today he tried the variable-pace training he had planned last month: the first two kilometers were easy running, the middle two kilometers accelerated to 5:40 per kilometer, and the last kilometer was a recovery jog. Overall, he felt significant cardiovascular strain but managed to finish. He decided to add a variable-pace run once a month from now on. After the run, he walked home and bought breakfast for the family — Hainan noodles and bread.

events.name: Weekend family shopping and qingbuliang.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove his wife and two sons to a small supermarket near home to buy daily necessities. Wang Lijuan selected vegetables and daily goods, while Lu Mingqiang took the two sons to the snack section and let each child choose one snack. Zixuan chose a bag of potato chips, and Zihan chose cookies. At checkout, Lu Mingqiang noticed that the monthly grocery bill had risen, and told his wife to watch their spending. After an afternoon shower, he took the children to the night market at the street corner and made good on the promise of qingbuliang ahead of schedule. The family of four enjoyed the cool summer treat.

events.name: Tutoring weekend math homework
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang tutored Zixuan at the dining table on the weekend math homework and previewed adding fractions. Zixuan caught on quickly and finished the homework by himself. Lu Mingqiang praised his progress and encouraged him to keep working hard next week. Tutoring ended relatively early, and the whole family watched TV for a while.

start_state.mood: Relaxed weekend mood, looking forward to trying variable-pace running.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and relaxed; the weekend family life was fulfilling and well-organized.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km (including 2 km of varying-pace running), overall pace around 6:10 per kilometer.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with brief thunderstorms in the afternoon, temperature 28-33°C

2025-07.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang spent the morning at home with Zixuan going through the week's mistake notebook together and re-demonstrating difficult points with teaching aids. Zixuan proactively shared interesting school stories. In the afternoon, he called his mother to remind her to take care of her knees during rainy weather. In the evening, it was the final day of tutoring; he gave a summary and praise, strengthening the parent-child bond.

events.name: Organizing the mistake notebook and parent-child sharing
events.description: On Sunday morning, Lu Mingqiang and Zixuan sat at the dining table to organize this week's wrong-question notebook together. He used teaching aids to re-demonstrate several geometry difficulties that had confused Zixuan, and Zixuan could now clearly retell the problem-solving approach. During the organizing, Zixuan voluntarily shared something funny from school — his deskmate had drawn a rectangle as a trapezoid in math class last time and was called out by the teacher. The father and son laughed together. The atmosphere was relaxed, and learning blended into everyday conversation.

events.name: Call to check on mother's knee
events.description: Lu Mingqiang noticed that the weather forecast said it would remain cloudy and rainy for the week, so at noon he called his mother Chen Xiuying and reminded her to apply a hot compress to her knees while the weather was clear and put on the medicated plaster ahead of time. His mother said her knees were still okay, just uncomfortable when the weather changed, and told her son not to worry. Lu Mingqiang said he would have his wife send over some coix seeds to dispel dampness later. After hanging up, he told his wife to buy an extra portion of coix seeds next week.

events.name: Tutoring summary and praise
events.description: The two weeks of intensive tutoring came to a successful end that evening. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang did not take out the teaching aids, but looked at Zixuan seriously and said, "You have improved a lot over these two weeks. From being unwilling to sit down at the very beginning to actively learning later, Dad has seen it. Math is very important; keep working hard." He patted Zixuan on the shoulder, his tone full of sincere affirmation. Zixuan grinned when he heard this, nodded and said, "Got it." Lu Mingqiang then took out a new notebook and gave it to Zixuan, encouraging him to write down questions he didn't understand so they could solve them together in the future. Zixuan happily accepted it.

start_state.mood: Slept in and woke up naturally; the weekend was lazy and pleasant.

end_state.mood: Relieved and gratified; two weeks of educational companionship were rewarding and strengthened the parent-child bond.

state.daily_exercise: Went out by electric bike, no obvious exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to light rain, with rain intensifying in the afternoon; outer bands of Typhoon Talim affecting the area, temperature 26-30°C.

2025-07.daily_overview: Monday was a workday, and the typhoon's impact intensified. During the day, Lu Mingqiang completed routine inspections and typhoon-proofing reinforcement. In the evening, the team received an emergency repair order. Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang and Jianguo to repair damaged lines in the wind and rain, and guided the apprentice in the operation. During late-night troubleshooting, Jianguo's arm was cut fairly deeply by a sharp edge. Lu Mingqiang immediately bandaged it and reported the situation, completing the emergency response. The high-intensity rescue work continued until the early morning of the next day.

events.name: Preventive inspection and reinforcement before the typhoon
events.description: On Monday morning, Lu Mingqiang's work team, following the company's deployment, carried out a pre-typhoon preventive inspection of important power distribution facilities in its jurisdiction. They focused on reinforcing outdoor distribution cabinets, tightening cable connectors, and clearing loose objects that could be blown by the wind. Lu Mingqiang specifically checked the generators and emergency lighting equipment to ensure they were ready for use. Team leader Zhang stressed that an emergency response might be activated that night and required all members to keep communications open.

events.name: Led apprentices in emergency repairs to the line in the wind and rain.
events.description: In the evening, heavy rain from the outer rainbands of the typhoon caused multiple line trips in Xiuying District. Lu Mingqiang's team assembled urgently, picked up equipment, and set off in the rain. Lu Mingqiang led Zhao Qiang and Jianguo to focus on repairing a broken-line fault. The rain was too heavy, so he had Zhao Qiang hand him tools and hold a flashlight while he climbed the pole and connected the wires, explaining safety points for working in the rain as he worked: prevent slipping, keep hands dry, and confirm before testing voltage... Zhao Qiang studied attentively. After more than two hours of effort, power was restored to the area.

events.name: Emergency bandaging for an injured coworker
events.description: Late at night while inspecting another fault point, Chen Jianguo was moving a metal barrier blown over by the wind when his arm was cut with a deep gash by a sharp edge and needed to be bandaged to stop the bleeding. Lu Mingqiang immediately went over to check and asked Zhao Qiang to hold up the light. He took the first-aid kit from his tool bag and, following the training steps, cleaned the wound, disinfected it, and applied pressure bandaging, with steady movements. After bandaging, he reassured Jianguo and immediately reported to Team Leader Zhang, suggesting that Jianguo return to the vehicle to rest. After Team Leader Zhang agreed, Lu Mingqiang asked Zhao Qiang to help Jianguo into the vehicle, while he continued checking the remaining lines.

events.name: Finished the emergency repair task in the early morning and rested.
events.description: Around 3:30 a.m., power was basically restored to the area. After confirming that the equipment was stable, Lu Mingqiang returned to the work vehicle. He checked the remaining tasks with the other team members and recorded the fault details for a later thorough repair. Team leader Zhang arranged for them to take turns resting in the vehicle until dawn, when they would hand over the shift. Lu Mingqiang leaned back in the seat, exhausted, but his nerves remained tense, worrying that there might be another emergency.

start_state.mood: Sensing that the typhoon night would bring challenges, he kept his mind focused.

end_state.location: Temporary rest spot in a construction vehicle.
end_state.mood: His body was extremely exhausted but his mind remained tense; he worried about his injured workmate and also felt a slight relief at the success of the emergency repair.

state.daily_exercise: High-intensity outdoor emergency repair, extremely physically demanding.

date_attribute.weather: Moderate rain turning to showers, temperature 26–30°C

2025-07.daily_overview: Tuesday was payday. After a brief rest in the early morning, Lu Mingqiang went back to the company in the morning to hand over work and was approved for half a day of comp time. In the morning he kept his accounts and set aside savings; in the afternoon he went to the hospital to visit his injured coworker Chen Jianguo. In the evening he returned home to reunite with his family and enjoy a home-cooked dinner. There were no tutoring or study tasks that night, so he checked Zixuan's summer homework, chatted with his wife about family matters, and washed up and went to bed early to conserve energy for the continued emergency repairs during the typhoon season.

events.name: Payday bookkeeping and savings.
events.description: July 15 was payday. When Lu Mingqiang woke up in the morning, he received a mobile banking text notification that the July salary and high-temperature allowance totaling 4,200 yuan had been credited. During a break in the morning, he logged into the mobile banking app, verified the amount, and, following the family's savings habit, transferred 3,000 yuan from the current account to the fixed-term savings account. He then recorded in detail in the small ledger he carries with him: July 15 income 4,200 yuan, fixed deposit 3,000 yuan, reserved daily expenses 1,200 yuan, and noted the date. Everything was orderly.

events.name: Afternoon visit to an injured coworker.
events.description: In the morning, he returned to the company for a brief handover. Team Leader Zhang approved half a day of compensatory leave for Lu Mingqiang. He rode his electric bicycle to the community health service center where Chen Jianguo was, to visit his workmate who had injured his arm during the emergency repair last night. Jianguo’s wound had been stitched and he was in good spirits. Lu Mingqiang passed on the team’s get-well fruit and told him that the team leader had arranged light work for him this week. The two chatted a bit about the dangers of last night’s emergency repair and were both glad there had been no more serious accident. Before going home, Lu Mingqiang stopped on the way to buy Jianguo’s favorite grilled fish, and asked Zhao Qiang to deliver it after work.

events.name: Evening gathering with family and early rest
events.description: In the evening he returned home; his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared dinner, and the family sat around the table. Lu Mingqiang briefly mentioned last night's emergency repair, glossing over his injury so the family wouldn't worry. After dinner, he checked Zixuan's summer homework and praised his neat handwriting. Zihan climbed onto his lap asking for a story; after ten minutes of storytelling, he was yawning nonstop. Wang Lijuan urged him to go wash up and rest. Lu Mingqiang finished washing and went to bed at 22:30, listened to a short audio program, and fell into a deep sleep at 23:15, recovering his strength.

start_state.mood: Physically tired but the task was completed; he felt a bit relaxed.

end_state.mood: Rest after extreme fatigue, relieved that a fellow worker was not seriously hurt, and family warmth drove away the exhaustion.

state.daily_exercise: In the morning, rode an electric bike from the company back home; in the afternoon, walked to the hospital; in the evening, no exercise.

2025-07.daily_overview: After the typhoon passed, Lu Mingqiang's team worked hard for two days and two nights to finally complete the emergency repairs. In the evening after finishing work, Squad Leader Zhang paid out of his own pocket to treat the whole team to a late-night meal at a street food stall. He and his coworker Chen Jianguo shared their exhaustion with each other, and when he got home late at night, he fell straight asleep.

events.name: Completed typhoon emergency repairs and carried out on-site cleanup.
events.description: After two days and two nights of continuous work, on the morning of July 16 the crew repaired the last damaged section of line and restored power supply. Then all members cleaned up the site, collected the emergency repair tools, and checked the equipment status. Apprentice Zhao Qiang took the initiative to handle heavy tasks during the repair, carrying cables and delivering parts without ever complaining, and was publicly praised by Team Leader Zhang.

events.name: Team Leader Zhang proposed a late-night snack for the crew.
events.description: As they were finishing work in the evening, Team Leader Zhang saw that everyone was muddy and exhausted, so he immediately announced that he would treat the team to a late-night meal at a street-side food stall. Everyone cheered in approval.

events.name: Late-night food stall meal and confiding in workmates
events.description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo took Team Leader Zhang's car to a familiar street-side food stall in Longhua District. After a few plates of salt-and-pepper duck heads, stir-fried rice noodles, and cold beer, the two sat side by side. Lu Mingqiang couldn't help pouring out his recent work pressure and lower back soreness, and Jianguo also talked about how he had strained his back while carrying cables last year. They poured drinks for each other, joked around, and gradually relaxed over the clinking glasses. Lu Mingqiang only drank one glass of beer, mostly drinking tea, restraining himself because his back injury had just healed and he had to deal with follow-up work tomorrow.

events.name: Finished late-night snack and went home late at night
events.description: Around 11 p.m., the late-night snack ended. Lu Mingqiang said goodbye to his workmates and rode his electric bike alone back to his home at No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road. After a quick rinse, he fell onto the bed and slept soundly.

events.name: Weighed himself hastily before bed and found he had gained a little weight
events.description: Before taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang stepped on the scale. It showed 71.7 kg, slightly higher than yesterday's 71.5 kg. He guessed it was water retention from the energy drinks he had downed during the nonstop emergency repairs and this late-night snack, so he didn't take it to heart.

start_state.location: At the power repair site on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District (inside the utility truck)
start_state.mood: Extremely tired but highly focused

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jinmao Middle Road
end_state.mood: Body drained, he sinks into sleep with a slight alcohol buzz and stress released.

state.daily_exercise: High-intensity physical labor (emergency repair operation)

2025-07.daily_overview: The overexertion from the typhoon emergency repairs finally caught up with him. Lu Mingqiang's back pain became unbearable, so he took leave to see a doctor and was diagnosed with acute lumbar muscle strain. Encouraged by his master, he gritted his teeth and set long-term rehabilitation goals; his wife immediately started strict rehabilitation diet management. This day became a turning point in his health condition.

events.name: Took leave to see a doctor and was diagnosed with lumbar muscle strain.
events.description: When he woke up early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang had severe lower back pain and could hardly turn over. His wife Wang Lijuan quickly called his company on his behalf and asked for a day off. In the morning, the couple went to the community clinic. After the examination, the doctor told him it was acute lumbar muscle strain and sternly warned that he must reduce bending and heavy lifting, otherwise his lumbar spine might develop serious problems after age 40.

events.name: Called his mentor, Master Li, and gained confidence in his recovery.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang slumped on the sofa in low spirits. At the thought that his back was already ruined at just thirty-five, a wave of anxiety washed over him. He called his master, Master Li. After listening, Master Li laughed heartily and told him how at forty his own back was in even worse condition, but he kept practicing the 'swallow' exercise and could still climb utility poles today. He advised Lu Mingqiang not to push through the pain and to recover scientifically. Deeply moved by these words, Lu Mingqiang made up his mind.

events.name: Write health goals in the phone memo and start morning stretching.
events.description: After hanging up the phone, Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved. With elderly parents and young children to care for, he knew he absolutely could not just collapse, so he quietly resolved to recover through a scientific approach. He immediately opened the memo app on his phone and solemnly wrote, “2026 goals: run three times a week, get weight below 70 kg.” That evening, despite the soreness, he followed a video for his first 10-minute core-stretching session. His movements were stiff, but he gritted his teeth and kept going.

events.name: Wife plans a recovery diet and buys ingredients
events.description: After returning from the clinic, Wang Lijuan began to work out a diet plan high in protein and low in oil and salt. In the afternoon, she made a special trip to the community market to buy fresh milk, eggs, fish, and a variety of vegetables. That evening she prepared steamed fish and blanched greens for Lu Mingqiang, and seriously told him to give up beer and late-night snacks and switch to warm milk to help him sleep.

events.name: Quit the late-night snack and beer habit
events.description: During dinner, Lu Mingqiang habitually wanted to open a bottle of ice-cold beer, but Wang Lijuan handed him a cup of warm milk. He hesitated for a moment, thought of the doctor's warning and his master's words, and finally took the milk and drank it in one gulp. From that day on, he completely gave up late-night beer and kebabs.

events.name: Body weight slightly increased to 71.8 kg.
events.description: Because he stayed in bed all day and ate regularly, his evening weigh-in showed 0.1kg more than yesterday. Lu Mingqiang smiled wryly, but his wife comforted him, saying he should rest well and not worry about the number.

events.name: Search and download rehabilitation exercise videos
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang searched on his phone and downloaded several rehabilitation stretching and core training video routines suitable for lumbar muscle strain, preparing for the systematic training he would begin the next day.

start_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jinmao Middle Road
start_state.mood: Overwhelmed by severe lower back pain, anxious and restless

end_state.location: Bedroom at home on Jinmao Middle Road
end_state.mood: He calmed down from anxiety, strengthened by his mentor's encouragement and his wife's care, but his back pain was still a faint reminder.

state.daily_exercise: Tried core muscle stretching for 10 minutes for the first time.

2025-07.daily_overview: Mother Chen Xiuying hurried over to help, and three generations came together to get through the difficult time. In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and his wife worked together to make a recovery meal plan and went to the market to buy groceries. The home was filled with warmth because of the mother's arrival and her signature dishes. In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang tried standing against the wall on the balcony and doing slight backward extensions. Feeling that his lower back had loosened up a bit, his confidence greatly increased.

events.name: Mother-in-law Chen Xiuying came over from Meilan District to help.
events.description: Upon learning that her son had a back injury and her daughter-in-law had to work while taking care of two children, Chen Xiuying set off early in the morning from her home on Haifu Road, Meilan District. She took the bus with some changes of clothes and a bag of homemade snacks, and arrived at her son's home on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, at 10 a.m.

events.name: Wang Lijuan got her mother-in-law settled.
events.description: Wang Lijuan specially took half a day off today to welcome her mother-in-law at home. She helped her mother-in-law put her things in the guest room and briefly explained the recent family arrangements and Lu Mingqiang's injury. After hearing this, her mother-in-law kept nodding, immediately tied on an apron, and went into the kitchen to prepare lunch.

events.name: The couple worked together to make a rehabilitation diet meal plan and went shopping for it.
events.description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang felt his lower back was a bit more mobile, so he sat at the dining table with his wife and, based on the doctor's and online advice, refined a two-week high-protein, low-oil, low-salt diet plan. The two then walked to the nearby food market, carefully selecting chicken breast, sea fish, eggs, pure milk, and various green vegetables, filling the refrigerator to the brim.

events.name: Mother-in-law is preparing her signature home-style dishes
events.description: In the evening, his mother made Lu Mingqiang's favorite Hainanese chicken rice and stir-fried sweet potato leaves. The aroma of a table of home-style dishes filled the room. Watching his mother's busy back, Lu Mingqiang felt his backbone stiffen with confidence.

events.name: Tried the standing back extension movement.
events.description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang held the railing on the balcony and tried a small backward extension. Surprisingly, his lower back felt a bit looser. He happily told Wang Lijuan, and the couple both saw a glimmer of hope for recovery.

start_state.mood: He still didn't dare exert force with his lower back, but having his family around made him feel secure.

end_state.mood: Warm and at ease. The taste of my mother's cooking and my wife's care took away most of my anxiety, and I also felt my body improving.

state.daily_exercise: Stick to 10 minutes of morning core stretching and try standing back extension exercises.

2025-07.daily_overview: Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang's family enjoyed a wonderful kite-flying trip at Wanlv Garden. Though his lower back was a bit uncomfortable, it was no big deal. In the evening, their neighbor Uncle Wang enthusiastically recommended that he join a community table tennis match, opening a new window in his sports world. Because of the high amount of daytime activity and the light dinner, his weight dropped to 71.8 kg.

events.name: Check the kites and prepare for the family outing.
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lu Mingqiang carefully took out three well-preserved traditional kites from the storage room and checked the reels and frames one by one. His wife Wang Lijuan, meanwhile, prepared a backpack full of bottled water, homemade cold drinks, and several boxes of laobaicha snacks, while their two sons excitedly ran around the living room carrying small kites.

events.name: Drove to Evergreen Park to fly kites
events.description: At 8:10, Lu Mingqiang drove the family car with the whole family from Jinmao Middle Road, drove along Binhai Avenue for 15 minutes, and arrived at Wanlv Garden. Along the way, his eldest son Lu Zixuan pressed against the window watching the sea, while his second son Lu Zihan leaned in his mother's arms nibbling biscuits.

events.name: Kite-flying time on the lawn and parent-child interaction
events.description: After arriving at the lawn at 9 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang crouched down to demonstrate how to let out the line with the sea breeze. Zixuan succeeded in getting the kite airborne after two tries and shouted excitedly. Zihan dragged a small kite and chased seabirds. Lu Mingqiang and Zixuan each flew one and competed to see whose kite flew higher, while his wife took photos and videos on the side. At around 10:30, his waist felt slightly sore, so he sat on the picnic mat and watched the children continue playing.

events.name: Take in the kite and go home for a midday rest
events.description: Around 11:00, the wind weakened. Lu Mingqiang called to his sons to reel in the lines, and the family packed up their gear and trash and headed home. On the way back, the two children fell asleep in the back seat. Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan chatted softly about the arrangements for next week and arrived home at 11:30.

events.name: The mother-in-law took meticulous care of the household chores all day.
events.description: At 6 a.m., her mother-in-law got up and made a breakfast of laobaicha snacks, then cleaned the living room and bedrooms, and took the two grandsons to play in the community garden. At noon she made Hainanese chicken rice and qingbuliang. In the afternoon, after coaxing Zihan to take a nap, she tutored Zixuan with his summer homework, and prepared dinner in the evening. Although busy, she was methodical, leaving the family without worries during the day.

events.name: Neighbor Uncle Wang recommended him for the community table tennis competition.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang happened to meet Uncle Wang in the stairwell. Learning that Lu Mingqiang's back injury prevented strenuous exercise, Uncle Wang strongly recommended he take part in the community table tennis tournament, saying they lacked a substitute and the exercise level was just right. Lu Mingqiang was persuaded and asked in detail about the time, place, and rules of the tournament.

events.name: Go home and tell family about the decision to participate in the competition
events.description: As soon as he got home, Lu Mingqiang told his wife that he had decided to take part in the community table tennis tournament. Wang Lijuan and his mother both expressed support, saying it was a good way to get some exercise. Zixuan also excitedly said he wanted to go cheer for his dad.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to weekend family time, but my lower back still reminds me to be careful.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and happy. Flying kites brought back childhood joy, and he's eager to try the table tennis match.

state.daily_exercise: Morning stretch 10 minutes, kite flying (moderate activity)

2025-07.daily_overview: A fulfilling and busy Sunday: in the morning, he repaired the vegetable rack damaged by the typhoon and bought family accident insurance, and formally decided with his eldest son to jointly enter the science and technology model competition. In the afternoon, he invited Uncle Wang for laobaicha to thank him and talk about competition experience, and signed up for the table tennis match along the way. In the evening, he tried table tennis practice for the first time, but adjusted his rest time because of too many activities. Before bed, he reviewed his work notes. Thanks to the activities and relaxation, his weight stayed at 71.9 kg.

events.name: Repairing the vegetable rack on the balcony damaged by the typhoon
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang carefully inspected the balcony for traces left by the typhoon and found that some brackets were broken and the drip irrigation lines had come loose. He took wire, pliers, and cable ties from his toolbox, squatted down, and reinforced the brackets one by one, realigned the drip irrigation lines, and added a bottom drainage channel. It took him nearly an hour to restore the vegetable rack to stability. His wife helped hand him tools while his sons did homework in the living room.

events.name: Purchase comprehensive accident insurance for the family.
events.description: After repairing the vegetable rack, Lu Mingqiang remembered the work risks during the typhoon. After discussing with his wife, he used his phone to check the accident insurance plans of Ping An and China Pacific, and finally chose Ping An's Family Protection package, paid the annual fee of 800 yuan online, and saved a screenshot of the electronic policy.

events.name: The eldest son brought home a notice about the science model competition, and father and son decided to participate together.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Zixuan came back from the community summer activity class and excitedly showed a flyer for the district science and technology model competition. After reading the rules, Lu Mingqiang had an idea and proposed making an environmentally friendly powered car using the motor from an old electric toothbrush and a discarded plastic bottle. He drew a sketch on the whiteboard to explain the principle. Zixuan asked for details, clapped his hands repeatedly, and the two high-fived, agreeing to officially sign up for the competition.

events.name: In the afternoon, had tea with Uncle Wang and chatted about the table tennis match
events.description: At 3 p.m., to thank Uncle Wang for his recommendation the previous day, Lu Mingqiang invited him to a tea shop on Jinmao Middle Road for laobaicha. The two chatted over dim sum for more than an hour. Uncle Wang shared interesting stories and match experience from playing table tennis in his youth, and their relationship warmed from polite small talk. After tea, Lu Mingqiang stopped by the community cultural and sports center on the way and filled out the registration form for the street workers' table tennis competition.

events.name: Went to the community cultural and sports center to sign up for the table tennis tournament
events.description: After drinking tea, Lu Mingqiang stopped by the community cultural and sports center on the way to fill out the registration form for the subdistrict staff table tennis competition, then dug out his table tennis racket, which had been covered in dust for a long time, from home and confirmed after checking that the rubber was still usable.

events.name: Review work notes and do case analysis before bed
events.description: After showering, Lu Mingqiang sat at the head of the bed and flipped through the maintenance notes he had taken recently, applying the fault-diagnosis logic he had learned to the actual cases encountered during emergency repairs to verify and deepen his understanding.

events.name: The mother-in-law handled housework and looked after the grandchildren all day.
events.description: Mother-in-law came back from grocery shopping at 6 in the morning and made breakfast. In the morning she did laundry and mopped the floor, took her two grandsons to the pavilion in the residential area to play with the neighbors' children. At noon she steamed fish and stir-fried greens. In the afternoon she read with Zixuan and fed fruit to Zihan. In the evening she made her signature roast fish, keeping the family's life well organized.

events.name: A heartwarming little father-son episode during rehabilitation stretching.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang was doing a core stretch in the living room. Zixuan passed by, saw his father hunched over, and laughed, shouting, "Daddy looks like a big shrimp!" Everyone burst out laughing, adding a light touch to a busy day.

start_state.mood: Gradually recovering from back injury, with a calm mindset, planning several household chores

end_state.mood: Content and slightly tired, he had accomplished several important matters during the day. Reaching a project cooperation with his eldest son made him more confident about the education transformation. He went to bed early to restore his energy.

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of morning core stretching

2025-07.daily_overview: On the first day back at work after his back injury, Lu Mingqiang only did light ground-level tasks. Before work, Wang Lijuan specially prepared a lumbar support belt for him, and his coworkers were especially considerate. In the evening he insisted on practicing ball skills, and after returning home he completed the online registration for the tech model competition. His mother's advice also relieved him a great deal about tutoring the children. Thanks to light sweating and a regular diet, his weight stayed at 71.9 kg.

events.name: Return to work wearing a lumbar support belt and take on light work.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the company early in the morning. Before leaving, his wife helped him fasten an elastic lumbar support belt. Team Leader Zhang specially arranged for him to work together with Chen Jianguo on ground tasks such as dust removal from distribution cabinets and routine inspections, avoiding any work requiring climbing or heavy lifting. His co-workers all looked out for him, and Zhao Qiang even rushed to carry the tools.

events.name: After work, go to the community activity room to practice ball.
events.description: After finishing work in the evening, Lu Mingqiang did not go straight home. Instead, he dropped into the community activity room and practiced forehands and backhands against a ball machine for an hour, the sweat washing away the day's work stress.

events.name: Completed online registration for the science and technology model competition
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang opened the registration system for the District Science and Technology Museum, filled in his and Zixuan's information as required by the notice, uploaded an electronic photo of Zixuan's ID card, and printed the registration confirmation form after successfully submitting.

events.name: Mother-in-law's soothing words eased the anxiety about education
events.description: Seeing that Lu Mingqiang's voice grew louder while he was tutoring Zixuan, his mother-in-law took the chance to pull him into the kitchen when he was taking a break and said softly, “Be a little more tolerant with the child. Weren't you the same way back then?” That one simple sentence warmed Lu Mingqiang's heart, and he was much more patient in tutoring afterward.

start_state.mood: Determination to return to work mixed with a hint of caution.

end_state.mood: Work is fine, and the family atmosphere is more harmonious thanks to his mother's wisdom; he feels relaxed at heart.

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes.

2025-07.daily_overview: During the day, he conducted routine inspections as usual. After work, he took his eldest son to a hardware store and a scrap yard to hunt for bargains, and gathered all the materials needed for the eco-friendly powered cart. In the evening after ball practice, everyone at home busied themselves with their own things; grandma teaching her grandson to make dumplings became the highlight of the day. Lu Mingqiang ran into his client Li Jianguo at the hardware store, and the two briefly exchanged views on the recent market. His weight slightly dropped to 71.8 kg.

events.name: Took Zixuan to the hardware store and the scrap station to collect materials.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike carrying Zixuan, first going to a nearby hardware store to buy glue, cable ties, and a small hacksaw blade, then to a scrap appliance recycling station where he dug out several old electric toothbrush motors, plastic bottles, and cardboard. At the hardware store, he ran into client Li Jianguo. The two stood and chatted for five minutes. Boss Li said the store's wiring was due for inspection, and they agreed that he would go over next week to take a look. Zixuan's eyes lit up, and he kept asking whether this could be used and whether that had enough power.

events.name: Evening table tennis practice
events.description: After dinner and a brief rest, Lu Mingqiang still went to the activity room to play table tennis for an hour. His forehand is getting more and more comfortable, but his backhand is still unfamiliar, so he plans to focus on practicing backhand tomorrow.

events.name: The mother-in-law took care of her grandson during the day and taught him how to make dumplings.
events.description: In the morning, Grandma made Hainan rice noodles; in the forenoon, she vacuumed and tidied the bookshelves; in the afternoon, she took the two grandsons to the community pool to play in the water (while Lu Mingqiang was resting at home and helped watch their belongings); at noon, she made a pot of Hainanese chicken rice. In the evening, she also taught Zixuan to make dumplings, while Zihan played with dough beside her. At night, the whole family ate the dumplings they had made, full of joy.

events.name: After dinner, the father and son took apart an old toothbrush motor.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang and Zixuan used a screwdriver on the balcony to take apart an old electric toothbrush, removed the micro motor, and confirmed after testing that it still spun. The two excitedly began planning the chassis of a small car.

start_state.mood: Started the day with a little excitement about collecting materials

end_state.mood: Looking at the motors and bottles piled in the corner, he was full of anticipation for the father-son project.

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes.

2025-07.daily_overview: Work rhythm was steady, and after getting off work he practiced racket swings as usual. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa studying electrical materials. His back injury improved day by day. Grandma took the two grandsons to the library to return and borrow books; every family member was properly occupied. A sudden thunderstorm caused a brief power outage in the community, and Lu Mingqiang guided neighbors by experience to check the circuit breakers. His weight remained stable at 71.8 kg.

events.name: Go to work as usual and pay attention to lower back protection.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang went with his crew to a mall today to replace old distribution cabinets. He was responsible for handing up tools and wiring from the ground. Every time he needed to squat down, he deliberately bent his knees instead of his waist. His colleagues praised him for recovering well.

events.name: Keep up table tennis practice after work
events.description: After getting off work, he headed straight to the activity room and focused on practicing backhand pushes and footwork. He sweated profusely within an hour, and his waist didn't protest.

events.name: In the evening, read senior electrician technician materials.
events.description: After showering, Lu Mingqiang leaned back on the sofa and opened the technical materials he had printed a month ago, writing thoughts in the margins as he read. Zixuan was assembling a model nearby, occasionally asking a question, and his father would put down his pen to answer.

events.name: Mother-in-law's housework and library trip.
events.description: Grandma made Laoba tea snacks early in the morning. In the morning, during the big cleaning, she polished the range hood until it shone, then took her two grandsons to the community library to return and borrow books. At noon, braised pork belly with vegetables; in the afternoon, after accompanying the children for their nap, she carefully checked Zixuan's summer homework and told Zihan stories.

events.name: A thunderstorm caused a power outage in the residential community, and Lu Mingqiang helped troubleshoot the fault.
events.description: At 8 p.m., a thunderstorm caused a power outage in one building in the residential community. Lu Mingqiang heard his next-door neighbor Wang Jianguo calling out, went out to help inspect the main electrical box, quickly determined that the leakage protector had tripped, guided the reset, and power was restored. The neighbors were impressed by his skill.

start_state.mood: He was in decent spirits, and the continued improvement in his lower back made him more confident in his rehabilitation plan.

end_state.mood: Calm and focused, spending a quiet evening amid books and the children's questions, with a sense of accomplishment after helping others.

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes.

2025-07.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang, whose back injury had improved significantly, tried a short-distance walk, and the whole family was delighted. After work, he practiced ball as usual, and in the evening systematically reviewed the notes from the first round of electrician exam review, laying the foundation for the next stage of advanced study. As his activity level increased, his weight dropped slightly to 71.7 kg.

events.name: Tried short-distance walking, and the lower back injury improved significantly.
events.description: Today, when there was no work in the workshop, Lu Mingqiang slowly walked back and forth in the yard a few times, with only slight soreness left in his lower back. His fellow worker Jianguo joked that he no longer had to walk with his hand on his back, and he himself clearly felt that each day was easier than the last.

events.name: Table tennis practice after work.
events.description: His improved health made him more energetic at the ping-pong table. Today he specifically found a playing partner with strong spin on serves to practice with. Although he made quite a few errors returning serves, his reaction speed was improving.

events.name: Before bed, systematically reviewed the first round of revision notes.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang spread out on his desk the notes from the teaching videos he had been watching sporadically over this period, went through them from beginning to end, and used a highlighter to mark key points and forgotten content, paving the way for the upcoming second round of systematic review.

events.name: Mother-in-law's daily housework and time with the children
events.description: In the morning, Lu's mother made Hainanese chicken rice. In the late morning, she sorted seasonal clothes in the wardrobe. In the afternoon, she took the two children to the supermarket to buy groceries and daily necessities. In the evening, she made grilled fish and stir-fried greens. Lu Mingqiang's steady recovery also put his mother at ease. That night, the family chatted and laughed while watching TV in the living room.

start_state.mood: Completely renewed; better health brings a lighter spirit.

end_state.mood: A sense of accomplishment. Organizing notes turned scattered knowledge into a system, and the dual progress in recovery and exam preparation is encouraging.

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes, and short-distance walking.

2025-07.daily_overview: His mother finished a week of helping out and returned to Meilan District. The family said goodbye reluctantly. Lu Mingqiang completed the first round of electrical theory review, and his mock exam scores soared. In the evening, he chatted late into the night with fellow collector Chen Jianguo over an old photo, and the plan to meet for collecting early next month was settled. Because dinner was lighter after his mother left, his weight dropped to 71.6kg.

events.name: Mother-in-law packed her luggage, said goodbye, and went home.
events.description: Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang's mother had packed her luggage, and Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan helped carry it to the bus stop. Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan clung to their grandmother and wouldn't let go. After telling Lu Mingqiang to be sure to keep up his stretching, she boarded the bus back to Meilan District. The warm week of family reunion came to a temporary close.

events.name: Maintained regular practice before and after work.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang did a vehicle-based line inspection today, and only needed to record data. After getting off work in the evening, he practiced ball in the activity room for an hour as usual, consolidating his backhand technique.

events.name: Completed the first round of review and made progress on the mock test
events.description: After dinner, he logged into the electrician exam online question bank and took two rounds of mock tests. His score jumped from 60 at the beginning of the month to 78, which greatly boosted his confidence. He took a screenshot and sent it to his wife to share the joy.

events.name: Had a late-night chat with bottle-collecting friend Chen Jianguo and agreed to meet
events.description: At 8 pm, fellow collector Chen Jianguo sent a black-and-white photo of a 1950s Haikou old distillery on WeChat. Lu Mingqiang perked up immediately. The two chatted by voice from 8 pm to nearly 11 pm, comparing the bottles and old wine labels in their hands. Lu Mingqiang, in high spirits, suggested that Chen come to his home in early August to look at the items over tea, and the other readily agreed.

events.name: Schedule vehicle maintenance in advance.
events.description: Considering the many weekend plans, Lu Mingqiang called a familiar roadside repair shop near Jinmao Middle Road before leaving work and made an appointment for Saturday morning to have the vehicle's annual maintenance done.

start_state.mood: He was reluctant to see his mother leave, but was also moved by his family's efforts.

end_state.mood: The dual pleasure of progress in exam preparation and exchange of collections left him still savoring it while lying in bed

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes.

2025-07.daily_overview: On Saturday I handled several big things: early in the morning I sent the car in for maintenance and discovered a hidden uneven tire wear problem; in the morning I went to the swimming pool to sign up the whole family for a parent-child class; in the afternoon I practiced ball games as usual; in the evening I studied work safety regulations through videos and finalized meeting details with a collector friend. Because of the hot weather, my appetite was average; my weight was 71.7 kg.

events.name: Annual vehicle maintenance and record keeping
events.description: At 8:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove the car into a roadside repair shop near Jinmao Middle Road. The mechanic replaced the engine oil, oil filter, and air filter, and after checking the brake pads and chassis, reminded him that the front wheels had slight uneven wear and suggested a four-wheel alignment. Lu Mingqiang paid 350 yuan. When he got home, he recorded the expense on his phone and added 'four-wheel alignment' to his August to-do reminders.

events.name: Sign up the whole family for a summer parent-child swimming class
events.description: At 10 a.m., Lu Mingqiang drove to a swimming pool on Longkun South Road. After consulting, he enrolled the father and two sons in a parent-child swimming class and bought three sets of swim trunks, goggles, and swim caps on the spot. He also informed the coach in advance about his lower back injury and the children's fear of water.

events.name: Afternoon table tennis practice
events.description: After the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang still went to the activity room to sweat it out for an hour. Today he simulated match pace and strengthened his backspin serves.

events.name: In the evening, watched an instructional video on safety regulations for high-voltage equipment.
events.description: Targeting the safety code weaknesses exposed by the mock exam, Lu Mingqiang watched a video on safety specifications for high-voltage equipment installation on his computer in the study, noting down operating procedures and error cases as he watched, and planned to do the supporting exercises the next day.

events.name: Finalized the meeting time with a fellow collector via WeChat.
events.description: After dinner, Chen Jianguo sent several voice messages. The two agreed that Jianguo would visit on Saturday afternoon, August 3. Lu Mingqiang would have laoba tea and that treasured bottle of Haikou Daqu liquor from the 1990s ready.

start_state.mood: Weekend status: plans in order, good energy

end_state.mood: Pushed forward multiple tasks as planned; a compact and orderly Saturday brought a sense of control.

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes.

2025-07.daily_overview: A Sunday full of new experiences: in the morning, the father and two sons had their first parent-child swimming lesson, and Lu Mingqiang confirmed in the water that his lower back was fine. In the afternoon, he played in a community table tennis match as a substitute. His team lost by a narrow margin, but he rediscovered the thrill of hitting the ball and made new playing friends. In the evening, he reviewed safety regulation exercises. After the heavy physical exertion, his weight dropped to 71.6 kg.

events.name: First parent-child swimming lesson
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived at the swimming pool on time with Zixuan and Zihan. The coach first had everyone practice breath-holding and floating at the poolside. After getting into the water, Lu Mingqiang clumsily lay on the pool edge practicing the breaststroke kick, and his sons laughed saying he looked like a frog. But when he succeeded in floating with no pain in his waist, he felt a surge of joy.

events.name: Go home and share fun stories about swimming
events.description: After class, the father and two sons showered and headed home. Zixuan vividly described to his mother, "Dad lay in the water like a toad," and the whole family burst into laughter. Lu Mingqiang decided to practice holding his breath at home before each class.

events.name: Join the community table tennis tournament and meet fellow players
events.description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang arrived early at the gymnasium of the Municipal Workers' Cultural Palace as a substitute. After warming up and stretching, he played doubles with a temporary partner. They fought hard to take the first game but then narrowly lost 1-2, stopping in the first round. After the match, he actively chatted with the opponents and court-side players, adding three new WeChat friends, among whom Wang Hao was the one he got along with best.

events.name: Evening: completed special exercises on safety regulations
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang sat quietly at his desk, took out the accompanying exercise book from yesterday, finished all the practice questions on safety regulations for high-voltage equipment installation in one go, and circled the wrong answers in red pen for review.

start_state.mood: Feeling both nervous and excited about the swimming lesson, with lingering worries about the back injury in the back of my mind

end_state.mood: Extremely fulfilling and exciting; the pain-free swimming in the water and the pleasure of hitting the ball during the match together ignited a passion for sports.

state.daily_exercise: Parent-child swimming for 1 hour, table tennis match and warm-up, 10 minutes of morning stretching

2025-07.daily_overview: On a workday, he started a new round of studying. In the evening, he focused on overcoming weaknesses in circuit fault diagnosis, proactively contacted his new table tennis partner Wang Hao, and scheduled future practice sessions. He also downloaded an electrician study app to expand his toolkit. Thanks to continuous exercise, his weight remained stable at 71.6 kg.

events.name: On duty during the day and did waist stretches in spare time.
events.description: Today in the distribution room doing routine tests, Lu Mingqiang got up and did some stretches every hour. His coworkers had gotten used to his rehabilitation routine, and they teased him that he was getting better and better at maintaining himself.

events.name: Intensive study of instructional videos on complex circuit fault diagnosis
