events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang played a set of complex circuit fault diagnosis and analysis videos on his computer. He repeatedly watched the content in which he had lost points in the tests a few days earlier, such as differential protection and ground fault troubleshooting, and drew fault trees in his notebook.

events.name: Arranged a fixed practice time with new practice partner Wang Hao.
events.description: While taking a break from watching videos, he confirmed with Wang Hao via WeChat that they would practice regularly from 7 to 8 p.m. every other Thursday starting July 31, at the community activity room. The two also agreed to get to know each other's playing styles at the first meeting.

events.name: Download the electrician learning app and familiarize yourself with its functions.
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang searched on his phone and downloaded a popular electrician study app. After installing it, he browsed the course outline and question bank settings, planning to replace part of his pen-and-paper practice with it.

start_state.mood: Methodical, with a clear sense of purpose.

end_state.mood: Study is fulfilling, and a broader social circle brings new expectations.

state.daily_exercise: Morning stretching for 10 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: Exam preparation entered the practical-analysis stage. After finishing the fault-diagnosis practice problems in the evening, Lu Mingqiang sat down and assessed himself item by item against the exam syllabus, identifying variable-frequency drives and PLC programming as two tough nuts to crack. In the afternoon, because a colleague took leave, he temporarily filled in and did an extra inspection of one more residential community. He felt no discomfort in his lower back and weighed 71.7 kg.

events.name: Worked outdoors during the day with a temporary increase in workload
events.description: Today the team originally planned to go to an old residential community to replace distribution boxes, but a colleague from another group asked for leave due to a family emergency. Squad leader Zhang arranged for Lu Mingqiang's group to visit an additional community for inspection. Lu Mingqiang was in charge of technical guidance. For any wiring that required bending over, he either had Zhao Qiang do it or squatted down himself, strictly following the rehabilitation requirements. During the inspection, he noted several hidden dangers of aging wires in his notebook.

events.name: Completed specialized practice on complex circuit fault diagnosis
events.description: After the meal, he opened the app he had been studying last night and used its built-in simulation software for fault tree analysis training. As he worked through one practice problem after another, his troubleshooting approach became increasingly clear.

events.name: Conduct a self-assessment against the exam syllabus.
events.description: Then Lu Mingqiang took out the printed senior technician exam syllabus and assessed himself item by item: he was fairly familiar with circuit diagram analysis, but he was almost starting from scratch on frequency converter principles and PLC programming. He made prominent marks with a red pen and planned a focused push in August.

start_state.mood: Objectively view your shortcomings and stay pragmatic

end_state.mood: Saw the roadblocks ahead clearly; though pressure exists, the direction is clear.

state.daily_exercise: Morning stretching for 10 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: During the day, Lu Mingqiang took his apprentices Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to the supermarket to survey the circuit upgrade project on site. In the evening, he sat with his wife and quickly completed the monthly financial review and cost-cutting plan. Before bed, he studied the principles of protective devices and made a study plan for the first two weeks of August. Thanks to good dietary control recently, his weight was 71.9 kg.

events.name: Led an apprentice to survey the supermarket's circuit upgrade needs.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to a supermarket in Longhua District. After communicating with the person in charge about the needs for circuit capacity expansion and zone control, the three inspected the existing circuits one by one from the power distribution room to the sales floor and cold storage. Lu Mingqiang explained as he inspected, and Zhao Qiang took notes with a notebook.

events.name: Monthly family finance review with my wife in the evening.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and his wife checked the July income and expenses at the dining table and found that fuel costs had exceeded the budget by about 200 yuan. They immediately agreed on a saving plan starting in August: he would switch to commuting by electric bike, and the family would eat out less. He quickly finished keeping the accounts. The whole process took about 40 minutes.

events.name: Study and create an August exam preparation plan.
events.description: After keeping the accounts, Lu Mingqiang reviewed videos to reinforce his knowledge of protective devices. Then, based on the weak areas identified in yesterday's assessment, he drew up a review plan on the computer for the first two weeks of August, printed it, and put it up by his desk. The whole process took about 1.5 hours.

start_state.mood: A new day of work begins, carrying a sense of mission to pass on experience.

end_state.mood: With transparent family finances and a clear learning path, he felt at ease at the end of July.

state.daily_exercise: Morning stretching for 10 minutes

2025-07.daily_overview: On the last day of July, with the back injury almost pain-free, Lu Mingqiang completed a detailed measurement of the supermarket's electrical circuits. In the evening, he packed his gear and went to meet his playing partner Wang Hao for their first regular table tennis practice. After going home, before bed, he continued to compile and review wrong questions, ending his July with a resilient and powerful full stop. His weight finally returned to 72.0 kg, matching the goal set at the beginning of the month.

events.name: Back injury significantly improved and rehabilitation results summarized
events.description: Waking at 6:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang found that bending over to tie his shoelaces was basically painless. He used the fragmented time before work to jot down in his phone memo the key rehabilitation points from the past two weeks, including daily stretching, correct posture, quitting late-night snacks, and swimming as a supplement, and reminded himself to keep it up.

events.name: Went back to the supermarket to perform detailed circuit measurements.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang returned to the supermarket with Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun, using a distance meter and a multimeter to measure and record the routing and wire diameter of the circuits in the cold-chain equipment area, the checkout counters, and the lighting zones one by one. He also hand-drew a circuit renovation sketch, marking the key nodes where switches need to be replaced and capacity needs to be expanded, laying the foundation for the subsequent quotation and construction.

events.name: Evening first regular practice with a fellow player
events.description: After work in the evening, Lu Mingqiang checked his racket and sportswear and went straight to the activity room. At 7 p.m., he started his first regular practice with Wang Hao. The two warmed up with rallying and then moved to multi-ball training; they worked in good coordination, and an hour passed in a flash. After practice, they agreed that the next practice would still be on Thursday evening, August 14.

events.name: Complete protection device exercises and summarize wrong answers
events.description: After practice, Lu Mingqiang returned home and washed off the sweat. Before going to bed, he finished the remaining protective device exercises from yesterday, then gathered together the wrong answers and easily confused points from the various special practice sessions over the past five days, used a mind map to reorganize the framework of weak knowledge, and prepared to take it into August.

events.name: Weighed in at 72.0 kg and recorded it in the health log.
events.description: After showering, he stepped on the scale, and the number jumped to 72.0kg. Lu Mingqiang wrote in his memo: July 31, back injury 90% recovered, weight back to 72, continue strengthening core in August, sprint for exam preparation.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, with a sense of ritual about summarizing and starting a new phase.

end_state.mood: Health is improving and exam preparation is solid; socially, life follows a routine and work is organized. I feel confident about the coming month.

state.daily_exercise: Table tennis practice for 1 hour, morning stretching for 10 minutes.

2025-09.daily_overview: Eldest son Lu Zixuan’s 9th birthday coincided with the first day of the autumn semester, and the whole family’s daily rhythm switched to a regular, compact mode. After finishing his core training early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang took the two children to school, bought his mother’s medicated plaster and picked out a birthday gift before work, and went to the company in the morning to collect his salary and check the details. In the evening, the family of four celebrated Zixuan’s birthday at Wenchang Chicken Restaurant, gave him electronic building blocks, and Zixuan made a wish to become an engineer. After dinner, the couple discussed cutting back this month’s expenses and adjusting their diet to help with weight loss, building family support for the upcoming exam preparation. Because the day was packed, he did not schedule a morning run, but he still kept up his daily core training.

events.name: Daily core training.
events.description: After getting up at 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang completed a 15-minute core and back strengthening workout in the living room: three sets each of the superman exercise, plank, and glute bridge. The movements were smooth and have become second nature.

events.name: Take the child to school for the start of the fall semester.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang and his wife prepared breakfast together and woke up the two children. At 7:20, he drove to first take his second son Lu Zihan to the kindergarten near the community, then take his eldest son Lu Zixuan to Jinlong Primary School in Longhua District to register. On the first day of school, the two children were excited. Zixuan specially reminded his father that today was his birthday, and Lu Mingqiang promised to celebrate properly in the evening.

events.name: Bought the medicated patches his mother needed at the pharmacy.
events.description: After dropping off the children, Lu Mingqiang stopped by the pharmacy next to his home on Jinmao Middle Road to buy the knee hot-compress patches his mother Chen Xiuying needed this month. As the autumn rainy season was approaching, he deliberately bought two extra boxes to ensure his mother would not run out of medicine for the whole month, then put them away to take when he visited his parents on the weekend.

events.name: Picking out a birthday gift for the eldest son at the toy store
events.description: Then he drove to a toy store on Jiefang West Road in Longhua District and, based on Zixuan's interest in science and engineering over the past six months, selected a programming electronic building block set suitable for a 9-year-old, including circuit and logic modules, costing over 200 yuan, and had the clerk carefully wrap it as a birthday surprise.

events.name: Reserve a birthday dinner by phone
events.description: On the way to the company, Lu Mingqiang called an established Wenchang chicken restaurant on Zhongshan Road, Longhua District, Haikou, and booked a small private room for 6 PM that evening, so the family of four could quietly celebrate Zixuan's birthday.

events.name: Go to the company to receive and verify September's salary.
events.description: At 8 a.m., after arriving at the company at No. 28 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, Haikou, Team Leader Zhang notified everyone to collect pay slips. Lu Mingqiang confirmed at the finance window that his take-home pay for September was 3300 yuan, carefully checked the attendance record and social security deduction details, folded the pay slip, and put it into the pocket of his work uniform.

events.name: The whole family celebrated the eldest son's birthday.
events.description: After getting off work at 6:30 in the evening, he picked up his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and second son Lu Zihan, brought the electronic building block gift, and drove to the booked restaurant. During the meal, they ordered home-style dishes such as Wenchang chicken and family reunion stew. Zixuan was fascinated with the gift after opening it and made a wish in front of everyone: "When I grow up, I want to be an engineer and know technology like Dad." The whole family sang the birthday song, Lu Mingqiang recorded a video with his phone, and the atmosphere was warm.

events.name: The couple discussed tightening the budget and adjusting their diet.
events.description: After returning home from the dinner, Lu Mingqiang and his wife discussed this month's financial plan in the living room. Since his mother's 80th birthday in August had cost quite a lot, the two agreed to strictly divide 3,300 yuan into 1,500 yuan for daily expenses, 800 yuan for the education fund, and 1,000 yuan for savings, and noted in the accounting book that non-essential expenses such as video games and dining out should be cut down this month. At the same time, to support Lu Mingqiang's exercise and weight loss plan, they agreed that starting this week, dinner would include more vegetables and whole grains cooked by boiling or steaming, and less greasy food.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City
start_state.mood: Slightly rushed but full of anticipation, thinking about the eldest son's birthday and the first day of school

end_state.mood: Content but with slight financial pressure, yet the family celebration brings a sense of happiness.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Tuesday, the school sent an urgent notice to install the Smart Campus app. Lu Mingqiang was stumped by his old phone and finally turned to an old tablet at home. After work he made a special trip to buy accessories, and eventually, under the "reverse teaching" of his eldest son Lu Zixuan, the installation went smoothly. The father and son had subtly swapped technological roles. Lu Mingqiang, with mixed feelings, patiently learned the operations. In the early morning he completed his morning run and core training and felt energetic all day.

events.name: Morning run and core training
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang went to Wanlv Garden for a 3-kilometer jog. After returning home, he did 15 minutes of core strength training, took a shower, and then took the children to school.

events.name: Learned that the Smart Campus app needs to be installed
events.description: At around 9 a.m., his wife Wang Lijuan saw a notice from the homeroom teacher in the parents' WeChat group requiring all parents to install the Smart Campus app and bind their student registration information before tonight. She immediately called Lu Mingqiang, who was preparing materials at his company, and asked him to find a way to install it.

events.name: Tried installing with an old phone and failed
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang took out his three-year-old Android phone, found the app in the app store, and tapped download, but the system prompted that the version was too low to install. He repeatedly tried clearing the cache and restarting the phone, but still failed. Looking at the laggy screen, he felt a bit irritated.

events.name: Buy tablet accessories
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang discussed with his wife and decided to put the idle tablet at home to use. After dinner, he walked to the nearby Guomao Digital Mall and spent 60 yuan on a tablet case and a stylus, preparing for Zixuan's upcoming study use.

events.name: Successfully installed the app under the eldest son's guidance.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang fiddled with the tablet on his own for about ten minutes, but still couldn't find the correct download channel. Lu Zixuan, who was nearby, came over and said, "Dad, let me help you." Zixuan skillfully opened the app store, searched for and downloaded the app, then taught his dad step by step how to link the student registration and view class notifications and homework. Lu Mingqiang watched his son's smooth operation, carefully noting the steps, and sighed, "Now I really have to learn from my son." Zixuan smiled proudly.

events.name: Checked the second son's home-school communication notebook.
events.description: After the APP matter was over, Lu Mingqiang picked up the home-school communication booklet that his younger son Lu Zihan had brought back from kindergarten, read the teacher's comments for the day, briefly talked with his wife about Zihan's nap at school, then urged the two children to wash up and go to bed.

start_state.mood: Ordinary, following the usual routine.

end_state.mood: He was a little emotional, and also felt gratified by his son's abilities; the role swap brought a fresh feeling.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog 3 km, core training 15 minutes

2025-09.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Lu Mingqiang went out during the day to do inspection and repair work. After work, as usual, he went to the squash club and had an intense hour-long match against his playing partner Lin Feng, enjoying the workout. After returning home in the evening, he continued sharing tablet usage tips with his eldest son. The father and son's close interaction through technology has become the new normal at home, and Zixuan's self-confidence has clearly grown. Morning core training started a fulfilling day.

events.name: Daily core training.
events.description: Got up at 6:00, completed 15 minutes of core strength training, then prepared breakfast and took the child to school.

events.name: Routine electrical inspection and maintenance work.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang went with his work team to a commercial building in Xiuying District to handle a fault where the control cabinet kept tripping. He took his apprentice Zhao Qiang and, step by step, used a multimeter to check the wiring. Finally, after replacing an aged contactor, everything returned to normal. During the work, he explained in detail to Zhao Qiang the diagnostic approach for similar faults.

events.name: Noticed Zhao Qiang's condition.
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang noticed that Zhao Qiang was a little quiet and ate faster than usual. He asked with concern whether he was feeling unwell. Zhao Qiang forced a smile and said, 'It's nothing, maybe I didn't sleep well.' Lu Mingqiang did not ask further, but vaguely felt that his apprentice had something on his mind.

events.name: Evening squash training
events.description: After work, he simply ate the steamed fish and greens his wife had left for him, and at 7:30 p.m. drove to the squash club. He played four games against his squash buddy Lin Feng, with the score tied 2-2. Afterwards, the two exchanged tips on backhand grips, and Lin Feng praised him for his increasingly smooth strokes. Lu Mingqiang worked up a full sweat and felt the whole week's fatigue melt away.

events.name: Father and sons continued the tablet activity.
events.description: At nearly 9 p.m., he got home. His elder son, Zixuan, was still awake and eagerly pulled his father over to show him an educational game he had found on the tablet. Lu Mingqiang sat down, and Zixuan taught him how to download a children's introductory programming app and showed him how to use block-based commands to make a character move. Lu Mingqiang tried a level and sincerely praised Zixuan, saying that he learned faster than Dad and could be a little teacher in the future. Zixuan felt very proud. That night he tossed and turned, unable to sleep, and made a point of writing down the steps, saying he would tell his science teacher the next day.

events.name: Spent time with his second son and fell asleep relaxed.
events.description: After interacting with Zixuan, Lu Mingqiang picked up his second son Zihan and played with him with colorful building blocks for a while, then told a five-minute short story. After the children fell asleep, he took a shower, played Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies on his phone, leaned back on the sofa and listened with his eyes closed for ten minutes, then returned to his room to rest.

start_state.mood: Calm, regular workday mindset

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and relaxed, with the pleasant sensation after exercise intertwined with the joy of parent-child interaction.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, squash for 1 hour

2025-09.daily_overview: On Thursday, after his morning run, Lu Mingqiang felt refreshed and threw himself into work. During a work break in the morning, he completed the transfer of the education fees for his two children. After dinner, he began tidying up the study, clearing out a dedicated study space for the Senior Technician exam preparation that would start the next day, and made an initial plan. Incorporate core training into the morning routine.

events.name: Morning run and core training
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, went to Wanlv Park for a 3.5 km jog at a steady pace, returned home and did 15 minutes of core strength training. After taking a shower, took the two children to school and reminded Zixuan on the way to go directly to calligraphy class after school.

events.name: Transfer payment for education expenses
events.description: During a work break at 10 a.m., Lu Mingqiang logged into mobile banking and confirmed that his current account balance was over 4,000 yuan. He first transferred 300 yuan to the account of his eldest son's calligraphy class teacher with the note “Lu Zixuan September calligraphy”; then he transferred 600 yuan to his younger son's kindergarten corporate account for this month's meal and childcare fees. After completing the operations, he took a screenshot and sent it to his wife on WeChat for her records.

events.name: Warehouse organization and tool inventory
events.description: Today the team had no outside tasks, so Lu Mingqiang, Zhao Qiang, and Chen Jianguo inventoried safety equipment in the warehouse. Lu Mingqiang carefully checked several pairs of insulating gloves and voltage detectors, found two pairs of work gloves worn at the thumbs, immediately reported it to Team Leader Zhang, and replaced them with new ones. Zhao Qiang was nearby learning how to keep the material ledger.

events.name: At noon, I looked through the exam outline.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang browsed the exam syllabus for senior electrician in the break room on his phone and decided to start with the Power System Analysis section. He briefly marked a few key chapters, and mentally began shifting from daily practical skills to a more systematic theoretical approach.

events.name: Clean up the study room in preparation for the exam
events.description: At dinner, he told his wife, "Starting tomorrow night, I'm going to focus all my energy on review." Wang Lijuan immediately said she would handle all the housework and supervise the kids' homework in the evenings, and she turned down the volume on the living room TV. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang went into the study, wiped the dusty desk lamp, neatly arranged the textbooks "Advanced Electrician Theory" and "Power System Analysis" along with their companion exercise books on the desk, then took a few pens from an old pencil case and wrote an initial plan in the notebook: "Every night 7:30-9:30, plus half a day on weekends."

events.name: Rest early
events.description: Considering that he would need energy for the review tomorrow, he set his phone alarm earlier and turned off the lights at 10 p.m. to sleep.

start_state.mood: Steadfast and methodical, preparing for the upcoming exam study journey

end_state.mood: Expectant and ready, feeling settled about the upcoming intensive study

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 3.5 km, core training 15 minutes

2025-09.daily_overview: On Friday, Lu Mingqiang received 5,000 yuan in education support from his elder brother Lu Minghua, which immediately eased the family's financial pressure. During his lunch break, he began a parent-child communication learning journey, and in the evening he officially started preparing for the Senior Technician certificate, drew up a thorough plan, and completed the first two-hour review session, finishing the day with classic old songs. It was a full and orderly day. After doing core training in the early morning, he did not go for his morning run because of insufficient time.

events.name: Core training
events.description: He woke up a little late (6:10), but still completed 15 minutes of core strength training, then hurriedly took the children to school.

events.name: Received older brother's remittance and thanked him
events.description: A little after 8 a.m., Lu Mingqiang's phone received a bank SMS notification showing a transfer of 5,000 yuan from Lu Minghua with the note 'for nephew's education'. He immediately called his brother to thank him. Lu Minghua, in Shenzhen, said business was okay, told him to pay more attention to their parents and take care of his health, and they agreed to meet again on National Day.

events.name: Discussed and completed the allocation of education funds.
events.description: During the morning work break, Lu Mingqiang called his wife to discuss and decided to first use the money to cover the previously paid expenses of 300 yuan for the eldest son's calligraphy class and 600 yuan for the younger son's kindergarten, with the remaining 4,100 yuan set aside as a dedicated education reserve. He then transferred 900 yuan from his mobile banking account to the demand deposit account to make up the difference, transferred 4,100 yuan to the family education savings account, and made a detailed record in the ledger.

events.name: Subscribe to a parenting podcast.
events.description: While waiting for a work assignment, Lu Mingqiang searched for the Parenting School series on a podcast app. After browsing the catalog, he found the content matched his own worries, subscribed, and planned to study it gradually during lunch breaks and commutes.

events.name: Listening to Episode 1 of Parent School during the lunch break.
events.description: During the lunch break, he hid in the company break room, put on earphones, and carefully finished listening to the first episode, which was about 'active listening.' While listening, he reflected on his habit of interrupting Zixuan too quickly when tutoring him on homework in the past, and wrote the key phrase 'set aside judgment, listen first, then respond' in his phone memo.

events.name: Install the electric meter box in the afternoon
events.description: In the afternoon, he went with the work crew to a newly built residential area in Xiuying District to install floor electricity meter boxes. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for wiring and fixing, and they worked until nearly 5 p.m. During this time, Zhao Qiang also worked quietly, but his movements were a bit slower than usual. At quitting time, Lu Mingqiang patted Zhao Qiang on the shoulder and told him, 'Have a good rest on the weekend.' Zhao Qiang replied in a low voice, 'Thank you, Master.'

events.name: Formulated a review plan and began systematic study for the first time.
events.description: At dinner, his wife served steamed fish and garlic broccoli. At 7:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang sat down in his study on time and spent half an hour making a detailed review plan: Phase 1, theory focus (September to mid-October); Phase 2, intensive exam-question practice; Phase 3, filling gaps in practical skills. He organized his textbooks and exercise books and downloaded a mobile question bank app. He then started studying from Chapter 1 of Power System Analysis, took notes until 9:30 p.m., and did 20 supporting exercises on the app with a 75% accuracy rate, marking transformer knowledge as a weak point.

events.name: Relaxing with music before bed
events.description: After finishing his review, he leaned back on the sofa in the living room, put on his earphones, and played classic old songs such as “Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies” on his phone. He closed his eyes and rested for over ten minutes, letting his strained nerves relax, then went to bed at 10:40.

start_state.mood: Feeling grounded with elder brother An's support, looking forward to a pioneering day

end_state.mood: Fulfilling but with some study pressure; overall pace is satisfactory.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lu Mingqiang headed out early for a morning run, then took medicated patches back to his parents' home in Meilan District for lunch and checked the old house's wiring. In the afternoon he returned home and packed his treasured baijiu. In the evening he attended a KTV birthday celebration for his workmate Jianguo, where he was urged to sing "Friends." His tone-deaf singing made everyone laugh, and he drank a little to add to the fun. After enjoying himself, he decided to skip one review session to savor a rare moment of social relaxation. Because of staying up late and drinking, his weight increased slightly.

events.name: Morning run and core training
events.description: At exactly 6:00, completed a 5 km morning run in Wanlv Park, went home and did 15 minutes of core training, and weighed 70.9 kg after the run.

events.name: Visit parents and repair electrical circuits.
events.description: After taking a shower, he took the medicated patches and fruit he had bought a few days earlier and drove at 9 o'clock to his parents' home in Meilan District. His mother, Chen Xiuying, took the patches and praised him for being thoughtful. His father, Lu Jianguo, was playing chess in the neighborhood. Lu Mingqiang chatted with his parents about recent happenings, and his mother made his favorite Hainanese chicken rice. During the conversation, he noticed a loose socket in the living room and fixed it with the screwdriver he had brought. His father mentioned that the circuit breaker had been tripping sometimes recently, so Lu Mingqiang checked the main switch, judged that the air switch had aged, and agreed to bring a new one to replace it when he came back for National Day. The father and son also talked about his Senior Technician exam, and his father nodded and said, "It never hurts to have more skills."

events.name: Pick out and wrap gifts
events.description: At 4 p.m., after returning home, Lu Mingqiang selected a bottle of 2018 locally produced Haikou Daqu liquor from his liquor bottle collection cabinet, carefully packed it in a red gift bag. This was the birthday surprise he had specially prepared for his workmate Chen Jianguo.

events.name: Listening to a podcast on the way to KTV
events.description: At 5:30 p.m., he drove to a KTV in Longhua District, about 20 minutes away. Using his car's Bluetooth, he played Episode 2 of "Parent Classroom" and learned the principles and phrasing of "nonviolent communication"; he was deeply impressed by the concept of "observing rather than commenting."

events.name: Sang songs and drank at a KTV gathering
events.description: After arriving at the private room, Lu Mingqiang handed the gift to Chen Jianguo. Jianguo opened it and said, 'Old Lu knows me.' He initially sat in the corner eating sunflower seeds and drinking coconut juice. When his coworkers egged him on to request a song, he couldn't refuse and chose 'Friends'. As soon as he started singing, he went off-key, making the whole room burst into laughter. Even the usually serious Team Leader Zhang laughed so hard that he doubled over. Lu Mingqiang himself also finished the song with a cracked voice and then laughed until he couldn't stand straight. With the atmosphere so lively, he made an exception and drank half a bottle of beer, feeling slightly tipsy but extremely relaxed.

events.name: Gathering return trip and pausing review.
events.description: The gathering ended at 10 pm. Since Lu Mingqiang had drunk a bit, he asked a designated driver to take him home. On the way, he recalled the scene of everyone laughing and joking, and a smile still lingered at the corners of his mouth. He got home at nearly 10:30. After discussing with his wife, he decided to put off the planned senior technician review tonight and save his energy to make it up tomorrow evening. His wife thoughtfully made him a cup of honey water. He played briefly with the children for ten minutes, then washed up and went to bed at 11:10.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to being with parents and the evening gathering

end_state.mood: Relaxed and happy. Although I was thinking about review, the joy of stealing some free time diluted the guilt.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km, core training for 15 minutes

2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, after his morning run, Lu Mingqiang took the whole family to the swimming pool. The father and his two sons practiced together, and Lu Mingqiang could already swim 25 meters. In the morning he caught up on the review he had paused the night before; in the afternoon they went to Baishamen Park to fly kites and enjoy warm family time. In the evening he continued studying and helped Zixuan with his science class materials, balancing effort and rest. The whole day reflected a healthy family routine.

events.name: Morning run, met a fellow runner
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang jogged 4 kilometers in Wanlv Park. On the way, he met his running buddy Chen Bin. As they ran, they chatted about children's education and healthy eating. Chen Bin recommended a math learning app, and Lu Mingqiang noted it down to try with Zixuan. After returning home, he completed 15 minutes of core training.

events.name: Parent-child swimming class
events.description: At 8:30 a.m., the whole family drove to the community swimming pool. Lu Mingqiang guided his two sons in practicing breaststroke kicks and breathing. Zixuan could already swim 5 meters independently, and Zihan could hold his breath and paddle while supported by his father. Lu Mingqiang easily finished 25 meters himself, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment at the children's progress. His wife accompanied them in the shallow area.

events.name: Morning catch-up review session
events.description: At 10 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang returned home and buried himself in the study, making up the two hours he missed the night before. He systematically studied the working principle of transformers and equivalent circuits, took detailed notes, and completed the accompanying exercises.

events.name: Family flies kites in the park.
events.description: At 3:30 in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang took out his collection of traditional sand-swallow kites and a small children's kite, and drove with his wife and two sons to Baishamen Park. The autumn sky was clear and crisp, and there were many kites in the park. He skillfully let out the line to fly the kites, Zixuan ran with the line, and Zihan stood on tiptoes trying to pull it. Wang Lijuan recorded the scene of the father and his two sons together with her phone. After flying kites for about an hour, the family ate Hainan noodles and Baoluo noodles at a noodle shop beside the park, full of joy.

events.name: Evening review and consolidation
events.description: At 7:30 after dinner, Lu Mingqiang continued reviewing. This time he used a mobile question bank for a mock chapter test. His accuracy rate rose to 80%, and his understanding of transformers was strengthened.

events.name: Help Zixuan prepare science materials
events.description: While relaxing after the review session, Zixuan said the teacher asked him to bring small magnets and batteries for tomorrow's science class. Lu Mingqiang helped him find suitable button magnets and used batteries in the toolbox, put them into his pencil case, and reminded him about safety.

start_state.mood: Felt a little guilty about missing class yesterday, but quickly adjusted his mindset.

end_state.mood: Full of family warmth and the satisfaction of self-improvement.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 4 km, swim 45 minutes, core training 15 minutes, kite flying

2025-09.daily_overview: Monday began another busy week. During the day, Lu Mingqiang completed emergency repairs for a power outage in an old residential building, and in the evening he continued his intensive theoretical review. He became increasingly aware that his apprentice Zhao Qiang had been troubled lately, but he didn't have a chance to talk in depth. Because he was tired from work, he skipped his morning run and only did core training. He studied until late at night and went to bed a little later than usual.

events.name: Early morning school drop-off and core training.
events.description: He got up at 6:15, completed 15 minutes of core training, and as usual took the two children to school. On the way, he told Zixuan to actively raise his hand in class, and comforted Zihan, who had a bit of separation anxiety: 'Dad will pick you up after school.'

events.name: Replacing the main switch in an old residential building
events.description: In the morning, the crew went to an old residential building in Xiuying District to replace the main switch and aging wiring during a power outage coordinated with the power supply bureau. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for removing the old switch and installing a new circuit breaker. Zhao Qiang was passing tools beside him but was somewhat distracted, handing over the wrong wrench twice. Lu Mingqiang asked in a low voice, 'Are you feeling unwell?' Zhao Qiang shook his head. Chen Jianguo also noticed something unusual and took the initiative to take the wrench and help.

events.name: Browsed the electrician forum at noon.
events.description: During lunch break, Lu Mingqiang browsed an electrical technology forum for a while and saved a post about smart meter communication protocols, thinking it might be useful if he opens a workshop later.

events.name: Team meeting before leaving work
events.description: After continuing to install the electrical boxes in the afternoon, Team Leader Zhang held a brief wrap-up meeting, reminded everyone that due to the outer edge of the typhoon there might be thunderstorms in the coming days, and required all members to keep their phones available and be prepared for emergency repairs.

events.name: Evening review and notes
events.description: After dinner at 7:30, Lu Mingqiang went into the study to review the chapter on short-circuit current calculation in Power System Analysis. This part was rather abstract, so he read the book repeatedly and drew diagrams to understand it, studying until 10:20. His wife brought him a glass of warm milk at 10:00. Because working through the difficult point took time, he studied 20 minutes longer than usual. When he finished, his shoulders and neck felt slightly stiff, but he didn't pay attention to it.

events.name: Relaxed into sleep.
events.description: After finishing work, he leaned back on the sofa and listened to Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies with his eyes closed, feeling somewhat calmer, and went to bed at 10:50.

start_state.mood: Normal, a bit worried about the apprentice

end_state.mood: Slightly tired but determined; review is somewhat difficult, but not backing down.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lu Mingqiang talked with his running partners about family education during his morning run. The all-day low-voltage line inspection consumed considerable physical energy. In the evening, he got into the zone for review, and his score on the first mock test improved compared with before. Before bed, while tutoring his eldest son's homework, he initially applied listening skills, and the effect was beginning to show. His neck and shoulders still felt slightly uncomfortable, so he applied a hot compress himself.

events.name: Morning run and core training
events.description: Got up at 5:50, jogged 4 kilometers in Wanlv Park as usual, and happened to meet running buddy Chen Bin. The two chatted while running about cultivating children's study habits. Chen Bin suggested more encouragement and less pushing. After returning home, he did 15 minutes of core training and felt refreshed and clearheaded.

events.name: Low-voltage line inspection
events.description: Today the team's task was to inspect the low-voltage lines around Binlian Village in Haikou. Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang were in one group. They climbed ladders to measure temperatures and recorded the condition of the joints, and found two aluminum joints with severe oxidation, marking them on the spot for repair. Zhao Qiang was still quiet. At noon, as the three squatted by the roadside eating, Jianguo whispered that Little Zhao might be thinking about resigning. Lu Mingqiang nodded and said not to ask, and to wait for him to say it himself.

events.name: Noon phone call home to check in
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang called his wife and learned that Zihan had made a pinwheel craft in kindergarten today and received a little red flower, and that Zixuan's calligraphy homework had also been praised by the teacher. He felt very gratified.

events.name: Evening review and mock test
events.description: After dinner at 7:30, he continued studying for the exam. Using a question bank on his phone, he took a mock test with a perfect score of 100 and got 78, an improvement over the past few days. The lost points were concentrated in the relay protection setting section. He carefully reviewed the explanations for the wrong questions and made marks. He studied until 9:30, when the soreness in his shoulders and neck returned, so he paused to stretch his neck.

events.name: Use attentive listening when tutoring homework
events.description: Before bed, he checked Zixuan's math homework and found a calculation error in a word problem. This time, instead of rushing to give the answer, he used the active listening technique he had just learned and first asked, "Which part of this problem do you think is the hardest?" Zixuan thought for a moment and said the step-by-step equations were a bit messy. Lu Mingqiang guided him to break the problem into two steps, and Zixuan quickly corrected it on his own. Lu Mingqiang patted his head and said, "The way you think things through is wonderful."

events.name: Hot compress and music before bedtime
events.description: After reviewing and tutoring, he asked his wife to help apply a hot towel to his shoulders and neck for 10 minutes, then played “Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies” to relax and fell asleep at 10:40.

start_state.mood: Positive; the morning run brought a good state.

end_state.mood: Satisfied; happy about the review progress and positive parent-child interaction.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 4 kilometers, core training 15 minutes

2025-09.daily_overview: On Wednesday, Lu Mingqiang was out all day doing maintenance and inspection on distribution cabinets. Relying on his experience, he found and eliminated a damp short-circuit hazard and was praised by the property manager. Because the task ran late, he voluntarily canceled the evening squash training and went home to focus on studying. During the lunch break, he listened to episode 3 of the parent-child podcast and continued to internalize parenting methods. In the evening he only did core training; after studying, the discomfort in his shoulders and neck worsened, and he began to take it seriously.

events.name: Received the maintenance task at the pre-shift meeting
events.description: At 7:40 a.m., Team Leader Zhang called a team meeting and assigned Lu Mingqiang's group to Jinmao Community in Longhua District to complete the annual inspection of power distribution cabinets in three old residential buildings. He handed out tools, desiccant, sealing gaskets, and other materials, and particularly emphasized checking moisture protection during the recent rainy days.

events.name: Arrive at the scene and liaise with property management.
events.description: At exactly 8 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang drove the work vehicle carrying Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang, and others to Jinmao Residential Community, where he met with the property manager Wang Jianguo to discuss the locations of the distribution cabinets and possible problems.

events.name: Discovered and handled a dampness-related short circuit hazard.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang led the team to inspect the wiring terminals and insulation of each distribution cabinet one by one. When he opened the door of Building A's distribution cabinet, he smelled mildew. He used a 500V megohmmeter to measure insulation resistance and found one circuit reading only 0.2 megohms. After careful inspection, he found that the wiring bar had rusted and short-circuited due to water ingress caused by aging sealing gaskets. He decisively cut off the power and replaced the damaged sealing gaskets and wiring bar with Zhao Qiang, removed the copper rust, and re-measured the insulation resistance, which recovered to above 5 megohms. Power was restored normally. He had Zhao Qiang take photos to record the fault point.

events.name: Proposed corrective action suggestions to the property management director
events.description: After the inspection and repair, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to explain to Director Wang Jianguo in detail the principle behind the dampness hazard, suggested installing moisture-proof boxes inside the distribution cabinet and inspecting the sealing performance every quarter, and then carefully filled out the maintenance record form. Director Wang expressed his repeated thanks, saying that Master Lu was professional and meticulous in his work.

events.name: Lunch break: listened to podcast Episode 3.
events.description: At noon, the work team ate boxed lunches in the property management office. Lu Mingqiang, while eating, opened a podcast on his phone and listened to the newly updated Episode 3 of "Parents' School," which was about how to use specific encouragement to stimulate children's motivation to learn. On a sticky note within easy reach, he wrote down 'describe the behavior + affirm the effort + avoid being vague.' He thought of how he had used exactly this method when tutoring Zixuan last night, and it felt very apt.

events.name: Returned to the company and reported
events.description: At 4 p.m., after completing all the inspection and repair work, Lu Mingqiang returned to the company, organized his tools, and gave Team Leader Zhang a verbal report of the whole process. The team leader signed the task sheet to confirm completion.

events.name: Cancelled squash practice and returned home to review.
events.description: As it was already past 5:30 after work, Lu Mingqiang called his squash buddy Lin Feng and explained that he could not make it to squash tonight. Lin Feng said he understood. He got home around 6:00, did 15 minutes of core training first, and after dinner at 7:30 continued reviewing the relay protection chapter, combining it with today's actual dampness fault to deepen his understanding. He spent two hours on intensive reading and practice problems. But from sitting too long, his shoulder and neck became noticeably sore, and he had to get up and move every half hour.

events.name: Relaxing music and hot compress before bedtime.
events.description: Study ended at 9:40. As usual, he leaned back on the sofa, listened to old songs such as Friends on earphones, and had his wife apply another hot compress to his neck and shoulders and rub some pain-relief oil on them. He fell asleep at 10:30.

start_state.mood: Stay alert and remain focused on the whole day's maintenance tasks.

end_state.mood: He was tired, but his confidence in his technical skills had been affirmed; however, shoulder and neck discomfort was beginning to bother him.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes (physical labor is already sufficient).

2025-09.daily_overview: On Thursday, after running in the rain in the morning, Lu Mingqiang threw himself into sorting out the warehouse. During this time, apprentice Zhao Qiang privately revealed that he had decided to resign and return to his hometown. Although Lu Mingqiang was reluctant to see him go, he still gave his support, and the two agreed to have a farewell meal over the weekend. In the evening, he felt emotionally stirred while reviewing, but he still insisted on completing the plan. His shoulder and neck soreness persisted, so he added stretching to relieve it.

events.name: Morning run and core training
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang jogged 5 km in Wanlv Park in a light rain. His steps splashed water on the rainy path, and he felt refreshed after the run. Back home, he completed 15 minutes of core training and added extra shoulder and neck stretches.

events.name: Zhao Qiang revealed his decision to resign
events.description: While organizing tools in the warehouse after work started, Lu Mingqiang was teaching Zhao Qiang how to maintain the hydraulic pliers and noticed that his apprentice seemed to hesitate several times, as if wanting to say something. During a break, Zhao Qiang pulled him over to the materials rack and formally said that he had decided to resign and return to his hometown in Yongzhou, Hunan, to develop his career, because his family was urging him to get married and his father was in poor health, so he wanted to work nearby. Lu Mingqiang was silent for a moment, then patted him on the shoulder and said, "As long as you have made up your mind, that's fine. With your skills, you can now handle things on your own; you won't have to worry about making a living back home." They agreed that he would treat Zhao Qiang to a nice farewell dinner on Saturday evening.

events.name: At noon, kept an eye out for job postings for my apprentice.
events.description: During lunch, Lu Mingqiang was still concerned. He opened several WeChat groups of peers in Yongzhou, found two local electrician job postings, and forwarded them to Zhao Qiang so he could have a reference when he went back.

events.name: Evening Thoughts and Review
events.description: During dinner he told his wife that Zhao Qiang was leaving. Wang Lijuan said that this apprentice was steady and reliable, so they should indeed treat him to a meal. At 7:30 p.m., before entering the study to review, he first did a set of shoulder and neck relaxation exercises. While reviewing, images of himself learning from scratch under Master Li in those years kept flashing through his mind, and the relay protection formulas in the book seemed especially hard to absorb. He took a deep breath, forced himself to concentrate, and kept studying the planned content until 9:30. Although efficiency was slightly low, he did not miss anything.

events.name: Bedtime reflections and hot compress
events.description: After reviewing, he played the song 'Friends', closed his eyes and rested, remembering what Master Li once said: 'The skills of an electrician are passed down from generation to generation.' Now that he had seen off his own apprentice, he was filled with emotion. Before bed, he applied another hot compress to his shoulder and neck. He got into bed at 10:45 and tossed and turned for a while before falling asleep.

start_state.mood: Calm, but with a faint sense that something will change today.

end_state.mood: A mix of slight melancholy and pride, as the master-apprentice bond faces farewell.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog 5 kilometers (in the rain), 15 minutes of core training, shoulder and neck stretches.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Friday, Lu Mingqiang finished listening to the last episode of a parenting podcast during his commute to work and learned emotional management methods. He completed fieldwork such as streetlight repairs throughout the day. In the evening, his review went well, breaking 80 points for the first time, boosting his confidence. Long hours of studying at a desk worsened his shoulder and neck soreness, officially recorded as a minor strain. He started daily hot compresses and stretching.

events.name: Listened to Episode 4 of the podcast on the commute.
events.description: At 6:15 in the morning on the way to work, he connected his phone and played Episode 4 of "Parents' School", on the topic of how to manage irritability when helping with homework. The speaker introduced techniques such as the deep-breathing pause method and breaking large tasks into smaller steps. While waiting at a red light, Lu Mingqiang quickly jotted down three key points in his phone notes and planned to start practicing them today. Because he got up a little late, he did not go for a morning run today and only did core training.

events.name: Street light cable replacement work
events.description: In the morning, the team went to the Haisheng Road area to replace several streetlight cables that had aged due to typhoon effects. Lu Mingqiang climbed a ladder to connect wires and apply insulating wrapping. Under the blazing sun, his work clothes were soaked through, but his hands moved deftly. His workmate Jianguo passed materials up from below, and the two worked in perfect coordination. During the work he occasionally turned his neck, feeling obvious soreness between his shoulder blades.

events.name: Discussed the farewell plan at noon.
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang and Jianguo sat at the same table in the cafeteria. When he mentioned inviting Zhao Qiang to dinner tomorrow evening, Jianguo immediately said he would go too, as a way to see Xiao Zhao off. Lu Mingqiang called the Hainan cuisine restaurant he usually frequented and booked a table.

events.name: Received praise from the manager at the weekly meeting
events.description: In the afternoon, Team Leader Zhang chaired the weekly meeting and summarized the week's work, singling out Lu Mingqiang for praise for proactively discovering a major moisture-related short-circuit hazard during the inspection at Jinmao Residential Community, avoiding a possible large-scale power outage. Manager Liu from the Engineering Department also attended and asked him about his preparation progress for the senior technician certification, encouraging him, 'Come on, Old Lu. Once you get the certificate, the company will give a subsidy.' Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement.

events.name: Refueled the car in preparation for the weekend trip
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang went to a gas station and filled up the family car, in preparation for the weekend's school runs and photo outings.

events.name: Evening review: breakthrough in results
events.description: At 7:30 he reviewed on schedule and took a comprehensive mock test on relay protection, finally scoring 82 and breaking the 80 mark for the first time. He was quite encouraged and decided to make an exception by taking a small sip of wine at tomorrow's farewell dinner to reward himself. But after sitting for a long time, the pain in his shoulder and neck worsened. He realized he had to take it seriously, so that evening he formally recorded it as 'mild shoulder and neck soreness' and, after checking information, decided to apply hot compresses daily, rub on medicated oil, and get up and move regularly.

events.name: Add a shoulder and neck care routine
events.description: After the review session, he set an alarm on his phone to remind himself to stand and move every 45 minutes, asked his wife to massage his shoulders and neck for 10 minutes, applied medicated oil, and used a hot compress before bed.

start_state.mood: Resolute and expectant.

end_state.mood: Confident and cheerful; the review breakthrough brought positive feedback, but the body is sending warnings.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes; shoulder and neck stretching.

2025-09.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lu Mingqiang was still on duty for line patrol in the morning. In the afternoon, his apprentice Zhao Qiang officially bid him farewell. In the evening, he invited Zhao Qiang and Chen Jianguo to an authentic Hainan restaurant for a farewell dinner. Over toasts, they wished each other well, and the master-apprentice bond turned into simple blessings. After returning late, he cut back on his review again, his mind heavy with the reluctance of parting. Because he drank at the farewell dinner and his emotions fluctuated, he went to bed late, and his weight dropped slightly.

events.name: Morning run and morning line inspection.
events.description: After a 5:50 a.m. run of 4 km, core training, and shoulder and neck stretching, Lu Mingqiang arrived at the company by 8:00. Because of the typhoon-season duty arrangements, he, Zhao Qiang, and Chen Jianguo were sent to the Meilan District area to inspect low-voltage lines and clear branches that might affect the lines. The three worked until 12 noon, during which Zhao Qiang worked especially hard, as if trying to express his camaraderie with his last bit of sweat.

events.name: Zhao Qiang formally came to say goodbye.
events.description: In the afternoon, while everyone was organizing tools at the company, Zhao Qiang walked over to Lu Mingqiang, who was checking multimeters, and formally said goodbye, saying that he had completed the formalities with the team leader and would leave tonight. Lu Mingqiang stood up, took out from his tool bag the old multimeter that had been with him for many years, and handed it to Zhao Qiang: "Keep it as a memento; it measures voltage very accurately." Zhao Qiang took it with red-rimmed eyes and bowed deeply. The two chatted for a while in the rest corner, and Lu Mingqiang repeated the few safety mnemonics he had summed up over the years.

events.name: Held a farewell dinner for Zhao Qiang and Jianguo
events.description: After getting off work at 5, Lu Mingqiang called Chen Jianguo, and the three of them drove to a familiar Hainan restaurant in Longhua District. He ordered signature dishes such as Hainanese chicken rice, qingbuliang, and grilled fish, and made an exception by opening a bottle of local beer, pouring a glass for each of Zhao Qiang and himself. During the meal, he told them, 'An electrician can always earn a living wherever he goes. Build solid skills and don't disgrace your master.' Zhao Qiang nodded repeatedly. The three chatted about many work memories and family matters, and the atmosphere was sincere and nostalgic. Lu Mingqiang drank about half a bottle of beer and was slightly tipsy. After the meal, Lu Mingqiang settled the bill, and the three waved goodbye at the restaurant door until their backs disappeared.

events.name: He found it hard to calm down after returning.
events.description: After getting home shortly after 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa and stared blankly for a while. His wife came over and sat down, and he said with emotion, 'When Master Li saw me off back then, it was the same.' Wang Lijuan held his hand. The soreness in his neck and shoulders made him rub them from time to time, and his wife applied medicated oil for him.

events.name: Reduce evening study load
events.description: Feeling emotionally stirred, he decided to review only for one hour tonight. He did a set of relay protection multiple-choice questions, and the accuracy rate was acceptable. He stopped at 9:30, played 'Friends' twice on repeat, and went to bed at 11:00. Before bed, he still applied a hot compress to his neck and shoulders.

start_state.mood: Normal, but aware that today holds a special farewell.

end_state.mood: Feeling reluctant and sad but also comforted, completing the master's final farewell to his apprentice

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 4 km, 15 minutes of core training, shoulder and neck stretching

2025-09.daily_overview: On Sunday, while organizing his tool cabinet, Lu Mingqiang unexpectedly discovered his passion for antique electrical equipment. Excited, he cleared out a display area and opened a new world of collecting. In the morning, the whole family went swimming; in the afternoon, he took his wife to the flea market and picked up a 1968 current transformer. In the evening, as he reviewed his studies, the echoes of technological history still rang in his mind. Because of the excitement and collecting activity, he went to bed late, but he continued his neck and shoulder care.

events.name: After the morning run, tidying the tool cabinet sparked a new hobby.
events.description: After a 3 km morning run at 6:30, he went home for breakfast, then did core training and shoulder-neck stretches. At about 9 o'clock, he opened the tool cabinet to find a test pen and came across several old tools he had used years ago—wooden-handled screwdrivers, an old wire stripper, and the like. Moved by the objects, he took them all out and wiped them carefully with a rag. The more he wiped, the more absorbed he became, feeling that these old things carried a sense of time like an electric current.

events.name: Parent-child swimming
events.description: Because he suddenly felt enthusiastic that morning, he moved the swimming time up to 10 a.m. The whole family rushed to the community swimming pool, where Lu Mingqiang continued to coach his sons in practice and swam 300 meters himself, feeling his shoulders and neck much more relaxed in the water.

events.name: Create a tool cabinet display area
events.description: After returning from swimming, he decided to clear out the upper shelf of the tool cabinet as a display area. He moved the everyday tools to the lower shelf, cleaned the upper shelf again with a clean rag, then neatly arranged the old tools that he had polished to a shine, and stepped back a few paces to admire them. A simple personal electrician's tool collection corner began to take shape, and he took out his phone to snap a photo.

events.name: Search online for tutorials on restoring antique equipment.
events.description: After his interest was sparked, he opened his phone and computer to search for 'antique electrician tool restoration' and 'vintage electrician equipment collecting,' found several professional forums and tutorial videos on rust removal and oiling maintenance, watched and saved them carefully, and decided to study further in the future.

events.name: Discussed with wife and went to the second-hand market.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang excitedly shared his new discovery with his wife and suggested going to the Xiuying Little Street second-hand market in the afternoon to see if they could find any old treasures. Wang Lijuan smiled and agreed, saying she wanted to browse too. At 3 p.m., he took 200 yuan in cash and a shopping bag, drove his wife there, and the two chatted and laughed in the car.

events.name: Scored the first collectible item: a 1968 current transformer
events.description: At a street stall at the Xiuying Small Street flea market, Lu Mingqiang was quickly attracted by a dusty oil-immersed current transformer. He looked closely at the metal nameplate engraved with "Haikou Power Plant 1968". He asked the stall owner, who quoted 120 yuan. Drawing on years of bargaining experience from buying hardware materials, Lu Mingqiang used the excuse that "the old item's condition is mediocre, but I want it for research" and bargained the price down to 80 yuan. He was overjoyed and kept stroking it, while his wife helped take photos and post them on Moments.

events.name: Return home to clean and put away the collection items.
events.description: After returning home, he used a dry cloth and a little WD-40 rust remover to give this 1968 current transformer a simple cleaning, removing surface rust without damaging the old patina. Then he solemnly placed it in the upper display area of the tool cabinet, side by side with the old tools from the morning. He admired and photographed it again, filled with a sense of accomplishment. During the activity, his shoulder and neck reacted again, but his enthusiasm did not wane.

events.name: Evening review and neck and shoulder care
events.description: At 7:30 after dinner, in the good mood brought by the collecting trip, he went into the study to review power system analysis. His study efficiency was unexpectedly high, and from time to time he connected the theoretical knowledge with the old equipment he had just touched. He finished studying at 9:30, then applied a hot compress to his neck and shoulders, rubbed on medicinal massage oil, and listened to old songs to relax until 11.

During his lunch break he sat alone in the car eating the lunch he had brought in the morning and listened to an audio program from his favorite forum.

events.description: During a lunch break, he browsed a post on a collecting forum on his phone by an old hand, titled 'Exploded View of the Internal Structure of an Oil-Immersed Transformer.' It was full of pictures and text, and happened to be the same model as one of his recent acquisitions. He was so fascinated that he bookmarked the post.

events.name: Deepening communication skills through homework tutoring.
events.description: After dinner, Zixuan took out his math homework for the day and was stumped by a two-step word problem. Lu Mingqiang moved a stool over and sat beside him, deliberately slowing his speech and applying 'active listening.' He first asked, 'What story do you think this problem tells?' Zixuan replied, 'Buying stationery.' He then said, using a 'nonviolent communication' approach, 'I can see you've already calculated the cost of the first pen, which means you understand what each step means. If you wrote out the second step in the same way, would it be clearer?' His tone remained calm throughout. Zixuan quickly wrote out the full equation, and after getting it right, said happily, 'Dad, you're so gentle today.' Lu Mingqiang smiled and patted his head, feeling gratified that his educational approach was working.

events.name: Researching the second-hand market in Haikou
events.description: After helping with the homework, he turned on the computer and used maps and local life forums to search for secondhand markets in Haikou. He found several places such as the Wenming East Road Secondhand Market and the Xingang Pier Flea Market, and carefully noted the opening hours, locations, and transportation routes, planning to continue treasure hunting there on the weekend.

events.name: Flipping through maintenance notes sparked inspiration
events.description: Before entering the study at 7:30 pm for review, he took out a 1980s equipment maintenance notebook from a cabinet next to his liquor bottle collection that he had obtained from Master Li back then. When he turned to the chapter on voltage stabilizer faults, the notebook said, "Aging filter capacitors often cause unstable voltage and frequent tripping." This reminded him of when he had previously accompanied his son in building electronic building blocks: if the filter capacitor failed in the circuit, the LED light would flicker unstably. The two circuit logics converged in his mind. He looked thoughtful, then opened his portable tool kit, checked and confirmed that the multimeter with normal capacitance measurement function was within its calibration period, and mused that if he encountered a similar fault in the future, he could use this method to troubleshoot. This logical deduction combining historical experience and parent-child practice made him faintly excited.

events.name: Evening review and neck and shoulder care
events.description: After sorting out his thoughts, he still reviewed as planned from 7:30 to 9:30. Because he was mentally active today, his study efficiency was good, and he even did a dozen or so extra practice problems. During the break, he got up and moved around every 45 minutes and applied a hot compress on schedule. After reviewing, he sank into the sofa as usual, put on his earphones, played Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies and Friends, closed his eyes and rested for a dozen or so minutes. His old notes and his son's building-block circuit flashed through his mind, and a faint, barely noticeable smile hung at the corner of his mouth.

events.description: After arriving at the shop, Boss Li described how the voltage stabilizer kept tripping frequently and the previous two groups of colleagues had failed to fix it. Combined with the replacement method, he quickly pinpointed the fault: an aged filter capacitor with a bulging top.

events.description: Take a new capacitor of the same specification from the toolkit, carefully desolder the old part with a soldering iron and screwdriver, clean the pads, and make sure the new capacitor's polarity is correct and the solder joints are solid with no cold joints.

events.name: Tested the equipment and won customer praise
events.description: After the replacement, the power was reconnected and various parameters were tested with a multimeter. The voltage stabilizer output was stable and no longer tripped. Boss Li gave a thumbs up and praised him repeatedly, solemnly promising that he would be the first to support him when he opened a studio in the future. Lu Mingqiang felt a sense of accomplishment, and his reputation in the industry improved as well.

2025-09.daily_overview: The morning engineering meeting and routine inspection went smoothly. In the afternoon, his wife called to say she was feeling unwell, so Lu Mingqiang came home early to take care of her and cooked dinner, showing the warmth of family mutual support. In the evening, they received the good news that his brother-in-law Guoqing would visit with his girlfriend, and the whole family happily discussed the family dinner arrangements.

events.name: Morning core stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:30, did 15 minutes of core and stretching exercises, and felt refreshed.

events.name: Morning project sync meeting
events.description: In the morning, Manager Liu called a one-hour meeting with the team leaders and key staff to discuss personnel and equipment arrangements for the two substation renovation projects next month. Lu Mingqiang was in charge of taking notes and took on the transformer replacement team.

events.name: Routine afternoon line inspection
events.description: In the afternoon, he and Team Leader Zhang patrolled the overhead lines along Haiyu Middle Road, cleared several branches that were touching the lines, and recorded the details in the work log.

events.name: Came home early to take care of his wife
events.description: At 3 p.m., he received a call from his wife saying she felt dizzy and fatigued, possibly because she had caught a chill during the night. Lu Mingqiang asked for leave and got off work an hour early, stopping at a pharmacy on the way to buy Huoxiang Zhengqi liquid. After getting home, he arranged for his wife to rest, cooked a light vegetable congee himself, and helped his eldest son with his homework.

events.name: My wife's younger brother called to confirm his National Day visit.
events.description: At 8 pm, Lu Mingqiang's wife Wang Lijuan felt better. Her younger brother Chen Zhiqiang video-called and confirmed that he would bring his new girlfriend back to Haikou on National Day to meet the family. Lu Mingqiang took the phone and chatted with his brother-in-law for a while. After hanging up, the couple immediately sat down at the dining table to discuss: according to Hainan customs, prepare a family dinner with a menu of Hainanese chicken rice, grilled fish, Qingbuliang, and Laoba tea snacks. Then Lu Mingqiang called his mother Chen Xiuying on the spot and asked her to come over on the 1st to help cook; she readily agreed.

events.name: Light review
events.description: Because of family care responsibilities, review time was shortened to one hour. He did 30 multiple-choice questions on the app, with an accuracy rate of 88%.

start_state.mood: Approach work with a calm, steady mindset

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: The warmth of family mutual support filled him with anticipation for the reunion.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training.

2025-09.daily_overview: After a morning run, he efficiently completed the emergency repair of cable joints. After work, he went shopping with his wife for ingredients for a family dinner, showing a strong sense of everyday life while selecting goods at the market. In the evening, after reviewing, the family sat together discussing the National Day menu, and a sense of anticipation spread. However, he felt a bit greasy after trying a little grilled fish.

events.name: Morning core and stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:00; core work and stretching for 15 minutes; felt light and full of energy.

events.name: Morning run and morning emergency repair task
events.description: At 6:20, he ran 5 km in Wanlv Park at a pace of 6:28 min/km. In the morning, he received an urgent work order: a facility's buried cable had been cut during construction. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo rushed to the scene, waterproofed the intermediate joints, and restored power supply by noon.

events.name: Organize collected materials in the afternoon.
events.description: In the afternoon, while organizing tools at the company, he checked his bookmarked forum again and found a well-preserved 1974 vintage multimeter up for auction with a low bid. He decided to keep an eye on the final price.

events.name: The couple worked together to shop for ingredients for the family dinner
events.description: After work, Wang Lijuan called and said she had arrived at the food market. Lu Mingqiang drove directly there to meet her. The two first went to the fresh food stall and picked a plump grouper for grilled fish, then bought a free-range chicken, fresh coconuts, and ingredients for making qingbuliang. Finally, they bought drinks and several seasonal fruits at the supermarket, filling the trunk to the brim.

events.name: Evening family discussion and review
events.description: After returning home, the couple packed the ingredients into the refrigerator together. During dinner, he couldn't resist trying a piece of grilled fish, but felt it was too greasy and secretly resolved to stay away from it. The whole family excitedly discussed the details of the National Day family dinner and where to take the future sister-in-law that day. Afterward, Lu Mingqiang focused on reviewing for two hours and reworked the wrong questions from the previous night's past exam paper.

start_state.mood: Energetic and highly organized

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Everyday life is filled with anticipation, and the couple's sense of collaboration has grown.
