2025-09.daily_overview: After the morning run, the whole family did a thorough cleaning to welcome guests. In the afternoon, at the flea market, he found the first Republic-era knife switch, giving the collection plan a solid start. In the evening, a privacy misunderstanding caused a small dispute between the couple. After sincere communication, they made a new pact of mutual trust, and their bond became stronger.

events.name: Morning core and stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:30 and did 15 minutes of core exercises and stretching to warm up for the morning run.

events.name: Morning run of 5 kilometers at Wanlv Garden.
events.description: Set off for Wanlv Garden at 6:50, easily finished 5 kilometers with a pace of 6 minutes 35 seconds, starting the weekend.

events.name: Whole-family spring cleaning to welcome the festival.
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang and his wife and children worked together: cleaned the living room glass, mopped the floor, tidied up odds and ends, rearranged the decorations on the sofa and coffee table, and put new sheets on the guest bed. The whole home took on a fresh look, full of a sense of ceremony for welcoming guests.

events.name: Treasure hunting at the Bo'ai Road flea market.
events.description: Around 3 p.m., the sky was cloudy and not sunny, so Lu Mingqiang biked to the secondhand market on Bo'ai Road. He stopped for a long time at an old stall, browsing through a pile of old electrical equipment, and finally found a well-preserved knife switch from the Republic of China period, with faint manufacturer characters engraved on the ceramic base. Lu Mingqiang suppressed his excitement, bargained, and bought it for 120 yuan, as if he had found a treasure.

events.name: Discovering the tablet's browsing history led to a brief argument
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang wanted to use the old tablet at home to check new posts on his favorite collecting forum, but accidentally discovered in the browser history that his wife had visited the pages of the collecting forum he frequented and a folder of exam preparation materials. Feeling his privacy had been invaded, he questioned his wife in a somewhat harsh tone. Wang Lijuan explained that the child had clicked around randomly earlier and she had seen them unintentionally—it was by no means deliberate. After a few exchanges of bickering, the two fell silent.

events.name: Communicated calmly and reached a mutual trust agreement.
events.description: Half an hour later, Lu Mingqiang voluntarily walked back to the living room and candidly expressed the importance of personal private space. Wang Lijuan also reflected that she had indeed taken a couple of extra glances out of curiosity that day, but with absolutely no intention of monitoring him. The two discussed it calmly and finally agreed that from then on each would use his or her own tablet, and that although the phone photo albums would not be locked, they promised not to secretly browse each other’s. The emotional knot was untied, and the trust in their marriage actually grew stronger.

events.name: Evening review and relaxing with old songs
events.description: After making up, the atmosphere at home was warm. Lu Mingqiang started reviewing at 9 o'clock, and his concentration was unaffected. After finishing, he put on headphones and listened to “Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies,” closed his eyes and drifted into thoughts about the future. After more than ten minutes, his fatigue dissipated.

start_state.mood: Relax and welcome the weekend, looking forward to Taobao

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: After reconciliation, the sense of trust feels more solid, and I am satisfied with the start of the collection.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km, 15 minutes of core training, and strenuous house-cleaning chores.

2025-09.daily_overview: In the early morning, he took on the challenge of his first personal 10-kilometer run and set a new record, reaching a new physical level; in the morning, the whole family flew kites in the park and relived childhood fun; in the afternoon, he washed the car and tidied tools, and was pleasantly surprised to find that his second son had developed the habit of active reading, showing that patient parenting had borne fruit; in the evening, they warmly confirmed the final details for welcoming guests.

events.name: Morning core and stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:30, did 15 minutes of deep stretching to fully prepare for the long run.

events.name: 10-kilometer run at Wanlv Park.
events.description: Arrived at Wanlv Garden at 7:00 and did dynamic warm-ups. Started at a pace of 6:40, kept the rhythm along the way, and slightly picked up the pace for the last kilometer. The total time was 1 hour 8 minutes, completing his first 10 km run, and the app recorded a new milestone. After the run he stretched thoroughly and felt his lungs and muscles still had plenty in reserve.

events.name: Flying kites with the whole family at Wanlv Garden
events.description: After the long run, went home for breakfast and a short rest. At 10 a.m., brought the bagua kite he made himself and went to Wanlv Garden again with his wife and two sons. The eldest son, Lu Zixuan, successfully flew the kite high and steady for the first time, with Lu Mingqiang beside him coaching on letting out and reeling in the line. The second son chased the kite's shadow across the lawn; the whole family was happy and harmonious.

events.name: Afternoon car wash and tool organization
events.description: After going home for a midday rest, Lu Mingqiang washed the car himself by the water pipe downstairs, and also rinsed and dried the floor mats inside the car. Then he went back to the garage, wiped and oiled the tools that had been used frequently recently, and rearranged them in the toolbox by type.

events.name: Pleasantly surprised to find his younger son reading independently.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang brought in the dried car floor mats from the balcony. Passing through the living room, he saw his younger son Lu Zihan sitting alone on the play mat, quietly flipping through a dinosaur picture book, pointing at the pictures with his little finger and imitating the sounds in his mouth. At that moment, Lu Mingqiang suddenly felt that the patient guidance with building blocks and nursery rhymes over the past two weeks had really worked — the child's reading habit had quietly taken root, and a warm feeling surged in his heart. He quietly stepped back into the kitchen and pointed the scene out to his wife. They smiled at each other.

events.name: Evening review and guest confirmation
events.description: In the evening, he studied efficiently for two hours with a gratified mood. Before bed, he and his wife did a final check of the family dinner plan: what time his mother would arrive in the morning, who would pick up his wife's younger brother at the station, the serving order of the dishes… Everything was in order, just waiting for the guests to arrive.

start_state.mood: In high spirits, ready to take on a long distance.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Satisfied and calm, happy for his son's growth, proud of his physical breakthrough

2025-09.daily_overview: Last working day before the holiday: after the morning run, completed a major safety inspection; at noon, picked up his wife's birthday cake during off-peak hours and quietly prepared a gift; in the evening, excitedly looked forward to gathering with family, while maintaining his review momentum and building strength for a strong finish to September.

events.name: Morning core and stretching
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, did 15 minutes of core exercises and stretching, and the body has fully recovered.

events.name: Morning run and pre-holiday inspection
events.description: At 6:20, ran 5 km in Wanlv Garden Park at a pace of 6 minutes 26 seconds per kilometer. In the morning, the company organized a special safety inspection before the National Day holiday. Lu Mingqiang followed Team Leader Zhang to inspect the key distribution rooms and outdoor ring main units in the area one by one, filled out safety inspection cards, and cleared a tree-obstruction hazard.

events.name: Afternoon pre-holiday safety meeting
events.description: At 2 p.m., the whole company held a monthly safety review and holiday-duty deployment meeting. Manager Liu specifically praised Lu Mingqiang for independently handling several difficult faults in September. Lu nodded modestly. After the meeting, he left work half an hour early.

events.name: Pick up wife's birthday cake and select a gift
events.description: After work, he first went to the cake shop and picked up the 8-inch fresh fruit cake ordered last week, carefully placing it in an insulated bag. Then he went to the nearby department store and selected an exquisite silver necklace for his wife Wang Lijuan as a surprise gift for her birthday five days later.

events.name: Lively family atmosphere in the evening
events.description: Back home, the children gathered around to look at the cake box. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said they could only eat it in a few days. During dinner, everyone discussed the arrangements for picking up Uncle and Aunt-to-be (wife's younger brother and his girlfriend) the next day. The living room was piled with the bought drinks and snacks, with a strong festive atmosphere.

events.name: Stick to evening review
events.description: After the lively gathering, Lu Mingqiang still went to his study on time to review. He finished the remaining part of the chapter on switching operation specifications and did 15 random multiple-choice questions, with an accuracy rate of 87%. He weighed himself before bed.

start_state.mood: Busy but orderly before the holiday.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Exhilarated yet tender, longing for reunion.

2025-09.daily_overview: On the last day of September, a 5:50 a.m. morning run kicked off a self-disciplined day; in the morning, he finished pre-holiday wrap-up work; at noon, he won his beloved old multimeter on Taobao auction; after work, he prepared an early birthday surprise for his wife; in the evening, after reviewing, he listened to old songs and weighed himself, his weight dropping to 70.5 kg; his monthly running mileage exceeded the target, bringing a fulfilling September to a perfect close.

events.name: Morning core and stretching
events.description: Woke up at 5:50 and did 15 minutes of core and deep stretching; my body felt agile and flexible.

events.name: Morning run and a relaxed finish
events.description: At 6:05, he went to Wanlv Garden and did an easy 5 km jog at a 6:30 pace. In the morning, at the company, he only filed a few maintenance reports and chatted with coworkers Chen Jianguo and Team Leader Zhang about their holiday plans. The company already had a relaxed pre-holiday atmosphere.

events.name: At noon, successfully won the old multimeter at auction
events.description: The auction for the vintage 1974 multimeter he had been watching during his lunch break was about to close. Lu Mingqiang kept his eyes on his phone and, in the final minutes, placed a bid of 160 yuan and won it successfully; its condition met expectations. He immediately took a screenshot and sent it to Chen Jianguo, a collector friend in the liquor bottle collecting group, to share his joy.

events.name: Prepare a birthday surprise for his wife
events.description: He left work early in the afternoon, went to the cake shop to pick up the pre-ordered small cake (reserved for October 5), and on the way stopped at a flower shop to arrange a bouquet of champagne roses. After returning home, while his wife was still out doing housekeeping in the community, he hid the gift and flowers in the wardrobe to prepare for October 5.

events.name: Evening review, listening to music, and weighing himself
events.description: After his wife came home, the family had a pleasant dinner together. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang completed the last review session of the month for the exam preparation, going over all the mistakes he had made. After reviewing, he put on his earphones and listened to "Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies" and "Friends," feeling that the month had been hard but worthwhile. Finally, he stepped on the scale, and the numbers stopped at 70.5 kg, nearly one kilogram less than at the beginning of the month. His belt was one notch looser, and a tangible sense of improved vitality welled up in him. Smiling, he recorded the new number in his notebook.

start_state.mood: Fulfilling but slightly tiring, with a strong sense of closure in the summary.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Filled with a sense of achievement and confidence, and full of anticipation for October

2025-01.daily_overview: During the New Year holiday, Lu Mingqiang did a simple thorough cleaning at home, organized his commonly used tools, and solemnly wrote his annual goals on the new calendar, clarifying the direction for his professional improvement and his son's studies. In the evening, he studied electrical engineering online as planned, starting the new year's rhythm of self-improvement.

events.name: New Year's Day home cleaning and goal setting
events.description: In the morning, while the family was still asleep, Lu Mingqiang did a simple cleaning of the living room and bedroom, wiping away dust and tidying up clutter to welcome the New Year in a clean and tidy environment. After cleaning, he went to the balcony storage cabinet, took out his electrical repair toolbox, counted and wiped down the multimeter, wire strippers, screwdrivers, and other common tools one by one, confirming that nothing was damaged or missing. In the afternoon, he opened the 2025 desk calendar at the dining table and carefully wrote on the January 1 page with a pen: "This year's goals: obtain the senior technician qualification and help Xuanxuan improve his math." In doing so, he clarified two core directions for himself: career advancement and family education.

events.name: Evening electrical technology study
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang went into his home study, opened the computer browser, logged into the 'Electrical Technology' forum and the WeChat Favorites group, browsed technical discussion posts and the basic materials shared in the group, focusing mainly on learning how to read circuit diagrams and fault analysis cases. He stayed focused for 30 minutes, making a good start for the new year's technical improvement.

start_state.mood: Energetic and full of anticipation for the new year.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and determined, with clear goals

2025-01.daily_overview: On the first day back at work after the holiday, Lu Mingqiang accidentally sprained his lower back while carrying heavy objects, but he still managed to start the work case documentation, beginning to distill his experience into writing. In the evening, despite the discomfort, he continued studying online and applied a medicated patch to ease the pain.

events.name: Suffered a lower back strain at work
events.description: In the morning, while moving a heavy power distribution box in the company warehouse, Lu Mingqiang suddenly felt a sharp pain in his lower back and could barely straighten up. His workmate Chen Jianguo immediately came over to help and supported him to rest nearby. In order not to delay the task, Lu Mingqiang continued working after the pain eased slightly. After getting home from work, he immediately applied a medicated plaster, and the pain subsided a little.

events.name: Start work case recording.
events.description: After getting home from work, Lu Mingqiang took out a brand-new blank notebook from the desk drawer and neatly wrote on the title page with a pen, "Even a technical worker needs to be good with a pen," to motivate himself. Then, enduring his lower back pain, he sat at the desk, recalled a transformer fault he had handled that day, and recorded the equipment model, fault symptoms, troubleshooting steps, and handling methods, initially establishing a new habit of recording maintenance cases every day.

events.name: Evening electrical technology study
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang leaned back in the study chair, opened his computer, and browsed technical posts on the “Electrical Technology” forum and basic materials in his WeChat favorites groups, focusing on reading circuit diagrams and fault analysis cases. Despite the discomfort in his waist, he still completed 30 minutes of study.

start_state.mood: As usual, preparing to start work after the holiday.

end_state.mood: A bit frustrated by the back pain, but slightly fulfilled by starting the logging habit.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-01.daily_overview: During the day he insisted on working with an injury, clearly moving more slowly. After work, the whole family went to his parents' home for dinner. His father noticed his waist discomfort and promised to teach him rehabilitation exercises via video. On the way home, he silently resolved to obtain the senior technician certificate, and continued his evening studies without stopping.

events.name: Friday family dinner
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang took his wife Wang Lijuan and their two sons Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, and drove to his parents' home in Meilan District. His mother Chen Xiuying had already prepared his favorite Hainanese chicken rice and a few signature home-style dishes. During the meal, his father Lu Jianguo noticed that his walking posture was a little stiff and asked with concern. When he found out it was a sprain, he reminded him that in their line of work the lower back is the key asset, and said that when he got home that evening he would video-call to teach him a few rehabilitation exercises, since that was how he had recovered from his own back injury. Lu Mingqiang felt a warmth in his heart and agreed immediately. After the meal, he silently resolved to obtain the senior electrical technician certificate and truly make his father proud.

events.name: Evening electrical technology study
events.description: After returning from his parents' home and settling the children, Lu Mingqiang still went into his study and insisted on spending 30 minutes browsing technical posts on the Electrical Technology forum and materials from his WeChat favorites group, focusing on learning circuit diagram reading and fault analysis cases to keep his learning uninterrupted.

start_state.mood: Feeling a little under the weather, but looking forward to the dinner gathering tonight.

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilled, strengthened my resolve to get the certificate, and look forward to my father's rehabilitation guidance.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-01.daily_overview: On the weekend day off, his wife dragged him to a parent-child communication lecture. The couple was deeply inspired and agreed to change their parenting methods. In the evening, his father, as promised, gave video-guided instructions for his lower back injury rehabilitation. Lu Mingqiang practiced the superman and glute bridge exercises for the first time, laying the foundation for subsequent recovery.

events.name: Attend a parent-child communication lecture.
events.description: In the morning, his wife Wang Lijuan dragged Lu Mingqiang to a public lecture organized by the community called How to Communicate with Adolescent Children. During the lecture, when the expert mentioned the importance of listening to what children have in their hearts, Lu Mingqiang reflected that he had indeed been too impatient when tutoring Xuanxuan. After the lecture, his wife took out a notebook, and the two of them wrote down together the phrase: listen to the child first. They also agreed to remind each other of this and stay patient when educating the children in the future.

events.name: Try a new way of communicating
events.description: After getting home, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to talk to his eldest son Lu Zixuan about the day's homework. He tried not to criticize first, but instead listened while the child explained his difficulties. Xuanxuan was a bit surprised and was willing to say a bit more. The communication was noticeably better than usual, and Lu Mingqiang felt gratified.

events.name: Evening electrical technology study
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang, as usual, browsed the "Electrical Technology" forum and materials from his WeChat Favorites and groups in his study, continuing to learn how to read circuit diagrams and study fault analysis cases. His mood for studying tonight was calmer than usual.

events.name: Father gives video guidance on back injury recovery
events.description: At about nine in the evening, his father Lu Jianguo contacted Lu Mingqiang on WeChat video as arranged. He first asked how his lower back had felt during the day, then pointed out that an electrician who carries heavy loads over a long career must strengthen his lower back. He then personally demonstrated two exercises on video: the superman exercise and the glute bridge, and repeatedly emphasized the key techniques.

events.name: First rehabilitation training session
events.description: After hanging up the video call, Lu Mingqiang spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and, following his father's guidance, seriously did a set of superman exercises and glute bridges. Although his form was not quite standard and his lower back was clearly sore, he remembered the key points and resolved to persist morning and night from tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Still some discomfort in the lower back; mood is average.

end_state.mood: Gained a new understanding of educational methods and developed confidence in rehabilitation training.

state.daily_exercise: First session: 1 set of superman and glute bridge exercises.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang rested at home, and from today he officially began morning and evening rehabilitation training. In the afternoon he organized his beloved liquor bottle collection and chatted with friends in the group. However, during evening study, the home broadband kept dropping frequently, seriously affecting his online study and exam preparation plan, making him restless and annoyed.

events.name: Morning and evening rehabilitation training begins.
events.description: After getting up in the morning and before going to bed at night, Lu Mingqiang did one set each of superman exercises and glute bridges, 15 reps per set. At first, his lower back muscles were noticeably sore, but he gritted his teeth and finished, treating this as the first day of his lower back rehabilitation training.

events.name: Organizing the wine bottle collection
events.description: In the afternoon, his wife took the children to the supermarket for shopping. Since Lu Mingqiang was not convenient to go out, he stayed alone to organize the baijiu bottle collection on the bookshelf. He wiped a few of his favorite old Hainan local liquor bottles, took several photos of a newly acquired sauce-colored flat bottle, and sent them to the collection WeChat group. Group members gave him likes one after another, and someone shared a similar collectible. He felt quite delighted.

events.name: Broadband failure affected studying.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang went into the study as usual to do his online learning, but found the broadband kept disconnecting. Opening a page on the Electrical Engineering Technology forum took forever to load, and even the course video wouldn't load at all, seriously slowing down his study progress. After repeated refreshes with no success, he paced around the room in frustration.

events.name: Intermittent evening study
events.description: Despite the unstable internet, Lu Mingqiang still tried to use the brief few minutes when the connection came back to browse a few posts on a technology forum, but the entire evening study plan was completely disrupted, which made him realize how serious the home network problem was.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired due to lower back pain.

end_state.mood: Frustrated by network issues; collecting and chatting brought brief joy, but the study plan was thwarted.

state.daily_exercise: Superman exercises and glute bridges, 15 reps each in the morning and evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: At the start of the new week, the lower back discomfort persisted, and he deliberately reduced heavy work. After work, he tried to fix the broadband himself but failed, and evening study was still affected. Today also launched the 21-day parent-child reading check-in for the younger son's kindergarten. Reading picture books to the younger son before bed became a new fixed routine. Director Wang from property management asked in passing if he could help check the community's electrical circuits over the weekend.

events.name: Protect your lower back during work.
events.description: During work, Lu Mingqiang proactively explained his lower back condition to the shift leader. The shift leader assigned him lighter tasks that required more technical skill, such as wiring inspections and preliminary fault diagnosis, while the heavy lifting was temporarily shared by Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang. He had a medicated patch on his lower back all along and walked a little slower.

events.name: Tried to repair the broadband myself.
events.description: After getting home from work, the first thing Lu Mingqiang did was restart the router and optical modem, checked whether all Ethernet cable ports were loose, and even logged into the router's admin panel to adjust channel settings, but the disconnection problem remained. After dinner he tried again, with no improvement. His wife complained nearby that the TV was too laggy to watch, and he became even more anxious.

events.name: Kept studying in the evening
events.description: Although the broadband was still unreliable, Lu Mingqiang managed to connect his computer to his phone's mobile hotspot and browsed some posts on the "Electrical Technology" forum and basic materials in a WeChat favorites group, studying circuit diagram reading and fault analysis cases. He still kept it to 30 minutes.

events.name: Continue rehabilitation training
events.description: Complete one set of superman exercises and glute bridges in the morning and evening, 15 reps per set. During the training, the lower back muscles felt slightly sore, but compared with a few days ago, they have adapted a bit.

events.name: Started the parent-child reading check-in
events.description: In the evening, his wife reminded him that the kindergarten their second son Lu Zihan attends had launched a '21-day parent-child reading check-in' activity. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to take on the task of reading picture books to his younger son every night. He pulled a copy of Baby Bear from the bookshelf, held Zihan on the sofa, and read it slowly. After finishing, he took a photo and uploaded it to the class group to complete the check-in.

events.name: Entrusted by the property manager along the way
events.description: After work, at the community gate, Lu Mingqiang ran into Wang Jianguo, the property management director. Director Wang said that the public lighting in several buildings had unstable voltage and asked Lu Mingqiang to check the wiring when he had time over the weekend. Although his back injury had not healed, Lu Mingqiang agreed to take a look first, tentatively set for Saturday morning.

start_state.mood: Lower back still hurts, slightly uneasy about the new week's tasks.

end_state.mood: Troubled by the broadband problem, but felt warmth from parent-child reading; accepting the property management's request added a sense of responsibility.

state.daily_exercise: Superman exercises and glute bridges, 15 reps each in the morning and evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: Rainy day, the fifth day of the lower back injury, training intensity gradually increasing. Worked normally during the day, and during lunch break sent a WeChat greeting to a childhood friend. In the evening continued searching for a broadband solution without success; studying still went on intermittently. The parent-child reading check-in continued, and the younger son began to look forward to this part.

events.name: Daily maintenance work
events.description: Lu Mingqiang spent the whole day inspecting electricity meters and handling simple faults in several residential communities under the company’s responsibility. Because of the drizzling rain and slippery roads, he was extra careful, and when moving tools he tried to use his legs rather than his lower back.

events.name: Remote care from a childhood friend
events.description: During the lunch break, his childhood friend Wang Hai called via WeChat video. During the chat, he learned that Lu Mingqiang had strained his lower back. Wang Hai immediately said he would send a box of Guangdong specialty medicated oil and plasters. Lu Mingqiang could not refuse and had to thank him. The two chatted a while longer about their children and work, and agreed to meet up when Wang Hai returns to Haikou during the Spring Festival.

events.name: In-depth troubleshooting of broadband faults
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang systematically searched technical forums and Baidu for solutions to "frequent broadband disconnections". Following the tutorials, he tried updating the computer's network card driver, modifying the router's MTU value, and other operations one by one, but the problem remained and the disconnections still occurred at random. This made him realize it might be a line or hardware problem.

events.name: Studied technical materials intermittently.
events.description: The network was unstable, so Lu Mingqiang could only open a few basic electrical PDFs he had downloaded to his computer earlier and continue studying circuit diagram reading and fault analysis. He barely managed to keep going for 30 minutes.

events.name: Strengthen rehabilitation training
events.description: He did one set of superman exercises and glute bridges in the morning and one set in the evening, increasing each set to 20 repetitions. His lower back began to get used to the contraction; it was still sore and swollen, but no longer as sharp as at first.

events.name: Parent-child reading: read The Very Hungry Caterpillar to my second son
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang picked up the picture book The Very Hungry Caterpillar and read it aloud word by word to his second son Lu Zihan. The little boy listened intently and even imitated the sound of the caterpillar eating. After reading, they took a photo together to check in. Zihan happily hugged his father and said, “I want you to read it again tomorrow.”

start_state.mood: Feeling a bit dreary due to the light rain.

end_state.mood: Anxious over the persistent broadband issue, but parent-child reading and a childhood friend's care brought comfort.

state.daily_exercise: Superman exercises and glute bridges, 20 reps each, morning and evening

2025-01.daily_overview: In the morning, he rushed out with his co-worker Chen Jianguo to repair the community's distribution box. The two worked well together and restored power to the whole building within two hours, earning praise from property management and leadership. In the evening, his studies turned to relay protection theory, and he scheduled a broadband repair. The pain in his lower back had significantly eased.

events.name: Emergency power distribution repair task
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang received a call from the team leader saying that the entire building in a residential community on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, had lost power due to a tripped breaker. He immediately prepared a multimeter, screwdriver, insulating tape, and spare switches with Chen Jianguo in the tool room, then drove the service vehicle from Xiuying District to the site. After arriving, the two opened the distribution box and, using the multimeter to test section by section, precisely located the short-circuit point caused by aging wiring within half an hour. They then replaced the damaged wires together, carried out careful insulation treatment, and performed insulation tests and load tests on the repaired lines. After confirming that all indicators were safe, they closed the switch and restored power; the entire building had power back in less than two hours after the outage. The property manager gave a thumbs up on the spot, and Manager Liu mentioned them by name in the team's WeChat group, praising their quick response. This successful emergency repair made Lu Mingqiang once again feel the value of his own hands.

events.name: Schedule a broadband repair appointment.
events.description: After getting home from work, Lu Mingqiang called the operator's customer service and described in detail how his home broadband had been frequently disconnecting over the past week and the troubleshooting process he had already done. The customer service representative determined that it might be a line or optical modem issue and scheduled a repair technician to visit the next day.

events.name: Study the fundamentals of relay protection
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang opened his exam prep textbook in the study and began learning the basic concepts of relay protection and the principle of differential protection, jotting down key points in his notebook as he read.

events.name: Rehabilitation training continues.
events.description: He completed 20 reps each of the Superman exercise and glute bridges on time in the morning and evening. Today, the pain in his lower back during the movements was noticeably lighter than in previous days, and his range of motion improved. He was quietly glad he had stuck with it.

events.name: Parent-child reading: reading My Dad to my second son
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang sat on the bed holding his younger son and opened the picture book My Dad. When he read “My dad isn't afraid of anything,” Zihan suddenly pointed at him and said “Daddy!”, making Lu Mingqiang laugh heartily. After taking a photo to record the moment, the little one fell asleep contentedly.

start_state.mood: His lower back felt more relaxed, and he felt confident about the job.

end_state.mood: Filled with professional pride at the successful emergency repair, and rekindled hope for broadband maintenance.

state.daily_exercise: Superman exercises and glute bridges, 20 reps each, morning and evening

2025-01.daily_overview: The broadband repair technician came to the door, found that the fiber optic connector had aged, and replaced it. The disconnection problem that had troubled him for nearly ten days was completely solved. Lu Mingqiang excitedly shared the news in the collectors' group and on the forum. His evening study efficiency increased significantly, and he studied distance protection and zero-sequence current protection in depth. His rehabilitation training movements became more standard.

events.name: Routine installation work.
events.description: Today's work arrangement is to install an electric meter and distribution lines for a new shop in Xiuying District. Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang were partners; as he worked, he explained wiring specifications to his apprentice, and his body movements were no longer a problem.

events.name: Broadband fully repaired.
events.description: In the evening, the carrier's maintenance technician arrived as promised. After instrument testing, he found that the connector of the incoming fiber optic cable had aged, causing significant signal attenuation and frequent disconnections. The technician quickly replaced the connector and re-spliced the fiber, then ran a network stability test and left after confirming full signal strength. Lu Mingqiang immediately connected to Wi-Fi and opened the forum; the page loaded in a flash, and he finally breathed a sigh of relief. He immediately sent a message saying “The network is back!” in the family group and the collection group, along with a comparison of the earlier annoyed emoji stickers, which drew a wave of likes.

events.name: Learn advanced relay protection efficiently
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang continued studying relay protection theory in the study, where the internet connection was stable. He focused on mastering the principles of distance protection and zero-sequence current protection, repeatedly working through the examples in the textbook to understand them. His learning efficiency was more than double that of the previous days, and he took detailed notes.

events.name: Rehabilitation training is gradually getting better.
events.description: Do one set each of superman exercises and glute bridges in the morning and evening, 20 reps each. Now he can perform the movements with fairly standard form, and his lumbar mobility has improved significantly. He barely feels any pulling pain when bending forward or sideways.

events.name: Parent-child reading: reading "No, David!" to his younger son.
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang read "No, David!" for Zihan. The little guy listened and shouted along, "No, David!" The father and son burst into laughter. After finishing the check-in, Lu Mingqiang felt that these few minutes of companionship every day were especially precious.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the broadband being fixed; in good spirits.

end_state.mood: Smooth network, efficient learning, and a much better mood

state.daily_exercise: Superman exercises and glute bridges, 20 reps each, morning and evening

2025-01.daily_overview: Friday evening, as usual, the family had dinner together. His mother specially stewed pork bone soup to nourish his lower back. His father again emphasized the importance of the senior technician certificate and promised to help find a question bank. In the evening, he studied relay protection setting calculation and tried solving calculation problems. The rehabilitation training reached a phased conclusion, and he decided to turn it into a daily habit.

events.name: The whole family visits the parents again
events.description: After work, the family of four went to his parents' home again. His mother Chen Xiuying brought out a large pot of winter melon and pork bone soup and said, “Mingqiang, you hurt your back, so you should drink more soup to supplement calcium.” She also made his favorite Hainanese chicken rice and garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves. At the dinner table, his father Lu Jianguo spoke earnestly again: “You need to hurry up with your senior technician certificate. I found out that Old Li's son passed the exam last year. I have the question bank; I'll send it to you tomorrow, while you are still young and have a good memory.” Lu Mingqiang nodded seriously, and his determination to get the certificate grew even stronger. He planned to start systematically reviewing the theory from next week.

events.name: Study relay protection setting calculation
events.description: After returning from his parents' home, once the children had gone to bed, Lu Mingqiang sat in the study and opened his textbook to learn the basic methods of relay protection setting calculation, and tried to complete the two calculation problems after the lesson. Although it was a bit difficult at first because he was just getting started, he derived step by step and got the correct answers, which gave him a strong sense of achievement.

events.name: Rehabilitation training phase summary
events.description: Lu Mingqiang completed the day's two sets of morning and evening superman and glute bridge exercises (20 reps each), which meant he had persisted for six days. He clearly felt that the lower back pain had basically disappeared, and he no longer needed to be overly careful when bending over to lift light objects. He wrote in his notebook, “Stage one of rehabilitation complete, can gradually add stretching,” and decided to incorporate these two exercises into his future daily routine to prevent recurrence of the back injury.

events.name: Parent-child reading: read Guess How Much I Love You to my second son
events.description: In the evening, as usual, he read a picture book to Zihan. Today's choice was “Guess How Much I Love You.” When he read the part where the little rabbit stretches its arms wide and says, “I love you this much,” Zihan also spread his little arms. Lu Mingqiang's eyes grew slightly warm, and he hugged his son tightly.

start_state.mood: His body has almost recovered, and he is in good spirits.

end_state.mood: More determined to achieve the certification goal, happy with the rehabilitation training results, and motivated by family warmth.

state.daily_exercise: Superman exercises and glute bridges, 20 reps each, morning and evening

2025-01.daily_overview: Saturday was a day off. In the morning, he helped the property management office inspect the public circuits, found a loose connection, and fixed it, with Director Wang thanking him repeatedly. In the afternoon, he repaired an old kite at home, but stopped because bending over made him uncomfortable. After dinner, he focused on logging into the electrician technology forum, posted a question about relay protection, and helped other netizens. Before bed, there was trading activity in the liquor bottle collection group, and he successfully reserved a Hainan liquor bottle he had long desired. The parent-child reading check-in went on as usual.

events.name: Volunteered to help the property management inspect and repair wiring.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived at the community property management office as scheduled, and Director Wang Jianguo took him to inspect several lighting distribution boxes in public areas. After measuring with a multimeter, he quickly found a loose terminal connection in the corridor of Building 7, causing voltage fluctuations. He tightened the screw, re-crimped the connection, and also checked the remaining spots, finishing in less than an hour. Director Wang was very grateful and insisted on pressing a pack of cigarettes into his hand. Lu Mingqiang declined but had no choice but to accept.

events.name: Tried to repair the kite
events.description: After his afternoon nap, Lu Mingqiang dug last year's traditional butterfly kite out of the storage cabinet and found that several bamboo strips were broken. He found some bamboo strips and a utility knife to fix it, but after bending over to whittle the bamboo for a few minutes, his lower back became sore and achy, so he put down the tools and decided to wait until he fully recovered. He took a photo of the damaged kite and posted it in the kite group to ask for repair tips. His sports buddy Chen Jie and several group members offered helpful advice.

events.name: Forum technical exchange and collection gains
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang logged into an electrical technology forum, organized several questions he had encountered while studying relay protection principles into a post, and actively replied to a few questions in the beginner section about household electrical circuit faults. While interacting, he switched to a baijiu bottle collecting forum and saw a local collector, 'Haikou Lao Chen,' list a Haikou Daqu bottle from the 1990s that he had long been seeking. He immediately commented to negotiate the price and successfully reserved it, agreeing to meet in person next weekend for the trade. This greatly cheered him up.

events.name: Parent-child reading: read The Crocodile and the Dentist to the second son.
events.description: For the bedtime parent-child reading session, Lu Mingqiang picked "The Crocodile Is Afraid, the Dentist Is Afraid" and imitated the inner monologues of the crocodile and the dentist in an exaggerated tone. Zihan giggled and followed along repeating "afraid, afraid." The check-in was completed successfully.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, enjoying the slow pace of the weekend

end_state.mood: Fulfilled by helping others and the rewards of collecting, looking forward to resuming running tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: None (voluntary rest)

2025-01.daily_overview: Early in the morning, he went for his first 5-kilometer jog since the back injury and exchanged stretching tips with running buddies. In the afternoon, he had dad tea with his workmate Chen Jianguo and shared study tips for the exam, forming a study alliance. In the evening, he took the whole family to his parents' home for dinner and shared the joy of his running recovery. At night, he began systematically reviewing advanced electrician theory. He kept up the parent-child reading check-in.

events.name: First morning run after a back injury.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang felt that his waist had fully recovered and, as agreed, met his running partner Chen Bin at the entrance of Baishamen Park. Chen Bin first led him through a full set of pre-run dynamic stretches, with movements especially targeting the waist and abdomen. Then the two jogged 5 kilometers along the park trail, keeping the pace at about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. Along the way, Lu Mingqiang exchanged stretching techniques with Chen Bin while running. After the run, he felt refreshed all over and felt that he was officially back in form.

events.name: Drank tea with workmates and formed an exam preparation alliance.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo met at their usual Laobaicha shop in Longhua District. They each ordered a pot of black tea and a few snacks. Lu Mingqiang took out his recent exam prep materials, and Chen Jianguo generously shared the review techniques and key points he had used when preparing for the electrician certificate exam. Lu Mingqiang carefully wrote them down in his notebook. The two encouraged each other to keep studying for the exam while taking care of their families, and they chatted for over two hours before they knew it, forming an informal exam-prep alliance.

events.name: Routine Sunday visit to parents
events.description: After leaving the tea shop, Lu Mingqiang went straight home to pick up his wife and children, and the family drove to his parents' house. His mother, Chen Xiuying, had prepared a table of dishes. Seeing his brisk steps, his father, Lu Jianguo, said happily, "Looks like you can take up running again, but don't rush to increase the volume!" Lu Mingqiang smiled and agreed. During the meal, he told his father about the morning run and the afternoon alliance. His father nodded approvingly and immediately sent him a question bank for the senior electrician exam via WeChat. The family spent a warm evening with laughter and joy.

events.name: Evening electrical theory review.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat in the study, used the question bank his father had just sent to systematically review the advanced electrician theory knowledge points, and focused on outlining electrical safety codes and common fault analysis to lay a foundation for the practical questions ahead.

events.name: Parent-child reading: read "Swimmy" to the second son.
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang told Zihan the story of 'The Little Black Fish.' When he said the little black fish organized all the small fish into a big fish, the little one stared wide-eyed and said 'Awesome!' They took a photo together as a check-in, and they had kept up the 21-day plan for a week.

start_state.mood: Body recovering, looking forward to exercise

end_state.mood: Satisfied. I have a companion for exam preparation, exercise is back on track, and family dinners are as warm as always.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-01.daily_overview: A new week. During work breaks during the day, I started taking the online safety production course required by the company. After work, the family tasted desserts from the newly opened Qingbuliang shop, enjoying a warm and happy time. In the evening, I reviewed senior electrician practical exam points and continued parent-child reading. The pace of work and study was intense.

events.name: Studied a workplace safety course during a break at work.
events.description: Today the company notified all frontline employees that they must complete the online safety training by January 19. Lu Mingqiang used his lunch break and afternoon work breaks to log into the learning platform on his phone and watch the first batch of instructional videos, which covered safety regulations for working at heights. He took notes while watching and started a week-long daily check-in study plan.

events.name: Came across a new shop and tried qingbuliang.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode past Haisheng Road and noticed a newly opened "Ajie Qingbuliang" shop. Remembering that his wife loved it, he stopped and bought four servings. After dinner, the whole family sat together to share. The coconut water was sweet and the toppings were plentiful; the children cheered with joy, and his wife Wang Lijuan praised him for being thoughtful. This small family ritual added a lot of brightness to an otherwise plain Monday.

events.name: Review hands-on exam points in the evening
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the practical operation part of the senior electrician exam, focusing on sorting out the debugging methods and standard wiring procedures for common electrical equipment, and mentally simulated the diagrams in the textbook.

events.name: Parent-child reading: read 'Grandpa Always Has a Way' to the second son.
events.description: In the evening, holding Zihan, he read Something from Nothing. Seeing in the story how the grandfather turned an old blanket into something new again and again, Lu Mingqiang was reminded that his own father was also skillful with his hands, and he read with deep emotion. Zihan listened quietly and then imitated, saying 'Grandpa has a way.'

start_state.mood: Energy restored, ready to devote to work and study

end_state.mood: Although a bit tired, the study tasks progressed as planned, and home-cooked food brought little moments of happiness.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-01.daily_overview: During the day he continued studying the work safety course in spare moments, and in the evening he did a set of senior electrician mock exam questions. The less-than-ideal score made him somewhat discouraged; his wife warmly comforted him and helped him review the key points by quizzing him. He also prepared information for broadband renewal and upgrade. The parent-child reading check-in never stopped.

events.name: Continue the workplace safety course study.
events.description: Using fragmented time during the lunch break and before leaving work, Lu Mingqiang completed the second chapter of the online work safety course on his phone. The chapter covered temporary electricity safety at construction sites. Although some of the provisions were dull, he persisted and finished the chapter quiz.

events.name: Setback on the advanced electrician mock self-test and joint learning as a couple
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang found a set of senior electrician mock exam questions and answered them carefully within the time limit. After checking the answers, he saw that his mistakes were mainly in relay protection setting calculations and high-voltage safety regulations, with only 60 percent correct. His heart suddenly sank. His wife Wang Lijuan noticed his expression, made a cup of tea, brought it into the study, and after asking softly, took the initiative to say, "You read the questions and quiz me; maybe two people can memorize faster." So one read the questions and the other repeated the answers. Whenever Lu Mingqiang got stuck, his wife used everyday metaphors to help him understand, until late at night. Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved and regained his confidence.

events.name: Learn about broadband renewal plans
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang opened the China Telecom app, checked the expiration date of his current broadband plan and renewal promotions, and compared different speeds and plans that included a gigabit router. Feeling confident, he planned to go to the business hall after work tomorrow to handle it.

events.name: Parent-child reading: read A Garden of Vegetables Turned into Spirits to the younger son.
events.description: In the evening, he picked a lively book for Zihan, One Garden of Vegetables Turned into Spirits. Lu Mingqiang read it in the rhythm of kuaiban, and Zihan bounced about excitedly on the bed. The reading check-in was completed amid the happy commotion, while their mother laughed and took photos from the side.

start_state.mood: Calm, proceed as planned.

end_state.mood: He was down about the mock exam results, but his wife's support reignited his determination, and discovering weak points is also progress.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-01.daily_overview: During the day, he found time to finish the last part of the safety production course. After work, he went to the service hall to renew the broadband contract and upgrade to a gigabit router, giving the home network a fresh new feel. In the evening, he focused on reviewing high-voltage electrician safety techniques and resumed squash practice with a one-hour adaptive training session with his squash partner Lin Feng. Parent-child reading has become an unshakable family ritual. Rehabilitation training is done morning and evening without fail.

events.name: Work safety course concluded.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang used his lunch break and the short time after work to grit his teeth and finish the third part of the online safety production course, which covered electrical fire prevention and first aid. Although he was already drowsy after a day's work, he insisted on watching all the videos and submitting the test, finally completing all his study tasks today.

events.name: Handle broadband renewal and router replacement
events.description: After getting off work in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang went directly to the China Telecom business hall and submitted a one-year broadband renewal application. On the recommendation of the staff, he paid an additional 50 yuan to replace the old optical modem-router combo with a brand-new gigabit dual-band model. The monthly plan fee increased slightly by 10 yuan, but the internet speed improved noticeably. After returning home, he connected the new router himself according to the instructions, set up the 2.4G and 5G dual-band Wi-Fi, and all devices connected and loaded instantly. The home network environment was completely refreshed.

events.name: Evening focused review of safety technical specifications
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat in the study with very fast internet, opened the electronic document Safety Technical Specifications for High-Voltage Electrician Work, focused on reinforcing the chapters on insulation protection, power testing procedures, and safety distances, and drew simple flowcharts in his notebook as he read to deepen his memory.

events.name: Squash recovery practice
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived as promised at the squash court of Haikou Dynamic Fitness Club to meet his playing partner Lin Feng. Considering that his waist had just recovered, the two agreed to focus on light practice. Lin Feng deliberately reduced the speed and power of his shots, while Lu Mingqiang focused on ball control and footwork, avoiding sudden stops and turns. In one hour, they played three slow-paced rallies with technical exchanges in between. After practice, he felt slight soreness in his lower back, but overall it felt good. Lin Feng said his "form was back to about seventy percent."

events.name: Morning and evening rehabilitation exercises for the waist and back
events.description: After getting up in the morning and before going to bed at night, Lu Mingqiang did a set of lower back rehabilitation exercises each time, including 15 reps each of the superman exercise and glute bridges, and added 3 reps each of the cat-cow stretch and standing side stretch, fully engaging the lower back muscles. After nearly two weeks of persistence, he felt that his core stability had improved significantly.

events.name: Parent-child reading: reading Happy Birthday, Moon to the second son.
events.description: Before bed, he read Happy Birthday, Moon to Zihan. When the little bear called out to the moon, Zihan also imitated it by lowering his voice. Lu Mingqiang smiled and played with him for a while. After checking in, he looked at the check-in calendar and saw he had kept it up for 10 days, and a small sense of achievement welled up inside him.

start_state.mood: Determined to get the broadband and the course sorted out; the fighting spirit remains.

end_state.mood: After the network upgrade, I feel refreshed in body and mind. Study and exam preparation are progressing steadily. Resuming squash practice feels good, and the family atmosphere is warm.

state.daily_exercise: Waist and back rehabilitation training, one set in the morning and one in the evening (superman exercises, glute bridges, stretching), and 1 hour of squash practice.

2025-01.daily_overview: Thursday, a workday, with fine weather. During the day, he installed distribution cabinets at the company in Xiuying District and silently memorized transformer installation torque during the lunch break. The gigabit broadband upgraded at home last week gave the whole family a smooth internet experience. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang completed Chapter 4 of the online safety production course and spent a fixed 30 minutes studying online. He kept up the waist and back rehabilitation training after getting up and before bed, and his waist felt relaxed.

events.name: Morning commute and morning rehabilitation.
events.description: Got up at 6:20, first did 15 minutes of lower back stretches, superman exercise, and glute bridge, then ate Hainan rice noodles prepared by my wife at the dining table, and rode an e-bike along Binhai Avenue to the company at No. 28 Haisheng Road, Xiuying District, a 10-minute commute.

events.name: Daily installation work and lunch break review.
events.description: In the morning, I followed the work crew to install a new power distribution cabinet in Binhai Xincun Residential Community. I strictly tightened the busbars according to specifications. During the lunch break, I reviewed the textbook screenshots on my phone in the tool room and silently memorized the key torque values for transformer installation.

events.name: Home network experience upgrade
events.description: After returning home from work, his mother Chen Xiuying brought freshly cooked Hainanese chicken rice. After dinner, his wife Wang Lijuan turned on the TV and smoothly watched a parenting course on the newly upgraded gigabit network. His eldest son Lu Zixuan used a tablet for an online coding introduction, while his second son Lu Zihan snuggled against his mother watching picture-book animation. The whole family experienced lag-free internet for the first time.

events.name: Work safety course study
events.description: In the evening, in his study, he logged into the company-designated safety production training platform on his desktop computer and studied Chapter 4, the Electrical Work Ticket System. Combining it with his own experience of filling out tickets, he understood the provisions and felt that his memory of the regulations had become more systematic.

events.name: Fixed 30 minutes of internet use.
events.description: After finishing the course, I habitually opened the electrical technology forum, browsed today's hot posts, found a discussion about TN-S system grounding protection, replied with a few sentences based on my practical experience, and got two likes.

events.name: Bedtime preparation and evening rehabilitation
events.description: Check the remaining test pen and insulating tape in the tool kit, charge the electric bike, then do 15 minutes of evening lower back rehabilitation exercises, and go to bed at 22:45.

start_state.location: Home at No. 15, Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou
start_state.mood: Calm and clear-headed

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation training (superman exercise, glute bridges, stretching) morning/evening

2025-01.daily_overview: Friday, cloudy, 16-22°C, light breeze. During the day, completed an emergency repair of a tripped circuit at a shop and attended the team's short safety meeting before Spring Festival. After work, helped neighbor Uncle Wang fix a kitchen outlet, earned his gratitude, and discussed the exterior wall painting of the community. In the evening, it was the weekly family dinner at his parents' home. His father shared the experience of getting his electrician's certificate back then, which deeply moved Lu Mingqiang. After returning home, he gritted his teeth and studied the difficult Chapter 5, and persisted with 30 minutes of online study. Rehabilitation training went on as usual.

events.name: Emergency repair and team meeting
events.description: In the morning, a sweet soup shop on Guomao Road reported a circuit breaker trip, and Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang arrived. They found that an oxidized wire connection had caused a short circuit and restored power in half an hour. In the afternoon, Team Leader Zhang called the team together for a short meeting, emphasizing that before the Spring Festival, all work must have two-person verification and power-off tagging. After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang called retired Master Li to consult about a wiring problem in an old indoor distribution box, and Master Li patiently answered.

events.name: Help neighbor fix the power outlet
events.description: Just after getting off work, as he entered the residential corridor, the neighbor Uncle Wang came up and said that the kitchen socket sparked whenever he plugged in an appliance. Lu Mingqiang went home, put down his tool bag, took out his tools, went to Uncle Wang's home, and opened the socket panel. He found that oxidation of the aluminum wire had caused poor contact, so he stripped the wire and tightened it again. After restoring power, he also tested the ground connection.

events.name: Drinking tea and chatting with Uncle Wang.
events.description: After the repair, Uncle Wang insisted on keeping him for a cup of kuding tea. The two chatted about the recent exterior wall painting in the neighborhood and their children's final exam results. After about half an hour, Lu Mingqiang took his leave and went home.

events.name: Family dinner at parents' home
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lu Mingqiang took his wife and two sons to his parents' home in Meilan District. His mother made steamed fish and roast goose. During the meal, his father Lu Jianguo talked about how, when he took the electrician certificate exam in the 1980s, he had relied entirely on handwritten notes, and encouraged him to get more certificates while he was young. Lu Mingqiang was deeply moved. After dinner, he discussed with his wife that they must buy textbooks and study systematically.

events.name: Struggled to study Chapter 5.
events.description: He returned to his Longhua home at nearly 9 o'clock, went into the study, and continued learning Chapter 5 of the work safety course. The content involved ground fault calculations for high-voltage systems. Because his math foundation was weak, it was very hard to understand, and he broke into a sweat on his forehead, but he forced himself to read it twice and scribbled the formulas several times in his notebook.

events.name: Regular internet browsing and reflection
events.description: After studying, he opened a forum to relax. Seeing others showing off their senior technician certificates, he sighed to himself that he wished he had studied more back then, but he still continued browsing technical posts for 30 minutes. Before going to bed, he completed the evening lower back rehabilitation training.

start_state.mood: Feeling okay.

end_state.mood: Tired but inspired

state.daily_exercise: Morning/evening lower back rehabilitation training

2025-01.daily_overview: Saturday was a rest day with bright sunshine. In the early morning, Chen Bin invited him for a run at Baishamen Park. Lu Mingqiang completed a 5 km slow jog, and his waist no longer felt obviously uncomfortable. In the morning, he inspected the storage shelf at home and checked the traditional kites. In the afternoon, he met up with his kite-flying friend Chen Jie and took his second son to Wanlv Garden to fly kites, enjoying father-child time and exchanging kite-flying tips. In the evening, he studied Chapter 6 of the safety course, and for the first time searched online for senior technician textbooks, decisively placing an order. He kept up his rehabilitation exercises morning and evening.

events.name: Morning jog at Baishamen Park.
events.description: He got up at 6:50, did dynamic stretching, then drove to Baishamen Park and met up with his running buddy Chen Bin. The two jogged 5 kilometers along the seaside trail at a pace of about 6:20 per kilometer. After the run, they exchanged tips on recovering from a lower back injury, and Chen Bin suggested he add core training.

events.name: Morning chores and kite preparation
events.description: After returning home, I took a shower and had breakfast. First I fixed the loose handle on the kitchen faucet, then I unfolded three traditional kites on the balcony, chose the rainbow-colored one, checked that the kite line reel moved smoothly, and put coconut water and bread into the picnic bag.

events.name: Took his second son to fly kites at Wanlv Garden (with Chen Jie)
events.description: A little after 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove Lu Zihan to Wanlv Park. Chen Jie was already waiting on the lawn and had brought a newly made centipede kite. While flying kites, the two exchanged tips on handling bamboo strips, and Chen Jie demonstrated a newly learned method for balancing the kite tail. Lu Mingqiang taught Hanhan hands-on how to let out and reel in the line. The little guy was so excited that he shouted, "Daddy, it's flying so high!"

events.name: Parent-child time on the lawn
events.description: When the kite was drifting steadily in the sky, everyone rested on the mat together and drank coconut water. Hanhan pointed at the kite in the sky and said it looked like a rainbow. Lu Mingqiang teased him, saying they could draw one for Mom when they got home, and Hanhan nodded vigorously.

events.name: Packed up and went home in the evening.
events.description: At nearly 5:00, the wind died down. Lu Mingqiang slowly reeled in the line, folded up the kite with Hanhan, packed up the mat and empty coconut shells, said goodbye to Chen Jie, and drove home. On the way, Hanhan fell asleep in her child safety seat.

events.name: Study Chapter 6 of the safety course and order the textbook
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang studied Chapter 6 of the work safety training, Emergency Rescue and Electric Shock First Aid. The content was practical, so he grasped it quickly. Then he spent the usual 30 minutes online and saw a post on an electrician forum recommending the Advanced Electrician Theory Tutorial. After checking the table of contents and finding it suitable, he immediately placed an order on an e-commerce platform. Before bed, he did his evening lower back rehabilitation exercises.

events.name: Recorded parent-child reflections before bed
events.description: Before going to sleep, he briefly wrote in his phone memo: Today I took Hanhan alone to fly a kite. He was clingier than usual, so I should spend more one-on-one time with the younger one in the future.

start_state.mood: Relaxed

end_state.mood: Warm and pleasant

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, waist and back rehabilitation training morning/evening, kite flying (light activity)

2025-01.daily_overview: Sunday, cloudy with a light breeze. In the early morning, he went alone to Baishamen Park for a 5-kilometer jog and felt good. In the morning, he sorted through the week's wrong answers from studying at home. In the afternoon, he focused on finishing the final chapter of the safety training and passed the exam, receiving the electronic completion certificate. At noon, he received a call from fellow worker Chen Jianguo and arranged to meet next weekend for tea to discuss exam preparation. In the evening, he opened up to his wife, and became even more determined to take the Senior Technician exam. He completed the rehabilitation training as usual.

events.name: Morning jog at Baishamen Park.
events.description: Woke up at 6:50, drove alone to Baishamen Park, did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching first, then jogged 5 kilometers along the seaside trail at a pace of 6 minutes 25 seconds per kilometer. There was no discomfort in his lower back, and he felt his stamina had basically recovered. After the run, he had a bowl of qingbuliang at a snack shop as breakfast.

events.name: Systematically organized wrong questions.
events.description: After finishing the run, going home and taking a shower, in the study I copied the 20 questions I got wrong in last week's workplace safety course into the mistake notebook, marked the easily confused electric shock first aid steps in red, and wrote out the correct explanations.

events.name: Completed work safety training
events.description: At 2 p.m. I started studying the last chapter (Chapter 7). There wasn't much content, so I finished it in one go and then took the online completion exam. Thanks to my recent solid review, I scored 96 points and smoothly obtained the electronic certificate.

events.name: Having tea with fellow worker Chen Jianguo
events.description: During the lunch break, Chen Jianguo called to ask about Lu Mingqiang's review progress. The two agreed to meet next Saturday (January 25) afternoon at the Laoba Tea Shop on Haixiu Road to talk about preparing for the senior technician exam.

events.name: Evening heart-to-heart chat with his wife.
events.description: At the dinner table, Lu Mingqiang said that he was struggling with the course he was studying and regretted not studying hard when he was young. His wife Wang Lijuan comforted him, saying, "It's not too late to learn now; the children and I both support you," which warmed his heart. The two agreed to start systematic exam preparation as soon as the textbooks arrived next week.

events.name: Regularly go online to share insights
events.description: In the evening, he spent the usual 30 minutes online, posted a short post on an electrician forum sharing his experience of learning safety regulations from scratch, and soon received encouraging replies from a few fellow workers. Before going to bed, he completed his back rehabilitation exercises.

start_state.mood: Sense of purpose

end_state.mood: Determined and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Jog 5 kilometers, lower-back rehabilitation training morning/evening

2025-01.daily_overview: Monday workday, overcast. During the day, replaced a high-voltage switch at the unit; during the lunch break, took a closed-book self-test on operating procedures. In the evening, received a WeChat video call from childhood friend Wang Hai, and the two agreed to have grilled fish at the usual place on the third day of the Lunar New Year. Lu Mingqiang happily posted on WeChat Moments. At night, he used his phone a bit longer out of excitement and went to bed a little later. He formally paid for the textbook order and continued reviewing safety knowledge. Rehabilitation training was the same as usual, but he did extra stretching before bed.

events.name: Replace the high-voltage switch.
events.description: In the morning, the work team came to a pump station near Haikou Port to replace an aging high-voltage load switch. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo partnered to disconnect the wires, polish the copper busbars, and install the new switch, paying attention to proper back mechanics throughout; the job was finished in an hour.

events.name: Practical guidelines for lunch-break self-testing
events.description: During lunch, sitting in the work truck, he tested himself from memory on transformer installation specifications using his own fill-in-the-blank questions, and found that he wasn't accurate about the torque values of the tap changer. He marked them with a red pen in his memo pad.

events.name: Sent a short video to arrange a get-together.
events.description: Just after getting home from work, a WeChat video call request from Wang Hai popped up on his phone. The two chatted about recent news for half an hour. Wang Hai said he would return to Haikou for the Spring Festival, and Lu Mingqiang immediately suggested going to the time-honored grilled fish restaurant on Jiefang West Road on the third day of the Lunar New Year. Wang Hai laughed and said, 'I was waiting for you to say that.'

events.name: Posted on Moments and got likes.
events.description: After hanging up the video call, Lu Mingqiang dug out an old photo of him eating grilled fish with Wang Hai a few years ago, wrote the caption "Old friend, see you on the third day of the New Year," and posted it on Moments. Within less than a minute, Wang Hai liked it, and his fellow worker in the same city, Wu Gang, also commented saying count him in. Excited, he kept browsing old photos for a while, which delayed the start of his evening study.

events.name: Ordered the textbooks.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang opened the shopping cart on the e-commerce platform, confirmed the delivery address for the Advanced Electrician Technician Theory Course, paid 67 yuan via WeChat Pay, and the system showed that it was expected to be delivered on January 22.

events.name: Evening study and internet use
events.description: In the study, I spent 30 minutes reviewing the wrong answers from the safety production completion exam and browsed a long post on an electrician forum about locating power cable faults, saving it for later. Because I was excited earlier, I went to bed later than usual, but I still completed my rehabilitation training before bed.

start_state.mood: As usual

end_state.mood: Full of anticipation

state.daily_exercise: Morning/evening lower back rehabilitation training

2025-01.daily_overview: Tuesday, a light winter drizzle fell. During the day he did maintenance in the indoor power distribution room and encountered a tricky fault; it was only resolved after calling Master Li for advice. The rain stopped just as he got off work. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang tried replacing some rehabilitation exercises with the newly learned core training and did two sets of planks. Then he drew a mind map of all the recent safety regulation key points and textbook preview content, and the structure immediately became clear. Checking the logistics, he found the textbook had arrived in Haikou and he would get it soon. His wife proposed a weekend deep cleaning, and he agreed to take care of the balcony and light fixtures.

events.name: Rainy-day indoor maintenance and consultation
events.description: All day, he was working in the power distribution room of a commercial complex in Longhua District, repairing drawer-type switchgear. Because rain suspended outdoor work, the pace was actually more relaxed. One switch control circuit had an unexplained trip. Lu Mingqiang pondered it for half an hour without success, called Master Li, and following his tip checked the secondary wiring terminals, finding that corrosion caused poor contact. After treatment, it returned to normal.

events.name: A New Core Training Attempt
events.description: In the evening, after doing his usual superman exercise and glute bridges, he remembered Chen Bin's suggestion and tried two sets of planks on the living room floor. He could only hold each set for 30 seconds, and his abdomen was trembling, but he felt his core was activated.

events.name: Drawing a mind map
events.description: After dinner, he spread out a large white sheet of paper and, with a black pen, wrote "Safety and Standards" in the center, then branched out into "work tickets", "grounding protection", "electric shock first aid", "fire response", and so on. He also added the framework of Chapter 1 of the textbook on the side, spending nearly 50 minutes.

events.name: Tracked the textbook shipment and discussed the thorough cleaning.
events.description: After finishing the mind map, he checked the logistics on his phone, and the information showed the textbook had arrived at Haikou Xiuying Sorting Center. His wife Wang Lijuan came over and said the New Year was approaching and they should do a big cleaning this weekend. Lu Mingqiang volunteered to take on the tasks of wiping the balcony glass and dismantling and washing the lamps.

events.name: Fixed 30 minutes of internet use.
events.description: In the evening, as usual, he opened the electrician forum and saw someone sharing the latest application conditions for senior technician appraisal. He screenshotted the key clauses and saved them to his phone's photo album. Before bed, he finished his evening stretching.

start_state.mood: Awake

end_state.mood: Clear and logical

state.daily_exercise: Back rehabilitation exercises (superman exercise, glute bridge, plank, 2 sets) morning/evening

2025-01.daily_overview: Wednesday, cloudy. During the day, he followed the work crew in replacing old cables at the factory. The workload was heavy, but he was careful to protect his lower back. In the evening, he picked up the long-awaited Theoretical Course for Senior Electrician Technician from the parcel locker. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang first went to the squash court for recovery training with Lin Feng, then returned home, bathed and changed, and opened the first chapter in his study to systematically learn the principles of new power distribution equipment, officially starting his theoretical exam preparation. Because he came home late after squash, he stayed focused studying late into the night.

events.name: Replace old cables at the factory
events.description: In the morning, the entire crew went to a seafood processing plant in Xiuying District to replace an aging main cable. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for pulling the new cable and fixing it in the cable tray. He deliberately wore the lumbar support to try it out; although it was hot and stuffy, it provided noticeable back support, giving him much more confidence while handling the cable.

events.name: Picked up the textbook.
events.description: On the way home from work, he passed the community parcel locker, entered the pickup code, and a small cardboard box popped out. After getting home and opening it, a blue-covered book titled "Theoretical Course for Senior Electrician Technicians" gave off the smell of printer's ink. He felt a bit excited, just like when he got his first set of tools that he had bought himself.

events.name: Squash training
events.description: After dinner and a short rest, he took his racket and hurried to Dynamic Fitness Club for a 1-hour squash training session with his playing partner Lin Feng. The two focused mainly on ball control and footwork drills. Lin Feng deliberately lowered his hitting speed to accommodate him. Lu Mingqiang felt no pain in his lower back during sudden stops and turns, and his confidence soared.

events.name: Systematically study Chapter 1 of the textbook.
