events.description: After squash, he returned home at 9 o'clock, hurriedly took a shower, and then studied Chapter 1 of the textbook, New Power Distribution Equipment, under the study lamp. He read from the working principle of sulfur hexafluoride ring main units to the advantages of solid-insulated switchgear, using a highlighter to mark key points as he went. When he encountered diagrams, he pondered how they corresponded to the real objects, and he didn't finish until 11 o'clock.

events.name: Regularly go online to learn about the review details
events.description: After finishing the first chapter, while he was not yet sleepy, he quickly went to the forum and searched for 'Hainan Technician Evaluation', found that year's detailed evaluation rules, carefully read the paper and defense requirements, and bookmarked them for later reference. Before bed, he simplified his rehabilitation exercises and mainly did lower back stretches.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to it.

end_state.mood: Excited and focused.

state.daily_exercise: Squash training for 1 hour, back and waist stretching (evening simplified)

2025-01.daily_overview: Thursday, clear and fine weather. The repair work during the day went smoothly. During the lunch break, I reviewed Section 1 of the textbook, Principles of Electric Circuits. In the evening, I focused on Section 2, Basic Concepts of Voltage and Current, and completed the practice problems using work examples, getting about 80 percent correct. I also consulted online about a cable selection issue, and felt that theory and practice were gradually coming together. Since I had stayed up late studying the previous night, I deliberately finished the evening study early today to ensure enough sleep. Rehabilitation training went on as usual, and I tried some new core exercises.

events.name: Daily maintenance and apprentice training.
events.description: In the morning, at a hotel to replace the main switch of the guest room distribution box, Lu Mingqiang had the apprentice Zhao Qiang do the disassembly and installation while he watched the details nearby, reminding him to test for voltage even after cutting off power.

events.name: Reading teaching materials during the lunch break
events.description: After lunch, he hid in the team rest room, opened Section 1 of the textbook to review circuit composition and basic physical quantities, and used a pencil to write examples from his own work in the margins, such as the difference between the control circuit and the main circuit.

events.name: Evening study of Section 2 and practice problems.
events.description: At 8 p.m. sharp, he sat down at the desk, carefully studied the concepts of electromotive force, voltage, and current, and analyzed the current flow against the simplified residential distribution box diagram in the textbook. Then he finished the 5 multiple-choice questions and 2 calculation questions at the end of the section, got 1 wrong, and understood it after recalculating. After studying, he added an extra set of glute bridges and superman exercises, feeling that his lower back strength was increasing.

events.name: Regularly going online to ask questions
events.description: He posted on the 'Power Cables' section of the forum asking for help with selecting the cross-section of the incoming cable for an old building. Two veteran electricians quickly replied with empirical data, and he copied it all down in his notebook.

events.name: Catch up on sleep and go to bed early
events.description: Realizing he hadn't had enough sleep the night before, he deliberately wrapped up all activities at 10:30, did his evening stretches, and went to bed half an hour early to ensure 7.5 hours of sleep.

start_state.mood: Stable

end_state.mood: Learning pays off

state.daily_exercise: Lower back rehabilitation training (superman exercise, glute bridges, stretching) morning/evening

2025-01.daily_overview: Friday, cloudy. The company distributed a year-end bonus of 8,000 yuan and an electronic shopping card, adding a sense of security to the family finances. In the afternoon, the main tasks were organizing the warehouse and maintaining tools. In the evening, as usual, they went to his parents' home for dinner; his father asked about his exam preparation, and his mother reminded him to take care of his health. After returning home, the couple discussed how to allocate the bonus and decided to put it in a fixed deposit, set aside money for Spring Festival expenses, and use the shopping card to buy a Li ethnic totem liquor bottle online. In a good mood, he read his study materials a bit longer that evening and went to bed a little later.

events.name: Year-end bonus distribution
events.description: A little after 9 a.m., his phone vibrated. An 8,000 yuan year-end bonus was transferred into his salary card, and the company system pushed a 500-yuan electronic shopping card. His colleagues were overjoyed. Lu Mingqiang calculated in his mind that this money could be saved.

events.name: Warehouse organization and tool maintenance
events.description: In the afternoon, the work team didn't go out; they organized spare parts in the warehouse. Lu Mingqiang wiped and oiled commonly used wrenches and hydraulic pliers with a cloth, preparing in advance for work after the holiday.

events.name: Dinner at his parents’ home and showing concern for them.
events.description: After 6 p.m., he arrived at his parents' home. His mother served his favorite grilled fish. His father asked how his preparation for the senior technician exam was going. Lu Mingqiang reported that he had started reading the textbook. His father nodded and said, "You need to understand the theory thoroughly too." His mother put food in his bowl and told him not to stay up late.

events.name: Couple discusses year-end bonus allocation
events.description: Back home, he sat with his wife at the living room tea table, opened the ledger and tallied up. They finally decided to put 5,000 yuan into a one-year fixed deposit, set aside 3,000 yuan as budget for Spring Festival red envelopes and New Year goods, and he asked to use the 500-yuan shopping card to buy a wine bottle he had had his eye on for a long time; his wife readily agreed.

events.name: Bought a Li ethnic totem wine bottle online.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang immediately logged into the shopping card's partner e-commerce platform on his phone and found an empty bottle of an aged Hainan local liquor. The bottle featured a relief of the Li ethnic group's Mighty God totem. It was priced at 498 yuan; after paying with the shopping card, he only needed to pay another 10 yuan for shipping. After placing the order, he browsed other liquor bottles and was too excited to fall asleep.

events.name: Learning Ohm's law from the textbook
events.description: Before bed, he continued studying Chapter 1, Section 3. He understood the part on Ohm’s law by using the example of measuring current with the clamp meter he often used during repairs, and it quickly clicked. He also drew inferences and calculated the resistance of a few simple circuits. It was past 11 p.m. when he finished studying, so he hurried through his evening stretches and went to sleep.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the bonus

end_state.mood: Satisfied and had a clear plan.

state.daily_exercise: Morning/evening lower back rehabilitation training

2025-01.daily_overview: Saturday was a rest day with fine weather. Early in the morning, he ran another 5 kilometers with Chen Bin, and his pace recovered to 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. In the morning, he systematically reviewed what he had learned over the past half month and drew a knowledge framework diagram. In the afternoon, he helped his wife with the thorough cleaning before the Spring Festival, and for the first time took out all his collection of more than 50 wine bottles, sorted and wiped them by era, and found an old 1987 bottle from the Haikou Winery. In the evening, as agreed, he met Chen Jianguo for Laoba tea and exchanged exam preparation insights. At night, he studied series and parallel circuits and shared his collection online. The whole day was fulfilling, but because the tea drinking went late, he went to bed later than usual.

events.name: Morning jog at Baishamen Park.
events.description: Left home at 6:50 a.m. and arrived at Baishamen Park at 7:00. This time he deliberately increased his pace for the last 1 km. After finishing the 5 km, apart from normal heavy breathing, he had no discomfort in his lower back and felt that his running rhythm had basically recovered. After the run, he chatted with Chen Bin, who praised him for recovering quickly.

events.name: Systematically reviewed and drew a framework diagram.
events.description: In the morning, in the study, I condensed the key points of the work safety course and the first chapter of the textbook into a framework diagram on one A3 sheet. I used different colors to mark what I had mastered and the weak points, and posted it on the wall in front of my desk.

events.name: Pre-Spring Festival cleaning and wine bottle organizing
events.description: In the afternoon, he helped his wife take down and wash the curtains and wiped the balcony glass. At 4 o'clock, he began sorting his liquor bottle collection. He carefully carried out five boxes of bottles and laid them on the living room floor — 52 bottles in all — arranging them into four rows roughly by the date on the bottle bottom: 1970s, 1980s, 1990s, and post-2000.

events.name: Had tea and a chat with Chen Jianguo.
events.description: At 6 p.m., he arrived as agreed at the Dad's Tea shop on Haixiu Road, where Chen Jianguo had already found seats. The two ordered iced black tea and snacks. Chen Jianguo said he had also bought the same textbook, and they agreed to encourage each other and report their progress on WeChat every Sunday evening. During the conversation, Chen Jianguo shared a common fault analysis question from the practical exam, and Lu Mingqiang carefully noted it in his phone memo. After finishing the tea, it was almost 8 p.m. by the time he got home.

events.name: Found a vintage liquor bottle from 1987.
events.description: After returning home, he continued sorting the liquor bottles. While looking through a pile of old bottles his father had given him years earlier, he found an empty Haikou Daqu bottle. Although the label had yellowed, the words "Haikou Distillery 1987" were still clear. The bottle had a simple coconut tree pattern on it, which reminded him of seeing a similar liquor at his father's workplace as a child. He set it aside, planning to look into its origin later.

events.name: Evening study of series and parallel circuits and online sharing.
events.description: After putting the bottles away in their proper places at 9 PM, he studied Section 4 of Chapter 1 of the textbook. To understand the equivalent calculation of series and parallel resistors, he tore off several sheets of scratch paper and repeatedly drew simplified diagrams until he could immediately say that two 5-ohm resistors in parallel give 2.5 ohms. After studying, he went online for 30 minutes and posted a group photo of the bottles he had organized that day to the collectibles section of a forum, with the caption "An electrician's other hobby." Some fellow collectors replied and exchanged comments. Before bed, he did his evening core training.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: It was rewarding

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km; lower back and core training (superman exercise, glute bridge, plank) morning/evening

2025-01.daily_overview: It was Sunday but a compensatory workday, and the sky was overcast. During the day, he worked his final shift before the holiday and organized the warehouse. In the evening, they received the good news that the family had won an award for perfect attendance in the parent-child reading check-in activity, and the whole family was thrilled. After dinner, the couple immediately set up a corner of the living room as a children's reading corner, and the two sons excitedly sat on the floor mat reading. After the children went to sleep, Lu Mingqiang photographed and catalogued the liquor bottles. He found a bottle from a 1970s overseas Chinese farm, which sparked his curiosity. After briefly sharing it in the WeChat group, he went to bed on time and fell asleep early.

events.name: Pre-holiday wrap-up work.
events.description: The entire team completed the last inspection of the district's power distribution rooms in the morning and put seals on them. In the afternoon, they cleaned up the warehouse. After Team Leader Zhang announced that the holiday emergency phones would remain available, they wished each other a happy New Year and went off work.

events.name: Won an award for the parent-child reading check-in activity.
events.description: In the evening, his wife held up her phone for Lu Mingqiang, who had just walked in, to show that the kindergarten class group had notified their family that they had been selected as Reading Star for perfect attendance check-ins. The electronic certificate was printed with the whole family's names. Zixuan and Zihan jumped up and down happily.

events.name: Set up a children's reading corner at home.
events.description: After dinner, the whole family took action immediately. Lu Mingqiang took out the small bookshelf and foam floor mat he had bought online from the balcony storage cabinet. His wife wiped clean the corner of the living room, and the two little ones helped arrange the picture books. In less than half an hour, a cozy little reading corner took shape.

events.name: Children experiencing the new reading corner
events.description: The eldest son Lu Zixuan immediately picked "One Hundred Thousand Whys" and sat on the floor mat flipping through it. The second son Lu Zihan hugged a stack of picture books and asked his father to read to him, so Lu Mingqiang read him "The Very Hungry Caterpillar." The atmosphere was peaceful.

events.name: Photograph and archive wine bottles.
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., after the children went to bed, Lu Mingqiang spread a soft-light cloth on the dining table, photographed the bottles he had sorted out yesterday one by one, and recorded their numbers, sources, and ages in a new notebook. When he photographed a plain yellow-glazed wine bottle, he turned it over and found the raised characters 'State-owned Overseas Chinese Farm, 1972' on the bottom, which gave him a jolt.

events.name: Found a Huaqiao Farm wine bottle and shared it.
events.description: Excitedly, he shared a picture of the Overseas Chinese Farm bottle in the wine bottle collecting WeChat group, sparking a lively discussion among collectors. Someone said it was a rare relic from the Hainan Agricultural Reclamation period. After that, he briefly looked through the group messages, didn't search in depth, and ended the activity to prepare for rest.

start_state.mood: Engaged in work

end_state.mood: Satisfied and excited.

state.daily_exercise: Morning/evening lower back and core training (evening simplified).

2025-01.daily_overview: The last full working day before the holiday, cloudy. During the lunch break, went to the bank and deposited 5,000 yuan into a one-year fixed deposit, adding another sum to the island tour savings. After work, went to a sporting goods store to try on and buy a waist guard for lower back protection. In the evening, received the delivery of a Li ethnic totem wine bottle, cleaned it and put it in the cabinet, and shared learning insights in the WeChat group. Before bed, began studying Chapter 2: Power System Fault Analysis. Because he had stayed up late the previous day, he deliberately returned to a regular sleep schedule today and went to bed on time after finishing his studies.

events.name: Morning low-voltage line maintenance.
events.description: Went with Zhao Qiang to handle a low-voltage problem at a household on the old street of Bo'ai Road. Investigation showed the aluminum wire entering the house had aged. After replacing it with copper wire, the voltage returned to normal. The resident insisted on giving us two tangerines out of gratitude.

events.name: Make a fixed deposit
events.description: At noon, he rode his electric bike to the bank on Jinmao Middle Road and deposited 5,000 yuan in cash as a one-year fixed deposit at the counter with an interest rate of 1.8%, then put the deposit certificate in his ledger.

events.name: Buying a back brace
events.description: After work, he dropped by a sporting goods store on Haixiu Road, compared three lumbar support belts, and finally chose a breathable mesh one with reinforced support. He put it on and tried bending over; the size was right, and he decided to wear it whenever lifting heavy objects from now on.

events.name: Li ethnic totem wine bottle arrived
events.description: At the parcel pickup point near the community entrance, he picked up the small cardboard box. After unwrapping layer after layer of foam, he found the wine bottle with the Li ethnic group's “God of Strength” totem relief carving intact, and the bottle felt heavy. He wiped it with a soft cloth and solemnly placed it in the middle compartment of the living room wine cabinet.

events.name: Shared learning insights in the WeChat group.
events.description: In the evening, he shared his insights on applying Ohm's law in the “Haikou Electrician Technical Exchange Group” chat and also answered a group member's question about leakage switch wiring. The group owner, Master Li, praised him for having a solid foundation.

events.name: Studied Chapter 2: Power System Fault Analysis.
events.description: Before bed, he studied Chapter 2 of the textbook, focusing on short-circuit types and characteristics. He related them to transformer fault cases encountered at work to understand them, and took half a page of notes. Although some formulas were slow to understand, he persisted and finished the section.

start_state.mood: Methodical in handling things

end_state.mood: Grounded and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Lower back and core training morning/evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: On Chinese New Year's Eve, the sun was bright. In the morning, he and his wife finalized the Spring Festival budget and bought a full set of red couplets. In the afternoon, while organizing wine bottles, he unexpectedly found an old 1987 bottle from the Haikou Distillery that his father had given him years ago. After searching, he learned about the ancient distillation technique of the Li ethnic group behind it and was deeply moved; he began recording the story of the bottle in his notebook. In the evening, the whole family went to his parents' home for a reunion dinner. He asked his father about the origin of the Overseas Chinese Farm wine bottle and received precious oral memories. On New Year's Eve, he still kept up his review habit, but because of staying up for the new year, he went to bed very late, and his weight increased slightly due to the sumptuous New Year's Eve dinner.

events.name: Finalize the Spring Festival budget and shopping
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and his wife took out the account book and decided to keep total spending on New Year goods and red envelopes within 3,000 yuan. Then the two went to a nearby market to buy Spring Festival couplets and Fu characters, and also bought a new set of clothes for each of the two children.

events.name: Sorting wine bottles and discovering a bottle his father had given him
events.description: After lunch, he wanted to wipe the wine cabinet once more to welcome spring. When he took out an old Moutai bottle, he also pulled out a dusty empty bottle of Haikou Daqu. The label bore the words Haikou Distillery and 1987, and he vaguely remembered his father casually giving it to him years ago. After gently wiping it with a damp cloth, the coconut tree trademark emerged.

events.name: Search for the distillery's history and record it.
events.description: He sat back on the sofa and searched for “Haikou Brewery” on his phone. A local chronicle article said that the factory had once used the traditional distillation process of the Li ethnic group to brew rice wine, and it stopped production in the late 1990s. Thinking of the “1972 State-Owned Overseas Chinese Farm” wine bottle discovered yesterday, he continued searching for relevant information and learned that it was a product of the Hainan Agricultural Reclamation period, listed as a scarce item on some collecting forums. A complex feeling surged in Lu Mingqiang's heart. He took a new notebook from the drawer and wrote on the first page: “The bottle holds the days of the workers from back then.” Afterward, he also took several detail photos of the bottle, preparing to write a record about it.

events.name: Chinese New Year's Eve reunion dinner
events.description: In the evening, he took his wife and children to his parents' home. His mother had made a table full of dishes, including Wenchang white-cut chicken and mackerel. During the New Year's Eve dinner, Lu Mingqiang specifically poured wine for his father, then took out his phone to show a photo of a wine bottle from the Overseas Chinese Farm and asked about its origin. His father adjusted his reading glasses and slowly told the story of how in 1973 they went to the farm to install irrigation and drainage lines.

events.name: Listening to father's oral history
events.description: His father recalled that the farm had rubber forests and a pepper garden, and that they ate and lived at the farm headquarters; the power lines were all installed by sheer manpower. Lu Mingqiang quickly wrote notes in his notebook, feeling that the wine bottle in his hand suddenly had warmth.

events.name: Staying Up on New Year's Eve and Continuing to Review
events.description: He returned to his own home a little after 10 p.m. His wife had already gone to bed with the children. Lu Mingqiang sat at his desk and spent 30 minutes quickly reviewing key safety knowledge, thinking that even on New Year's Eve he should not lose this momentum for study. Then he sat in the living room watching the Spring Festival Gala. It was not until the midnight bell rang that he did his evening core training in front of the TV and then went to bed.

start_state.mood: Joy on Lunar New Year's Eve.

end_state.mood: Affectionate and firm

state.daily_exercise: Lower back and core training morning/evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: Lunar New Year's Day, sunny and warm. In the morning, the whole family went to his parents' home to pay New Year's greetings, kowtowing to the elderly couple and handing them red envelopes; it was lively and warm. After returning home in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang carefully selected from the liquor cabinet an Overseas Chinese Farm bottle, a Li ethnic totem bottle, and an old Haikou Distillery bottle, planning to write stories for them. In the evening, he visited his aunt and called on relatives and friends. At night, amid the laughter of his family watching TV, he still went to the study to study Chapter 3 of the textbook, High-Voltage Equipment Maintenance, keeping up his habit. Because the Spring Festival food was rich and plentiful, his weight continued to rise slightly.

events.name: The whole family went to his parents' home to pay New Year's greetings.
events.description: On the first day of the Chinese New Year, Lu Mingqiang dressed his two sons in new clothes and took his wife to his parents’ home in Meilan District. As soon as they entered, Zixuan and Zihan knelt on the kneeling mats and kowtowed to their grandparents. Lu Mingqiang handed out the prepared red envelopes, and his mother smiled from ear to ear, bringing out rice cakes and sweet soup.

events.name: Played chess and chatted with my father.
events.description: Before noon, father and son set up a chessboard on the balcony. As they played, the father recounted more details about stringing lines at the Overseas Chinese Farm in his youth, specifically mentioning that the bottles back then were filled with rice wine brewed on the farm, and after finishing the wine, workers kept the bottles to arrange flowers. Lu Mingqiang added a few more lines to his notebook.

events.name: Select three representative wine bottles
events.description: In the afternoon, back home in Longhua, he lined up the Overseas Chinese Farm bottle, the Li ethnic totem bottle, and the 1987 Haikou Distillery old bottle from the liquor cabinet in a row on the desk, preparing to write a cultural note for each. He started with the Overseas Chinese Farm bottle and wrote an outline.

events.name: Visited my aunt and relatives.
events.description: At a little after 4 p.m., he took snacks and fruit to another district to visit Aunt Wang Xiuying. She held his hand and asked whether work was tiring, then pressed lucky money into the hands of her two grandsons. They sat for about an hour before taking leave.

events.name: Kept studying in the evening
events.description: In the evening, the family sat in the living room watching the replay of the Spring Festival Gala. Lu Mingqiang stayed with them for a while, then after 9 o'clock he went into the study on his own, opened the textbook, and began studying Chapter 3, High-Voltage Equipment Maintenance. He learned about the preventive-test cycles and key parameters of high-voltage equipment such as transformers and circuit breakers, and wrote the standard value for the transformer insulating-oil withstand voltage test on a sticky note, planning to stick it inside his toolbox after the holiday. Although firecrackers kept going off outside the window, he stayed focused and completed 30 minutes of study.

start_state.mood: Radiant with joy

end_state.mood: Relaxed and self-disciplined

state.daily_exercise: Lower back and core training morning/evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: The second day of the Lunar New Year, cloudy. I accompanied my wife to visit her parents and had a lively New Year meal with her parents and her younger brother Chen Zhiqiang, who had returned from Shenzhen. The children received toys as gifts. After returning home in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang began writing his first wine bottle story — the Overseas Chinese Farm wine bottle — based on his father’s oral account, writing it vividly. In the evening, he took the children to set off small fireworks, and before bed he still remembered to do a few safety knowledge simulation questions. Since the New Year meal was also rich, his weight dropped slightly but remained a little high.

events.name: Accompanied his wife back to her parents' home.
events.description: At 10 a.m., the family of four drove to the home of Lu Mingqiang's parents-in-law. His wife's younger brother, Chen Zhiqiang, had flown back to Haikou the previous night. As soon as they met, he picked up his nephew and spun him around, and brought out the programmable robot he had brought for Zixuan. Lu Mingqiang chatted with his brother-in-law and father-in-law about the differences between working in Shenzhen and Haikou.

events.name: New Year opening dinner gathering
events.description: At noon, his mother-in-law prepared a big table of dishes, including Wenchang chicken and braised assorted delicacies. Lu Mingqiang drank two small cups of rice wine with his father-in-law and Zhiqiang. Zhiqiang mentioned that business at his Huaqiangbei counter was gradually recovering. Lu Mingqiang then talked about his plan to take the technician certification exam. Zhiqiang patted him on the shoulder and said, “I trust my brother’s work.”

events.name: Write the wine bottle story of the Overseas Chinese Farm
events.description: I got home a little after 3 p.m., made a cup of tea, and opened the notes app on my phone in the study. Under the title 'A 1972 Overseas Chinese Farm Wine Bottle,' I recorded in detail how it was discovered, the markings on the bottom, and the history of the farm's power line installation that my father had told me, writing nearly a thousand words.

events.name: Take the children to set off small fireworks.
events.description: Just after dark, he took Zixuan and Zihan to the designated safe area in the community to play with handheld sparklers. The two children waved them, drawing circles of light. Lu Mingqiang recorded a video with his phone and sent it to the family group chat.

events.name: Evening safety knowledge practice
events.description: At 8:30 p.m., while the kids were watching Spring Festival cartoons, he did a self-printed safety knowledge multiple-choice quiz on the coffee table, got all 10 questions right, and smiled with satisfaction. Then he spent 30 minutes online reading veteran workers' summaries on the forum about precautions for starting work after the New Year. Before bed, he completed core training.

start_state.mood: Warm and cozy

end_state.mood: The satisfaction of completing a creative work

state.daily_exercise: Lower back and core training morning/evening.

2025-01.daily_overview: On the third day of Chinese New Year, the sky was clear and cloudless. In the morning, he met his childhood friend Wang Hai at the usual place on Jiefang West Road for grilled fish and catching up. The two strolled through the old streets, reminiscing about childhood, and walked for a long time. In the afternoon, he went home and continued writing the second wine-bottle story. In the evening, as usual, he went to his parents' house for the last reunion dinner of January. During the meal, his father encouraged him again, and Lu Mingqiang formally made a military pledge to obtain the senior technician title this year. After returning home, he read a picture book with his second son, and before bed browsed the forum and set a 100-day sprint plan. With diet control and walking, his weight had returned to 73.0 kg, and he entered a new phase.

events.name: Had dinner with his childhood friend Wang Hai and caught up
events.description: At 10:30 in the morning, when Lu Mingqiang arrived as agreed at the unmarked grilled fish food stall on Jiefang West Road, Wang Hai had already taken their usual spot. The two ordered two grilled fish, several plates of cold dishes, and two bottles of beer. They chatted from late morning into the afternoon, topics ranging from their children's schooling, to the ups and downs of Wang Hai's mobile phone accessories business in Huaqiangbei, and to reminiscing about the days when they used to set off firecrackers secretly in the alley. When parting, Wang Hai stuffed a bag containing two bottles of Shenzhen specialty liquor into Lu Mingqiang's hands, saying it would add new items to his liquor bottle collection next time.

events.name: Shopping and strolling.
events.description: After the meal, the two walked along Jiefang West Road all the way to People's Park, reminiscing about old buildings along the way and taking a photo together in front of the old department store. They walked for nearly an hour, and Lu Mingqiang felt light on his feet, treating it as post-holiday recovery exercise.

events.name: Continue writing the Li ethnic totem liquor bottle story
events.description: At 3 p.m. he returned home, slightly tipsy but energized. He washed his face, sat down at his desk, and continued writing the second note on his phone, describing the pattern details of the Li ethnic totem relief wine bottle and the meaning of Li brocade. He also noted that this bottle reminded him of seeing a Li grandmother weaving a tube skirt as a child.

events.name: Last family dinner of January
events.description: In the evening, he took his wife and children to his parents' home. At the dinner table, his mother brought out Hainan noodles steamed in a water bath and steamed pork ribs. His father said slowly while eating, “I've seen you studying every day lately. Mastering the electrical trade is a real skill; I'm sure you can do it.” Lu Mingqiang put down his chopsticks and said solemnly to the whole family, “Dad, Mom, I'm determined to get the senior technician certificate this year, so our family will have a technician too!” Everyone applauded.

events.name: Read picture books with his younger son.
events.description: When he got home in the evening, Hanhan hugged a picture book and pulled him to the reading corner in the living room, clamoring to hear “Little Bear Doesn’t Brush His Teeth”. Lu Mingqiang sat Hanhan on his lap and read in exaggerated animal voices from the story. Hanhan giggled, and after one reading asked for it again.

events.name: Browsing forums and making a 100-day plan
events.description: After Hanhan fell asleep, he turned on the computer and went to the electrical technology forum, where he bookmarked a detailed post about a technician's thesis defense experience. Then he opened a new notebook and, under the title "100-Day Sprint," broke down daily theoretical study and hands-on simulation tasks, writing until 23:00. Before closing the notebook, he quickly reviewed the key safety knowledge points learned this week and completed the evening core training.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to reuniting with an old friend.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling, warm, and full of ambition

state.daily_exercise: Walking (strolling through old streets with childhood friends), waist/back core training morning/evening

2025-10.daily_overview: On the first day of the National Day holiday, the morning at home began with a flurry of activity. His mother, Chen Xiuying, came over early to help, and the kitchen was filled with the aroma of Hainanese chicken rice and stewed soup. Lu Mingqiang and his two sons were helping out in the living room, occasionally sent by his wife to buy soy sauce. There was no morning run on the first day of the holiday, but he still did 10 minutes of stretching out of habit. In the afternoon, his wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang arrived with his girlfriend Lin Xue, and the whole family gave them a warm welcome. In the evening, at the plentiful family dinner, everyone chatted about daily life and work, and Lin Xue quickly fit into the warm family. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang did not forget to call his kite-flying friend Chen Jie and his workmate Chen Jianguo, agreeing to meet for a kite gathering at Evergreen Park on the 3rd. At night, the children played and fooled around in the living room while the adults drank tea and chatted; the feeling of National Day reunion filled the whole home.

events.name: Mother helped prepare the family dinner
events.description: In the early morning, his mother Chen Xiuying took the early bus from Meilan District, bringing her own pickled vegetables and free-range chicken from her hometown. She and Wang Lijuan processed the ingredients in the kitchen: marinating the meat, simmering old fire soup, cooking Hainanese chicken rice, and making old man tea snacks. Lu Mingqiang was responsible for taking care of the two sons, while also helping peel garlic, wash vegetables, and run errands to buy ingredients. The kitchen was steaming with heat inside and out.

events.name: Welcome his wife's younger brother and his girlfriend.
events.description: Around 3 p.m., his wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang arrived at the home in Longhua District with his girlfriend Lin Xue. Lu Mingqiang took his wife and children downstairs to greet them and helped carry the luggage upstairs. Lin Xue was a bit shy, and Wang Lijuan warmly pulled her into the house to chat. The two sons looked curiously at the electronic toys their uncle had brought. The family sat around drinking tea and making small talk, and Lin Xue gradually relaxed.

events.name: National Day family reunion dinner.
events.description: At 7 p.m., a lavish family dinner was served: Hainanese chicken rice, steamed grouper, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, mother's signature pork tripe soup, braised pork hock, and more. Lu Mingqiang poured a little baijiu for his father, and everyone raised their glasses to celebrate the holiday. They chatted warmly during the meal. Chen Zhiqiang asked about his brother-in-law's work and the current state of the repair industry, and Lin Xue shared her work as a preschool teacher. Lu Mingqiang did not say much, but a smile stayed on his face. The atmosphere was harmonious, and family affection grew warmer as cups were raised.

events.name: Invitation to a weekend kite gathering
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang went to the balcony and first called his kite-flying friend Chen Jie to arrange a kite gathering at Wanlv Park on the morning of the 3rd. Chen Jie readily agreed. Then he contacted his workmate Chen Jianguo via WeChat, inviting him and his family to come along. Chen Jianguo said it was a good chance to bring his daughter out to play. Lu Mingqiang confirmed the number of people and the time, and set the meeting point at the park entrance at 8:30.

events.name: Evening family leisure time
events.description: After clearing the dining table, his mother and wife watched TV in the living room, while his father played with building blocks with the grandchildren. Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa, occasionally joining the conversation, took out his phone to check messages in work group chats, and also searched for Haikou's weather during the National Day holiday. The family went to rest very late. Lu Mingqiang tidied up the guest room again for his wife's younger brother and his girlfriend to stay.

start_state.mood: Expectant and at ease, looking forward to family reunion.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and relaxed; family life felt warm and fulfilling.

state.daily_exercise: Household physical labor, no deliberate exercise (only 10 minutes of simple morning stretching)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 32°C/26°C, scattered light rain in the afternoon.

2025-10.daily_overview: The second day of the National Day holiday was more relaxed. Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to the pharmacy to buy a medicated patch for his mother. At noon, the whole family gathered again; Chen Zhiqiang and his girlfriend brought up the senior technician certificate and gave Lu Mingqiang encouragement. In the afternoon, he worked alone on the balcony repairing the kite, carefully reinforcing the spool and frame. In the evening, a brief shower passed quickly; the wife's younger brother and his girlfriend went to stroll on the old street, while Lu Mingqiang took his son for several laps around the neighborhood, enjoying the rare time alone with his child.

events.name: Buying medicated plasters for his mother
events.description: At 8:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike to the pharmacy on Jinmao Middle Road near his home. His mother's rheumatic legs often ache in damp rainy weather, so he bought a box of medicated plasters and two boxes of joint pain-relief patches, totaling 85 yuan. After returning home, he handed the medicine to his mother and explained the hot compress usage again. His mother smiled and said, "I know, you tell me every time."

events.name: Family luncheon the day after National Day
events.description: At noon the family had hotpot in the living room, steaming hot. During the meal, Chen Zhiqiang mentioned that a colleague at his company had gotten a raise after earning the senior electrician certificate, and encouraged Lu Mingqiang to get it too, saying that skilled trades are more valued as you get older and are even more stable than sales. His girlfriend Lin Xue agreed. Lu Mingqiang nodded and said he was already preparing, while silently moving his certification plan up a notch. His father also chimed in, recalling the time he was evaluated as a technician at the power supply bureau, with pride written all over his face.

events.name: Inspect and organize the kite equipment.
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang took the large kites out of the storage room. First he checked the bamboo frames for cracks and reinforced several key joints with fishing line and super glue. Then he checked the reels and rewound two spools of nylon line. Finally he packed the kites, reels, gloves, sun hat, five bottles of water, a few packs of biscuits, and the children's snacks into a large backpack. He also tucked a small bottle of cooling oil into the side pocket to keep mosquitoes away.

events.name: Evening parent-child jogging
events.description: At nearly 5 p.m., the rain had long stopped and the ground in the residential compound was half dry. Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and called Lu Zixuan to go downstairs. They jogged slowly around the community garden for about two kilometers, while his younger son Lu Zihan followed behind on a small tricycle. Halfway through the run, Lu Zixuan said he was tired, so Lu Mingqiang slowed down and taught him how to adjust his breathing. In the end, the father and son walked the final lap holding hands. Lu Mingqiang felt very relaxed—he shouldn't forget to exercise during the National Day holiday.

events.name: Evening settling in and casual chat
events.description: After dinner, my wife and younger brother went out for a night stroll along Qilou Old Street. Lu Mingqiang stayed home with his mother watching TV and rubbed her knees. His wife was in the room folding clothes, and Lu Zixuan was lying on the coffee table drawing a kite. Lu Mingqiang sent a WeChat message to his elder brother Lu Minghua, asking whether he had time off for National Day in Shenzhen, and also forwarded several photos of the family dinner.

start_state.mood: Relaxed, immersed in vacation mode.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling and calm, with the idea of getting a certificate fermenting in his mind.

state.daily_exercise: Rode an electric bike out for errands; jogged about 2 kilometers in the evening.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 31°C/24°C, wind force 2–3, suitable for kite flying

2025-10.daily_overview: Kite gathering day. Lu Mingqiang got up early to check his backpack and urged the children to put on their sun-protection jackets. When they drove to Wanlv Garden, the families of Chen Jie and Chen Jianguo had already arrived, and colorful kites were spread out on the grass. Lu Mingqiang chose an open area, coordinated everyone to spread out, and took the lead in flying a traditional eagle kite a full meter long. The children screamed, and the beginners imitated him while he guided from the side, just like a kite coach. In the afternoon, everyone ate snacks and chatted in the shade. Around three o'clock, they started reeling in the kites and cleaning up the site. Lu Mingqiang led the way in picking up trash, which inspired others to follow suit. On the way home, his two sons fell asleep in the back seat, still smiling.

events.name: Set off for Wanlv Park to meet up with friends
events.description: At exactly 8:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang set off from Longhua District with Wang Lijuan, Lu Zixuan, and Lu Zihan, arriving at Wanlv Garden in about fifteen minutes. Chen Jie's family was already waiting at the east gate entrance, and Chen Jianguo arrived soon after with his wife and daughter. After exchanging a few greetings, Lu Mingqiang led the way to a lawn away from trees, with moderate wind and no high-voltage lines nearby.

events.name: Organized and guided kite flying.
events.description: After Lu Mingqiang chose the area, he briefly explained to everyone how to position themselves to avoid tangled kite lines. He was the first to launch a traditional eagle kite; the cotton line twitched in his hand as the eagle climbed high into the sky. Then he walked over to Chen Jianguo and the children and showed them hands-on how to control the reel and how to use the wind to tug the line. Chen Jie also flew a centipede kite, and the two kites complemented each other in the sky. Lu Mingqiang was especially patient in guiding his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to fly a small butterfly kite on his own. For the first time, Lu Zixuan successfully got the kite to fly steadily, and his face flushed with excitement. The younger son was held by his mother and watched.

events.name: Simple lunch and conversation in the tree shade at noon
events.description: Around noon, everyone put away their kites and spread out mats in the shade under the trees, taking out their own bread, fruit, Hainan rice noodles, and qingbuliang. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo chatted about work arrangements after the holiday, while Chen Jie shared the frame of a swallow-shaped kite he had recently made. The children shared snacks with each other, and Wang Lijuan and Chen Jianguo's wife talked about parenting. The atmosphere was casual and harmonious.

events.name: Cleanup and farewell
events.description: At 3 p.m., the wind gradually died down, and Lu Mingqiang called everyone to start reeling in the lines. He carefully rolled up the eagle kite and took the lead in picking up litter such as water bottles and snack bags from the lawn into the garbage bags they had brought. The others also followed suit and cleaned up. At the park gate, he shook hands with Chen Jie and Chen Jianguo to say goodbye, and they agreed to meet again next time.

events.name: Return home to rest
events.description: Arrived home around 3:30. The two children were so tired that they had fallen asleep in the car. Lu Mingqiang carried them to bed, took a shower, curled up on the living room sofa with a cup of tea, and checked his phone. He saw Chen Jie had posted photos of today's kites in the group chat. He gave a like and replied, 'Let's make it bigger next time.' His wife was cleaning the shoes that had gotten dirty on the outing.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and excited about the long-planned kite gathering.

end_state.mood: A bit tired but very happy; the role of organizer brought a sense of fulfillment.

state.daily_exercise: Continuously walking and guiding in the park, standing for several hours

2025-10.daily_overview: Sunday museum day. Before breakfast, Lu Mingqiang confirmed that the provincial museum did not require same-day reservation, but it might be crowded. He packed his ID card, the children's water bottles, and some snacks, and set off by car just after nine, arriving in Qiongshan District twenty minutes later. In the industrial history exhibition area on the second floor, he became his son's personal docent. The old-style generators, steam engines, and other exhibits came alive in his words. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, almost pressed his face against the display glass, asking questions without stopping. Lu Mingqiang explained patiently, and his sense of pride as a skilled worker was ignited. In the afternoon, the whole family toured the interactive area, and the children had a great time. After getting home, Lu Zixuan still kept pulling his father to discuss the principles of power generation, so Lu Mingqiang simply dug out his old reference books from back then to show him the pictures.

events.name: Check travel information and prepare items
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, before breakfast, Lu Mingqiang checked the provincial museum's opening hours and address on his phone again, confirming that entry was allowed with an ID card without a reservation. He found the ID cards of the five family members in the drawer, put two small bottles of water, a few packs of crackers, and a pack of tissues into his backpack, and brought a sun hat for each of his two sons.

events.name: Drove to Hainan Provincial Museum
events.description: At 9:10 in the morning, the family set out from Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District. Lu Mingqiang drove, his wife sat in the passenger seat, and the two sons were in their car seats in the back. They took Guoxing Avenue and then Haifu Road, arriving at the Hainan Provincial Museum in Qiongshan District in about twenty minutes. They parked in a shaded parking space. The sunlight was beginning to be a bit glaring, but it was not very hot.

events.name: Visit the industrial history exhibition area and give a focused explanation.
events.description: In the Industrial History Hall on the second floor of the museum, Lu Mingqiang led his family straight to the display area for old-fashioned generators and steam engines. Lu Zixuan was drawn to a water turbine generator model from the 1970s. Lu Mingqiang crouched down, pointed at the rotor and stator, and explained in simple words, "The water pushes the magnet to spin, and electricity is generated." Drawing on his experience repairing small generator sets at work, he made the explanation vivid, and Wang Lijuan listened with great interest. His younger son, Lu Zihan, did not fully understand, but when the light bulb lit up as Dad turned the model's handle, his eyes went wide. Lu Mingqiang felt a strong surge of pride.

events.name: Interactive experience area
events.description: After seeing the static exhibits, they came to the interactive area on the history of electric power development, which had a small device that generated electricity by hand to light a bulb. Lu Mingqiang encouraged his eldest son Lu Zixuan to try cranking it. The first crank made the bulb dimly light up; cranking harder made it brighter. Lu Zixuan excitedly called his mother to look. Lu Mingqiang smiled on the side, occasionally explaining how electricity traveled to the bulb. He noticed there was also a puzzle board simulating circuit connections nearby, so he played with the children for a while, patiently teaching them the concept of positive and negative terminals.

events.name: Returned home and reviewed the visit.
events.description: A little after noon, they left the museum and had a simple meal of Hainan noodles nearby. Around 2 p.m. they got home, and the younger son was sleepy and went to bed. Lu Mingqiang and Lu Zixuan sat on the living room floor, searched on their phones for a clearer internal structure diagram of the generator, and continued the discussion from earlier in the day. Lu Zixuan said, 'It's like LEGO.' Lu Mingqiang smiled and told the story of the embarrassing time he first took apart an old motor. In the evening, he also remembered to tell his younger son Lu Zihan a story about a little mechanical bear.

start_state.mood: Relaxed; looking forward to taking the family out to broaden their horizons.

end_state.mood: He felt gratified and proud, and resonated with his eldest son on career interests.

state.daily_exercise: Walking around the museum for about three hours

2025-10.daily_overview: Wife's birthday. Lu Mingqiang quietly got up before dawn and biked to the antique stalls by East Lake, hoping to find some old treasures in the early morning. He got lucky: a 1974 analog multimeter was talked out of the stall owner's hands. Though old, it had an industrial beauty. By the time he got home, his wife was just waking up, and he casually hid his 'trophy.' The highlight of the day was the whole family celebrating the birthday girl. In the afternoon he went to pick up the pre-ordered cake, and the two children presented handmade cards. When the candles were lit, Wang Lijuan's eyes grew a little moist. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang wiped the multimeter clean and placed it on his desk, like a metaphor for himself about to sprint into exam prep—precision and durability.

events.name: In the early morning, shopped for and bought a vintage multimeter
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang quietly closed the door, got on his old mountain bike, and rode along Longkun North Road toward East Lake. The weekend antique street stalls were already set up. He rummaged carefully through a corner stall and found an MF47 analog multimeter manufactured in 1974, with a scratch on the case but an intact meter head. Without showing any expression, he bargained with the stall owner, bringing the price from 150 yuan down to 90 yuan. He wrapped it in newspaper, put it in his backpack, and rode home full of joy. When he entered the house at 7:30, he still carried the coolness of the early morning.

events.name: Wife's birthday celebration.
events.description: In the morning, the family made simple Hainan noodles and longevity noodles at home. At 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang went to the community cake shop to pick up the ordered 8-inch fruit cake. After dinner at 6 p.m., the whole family gathered around the dining table. Lu Mingqiang lit the colorful candles, the two sons sang the birthday song, and Wang Lijuan smiled with her eyes closed and made a wish. Lu Zixuan handed her a portrait of her mother he had drawn, and Lu Zihan gave her a small flower picked from the balcony. Wang Lijuan made the first cut of the cake, and Lu Mingqiang gently put his arm around her shoulder from behind. A simple celebration, full of warmth.

events.name: Evening: preparing the multimeter and gathering his thoughts
events.description: After the children went to sleep, Lu Mingqiang carefully wiped the old multimeter with a flannel cloth under the study lamp. He replaced the test leads with new wire and used his phone to look up the history of the same model of meter. When he saw on the forum that the senior technician exam required proficiency with various instruments, he felt this meter would be a good helper. In his work notebook he wrote, "Purchased MF47, can practice readings."

start_state.mood: Slightly excited, anticipating the secret birthday arrangements and the old keepsakes.

end_state.mood: Content and satisfied, with both family warmth and personal hobbies flourishing

state.daily_exercise: In the early morning, cycled about 8 kilometers round trip.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy during the day, clouds clearing to moonlight in the evening, 29°C/22°C

2025-10.daily_overview: Mid-Autumn Day. His wife's younger brother and his girlfriend left for Shenzhen this morning, and the whole family saw them off downstairs. During the day, Lu Mingqiang and his wife prepared the mooncakes and fruit for the moon-worship ceremony, while the children helped set up a small table on the balcony. After nightfall, the moon broke out from the clouds, and the family sat on the balcony to admire it. Lu Mingqiang poured a few cups of Laobai tea, raised his cup to his wife, and said: “After I pass the exam, we'll go see the real moon — a self-driving tour around the island.” It was a simple remark, but it brought a greater sense of certainty about the future to this Mid-Autumn night. He had always felt that with skills in hand and family by his side, life was worth looking forward to.

events.name: See off wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang and his girlfriend.
events.description: At eight in the morning, Chen Zhiqiang and Lin Xue packed their luggage. Mother Chen Xiuying pressed two bags of homemade snacks on them, and Lu Mingqiang helped carry the suitcases downstairs, reminding them to drive safely. Wang Lijuan held her younger brother's hand and said a few more words. As the car drove off, Lu Mingqiang waved, and his eldest son shouted, "Goodbye, uncle." The house became a little quieter all of a sudden.

events.name: Preparations for the Mid-Autumn moon worship
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang moved the small folding table out of the storage room and set it on the balcony. Wang Lijuan arranged mooncakes, grapes, pomelo, qingbuliang, and two cups of tea on plates. Under her father's guidance, Lu Zixuan made a simple little lantern from bamboo strips and rice paper, put a small LED light in it, and hung it on the drying pole on the balcony. Lu Zihan drew the moon with crayons next to them.

events.name: Enjoying the moon on the balcony on Mid-Autumn night and looking forward to the future.
events.description: Just after 7 p.m., a silver plate-like moon hung in the sky. The whole family gathered on the balcony, with mooncakes and fruit on the table. Lu Mingqiang poured tea for his wife and raised his cup, saying with emotion, 'You've worked hard these years. Once I pass the senior technician certificate exam, we'll go see the real moon, drive our little car around the island, and make Wenchang our first stop.' Wang Lijuan's eyes reddened slightly, and the boys cheered about seeing the sea. Lu Mingqiang looked at the moon and anchored his wish for the island-driving trip even more firmly.

events.name: A family Mid-Autumn Festival chat
events.description: After moon gazing, the children played with the light and shadows of the lanterns in the living room. Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat on the sofa and talked about the education of their two children: the eldest son's math tutoring needed to continue, and the younger son would move up to the top kindergarten class next year. Lu Mingqiang also mentioned in passing that he wanted to have a studio of his own, saying he would think it over after getting the certificate. His wife leaned on his shoulder and said, 'Take it one step at a time.'

start_state.mood: There was a faint reluctance to part, but the festive atmosphere soon washed it away.

end_state.mood: Warm with a clear sense of direction for the future, feeling assured inside.

state.daily_exercise: Move tables and chairs to set up the balcony

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, 28°C/21°C, north wind slightly cool, feels like early autumn.

2025-10.daily_overview: At the tail end of the holiday, the weather turned cool, so Lu Mingqiang started preparing the family's "Little Farm Plan." In the morning, he went alone to the farmers market and bought all the cherry tomato seeds, flower pots, and nutrient soil. After returning, he took his two sons to clean up the balcony corner and fill the pots with soil. However, since the seeds needed to be soaked to germinate, they decided to wait until the weekend to sow them officially. The three of them arranged the three flower pots neatly, and Lu Mingqiang wrote "Cherry Tomatoes (Dwarf)" on a label sticker, agreeing to sow the seeds on the weekend. As compensation, Lu Mingqiang explained to the children the principle of plant germination, and his eldest son listened with great interest. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang organized the tools he would need for work the next day and mentally switched back to work mode.

events.name: Purchased planting supplies.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to the farmer's market in Longhua District. At the seed stall, he carefully selected dwarf cherry tomato seeds suitable for balcony pots, and also bought two bags of nutrient soil, three medium terracotta flower pots, a small trowel, and a watering can, totaling 45 yuan. He also bought a bag of bone meal as base fertilizer.

events.name: Led his son in tidying up the planting area.
events.description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang, with Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan, cleared out the clutter from the east corner of the balcony and wiped the floor clean with a rag. The three of them lined up the flowerpots in a row, filled them with nutrient soil to seven-tenths full using small shovels, and Lu Mingqiang demonstrated how to level the soil surface. Lu Zixuan imitated the movements quite well, while Lu Zihan helped pass the tools. After filling the soil, Lu Mingqiang opened the seed packets and explained that the seeds need to be soaked for 24 hours to promote germination. Then the three of them wrapped the seeds in damp paper towels, put them in a small box, and placed it on the kitchen windowsill.

events.name: Explain planting knowledge and agree to sow seeds on the weekend.
events.description: While waiting for the seeds to soak, Lu Mingqiang searched for short videos on growing tomatoes on his phone in the living room and showed them to his sons, promising that once the seeds sprouted little white tips on the weekend, they would sow them together. Lu Zixuan took out his notebook, wrote a line: “2025.10.7 Preparing to plant tomatoes, sowing on the weekend,” and drew a sketch of a flowerpot. Lu Mingqiang marked the afternoon of October 11 (Saturday) on the calendar as “Sowing Day.”

events.name: Preparing for tomorrow’s return to work
events.description: At nine in the evening, the children were asleep. Lu Mingqiang arranged his work clothes, safety helmet, insulated shoes, multimeter, and tool bag by the door, and checked the battery level of the electric impact wrench. He also took out the week's task list issued by the company last week and highlighted the key points. He thought that starting tomorrow he would be busy again, but he didn't mind. On the contrary, he felt a sense of calm readiness before going into battle.

start_state.mood: Leisurely; on the last day of the holiday, he wanted to do something meaningful.

end_state.mood: Looking forward to the weekend planting and ready to devote himself to work.

state.daily_exercise: Rode an electric bike to buy groceries and tidied the balcony.

2025-10.daily_overview: Still resting. Today Lu Mingqiang decided to take care of an unfinished household task: a safety inspection of the electrical circuits throughout the house. Ever since the idea of the competition sprouted, he had become especially sensitive to wiring standards and safety. He spent the whole morning starting from the distribution box, checking each circuit breaker, outlet, and wire connection one by one. He found a slight burn mark on an old outlet in the kitchen, immediately rode his bike to the hardware store, bought a new one, and replaced it. In the afternoon, the rain stopped. He took the children for a walk in the community garden to get some fresh air, and also checked on the seeds that were soaking; a few had already sprouted white tips. In the evening, as planned, he went to the squash club for recovery training, but after only 40 minutes he felt out of practice and his stamina had clearly declined. Afterward, his whole body was sore and heavy. Before bed, he sent a WeChat message to his mentor, Master Li, to wish him a happy holiday.

events.name: Whole-house electrical circuit safety inspection.
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang took out a test pen, a multimeter, and insulating tape from his tool bag. He first turned off the main switch, opened the entrance distribution box, and tightened the wiring screws on each circuit breaker one by one, also testing whether the leakage protection switch was sensitive. Then he checked the outlets room by room, focusing on high-power circuits such as air conditioners and water heaters. He found that the plastic on the back of an outlet next to the kitchen counter had turned yellow and the wiring showed signs of oxidation; he judged this was caused by prolonged use of the electric kettle the year before last.

events.name: Replace the old socket.
events.description: After confirming the fault, Lu Mingqiang rode his e-bike to a nearby hardware store and bought a branded socket panel of the same specification (10 A) for 12 yuan. Back home, he turned off the corresponding branch circuit, used a test pen to confirm there was no electricity, then removed the old socket, stripped the copper wire ends to a bright finish, inserted them into the new socket's terminal holes, and tightened them. He also wrapped two layers of waterproof tape inside the recessed box. After installing the panel, he switched the breaker back on and tested it—the contact was good. With the kitchen hazard eliminated, he felt much more at ease.

events.name: Afternoon outdoor time with the kids and checking seeds
events.description: The rain stopped a little after 4 p.m., and the air was moist. Lu Mingqiang took his two sons for a walk in the community garden, stepping through shallow puddles. Lu Zihan wanted to go down the slide, but it was too wet, so Lu Mingqiang held him and pushed him on the swing a few times. Back home, the three of them went to the kitchen windowsill to check the soaked seeds and found that three tomato seeds had tiny white sprouts. The boys clapped excitedly. Lu Mingqiang rinsed them with clean water, wrapped them again in a damp paper towel, and said they could be planted the next day.

events.name: Evening squash recovery training
events.description: At 7:30 after dinner, Lu Mingqiang cycled to his usual squash club. His playing partner Lin Feng was already warming up on the court. The two practiced rallies for about 40 minutes, but Lu Mingqiang clearly felt his legs were heavy and his reactions were half a beat slow—he missed several shots he could normally return. Lin Feng smiled and said, 'You enjoyed the National Day holiday too much, didn't you?' Lu Mingqiang gave a wry smile and admitted his fitness had declined. The two agreed to play again next week. After the session, he did some light stretching and went home.

events.name: Sending holiday greetings to my mentor.
events.description: After taking a shower, close to ten o'clock, Lu Mingqiang sent a WeChat message to his mentor, Master Li: 'Master, happy Mid-Autumn Festival! I went to play ball today, and my body is rusty. How is your health?' Master Li replied quickly, saying he was still in good shape, and teased him: 'Young people just slack off during holidays.' The master and apprentice chatted for a while. Lu Mingqiang mentioned the certification exam, and Master Li said, 'Your skills are good enough; all you need is to dig into the theory.' He silently took note.

start_state.mood: Comfortable, but feeling that I should do something practical

end_state.mood: My body felt heavy, and I realized my physical fitness had seriously declined after the holiday.

state.daily_exercise: Rode a bike to the hardware store, took a walk of about 1 hour in the afternoon, and did squash training for 40 minutes in the evening.

2025-10.daily_overview: The first day after the holiday, work fully resumed. To get back into shape, Lu Mingqiang deliberately got up early and completed a 5 km morning run in Wanlv Park at a pace of about 6 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, feeling his body was still a bit heavy. Afterwards, he went straight to the company. After the morning meeting, he was assigned to install distribution cabinets at a newly built factory in Xiuying District, and worked with his partner Chen Jianguo until 3 p.m. before having lunch. Although the physical exertion was great, he noticed that while working at height, he paid special attention to the standard of every wiring point—a subtle change influenced by his master's advice to 'dig into the theory.' After work, he wiped the mud off the soles of his safety shoes before entering the house. In the evening, after helping his son finish several math problems, he sat on the sofa and looked at the advanced electrician theory question bank on his phone for more than half an hour. Before long, he felt his neck and shoulders stiffen, so he stood up and did some stretching exercises.

events.name: First morning run after the holiday
events.description: At 5:50 a.m., Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes, slipped out quietly, and cycled to Evergreen Park. After a brief warm-up, he ran 5 kilometers along his usual route, taking about 34 minutes. It was his first run after the holiday, and his cardiovascular fitness clearly could not keep up, with his pace dropping to 7 minutes in the last kilometer. But he still pushed through, went home drenched in sweat, showered, and then hurried off to work.

events.name: Return to work with a full-day installation task
events.description: At six-thirty in the morning, Lu Mingqiang rode an e-bike for ten minutes to the company on Haisheng Road, Xiuying District. At the morning meeting, Team Leader Zhang assigned tasks: he, Chen Jianguo, apprentice Zhao Qiang, and a rigger would go to the new workshop together to install two main distribution cabinets. After arriving on site, Lu Mingqiang was responsible for wiring and commissioning, Chen Jianguo assisted, and Zhao Qiang learned alongside. Because the cabinets were heavy and bulky, they used a manual chain hoist. Lu Mingqiang worked with his head up for nearly five hours straight, and his work clothes became soaked through, then dried in the wind. Lunch was delayed until three in the afternoon, when they hurriedly ate boxed meals.

events.name: Pay attention to the details of standard operation.
events.description: While wiring, Lu Mingqiang deliberately did one extra step compared with usual — he used number ferrules to label each control wire and stuck a handwritten simplified wiring diagram on the inside of the distribution cabinet door. This was a habit he had thought of while studying theory a few days earlier; he felt that standardized habits mattered more than rushing. Team leader Zhang happened to pass by and caught a glimpse, and gave rare praise: “Well done,” which lifted Lu Mingqiang's spirits.

events.name: Evening study and shoulder and neck discomfort
events.description: He got off work at six in the evening, his shoes covered in dust, and cleaned them with a brush at the stairwell entrance before going inside. After dinner, he guided Lu Zixuan through several division problems with remainders and checked the drawings Lu Zihan had made in kindergarten. After 8:30, the children got ready to wash up. Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa, opened the electrician question bank app on his phone, and studied the transformer and mutual inductor chapter for about forty minutes. Just as he was absorbed, he suddenly felt stiffness in his neck and right shoulder, so he had to stop. He walked over to the balcony and did a few wall angels and neck-shoulder stretches, and the symptoms eased slightly. He reminded himself: sitting too long is an electrician's great enemy.

start_state.mood: Determined to wake his body up with a morning run, but felt a bit tired.

end_state.mood: Tired body, but improved awareness of work standards; shoulder and neck discomfort raised vigilance.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km; heavy physical installation work all day (climbing, lifting, etc.)

2025-10.daily_overview: Today's two things: payday and making a budget. In the afternoon, the bank text message rang, and the October salary of 4,300 yuan arrived. In the evening, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan took out the notebook and listed the upcoming major expenses one by one: their son's math tutoring fee of 800 yuan, the Wenchang trip budget of 1,000 yuan, car insurance renewal of 1,200 yuan, and the remaining more than 1,500 yuan into family savings. The numbers were tight, but they calculated them clearly. Wang Lijuan said not to forget the water and electricity bills, and Lu Mingqiang slapped his forehead and added them. After balancing the accounts, the two smiled at each other. This is what living a steady life is like. He also took a look at his "studio dream account," which was still 0, but now it had a name—he added a line in his notes: "Start-up funds: competition prize money / performance bonus." During the day, his neck and shoulders still ached slightly while working, so he found time to do a few chest stretches, and in the evening followed a video to do 15 minutes of stretching, feeling mostly better.

events.name: Received October salary
events.description: A little after four in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang received a bank notification at the job site that his salary had arrived: 4,300 yuan, including 3,800 yuan base salary and 500 yuan monthly performance bonus. He took a screenshot and sent it to his wife. Chen Jianguo, standing nearby, also received his salary. The two chatted for a while, saying this month's performance was decent and the overtime for National Day was fully counted.

events.name: After work, organize family finances.
events.description: At 7:30 after dinner, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan sat at the dining table and opened the expense-tracking app and the banking app on their phones. The two went through the month's essential expenses item by item: renewal of the eldest son's math tutoring class, 800 yuan; the planned short trip to Wenchang at the end of the month, with estimated fuel, accommodation, tickets, and other costs of 1,000 yuan; vehicle insurance renewal at the end of the month, about 1,200 yuan; monthly daily expenses such as utilities and groceries, about 1,500 yuan. After calculating, they found that they basically broke even with no surplus. Wang Lijuan suggested cutting the travel budget to 800 yuan. Lu Mingqiang thought for a moment and said to keep 1,000 yuan, and if it was not enough, they could make up the difference from savings. Finally, they transferred the remaining few hundred yuan to the family savings account.

events.name: Record dream fund.
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang added a line on the 'Studio Launch' page in his phone's memo: '2025.10.10 Target funds 50,000 yuan, currently 0. Sources to be determined: competition prize / performance bonus / savings.' He stared at that line for a few seconds, then turned off his phone, feeling that even starting from zero, having a number made things feel solid.

events.name: Throughout the day, fit in shoulder and neck relief exercises
events.description: During breaks at the work site, Lu Mingqiang deliberately moved his shoulders more, doing several chest expansion exercises and shoulder circles. In the evening, while doing the financial calculations, he sat for too long and his neck and shoulders became stiff again. So before bed, he followed the rehabilitation video on his phone and did 15 minutes of targeted stretching, feeling his muscles relax. He wrote in his notebook: 'Stand up and move every 45 minutes of sitting.'

start_state.mood: Uneventful, a routine workday.

end_state.mood: Clear finances bring a sense of security, and shoulder and neck tension has eased somewhat.

state.daily_exercise: Heavy physical work, simple stretching during breaks

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny, 29°C/21°C, with a gentle autumn breeze.

2025-10.daily_overview: Saturday was a day off, and also the monthly unbreakable day to visit his parents. In the early morning, Lu Mingqiang first completed a 5 km run at Evergreen Park and felt his stamina was recovering. In the morning he drove the whole family to his parents' home in Meilan District. His father was playing chess with a neighbor downstairs; seeing his grandson, he immediately stopped the game and came over. His mother had already simmered a pot of pork rib and radish soup. During lunch, his father mentioned industry news he had heard from an old colleague, saying that senior skilled technicians are now in great demand. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to mention his idea of getting the senior technician certificate and setting up a studio. His father did not object, only reminded him to get all the licenses and qualifications in order. In the afternoon, the two children went with their grandfather to a nearby park, while Lu Mingqiang helped his mother fix the squeaky sliding door track in the kitchen. After returning home at around three o'clock, the soaked seeds had all sprouted little white shoots. Lu Mingqiang took his sons to the balcony, carefully planted the seeds in flowerpots, lightly covered them with soil, and thoroughly watered them with a spray bottle. Lu Zixuan solemnly wrote the first page in the brand-new "Tomato Growth Diary" notebook: "2025.10.11 Sowed cherry tomatoes," and drew a seed and a cloud. This little farm officially started.

events.name: Morning run recovery
events.description: At 5:50 a.m., Lu Mingqiang rode his bike alone to Wanlv Park. After warming up and stretching, he ran 5 kilometers along the seaside trail in about 33 minutes, with his pace improving to 6:35 per kilometer. After the run, he felt lighter than he did two days ago, and his heart and lungs were gradually finding their rhythm again. He went home, took a quick shower, and then urged the whole family to get up and get ready to go to his parents' house.

events.name: Visit parents on the weekend
events.description: At nine in the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove his wife and children from Longhua District and arrived at the old residential community in Meilan District where his parents lived in about twenty minutes. His mother Chen Xiuying greeted them with a smile at the door. His father Lu Jianguo was sitting under the pavilion playing chess with his chess friend Lao Zhang. When he looked up and saw his grandson, he quickly pushed the chess pieces aside and picked up Lu Zihan. The whole family went upstairs in high spirits.

events.name: Family lunch and father-son deep conversation
events.description: His mother prepared a table of dishes, and specially made his favorite Hainanese chicken rice for her son. During the meal, his father mentioned that a retired colleague's son had opened an electrical maintenance company in Guangzhou and it was doing well. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to say that he had won third place in a competition last month and was preparing for the senior technician exam, and might open a maintenance workshop in the future. His father put down his chopsticks and said seriously: "To open a shop you need qualifications; you have to pass the exam, and you need to inquire about storefront fire safety and the business license in advance." Lu Mingqiang nodded and kept this in mind.

events.name: Help mother repair the sliding door.
events.description: After lunch, his mother said the bottom wheels of the kitchen sliding door were broken and it squeaked when pushed. Lu Mingqiang found a screwdriver from his father's toolbox, removed the door panel, and saw that the wheels were badly worn. After noting the model number, he rode his father's electric bike to a nearby hardware store, spent 15 yuan to buy two new sets of wheels, then came back and installed them, also applying some grease to the track. The door slid smoothly and silently, and his mother said repeatedly, "That feels much better now."

events.name: Accompany father and children to the park.
events.description: Around 2 p.m., his father suggested taking the grandchildren to the nearby Bailong Park in Meilan District. Lu Mingqiang and his father each held a child's hand and walked around the artificial lake, while the children watched fish and chased butterflies. His father pointed at an old banyan tree and said, 'You used to play under this tree when you were little. Now your son is here—time really flies.' Lu Mingqiang smiled and photographed the backs of his father and grandson.

events.name: Sowing cherry tomato seeds, officially beginning the planting plan.
events.description: At 3:30 p.m. he got home. Lu Mingqiang took the tomato seeds that had all sprouted white from the kitchen windowsill and called his two sons over to the balcony. He had Lu Zixuan use a small shovel to dig a few shallow holes in the potting soil. Lu Zihan carefully placed the seeds in, and then the father and sons covered them with a thin layer of soil and watered them thoroughly with a watering can. Lu Zixuan brought out a new notebook and wrote “Tomato Growth Diary” on the cover. On the first page he recorded the date, the seed variety, and the sowing process, and drew a seed and the sun. Lu Mingqiang told his sons to observe the seeds every day but not to water too much, and they agreed to record data together every Sunday. The balcony mini farm was officially put into use.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to seeing my parents, and also thinking about the planting.

end_state.mood: Recharged by family love; the family's new plan brings a sense of hope

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 5 km, repaired the sliding door, walked around the park for about 1.5 hours, and did balcony planting work.

2025-10.daily_overview: A key step in preparing for the certification exam. In the morning, Lu Mingqiang listed the difficult problems he had accumulated during the week's review on paper, and packed a few dragon fruits as a gift.
