After lunch, he drove alone to Master Li's home in Meilan District. Master Li was in good spirits and invited him to sit on the balcony for tea, analyzing one by one the circuit analysis problems Lu had brought, and also demonstrating a few details in the practical operation standards that could easily lose points. When he left, Master Li took out a yellowed handwritten notebook from the study: "These are the notes I used when I took the technician exam. Take them and have a look." Lu Mingqiang accepted it with both hands and, back in the car, opened a page; the paper was brittle, but the ink was clear. After getting home, he spread the notebook on the desk and decided to use it as the outline for systematic review. That evening he studied from the notebook until nearly ten o'clock. To prevent a recurrence of shoulder and neck problems, he deliberately raised the desk lamp, propped up the book, and got up to move around every 45 minutes. Today his shoulder and neck were basically fine.

events.name: Organize difficult problems for exam preparation
events.description: At eight in the morning, Lu Mingqiang listed one by one in his notebook the points he did not understand from the scattered review during the week—mainly three-phase circuit unbalance analysis, the code for protective grounding on the secondary side of instrument transformers, PLC ladder diagram interpretation, and so on—eleven items in total. He also dug out the old multimeter, planning to take it for his master to look at. He asked his wife to pack five home-grown eggfruits and a few red-fleshed dragon fruits, wrapped in old newspaper.

events.name: Drove to my master's home.
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove his own car, turned on navigation, and set off from Longhua District. A light rain began to fall, so he turned on the windshield wipers and drove straight along Bailong North Road to No. 56 Haifu Road, Meilan District, arriving about twenty minutes later at the old residential community where Master Li lives. Master Li was watering flowers on the balcony and waved when he saw him.

events.name: Ask the master for help with difficult points in exam preparation
events.description: At Master Li's house, in the living room that doubled as a study, Lu Mingqiang spread out the questions he had listed on the tea table. Master Li put on his reading glasses and explained them one by one: he drew vector diagrams on paper with a pencil to analyze the three-phase imbalance, and took out a set of miniature contactors he had kept to demonstrate self-locking and interlocking circuits. Lu Mingqiang took out his multimeter to ask about the calibration of certain ranges, and Master Li also personally demonstrated comparison with a standard resistor. The two chatted for more than two hours, and the tea was refreshed three times.

events.name: Borrowed valuable exam-preparation notes.
events.description: After explaining the problem, Master Li got up and went into the inner room. After searching for a while, he took out a notebook whose cover was wrapped in kraft paper and handed it to Lu Mingqiang: “This is the notebook I kept when I was studying for the senior skilled worker exam in 2003 and later for the pre-exam training for the technician certificate. It has lots of mnemonics and common mistakes. Take it back, and don't get it dirty.” Lu Mingqiang took it, flipped through a few pages, and saw neatly written regular-script entries such as “quick-calculation mnemonics” and “cable ampacity estimation.” He felt warm inside and thanked him again and again.

events.name: Go home to study the notes and pay attention to sitting posture.
events.description: After getting home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang hastily ate a few bites and then went into the study. He placed his master's notebook in the center of the desk, flipped through it page by page, and photographed important points with his phone for archiving. Tonight he paid special attention to his sitting posture: he added a cushion to the chair and propped the notebook up on a book stand to avoid looking down. He studied from 8:00 to 9:50, organizing the exam-point structure of the first twenty pages, and got up to move around twice in between. His shoulders and neck felt good, and he planned to make this the main focus every evening going forward, combined with the question bank for review.

start_state.mood: Under pressure from exam preparation, but also filled with determination to solve problems.

end_state.mood: Grateful and uplifted; I now have precious study materials for the exam and a clear direction.

state.daily_exercise: Mainly indoor activities, no dedicated exercise

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, 28°C/20°C, north wind gradually picking up

2025-10.daily_overview: Work was getting on track, but his body was sending signals. Several consecutive days of manual labor and nighttime study left Lu Mingqiang clearly fatigued during the day, and one afternoon while moving cables in the warehouse he even felt momentary dizziness. He knew he could not stay up late anymore. That evening after returning home, he formally announced the “new rules” to the whole family: turn off phones at 10 p.m. every night, soak feet for fifteen minutes, and get into bed before 11 p.m. His wife responded enthusiastically and said he should have done this long ago. He set his phone alarm and strictly followed the rules on the first night. While soaking his feet in hot water, he closed his eyes and reviewed the day’s work, then lay down on time. The long-overdue early night gave his body a feeling of release as it sank into the mattress.

events.name: Physical fatigue signals on workdays
events.description: On Monday at work, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo went to a factory near Haisheng Road to make emergency repairs on the power distribution system that had tripped during the night. After the repair, they also helped the warehouse organize newly arrived cable reels. Around four in the afternoon, while moving a heavy cable reel, Lu Mingqiang felt dizzy and lightheaded and had to squat down for a few minutes to recover. Chen Jianguo handed him a bottle of water and advised him not to push himself too hard. Lu Mingqiang realized that it was caused by insufficient rest over several consecutive days combined with physical labor.

events.name: Decide to establish a regular daily routine.
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang talked with his wife Wang Lijuan at the dinner table about his physical reactions during the day, saying that with exam preparation and work, he had to ensure enough sleep. He proposed that from today on, he would turn off his phone at 22:00, soak his feet in warm water for 15 minutes, and go to bed before 23:00. Wang Lijuan strongly agreed, saying it was about time, and took over the task of supervising their son's homework in the evening to lighten his burden. Lu Mingqiang also decided to move his morning core stretching to after the evening foot soak as part of his bedtime routine.

events.name: First day of strictly following the daily schedule
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang turned off the TV, set his phone to Do Not Disturb, and put it on the nightstand in the bedroom. He went to the bathroom, filled a basin with warm water, sat down to soak his feet, and closed his eyes to relax, listening to his wife telling their son a story in the living room. Fifteen minutes later, he dried his feet, drank a small glass of warm water, and then did 5 minutes of core stretching (plank, lying leg raises). He got into bed at 22:10. Although his thoughts kept circling around circuit diagrams for a while, his body gradually relaxed, and he fell asleep at about 10:30. It was the earliest he had gone to sleep in recent weeks.

start_state.mood: His spirits were fairly good in the morning, but signs of fatigue appeared during the day.

end_state.mood: Enhanced sense of control over the body, falling asleep with the steadiness of having regained the rhythm.

state.daily_exercise: Heavy physical work, including carrying cables

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to rain showers, 26°C/21°C, high humidity.

2025-10.daily_overview: The second day of the routine. In the morning he got up at 5:50 according to the new plan and went to Wanlv Park for a 5 km morning run. Although the road was slippery after the rain and the pace dropped to 6 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, he still felt refreshed. The daytime work was routine maintenance, and he constantly reminded himself to follow the standards. He finished work early in the evening and got caught in a little rain on the way home. After arriving, he first went to the balcony with his sons to look at the cherry tomatoes; the pot remained quiet. After dinner, while helping his son with math, he yawned twice but resisted turning on the TV. After 9 o'clock, he went to the balcony again to check; the seeds still showed no signs of germination. He comforted the children and told them to be patient. At 10 o'clock sharp, he turned off his phone, soaked his feet, and did core stretching; he lay down before 10:45. Two consecutive days of going to bed early made him feel that his eyelids were no longer so heavy during the day.

events.name: Go for the usual morning run.
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, the alarm went off. Lu Mingqiang got up swiftly, washed up briefly, changed into sportswear, and cycled to Evergreen Park. The greenway was a little slippery after the rain, so he controlled his pace and completed a 5 km jog in 34 minutes. After running, he stretched thoroughly, returned home for a shower, and ate the nutritious breakfast his wife had prepared: eggs, oatmeal porridge, and cucumber salad. He felt much more energetic than yesterday.

events.name: Routine maintenance work on rainy days
events.description: The day's work schedule was fairly routine: in the morning, he went with Zhao Qiang to a residential complex in Longhua District to replace a set of old air switches; in the afternoon, he repaired the company's own power distribution room in Xiuying District. Because of light rain, he wore a raincoat for outdoor work, and even the voltage tester had to be kept dry. During the work, he deliberately applied the double-check method mentioned in his mentor's notes: 'first test for voltage, then test the tester, then test for voltage again.' Zhao Qiang quietly learned alongside. They wrapped up at 5 p.m., earlier than usual.

events.name: Remind mother to take care of her knees
events.description: Around 10 a.m., Lu Mingqiang saw a weather push notification on his phone during a work break saying it would be overcast and rainy this week, so he immediately called his mother. On the phone, he repeatedly told her to use a hot water bottle to warm her knees before the weather turned cold, to apply the medicated patch every other day, and not to wait until it hurt to use it. His mother agreed and also urged him to wear an extra jacket when going out so he wouldn’t catch a cold. After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang added a weekly Sunday reminder in his calendar: “Ask Mom about her knees.”

events.name: Tutoring son and observing plant growth.
events.description: After dinner during the children's homework time, Lu Mingqiang taught Lu Zixuan a math problem using the 'truncation method' for estimation, explaining approximate numbers with the example of planting cherry tomatoes. Then the father and his two sons took a small flashlight to the balcony to look at the flowerpot. The soil surface was still flat and clean, the seeds had not yet sprouted, but the soil smelled fresh. Lu Zixuan wrote in his observation diary: 'Day 3: no sprout yet, the soil is wet.' Lu Mingqiang told him to be patient, that it was like learning a skill—you can't rush it.

events.name: Second day of sticking to the new daily routine.
events.description: At 9:50 p.m., Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone, got some hot water to soak his feet, and did 15 minutes of core training and neck-shoulder stretches (plank, supine leg raises, wall angels). Outside, the rain was pattering. While soaking his feet, he chatted briefly with Wang Lijuan about whether to go to the bookstore on the weekend to buy their son an illustrated book on electrical science. At around 10:15 he dried his feet and went to bed, falling asleep quickly.

start_state.mood: Woke up feeling lighter than yesterday morning.

end_state.mood: A regular routine brings a subtle yet certain sense of control.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km, maintenance work, walking commute in the rain

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with few clouds, 29°C/21°C, clear and crisp autumn weather

2025-10.daily_overview: A highlight day in October. Lu Mingqiang represented the company in the municipal electric power industry skills competition. The theory exam went smoothly, and in the practical section his wiring was fast and standard, ultimately winning third place and a 3,000 yuan bonus. At the award ceremony he clenched his fist, not showing too much, but his heart was filled with professional pride. Client Boss Li said on the spot that the empty shop next door was suitable for opening a repair shop, and those words were like sparks landing on dry firewood. In the evening his wife prepared a celebration dinner: steamed fish, Hainanese chicken rice, and a small cake. He ate a bit more than usual and drank half a glass of beer. In his excitement, he marked Wenchang as the first stop of the island loop on his phone map, and searched for prices of used lifting platforms. Then he wrote in his memo: "Workshop launch: focus on technical guidance, costs must be controlled within 50,000 yuan." Before bed, he soaked his feet and studied his master's notes for half an hour, copying a complex circuit diagram. When he turned off the light and lay down, he was overflowing with happiness.

events.name: Preparing to take part in the municipal electric power skills competition
events.description: Waking up at 6:10 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang checked his tool bag again: electrician's knife, wire strippers, crimping pliers, multimeter, voltage tester, and so on, all complete. He also flipped through the page on "Wiring Speed Deduction Points in Competition" in his master's notes. He put on his clean company uniform, and his wife helped straighten his collar, saying "Don't be nervous." At 7:30 he rode his electric bike to the Haikou Vocational Skills Competition Center in Xiuying District.

events.name: Competition theory exam and practical skills contest
events.description: The morning theory exam covered electrical fundamentals, safety regulations, and drawing interpretation analysis. He worked steadily and finished all questions with ten minutes left to check. The afternoon practical exam required completing the installation and power-on test of a motor forward-reverse control circuit within the allotted time. Relying on daily experience and the recent standardized reinforcement training, Lu Mingqiang's wiring was neat and straight, wire number tubes were all in place, and the bundling was clean; he passed the fault simulation test on the first attempt. The examiner lingered a little longer in front of his workstation and nodded.

events.name: Won third place and prize money
events.description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, the results were announced: Lu Mingqiang won third place in the Haikou Power Industry Skills Competition, with a prize of 3,000 yuan. During the awards ceremony, he went on stage to shake hands and take photos with the other two winners. In the audience, Manager Liu and Team Leader Zhang from the company led the applause. Lu Mingqiang took the certificate, his emotions surging: in fourteen years in the industry, this was the first time he had earned a city-level ranking through technical skill, and it carried great weight.

events.name: Client Boss Li mentioned the possibility of opening a store.
events.description: After the event, client Li Jianguo came over specially to congratulate him. He praised Lu Mingqiang's steady skills and pointed diagonally across from his shop: 'There's an empty shop for rent over there, less than 20 square meters. If you want to open your own repair shop, it's just right.' Lu Mingqiang's heart skipped a beat, but he said, 'I'll finish the certificate exam first and think it over carefully.' After parting with Boss Li, he stood where he was and looked at the closed rolling shutter door. The frontage was small, but he could almost see a sign.

events.name: Family celebration dinner
events.description: After returning home, Wang Lijuan had prepared a table of dishes: steamed grouper, Hainanese chicken rice, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with garlic, and a small fresh cream cake. Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan presented their handmade “Dad is Number One” cards. Lu Mingqiang made an exception and drank half a glass of beer, clinked glasses with his wife, and said, “This bonus goes into the studio fund.” He ate half a bowl more rice than usual, and after the meal he even took his wife and children for a ten-minute walk around the neighborhood.

events.name: That evening, he conceived plans for the island road trip and the studio.
events.description: At eight in the evening, after the children were asleep, Lu Mingqiang sat at his computer, opened a map, and searched for homestays in Dongjiao Coconut Grove in Wenchang and tickets for Tongguling, then made a simple favorites folder. He also looked at prices for lifts on a second-hand equipment platform, ranging from 800 to 3,000 yuan. In his memo, he formally wrote: '2025.10.15 Studio launch: focus on technical guidance, no large-scale construction, costs must be kept within 50,000 yuan. Target customers: property owners in residential communities and temporary shops.'

events.name: Stick to a regular schedule and combine it with study
events.description: At 9:30, Lu Mingqiang turned off the computer, fetched hot water to soak his feet, and opened his master's handwritten notes. Under the light, he carefully studied the chapter “Fault Diagnosis of Three-Phase Asynchronous Motors,” wrote his own understanding in the margins with a red pen, and copied a complex circuit diagram. That night he studied twenty minutes longer than usual and did not close the notes until 10:20. With the lingering satisfaction of winning the award and thoughts about the future, he fell asleep around 10:40.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but ready to go, tense and focused.

end_state.location: Home study (also used as bedroom area)
end_state.mood: Feeling greatly inspired by the honor, the entrepreneurial blueprint is beginning to take shape, and I am full of confidence in the future.

state.daily_exercise: The competition practical test was physically demanding; took a ten-minute walk in the evening.

2025-10.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang started the new day amid congratulations from his colleagues and worked normally in the morning. At noon, he used his break to go to Meilan District to inspect in person the shop that Boss Li had mentioned, taking a substantial step toward his dream of a studio. After work, he went straight to the electrical appliance store and used his competition prize money to buy a new electric water heater. Back home, he skillfully removed the old unit and installed the new one, and also thoroughly checked the household circuit load to ensure electrical safety. In the evening, he went to the court for the postponed squash training and regained his feel for the ball. At night, he turned off his phone, soaked his feet to relax, and went to bed early to recharge his body and mind.

events.name: Morning routine and work commute
events.description: He got up at 6:10 in the morning, washed up briefly, and ate the breakfast his wife had prepared (Hainan rice noodles and eggs). Because he had won an award in the competition the day before, several coworkers came to congratulate him when he arrived at the company, and Team Leader Zhang also publicly praised him at the morning meeting. Lu Mingqiang smiled and responded modestly. In the morning, he partnered with Chen Jianguo to go to a newly built shop in Xiuying District to install a three-phase meter box. The two worked in good coordination and finished by 11:30.

events.name: Visit vacant shop spaces during lunch break
events.description: After getting off work at noon, Lu Mingqiang didn't take time to eat at the company and drove to Boss Li's electrical appliance repair shop in Meilan District. Upon arrival, Boss Li showed him the vacant shop space next door. It was about 30 square meters, with water and electricity hookups and a rolling shutter door, and there was decent foot traffic in front. The two talked in detail inside the shop. Boss Li told him the monthly rent was about 2,500 yuan, that he would need to register as an individual business and obtain an electrician's special operation certificate, and sincerely suggested that Lu Mingqiang first get the senior technician certificate before opening the shop, promising to help introduce customers then. Lu Mingqiang took photos of the layout and the street number with his phone, noted down the key information, then hurried back to the company, grabbing a boxed meal at a roadside fast-food restaurant on the way.

events.name: Afternoon routine maintenance
events.description: In the afternoon, back at the company, Lu Mingqiang continued with Chen Jianguo to another residential community to deal with the aging public hallway lighting wiring. They replaced more than ten meters of wire and several sound-activated switches. While working, he was still calculating the rent and start-up capital in his head.

events.name: Select a new electric water heater
events.description: After getting off work at 6 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove to an appliance store near Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District. He compared two 40-liter storage electric water heaters, chose a new energy-saving model with a leakage protection function, and paid 1,200 yuan with the prize money he had won in a competition. The store clerk helped lift the box into the trunk, and he drove it straight home.

events.name: Disassembling the old, aging electric water heater
events.description: After arriving home, Lu Mingqiang first turned off the main breaker for the dedicated circuit of the bathroom electric water heater, then closed the inlet valve, and opened the hot water tap to drain the remaining water in the tank. Wearing insulated gloves, he carefully used tools to disconnect the inlet/outlet pipes and power cord, lifted the old unit that had served for many years off the wall, and carried it to the living room floor. His wife Wang Lijuan helped by handing him tools, while his eldest son Lu Zixuan squatted nearby, watching curiously how his father did it.

events.name: Installed a new electric water heater and checked the electrical circuits throughout the house.
events.description: Following the instruction manual, Lu Mingqiang drilled new expansion bolt holes in the wall, mounted the new unit firmly, and connected the stainless steel corrugated water pipe and the power cord with leakage protection. After switching on the power, he carefully checked the current on each branch circuit in the distribution box, used a multimeter to measure the outlet grounding, and confirmed that the total household circuit load did not exceed 40 amps and the leakage protector operated reliably. When everything met the standard, he nodded with satisfaction.

events.name: Teaching wife safe operation.
events.description: After the installation was complete, Lu Mingqiang called his wife into the bathroom, pointed at the control panel, and patiently explained how to set the water temperature and use the timed heating function. He also demonstrated the test button on the leakage protection plug, teaching her to cut off the power immediately if she heard abnormal sounds or smelled a burning odor. Wang Lijuan listened attentively and pressed it herself several times. Only after confirming that she knew how to operate it did Lu Mingqiang feel relieved.

events.name: Children watching and parent-child interaction
events.description: Throughout the process, his eldest son Lu Zixuan and younger son Lu Zihan gathered around. Lu Zixuan kept asking, “Dad, why are there three wires?” “What is the principle of leakage protection?” Lu Mingqiang explained in simple words, and the little boy's eyes were full of admiration. Although the younger son did not quite understand, he imitated his brother and clapped happily. After the installation, Lu Mingqiang patted his two sons' heads and told them that if they study hard, they can build even more powerful machines in the future.

events.name: Squash training (make-up for October 15).
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang hurried to his usual squash club for a delayed training session with his squash partner Lin Feng. Since he hadn't played for a week, he clearly felt his touch was off and his stamina couldn't keep up, so he stopped early after only 45 minutes of play. Lin Feng suggested he do more core strength exercises to stay stable. After the session, the two chatted about how they had been doing.

events.name: Discuss startup plans with his wife.
events.description: Just after 9 p.m., Lu Mingqiang got home; his two sons were already asleep. In the living room, he showed his wife the shop space he had inspected at noon and the photos he had taken, and explained in detail his idea of first obtaining certification and building up clients before renting a place to open a studio. After listening, Wang Lijuan expressed support, but also reminded him to stay steady and cautious: first pass the senior technician certification, since the family had little savings and he should not rush ahead within half a year. Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement and decided to focus all his energy on preparing for the exam first.

events.name: Day 4 of executing the sleep plan
events.description: At 22:00, Lu Mingqiang proactively turned off his phone and stopped scrolling through news and forums. He soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes to relax his whole body. Then he checked the doors and windows, got into bed at 23:15, and, tired from the squash exercise, quickly fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Energetic and still excited about winning the award yesterday

end_state.mood: Fulfilled and determined, with a preliminary direction for starting a business

state.daily_exercise: Squash training for 45 minutes

2025-10.daily_overview: On the fifth day of regular sleep, Lu Mingqiang completed his daily electrical repair work during the day. In the evening, he put on his running shoes and went jogging in Wanlv Garden, enjoying some alone time to think. At night, he helped his eldest son with homework and dug out his master's notes to review electrical theory, accumulating fragments of knowledge for the certification exam. Life was balanced, with family and self-improvement going hand in hand.

events.name: Morning routine.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang woke up at 6:10 and felt that it was easier to get up than in the previous days, no longer drowsy. After washing up, he drank a cup of warm water, and his wife had already prepared sweet egg soup and steamed buns. After eating quickly, he drove to take the two children to school separately first, and then headed to the company.

events.name: Morning: install wiring for shops.
events.description: Today’s task was to go with Zhao Qiang to a newly renovated convenience store for the final wire layout and socket installation. While working, Lu Mingqiang explained the wiring standards to Zhao Qiang, especially the need for waterproof sockets near water sources. Zhao Qiang listened attentively and picked things up quickly. Lu Mingqiang felt that this young man had good aptitude.

events.name: Chatted with fellow workers at noon.
events.description: At noon, he ate at a small restaurant near the company. Chen Jianguo and Zhang Jianguo from the same shift were also there. The three talked about children's education. Chen Jianguo complained that his daughter refused to attend tutoring classes. Lu Mingqiang shared the experience of how his son improved in math and suggested not pushing too hard—finding the right teacher is key.

events.name: Afternoon equipment maintenance
events.description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo returned to the company warehouse to maintain and calibrate several commonly used cable testers and insulation resistance meters. They checked the batteries and test leads to ensure the equipment would be accurate on the next job. Team Leader Zhang came over and told them that there might be a rainstorm warning over the weekend, reminding everyone to pay attention to outdoor work safety. Lu Mingqiang checked the raincoat in his bag.

events.name: Evening jog at Wanlv Park
events.description: After going home and resting for half an hour after work, Lu Mingqiang changed into breathable sportswear and running shoes and drove to Wanlv Park. He ran 5 kilometers along the greenway, keeping a pace of about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, thinking about work and exam arrangements while running. After finishing, he stretched by the lake, breathing in the slightly humid evening air, and felt much of the week's fatigue melt away.

events.name: Helped my eldest son with math homework
events.description: After dinner, Lu Zixuan took out his math homework because there was a problem about two objects meeting that he didn't quite understand. Lu Mingqiang explained it step by step using diagrams, and his son quickly understood and said excitedly, “So it's that simple!” Lu Mingqiang patted him on the shoulder with relief and encouraged him to keep it up.

events.name: Evening independent review
events.description: Around 9 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang went into the study and opened the notes that Master Li had lent him, focusing on reviewing transformer protection principles and primary wiring diagrams. He compared them with the textbook and circled what he didn't understand with a red pen, planning to ask his master next time. After studying for half an hour, he felt that some problems were indeed hard to solve by self-study alone, and he looked forward to the systematic course even more.

events.name: Day 5 of carrying out the sleep plan
events.description: Turned off his phone at 22:00, soaked his feet in warm water for 15 minutes, closing his eyes and relaxing during that time, and reviewed what he had learned that day. Went to bed before 23:10 and fell asleep quickly.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed and motivated

end_state.mood: Relaxed, body feeling the pleasant ease after exercise

state.daily_exercise: Jog 5 kilometers

2025-10.daily_overview: On a rest-day morning, Lu Mingqiang took his two sons to Hainan Provincial Library, starting a journey of knowledge. The eldest son made clear his dream of becoming an engineer, which made him feel deeply gratified. He himself also borrowed books on industrial history and electrical engineering, extending his certification exam study to thematic reading. After returning home in the afternoon, he took the children to the park to fly kites, enjoying relaxed parent-child time. In the evening, he organized his study notes and maintained his regular routine.

events.name: Weekend wake-up and watering balcony vegetables
events.description: On his day off, Lu Mingqiang slept until 7:00. After waking up, he first went to the balcony to check on the cherry tomato plants he had planted two weeks earlier; the seedlings had already grown true leaves. He guided his two sons to water them with small spray bottles, asked them to observe the changes in the leaves, and record the growth height. His younger son, Lu Zihan, asked in a baby voice, “When can we eat them?”, making the whole family laugh.

events.name: Prepare to go out and drive to the Provincial Library.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang helped his wife dress the two sons neatly and changed into a clean shirt himself. He brought a water bottle, biscuits, and wet wipes, checked the car, and started the family car. With his two sons, he set out from home in Longhua District, took Guoxing Avenue to Hainan Provincial Library in Qiongshan District, a drive of about 25 minutes. On the way, Lu Zixuan excitedly pointed at a newly opened bookstore outside the window, and Lu Mingqiang promised to take him next time.

events.name: Activities in the children's section and adult section of the Provincial Library.
events.description: After arriving at the library, Lu Mingqiang first took his sons to the children's reading area. Lu Zixuan ran over to the popular science bookshelf, picked The Mysteries of Electricity and Illustrated Principles of Mechanics, carried them back and said seriously to his father, Dad, I want to be an engineer when I grow up, just as great as you! Lu Mingqiang felt a warm surge in his heart. Remembering that he had just won third place in the skills competition, he felt all his efforts were worth it. Lu Zihan, meanwhile, sat at the low table flipping through the picture book The Little Train. After settling the children, Lu Mingqiang went to the adult area. To verify the history of the collected liquor bottle and understand the motor principles involved in the competition, he applied for a library card and borrowed The Industrial History of Hainan and Three Hundred Essential Questions on Electrical Fundamentals. He also used a computer in the e-reading room to search for several introductory PLC articles, planning to study them in depth after getting the certificate.

events.name: Group photo in front of the library
events.description: At 12 noon, the three of them asked a passerby to take a commemorative photo on the steps in front of the library. Lu Mingqiang had one arm around each son, smiling brightly. He sent the photo to the family WeChat group. His father Lu Jianguo immediately gave it a like and sent a voice message saying the grandsons had grown much taller.

events.name: Drove back to the home in Longhua District.
events.description: Around 1 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove the boys back. On the way, they passed a familiar tea restaurant and bought two portions of Hainanese chicken rice to take home. When they arrived, his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared qingbuliang, and the whole family had lunch together.

events.name: Flying kites at Wanlv Garden
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang took his treasured traditional butterfly kite out of the storage room and checked the bridle line and tail. He drove the whole family to Evergreen Park, where on the lawn he taught his two sons how to pull the line and run into the wind. After the kite rose steadily into the air, he let his eldest son control it alone; the little boy was nervous and excited. His wife took photos nearby, a gentle breeze blew, and the family enjoyed a peaceful afternoon.

events.name: Evening reading on industrial history and simple stretching
events.description: At night, after the children went to bed, Lu Mingqiang browsed The History of Hainan Industry in his study. Reading the chapter on Hainan's electric power construction in the 1980s, he deeply felt how hard the predecessors had worked. He copied down a few key years and data into his notebook, planning to tell his sons about them later. Then he did 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to avoid discomfort from sitting too long.

events.name: Day six of carrying out the sleep plan.
events.description: At 22:00 turned off his phone, soaked his feet in warm water for 15 minutes, and relaxed his muscles. Went to bed before 23:05, saving energy for tomorrow's family visit.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and happy, looking forward to spending the weekend with my son.

end_state.mood: Gratified and content because he saw his son's growth and dreams.

state.daily_exercise: Kite flying (light outdoor activity), 10 minutes of evening stretching

2025-10.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang and his family of four drove to his parents' home in Meilan District to spend Sunday together. The Hainanese chicken rice cooked by his mother was a treat for the whole family, and his father gave simple yet profound encouragement for his son's work achievements and entrepreneurial ideas. The warm reunion strengthened Lu Mingqiang's resolve, and after returning home in the evening, he and his wife once again agreed on a steady and sure pace.

events.name: Pre-departure preparations
events.description: He got up at 7 a.m. Lu Mingqiang checked the car's fuel level and tires, while his wife Wang Lijuan packed the fruit and pastries to bring to his parents' home. The two sons were excited when they heard they were going to their grandparents' house and took the initiative to help carry the bags. At exactly 9 o'clock, the family set off from Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District.

events.name: Arriving at parents' home and family interaction
events.description: About a 20-minute drive to the old residential community on Haifu Road, Meilan District, where his parents live. Father Lu Jianguo was playing chess with neighbors downstairs. Seeing the grandsons running over, he immediately put down his chess pieces with a cheerful smile. Mother Chen Xiuying had been watching for them at the door, picked up the second son, and gave him a kiss. Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat in the living room with his parents, drinking tea and chatting. His mother nagged that he looked thinner again and told him to be careful. Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside.

events.name: Mother meticulously made Hainanese chicken rice
events.description: Early in the morning, Chen Xiuying used Wenchang chicken and fragrant rice to prepare her specialty dish. Lu Mingqiang came into the kitchen to help chop the chicken, and his wife washed the vegetables. When the chicken rice was served, the aroma filled the room, and the dipping sauce was perfectly mixed. The eldest grandson, Lu Zixuan, ate two bowls in one go and kept praising Grandma for making it tastier than anything from outside.

events.name: The whole family sits around the table for lunch
events.description: On the table were Hainanese chicken rice, sweet potato leaves with shrimp paste, winter melon and sea snail soup, and pan-fried mackerel. Lu Mingqiang poured a small glass of homemade rice wine for his father, and the father and son clinked glasses. They chatted about family matters as they ate. His father mentioned an interesting story about the recent electrical renovation in the community, and Lu Mingqiang also shared his experience of the emergency cable repair a few days earlier.

events.name: A long private father-son talk.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang sat down with his father on the balcony. He described in detail how he had won the skill competition and frankly shared his idea of opening a repair workshop in the next few years. Lu Jianguo nodded approvingly and praised him for his ambition, but with more than forty years of electrician experience, he advised him: skills must be solid, and you also need to know how to deal with people. He suggested first obtaining the senior technician certificate, building a good reputation and accumulating funds, and then planning further growth. Lu Mingqiang took this seriously to heart.

events.name: Farewell on the way back
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang's family said goodbye to his parents. His mother stuffed a full bag of freshly made yiba cakes for them to take home. The two sons reluctantly said goodbye to their grandparents and promised to come again next week. They drove back to Longhua District. On the way, his wife said his father's advice was very pertinent, and Lu Mingqiang agreed.

events.name: Evening discussion between husband and wife
events.description: After the children fell asleep at night, Lu Mingqiang and his wife leaned against the headboard and talked about starting a business again. Wang Lijuan said, "Dad is right. We'll take it step by step. First get the certificate. I'll cover the daily household expenses, so you can focus on studying." Lu Mingqiang was moved and held her hand, full of expectations for the coming year.

events.name: Day 7 of the sleep plan
events.description: Turn off the phone at 22:00, soak feet in warm water for 15 minutes, go to bed before 23:00. Follow the healthy routine fully for a week.

start_state.mood: Warm, looking forward to family reunion.

end_state.mood: Down-to-earth, and full of motivation after gaining family support.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise

2025-10.daily_overview: On a Monday workday, Lu Mingqiang guided his apprentice Zhao Qiang to complete the electric meter upgrade task. The biggest surprise that evening came from his eldest son's math test paper. When the couple saw that the child no longer left word problems blank and his scores were rising steadily, they decided to continue investing in his education and extend the tutoring until the end of the year. In the rainy night, the warmth of home felt especially real.

events.name: Take the children to school and go to work
events.description: At 6:15 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang took his two children to school and kindergarten in a light rain, then headed to the company. The roads were slippery in the rain, so he drove a few extra minutes. After arriving at the company, Team Leader Zhang assigned today's team tasks.

events.name: Community electricity meter upgrade work
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang took Zhao Qiang to an old residential community on Jinpan Road to replace the old mechanical electricity meters with smart meters. He let Zhao Qiang do the disassembly and installation while he supervised, and corrected Zhao Qiang's improper wire-stripping length. The work lasted until 11:30, and they completed replacements for 12 households.

events.name: Lunchtime chat with workmates over fast food.
events.description: At noon, in the fast-food restaurant at the entrance to the residential complex, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang ate pork trotter rice and chatted. Chen Jianguo mentioned that his family was planning to change their refrigerator, and Lu Mingqiang suggested he wait for the month-end mall promotion. Zhao Qiang then said his parents back home wanted him to find a girlfriend in Haikou and settle down, and the other two teased him about it.

events.name: Afternoon archive sorting
events.description: In the afternoon, the company required each team to organize the maintenance work orders and material requisition records from the past six months. Lu Mingqiang and his team members checked the numbers and bound the forms in the office. His handwriting was neat and the data were clear, and Manager Liu praised him once during a routine inspection.

events.name: Eldest son shows math test paper
events.description: When he got home at 6 p.m., Lu Zixuan excitedly pulled the math unit test paper out of his schoolbag. The score of 88 made Lu Mingqiang's eyes light up. He looked it over carefully and found that the word problems, which he often left blank before, had all been done seriously this time, with points only deducted for calculation errors. Lu Mingqiang happily picked up his son and spun him around, repeatedly saying good son.

events.name: Husband and wife discuss extending tutoring
events.description: At the dinner table, Wang Lijuan also looked at the test paper. After the meal, while washing dishes in the kitchen, the two discussed it and agreed that it proved the tutoring was effective, so they should strike while the iron was hot and extend the math tutoring until the end of the year. The wife reminded him that it would cost an extra 600 yuan each month, but it would be worth it as long as it worked. Lu Mingqiang nodded and decided that his wife would contact the tutor the next day to confirm the renewal.

events.name: Homework correction tutoring and evening companionship.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang helped his son correct the wrong problems and used examples of getting change when shopping to illustrate mixed addition and subtraction operations. His son quickly understood. Afterward, the family watched TV for half an hour, and the younger son fell asleep nestled in his mother's arms, in a warm atmosphere.

events.name: Continuing sleep routine
events.description: At 22:00, as usual, he turned off his phone. While soaking his feet, Lu Mingqiang skimmed the work group chat to confirm the next day’s arrangements. He fell asleep before 23:00, with the sound of rain helping him sleep.

start_state.mood: Keeping a calm mindset, feeling a bit down because of the cloudy rain.

end_state.mood: Feeling gratified and proud of the child's progress.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise; physical labor at work.

2025-10.daily_overview: This was a highly intense and glorious day. In the afternoon, a sudden main cable failure occurred in the residential complex. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo rushed out and worked continuously for 4 hours in the sweltering heat, finally restoring power at 9 p.m., ensuring normal life for hundreds of households. Their professionalism and dedication earned written praise from the property management, and brought Lu Mingqiang's sense of professional achievement to a new height.

events.name: Morning tool maintenance
events.description: After arriving at the company in the morning, Lu Mingqiang used the time before starting work to clean the multimeter test leads with alcohol wipes and lubricated the moving joint of the cable cutters. He had a hunch that a big job might be coming up soon, so his tools had to be kept in top condition.

events.name: Morning inspection of office building power distribution room
events.description: In the morning, Team Leader Zhang arranged for him and Zhao Qiang to go to an office building in Guomao for the quarterly safety inspection of the electrical distribution room. Lu Mingqiang measured the current of each circuit and checked the busbar temperature. He found that a wiring terminal was slightly oxidized, immediately polished it with sandpaper and re-tightened it, eliminating a latent hazard. Zhao Qiang took notes beside him and learned the details of the inspection.

events.name: Received an emergency repair call
events.description: Just as Lu Mingqiang sat down in the company cafeteria at noon, his phone rang. The caller was Director Wang of the Jinmao Middle Road residential community property management. In an urgent tone, he told Lu that a main cable fault had caused power outages across several buildings, affecting hundreds of households. Lu Mingqiang immediately agreed to help, quickly notified his workmate Chen Jianguo, and the two put down their chopsticks and rushed to the warehouse to prepare repair supplies.

events.name: Fault location and solution determination
events.description: At 13:00, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo arrived at the scene carrying a cable detector, generator, joint materials, and protective equipment. They traced along the cable route and finally found slight scorch marks on the ground near the flowerbed, determining that the buried cable had short-circuited due to long-term moisture and aging. Lu Mingqiang reported to team leader Zhang, who had arrived at the scene, and they decided to immediately make an intermediate joint and replace about two meters of the damaged section.

events.name: A grueling four-hour emergency repair battle.
events.description: The two took turns inside the enclosed safety area. They first installed safety grounding at both ends of the faulty cable, then stripped the semiconductive layer and peeled off the main insulation layer by layer. The afternoon was humid and overcast, and sweat soaked the backs of their work clothes. In accordance with the process requirements, they crimped the connector, polished the insulation ends, and wrapped stress-control tape; every step was meticulous. Chen Jianguo handed tools and Lu Mingqiang did the main operation, and the two cooperated very quickly. After the joint was wrapped, they also carried out insulation resistance tests and voltage withstand tests section by section to ensure the new joint was completely reliable.

events.name: Confirmed and restored power supply building by building.
events.description: At 9 p.m., all emergency repairs were completed. The moment Lu Mingqiang pressed the main switch, the streetlights in the community and the corridor lights in each building lit up one after another, and many residents clapped from their balconies. To ensure safety, he nevertheless went building by building to check the voltage and phase sequence in the meter boxes, confirmed that all units were normal, and signed the property management logbook.

events.name: Tired return home and bedtime routine
events.description: It was nearly 9:40 p.m. when he got home. His wife had kept the meal for him. He ate it quickly and took a hot bath. Though his whole body was sore and tired, he felt very pleased. He forced himself to stay awake to soak his feet, then fell asleep as soon as his head hit the pillow, entering a deep sleep before 23:00.

start_state.mood: Energetic and ready for the day's work

end_state.mood: Extremely exhausted but filled with a sense of accomplishment and pride.

state.daily_exercise: High-intensity emergency repair.

2025-10.daily_overview: The commendation letter for the emergency repair was sent to the company, and Lu Mingqiang gained great professional satisfaction from his colleagues' praise. In the evening, he went to play squash as usual, proactively asked about sports injury prevention, and consciously applied scientific body mechanics to carrying. At night, he made a year-end gathering appointment with an old classmate far away in Shenzhen. The rekindled friendship made him feel how precious time is.

events.name: Praise at the morning meeting
events.description: At the morning pre-shift meeting, Squad Leader Zhang read aloud a letter of commendation from the property management of Jinmao Middle Road Residential Community in front of the whole team. The letter highly praised the technical skills and dedication of Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo. Manager Liu came by and orally announced that each of them would receive an outstanding employee award, which would be reflected in the year-end evaluation. Lu Mingqiang was a bit embarrassed but very pleased at heart.

events.name: Morning box-type transformer inspection.
events.description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo were dispatched to inspect several public box transformers along Binhai Avenue. Combining the key points from Master Li's notes on transformer oil level and breather inspection, he observed especially carefully and found that the silica gel in one box transformer had changed color, so he immediately recorded it and reported it for repair. While working, he began consciously using his legs and core to lift heavy items, and his lower back indeed felt more comfortable.

events.name: Afternoon cable handling training
events.description: In the afternoon, the company received a new batch of cables, and the work team collectively moved them into storage. While carrying, Lu Mingqiang explained lower-back protection techniques to Zhao Qiang and demonstrated the core-tightening, knee-bending squat movements he had just learned from squash. Several older co-workers also tried them and said they were good.

events.name: Squash training and asking about core protection
events.description: After getting off work at 5:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang drove directly to the squash club. During training today, he specially asked his fellow player Lin Feng how to avoid twisting his waist and shoulders when hitting the ball. Lin Feng taught him several core-activation exercises and pointed out that he had been excessively arching his lower back during his swing. Lu Mingqiang practiced the backhand wall shot for half an hour, trying to use his hips to drive the turn, and felt that his shots were much smoother. During a break, he thought to himself that this kind of fine control of the body would certainly be useful in future smart home installation and debugging.

events.name: Called an old classmate and created a group chat.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang received a WeChat voice call from Zhou Wei, his middle school classmate, in Shenzhen. The two chatted about how they had been for half an hour. Zhou Wei said he would definitely return to Haikou by the end of this year and suggested that they get together with Wu Gang for a gathering. Lu Mingqiang readily agreed, then contacted Wu Gang. The three created a small group called Youth Days. In the group, they posted old graduation photos. Lu Mingqiang found a photo of a treasured bottle of old liquor he had kept and posted it, saying that everyone should bring a story behind their bottle to the gathering. Wu Gang and Zhou Wei responded enthusiastically and agreed to be there no matter what.

events.name: Continue the bedtime ritual.
events.description: At 22:00 he turned off his phone. While soaking his feet in warm water, Lu Mingqiang couldn't help looking at old photos in the group chat again, a smile at the corner of his mouth. At 22:55 he went to bed and fell asleep quickly.

start_state.mood: Good, morale is high because of praise.

end_state.mood: Pleasant and warm, the warmth of revisiting an old friendship lingers.

state.daily_exercise: Squash training for 60 minutes (including core-specific exercises)

2025-10.daily_overview: During the morning jog, Lu Mingqiang and his running buddy Chen Bin agreed to run a marathon together in the future. During the day he worked efficiently to troubleshoot problems, and in the evening he had an in-depth exchange with old classmate Wu Gang at the Laoba Tea House about entrepreneurial ideas, gaining a promise of local customer resources. That day, both his healthy lifestyle and career network moved forward.

events.name: Morning Run Encounter and Marathon Promise
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang ran 5 kilometers along the greenway at Wanlv Park. This was his first day back to morning running, with a pace of about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer; his breathing was slightly quick but his rhythm was fine. Halfway through, he ran into Chen Bin, who often ran with him. Chen Bin excitedly said he had signed up for the Wanning Half Marathon in December and urged him to sign up too. Lu Mingqiang thought about it and said he had to take a certification exam in November and really couldn't spare the time, but he promised to run a half marathon with Chen Bin in the first half of next year. They chatted while running, and after finishing, they felt refreshed and invigorated.

events.name: Morning factory power distribution cabinet maintenance
events.description: After his morning run, Lu Mingqiang went home, showered, and ate, then hurried to the company. Today the team received an urgent order to go to a food factory in Gangao Industrial Zone to repair a power distribution cabinet that had tripped. He and Chen Jianguo used a megohmmeter to test it section by section and found that a heating tube was short-circuited to ground. The two quickly replaced the heating tube and the scorched contactor, and the factory production line resumed operation at 11 o'clock. The person in charge gave a thumbs up.

events.name: Midday nap and an idea to study in spare time
events.description: At noon, he had a free work meal at the factory cafeteria. During the break, Lu Mingqiang scrolled through two posts about PLC control on an electrician forum on his phone. The more he read, the more he felt that systematic study was urgent. He decided to find a suitable online course and sign up soon.

events.name: Afternoon routine installation tasks
events.description: In the afternoon, the company sent him to a newly opened barbershop on Haixiu Middle Road to install a three-phase electric water heater. Lu Mingqiang finished the job within an hour. The boss was satisfied and, as he was leaving, stuffed two wash-cut-blow experience vouchers into his hand. Lu Mingqiang smiled and thanked him, thinking he could bring his sons for haircuts.

events.name: Contact an old classmate to arrange tea
events.description: Before leaving work in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang sent Wu Gang a WeChat message, inviting him to meet up tonight at their usual spot in Longhua District—the Dad's Tea Shop at the street corner of Qunshang Village—to catch up. Wu Gang readily agreed.

events.name: In-depth exchange at the Laoba Tea House
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lu Mingqiang walked to a tea shop full of local life. Wu Gang had already ordered two glasses of iced drip coffee and two bowls of qingbuliang. The two talked about everything from kids to work. Lu Mingqiang excitedly mentioned winning a competition and preparing for the senior technician exam, and also told him everything about inspecting the storefront. Wu Gang was very supportive, saying he was skilled and reliable and that a repair studio would surely find a market. He promised on the spot to help introduce customers in the community group after the store opened, and suggested he keep in touch with the property management company. They didn't leave until after 9.

events.name: Bedtime review and planning
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang washed off the smell of smoke and tea and soaked his feet as usual. Recalling Wu Gang's words, he wrote in his phone memo: 'Maintain property management relationships, long-term customer source.' He went to bed at 22:50 and soon fell sound asleep.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, looking forward to the morning run.

end_state.mood: Inspired and more confident about future career

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers.

2025-10.daily_overview: A plain but fulfilling workday. Lu Mingqiang conscientiously mentored Zhao Qiang, who is like a nephew to him, at work, and in the evening returned home to continue spending time with family. In the morning he completed an 8-kilometer run, with his pace recovering to 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, and his condition clearly improved. In the evening he buried himself in his master's notes, building strength for the certification exam. A regular routine has become part of his life, and both body and mind are gradually on the upswing.

events.name: Morning run 8 km
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang went to Wanlv Garden for a morning run. Today he deliberately extended the distance and ran 8 kilometers at a pace of 6 minutes 30 seconds, a clear improvement over last time. He felt his cardiorespiratory function was recovering and was full of energy after the run. When he got home, his wife praised him for looking much better recently.

events.name: Routine work preparation.
events.description: At 6:50 he had breakfast. Lu Mingqiang wore a newly issued denim work uniform today. After arriving at the company, he checked the insulating gloves and safety helmet needed for the day.

events.name: Morning maintenance of streetlight lines.
events.description: The morning task was to go to People's Park to repair two streetlights that had gone out. Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang got on the aerial work platform and found that the ballasts had burned out. While replacing the new ballasts, he taught Zhao Qiang how to use a multimeter to judge the fault, and also reminded him how to fasten the safety rope during aerial work. Zhao Qiang studied carefully, and Lu Mingqiang felt that as long as this young man worked steadily, he would soon become skilled.

events.name: Lunch break call with family
events.description: During the noon break, Lu Mingqiang called his wife and asked whether his younger son had been well-behaved at kindergarten. His wife said the teacher praised Yangyang for being able to put on his own shoes. Lu Mingqiang felt very happy inside.

events.name: Afternoon sorting and discharging in the warehouse.
events.description: In the afternoon there were no outside assignments, so Team Leader Zhang organized everyone to tidy up the warehouse. Lu Mingqiang and several coworkers sorted old cables by cross-section and bagged scrap copper wire for recycling. While moving things, he kept his core tightened as usual. A coworker joked that he was practicing qigong, and he laughed and said it really works.

events.name: Buying groceries after work
events.description: On his way home from work, Lu Mingqiang stopped by the vegetable market to buy garlic and ginger that his wife had asked for, and also picked a fresh tilapia, planning to make grilled fish in the evening. When he got home, his wife had already prepared the side dishes. He changed out of his work clothes and went into the kitchen to help with the grilled fish.

events.name: In-depth review of notes in the evening
events.description: After dinner, after playing with the children's building blocks for a while, Lu Mingqiang sat down in his study and carefully reviewed the section on relay protection setting calculation in Master Li's notes. Comparing it with the textbook, he spent over an hour finally figuring out a formula that had previously been unclear, and closed the notebook with satisfaction. He thought to himself that systematic classes would begin next Monday, so he had to lay a good foundation in advance.

events.name: Stick to the pre-bedtime routine
events.description: At 22:00 he turned off his phone on time. While soaking his feet, he closed his eyes and replayed what he had learned that day in his mind. At 22:50 he got into bed and slept peacefully.

start_state.mood: Calm, ready to complete the work step by step.

end_state.mood: Fulfilled, feeling pleased that the difficult problem was solved

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 8 km

2025-10.daily_overview: The first stop of the around-island road trip officially began! Lu Mingqiang drove the whole family to Wenchang, climbed Tonggu Ridge to overlook the sea, went beachcombing and picked up seashells at Stone Park, and checked into a seaside homestay in the evening. The first day of the trip went smoothly, and the whole family was immersed in the joy of slowing down. The once-promised "seeing the real moon" began to become reality.

events.name: Early morning inspection and luggage loading
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang got up a little earlier than the rest of the family. He checked the car's tire pressure, oil, and coolant, and loaded the travel bags, child seats, water bottles, and snack box he had packed the night before into the trunk. His wife prepared sun hats and spare clothes for each child. At 7:30, the whole family finished breakfast (rice noodle soup) and got ready to leave.

events.name: Drive to Wenchang.
events.description: At exactly 8:00, Lu Mingqiang drove the family car from Longhua District toward Wenchang via the Haiwen Expressway. On the way, his two sons were very excited. Lu Zixuan leaned by the window counting wind turbines, and Lu Zihan soon fell asleep in his car seat. His wife played old songs, and Lu Mingqiang, in a relaxed mood, hummed along occasionally. They took a 10-minute break at a service area halfway and bought fresh young coconuts.

events.name: Hiking and watching the sea at Tongguling Nature Reserve
events.description: Arriving at Longlou Town in Wenchang around 10 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang bought tickets and the whole family entered the Tonggu Ridge Nature Reserve. They walked slowly up the hiking trail, with dense vegetation on both sides. When they reached the viewing platform, the curved coastline of Moon Bay and the azure sea spread out before them. Lu Mingqiang lifted his eldest son so he could see farther, and Lu Zixuan shouted, 'The sea is so big!' In front of the 'Tonggu Ridge' stone tablet, they asked another tourist to take a family photo for them.

events.name: Beachcombing for shells at Stone Park
events.description: After coming down the mountain, they drove to the nearby Stone Park. Large areas of rocks emerged from the water after the tide went out. Lu Mingqiang rolled up his trouser legs and took his sons to look for small crabs and sea snails in shallow puddles. Lu Zixuan caught a hermit crab and jumped with joy, while Lu Zihan, with his mother's help, collected a small bucket of seashells. The sunshine was warm, the sea breeze brushed their faces, and it was very pleasant.

events.name: Checked in at a homestay in Longlou Town.
events.description: At 5 p.m., the family arrived at the pre-booked homestay, a family room converted from a three-story residence. It was clean and tidy, with a view of the sea in the distance. Lu Mingqiang paid 600 yuan for the room and checked in. The children jumped and played in the room, while the adults brewed tea on the balcony to relieve fatigue.

events.name: Guesthouse dinner and rest
events.description: At 7 p.m., the whole family went to the restaurant downstairs at the guesthouse for dinner, ordering Wenchang chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and sea snail and winter melon soup. During the meal, Lu Mingqiang raised his glass (using tea in place of wine) and said, "This is the first stop of our around-island trip. From now on, we'll visit one or two places each year and see all of Hainan Island." His wife smiled and clinked glasses with him. After dinner they returned to the room, and the two children soon fell asleep from exhaustion. Lu Mingqiang and his wife chatted quietly on the balcony, looking at the stars.

events.name: Keeping a healthy routine while traveling
events.description: At 22:00, Lu Mingqiang turned off his phone as usual and soaked his feet in a wooden basin borrowed from the guesthouse. He fell asleep peacefully before 23:00, storing up energy for the next day.

start_state.mood: Excited and full of anticipation, finally starting the first stop of the island tour

end_state.mood: Pleasant and relaxed, overflowing with family happiness.

state.daily_exercise: Mountain hiking for about 1.5 hours

2025-10.daily_overview: On the second day of the trip, the magnificent scenery of Dongjiao Coconut Grove and the authentic coconut rice left the whole family with good memories. In the early morning, Lu Mingqiang jogged along the coastline of Dongjiao Coconut Grove, enjoying the sea breeze and coconut shadows. In the afternoon, they returned safely to Haikou. Lu Mingqiang noted in his memo, "First stop successful," bringing this short trip to a satisfactory end. Back home, tidying up and resting became the main theme, and his anticipation for next year's trip around the island had already been ignited.

events.name: Morning jog in the coconut grove
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and jogged 5 km along the coastline of Dongjiao Coconut Grove. The sea breeze was gentle, and the coconut palms rustled; he felt relaxed and happy. This became a unique sports memory from his trip. After the run, he bought a bag of fresh coconut shred cakes and brought them back to the guesthouse.

events.name: Check-out and heading to Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area
events.description: At 8 a.m., after a simple breakfast and the coconut-flavored buns provided by the homestay, Lu Mingqiang checked out. They also bought some Wenchang specialty coconut candy and coconut shred cakes at Longlou Town market as souvenirs. At 9 o'clock they drove to officially visit the Dongjiao Coconut Grove Scenic Area, where rows of coconut trees swayed in the morning light.

events.name: Strolling through Dongjiao Coconut Grove and taking photos
events.description: The family walked along the dirt path through the coconut grove. Lu Mingqiang told his two sons how coconuts grow. Lu Zixuan tried to climb a leaning dwarf coconut tree, while Lu Zihan was fascinated by the dried coconut shells on the ground. His wife Wang Lijuan took many photos of the father and sons on the coconut grove path and, after posting them on Moments, received countless likes.

events.name: Taste the specialty coconut rice.
events.description: At noon, at an old restaurant near the scenic area, Lu Mingqiang ordered coconut boat rice, sliced Wenchang chicken, and stir-fried winged beans. The coconut rice was steamed with mature coconut meat and glutinous rice, making it sweet, fragrant, and soft, and the children especially loved it. This lunch cost 120 yuan, and Lu Mingqiang felt it was well worth the money.

events.name: Returned to his home in Haikou.
events.description: At 1 p.m., they ended their trip to Wenchang and drove back to Haikou along the same route. The children slept soundly in the back seats, and his wife also rested with her eyes closed. Lu Mingqiang concentrated on driving and arrived safely at their home in Longhua District around 3 p.m.

events.name: Returned home to organize and record.
events.description: After getting home, Lu Mingqiang put the dirty clothes in the washing machine while his wife sorted the local specialties they had bought. He wrote in the memo on his phone: “Oct 25-26 Wenchang stop complete, spent about 800 yuan. Tongguling was magnificent, Stone Park was fun. Next year’s goal: Qionghai Boao stop.” After writing, he took out a map and imagined future trips, the corners of his mouth unconsciously lifting.

events.name: Evening rest at home.
events.description: Feeling a bit tired after returning from the trip, Lu Mingqiang did no extra exercise in the evening. He took his son for a walk in the residential area, gently stretching his limbs, and chatted briefly with his neighbor Uncle Wang about travel experiences. For dinner, he simply had congee with light side dishes, plain and refreshing to cut the grease.

events.name: Sleep plan continues.
events.description: Turned off the phone at 22:00, soaked feet in warm water for 15 minutes, and recalled the little moments of the trip. Got into bed at 22:50 and soon fell asleep.

start_state.mood: Content, looking forward to exploring a new day

end_state.mood: Calm and content, looking forward to next year's island tour

state.daily_exercise: Morning 5 km run (coconut grove jog)

2025-10.daily_overview: The road to certification saw substantial progress. Lu Mingqiang officially enrolled in an online intensive course and bought textbooks, setting a fixed study time from 8 to 9 every evening. His exam preparation shifted from fragmented to systematic. That evening he called his master to report, receiving valuable guidance from experience. After two weeks of a regular routine, signs of a lighter body and improved complexion began to appear.

events.name: Felt refreshed in the morning.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang got up at 5:55 a.m. and clearly felt he no longer had to struggle as much as before. In the mirror, his complexion looked a bit rosier. While making breakfast, his wife said with a smile, "You've been looking much better lately." After washing up briefly, he had breakfast and went to work full of energy.

events.name: Morning substation maintenance study
events.description: Today the company arranged to go to a 10kV substation in Xiuying District for annual preventive tests. Lu Mingqiang followed the veteran workers to measure insulation and conduct loop resistance tests. During the break, he reviewed the protection principles related to Master Li's notes against the on-site equipment, deepening his understanding of the high-voltage system.

events.name: Midday online registration and book purchase
events.description: While eating lunch in the cafeteria, Lu Mingqiang used the link recommended by his co-worker Zhang Jianguo to pay 199 yuan via mobile phone and sign up for the Online Intensive Course for Senior Electrician Technician. The course includes modules such as PLC control and high-voltage power transformation and distribution, and is valid for 4 months. He then ordered the supporting textbook Power System Analysis from an online bookstore, expecting it to arrive in three days. After signing up, he felt a weight off his mind and more motivated.

events.name: Afternoon routine maintenance.
events.description: In the afternoon, the team went to a shopping mall to clean dust from low-voltage distribution cabinets and tighten terminals. While working, Lu Mingqiang mentally reviewed the high-voltage knowledge from the morning, hoping to connect theory and practice soon. When knocking off, Team Leader Zhang praised him for being more meticulous in his work recently.

events.name: Make a study plan and attend the first lesson.
events.description: Arrived home at 7:30 in the evening, had dinner, and rested for a while. At exactly 8:00, Lu Mingqiang entered the study and opened the mobile app to officially begin the first course introduction. He took careful notes alongside the textbook and marked key concepts such as PLC scan cycle and I/O mapping with a red pen. The one-hour study gave him an overall grasp of the systematic course that followed.

events.name: Called his master to report and ask for advice
events.description: After finishing the first lesson, Lu Mingqiang called Master Li. He first thanked him for lending him the notes, then reported that he had signed up for the online course and was studying every night as planned. Master Li was very pleased and urged him, "Just reading is not enough; you need to get hands-on and draw more diagrams to thoroughly understand circuit principles." He also told him about the time he almost failed the PLC hands-on section when he took the senior technician exam, and advised him to find opportunities to get hands-on experience with small PLC equipment as soon as possible. The two agreed that next month Lu Mingqiang would bring a good bottle of wine to Master Li's home, and Master Li would explain things in more detail.

events.name: Record key points for exam preparation
events.description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang immediately took out his dedicated notebook and wrote down the key points Master emphasized, such as “draw diagrams by hand” and “find a small PLC to practice on.” He also circled a weekend in the middle of next month and noted, “Visit Master Li with a bottle of wine.”

events.name: The Rewards of Sleep Habits
events.description: While soaking his feet before bed, he realized it was already the second week of strictly following a regular routine. Indeed, he no longer felt sleepy during the day, was more focused at work in the morning, and could still study efficiently for an hour after work. His wife was right—his complexion had improved a lot. He got into bed at 22:50 and fell asleep satisfied in body and mind.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and anticipation

end_state.mood: Firm and goal-oriented, full of confidence in getting the certification

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise

2025-10.daily_overview: During the day's electrical installation work, Lu Mingqiang put theory into practice and handled a complex control circuit. At 8 p.m., he logged on as scheduled to study the basic PLC module, and after class he had a long video chat with his childhood friend Wang Hai in Shenzhen, sharing his idea for a smart home studio. The cutting-edge information from a first-tier city broadened his thinking.

events.name: Install electrical cabinets at the mall (morning)
events.description: The company undertook the installation of a new electrical cabinet for a small shopping mall. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo were responsible for the wiring. He found that the secondary control circuit in the cabinet was more complex than usual, which happened to be related to the PLC module principle he had just been studying. While carefully crimping terminals and labeling according to the drawings, he matched the concepts of input and output points in his mind. After completion, it passed debugging smoothly, and he felt that theoretical learning had begun to feed back into his work.

events.name: Midday discussion with the team leader on technical issues
events.description: At lunch, Team Leader Zhang carried his meal and sat down next to Lu Mingqiang, asking how his exam preparation was going. Lu Mingqiang said he had already signed up for an online course. Team Leader Zhang nodded and said, "Good," and told him that the company intended to train key technical staff to master intelligent control, and encouraged him to study hard. Lu Mingqiang felt greatly inspired.

events.name: In the afternoon, guided Zhao Qiang in troubleshooting.
events.description: In the afternoon, the work team went to handle a tripping complaint. Lu Mingqiang gave the lead to Zhao Qiang and watched from the side. At first, Zhao Qiang could not find the cause. Lu Mingqiang reminded him to use the sectional troubleshooting method, and they finally found that it was an internal wiring error on the user's side. He patted Zhao Qiang on the shoulder and said, "Only when you can find faults are you truly qualified."

events.name: Evening PLC course study
events.description: At 8 PM, Lu Mingqiang was in his study using a mobile app to learn the PLC basic module. He drew ladder diagrams from the textbook, and circled "soft component definitions" and "scanning working principle" in red where he found them difficult to understand, planning to review them over the weekend. He studied with focus for an hour, with his phone on silent and no one disturbing him.

events.name: Video call with childhood friend Wang Hai
events.description: After studying, Lu Mingqiang proactively made a WeChat video call to his childhood friend Wang Hai. After exchanging a few pleasantries, Lu Mingqiang elaborated on his plan: first get a senior technician certificate, then open a smart home repair studio in Haikou, taking on installation and commissioning business. Wang Hai shared how booming the smart home market was in Shenzhen, advised him to pay more attention to wireless protocols and security monitoring, and also promised to help him keep an eye out for device manufacturer information when he had time. Lu Mingqiang took careful notes, was inspired by his friend's enthusiasm, and his blueprint became clearer and clearer.

events.name: Record startup inspiration
events.description: After the phone call, Lu Mingqiang wrote in his notebook items such as "Research Zigbee and WiFi modules" and "Consider buying a smart lighting demo board at the end of the year." He was still thinking about these new terms until he got into bed, feeling excited and confident.

events.name: Stick to the bedtime routine
events.description: Turn off the phone at 22:00 and soak feet to relax the nerves. Get into bed at 22:50; dreams seemed full of flashing signal lights.

start_state.mood: Clear-headed and ready to devote myself to work and study.

end_state.mood: Excited and mentally active; his entrepreneurial vision received external confirmation.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise

2025-10.daily_overview: The day was injected with vitality by the morning run, safety procedures were strictly followed at work, and this echoed with the evening study content. Lu Mingqiang increasingly felt the beauty of theory and practice supporting each other. After work, he attended his eldest son's school science and technology festival, and the father and son had more and more common topics; the dream of becoming an engineer was quietly growing.

events.name: Morning run at Baishamen
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and went alone to Baishamen Park for a 6-kilometer morning run. He maintained a steady pace and even breathing.
