After the run, he did 10 minutes of stretching by the beach and watched the sunrise over the sea for a while. The morning run kept his mind clear all day.

events.name: Morning low-voltage power distribution safety work.
events.description: Today's job was replacing the incoming service lines for an old public rental housing project. As the safety supervisor, Lu Mingqiang repeatedly reminded Zhao Qiang and another worker to be sure to test for electricity and attach grounding wires. He kept reciting the safety regulations he had studied the night before and verified each key point on site, leading the team to complete the task safely.

events.name: Had a phone call with wife at noon.
events.description: During the lunch break, he called home. His wife said she had bought a new picture book for the second son, and the eldest son had signed up for the water rocket competition at the school science festival. Lu Mingqiang was very happy to hear this and said he would definitely go and watch in the evening.

events.name: Afternoon power restoration test
events.description: In the afternoon, all household lines were replaced. Lu Mingqiang checked the phase sequence one by one, then closed the switch and restored power; voltage and current were normal. He also proactively helped several elderly households check their indoor outlets. Finding a loose ground wire in one household, he tightened it in passing. The elderly people were extremely grateful and gave him several guavas from their own garden. Lu Mingqiang couldn't refuse, so he brought them home.

events.name: Attend the school science and technology festival parent-child activity
events.description: After getting off work, Lu Mingqiang went straight to his eldest son's school. The playground was filled with students' science and technology projects. The water rocket made by his son Lu Zixuan and two classmates was successfully launched and flew about 30 meters, and the little guy cheered with joy. Lu Mingqiang recorded the whole process with his phone, his eyes full of pride. A teacher recognized him and joked, “He loves electricity so much; he'll definitely take over your job in the future.” Lu Mingqiang smiled and ruffled his son's hair.

events.name: Family dinner sharing
events.description: After getting home, Lu Zixuan excitedly told his mother and younger brother about the competition. The family had grilled fish for dinner in a lively atmosphere. Lu Mingqiang cut up the guava, and after the meal everyone ate it together; it was sweet and refreshing.

events.name: Evening study of high-voltage safety regulations
events.description: From 20:00 to 21:00, Lu Mingqiang studied the high-voltage safety procedures module of the online course in his study. He took careful notes, recording key points such as the cross-sectional requirements for grounding conductors and the regulations for using voltage testers one by one. An hour later, he organized his notes from the past few days, feeling that his knowledge framework was gradually taking shape.

events.name: Go to bed on time
events.description: At 22:00, turned off my phone, soaked my feet for 15 minutes, and thought about tomorrow's study tasks. Went to bed at 22:55 and fell asleep quickly.

start_state.mood: Energetic and planning to go for a morning run.

end_state.mood: Proud and fulfilled; time with the kids plus the technology he loves.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 6 kilometers.

2025-10.daily_overview: During the day he worked normally; in the evening, Lu Mingqiang switched to his treasured hobby — cleaning and organizing recently collected wine bottles, taking photos and uploading them to the forum to share with fellow enthusiasts, and received quite a few likes. For exam preparation, he continued tackling advanced PLC knowledge and wrote down questions to ask later. Life was kept in balance among technology, hobbies, and family.

events.name: Morning coordination for line renovation
events.description: Today, in coordination with the municipal road renovation, the streetlight cables were relocated. Under the scorching sun, Lu Mingqiang directed Zhao Qiang and another worker to dig test pits, marked the cable route, and made the intermediate joint himself. He applied experience accumulated from emergency repairs; every step was clean and decisive, and the work was finished half an hour ahead of schedule.

events.name: At noon, chatted with Chen Jianguo about collecting.
events.description: During lunch, Chen Jianguo was scrolling on his phone and saw a bottle of Moutai Town liquor with a distinctive shape, and showed it to Lu Mingqiang. Lu Mingqiang's eyes lit up, saying the bottle's glaze color was rare, but it was a pity it was hard to buy. The two agreed to try their luck at the local flea market together when they had time.

events.name: Afternoon wrap-up and early return.
events.description: The project ended early in the afternoon, and Team Leader Zhang let him leave early. Lu Mingqiang got home shortly after 4 o'clock, played Gomoku with his younger son for a while, and then went to look at the tomato seedlings on the balcony. When he found that side branches had grown, he taught his two sons how to pinch off the side shoots to concentrate nutrients.

events.name: Evening review of advanced PLC knowledge
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang first finished the day's online course—Timers and Counters in Advanced PLC Applications. While taking notes, he found a complex case he did not understand, marked it heavily with a red pen, and planned to gather the difficult points over the weekend to ask Master Li.

events.name: Clean and organize the wine bottle collection
events.description: After studying, he took out three special wine bottles collected over the past few months—a blue-and-white porcelain wine bottle themed on Danzhou folk songs, a sauce-aroma baijiu bottle shaped with Li ethnic totems, and an antique imitation bronze wine vessel. He carefully cleaned the inside and outside of the bottles with a soft cloth and clean water, dried them, spread a white cloth on the dining table, set up lighting, and took high-definition photos from different angles with his phone.

events.name: Update the digital collection album and upload it to the forum
events.description: After importing the photos into his computer, he used his self-made Excel collection ledger to record in detail the origin, date of acquisition, and material features of each liquor bottle, and added his photography notes. He then picked the 9 most satisfying photos and, along with text descriptions, posted them to the "Qiongdao Liquor Bottle Collectors" forum. The post soon received more than a dozen replies and likes. A fellow forum acquaintance, Chen Jianguo (same name, different person), privately messaged him to ask if he wanted to exchange a Li totem bottle. Lu Mingqiang happily replied and arranged to meet in person next month.

events.name: Before-bed habit
events.description: At 22:00, turned off my phone. While soaking my feet, I browsed new replies on the forum and felt very pleased. Went to bed at 22:50 and fell asleep peacefully.

start_state.mood: Calm and fulfilled

end_state.mood: Satisfied and relaxed, because sharing my hobby was recognized

state.daily_exercise: Outdoor work and physical labor.

2025-10.daily_overview: On the last day of the month, after Lu Mingqiang finished reviewing the high-voltage safety regulations and sorting out his notes, his knowledge system became more solid. After work, he and his wife picked out an air fryer, adding a healthy new option to the family's diet. When colleagues met him, they all remarked on how radiant he looked; three months of exercise and a regular routine were quietly reshaping his condition.

events.name: End-of-month work meeting
events.description: After arriving at the company in the morning, Squad Leader Zhang held a brief month-end safety summary meeting, praising the team for having the lowest failure rate this month, and specifically mentioning Lu Mingqiang's exemplary role in emergency repairs and troubleshooting. After the meeting, several colleagues patted him on the shoulder and said he had been full of energy lately and seemed younger than ever. Lu Mingqiang thanked them with a smile.

events.name: Morning re-inspection of the electrical distribution room at the commercial complex.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo went to the shopping mall's electrical distribution room that they had serviced last month for a follow-up inspection. They checked the capacitor operating data and busbar joint temperatures. All parameters were stable, and the two recorded and archived the information. During the work, Chen Jianguo mentioned that his family also wanted to follow his regular routine but couldn't stick to it. Lu Mingqiang suggested starting with going to bed half an hour earlier.

events.name: Systematically organized notes at noon.
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang did not chat with the others. Instead, alone in the employee break room, he reviewed the past four days of online courses and notes, drew a knowledge tree diagram, and turned the difficult points on PLC and safety regulations into a list of questions, planning to ask Master Li in person next time. After finishing, he looked at the tidy notes and felt a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Afternoon routine maintenance and leaving work early.
events.description: The afternoon tasks were simple; he only went to two residents' homes to replace leakage switches. Lu Mingqiang finished at 3:30 and returned to the company to report. The company happened to announce that everyone could leave work one hour early today. He packed up his things and drove home.

events.name: Buy an air fryer
events.description: On the way home, Lu Mingqiang remembered the air fryer his wife had mentioned last week, so he detoured to the home appliance store in Longhua District. The couple communicated via WeChat and selected a small-capacity air fryer priced at 380 yuan, which saves oil and can make grilled fish, chicken wings, and more, balancing health and taste. After paying, he carried the new air fryer home, and the children curiously gathered around to look.

events.name: Review and month-end summary.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang reviewed the week's studies in his study room, focusing on writing out key clauses of the high-voltage safety regulations from memory and marking errors and omissions with a red pen. He opened the calendar and saw that the first weekend of November was the practical pre-exam for Senior Technician, reminding himself to speed up. After tidying his notes, he felt much more at ease.

events.name: Couple tried out the new pot.
events.description: After his wife cleaned the air fryer, she tried frying some french fries and marinated chicken wings. They came out crispy on the outside and tender inside, not greasy, and even the youngest son said they were delicious. Lu Mingqiang felt the money was well spent, and that future fitness meals could be varied too.

events.name: Maintained a regular daily routine
events.description: At 22:00 he turned off his phone and, while soaking his feet in warm water, reflected on the past month: from winning the award to inspecting the storefront, from the Wenchang trip to systematic study, everything was moving toward the goal. He fell asleep before 23:00 with a smile, full of anticipation for November.

start_state.mood: Refreshed and ready for the last working day of the month.

end_state.mood: Satisfied and accomplished, full of confidence in the future.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to showers, 27–34°C, high humidity.

2025-08.daily_overview: On the first day of August, Lu Mingqiang tried resuming his morning run to test his lower back. Later, at work, he began meticulous family financial management for the month and prepared medicated patches for his mother. After work, he started making an eco-friendly toy car with his eldest son and explained circuit principles via phone video for the first time. In the evening, he finalized the August budget in detail with his wife, started keeping daily accounts, and continued reviewing theory for the Senior Technician exam. Life shifted into a fulfilling, orderly new rhythm.

events.name: Morning core rehabilitation training and adaptive jogging.
events.description: After getting up at 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang first completed 15 minutes of lower back and core rehabilitation stretching in the living room at home - superman, plank, and glute bridge, 3 sets each. Feeling that his lower back moved freely, he went to Wanlv Park and tried a 2 km slow jog, with a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer, paying attention to the feeling in his lower back the whole time. After the run, he stretched thoroughly and confirmed there was no discomfort, greatly boosting his confidence in returning to running.

events.name: Buy medicated patches for mother before going to work.
events.description: After his morning run, he came home and took a shower, then stopped by the pharmacy near the neighborhood to buy the joint pain relief plasters his mother Chen Xiuying needed this month. He deliberately chose the brand his mother usually used and bought two extra boxes as backup, so that she could change them promptly when her knees hurt in rainy or damp weather.

events.name: Review basic electrical theory during lunch break
events.description: Using half an hour of his lunch break, Lu Mingqiang opened the vocational skills learning app in the company break room, specifically reviewed the DC circuit calculation and electromagnetic induction chapters of basic electrical theory, and did 10 supporting multiple-choice questions, scoring 9/10.

events.name: Formulate supermarket construction plan during work breaks
events.description: Back in the company in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang, based on the site survey data from the previous days and the supermarket's operating hours requirements, worked out a detailed circuit renovation construction schedule on the office computer, calculated the required cable specifications, switch models, and distribution box capacity, and made a complete procurement materials list, which he submitted to Team Leader Zhang for review. Team Leader Zhang nodded and approved it, and reminded him to pay attention to safety.

events.name: After dinner, collected model materials with the eldest son and explained the principles.
events.description: After returning home from work and eating dinner in the evening, Lu Mingqiang and his eldest son Lu Zixuan searched for discarded items on the home balcony together, collecting materials such as an old electric toothbrush motor, plastic bottles, wire, and bottle caps. The father and son sat on the floor, and Lu Mingqiang played a simple animation on his phone, explaining to his son the basic working principle of an electric toy car: the battery supplies power to make the motor spin, which drives the wheels forward. Lu Zixuan listened with great interest, frequently asking why.

events.name: The couple discussed and confirmed the August family budget.
events.description: After settling the second son to sleep shortly after 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan sat at the living room coffee table, took out paper and pen, and itemized August's fixed and special expenses one by one: the birthday gift for his mother's 60th birthday, a gift for their tenth wedding anniversary, a planned phone replacement, the cost of a scheduled comprehensive physical examination, and the renewal of the eldest son's parent-child swimming class. After repeated discussions, the two finally set the total family budget for August at 8,000 yuan.

events.name: Started daily expense tracking for August.
events.description: After discussing the budget, Lu Mingqiang took out a brand-new notebook from the drawer, neatly wrote "August Household Expenses" and the total budget on the title page, then recalled the day's small expenses together with his wife—morning breakfast, medicated plasters, groceries, and so on—recording each item and calculating the remaining amount. The two agreed to check the day's accounts every night before going to bed from then on.

events.name: Review variable frequency drive principles and take notes before bed.
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang walked into the small study and, as planned, used the learning app to review the basic difference between V/F control and vector control in the principles of variable-frequency drives. He took out his notebook and carefully recorded the concepts that were easy to confuse, and marked the braking unit section that needed more work. The study session lasted about 30 minutes.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City
start_state.mood: Slightly nervous; looking forward to resuming running to test my lower back.

end_state.mood: Feeling solid and content; the physical test went smoothly, and the family finances now have a clear direction

state.daily_exercise: Morning core stretching for 15 minutes, jogging 2 kilometers, walking commute to and from work.

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny with clouds, temperature 28-35°C, light sea breeze in the afternoon.

2025-08.daily_overview: The whole family went out on Saturday to the parent-child swimming pool. Lu Mingqiang and his two sons took their second swimming lesson together. He could finally float for a short while; his sons joked that he looked like a frog, and he enjoyed it. Before the lesson, he did a 3 km morning run to consolidate his recovery and build confidence. After the lesson, the boys excitedly shared their progress with their father. Back home, his wife had prepared a table of home-style dishes. In the evening, he continued bookkeeping and reviewing, and took his apprentice Zhao Qiang to buy materials for the supermarket renovation. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang also collected model materials with his elder son and explained the principles of batteries and motors — a fulfilling and happy day.

events.name: Morning 3-kilometer consolidation run and core stretching.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang went alone to Baishamen Park and jogged 3 kilometers on the shaded track, keeping a pace of 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. Along the way, he used his phone three times to record cadence and heart rate, and felt it was easier than yesterday. After the run, he did a 15-minute core stretching routine, with no discomfort in his lower back.

events.name: The whole family gets the swimming supplies ready together
events.description: After getting home and finishing breakfast, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan took out swimsuits, goggles, bath towels, and a change of clothes for the whole family. He checked the kickboard and arm floats for leaks, packed a swim cap for each child, and put the wet clothes storage bag into the backpack.

events.name: Driving to the parent-child swim center and reminding the children along the way
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang drove his family car, with his wife and two sons, from their home on Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District to a reserved parent-child swimming center in the Guomao commercial area. On the way, he gently reminded the children to listen to Coach Chen and to be careful and not run around.

events.name: Attended the second parent-child swimming lesson and made a floating breakthrough.
events.description: In the shallow water area, Coach Chen guided Lu Mingqiang and his two sons to practice breath-holding, breathing, and breaststroke leg movements in turn. Lu Mingqiang seriously lay on the poolside and repeatedly practiced leg squeezing and kicking. Although he was already 35 years old and couldn't swim at all, he showed no embarrassment. After practicing on his own at home last week and consolidating it in this class, he successfully floated briefly in the water, and his waist didn't feel sore even when exerting force. Seeing their father clumsily floating on the water, his two sons laughed and shouted, 'Daddy looks like a big frog.' Lu Mingqiang himself also laughed heartily.

events.name: After class, high-fived in celebration and called his father
events.description: After the second lesson, Lu Mingqiang crouched down outside the swimming pool and high-fived his two sons to celebrate, praising their bravery. Then he walked under a tree, called his father Lu Jianguo, and excitedly shared the news that he had learned to float. His father said 'good' repeatedly on the phone and told him not to push himself too hard.

events.name: Take apprentice Zhao Qiang to purchase construction materials
events.description: In the afternoon, during a break, Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice Zhao Qiang and drove to the building materials market around Longhua District. Following the approved material list, they purchased cables, air switches, residual current circuit breakers, surface-mounted distribution boxes, and other items with specified specifications one by one. On site, he taught Zhao Qiang how to use a vernier caliper to check the copper core diameter and how to identify genuine switches. Zhao Qiang took careful notes.

events.name: The whole family had dinner together and amused each other by imitating swimming movements.
events.description: In the evening, his wife, Wang Lijuan, cooked a table of home-style dishes: white cut chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, and winter melon and white clam soup. During the meal, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan couldn't help imitating their father floating while swimming—flailing their arms and kicking their legs—and the family kept laughing. Lu Mingqiang felt genuinely happy about his small progress and put food into the children's bowls.

events.name: After dinner, collected model materials with the eldest son and explained the principles.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang took an illustrated book titled Basic Electricity for Young Electricians from the study and, drawing on the impression from the previous day's first mobile video explanation, again explained to his son the basic relationship between the battery's positive and negative terminals and the rotation of the motor.

events.name: After dinner, the couple kept accounts together.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan took out the ledger and recorded the day's expenses one by one, including groceries, fuel for the car, and the parking fee for the swimming lesson. Comparing with the beginning-of-month budget, they found that swimming consumables cost a little more than expected and agreed to buy fewer energy drinks next time.

events.name: Review for the exam in two separate blocks: during lunch break and before bed.
events.description: Taking advantage of the relatively abundant weekend time, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the basics of electrical theory for 35 minutes during the post-lunch rest, and reviewed the principles of frequency converters for 35 minutes in the study before bed, and organized a mind map of the notes from the past week.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the family weekend activity; body feels light after the morning run.

end_state.mood: Excited and content, feeling happy about the swimming breakthrough and family time.

state.daily_exercise: 3 km morning run, about 1 hour of in-water practice in swimming class, core stretching

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning to thunder showers, temperature 26-33°C, yellow lightning warning in the evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, after repeated urging from his wife, Lu Mingqiang finally used the rest of his year-end bonus to buy a new phone, ending five years with his old one. After returning home and installing learning, running, and bookmarking apps, he sighed that he should have changed it long ago. During the day, he continued making the car body frame with his son. In the evening, he arranged two review sessions and did a final count of materials and division of labor for the next day's supermarket construction. In the morning, the couple had a brief spat over changing the phone, but they quickly reached an agreement — an upgrade of their digital life tools.

events.name: A brief disagreement with his wife in the morning about changing mobile phones.
events.description: At breakfast, his wife Wang Lijuan again brought up that his old phone had a cracked screen and was running laggy, and suggested using the rest of the year-end bonus to replace it. Lu Mingqiang was reluctant to spend the money and thought it could still be used. His wife did the math for him: the learning app kept crashing, and blurry photos affected his work, so putting off the replacement might cause problems. In the end, Lu Mingqiang was persuaded and decided to buy one that day.

events.name: Drive to the mobile phone store to pick out a new phone
events.description: A little after 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang drove to a brand smartphone store in the Guomao business district of Longhua District. With the introduction of the salesperson, he compared several domestic smartphones, focusing on screen size and RAM. In the end, he selected a model with a 6.7-inch large screen and smooth performance, priced at 1,499 yuan.

events.name: Pay with the remaining year-end bonus, reflecting financial control.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang paid 1,499 yuan with the remaining year-end bonus from his bank card, without touching the family's daily savings, consistent with the phone replacement fee reserved in the budget at the beginning of the month. He specifically asked the shop assistant to issue an invoice, planning to bring it home for his wife to review.

events.name: Go home to back up data and activate the new phone
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang used a data cable in the study to back up contacts, photos, and study notes from his old phone to the computer, then imported them into the new phone and replaced the SIM card. After about an hour of fiddling, the new phone finally started up successfully.

events.name: Installed various apps on the new phone; the experience was smooth.
events.description: That evening, Lu Mingqiang sat in his study and installed in one go an electrician exam practice app, a running tracking app, and a local bottle collection forum. He swiped the screen smoothly with his fingertips and opened a video explaining PLC; it loaded with almost no delay, and he couldn't help shouting to his wife, "We should have switched a long time ago."

events.name: The father and son continued making the small car’s body frame.
events.description: After the afternoon thunderstorm stopped, Lu Mingqiang and Lu Zixuan continued working on the living room floor. Using discarded plastic bottles and cardboard, along with scissors and a hot glue gun, they made the body frame of a small car. Lu Mingqiang demonstrated how to cut symmetrical shapes and secure them, and his son Lu Zixuan carefully applied glue to stick the parts together. The car body began to take shape, and Lu Zixuan felt a strong sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Check the day's expenses in the evening
events.description: During the evening bookkeeping time, Lu Mingqiang sat down with Wang Lijuan and formally recorded the large expense of buying a new phone that day, and also added the costs of snacks for the children, groceries, and phone accessories. Looking at the numbers in the ledger, Lu Mingqiang reminded himself to control his pocket money even more in the coming days.

events.name: Studied electrical theory in segments throughout the day.
events.description: On Sunday, his rest day, Lu Mingqiang scheduled 30 minutes in the morning and 30 minutes in the afternoon in his study to review the key chapters of basic electrical theory, and another 30 minutes in the evening to review inverter principles. He also organized and archived the content reviewed during the week and marked the error-prone points.

events.name: Organize the supermarket construction materials and tools, and do a final check.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang took his apprentices Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun to the company warehouse, where they sorted and neatly stacked all the materials purchased the day before according to the different construction areas of the supermarket, and counted tools one by one, including impact drills, wire strippers, and multimeters. He then called the supermarket's engineering liaison again to confirm the power-off areas and time periods during the construction starting tomorrow, as well as the arrangement of on-site safety officers, to ensure everything was foolproof for the next day's start.

start_state.mood: Was a bit reluctant to change phones, but was eventually persuaded by his wife

end_state.mood: Full of novelty, full of anticipation for the new tools, and ready for tomorrow's construction

state.daily_exercise: No targeted exercise; tidied up at home and went out for a walk.

2025-08.daily_overview: In the new week, Lu Mingqiang devoted himself fully to the first day of the supermarket circuit upgrade and renovation project. In the early morning, he arrived at the site and held a pre-shift meeting, deploying in detail the old wire removal tasks and safety measures. During work breaks, he kept up with lunch break and evening exam review. After getting off work, he did the family bookkeeping with his family and supervised the children doing simple swimming float imitation exercises. Team leader Zhang suddenly came to the site for an inspection and praised the team's safety measures.

events.name: Held a pre-shift meeting at the supermarket construction site
events.description: At 8:00 a.m., Lu Mingqiang and his apprentices Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun arrived on time at a small and medium-sized supermarket construction site in Longhua District. After changing into work clothes and insulating shoes, he gathered the two men in the area where the shelves had been cleared and held a brief pre-shift meeting. He drew the old circuit areas to be dismantled that day and the order of work on the whiteboard, emphasized the power-off confirmation procedure and the safety of working at height, and checked everyone's safety helmet and gloves.

events.name: Spent the whole day dismantling old circuits and cleaning up the site.
events.description: From morning to afternoon, Lu Mingqiang led his apprentices to dismantle the aging wires, air switches, sockets, and broken fluorescent light brackets in the supermarket section by section according to the plan. They used a voltage tester to repeatedly confirm the power was off before starting. The removed cables were sorted and stacked by copper and plastic materials, keeping the aisles clear. During the lunch break, the three of them simply had boxed meals at a nearby small shop.

events.name: Reviewed electrical theory during the lunch break.
events.description: After lunch, in the mall's employee rest area, Lu Mingqiang used his 30-minute lunch break to open the practice-question app on his new phone, reviewed the easily confused principle of power factor improvement in electrical fundamentals, and saved screenshots of two wrong questions.

events.name: Squad Leader Zhang praised the work during an on-site surprise inspection.
events.description: During the afternoon construction work, Team Leader Zhang suddenly appeared at the supermarket site to inspect the demolition progress and safety measures. Seeing that materials were neatly stacked, safety signs were clear, and Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun were operating according to standards, he praised Lu Mingqiang in front of the three of them and urged them to continue keeping it that way.

events.name: In the evening, went home and kept accounts, recording the qingbuliang and gas expenses
events.description: After getting off work and returning home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang took out the account book before going to bed and recorded the day's expenses: buying qingbuliang to cool down on the way home from work and refueling the car. His wife Wang Lijuan added the day's spending on vegetables and stationery for the children. After verifying that everything was correct, they closed the book.

events.name: Before bed, review frequency converter principles and record common mistakes.
events.description: Despite being a bit tired from the heavy physical labor during the day, Lu Mingqiang still insisted on sitting at his desk before bed. He used an app to review the difference between the braking unit and the regenerative unit of a frequency converter, and neatly copied the error-prone points into his study notebook. It took 30 minutes.

events.name: Imitate floating movements with the child.
events.description: After dinner, before washing up, Lu Mingqiang had his two sons lie on the living room floor and imitate the swimming float position again. He guided the elder son on how to tighten his core and keep his legs together, and encouraged the younger son to try too. The brief parent-child interaction filled the home with laughter.

start_state.mood: Staying focused and preparing for new engineering challenges

end_state.mood: Physically tired but mentally grounded; the project started smoothly, and the praise gave him even more motivation

state.daily_exercise: A lot of walking and climbing at the construction site; no extra exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy to sunny, with light fog in the early morning, temperature 28-34°C

2025-08.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang enjoyed the morning coastline alone during his early run, used his new phone to take a photo of the sunrise and set it as wallpaper, and still felt calm after returning home. During the day he continued the supermarket circuit dismantling work to its end, in the evening did family bookkeeping, and worked with his son on fixing and wiring the motor of a small car, father and son collaborating to push forward a tech DIY project. For exam review, he took variable-frequency drives as the main thread; listening to an audio clip during the lunch break was an efficient way to study.

events.name: Go alone to Xixiu Beach in the early morning for a run and enjoy some solitude.
events.description: At 5:30 in the morning, the alarm clock rang. Lu Mingqiang washed up quickly, changed into his newly bought quick-dry sports T-shirt and running shoes, took his new phone, quietly closed the door, and drove to Xixiu Beach Park. He completed a 5-kilometer morning run along the red rubber track by the seaside, with steady strides and a pace of about 6 minutes 5 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he sat on the breakwater, regulating his breathing while listening to the waves and watching the red sun rise from the sea horizon. He took a photo with his new phone and, satisfied, set it as his wallpaper. On the way back, he bought a fresh coconut at the roadside, drank the sweet coconut water to cool off, and drove home slowly.

events.name: Construction proceeded as usual, and the removal of the supermarket's old electrical circuits was completed.
events.description: Back at the supermarket construction site, Lu Mingqiang, together with Zhao Qiang and Liu Xiaojun, continued to remove the old wiring and electrical distribution facilities in the remaining area, carefully sorting all recyclable old copper cables. By the end of the afternoon, the demolition work was fully completed and the debris was cleaned up, making full preparations for installing the new cable trays tomorrow. He specifically praised Zhao Qiang for his careful operation when independently removing a set of switches today.

events.name: During lunch break, listen to an audio explanation about frequency converters using Bluetooth earphones
events.description: During the 30-minute lunch break, Lu Mingqiang put on his newly bought Bluetooth earphones and listened to a saved audio course on frequency converter principles, focusing on how acceleration and deceleration time settings affect the motor—studying while resting with his eyes closed.

events.name: Evening father-son activity: securing the motor and wiring.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and Lu Zixuan continued making the small car at the coffee table. Lu Mingqiang used cable ties to fix the motor removed from an electric toothbrush onto the car's chassis, installed the battery box, and patiently picked up the red and black wires to explain the basic concepts of positive and negative poles — electricity flows from the positive pole like water, through the motor, and back to the negative pole. Under his guidance, Lu Zixuan carefully used a screwdriver to tighten the wires to the terminals. His little hands were not very nimble, but he was very focused.

events.name: Household accounting; added expenses for breakfast and fruit.
events.description: Wang Lijuan recorded the day's expenses for buying stationery and Sunkist oranges for the two children in the account book. After checking, Lu Mingqiang added the cost of the coconuts and breakfast he had bought in the morning, with every entry clearly labeled. Looking at the book, he said, 'If we record things this clearly, we'll know where the money went at the end of the month.'

events.name: Pre-bed review of electrical fundamentals
events.description: 30 minutes before bed, Lu Mingqiang adjusted his study plan and decided to review basic electrical knowledge that evening, focusing on redoing some previous incorrect questions to consolidate his memory.

start_state.mood: Woken up by the anticipation of the morning run, feeling refreshed and clear-headed.

end_state.mood: Calm and fulfilled inside; enjoyed solitude and quality time with his child

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers, core stretching.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with moderate rain, temperature 26-31°C, very humid.

2025-08.daily_overview: On a rainy Wednesday, Lu Mingqiang spent the day at the construction site leading apprentices in installing new wire troughs and cable trays. Work at height and damp weather tested their patience even more. During breaks and in the evening, he continued his theoretical study, and noticed that this month's electricity bill was slightly higher, so he discussed reducing air conditioning use with his wife. After work, he helped Uncle Wang, a neighbor, repair an outlet on the way home, and the small favor brought the neighbors closer. Though the work was tiring, seeing the supermarket's wiring gradually renewed gave him a sense of accomplishment.

events.name: Supermarket construction: installing wire ducts and cable trays (indoor work while it rained outside)
events.description: Although it was raining moderately outside, the indoor construction in the supermarket was unaffected. Lu Mingqiang and two apprentices, above the supermarket ceiling, used expansion bolts to secure the new galvanized wire troughs and cable tray supports according to the marked positions, repeatedly calibrating with a spirit level to ensure the levelness and verticality met the specifications. He reminded the apprentices to hold tools firmly when passing them at height, to keep people from standing below, and to guard against accidents caused by wet, slippery conditions in the rain.

events.name: Continue reviewing the fundamentals of electrical engineering during the lunch break.
events.description: During his 30-minute lunch break, Lu Mingqiang sat in a corner of the mall, connected to the public Wi-Fi, and used an app to drill multiple-choice questions on basic electrical theory. He focused on phasor diagram analysis of three-phase AC circuits and took screenshots of several typical mistakes.

events.name: After work, helped neighbor Uncle Wang repair an electrical outlet.
events.description: When he was coming home from work, his neighbor Wang Jianguo stopped him in the hallway and said the kitchen outlet at home was broken. Without saying a word, Lu Mingqiang went home to get his tools, helped Uncle Wang replace the burnt-out outlet, and checked the wiring. Gratefully, Uncle Wang gave him fresh vegetables from his own garden. Lu Mingqiang tried to decline but couldn't refuse, so he accepted them and thanked him.

events.name: Went home in the evening and discussed saving energy because the electricity bill was high.
events.description: Back home, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan kept the accounts as usual. Wang Lijuan showed the electricity bill text message she had just received, which showed that this month's electricity bill was nearly 50 yuan more than last month. Lu Mingqiang thought for a moment and believed it was because he had been using the air conditioner for long periods at night while studying, and his younger son's room had the air conditioner on frequently as well. The two discussed that starting tonight, the children would only use the fan with a timer when sleeping, and the living room air conditioner temperature would be raised by one degree to reduce energy consumption.

events.name: Before bed, review variable frequency drive principles and organize the week's content
events.description: After settling in for the evening, Lu Mingqiang reviewed the principles of variable-frequency drives in his study for 40 minutes. He also took out the notes from the previous five days and organized what he had learned this week into a mind map, marking which topics he had fully mastered and which still needed reinforcement, to prepare for the weekend summary review.

start_state.mood: Woken up by the sound of rain, slightly drowsy.

end_state.mood: After completing my studies and the energy-saving decision, I felt at ease, and helping others made me feel warmer.

state.daily_exercise: Heavy physical labor at the construction site; no additional exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Showers turning to cloudy, 27-32°C, sun in the evening

2025-08.daily_overview: Thursday: work on the construction site continued steadily. New cables were laid and labeled in the supermarket. After work, Lu Mingqiang hurried to the community activity room for the weekly table tennis practice with his table tennis partners. His backhand technique improved, and the partners invited him to sign up for the community friendly match at the end of the month. Back home in the evening, he completed the power-on test of the toy car — the motor ran normally! His son cheered with joy. Before bed, he summarized this week's exam preparation and planned next week. Both life and study were fulfilling.

events.name: Laying cables and threading wires at the supermarket construction site
events.description: During the day, Lu Mingqiang guided two apprentices in threading power cables and lighting wires of various specifications into the installed cable trays and wire ducts one by one according to the design drawings. At each wire end, he wrote the number and function on a waterproof label, ensuring clear routing and strict separation of power and signal lines to avoid interference. When finishing work, he sealed the wire ends with insulating tape to prevent moisture.

events.name: Reviewing inverter principles during the lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang watched a micro-lecture about PID adjustment of frequency converters in the company lounge, sketching a simple feedback control block diagram in his notebook as he watched.

events.name: After work, hurried to the community activity room to play table tennis
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang went home, quickly changed into sportswear, rode his electric bike to the community activity room, and played table tennis with three fellow players at the weekly Thursday activity. Today he focused on practicing backhand pushes and fast flicks, gave up some powerful smashes, and noticeably increased the number of rallies. He also earned a compliment from his fellow player Lao Zhou: 'Your backhand is much more stable.' During breaks they chatted about the hot weather and the kids' summer homework, with lots of laughter. Lao Zhou mentioned a community table tennis friendly match at the end of the month and asked if he wanted to sign up together. Lu Mingqiang said he'd think about it.

events.name: Recorded expenses after the table tennis session
events.description: After returning home from playing ball, Lu Mingqiang wiped his sweat and kept accounts: he had bought two liang of the kuding tea his father loved and calcium supplements for his mother. Wang Lijuan added the weekend groceries and summer clothes for the children as expenses. The two quickly checked the accounts; because the game had kept them out late, the children were already asleep.

events.name: Father and son completed the motor power-on test for the small car.
events.description: Taking advantage of a short break after dinner, Lu Mingqiang and Lu Zixuan soldered the motor wires securely to the battery box. He guided his son hand-over-hand on how to hold the soldering iron and feed solder accurately, repeatedly stressing safety. Once soldering was done, they installed batteries and closed the switch; the little motor whirred at high speed! Lu Zixuan was so happy he clapped and jumped. Lu Mingqiang also recorded a video with his phone and sent it to his older brother Lu Minghua, who was at work.

events.name: Complete this week's study summary and list next week's plan
events.description: Before bed in the study, Lu Mingqiang took out the notes and screenshot mistakes accumulated this week and summarized that his weak point in electrical fundamentals was magnetic circuit calculation, and his weak point in frequency converters was parameter group logic. He made a review and attack plan for next week and wrote down the goal of “increasing the amount of practice questions.”

start_state.mood: Body feels a little heavy, but looking forward to relaxing with table tennis in the evening

end_state.mood: The dual satisfaction of post-exercise comfort and successful handiwork.

state.daily_exercise: Ping-pong for 1 hour, labor at the construction site

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, temperature 28-36°C, low humidity, a typical hot day.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday, the work on site progressed to installing and wiring a new distribution cabinet at the supermarket, and the work intensity was high. During the lunch break, he received a company notice that Typhoon Talim might affect Hainan next week, so emergency repair tools needed to be prepared in advance, making him feel a bit tense. After getting off work, he set aside work matters, focused on PLC simulation study at home, and searched online for information about the aerospace science exhibition, excitedly telling the whole family they would go out tomorrow. In the evening, as usual, the couple kept the accounts, and the children had already gone to bed.

events.name: Install the main distribution cabinet and connect the wiring at the supermarket.
events.description: Today we entered the core stage of the circuit renovation. Lu Mingqiang used a hammer drill to make holes at the designated positions, installed expansion bolts, and securely fixed the heavy main and sub distribution cabinets. Then, following the circuit diagram, he carefully connected the previously laid cables to the corresponding air switches, leakage protectors, and wiring terminals. After each connection, he used a multimeter to do a preliminary continuity test and repeatedly checked the drawings to prevent incorrect wiring. Even his apprentice admired how methodical he was when wiring.

events.name: Use the lunch break to focus on PLC simulation practice
events.description: Taking advantage of the 30-minute lunch break, Lu Mingqiang opened the newly installed PLC simulation app on his phone, started practicing ladder diagram programming from the most basic contact and coil instructions, built a simple motor start-stop circuit, and successfully ran the simulation. He gained considerable insight from it.

events.name: Received a typhoon warning and checked the emergency tools before leaving work.
events.description: In the afternoon, the company's WeChat work group notified that Typhoon Talim, the fourth typhoon of this year, might affect Hainan next week, and required all teams to check emergency repair tools and supplies. Before leaving work, Lu Mingqiang deliberately went to the warehouse, counted his emergency kit, and added waterproof tape and flashlight batteries, silently praying that the typhoon would not cause a major disaster.

events.name: Friday evening: looked up information about the aerospace science exhibition
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang searched for the 'Aerospace Science Exhibition at Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center' in his new phone's browser and found that it happened to be open on the weekend and free for the whole family, with no reservation needed. Opening hours were from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. He told his wife about the information and decided to take the whole family there early the next morning. When his eldest son Lu Zixuan heard this, he ran over excitedly and asked, 'Can we see rockets?' Lu Mingqiang smiled and nodded.

events.name: In the evening, he did the bookkeeping and summarized this week's expenses.
events.description: On the night before going out on Saturday, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan kept accounts as usual: besides buying groceries and daily necessities, they also recorded the small expenses for mineral water and snacks for the children while taking a stroll in the park. The two briefly summed up the week's spending, found that it was slightly under budget, and decided they could relax a little over the weekend.

events.name: Review PLC instructions before bed.
events.description: Before bed, in the study, Lu Mingqiang opened the PLC simulation app again, reviewed the basic instructions, and tried to connect the timer to the start circuit so that the motor would start with a delay. Although he encountered a small logic problem, he eventually solved it and closed the computer with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Full of expectation for the weekend family trip, but the typhoon news brings a hint of concern.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and looking forward to the family time over the next two days.

state.daily_exercise: Heavy physical labor at the construction site; no dedicated exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 28-35°C, strong UV in the afternoon, with dry hot wind

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang completed a 6 km long-distance run with marked improvement in endurance. Then the whole family happily headed to the space science exhibition. The eldest son lingered in front of the Long March rocket model. Lu Mingqiang explained the role of the electrical power system with his professional knowledge and bought space postcards for the children at the souvenir shop, igniting the family dream of going to Wenchang to see an actual rocket launch. He happened to meet fellow worker Zhang Jianguo, who was also visiting with his family, and they chatted briefly. After returning home in the afternoon, he continued making the small car and practiced PLC during his lunch break. In the evening, he and his wife formally established a new future travel goal.

events.name: 6 km long-distance jog at Baishamen Park
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang changed into his running shoes and went alone to Baishamen Park for a 6 km LSD run. He deliberately controlled his breathing rhythm, inhaling every three steps and exhaling every three steps, keeping a pace of 6:15 per kilometer. In the last kilometer he picked up the pace a bit and felt that his endurance had clearly improved, with no discomfort in his knees or ankles. After the run, he did 15 minutes of core stretching.

events.name: The whole family drove to the aerospace science exhibition.
events.description: At 9:30 a.m., Lu Mingqiang drove the family car with his wife and two sons, setting off from home on Jinmao Middle Road and heading along Binhai Avenue toward Hainan International Convention and Exhibition Center. On the way, he told the children about the rocket models and astronaut suits they would see. His younger son, Lu Zihan, asked innocently, "Where does the rocket fly to?" making everyone in the car laugh.

events.name: Visited the aerospace exhibition and explained the role of power systems to his son
events.description: After entering the aerospace achievements exhibition hall, Lu Zixuan was immediately attracted by the huge Long March 5 launch vehicle model, his mouth hanging open. Lu Mingqiang squatted down and, pointing at the pipes at the bottom of the rocket, explained in plain language: just as a home needs wires for electricity, a rocket also has a powerful electrical system for ignition, navigation, and communication. He compared a photo of a distribution cabinet stored on his phone with the rocket’s tail. His son seemed only half to understand but listened with fascination. Later, Lu Mingqiang took the whole family to experience VR space walking.

events.name: Ran into fellow worker Zhang Jianguo and had a brief conversation
events.description: Near the exhibition exit, Lu Mingqiang's family ran into his co-worker Zhang Jianguo, who was visiting with his wife and daughter. The two briefly exchanged their thoughts on the exhibition. Zhang Jianguo mentioned that they might have to work overtime next week for emergency repairs due to a typhoon, and Lu Mingqiang nodded to indicate that he was ready.

events.name: Buy space-themed postcards for the children.
events.description: Near the end of the visit, Lu Mingqiang picked out a beautiful set of Wenchang Space Launch Site-themed postcards for his two sons at the souvenir shop. The younger son tightly clutched a postcard showing a rocket launch in his little hand and wouldn't let go. Lu Mingqiang smiled, bent down, and asked if he wanted to go see the real place. Lu Zihan nodded hard.

events.name: During the return trip exchange, a desire to watch a real rocket launch emerged.
events.description: After the afternoon visit, Lu Mingqiang drove home. On the way, the two children chattered in the back seat about the exhibition, and his wife smiled and said the kids really had their horizons broadened today. While driving, Lu Mingqiang said to his wife, "When the eldest is a bit older, let's really make a trip to Wenchang and see a rocket launch with our own eyes—it's even more impressive than this exhibition." His wife nodded in agreement, and the two initially agreed to put this idea into the family's medium- and long-term plans.

events.name: In the evening, formally expressed the new family travel vision.
events.description: That night, after the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat in the living room drinking lao ba cha. He formally proposed making a trip to the Wenchang Space Launch Site to watch a rocket launch the family travel goal for the next 2-3 years, and his wife supported it. He opened the map to check distances and possible accommodation, and began planning to make a special detour to Wenchang during an island road trip.

events.name: Practice PLC timers and counters during the lunch break.
events.description: During the lunch break after returning from the exhibition, Lu Mingqiang opened a PLC simulation app in his study, specifically practiced the combined use of timers and counters, wrote a small program for automatic garage door control, and after successful simulation took a screenshot and saved it as a note.

events.name: The father and son adjusted the wheels of the small vehicle and lubricated them.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang and Lu Zixuan made four small car wheels from bottle caps and connected them with wire passed through the motor gear shaft. But when they first pushed the car, the wheels did not turn smoothly. Lu Mingqiang checked it together with his son and found that the bend angle of the wire was wrong, causing excessive friction. He patiently adjusted the angle of the wire and put a little sewing machine oil on the bearing, and the wheels turned smoothly immediately.

start_state.mood: Excited, looking forward to the morning run and the whole family visiting the exhibition

end_state.mood: Deeply moved, and the family travel goal gained a concrete direction.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 6 km, and about 10,000 steps walking around the exhibition.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang deliberately slowed down and rested at home. In the morning he practiced PLC simulation; in the afternoon he met fellow collector Chen Jianguo at Laoba Tea Shop to exchange wine bottles, and obtained an empty bottle of Hainan Yedao Deer Turtle Wine that he had long wanted. After returning home, he cleaned it and took photos, and also found time to browse online and order a waterproof Bluetooth speaker to prepare for listening to audio in the kitchen later. In the evening he played with building blocks with the children and chatted with his wife about next week's arrangements. He reduced his exam review time slightly to adjust his state. A simple and pleasant family day.

events.name: Practice PLC step instructions in the study
events.description: In the morning, while the child was watching cartoons, Lu Mingqiang opened a PLC simulation app in his home study and specifically practiced the step instructions STL and RET. He wrote a simple sequence control program simulating three steps of a conveyor belt: start, feeding, and stop. He revised the ladder diagram several times until the simulation ran smoothly, and wrote down notes on what he had learned.

events.name: In the afternoon, exchanged liquor bottles with fellow collector Chen Jianguo.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike to a traditional tea house on Haifu Road to meet his fellow collector Chen Jianguo. Chen Jianguo brought a well-preserved old-style empty bottle of Hainan Yedao Deer Turtle Wine, exactly what Lu Mingqiang had been wanting to collect. In return, Lu Mingqiang gave him a bottle of 1980s Haikou Daqu. The two sipped tea and talked about bottles, enjoying a very pleasant conversation.

events.name: After returning home, washed the wine bottle and took photos as a keepsake.
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang carefully cleaned the newly obtained wine bottle with a soft cloth, attached a label noting the date and source, and arranged it in the bottle collection cabinet on the balcony. He took a photo and posted it to a collecting forum to share, and it drew likes from a few fellow enthusiasts.

events.name: In the afternoon, I browsed online and ordered a waterproof Bluetooth speaker.
events.description: During free time in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang searched on an e-commerce platform and ordered a waterproof Bluetooth speaker suitable for hanging in the kitchen, spending 99 yuan, to prepare for listening to audio in the kitchen later.

events.name: Resting at home, building blocks with his son
events.description: During the evening shower, Lu Mingqiang played with his second son Lu Zihan on the floor building plastic blocks and helped him build a small car. Meanwhile, his eldest son was looking at the postcards brought back from the space exhibition and kept running over to ask questions, all of which Lu Mingqiang patiently answered.

events.name: Chatting with his wife about next week's plans
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan didn't hurry to keep the accounts. Instead, they brewed a pot of tea and chatted briefly in the living room about the coming week. He estimated that the supermarket construction could be finished by Wednesday or Thursday. His wife reminded him that the 15th was the day of his scheduled medical check-up and told him not to forget. Lu Mingqiang nodded and said he had already put it in the calendar on his phone.

start_state.mood: Lazy, enjoying the slow pace of the weekend.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and recharged, calmly preparing for the new week.

state.daily_exercise: No specific exercise; light housework and going out

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, 28-35°C, strong UV

2025-08.daily_overview: A busy Monday. During the day, Lu Mingqiang completed all the wiring and checks at the supermarket before the distribution cabinet was formally energized. Because his apprentice Zhao Qiang was on leave, he took on most of the finishing work alone. In the evening came a milestone — he and his son completed the final assembly of the eco-friendly powered car. The moment it ran, the two high-fived in celebration! Afterwards, Lu Mingqiang invited fellow worker Chen Jianguo to the night market for grilled fish, chatting about daily life, venting, and agreeing to sign up for a skills class together. Around 9 p.m., he returned home after drinking, and before bed spent 20 minutes simulating work problems. A fulfilling day.

events.name: Completed the wiring and inspection of the supermarket power distribution cabinet alone (Zhao Qiang was on leave).
events.description: In the morning at the construction site, Zhao Qiang sent a WeChat message saying he had a fever and asked for leave. Lu Mingqiang and Liu Xiaojun then stepped up their work; Lu Mingqiang completed all the remaining wiring on his own and did a final check, using a multimeter to measure insulation and continuity one by one. He worked until noon before it was basically done. Although tired, he did not compromise on quality control.

events.name: Lunch break review of PLC analog instructions
events.description: During a 30-minute lunch break, Lu Mingqiang watched instructional videos on PLC analog input/output instructions on his phone in the break room, focusing on learning the concepts of analog-to-digital conversion and data comparison instructions.

events.name: After work, complete the final assembly and testing of the eco-friendly power car
events.description: After finishing work and returning home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang and Lu Zixuan carried out the final assembly—gluing the battery box firmly onto the chassis and checking all wire connections. He took a deep breath and let his son press the switch himself. The car ran smoothly forward accompanied by the sound of the motor, and it didn't even stop when crossing the gaps between floor tiles! Lu Zixuan jumped up excitedly and cheered. Lu Mingqiang gave him a high-five and recorded this successful moment with his phone. He praised his son for his focus and patience over the past half month, and Lu Zixuan hugged the car, unwilling to put it down.

events.name: Invite workmate Chen Jianguo for barbecue.
events.description: After the small cart was a success, Lu Mingqiang was in a great mood. He sent a WeChat message to his workmate Chen Jianguo, inviting him to dinner at a lively night-market barbecue stall on Jinmao Middle Road. Chen Jianguo readily agreed.

events.name: Eating grilled fish, drinking, and chatting at the night market.
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo sat at a night market stall and ordered a serving of the signature grilled fish, several skewers of lamb, and a pitcher of iced beer. Lu Mingqiang picked up a large piece of fish and talked about his son's successful making of a small car. Chen Jianguo complained that his mother was urging him to get married again, saying that if he didn't bring a girlfriend home this year, he shouldn't come back for the New Year. The two traded remarks back and forth, and their laughter drew glances from nearby tables.

events.name: During the meal, they agreed to sign up for a skills training course together.
events.description: The topic turned to technology. Lu Mingqiang mentioned that he planned to go all out for the senior technician exam in September. Chen Jianguo said he had also been wanting to systematically improve his practical skills in PLC and variable frequency drives. The two hit it off and agreed to sign up together next month for an industry skills training class, with classes every Saturday, to keep each other accountable. Lu Mingqiang noted down the online registration link on his phone.

events.name: Going home separately late at night
events.description: The two chatted over dinner until 9 p.m., paid the bill, and each went home. Lu Mingqiang was slightly tipsy but got home safely. His wife handed him honey water and gently chided him for drinking without restraint.

events.name: Verified a work issue using PLC simulation before bed
events.description: Despite arriving home late and slightly tipsy, Lu Mingqiang still spent 20 minutes in his study opening the PLC app, abstracting the supermarket freezer motor forward-reverse control requirement encountered during the day's work into a ladder diagram. After the simulation passed, he went to wash up with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Filled with anticipation, my son's model project is about to be completed.

end_state.mood: Extreme satisfaction, the fulfillment of parenting plus a happy gathering with friends, intoxicated with happiness.

state.daily_exercise: Physical labor on the construction site; no dedicated exercise

2025-08.daily_overview: In the hot weather, Lu Mingqiang conducted a comprehensive test of the newly installed circuits at the supermarket, checking insulation, continuity, and polarity item by item, rigorously and meticulously. At 6 p.m., he completed interval running training in the lingering heat, sweating profusely, but his heart and lungs received a full workout. On the way, he met his running buddy Chen Bin, and they encouraged each other. In the evening, he did family bookkeeping, recorded the high-temperature electricity costs, and reminded his family to save energy. Before bed, after taking a shower, he reviewed his PLC analog value notes to deepen his understanding.

events.name: Insulation and continuity testing for the supermarket's newly installed wiring.
events.description: During the day, Lu Mingqiang led his apprentices in using a megohmmeter and a multimeter to perform insulation resistance tests and continuity tests on all newly installed wiring, and checked the polarity of the live, neutral, and ground wires of each socket one by one. He found a socket where the neutral and ground wires were reversed and immediately corrected it, using this as an example to explain the dangers of reversed neutral and ground connections to Liu Xiaojun. After testing, he closed the switch to energize the circuits under no-load conditions. All voltage and current values on every circuit were within normal range, and he carefully recorded the commissioning data.

events.name: Studied analog instructions during the lunch break
events.description: During the 30-minute lunch break, Lu Mingqiang watched a teaching video on PLC analog input/output instructions on his new phone in the rest room, focusing on the concept of analog-to-digital conversion and data comparison instructions. Although it was somewhat abstract, he gradually understood it by relating it to the temperature sensor signals he saw at work.

events.name: Evening interval training run; ran into fellow runner Chen Bin
events.description: At 6 p.m., despite the heat, Lu Mingqiang changed into a vest and shorts and went to the nearby school playground for interval running: 400-meter fast run (pace about 4 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer) + 200-meter slow walk, repeated for 6 sets. When he reached the third set, his running buddy Chen Bin also came to exercise, and the two ran the last three sets together, encouraging each other. After running, he drank half a bottle of lightly salted water and felt his heart and lungs were effectively activated.

events.name: Evening family bookkeeping, recording high-temperature electricity expenses
events.description: In the evening while keeping the accounts, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan checked the day's small expenses, including buying water and the increased air-conditioning cost caused by the hot weather, and reminded the family to be frugal.

events.name: Take a relaxing shower before bed and quickly review the PLC analog notes.
events.description: After finishing his run and taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang spent 10 minutes in his study reviewing the PLC analog input/output concepts he studied at noon, combining them with the temperature sensors at work to deepen his understanding.

start_state.mood: Focused, thinking about finishing the test as soon as possible

end_state.mood: Tired but refreshed after exercise; reviewing makes knowledge more solid

state.daily_exercise: Interval running about 5 km (including warm-up)

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to thundershowers, temperature 26-32°C, heavy rain in the afternoon

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday, the supermarket project underwent final debugging and defect elimination. Lu Mingqiang re-measured the power delivery parameters to ensure everything was foolproof. In the evening at home, he performed PLC comprehensive programming simulation and compiled all this week's notes into a booklet, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment. Although leaving work in heavy rain was somewhat inconvenient, he was planning tomorrow morning's acceptance check. In the evening, he also found time to help his eldest son with summer homework, and video-called his elder brother Lu Minghua to share the good news, strengthening their brotherly bond.

events.name: Commissioning with load after energizing the supermarket's circuits
events.description: In the morning, after confirming insulation and safety measures, Lu Mingqiang gradually energized the supermarket lighting and part of the freezer loads area by area, used a clamp meter to measure the current in each circuit, and recorded the three-phase balance. One lighting circuit had a slightly high current. He investigated and found that the number of light fixtures was more than expected, so he immediately adjusted the circuit distribution. By the afternoon, all switches, sockets, and light strips were functioning normally, and he cleaned the construction site section by section with his apprentice.

events.name: Completed the comprehensive programming simulation problems during the lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang completed a set of PLC comprehensive programming simulation questions from the APP's mock exam, including complex requirements for motor forward/reverse rotation with timed switching. He drew a state transition diagram on scratch paper, then wrote the ladder diagram. He finally passed, and the star for the points lit up.

events.name: In the evening, organized this week's notes and highlighted the easily confused points.
events.description: In the evening in the study, Lu Mingqiang took out all of this week's study notes and screenshots, organized the easily confused points in electrical fundamentals, frequency converters, and PLCs (such as the difference between contactors and relays, and the difference between torque boost and voltage boost) into a table, and clipped it into the notebook. The entire notebook booklet had become much thicker; he flipped through the earlier content and was satisfied with his persistence.

events.name: Tutoring the eldest son to finish his summer vacation math homework.
events.description: After dinner, his wife mentioned that the eldest son still had a few pages of math summer homework unfinished. Lu Mingqiang then sat down at his son's desk and patiently explained several word problems, using electricity meter data from daily life as examples. His son understood quickly. After finishing the homework, father and son played with puzzles for a while.

events.name: Evening family video call chatting with older brother Lu Minghua
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to make a WeChat video call to his older brother Lu Minghua, who was on the night shift. He shared the news that the supermarket project would be accepted tomorrow and the good news that his son's toy car had been successfully built. The two encouraged each other and agreed to go back to their parents' home next month to fix the old house's electrical circuits together. The call lasted 15 minutes and strengthened the bond between the brothers.

start_state.mood: Orderly and methodical, the project is nearing completion.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling; knowledge management made the learning path clear, parent-child interaction was pleasant, and brotherly ties were strengthened.

state.daily_exercise: Construction activity, no additional special item.

date_attribute.weather: Heavy rain turning cloudy, temperature 25-29°C, yellow rainstorm warning for the whole city.

2025-08.daily_overview: In the heavy rain, Lu Mingqiang successfully completed the final acceptance and handover of the supermarket circuit renovation project. Team Leader Zhang praised him on site for finishing half a day early. He also booked a comprehensive physical examination for him and his wife the next day and made preparations for overtime in response to the typhoon—that evening he was called back to the company to inspect the emergency warehouse. He was tired but relieved. Lying in bed at night, he quickly reviewed the week's core PLC content on his phone, decided to organize the key points on Saturday, and fell asleep at 23:00.

events.name: Completion acceptance of the supermarket circuit renovation project.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang performed a final functional test on all switches, sockets, lamps, and distribution cabinets, and thoroughly cleaned up the site. He then demonstrated the operations to the supermarket's person in charge item by item, explained the control scope and precautions for each circuit in the new distribution box, and completed the handover signing. The supermarket manager expressed great satisfaction with his professionalism and construction quality.

events.name: Report to Squad Leader Zhang and give a wrap-up summary.
events.description: After hanging up, he was in a good mood. On the way to the bathroom to take a shower, he passed by the electronic scale and stepped on it again. The screen clearly displayed “71.8kg”. He looked at it with satisfaction for a few seconds, feeling that his waist and back were indeed much more relaxed, and confirmed the morning’s weight data.

events.name: Called to book a comprehensive physical exam for the couple.
events.description: On the way back from work, while waiting at a red light, Lu Mingqiang used the speakerphone to call Meinian Onehealth Physical Examination Center and booked an in-depth physical examination package for the morning of August 15 for himself and his wife Wang Lijuan. The customer service confirmed the time and fasting requirements, and he noted them all in his phone reminders.

events.name: In the evening, was urgently called back to the company to inspect typhoon emergency supplies
events.description: At 8 p.m., Team Leader Zhang notified the team group chat that Typhoon Talim's path might hit Hainan directly, asking all team members to return to the company to inspect emergency repair supplies. Lu Mingqiang immediately rushed back to the company warehouse and, together with his colleagues, inventoried generators, cables, emergency lights and other materials, replenished fuel and waterproof equipment, and didn't get home until after 10 o'clock.

events.name: Before bed, quickly review this week's PLC and plan next week
events.description: Even though it was late, Lu Mingqiang still spent 5 minutes quickly reviewing the week's core PLC content, decided to sort out the key points on Saturday, and then went to sleep.

start_state.mood: A bit worried about the heavy rain, but determined to complete the project.

end_state.mood: Tired but relaxed. The project was delivered successfully, tomorrow's physical exam is arranged, and emergency preparations are in place.

state.daily_exercise: Finishing up and cleaning the construction site, and doing warehouse moving work in the evening.

2025-08.daily_overview: Turning point day: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and his wife completed a comprehensive physical exam. In the afternoon, the report showed that he had high blood lipids and mildly elevated cholesterol, and his wife was anemic, so the couple immediately decided to adjust the family's diet. The same day, he received the confirmation notice for the official senior technician exam, scheduled for November 12, and decisively decided to enter the sprint phase starting that day, increasing his daily exam preparation to 2 hours. In the evening, he hung the Bluetooth speaker he had received in the kitchen and started playing audio. That night, he did targeted practice on weak areas and also specifically reminded his mother to protect her knees in the rainy weather next week. Health and study both went up a gear, opening a new chapter in his outlook on life.

events.name: Morning core training for 15 minutes
events.description: After getting up in the early morning, Lu Mingqiang as usual completed a 15-minute core strength and stretching routine in the living room, including superman exercises, planks, and glute bridges. He felt his lower back strength was stable, with no discomfort at all, fully recovered.

events.name: Call to remind mother to apply a hot compress to her knee.
events.description: Before going out, Lu Mingqiang saw in the weather forecast that there would be continuous rain next week, so he immediately called his mother Chen Xiuying and reminded her to apply a hot salt pack to her knees every night before bed before the rainy days came, to ease joint pain. His mother laughed on the phone and said she knew, telling him not to worry.

events.name: Drive to the physical examination center with his wife.
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan drove to the Meinian Onehealth Physical Examination Center on Haixiu Road on empty stomachs. On the way, they reminded each other not to drink any water. Because they arrived early, there was not a long queue, and the process began quickly.

events.name: Completed a full comprehensive physical examination.
events.description: The couple completed all the items on the examination checklist in order, including blood draw, abdominal ultrasound, electrocardiogram, and chest X-ray. In the ultrasound room, the doctor reminded Lu Mingqiang that he was showing a tendency toward mild fatty liver and needed to watch his diet and exercise; he took this to heart. The whole physical examination took about two and a half hours.

events.name: Received the physical examination report and found an issue.
events.description: At 2 p.m., the physical examination report came out. Lu Mingqiang read it carefully: his triglycerides were 2.3 mmol/L (slightly high), his cholesterol was mildly elevated, and there was a tendency toward mild fatty liver; his wife Wang Lijuan had low hemoglobin and mild iron-deficiency anemia. The two exchanged a look, wearing somewhat solemn expressions, but were also glad to have found out early.

events.name: Together, they decided to adjust the family's dietary structure.
events.description: On the drive home, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan discussed: from now on, the family should reduce braised and fried dishes, replacing them with steamed and boiled dishes; stir-fried dishes should use less oil and salt; and they should eat pork liver or spinach at least twice a week to supplement iron. Lu Mingqiang also raised the issue of cutting down on alcohol and decided to try not to drink beer at future gatherings.
