They decided to go to the community hospital the next day to consult on a specific diet plan.

events.name: Received the official registration confirmation for the Senior Technician exam; the exam is scheduled for mid-November.
events.description: When he returned to the company in the afternoon to handle daily affairs, Lu Mingqiang received the official confirmation notice for the Senior Technician vocational skill appraisal exam issued by the company, and the exam time was set for November 12. He quickly estimated the time—there was less than three months left—and immediately wrote a decision on the back of the notice: from that day on, he would enter the sprint phase, increasing his daily theory review time from 1 hour to 2 hours, and on weekends he would focus all day on solving practical problems with variable-frequency drives and PLCs. He took a photo of this resolution and sent it to his wife.

events.name: Unbox and install the Bluetooth speaker
events.description: In the evening, the courier delivered the waterproof Bluetooth speaker bought the previous night. Lu Mingqiang unboxed it and, following the instructions, mounted the speaker on the kitchen wall tiles using suction-cup hooks. He connected the charging cable and paired it successfully with his phone via Bluetooth. He then played an audio about the history of the Industrial Revolution; the sound was clear, and the kitchen instantly took on a learning atmosphere.

events.name: Tested the speaker with parenting audio and listened together with my wife.
events.description: After dinner, while clearing away the dishes, Lu Mingqiang turned on the speaker and played a parent-child education audio program, and they discussed how to cultivate children's concentration. His wife Wang Lijuan, while wiping the stove, was also drawn in by the content. She dried her hands, stopped to listen, and exchanged a few words with Lu Mingqiang. Both felt this was a very good way to learn.

events.name: Evening focused practice on weak points in circuit fundamentals
events.description: As planned, Lu Mingqiang completed a targeted exercise of 30 multiple-choice and true-or-false questions on weak points in circuit fundamentals through the vocational skills app in the study this evening. After grading, he got 5 wrong, all involving complex DC circuit calculations. He took out a separate piece of scratch paper and recalculated the wrong problems until he understood them.

start_state.mood: Feeling a bit heavy on an empty stomach, but concerned and somewhat nervous about the health check results

end_state.mood: The physical exam results brought vigilance and motivation; I upgraded my exam preparation plan and launched a health reform, feeling a strong sense of direction.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core training for 15 minutes, physical exam and commuting consumption

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, with brief showers in the afternoon, temperature 27-34°C.

2025-08.daily_overview: Today, Lu Mingqiang's family life revolved around two major events: in the morning, he bought books according to the newly issued syllabus for the senior technician exam and planned audio learning in the kitchen; then he went with his wife to the community hospital to handle follow-up matters from the physical examination, received dietary advice, and together they worked out a family diet adjustment plan. In the afternoon, he received the Bluetooth speaker, installed and tried it out, then completed an 8-kilometer run. In the evening came the exciting moment — his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, won the Best Creativity Award in the science and technology model competition, and father and son shared the glory. This day also marked the official launch of the family's healthy eating reform.

events.name: Morning core strength training
events.description: After getting up at 05:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of core and back training per the rehabilitation therapist's guidance for [shrimp exercise], including planks, glute bridges, and superman poses. His movements were smooth and standard, with no discomfort in his lower back.

events.name: Ordered senior technician exam preparation books based on the annual exam syllabus.
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang opened the Senior Technician exam syllabus issued by the company. Carefully checking the table of contents, he found that he needed to add the latest theory reference books and exercise collections. Considering that Xinhua Bookstore might not have a complete set, he searched and ordered a set of the 'Guide to the Electrician Senior Technician Qualification Certification Exam' and its accompanying exercise collection on Tmall using his newly bought smartphone. He chose in-store pickup to save shipping costs and planned to pick them up in the afternoon when passing by the bookstore.

events.name: Plan an evening audio learning session in the kitchen
events.description: After hanging the Bluetooth speaker in the kitchen last night to listen to clips of historical documentaries with good results, Lu Mingqiang further refined the plan today: he decided to play audio in the kitchen every night from 7:00 to 8:00, connecting his phone to the speaker, rotating content between industrial development history and parent-child education courses, and setting calendar reminders. He deliberately shared the plan with his wife to coordinate the family's daily schedule.

events.name: Go to the community hospital to pick up the physical examination report and mark items of concern
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan went together to Jinmao Community Health Service Center, where they used their ID cards to pick up the comprehensive physical examination report from yesterday. He flipped through the report and found that his triglycerides were 2.1 mmol/L and total cholesterol 6.0 mmol/L, both slightly above normal; his wife's hemoglobin was low, indicating mild anemia. He circled these abnormal indicators with a pen, planning to consult a doctor.

events.name: The couple waited in line at the community hospital for a nutrition consultation
events.description: After picking up the report, the couple went to the nutrition clinic on the first floor and found several people already in the waiting area. Wang Lijuan was a bit nervous, and Lu Mingqiang gently comforted her, saying, "Let's hear what the doctor says; we can adjust together." They waited about 20 minutes, during which they discussed the feasibility of using less oil and salt in the future.

events.name: Consult a nutrition department doctor for professional dietary advice
events.description: When their turn came, Lu Mingqiang handed the two reports to the doctor. After careful analysis, the nutrition department doctor pointed out that his problems were excessive intake of cooking oil and salt and insufficient vegetable intake, while his wife had insufficient iron and protein. The doctor prescribed a specific plan: control daily salt to below 6 grams and oil to within 25 grams, increase consumption of steamed fish, chicken breast, dark green vegetables, and pork liver, and recommended buying a salt-control spoon and a graduated oil bottle.

events.name: Organized and recorded the dietary guidance given by the doctor
events.description: After the consultation, Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat down in the rest area of the community hospital. Wang Lijuan took out her phone notes, and Lu Mingqiang repeated the doctor's key points: limit salt and oil, focus on steaming and boiling, eat pork liver soup twice a week, and ensure a fist-sized portion of dark green vegetables every day. His wife recorded them item by item and marked the key points, planning to post them on the refrigerator when they got home.

events.name: Jointly discuss and formulate an initial diet adjustment plan
events.description: On the way home, the couple stopped by the food market. Lu Mingqiang suggested trying steamed fish and garlic broccoli at lunch and cutting back on braised dishes. Wang Lijuan thought that was acceptable but worried the children would complain. The two initially agreed: starting tomorrow, add boiled eggs and multigrain porridge to breakfast, change the packed lunch to low-oil bento boxes, and strictly avoid deep-frying at dinner. They also made a list of items to buy: a salt-control spoon, an oil dispenser, and steamed-fish soy sauce.

events.name: Received the Bluetooth speaker delivery in the evening, tried it out, then hung it up in the kitchen.
events.description: Around 4 p.m., the courier delivered the Bluetooth speaker Lu Mingqiang had ordered online on Sunday. He unpacked and inspected it, then, following the manual, used a suction-cup hook to fix the speaker onto the kitchen wall tiles and paired it with his phone via Bluetooth. He casually played an audio clip about the history of the Industrial Revolution; the sound was clear, preparing for future kitchen learning sessions.

events.name: Do an 8-kilometer long run to simulate 10-kilometer pace.
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., it was a bit cooler in Haikou. Lu Mingqiang changed into quick-dry clothes, ran along Jinmao Middle Road to Wanlv Garden, circled the garden twice, and then turned back, maintaining a pace of 6:30 per kilometer throughout to simulate race rhythm. He drank water twice along the way and felt his breathing was smooth and his legs had no discomfort. He realized that after recovering from his back injury, his running condition was steadily improving, and he felt more confident about completing a continuous 10-kilometer run.

events.name: Father and son participated in the science and technology model competition and won the Best Creativity Award.
events.description: At six in the evening, Lu Mingqiang changed into a neat shirt and took his elder son Lu Zixuan to the Haikou Youth Activity Center to attend the award ceremony for the Science and Technology Model Competition. When the host announced that the "Eco-Friendly Powered Car Project" had won the Best Creativity Award, Lu Zixuan ran onto the stage excitedly. Lu Mingqiang was so moved that his eyes welled up, and he kept taking photos. After receiving the award, he picked up his son and said, "Dad is proud of you," and promised to take the whole family out for qingbuliang the next day to celebrate.

events.name: Before bed, review how the first day of dietary adjustment felt.
events.description: At 9 p.m., after the children fell asleep, Lu Mingqiang and his wife briefly reviewed the experience of starting a light diet that day on the sofa. Wang Lijuan said the steamed fish was very tender and that you could still taste the freshness even with less salt; Lu Mingqiang said it would take some getting used to, but it was worth it for his health. The two agreed to supervise each other and recorded the adjustments in their shared phone memo.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and full of anticipation

end_state.mood: Excited and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, 8 km long run

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with thundershowers in the evening; temperature 28-36℃.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang devoted all his time to family and self-improvement. Early in the morning he attended a parent-child swimming class and continued practicing breaststroke; later in the morning he studied mechanical disassembly and assembly and circuit drawing in his study, consolidating his skills. Then he officially launched the family healthy-eating reform, putting a salt-control spoon in place and marking the oil bottle with graduations, planning a weekly menu, and buying ingredients. In the afternoon he took his two sons to hand-make traditional diamond-shaped kites. The test flight failed, but there was non-stop laughter, and afterwards the father and sons discussed improvements. In the evening, he used his spare time to devise math problems based on circuit diagrams, preparing for tutoring his elder son later. The day was fulfilling and heartwarming.

events.name: Attended parent-child swimming class after morning core training
events.description: After getting up at 6:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang did his usual 15-minute core training, then woke the children, and the family of four went to the community swimming pool for the Sunday parent-child swimming class. Under the coach's guidance, Lu Mingqiang could already swim 10 meters using the breaststroke kick without a kickboard. Although his breathing was still a bit unsteady, he had made obvious progress. After class, he played in the water with the children for ten minutes.

events.name: The accuracy of the mechanical assembly and disassembly simulation exercises in the Study Room App improved.
events.description: After breakfast, having returned from swimming, Lu Mingqiang went alone into the small study, opened the mechanical disassembly and assembly module in the electrician study app on his phone, and focused on the 3D disassembly and assembly simulation of a gearbox. Combining it with the diagram-based exercises in the study guide he had picked up yesterday, he wrote down the structural relationships as he disassembled. After practicing ten questions in a row, his accuracy rose from just over 60% to 80%. He stretched and felt even more confident about his exam preparation.

events.name: Formally implementing the family healthy eating reform
events.description: At 10 a.m., Lu Mingqiang hung the salt-control spoon and the graduated oil jug he bought yesterday in a conspicuous place in the kitchen, and wrote 'family daily limit' at the 350 ml line of the oil jug with a marker. He opened the notes app on his phone and, referring to the nutrition department's recommendations, formulated a weekly menu: Monday, steamed sea fish with garlic broccoli; Tuesday, winter melon and clam soup with lean meat; Wednesday, pork liver and spinach soup, etc. Then he went to the market with his wife to buy according to the menu, purchasing fresh sea fish, chicken breast, dark green vegetables, and olive oil.

events.name: Father and two sons purchase materials to make traditional kites.
events.description: After returning from the market, Lu Mingqiang kept the promise he had made to the children the day before and took his two sons to the community hardware store. Having never made a kite, he compared items in the store for a long time and finally chose flexible thin bamboo strips, several sheets of rice paper, white glue, and cotton thread. His younger son, Lu Zihan, grabbed the glue, and his elder son, Lu Zixuan, hugged the paper, running home excitedly.

events.name: Three people cooperated to make a traditional diamond-shaped kite.
events.description: Back home, Lu Mingqiang cleaned the dining table and spread newspapers over it. He was responsible for binding the bamboo-strip frame, using thin thread to secure the crossing points; his technique was unskilled but careful. His eldest son Lu Zixuan drew rocket and star patterns on xuan paper with colored markers; his younger son Lu Zihan sat beside him, helping pass scissors and thread spools. After an hour of work, a colorful diamond-shaped kite finally took shape.

events.name: Kite test flight in the community open space failed but was full of joy.
events.description: At 4 p.m., just after a thunderstorm, the air was fresh. The father and his two sons came to the central square of the residential community with a homemade kite. Lu Mingqiang ran hard against the breeze; the kite wobbled up two meters and then pitched nose-first to the ground. After several failed attempts, three or four neighborhood children gathered to watch. Lu Zihan laughed and clapped. Lu Mingqiang wiped his sweat and said, "It's okay, failure is also fun," and the three of them burst into laughter on the grass.

events.name: After the test flight failed, agreed to improve the kite
events.description: On the way home, Lu Mingqiang told his two sons that when he was a child, his father had also taken him to make kites, and the first one could not fly either, but after adjusting the center of gravity and the bridle line, it worked. They discussed that next time they could add two long ribbons to the tail, like Grandpa Wang in the next unit, to improve balance. Lu Zixuan volunteered to search online for tutorials. Lu Mingqiang promised to try again next weekend.

events.name: In the evening, he conceived and sketched math problems based on circuit diagrams.
events.description: In the evening, while his wife was reading picture books with the children, Lu Mingqiang went back to his study. He took out the simple lighting circuit diagram from his senior technician textbook, drew the circuit on a piece of white paper, labeled the resistance values, and made up five problems involving Ohm's law and series voltage division calculations. He plans to start tutoring his eldest son with these problems tomorrow, integrating abstract math into visible circuits to continue the interest in learning sparked by the technology award.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilling.

2025-08.daily_overview: Monday work went as usual. During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang used an app in the rest room to reinforce his knowledge of safety regulations. After work, he first picked out a gold necklace for the wedding anniversary, then briefly discussed the anniversary plans with his wife over dinner and talked about surprise arrangements. Afterwards, he received a call from an old client, Li Jianguo, about a frequency converter malfunction. After a preliminary check found nothing, he called his mentor Master Li for directional advice. In the evening, he also went to the market to buy healthy ingredients and kept up with focused practice on fault diagnosis cases. Despite the busy schedule, he balanced work responsibilities, family affection, and self-improvement.

events.name: Morning core training and commute.
events.description: After getting up at 05:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang completed a 15-minute core workout, ate the multigrain porridge and boiled eggs his wife had prepared for breakfast, then rode his e-bike to the company, feeling light on the way.

events.name: During the lunch break, completed the special practice on electric power safety regulations in the app.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang did not rest immediately as usual. Instead, he sat on a plastic chair in the lounge, opened the safety training section in the phone app, and selected 'Special Practice on Preventing Electric Shock Accidents.' He restored the wrong operations in the real cases one by one, paying special attention to key points such as hanging safety signs, verifying electricity, and arranging dedicated supervision. All seven questions were answered correctly. Satisfied, he took a sip of water and began a short nap.

events.name: After work, shop for a gold necklace for the wedding anniversary.
events.description: After getting off work at 5 p.m., Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike directly to a time-honored gold shop on Jiefang West Road in Longhua District. At the counter, he repeatedly compared gram weights and designs, and finally chose a simple 24k gold pendant necklace for 495 yuan. The sales clerk packaged it in a red velvet box; he carefully put it into his inner pocket and smiled all the way home.

events.name: After dinner, briefly discussed the anniversary plan with his wife Wang Lijuan
events.description: During dinner, Lu Mingqiang discussed with his wife the specific arrangements for their tenth wedding anniversary the day after tomorrow. He told her that he had already bought a gold necklace and planned to ask his mother to help watch the children for a while, in order to give her a surprise. Wang Lijuan said there was no need for anything too grand, but agreed with a smile.

events.name: Received a call from customer Li Jianguo about a frequency converter fault and conducted a preliminary check.
events.description: Just after getting home and changing into slippers, Lu Mingqiang's phone rang. A long-time customer, Li Jianguo, anxiously reported that a variable-frequency drive for a cutting machine in his shop in Meilan District kept tripping, shutting down the entire production line. Lu Mingqiang grabbed his usual multimeter and immediately rode over to the repair shop. His initial measurements showed normal input voltage and acceptable motor insulation, but the fault was intermittent. He suspected interference or hidden leakage, but with limited time on site he couldn't pinpoint it.

events.name: Called Master Li to consult him
events.description: After returning home at nearly 7:30, Lu Mingqiang quickly ate a few mouthfuls of rice, then called his master, Master Li. He described in detail the phenomenon when the frequency converter tripped, the external inspection data, and the problem points he had failed to find. After thinking, Master Li judged that it was likely harmonic interference generated by the extruder or poor grounding connection, and suggested installing a filter at the input end of the frequency converter the next day and tightening all grounding stakes one by one. Lu Mingqiang noted it all down.

events.name: Purchased healthy ingredients at the market
events.description: Despite the tight schedule, Lu Mingqiang still made a detour to the vegetable market. After shopping around, he bought a fresh golden pompano, a bunch of spinach, and two tomatoes, and specifically bought a small bottle of olive oil for easy oil control. The stall owner, Lao Chen, teased, "Brother Qiang has been buying fish every day lately." He smiled back, "Gotta stay healthy."

events.name: Evening: completed fault diagnosis case analysis exercises on the app
events.description: After bathing, Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room and used an app to do 20 sets of fault diagnosis case exercises, focusing on interference and overload cases related to frequency converters. He carefully read the fault tree of each case and entered his analysis of today's situation into his mistake notebook. He was well aware that he would verify his master's advice in practice tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Energetic

end_state.mood: Grounded and slightly tired

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, commute by cycling

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, with isolated afternoon thunderstorms, temperature 26-33°C.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lu Mingqiang went to the client's shop early in the morning. Using his master's advice, he successfully solved the frequency converter fault, and the client called the company to praise him, giving him a strong sense of work fulfillment. At noon, he took a comprehensive mock test in the break room and got an 80% accuracy rate, confirming the effect of his recent review. In the evening, he completed a 5-kilometer tempo run at lactate threshold pace. Later that night, he chatted with his childhood friend Wang Haiming over video about how things were, and they agreed to meet on National Day. An ordinary day full of professional achievement and emotional connection.

events.name: Morning core training.
events.description: Got up at 05:45. After 15 minutes of core training, Lu Mingqiang felt his waist stability had improved again, so he decided to try a slightly faster pace on today's run.

events.name: Based on the suggestion, go back to the site again to thoroughly solve the frequency converter fault
events.description: At seven in the morning, Lu Mingqiang clocked in at the company and then went straight to Li Jianguo's repair shop. He first connected a simple filter in series with the VFD input terminals, then, as his master had said, tightened all grounding screws—sure enough, he found that a ground wire screw at the terminal block had loosened and oxidized. After re-polishing the connections and switching on the power for a test run, the VFD ran smoothly and no longer tripped. Boss Li shook his hand firmly and thanked him repeatedly.

events.name: A customer called the company to praise Lu Mingqiang.
events.description: Shortly after the fault was resolved, Li Jianguo specifically called Manager Liu of the company's engineering department to praise Lu Mingqiang for his solid technical skills and timely service, saying he even came to help after work hours. Manager Liu named him in a commendation in the department WeChat group, and Team Leader Zhang also sent a thumbs-up emoji in a private message. When Lu Mingqiang saw these messages, he felt more confident in his approach to handling difficult problems.

events.name: Run a 5-kilometer tempo run at lactate threshold pace.
events.description: As the sun set, Lu Mingqiang changed into his running gear and did a 5-kilometer tempo run along the trail from Jinmao Middle Road to Haikou Bay Park. He deliberately kept a pace of about 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, feeling the coordination of breathing and stride frequency. His thighs were slightly sore, but his overall rhythm was stable. Along the way, he saw many residents out walking after work, which strengthened his determination to integrate running into his life.

events.name: Comprehensive mock test in the lunch break app achieved an accuracy rate of over 80%
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang took advantage of a quiet corner of the break room, opened the app, and took a complete mock test covering electrical theory, fault analysis, safety regulations, etc. The time limit was 90 minutes; he finished 5 minutes early with an accuracy rate of 82%. He clenched his fist toward the phone screen to celebrate, took out a small notebook to record his weak points, and planned to strengthen them in the evening.

events.name: Answer a WeChat video call from childhood friend Wang Haiming
events.description: At eight in the evening, Lu Mingqiang had just finished tutoring his eldest son's homework when a video call invitation from Wang Haiming popped up on his phone. He walked to the balcony to answer. In the picture, Wang Haiming, wearing a large T-shirt, sat in his rented apartment in Shenzhen. The two chatted in Hainanese as usual. Wang Haiming shared the hardships and pleasures of doing business in Huaqiangbei, and hinted that he might return to Haikou at the end of the year to help relatives run their shop. Lu Mingqiang enthusiastically talked about his son's award and his father giving him an old liquor bottle. Wang Haiming confirmed that he would return to Haikou for National Day, and Lu Mingqiang immediately agreed to get together.

events.name: Shared the content of the phone call with his wife and looked forward to the National Day gathering.
events.description: After hanging up the video call, Lu Mingqiang returned to the living room and said to his wife, who was folding clothes, "That guy Wang Haiming is coming back for National Day. When the time comes, we'll invite Wu Gang and the others, and we'll probably have to go to that grilled fish restaurant on Haixiu Road." Wang Lijuan smiled and agreed, then asked with concern whether Wang Haiming really intended to move back and build a life here. The couple chatted on this topic for a while, feeling that the reunion of old friends after many years was something to look forward to. Because they talked late, they went to sleep half an hour later than usual.

start_state.mood: Steady and confident.

end_state.mood: Pleasant and full of anticipation.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, 5 km tempo run

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, light breeze, sunset glow in the evening, temperature 27-34°C

2025-08.daily_overview: Wednesday was the tenth wedding anniversary of Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan. During the day he worked as usual, did core training before the lunch break, and then looked up the registration process for senior technician certification. In the evening after work, he hid the gold necklace, carefully set up a tea table on the balcony, and created a romantic atmosphere with cooling dessert soup, grilled fish, and old man tea. When he handed the necklace to his wife, the couple recalled the little moments of ten years on the balcony. His wife's words, "Take good care of your health, that's more important than anything," moved him deeply. Late at night, he calmly reviewed the week's wrong questions again, turning his emotion into the drive to improve.

events.name: Morning core training and daily work.
events.description: Woke up at 05:50, did 15 minutes of core training, and went to work. I was in a special mood today, thinking about this evening's plans, and I had extra energy at work.

events.name: Core training before the lunch break, looking up the senior technician application process, and preparing materials
events.description: At 11:30 a.m., after completing 15 minutes of core training in the break room, Lu Mingqiang used his lunch break to look up the registration process. He took a photo of the exam registration notice on the company bulletin board with his phone and searched online for the registration deadline and required materials. He found that he needed proof of years of work and the company's official seal, and planned to ask Team Leader Zhang for it the next day. He also noted the specific time of the theory exam—November 12, with 84 days left on the countdown.

events.name: After getting off work, decorate the balcony to celebrate the wedding anniversary.
events.description: When he got home at six in the evening, Lu Mingqiang first let his wife rest a bit longer. He cleaned the balcony himself, set up the small folding table, and spread the indigo-dyed cloth from the children's art class. He brewed a pot of fragrant Laoba tea, set out the qingbuliang from the fridge and the grilled fish bought at noon, and even lit two light purple candles. When everything was ready, he went to the bedroom to invite his wife out, and said with a smile, "Dear, happy anniversary."

events.name: Gave a gold necklace and reminisced about their ten years of marriage.
events.description: After sitting down on the balcony, Lu Mingqiang took a red velvet box from his pocket and handed it to his wife. Wang Lijuan opened it and saw a shiny gold necklace. Her eyes turned slightly red, and she said softly, "It's been ten years, and you're still spending so much money on me." Lu Mingqiang put it on for her. The two drank laoba tea while recalling the simple wedding ten years ago, the panic when their first child was born, and the difficulty of buying the house... His wife held his hand and urged, "You climb poles and repair electrical lines outside. You must take care of yourself. Nothing is more important than you looking after yourself." Lu Mingqiang nodded firmly.

events.name: Evening focused review of the wrong questions from the previous five days
events.description: On the evening of the anniversary, after his wife had settled the child into bed, Lu Mingqiang went to his study on his own, opened the error notebook he had been keeping these days, and reworked the problems one by one, especially re-deriving the wrong ones related to transformer loss calculations and the principles of electrical isolation. After repeated practice, he wrote out the correct solutions once more to deepen his memory. It was almost 11 p.m. by then, but he felt that working hard for his family's future was especially meaningful.

start_state.mood: Secretly looking forward

end_state.mood: Deeply sentimental yet resolute.

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, and core strengthening for 15 minutes before the lunch break.

2025-08.daily_overview: Thursday's work was still hectic, but after work Lu Mingqiang had his biweekly table tennis social night. He rode his electric bike to the community activity room and played several games with three fellow players. His backhand push-blocking stability improved again, and they also set a time for the next run. After playing, he went home a bit tired but still completed the last APP-specific assessment of the week. His accuracy rate remained steady at 90%, and he was satisfied with his exam preparation progress.

events.name: Morning core training and daily work.
events.description: Got up at 05:50 in the morning and completed a 15-minute core workout. There was a table tennis activity after work today, so Lu Mingqiang deliberately ate more vegetables at noon to replenish his energy.

events.name: After work, prepare sports equipment and go to the community activity room
events.description: Arriving home at 5:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang quickly ate the low-oil dinner his wife had left for him — steamed pumpkin and stir-fried amaranth — then took his table tennis paddle from the cabinet, wiped the rubber with a damp cloth, checked the tackiness of the paddle face, put a bottle of water in his backpack, and rode his e-bike to the community activity room, facing the evening breeze and feeling lighthearted.

events.name: Practiced table tennis with a fellow player and consolidated backhand technique.
events.description: In the activity room, his squash buddies Brother Zhang, Lin Feng, and others were already warming up. Lu Mingqiang first rallied with Brother Zhang, then focused on practicing backhand push and fast flick. Now that his back injury had healed and his core was stable, his backhand consistency and placement control had improved significantly. Lin Feng watched from the sidelines and said that Brother Qiang's backhand was now the steadiest among them. They played a few doubles games, with Lu Mingqiang covering the backhand position, winning more than losing. He also arranged to go running with Lin Feng early Sunday morning.

events.name: Conduct the final app-specific evaluation of the week
events.description: After returning home and taking a shower, it was nearly nine o'clock, but Lu Mingqiang still opened the mobile app as planned to take the last special assessment of the week. He concentrated on questions about substation operation and maintenance, answering all 40 questions in one go, with a final accuracy rate of 91%. When he checked the statistics, the confusing questions had decreased significantly. He let out a long breath, crossed off today on the calendar, and kept a good pace in his exam preparation.

start_state.mood: Peaceful

end_state.mood: Confident and fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, table tennis for 1 hour.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning overcast, with thundershowers in the evening, temperature 25-32°C.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Friday afternoon, an urgent cable fault repair task suddenly came up. Lu Mingqiang led his apprentice Zhao Qiang to rush to an old residential building. Relying on experience, he quickly located the aging short-circuit point, decisively replaced the main cable, and successfully restored power after more than two hours. This real-world operation tested his on-site command ability and gave Zhao Qiang a rare learning opportunity. Afterwards, the team leader praised them. When he got home in the evening, he called his family to share the experience. Though physically and mentally tired, he felt a sense of accomplishment and peace.

events.name: Morning core training was temporarily cancelled.
events.description: In the morning Lu Mingqiang overslept (he had studied late the night before) and did not wake up until 05:55. After a hurried wash, he only did a few stretches and did not have time for the full core workout, planning to make it up in the evening.

events.name: Team Leader Zhang notified everyone of an emergency repair task
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang was organizing tools at the company when Team Leader Zhang walked up quickly and said that an old residential building on Jinmao Middle Road had suddenly lost power entirely. The preliminary judgment was a fault in the main incoming line in the basement, and emergency repair was needed. He immediately designated Lu Mingqiang to lead the team and had apprentice Zhao Qiang accompany him. Without a word, Lu Mingqiang picked up the emergency kit and called for Zhao Qiang to start the company's repair pickup truck.

events.name: Take the toolbox and enter the basement with Zhao Qiang to investigate
events.description: After arriving at the scene, Lu Mingqiang explained to the anxious residents that emergency repairs had already begun. He then put on his safety helmet, took a flashlight, and went down with Zhao Qiang into the sultry basement. As soon as the cover of the electrical box was opened, a burnt smell hit his nose. He carefully used a test pen to confirm the power was off, then used a multimeter to measure section by section, and found that the insulation resistance of a section of main cable from the distribution cabinet to the sub-distribution box was almost zero.

events.name: Discovered and handled a short circuit caused by aging cables.
events.description: He noticed that the cable sheath was cracked in many places; it was clearly an aluminum-core line that had been in service for more than twenty years, and the joints had burned black and formed beads. Lu Mingqiang judged that the high-temperature load combined with aging had caused a phase-to-phase short circuit. While explaining to Zhao Qiang that "oxidation and heating at copper-aluminum joints on old lines is a common hidden hazard," he made a plan: immediately take a spare copper-core cable from the pickup truck, cut off about 15 meters, and replace the entire section.

events.name: Directed the replacement of the main cable and tested the power supply
events.description: Under Lu Mingqiang's command, Zhao Qiang was responsible for passing tools and stripping wire ends, while Lu Mingqiang personally did the wiring and crimping, using high-voltage tape and plastic insulation for waterproofing. After the wiring was completed and repeatedly verified, Lu Mingqiang closed the circuit breaker — the basement lights came on at once, and cheers came from the residents in the building. He then checked the three-phase voltage one by one and only after confirming it was normal announced that the emergency repair was over.

events.name: Clean up the worksite and report to Team Leader Zhang.
events.description: After the emergency repair, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang cleaned up leftover wire ends and swept up insulation debris, and filled in the maintenance log with the fault description, handling process, and replaced materials. He then called Squad Leader Zhang to report that power had been successfully restored at 18:30, and the residents were very satisfied. Zhang praised him repeatedly over the phone, saying "hard work," and told him the repair would be recorded as a bonus point in his monthly assessment.

events.name: After getting home in the evening, called my family and briefly shared the emergency repair experience
events.description: It was nearly nine o'clock when he got home. Lu Mingqiang took a quick shower, sent a voice message to his wife and children, briefly telling them about today's successful emergency repair and reminding them to go to bed early. Then he called his mother to tell her that he had been too busy today to visit. His mother repeatedly said it was fine and told him to be safe. After the call, Lu Mingqiang was tired but at peace.

start_state.mood: Focus

end_state.mood: Tired but at peace and with a sense of accomplishment.

state.daily_exercise: Physical labor at the emergency repair site (equivalent to high-intensity interval training)

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy, occasionally sunny, clearing in the afternoon, 26-33°C

2025-08.daily_overview: Saturday was the 60th birthday of Lu Mingqiang's mother, Chen Xiuying. Early in the morning, he picked up the pre-ordered gold bracelet and took his wife and children to his parents' home in Meilan District. The midday birthday banquet was warm and grand. His father opened a vintage liquor stored for 32 years. Lu Mingqiang not only received the empty bottle as a gift, but also launched a family project to document the history of the liquor bottles. His mother privately praised him for becoming "more thoughtful," which warmed his heart. In the afternoon, he did a 3-kilometer recovery run in Baishamen Park to prepare for tomorrow's 10-kilometer challenge.

events.name: Make up core training in the morning.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang deliberately got up early at 05:45, seriously made up for the core exercises he had missed yesterday, and felt his strength was back.

events.name: Take the family to his parents' home to celebrate his mother's 60th birthday
events.description: Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang urged the children to get dressed neatly, took out the carefully wrapped gold bracelet gift box from the wardrobe, and the family of four drove to his parents' home in Meilan District. His mother, Chen Xiuying, dressed in a festive red Tang suit, waited at the door. Lu Mingqiang put the bracelet on his mother's wrist with his own hands, knelt down, and said, "Mom, on your sixtieth birthday, may you be healthy and long-lived." His mother beamed with joy.

events.name: At the birthday banquet, my father took out a bottle of treasured old liquor and told stories of the past.
events.description: The birthday banquet was cooked by his mother and wife together; all the dishes were light, modified home-style dishes. During the meal, his father Lu Jianguo brought out an old bottle of liquor with a slightly yellowed label from deep inside the cabinet and read out the handwritten words: 'Congratulations on the marriage of Jianguo and Xiuying.' He then recounted how, when he worked at the power supply bureau, a friend had brought the liquor from an old distillery in Ding'an. Lu Mingqiang had never seen the bottle before. His eyes lit up, and he took it with both hands to examine it.

events.name: Received an empty bottle and decided to systematically organize the family's liquor bottle history
events.description: After the wine was finished, Lu Mingqiang tentatively asked his father whether he could collect the empty bottles. His father readily agreed and said, "If you can sort out all these bottles from the past few decades, that will also be a treasure of our family." Lu Mingqiang stated on the spot that he planned to go door to door to learn about them and build records, and later compile a family wine bottle atlas. His mother privately took his father's hand and sighed, "Mingqiang is becoming more and more thoughtful." These words filled Lu Mingqiang with warmth.

events.name: Easy 3 km run at Baishamen Park
events.description: At a little past three in the afternoon, after returning to Longhua District from his parents' home, Lu Mingqiang changed into his workout clothes and went alone to Baishamen Park for an easy 3-kilometer run. He jogged along the artificial lake track, keeping his pace at around 7 minutes per kilometer, relaxing his lower back as he ran and feeling his muscles stretch. After finishing, he stretched by the lake for ten minutes, making his final physical preparations for tomorrow's 10-kilometer push.

events.name: Evening phone call with father to record the information he dictated from the wine bottle.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang opened his computer in the study and drafted a simple family wine bottle archive form. Then he called his father and asked him to describe in detail the origin of that old bottle, the name of the distillery, the vintage, and the old brewing stories he knew. His father was in high spirits and talked for about half an hour. Lu Mingqiang recorded it all one by one as the original material for building the archive.

start_state.mood: Solemn and joyful.

end_state.mood: Warm, touched, and filled with a sense of mission.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, 3 km easy run

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, turning overcast with showers in the afternoon, temperature 26-34°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang mainly devoted himself to socializing around liquor bottle collecting and collecting family oral history. In the morning he took the whole family swimming. Later, fellow collector Chen Jianguo came to visit with Hainan vintage liquor bottles he had recently acquired. The two drank tea, admired the bottles, and had a lively discussion about anecdotes from old distilleries, and agreed to attend a local collectibles exhibition together in autumn. In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang went to his father's home and asked his father to dictate what he knew about local distilleries from his youth, further enriching the source material for the family liquor bottle archive. These activities integrated his collecting hobby into family memory and enriched his inner world.

events.name: Family parent-child swimming.
events.description: At 06:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang's family of four arrived at the community swimming pool on time. Today the coach had other matters, so it was changed to free practice. Lu Mingqiang could already swim 15 meters independently using breaststroke. He tried swimming without a kickboard, and although his breathing rhythm was still a bit off, he felt a strong sense of accomplishment. His wife Wang Lijuan played in the shallow water with their younger son, and their elder son Lu Zixuan was swimming quite decently too.

events.name: Chen Jianguo came to our home as a guest, bringing along a bottle of liquor
events.description: Shortly after returning home from swimming at nine in the morning, Chen Jianguo arrived on his electric bike from Qiongshan District, carrying two old wine bottles from the Wuzhishan Tea Plantation that he had recently picked up. Lu Mingqiang had already prepared the tea set and a pot of Tieguanyin in the living room, with the cleaned 1988 commemorative wine bottle placed right in the center. The two started teasing each other as soon as they met, and Chen Jianguo said, 'Brother Qiang, your bottle is the real deal.'

events.name: Showing each other liquor bottles and exchanging collecting experience.
events.description: The two sat down in the living room and first showed each other the treasures they had brought. On the bottom of Chen Jianguo's ceramic bottle were the characters 'Local State-owned Wuzhishan Tea Estate Winery,' and he recounted how he had found it. Lu Mingqiang then described in detail the origin of his father's wedding commemorative liquor and his idea for compiling a family liquor bottle catalog. Chen Jianguo gave a thumbs-up, shared the names of several veteran collectors he knew in the collecting circle, and suggested that Lu Mingqiang interview them.

events.name: Agreed to go together to the Haikou bottle collection exhibition in autumn
events.description: The conversation was lively. Chen Jianguo mentioned that this November, the Haikou Folk Collection Association would hold an exhibition of old objects, with a special section for wine bottles. He strongly invited Lu Mingqiang to send exhibits together. After thinking it over, Lu Mingqiang nodded and agreed: "Perfect — I'll take my dad's bottle to the exhibition, so more people can see the culture of Hainan's old wine bottles." The two high-fived to seal the deal.

events.name: After Chen Jianguo took his leave, Lu Mingqiang sorted out his collection.
events.description: At eleven o'clock, Chen Jianguo packed up and left. Lu Mingqiang did not put away the tea set right away. He took photos of the commemorative liquor bottle from multiple angles with his phone and jotted down in his notebook the clues Chen Jianguo had shared. Then he carefully put the bottle back in the bookcase with glass doors, feeling that the road of collecting had become more interesting because of a like-minded friend and family heritage.

events.name: Go to father's home to record oral memories of the distillery
events.description: After the afternoon shower stopped, Lu Mingqiang went to his parents' house again. He deliberately pulled his father into the study and took out a voice recorder (using it after obtaining his consent). His father, Lu Jianguo, started with how he had traveled all over the island stringing power lines for the power supply bureau in the 1960s, then gradually moved on to the small distilleries in Ding'an, Qionghai, and other places, and to the old days of rationed supplies. Lu Mingqiang took careful notes, asked questions from time to time, and wrote several pages by hand.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and curious.

end_state.mood: Feeling mentally fulfilled and with a lot on his mind.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, 40 minutes of parent-child swimming.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, strong UV, temperature 28-35°C.

2025-08.daily_overview: During breaks at work on Monday, Lu Mingqiang received positive feedback in both career and health: he learned from Team Leader Zhang that he had been placed on the company's recommendation list for outstanding employees in the second half of the year, affirming his professional value. In the evening, he played his first formal squash match since recovering from his back injury with his playing partner Lin Feng, and his core stability won praise. That night, he and his wife reviewed a week's worth of data from their dietary adjustments and discussed a plan for continued optimization. Before bed, he also used the app to freely assemble questions and practiced 20 comprehensive questions on electrical fundamentals and frequency converters, with a 90% accuracy rate; he took screenshots of the wrong questions for later review. The three-meal reform was getting better and better.

events.name: Morning core training and daily work.
events.description: Woke up at 05:50, finished 15 minutes of core training. Today Lu Mingqiang felt his core was stronger and looked forward to the evening squash match.

events.name: Learned that he had been selected for the company's Advanced Individual recommendation list.
events.description: At the morning pre-shift meeting, Team Leader Zhang read out the department's recommendation list. Because of his outstanding performance in major projects such as typhoon rescue and supermarket upgrades, and his contributions to answering questions in online technical communities, Lu Mingqiang was recommended as a candidate for the Outstanding Individual Award for the second half of the year. His colleagues applauded one after another. Lu Mingqiang stood up to thank everyone and said shyly, “It’s all thanks to everyone’s cooperation.” In fact, he was very encouraged, feeling that he was one step closer to his long-term dream of owning his own studio.

events.name: First squash match with fellow player Lin Feng after recovering from a back injury
events.description: On the alternate Monday, it was squash night again. Lu Mingqiang arrived at the community activity room on time. Today Lin Feng suggested playing a formal match. Lu Mingqiang moved actively, frequently using his core strength to hit shots tight along the wall. At one point, after a big lunge to save a ball, he regained his balance steadily. Lin Feng couldn't help praising, "Brother Qiang, your back is really nimble now, and your core is very solid!" In the end, Lu Mingqiang won by a narrow score, and the two high-fived and laughed.

events.name: Reviewed the app's diet data with his wife and discussed the effect of the adjustments.
events.description: In the evening, the couple sat on the sofa and scrolled through the photos of their three meals and weight records over the past seven days on their phones. The data showed that Lu Mingqiang's weight had dropped slightly and Wang Lijuan was looking a bit better. Both felt that a light diet did not affect the taste, but the children did not like the boiled eggs at breakfast. They agreed to switch to egg and vegetable pancakes next week. Lu Mingqiang also suggested that his wife get a hemoglobin test to see whether her anemia had improved.

events.name: Calling mother to collect stories about the wine bottles.
events.description: Using a little time after the meal, Lu Mingqiang called his mother and asked her to recall the blue-and-white porcelain wine bottle that had come with her dowry. His mother said it was a gift from a liquor-brewing relative in her home village, Zhutian Village, and symbolized "a long, long lasting bond." He quickly added this key piece of information to his notebook, adding another entry to the family genealogy.

events.name: Before bed, used the app to do 20 self-selected practice questions.
events.description: After taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang used the app's free question-assembly feature in the study to randomly practice 20 comprehensive questions on electrical fundamentals and frequency converters, answering 18 correctly. The wrong questions involved details of harmonic suppression. He screenshotted the wrong questions and saved them to his album, planning to review them intensively on the weekend. The study session lasted 20 minutes.

start_state.mood: Full of anticipation

end_state.mood: Proud and grateful

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, 1 hour of squash match.

2025-08.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lu Mingqiang became a collector of family memories. Taking advantage of the daylight after work, he went to his parents' home, dug out old photo albums, found a few yellowed photos related to the liquor factory and liquor bottles, and carefully photographed them with his phone. After returning to his own home in the evening, he corresponded the story of the dowry liquor bottle his mother had told with the photos and preliminarily conceived an archive framework. The ordinary night became profound because of these fragments of history.

events.name: Morning core training and a short running break.
events.description: Got up at 05:50 in the morning and completed 15 minutes of core training. No extra exercise was planned today, but Lu Mingqiang felt his weight was steadily dropping and his mental state was very good.

events.name: Rephotographed old photos related to the wine bottles at his parents’ home
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike directly to his parents' home. His mother had already found two old photo albums. He sat in the living room and flipped through them, and found a photo of his father dining with several workmates in the power supply bureau courtyard when he was young; on the corner of the table stood exactly that bottle of 1988 commemorative liquor. There was also a photo of the old house in Mother's natal village. After getting permission, he photographed them one by one with his phone, adjusted the lighting to ensure clarity.

events.name: Organize photos and make an initial plan for the archive structure
events.description: Back home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang imported the rephotographed photos into his laptop and stored them in categories: "Father's wine bottles" and "Mother's dowry wine bottles". He added a photo attachment field to the spreadsheet and drafted a cover description for the wine bottle archive. He envisioned each bottle accompanied by an oral story and images, which could later be printed into a book for relatives.

start_state.mood: Stable

end_state.mood: Reflective and serene

2025-08.daily_overview: On Wednesday evening, Lu Mingqiang entered the oral accounts, photos, and physical items collected over the previous days into the computer, creating separate files for four family liquor bottles. After the rain stopped in the evening, he suggested the whole family go downstairs for a walk, and he bought joint pain relief patches for his mother.

events.name: Morning core training was interrupted by a rainstorm.
events.description: In the morning, just as Lu Mingqiang started core training, a rainstorm suddenly broke out and thunder cracked loudly. He had to stop early, only doing planks and stretching, which took 10 minutes.

events.name: After dinner, the whole family went for a walk together
events.description: After the rain stopped in the evening, Lu Mingqiang suggested the whole family go downstairs for a walk. The four of them walked along Jinmao Middle Road to a nearby pharmacy, where he bought this month's joint pain relief patches for his mother, Chen Xiuying, and also purchased extra patches in advance for rainy days. The children watched goldfish at the pharmacy entrance, and the family enjoyed the coolness after the rain and a rare moment of ease.

events.name: Create an independent electronic archive for the family's liquor bottles.
events.description: After returning from the walk, Lu Mingqiang sat back down in the study, opened the spreadsheet on his computer, and entered the four liquor bottles one by one: his father's 1988 wedding commemorative bottle, his mother's blue-and-white porcelain dowry bottle, an old Yedao Lujiu wine bottle he had collected in his early years, and an old Haikou Daqu bottle obtained from his aunt's home. For each bottle, he recorded the name, source, era, story summary, and attached a photo link. He also added the interviewee and date at the end of the spreadsheet, making it look especially formal.

start_state.mood: Clear and organized

end_state.mood: Satisfied and focused.

state.daily_exercise: 10 minutes of core training, daily commute

2025-08.daily_overview: On Thursday, Lu Mingqiang extended his healthy eating philosophy to traditional snack making. He invited his mother over to teach his wife how to make a lower-oil version of Hainan-style rice cakes and steamed turnip cake. The three generations interacted warmly, skillfully blending traditional flavors with healthy eating. In the evening, based on his archives, he began drawing the first draft of a family wine bottle history chart, arranging the four bottles chronologically and adding brief notes on family memories; he felt an increasingly strong sense of spiritual continuity.

events.name: The treadmill simulation run was changed to indoor core strengthening due to rainy weather.
events.description: He had originally planned to go for a morning run, but it kept raining, so Lu Mingqiang did core training in the living room instead, adding two extra sets of glute bridges and side planks. He also unrolled a yoga mat and taught his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, to do simple planks. The father and son laughed and joked around, which counted as exercise too.

events.name: Invited his mother to their home to teach how to make traditional low-oil snacks
events.description: In the evening, his mother, Chen Xiuying, took the bus to Longhua District. Lu Mingqiang had prepared glutinous rice flour, shredded coconut, and radish in advance, and replaced the lard in the recipe with olive oil. His mother washed her hands, and while demonstrating the low-oil coconut glutinous rice balls, she kept muttering, "In the old days, there was no such thing as controlling oil," but she cooperatively cut the oil amount in half. Lu Mingqiang and his wife studied carefully and even shot a short video, planning to make it independently next time. When steaming the radish cake, his mother used diced cured meat to enhance the flavor instead, and it was still fragrant. After tasting it, both children said it was delicious.

events.name: Begin drafting the family wine bottle history chart.
events.description: After seeing his mother off, Lu Mingqiang cleared off the desk in the study and spread out a large sheet of white paper. Referring to the electronic archive, he hand-drew a timeline from the 1980s to 2025, marked the four archived liquor bottles with simple sketches on the timeline, and copied down a summary of each one's background story. The lines were not professional, but they were full of a family touch. He planned to use this first draft as a rough version and later digitize and beautify it.

start_state.mood: Full of drive

end_state.mood: Warm and fulfilling

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 20 minutes, parent-child interaction (light)
