2025-08.daily_overview: During Friday dinner, the dietary reform hit a small snag—the two children complained that the dishes were too bland. Lu Mingqiang was prepared. He opened his phone to show the family's blood pressure and weight trends over the past two weeks, patiently explained the long-term health benefits of less oil and salt, and promised to take them to the park to fly kites on the weekend as encouragement. In the end, he gained their understanding. In the evening, he finalized the electronic version of the family wine-bottle historical chart. Looking at the illustrated timeline, he felt a sense of fulfillment from passing down the family legacy.

events.name: Morning core training went well.
events.description: Got up at 05:50 and finished 15 minutes of core training in one go. Lu Mingqiang looked in the mirror and could faintly see the outline of his abs, feeling pleased with himself.

events.name: At dinner, persuaded the children to accept a light diet
events.description: At seven in the evening, the whole family sat around the table eating steamed fish and cold dishes. After a few bites, Lu Zixuan muttered, “This is tasteless, I want fried chicken,” and Lu Zihan followed, saying, “The food isn't good.” Lu Mingqiang didn't get angry. He picked up his phone, opened the health management app, and brought up the family members' weight and blood pressure change curves. Comparing them with the test values from the physical exam more than ten days ago, he said to the children: “You see, Mom's anemia is improving, and Dad's blood lipids are dropping too. The meals helped make all this happen. If you can stick with it for a month, Dad will take you to Wenchang to see a rocket!” The children's eyes lit up and they nodded in agreement.

events.name: Finalized the electronic version of the family liquor bottle historical chart
events.description: After the children were asleep, Lu Mingqiang sat down at the computer, opened drawing software, and digitized his hand-drawn sketch. He added scanned old photos, labeled each bottle's name and origin story in a consistent font, and added the title 'Lu Family Wine Collection Chart - Not for Sale'. When finished, he printed out an A4 color draft and tucked it into the bookcase. Looking at the chart showing his father's wedding wine and his mother's dowry wine, he felt an indescribable sense of peace.

start_state.mood: Patient and calm.

end_state.mood: Gratified and satisfied

state.daily_exercise: Core training for 15 minutes, daily commute

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, isolated afternoon showers, temperature 27-33°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lu Mingqiang kept yesterday's promise and took his two sons to Wanlu Garden in the morning to fly kites and enjoy outdoor family time. Before that, the whole family went to the swimming pool for free practice. In the afternoon, he focused on tutoring his eldest son Lu Zixuan in circuit mathematics, using a comprehensive test paper to check the learning results of the past half month. Lu Zixuan completed it independently and scored 86, and Lu Mingqiang was pleased to acknowledge his progress. In the evening, he reviewed dietary data with his wife and marked on the calendar the countdown to the approaching senior technician exam.

events.name: Easy 3 km morning jog, followed by family free swimming practice
events.description: Lu Mingqiang got up at 06:00. After finishing his core training, he thought about the 10 km challenge tomorrow, so today he only did an easy 3 km jog at a pace of 7:30 per kilometer, and his legs felt relaxed. Then he took the whole family to the swimming pool for free practice. He swam 400 meters, his two sons each played in the water, and Wang Lijuan also swam for a while. Everyone had a great time.

events.name: Took the boys to Evergreen Park to fly kites
events.description: After swimming in the morning, Lu Mingqiang brought the improved kite, and the family of four took a bus to Evergreen Park. This time, a long streamer had been added to the tail of the kite, improving its balance. In the gentle breeze, it wobbled its way up to the height of a three-story building. Lu Zixuan took the line spool and ran around laughing, while Lu Zihan chased the shadow. Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan sat on the grass watching, feeling that no amount of effort was too much. After flying for more than ten minutes, the kite landed in the treetops, but no one cared, and they agreed to make a bigger one next month.

events.name: Tutoring the eldest son through a comprehensive circuits math test
events.description: At three in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang set up a small blackboard in the small living room and placed the comprehensive test paper he had prepared last night in front of his eldest son. All the math problems were embedded in circuit scenarios, such as 'A 12V battery and three resistors in series—find the voltage across each.' Lu Zixuan worked carefully on the calculations. Whenever he was uncertain, Lu Mingqiang did not give the answer directly, but drew an equivalent circuit to guide him. After grading, the score was 86. Lu Mingqiang gave a thumbs up and said, 'You have improved so much compared to when the vacation just started.' His son puffed out his chest and said, 'No matter how hard math gets in the future, I won't be afraid.'

events.name: In the evening, recorded the data from two weeks of dietary adjustments.
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang and his wife used an app to export the dietary records of the past two weeks and calculated that the average daily salt intake per person had dropped from 9 grams to below 6 grams, and oil from 40 ml to about 25 ml. He felt more energetic, and his wife also said she had fewer dizzy spells. The two decided to make the 8th and 23rd of each month their family health review days.

start_state.mood: Relaxed and pleasant

end_state.mood: Gratified and full of motivation

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, 3 km easy run, 400 m swim, running while flying kites

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, light breeze in the evening, temperature 26-32°C

2025-08.daily_overview: On the last day of August, Lu Mingqiang punctuated his month of exercise with a successful continuous 10 km run, adding an exclamation point to his training. His monthly mileage surpassed 50 kilometers for the first time, confirming his cardiorespiratory fitness and perseverance. In the morning, he did housework with his family, then rested and recovered. At 4 p.m., he tutored his eldest son for a math quiz, and the child was highly engaged. Afterwards, he reviewed two weeks of dietary data and formally made low-oil, low-salt cooking a family routine. In the dead of night, he organized all his exam preparation notes and marked the frequently missed questions, making thorough preparations for the September sprint. Before bed, he discussed the September family budget with his wife. Over the past two weeks, health, family, career, and hobbies had all advanced together, and he welcomed September with a rich harvest.

events.name: Successfully completed the 10 km continuous run challenge
events.description: He got up at 05:50 in the morning. After 15 minutes of core training, Lu Mingqiang set off from the residential community in his old running shoes, ran along Jinmao Middle Road all the way to Haikou Bay Park, circled the park twice, and returned the same way. He maintained a steady pace of 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, stopping only once to drink water, with deep and even breathing throughout. When the phone app announced, 'You have completed 10 kilometers,' he clenched his fist and gave a low shout, feeling he had done something he'd never dared to imagine before. After getting home, he sent a screenshot of the record to the running group, and his badminton buddy Lin Feng instantly replied: 'Brother Qiang, awesome!'

events.name: At the end of the month, his eldest son scored 85 on the math tutoring quiz.
events.description: At 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang slightly modified the wrong questions from the last test paper and made a new circuit math worksheet for Lu Zixuan to do again. This time Lu Zixuan was clearly more skilled, read the questions more carefully, and scored 85 points. Lu Mingqiang took out an aerospace science postcard as a reward and said, "When winter vacation comes, Dad will take you to Wenchang to see a real rocket." The little guy hugged the postcard and ran off to show his mother. Seeing the thirst for knowledge in his son's eyes made Lu Mingqiang happier than winning an award himself.

events.name: Review the effects of the dietary adjustments with family and establish them as long-term habits.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang summarized in simple terms: over the past half month, the cooking oil used at home had decreased by nearly half, and salt had also gone from heavy to light, while both weight and blood pressure were improving. Although the two children still wanted fried chicken a little, they no longer protested strongly. Wang Lijuan said she supported keeping things as they were. Lu Mingqiang immediately wrote the slogan Low oil, low salt · long-term persistence on the family whiteboard, and announced that from now on the menu for the following week would be set every Sunday.

events.name: Organize the August exam preparation notes and mark frequently missed questions
events.description: After instructing the children, Lu Mingqiang sat upright in his study and went through all the mistake notebooks, practice test papers, and app records from the past month one by one. With a red pen, he circled more than ten high-frequency mistake points, such as inverter harmonic mitigation and transformer differential protection, and prepared to make them the main focus of his September sprint. When he closed the notebook, he wrote "84 days, keep going" on the title page, with the countdown clearly in sight.

events.name: Discussed the September family budget with his wife
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang took out the ledger and checked August expenses with his wife. They found that because they had reduced how often they ate grilled fish out and shifted to home cooking, food expenses were nearly 400 yuan lower, and the surplus was put into the emergency fund. They agreed to stick to the budget in September and try to buy a new air conditioner for his parents by the end of the year.

start_state.mood: Firm and confident.

end_state.mood: Proud, satisfied, and full of anticipation.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of core training, a continuous 10 km run

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day of the May Day holiday, Lu Mingqiang's family enjoyed a rare family outing. In the early morning, he still kept up his morning run, then bought medicine for his mother and prepared a picnic. The whole family drove to Baishamen Park to fly kites and have a picnic, enjoying the holiday to the fullest.

events.name: Morning run at Baishamen
events.description: At 6:10 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his running shoes and went to Baishamen Park, jogging along the coastline for 35 minutes at a pace of about 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. The sea breeze was cool, and he felt light on his feet, giving his holiday an energetic start.

events.name: Bought pain relief patches at the pharmacy.
events.description: After his morning run, Lu Mingqiang went home and took a shower. Remembering that his mother's rheumatism plasters were almost used up, he biked to the pharmacy on Jinmao Middle Road downstairs and bought several pain-relieving plasters she needed for this month, and asked the clerk to keep an extra box in reserve.

events.name: Prepare picnic supplies
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan were busy in the kitchen. Wang Lijuan packed the Hainanese chicken rice, cooling dessert soup, and grilled fish prepared last night into insulated lunch boxes. Lu Mingqiang checked the picnic mat and two kites—a large traditional kite for himself and a small kite for his second son—and stuffed them all into the backpack.

events.name: Drive to the park
events.description: At exactly 10 o'clock, Lu Mingqiang drove the family car from Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District, carrying his wife and children to Baishamen Park in Meilan District. The drive took about 20 minutes. The two children chattered in the back seat, and his younger son Lu Zihan kept hugging a small kite and wouldn't let go.

events.name: Flying kites on the lawn
events.description: The family spread the picnic mat on the big lawn in the south of the park. Lu Mingqiang was the first to fly a traditional large kite. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, learned to control the lifting string, while his second son, Lu Zihan, excitedly held his own small children's kite and ran stumbling with his father's help until the kite finally rose, swaying in the air. Wang Lijuan used her phone to capture this rare scene.

events.name: Family picnic
events.description: Tired from kite flying, the whole family sat around the picnic mat and enjoyed the food they had brought. The ginger-and-scallion aroma of the Hainanese chicken rice, the refreshing sweetness of the qingbuliang, and the charred fragrance of the grilled fish mingled together. Wang Lijuan sighed that it was rare for the whole family to set aside work and simply sunbathe and eat like this; it was really nice.

events.name: Playing and walking on the lawn.
events.description: After the picnic, Lu Mingqiang chased back and forth across the lawn with his two sons. The younger son giggled, and the older son deliberately pretended to be a monster. His wife rested nearby, taking a burst of photos with her phone. Later, the family took a stroll along the park path, looking at the coconut groves and feeling the sea breeze, spending a leisurely afternoon.

events.name: Pack up for the return trip
events.description: At 4:30 p.m., the family packed up the picnic blanket, lunch boxes, and kite. Lu Mingqiang drove back along the same route; his wife and children were quiet in the car because they were tired, but all had contented looks on their faces. After arriving home, he helped his wife wash the dishes and ended the pleasant day out.

start_state.mood: Full of energy, looking forward to the holiday

end_state.mood: Content and slightly tired, with a strong sense of family warmth.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 35 minutes, flying kites and chasing each other around.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day of the holiday, Lu Mingqiang used his time at home to discuss weekend overtime plans with his workmates, while also keeping up his morning run and spending time with family, making early preparations for the upcoming work.

events.name: Morning run at Baishamen
events.description: At 6:15 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang continued his run at Baishamen Park for 35 minutes. The cloud layer was thick and it felt a bit stuffy, so he slowed his pace slightly to keep sweating. After the run, he stretched his legs on a park bench.

events.name: Contact Team Leader Zhang
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang proactively called Squad Leader Zhang, proposing to work overtime during tomorrow's weekend to inspect the old power distribution lines in Xiuying District and Longhua District, eliminating hidden dangers of summer peak load in advance. The two confirmed the key areas and required safety tools.

events.name: Organize tools and equipment.
events.description: After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang took out an infrared thermometer, a voltage tester, insulating gloves, and other tools from the storage room, checked the battery and condition of each one, neatly packed the testing equipment into his tool bag, and got ready for going out tomorrow.

events.name: Accompanying family at home.
events.description: In the afternoon, he played with building blocks and watched cartoons with his two sons in the living room. His wife went out to buy daily necessities, and Lu Mingqiang cooked simple noodles for the three of them as lunch. Toward evening, he called his mother, reminded her to apply the medicated patch, and wished her a happy Labor Day.

start_state.mood: Relaxation, rhythmic leisure

end_state.mood: Prepared for working overtime tomorrow and feeling calm about it.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 35 minutes.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first day of weekend overtime, Lu Mingqiang was pleasantly surprised to find his weight had dropped after his morning run. He energetically completed the inspection of old lines in Xiuying District and eliminated one hidden hazard.

events.name: Morning Run and Weigh-in
events.description: Although he worked overtime over the weekend, Lu Mingqiang still left at 5:50 AM and ran at Baishamen Park for 40 minutes, with a pace of about 6:10 per kilometer. After coming home and taking a shower, he instinctively stepped on the electronic scale — 71.0 kg! He had dropped 0.8 kg from a few days earlier. Excited, he took a photo of the scale display, captioned it “Running really can help you lose weight!” and posted it to his Moments. He soon got likes and encouragement from his badminton buddy Lin Feng and running buddy Chen Bin.

events.name: Troubleshoot aging electrical lines in Xiuying District
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang met up with his co-worker Chen Jianguo at the agreed location in Xiuying District. Wearing safety helmets, the two walked through the old residential area, using an infrared thermometer to check branch boxes and cable joints one by one. At an old low-voltage branch box, they found an abnormal temperature at the B-phase joint. They immediately de-energized it and tightened the connection, eliminating a potential short-circuit hazard that could have been caused by overheating.

events.name: Shared the joy with his wife.
events.description: After getting off work and returning home, Lu Mingqiang showed his wife the likes on his WeChat Moments as soon as he walked in. Wang Lijuan teased with a smile, 'Then why don't you quit fried chicken right away?' During dinner, he took the initiative to eat more vegetables and discussed with his wife making dinners lighter on oil and salt from now on.

start_state.mood: Slightly tired but kept up the morning run.

end_state.mood: Excited, a sense of accomplishment, and overflowing confidence in losing weight

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 40 minutes, plus over 10,000 steps of outdoor inspection walking.

2025-05.daily_overview: On the second day of weekend overtime, Lu Mingqiang continued to inspect the old circuits in Longhua District and recorded one hidden hazard. The confidence gained from losing weight prompted him to decide to systematically improve his squash training.

events.name: Light morning run
events.description: Yesterday's inspection was physically demanding, so this morning Lu Mingqiang slowed down his pace and only jogged for 25 minutes near the neighborhood, stopping at the first sign of light sweat to give his body an active recovery period. The scale showed 71.1 kg, a slight rebound but still at a low level.

events.name: Troubleshooting circuits in Longhua District
events.description: At 8:30 AM, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo moved to an old neighborhood near Jinmao Middle Road in Longhua District. Despite the muggy heat, the two focused on checking the internal temperatures of branch boxes. They found a copper-aluminum transition connector showing slight signs of oxidation and heating. It was still within the safe range but needed follow-up. Lu Mingqiang recorded the location and measured values in detail in his phone memo.

events.name: Decided to increase squash training.
events.description: With a breakthrough in weight management, Lu Mingqiang decided to make his squash training more systematic. During his lunch break, he browsed slow-motion videos online to study backhand power and sent a WeChat message to his squash partner Lin Feng, expressing his desire to play more matches and receive coaching. Lin Feng encouraged him to strike while the iron was hot and get a membership card to book a regular Wednesday court.

start_state.mood: Body slightly tired but spirits high.

end_state.mood: Clear goals, more structured about health and exercise

state.daily_exercise: 25 minutes of jogging and about 8,000 steps of patrol walking.

2025-05.daily_overview: On his compensatory rest day, Lu Mingqiang began systematically managing his diet, spending quality time with his family, and preparing nutritionally for the upcoming squash training.

events.name: Start meal logging.
events.description: After getting up in the morning, Lu Mingqiang created a new food diary in the memo app on his phone, took a photo of today's breakfast—a bowl of Hainan rice noodles plus a boiled egg—and recorded the estimated calorie intake. He was determined to turn weight control into a long-term habit through this approach. The scale showed 71.4kg, up 0.3kg from yesterday; he recorded that it might be because he had drunk less water yesterday and had now rehydrated.

events.name: Adjusted the family meal plan.
events.description: In the morning, he accompanied his wife to the Longhua District vegetable market to buy groceries. He took the initiative to suggest buying more fresh sea fish, green vegetables, and fruit, and less pork belly and fried food. Wang Lijuan teased him, saying he had "suddenly become a health expert," but cooperatively bought sea bass and sweet potato leaves.

events.name: Parent-child community activity.
events.description: In the afternoon, took the two children to play downstairs in the residential complex. The younger son played on the slide, while Lu Mingqiang played badminton for a while with the elder son. During the break, he also checked the screws on the community public fitness equipment and used the wrench he had with him to tighten a loose handle on a rowing machine.

events.name: Attempted a light dinner.
events.description: Dinner was cooked by Wang Lijuan: steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried sweet potato leaves, tomato and egg soup, and multigrain rice as the staple. Lu Mingqiang recorded every bite in his memo and found that the calories were nearly 200 kcal lower than usual, which strengthened his determination to control his diet.

start_state.mood: Feeling refreshed after a good night's sleep

end_state.mood: Gained confidence in diet management, satisfied and assured

state.daily_exercise: Badminton for 30 minutes, outdoor walk

2025-05.daily_overview: On the first workday after the holiday, Lu Mingqiang kept his morning run and received a pleasant surprise -- he was named Employee of the Month and received a 300 yuan bonus, all of which he handed to his wife after work.

events.name: Morning run, met a fellow runner
events.description: At 5:55 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang went for a 40-minute morning run in Baishamen Park, with a pace of about 6:15 per kilometer. On the way, he met his running buddy Chen Bin, and the two chatted while running about their weight loss progress. Chen Bin praised the weight loss data he posted on WeChat Moments as inspiring. He weighed in at 71.2 kg, down from yesterday.

events.name: Pre-shift preparation
events.description: After his morning run, he arrived at the company 20 minutes early, tidied up his work clothes and safety helmet, laid out the tools he needed, such as wrenches and a voltage tester, then attended the pre-shift safety roll call, full of energy and ready for the morning meeting.

events.name: Named Outstanding Employee of the Month
events.description: At the morning meeting, Team Leader Zhang announced that Lu Mingqiang had been named Employee of the Month for handling his own duties well during the training period and performing outstandingly, and handed him a red envelope containing 300 yuan in cash on the spot. Amid the applause of his colleagues, Lu Mingqiang shyly went up to the stage to accept it and said, "I'll keep working hard."

events.name: Daily installation inspection.
events.description: After the morning meeting, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo teamed up and went to a commercial building in Xiuying District to replace an electric meter box. The two worked in perfect harmony—removing the old one, installing the new one, and checking the wiring all in one smooth process. In the afternoon, they also inspected the secondary branch boxes on that line along the way.

events.name: Turned over the bonus to his wife.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang returned home and handed the red envelope to his wife Wang Lijuan untouched, for daily household expenses. He briefly shared his award experience. Wang Lijuan smiled with her eyes and said they would add an extra dish to celebrate on the weekend.

start_state.mood: Regular and fulfilling

end_state.mood: Feeling gratified and proud that one's professional value has been recognized.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 40 minutes; physical labor at work.

2025-05.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang officially applied for a squash membership card and started a fixed Wednesday training routine. Although his wife lamented the expense, she supported his hobby. After the evening training, he organized his notes and did extra practice on his backhand technique.

events.name: No morning run on the rest day
events.description: Considering the high intensity of the evening squash training, Lu Mingqiang deliberately canceled the morning run and slept half an hour longer. After waking up, he did a stretching routine on the balcony and used a foam roller to relax his shoulders and back. He weighed 71.1 kg.

events.name: Get a six-month squash membership
events.description: During the lunch break, accompanied by his squash buddy Lin Feng, he went to the squash club, paid 1,200 yuan for a six-month membership card, and booked a court for every Wednesday at 8 p.m. As the cashier entered the information into the system, he touched the surface of the card, feeling a sense of ceremony about formally committing to a hobby.

events.name: At noon, Lu Mingqiang, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang walked to Elder Sister Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant for lunch. Lu Mingqiang ordered a serving of spicy soup rice with a fried egg. His colleague Chen Jianguo complained about his son’s exam results, and Xiao Zhao chimed in. After the meal, he went to the Convenient Life Convenience Store next door and bought a bottle of mineral water. As he walked out of the fast food restaurant, he called his mother Chen Xiuying, asked about her cold-leg pains, reminded her to apply medicated patches and use hot water bottles more often, and talked about the plan to go home for dinner on the weekend. Only after hearing that she had already applied the patch did he hang up with relief.
events.description: During an afternoon break, Lu Mingqiang told his wife via WeChat how much the card had cost. Wang Lijuan replied, "Get it if you like," but then discussed with him reducing the number of meals out this month, crossing out barbecue and laobaicha snacks from the weekend plan. Lu Mingqiang agreed.

events.name: First squash intensive training.
events.description: As soon as he got off work in the evening, he went straight to the club. Lin Feng gave hands-on guidance on backhand strokes, breaking down the movements from grip to body rotation and swing. Lu Mingqiang noted key points in his phone memo such as "thumb presses against the handle, contact point at waist level," and then the two practiced together for 50 minutes. He was covered in sweat, but he found a long-missing sense of technical breakthrough.

events.name: Organize training notes.
events.description: After returning home and taking a shower that evening, Lu Mingqiang drew a simple diagram of the backhand movement path in his notebook and made a breakdown training plan for the next week—swinging the racket without a ball 100 times a day to build muscle memory. His wife handed him a glass of plain boiled water and smiled at his focused expression.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the evening training.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling yet slightly sore muscles; increased commitment to squash.

state.daily_exercise: Squash training for 50 minutes, including technique breakdown drills

2025-05.daily_overview: During the working day, he carried out electrical maintenance as scheduled. During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang completed his individual income tax annual reconciliation and received a tax refund, and also kindly helped two co-workers do the same. In the evening, he went home to tutor the children.

events.name: Indoor core workout instead of morning run
events.description: It was showery this morning, so Lu Mingqiang spread a yoga mat in the living room and did 30 minutes of core strength training—sit-ups, planks, and squats—to keep up the exercise momentum. His weight was 71.0 kg, steadily decreasing.

events.name: Individual income tax annual reconciliation
events.description: During the lunch break, he sat at his workstation and logged into the individual income tax app on his phone. He checked the special additional deductions for children's education and elderly care item by item, then submitted the annual settlement. The system popped up "tax refund amount: 120 yuan". He screenshotted the process, immediately forwarded it to the team's WeChat group "Electrician Brotherhood", and added the message: "It's very simple, you can get a refund this year."

events.name: Guide Chen Jianguo through his tax refund.
events.description: In the team, Chen Jianguo called Lu Mingqiang to ask for advice. Lu Mingqiang walked over to his workstation and guided him step by step: first update the special additional deductions, then enter the comprehensive income annual reconciliation filing. After about ten minutes, Chen Jianguo was pleasantly surprised to find that he could also get a refund of 80 yuan, and thanked him repeatedly.

events.name: Patiently teach Zhao Qiang how to file
events.description: Apprentice Zhao Qiang saw the group message and came over with his phone. Lu Mingqiang, seeing that he was unsure about his rental information, called the landlord to verify it for him and taught him how to fill in the housing rent deduction item. In the end, Zhao Qiang successfully completed his tax refund declaration.

events.name: Evening tutoring and review.
events.description: After getting off work and returning home, Lu Mingqiang checked his eldest son's math homework for the day and patiently explained the two wrong problems. After the child went to sleep, he sat at his desk and studied the first 20 pages of Master Li's notes, marking doubtful points in light of his own maintenance logs.

start_state.mood: The rewarding feeling of persisting in exercise even on rainy days

end_state.mood: The satisfaction of helping a workmate; the calm of a fruitful review

state.daily_exercise: Core strength training for 30 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: After learning that his eldest son's math grades had slipped, Lu Mingqiang, amid a busy schedule and exam preparation pressure, only gave a verbal reminder. In the evening he discussed countermeasures with his wife, feeling anxious about both his son and the exam.

events.name: Resumed morning run
events.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang returned to Baishamen Park for a run, using 40 minutes of aerobic exercise to release the pent-up feeling of recent days. He deliberately increased his stride cadence to let his mind go blank for a while. Weight: 70.9 kg.

events.name: Verbally reminded after learning the score
events.description: During breakfast, Lu Zixuan handed him the test paper with 82 points from the fifth unit math quiz. Lu Mingqiang frowned slightly and said, “You shouldn't have made calculation mistakes here, pay attention next time,” but since he had the senior technician mock exam tomorrow and had to work overtime troubleshooting this weekend, he didn't say much and only reminded his son to carefully correct the mistakes.

events.name: Performed routine electrical work throughout the day.
events.description: During the day, work proceeded as usual. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo went to a newly built residential community to install the main power distribution cabinet. He absent-mindedly connected one phase wire in the wrong sequence. Fortunately, Chen Jianguo caught it during a recheck. Lu Mingqiang slapped his head, apologized repeatedly, and refocused. This made him realize that stress was affecting his fine motor skills.

events.name: A couple's late-night conversation about education.
events.description: After the children went to bed at 9 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan sat on the edge of the bed in the bedroom, quietly discussing their eldest son's declining grades. Wang Lijuan said that recently their son had been distracted while doing homework, and Lu Mingqiang blamed himself for not helping much with tutoring over the past week. The two agreed that after tomorrow's mock exam, Lu Mingqiang would have a dedicated talk with their son and then work out a tutoring schedule.

events.name: Final cram before the exam
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang took out the theory textbook and quickly skimmed the relay protection setting calculation section, but he could not calm his mind and was not very productive. He closed the book at midnight with things on his mind.

start_state.mood: Worried about the exam, mildly anxious.

end_state.mood: Tossed and turned, unable to sleep, worried about both his son's studies and his own exam

state.daily_exercise: Morning run for 40 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: A roller-coaster day: Lu Mingqiang scored only 58 on the theory mock exam for senior technician, and his mood plummeted; but Master Li gave him a precious handwritten notebook, reigniting his determination. In the evening he still insisted on talking with his son and worked overtime to inspect the circuits.

events.name: Failed the senior technician mock exam.
events.description: At 8 a.m., Lu Mingqiang rode his electric bike in the rain to the training institution to take the theoretical mock exam for senior technician. The score came out immediately after the exam — 58, two points short of the passing line. Staring at the glaring red number on the screen, his palms began to sweat slightly. He sat alone in a corner for ten minutes, for the first time doubting whether he could get the certificate. It was only later that he learned from Shift Leader Zhang that this assessment was just to test the training results and help everyone identify their weaknesses; the formal technician evaluation registration would not start until August or September. This relaxed his mind a bit, but his sense of urgency remained undiminished.

events.name: Sought help from the master and obtained the handwritten notes
events.description: In the afternoon, when the rain let up, after completing an emergency repair on a power line, Lu Mingqiang knocked on the door of his retired master, Master Li. Seeing how dejected he was, Master Li, without a word, brought out from his study a stack of yellowed notebooks — handwritten notes of "200 Cases of Common Substation Fault Troubleshooting" — and said, "I passed the technician exam with this book back then. Take it home and work through it bit by bit; don't lose heart." Lu Mingqiang took it with both hands, felt its weight, and his eyes welled up.

events.name: Worked overtime to troubleshoot lines in Xiuying District
events.description: After leaving Master Li's home, Lu Mingqiang met up with Chen Jianguo and, as planned, inspected the remaining old lines in Xiuying District. He was especially careful in the rain and found that a cable joint in one distribution box had loosened due to oxidation from humidity. He immediately sanded it with sandpaper and retightened it, eliminating the second potential fault point of the weekend.

events.name: Have an in-depth talk with his eldest son.
events.description: Returning home at 7 p.m., Lu Mingqiang, despite his fatigue, called Lu Zixuan into the study. He softened his tone and said, “Dad also failed a test today, but you can make it up by having a teacher teach you. Let's work together to find the difficult points in math.” Only then did Lu Zixuan admit that he did not have a thorough understanding of word problems. The two of them solved two example problems together and agreed to spend an extra 20 minutes studying every evening.

events.name: Re-plan theory review
events.description: Late at night, Lu Mingqiang sat at his desk, opened Master Li's notebook, compared it with the mistakes in the mock exam, and marked the relay protection and high-voltage technology chapters as the highest priority. He drew a new review timeline in his notebook, dividing each remaining day in May into two modules: "basic consolidation" and "case tackling," determined to make a last-ditch effort. He didn't go to bed until 12:30 a.m.

start_state.mood: Mustered the energy to face the exam.

end_state.mood: From setback to inspiration, rediscovering a path to strive

state.daily_exercise: Outdoor inspection consumed physical energy; no specific training

2025-05.daily_overview: On his 35th birthday, Lu Mingqiang found emotional comfort in family care and gifts from close friends. He also completed the final phase of old wiring inspection and posted on the liquor bottle collecting forum for the first time, starting online exchanges.

events.name: Family birthday breakfast.
events.description: At 7:00 in the morning, Wang Lijuan quietly got up early and cooked a bowl of longevity noodles with two poached eggs. Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan each gave a handmade birthday card, one with a wrench and a utility pole, the other with a crooked little figure pulling a kite. Lu Mingqiang smiled and pressed the cards under the glass of the dining table. His weight was 70.8 kg, unchanged from yesterday.

events.name: Received a birthday gift from a childhood friend
events.description: At noon, EMS delivered a tightly packed cardboard box sent by Wang Hai, my close friend from Shenzhen. Inside was an exquisite old Cantonese-style baijiu bottle with a lifelike dragon carved on the bottle. The attached card read: "Happy birthday, brother. This bottle suits you. — Brother Hai." Lu Mingqiang immediately took a photo and sent it to Wang Hai, his heart filled with the warmth of being remembered.

events.name: Worked overtime to complete the final troubleshooting item.
events.description: At 10:30 a.m., Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo conducted a final inspection of the remaining old lines in Longhua District, focusing on using a temperature gun to check the temperature of transformer outgoing lines. Everything was normal. He let out a long sigh of relief, not only because the weekend overtime had finally come to an end, but also because a third potential hazard had been ruled out, building a safeguard in advance for the upcoming summer peak electricity demand. The two high-fived and acknowledged each other's hard work.

events.name: Video call with a childhood friend
events.description: At 8 p.m., Wang Hai made a video call right on time. The two talked for nearly an hour. Wang Hai showed off his newly acquired bottle of liquor, and Lu Mingqiang smiled wryly and mentioned that he had scored 58 on the mock exam, two points short of passing. Wang Hai raised a beer can on the other side of the screen and said, "What's there to be afraid of? You've lost almost two jin already, so you can definitely ace this exam too."

events.name: Wine bottle comparison and forum interaction
events.description: After the video, Lu Mingqiang placed the newly arrived Cantonese-style old liquor bottles on the liquor cabinet and compared the glaze colors and vessel shapes with the Hainan local old liquor bottles he had collected before. On a whim, he logged into the collecting forum and left his first comment under a post titled "Cantonese Brewing Techniques and Bottle Characteristics" by a collector friend from Guangzhou: "Hi OP, liquor bottles in Hainan use a simpler sealing method. Could it be that temperature affects fermentation? Please advise." Before long, a reply came, and the window for exchange opened.

start_state.mood: Woken by the family's surprise, deeply moved

end_state.mood: Surrounded by family, friendship, and support, tired but fulfilled

state.daily_exercise: Outdoor inspection on foot, with light stretching

2025-05.daily_overview: A new week began. Lu Mingqiang shared his learning experience at the team meeting and was praised. During the day, he mentored Zhao Qiang; in the evening, he made a 20-day review plan, moving into the systematic intensive phase of exam preparation.

events.name: Morning jog to adjust his mindset
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang went to Baishamen Park and ran for 35 minutes at a pace of about 6:10 per kilometer, using the rhythm of his heartbeat and breathing to sweep away the gloom of having done badly on the exam the day before. As he ran, he silently recited the relay protection mnemonics, trying to combine physical and mental training. He weighed 70.6 kg, a new low.

events.name: Coach Zhao Qiang in hands-on practice
events.description: Before starting work in the morning, he deliberately placed the drawings and parts list for today's switchgear installation in front of Zhao Qiang and explained the operating procedure and safety key points. At the construction site, he demonstrated the use of the torque wrench hands-on, emphasizing, "Tighten until you hear the click, not a single turn more." Zhao Qiang listened carefully and nodded frequently.

events.name: Experience sharing at team meeting
events.description: At the group meeting after finishing work in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to speak, sharing his fragmented learning method of listening to electrical engineering courses during commutes, taking notes during lunch breaks, and reviewing wrong questions in the evening. He said plainly, "One hour a day, and you can gradually work through it." Squad Leader Zhang praised his enthusiasm for mentoring and sharing on the spot, and encouraged everyone to make use of fragmented time.

events.name: Create a 20-day review plan
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang laid out the calendar and exam syllabus on his study desk. He broke down chapters such as relay protection, high-voltage technology, and electrical equipment into daily tasks, planning a "20-day sprint plan": review for a fixed one hour every day, add an extra hour of practice on weekends, and set a self-test once a week. As he pressed the schedule under the corner of the desk, he felt his direction was clearer than ever. Bedtime was 23:15.

start_state.mood: Sort out my feelings and prepare for the new week

end_state.mood: The confidence of a clear plan, driven by a sense of responsibility.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 35 minutes.

2025-05.daily_overview: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang asked Master Li about difficult points; in the evening he adjusted his review focus and began systematically building a collection of wrong answers, making his exam preparation more refined.

events.name: Routine morning jog
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, he ran easily for 35 minutes in Baishamen Park. Today he deliberately did not push hard, only aiming to maintain his fitness and store energy for the evening's memory-based study. He weighed 70.5 kg and felt lighter in his body.

events.name: Consulting Master Li during the lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang took Master Li's notebook to the rest area and asked about the knowledge points behind the three wrong questions in the mock exam one by one. Master Li opened the corresponding chapter of the notebook and explained using an analogy from an on-site wiring accident, which made him instantly understand why the "distance protection setting" must take the line length coefficient into account. Master Li especially emphasized that relay protection and high-voltage technology were his weakest areas and that he had to concentrate his efforts on them.

events.name: Adjust review plan
events.description: That evening, following Master Li's advice, he compressed the review time for the Power Distribution Network chapter in his original plan and allocated all the extra time to the Relay Protection Setting Calculation and High Voltage Insulation Coordination chapters, marking them as must-get points.

events.name: Studied notes and compiled a mistake collection.
events.description: After adjusting his study plan, he sat upright at his desk and read the first 100 cases of “200 Common Troubleshooting Cases.” Whenever he encountered an item related to a question he had gotten wrong, he stopped, copied down the fault phenomenon, cause, and handling points into his notebook, and compared them with the examples in his own maintenance logs, thus establishing an initial classification index of his mistaken questions. Bedtime was 23:30.

start_state.mood: Calm, with the freshness of a new study plan

end_state.mood: Now I have a concrete handle on the ambiguous points, and it feels reassuring.

state.daily_exercise: Morning jog for 35 minutes.

2025-05.daily_overview: Wednesday was his special squash training day. Lu Mingqiang continued to refine his backhand technique. In the evening, he studied his notes as usual, making progress in both sports and studies.

events.name: Evening squash backhand special training.
events.description: After work, Lu Mingqiang headed straight to the squash club. With his playing partner Lin Feng feeding balls, he repeatedly practiced backhand straight wall shots to correct last week's problem of raising his elbow too high, and played 50 minutes of high-density multi-ball drills. Lin Feng praised him, saying his muscle memory was beginning to form and his shot trajectories were much straighter. The stuffy court left him drenched in sweat, but he felt his stress drain away with it.

events.name: Evening Study Notes
events.description: He got home after taking a shower at nearly 9 o'clock. He simply ate the steamed fish and vegetables his wife had left for him, then sat down at his desk and read the "Line Faults" chapter in his notes as planned. He used a highlighter to mark the key points for judging fault waveforms, and temporarily inserted the new "resonance overvoltage" problem he had gotten wrong into yesterday's mistake notebook, adding preventive measures. He weighed himself: 70.5 kg, maintained.

events.name: Brief parent-child time before bed.
events.description: During a break from studying, he went to his second son's bedside and gently tucked in the blanket corner, then went to the eldest son's room to see if he was still reading. Lu Zixuan said all of today's homework was done, and he had also solved an extra word problem that Dad had left. Lu Mingqiang patted his head, feeling that his son was really working hard. Bedtime was 23:45.

start_state.mood: Building strength for the special training

end_state.mood: Relaxed after exercise, made progress in review, little joys

state.daily_exercise: Squash backhand special training for 50 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: On the thunderstorm day, Lu Mingqiang switched to indoor stretching. During work breaks, he completed the first aid training registration. In the evening, he reviewed the line fault chapter and thoughtfully reminded his mother to protect her knees. Because the morning run and review had worn him out, he chose to take a nap during the lunch break.

events.name: Indoor stretching instead of morning run
events.description: Thunder rumbled in the early morning, so Lu Mingqiang gave up going out. After getting up at 5:50, he did a set of comprehensive stretching and bodyweight squats in the living room to keep his joints flexible. He noted "rest from running on rainy days" in his memo. He weighed 70.5kg, the same as yesterday.

events.name: Remind mother to apply a hot compress.
events.description: During the lunch break, he called his mother Chen Xiuying and reminded her that it had been raining continuously these days and the air was humid, so she should remember to apply hot compresses to her knees and use the medicated patches bought last time. His mother laughed on the other end of the phone and said she had already applied them, telling him to focus on work.

events.name: Search for first aid training and sign up
events.description: During an afternoon break in the workshop, Lu Mingqiang used his phone to search for the Red Cross Society of Haikou's first-aid training for Safety Production Month. He read the course outline carefully, which covered CPR and trauma bandaging, and passing the assessment would lead to a first-aid certificate. He immediately submitted his personal information through the official WeChat account and paid the 150 yuan training fee online. The system showed successful registration, with the training scheduled for May 17-18.

events.name: Evening review of line faults.
events.description: At 8:00 p.m., Lu Mingqiang continued studying the second half of the circuit fault chapters in Common Fault Troubleshooting: 200 Cases, focusing on digesting the troubleshooting approach for grounding faults. He compared it with the loose connector case he had handled last weekend and added a note in red pen in his mistake notebook: rain and humidity accelerate oxidation. He felt theory and practice were gradually coming together. He went to bed at 23:20.

start_state.mood: Staying self-disciplined on a lazy rainy day.

end_state.mood: Completed one registration item; review is progressing steadily and my mind is at ease.

state.daily_exercise: Indoor stretching and bodyweight training for 25 minutes

2025-05.daily_overview: On a Friday workday, Lu Mingqiang felt refreshed after a 5 km morning run. On the way to work, he found lost money and turned it in. At noon he returned the wallet and refused a reward. Because he took compensatory leave for the weekend first-aid training, he organized training materials in the evening and continued reviewing for the Senior Technician exam. Life was tight but fulfilling.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: Got up at 5:50, jogged 5 kilometers along Jinmao Middle Road and Binhai Avenue, with a pace of 6 minutes 12 seconds per kilometer. The morning breeze was refreshing, and there was a clear feeling of improved stamina. After returning home and taking a shower, ate the Hainan noodles breakfast prepared by his wife.

events.name: Returning lost money on the way to work
events.description: While riding an e-bike along Jinmao Middle Road, he found a black wallet on the roadside containing an ID card, bank cards, and 600 yuan in cash. After arriving at the company, he contacted the elderly owner using the address on the ID card.

events.name: Returned the wallet and refused the reward
events.description: During the lunch break, the elderly man hurried to the company to get his wallet back and insisted on giving 200 yuan as thanks. Lu Mingqiang firmly declined and only accepted the handwritten thank-you letter. His colleague Jianguo, who witnessed this, praised him repeatedly.

events.name: Swap shifts with Team Leader Zhang.
events.description: After lunch, he found Team Leader Zhang and explained that he could not work overtime on the weekend because he would attend first-aid training, so the overtime tasks for May 17 and 18 were moved to next week. The team leader readily agreed.

events.name: Organize training supplies
events.description: After getting home from work, he took out a notebook, a black pen, an ID card, and a set of sportswear, put them into his backpack, and got ready for the two-day first aid training over the weekend.

events.name: Evening theory review
events.description: In the study, I reviewed the equipment installation and commissioning chapter of 200 Common Fault Troubleshooting Cases, reorganized the easily mistaken question types compiled over the past week, and marked key data with a red pen. Before bed, I listened to an audio clip of Electrician Safety Mnemonics recommended by Master Li.

start_state.location: Home on Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District
start_state.mood: Clear-headed and organized, ready for the workday.

end_state.location: Study at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Content and calm, feeling grounded because of the good deed and review progress

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km, core stretching 5 minutes.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Saturday, he attended first-aid training at the Red Cross Training Center all day, systematically learning CPR and AED use. His wife suggested via WeChat that they use her private savings to buy an air conditioner for the children. Lu Mingqiang agreed to find an acquaintance to help choose it after the training. In the evening, he felt a bit tired, but he still persisted in studying his master's notes for about 30 minutes and went to bed early.

events.name: Go to the training center.
events.description: After breakfast, he rode the electric bicycle to the Red Cross Training Center, checked in punctually at 8:30, and received textbooks and bandage practice kits.

events.name: First Day of First Aid Training
events.description: In the morning, studied cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) theory and practiced chest compressions; in the afternoon, practiced using an automated external defibrillator (AED), repeatedly drilling with a partner and gradually mastering the rhythm. During the lunch break, the air conditioning at the training center was too cold, and I sneezed a few times, but it eased after drinking hot water.

events.name: Wife suggested buying an air conditioner
events.description: During a training break, he received a WeChat message from his wife Wang Lijuan. She had saved up 1,000 yuan of private savings and suggested buying a second-hand air conditioner for the two children's room. Lu Mingqiang replied, "Okay, I'll ask Lao Zhou, who deals in second-hand appliances. After the training, we'll go pick one out."

events.name: Evening Study Notes
events.description: After getting home, he felt soreness and tightness in his shoulders and neck, so he applied a hot towel. He still persisted in studying two cases in his study from Common Fault Troubleshooting: 200 Cases, including abnormal transformer noise, highlighting the key handling steps with a highlighter. Because the hands-on training had been physically demanding, his reading efficiency was lower than usual, so he rested early after about 30 minutes.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to learning new skills, with a slight sense of the intensity of weekend training

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Fulfilling, but physically a little tired. Happy to have mastered the CPR technique, and still thinking about the air conditioner matter.

state.daily_exercise: The training involved a lot of hands-on practice, equivalent to moderate physical exertion

2025-05.daily_overview: On Sunday, completed the second day of first aid training, passed the assessment, and obtained the Red Cross first aider certificate. At noon, while browsing Moments, saw Lin Feng training at the squash club and left an encouraging comment. In the evening, lightly reviewed the training notes, called an acquaintance to arrange a visit to look at an air conditioner next week, and went to bed early due to training fatigue.

events.name: Training day two and evaluation
events.description: In the morning I studied trauma bandaging, fracture fixation, and casualty transport; in the afternoon there were theory and practical exams. Lu Mingqiang operated calmly and passed smoothly.

events.name: Awarded a first aid certificate.
events.description: After passing the assessment, he received the Red Cross first aider certificate on the spot and carefully put it into his backpack. He shared the news in the coworkers' group chat and got many likes.

events.name: Social media interactions
events.description: During the lunch break, he scrolled through Moments and saw a set of backhand training photos posted by his squash buddy Lin Feng at the squash club. Lu Mingqiang commented to wish him good luck in Saturday's match, and Lin Feng replied that he would be waiting for him to come and play.

events.name: Organized training notes.
events.description: After returning home, reviewed the two days of study content, organized key notes, and marked important points such as chest compression depth and AED electrode pad placement, preparing for the upcoming theory exam.

events.name: Air conditioner purchase appointment
events.description: Because he was tired from two days of training, he decided to first call Lao Zhou, an acquaintance who deals in second-hand appliances, tonight, and arrange to go to the warehouse to look at the goods next Saturday (May 24). His wife expressed understanding and said that the 500 yuan hospitality fund reserved this month had just become available, so next week would be the perfect time to buy.

events.name: Light evening review
events.description: After dinner, I did a light review of the first half of Common Fault Troubleshooting: 200 Cases, just skimming the table of contents and the key cases I had marked to keep the knowledge structure familiar. I found there was still a blind spot about transformer differential protection, so I noted it in my phone memo and planned to ask Master Li this week.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous, hoping to pass the assessment.

end_state.location: Study at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: At ease and satisfied; getting the first aid certificate added a sense of security, but the blind spots in review brought a new sense of urgency.

state.daily_exercise: The training operation is equivalent to light physical activity.

2025-05.daily_overview: After a 5 km morning run on Monday, went to work as usual. In the evening, received a video call from my wife's younger brother and learned that he planned to bring his girlfriend home for National Day. The two of us excitedly discussed arrangements to receive them and planned to set aside a hospitality fund. To celebrate, my wife specially made Lu Mingqiang's favorite grilled fish, and his weight crept up a little. Reviewed and worked on weak points in basic theory.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: Woke up at 5:45, jogged 5 km along Jinmao Middle Road at a pace of 6:15/km, and completed 5 minutes of core stretching after the run. After breakfast, left for work.

events.name: Normal maintenance work
events.description: During the day, I went with my work crew to a newly built residential community in Xiuying District to install power distribution cabinets, and I worked in good coordination with Jianguo. During the lunch break, we ate boxed meals under a tree and chatted about our families' summer plans.

events.name: Answer video call from wife's younger brother
events.description: After dinner, his wife's younger brother Chen Zhiqiang called via video from Shenzhen, excitedly saying he planned to bring his girlfriend back to Haikou during the National Day holiday to meet his parents, and asked Lu Mingqiang to help arrange accommodation and a family gathering in advance.

events.name: The couple discusses the reception plan.
events.description: After hanging up, he discussed it on the spot with his wife Wang Lijuan. They initially decided to let the two of them stay in the guest room and planned to organize a family barbecue gathering. His wife smiled and reminded him to start saving for a hospitality fund, setting aside 500 yuan each month starting this month.

events.name: Celebration dinner
events.description: To celebrate the good news, his wife specially grilled a tilapia. Lu Mingqiang ate a bit too much, and before going to bed, he wrote in his memo: 'Dinner grilled fish, high in calories.'

events.name: Evening theory review
events.description: Using the error-prone problems on Ohm’s law and Kirchhoff’s laws from the wrong-question collection, re-derived the formulas and wrote out key points from memory to ensure a solid grasp of the basic theory.

start_state.mood: The calm of an ordinary workday

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Warm anticipation, feeling more concrete about the family's future small goals, and reminding myself to watch my intake after eating a bit too much.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 kilometers, core stretching.

2025-05.daily_overview: Chatting with coworkers triggered safety awareness, so after work he consulted and bought family accident insurance, adding protection for the whole family. After the rain stopped in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang took a brisk 20-minute walk during his lunch break. Late at night, he met a local collector on a wine bottle collecting forum and confirmed a meeting time. Reviewing combined with maintenance logs helped him break through the transformer difficulty.

events.name: Install cable trays
events.description: In the morning, I was installing cable trays in a factory building in Xiuying District. During a work break, Jianguo recounted a near-miss electric shock accident from last week, and the two of them discussed the importance of safety protection.

events.name: Brisk walking during lunch break
events.description: After finishing the morning work, seeing the weather turn cloudy, he walked briskly around the construction site for 20 minutes at a pace of 11 min/km to stretch his muscles.

events.name: Consult about accident insurance.
events.description: After work, rode an electric bike to an insurance company business hall on Jinmao Middle Road, consulted the terms and per-person premium of a one-year family accidental injury insurance, and took back a brochure.

events.name: Discuss insurance purchase with wife
events.description: During dinner, I discussed the idea of buying insurance with my wife, explaining that accident insurance for the whole family of four would total about 800 yuan, and got her approval.

events.name: Completed purchasing insurance for the family
events.description: With his wife's support, he logged into the insurance company's platform on his phone to buy a one-year accidental injury insurance policy for the whole family, paid a premium of 800 yuan, saved the electronic policy, and told his wife where it was stored.

events.name: Late-night forum interaction.
events.description: After putting the children to sleep at 9:30 p.m., he logged on to the baijiu bottle collecting forum and saw a popular post about the history of old Hainan baijiu bottles. He left a comment sharing photos of his own collected old bottles, then received a private message from a local collector, and they agreed to meet at Fucheng Laobaicha Tea Shop on the afternoon of May 25.

events.name: Evening review of professional subjects
events.description: Reviewed the transformer maintenance logs of the past half year. For the two types of faults—three-phase unbalance and abnormal noise—compared with similar problems in the collection of wrong questions, sorted out the diagnostic approach and handling procedures, and finally clarified the differential protection logic that had puzzled him before.

start_state.mood: Worked as usual, but the topic of the accident made me more wary.

end_state.location: Study at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: At ease and fulfilled: insurance brings a sense of security, collecting and sharing adds anticipation, and review breakthroughs bring excitement.

state.daily_exercise: 20-minute brisk walk during lunch break, cycling commute

2025-05.daily_overview: After the morning run, he finished repairing the refrigerated cabinets at the supermarket. In the evening, he had the final intensive squash training session before the match, and his backhand improved significantly, boosting confidence for the weekend match. After training, he worked through the difficult points in motor control, and his theory review gradually got on track.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: Woke up at 5:50, ran 5 km around the residential community at a pace of 6:10 per kilometer, feeling increasingly fit. After running, did core activation and stretching, then showered and had breakfast.

events.name: Repaired supermarket cold cabinet circuit.
events.description: In the morning, he went with Chen Jianguo to a shopping mall in Longhua District to repair a freezer circuit. After checking, they found that the contactor contacts had aged. After replacing them, everything returned to normal, and the customer was very satisfied.

events.name: Special pre-match squash training.
events.description: At 7 p.m. sharp, he arrived at the squash club for the last regular training session before the competition with his squash buddy Lin Feng, focusing on simulating match play. His backhand volley success rate had improved significantly, and he could still keep up his stamina after long rallies. Lin Feng praised him: 'Your backhand is like a different person.'

events.name: Extra practice after training
events.description: After training, at Lin Feng's suggestion, he did two extra sets of lateral movement footwork drills to build up stamina for Saturday's competition. After taking a shower, he felt especially refreshed.

events.name: Evening review of motor control
events.description: For common incorrect wiring in star-delta starting and autotransformer reduced-voltage starting, I simulated fault symptoms with circuit simulation software, drew the correct control circuit diagram, and marked three easily confused nodes. It suddenly became clear.

start_state.mood: Ordinary workday, with a quiet anticipation for the evening workout

end_state.mood: Feeling full of energy and confidence, with more positive expectations for both the squash match and the exam.

state.daily_exercise: Morning 5 km run, 1.5 hours of squash intensive training

2025-05.daily_overview: After the morning run, he took his apprentice Zhao Qiang on maintenance inspections in the morning; in the afternoon he took leave to attend the parent-child reading activity at his eldest son's school. Father and son read picture books together and shared electrical knowledge, warming their relationship. In the evening he formally resumed tutoring math and conquered a difficult point in relay protection calculation. Before bed, he listened to an audio program to relax.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: Got up at 5:55, ran 5 km along the Haikou Bay greenway for a morning run, with a pace of 6:08 per kilometer, enjoying the coconut palms in the morning light. After the run, did a short stretch.

events.name: Take the apprentice for maintenance inspections in the morning
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Zhao Qiang went to an old residential community in Meilan District to replace the main switch of a distribution box. Lu Mingqiang explained safety precautions to Zhao Qiang while operating, and they finished at 10 o'clock. Zhao Qiang humbly took notes.

events.name: Ask the team leader for leave
events.description: After returning to the company at noon, I asked Shift Leader Zhang for the afternoon off, saying I had to attend a parent-child reading event at my son's school. The leader approved it and teased, "You're becoming more and more family-oriented."

events.name: Attend a parent-child reading activity
events.description: In the afternoon he walked to the First Experimental Primary School in Longhua District. At the classroom book corner, he read the picture book The Story of an Electrical Engineer together with Zixuan, then used a simple model to demonstrate safe electricity use. Zixuan proudly told his classmates, “My dad can fix electrical things,” and Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside.

events.name: Begin evening tutoring.
events.description: After the activity, he took Zixuan home. After dinner, he proactively checked his math homework, patiently explained two word problems, and Zixuan listened very attentively. Father and son agreed to have 30 minutes of tutoring every day.

events.name: Evening review of protection calculations.
events.description: Select 5 setting calculation problems on overcurrent protection and instantaneous protection from the mistake collection, recalculate them step by step, summarize mnemonic techniques, and write out the setting principle table from memory. Before bed, listen to the “Electrician Safety Mnemonics” audio for 10 minutes.

start_state.mood: In the morning, I worked focused; in the afternoon, I was full of anticipation to see my son.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home in Longhua District
end_state.mood: Warm and touching; the parent-child closeness was noticeably stronger, and the review was efficient too.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km, core stretching, and about 2 km of walking round trip to school.

2025-05.daily_overview: On Friday, after the routine morning run, he went to work. During the day he repaired street lamps and drew a grounding system diagram, connecting practice with theory. In the evening he relaxed briefly with his family, conserved energy for the next day's squash match, and deliberately went to bed early.

events.name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
events.description: Woke up at 6:00, went for an easy 5 km run around the neighborhood at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer, keeping up fitness without chasing speed, and saving energy for tomorrow's race.

events.name: Repair streetlight wiring
events.description: In the morning, I went with the crew to repair two unlit streetlights on Haisheng Road in Xiuying District. We found the cable connectors were oxidized; in the afternoon I reconnected them and restored lighting. During a break, I chatted with Jianguo about tomorrow's competition, and Jianguo wished him a good finish.

events.name: Draw the grounding system diagram.

2025-05.daily_overview: During the Dragon Boat Festival, Lu Mingqiang's family of four returned to his parents' home in Meilan District for a reunion. Three generations made zongzi together and had a reunion dinner. When his father was tipsy, he told stories about wiring at the distillery in his youth and mentioned the details of the distillery's electrical distribution at that time. Lu Mingqiang opened his phone gallery and showed a photo of a 1980s Yedao Deer Turtle Wine bottle he had taken from a collector friend. His father confirmed that it was exactly the distillery where he had renovated the electrical distribution room. Lu Mingqiang developed a vague sense of pride in the electrician profession and the roots of his hometown industry, and felt a deeper identification. After returning home in the evening, he did a month-end study review, then packed the items for tomorrow's self-test, and went to bed early.

events.name: Drove back to parents' home
events.description: At 8 a.m., Lu Mingqiang started the family car, took his wife and two children, brought the prepared zongzi ingredients, and headed to his parents' home in Meilan District.

events.name: The whole family wrapped zongzi.
events.description: At his parents' home, his mother Chen Xiuying taught the two grandsons hands-on how to fold zongzi leaves, fill in rice, and wrap them up. Lu Mingqiang and his wife also joined in. Zixuan wrapped lopsided but proud zongzi, while Zihan helped put in salted egg yolks on the side, and laughter kept filling the room.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival reunion dinner and memories of Father
events.description: During dinner, his father Lu Jianguo brought out home-brewed rice wine and had a few drinks with Lu Mingqiang. He recalled the old days when he had renovated the power distribution lines at the Haikou distillery in his youth, and pointed at the wine bottles Lu Mingqiang had collected, saying proudly, 'Who knows, some of these bottles of yours might be holding electricity we installed!' Lu Mingqiang's heart stirred; he thought of the 1980s Yedao Deer-Turtle wine bottle in his collection and pressed his father for details about the distillery's power distribution back then. His father squinted as he recalled that in those days there were still wooden poles and oil switches, but the fermentation workshop had extremely high demands for power supply stability, and when they ran the wiring, they could not afford to connect a single wire wrong. For the first time, Lu Mingqiang heard from his father about the connection between the electrician trade and the history of the island's industry, and an unprecedented sense of pride surged in his heart. Then he opened his phone's photo album and showed his father a photo he had taken on May 25 from a fellow collector of a 1980s Yedao Deer-Turtle wine bottle. His father looked at it for a long time, nodded, and said, 'This is exactly that distillery. Back then, I was in charge of renovating its power distribution room.' This detail perfectly brought together the collecting-and-exchanging line and the family heritage line.

events.name: Afternoon shower break
events.description: After lunch there was a shower. The family sat in the living room drinking partridge tea. The children listened to Grandpa tell stories of old Haikou, while Lu Mingqiang peeled lychees for the family.

events.name: Returned in the evening

He wrote in his monthly planner: ‘June goal: put what I’ve learned into summer power-supply work, consolidating it through practice.’

2025-04.daily_overview: On the first working day of April, Lu Mingqiang started the day at his usual pace. He got up at 6:10 in the morning and completed his lower back and core training in the living room (superman stretch, glute bridge, plank), a habit he never skipped. In the morning, he received a work order at the company on Haisheng Road and went to a residential community in Xiuying District to fix a tripping fault. During the lunch break, he insisted on a 35-minute brisk walk around the work site while listening to an episode of the audio program Industrial Memory. Later, he remembered that his mother’s medicinal plasters were almost used up, so he rode his bike to the pharmacy to buy some. At the beginning of the month, he made a point of recording March income and expenses in the family ledger and discussed with his wife cutting back on eating out to cope with tight cash flow. After bookkeeping, he confirmed his intention to register for the first intake of the Senior Technician exam preparation class recommended by the company. The training focused on systematic knowledge review and mock drills, and the official exam was expected to be held in November. In the evening, he helped his eldest son with math homework, and before bed he did a simple set of shoulder and neck stretches.

events.name: Early morning waist and back core training
events.description: At 6:10, Lu Mingqiang spread out a yoga mat in the living room and, as usual, completed three sets of superman exercises (20 reps each), three sets of glute bridges (25 reps each), and three sets of planks (70 seconds each). This routine fully activated his core muscles, preparing him for the day's physical labor.

events.name: Go to the residential community to handle a resident’s tripping fault.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang received a dispatch order. He took his toolbox and went to an old residential community in Xiuying District to investigate the problem of a resident's circuit frequently tripping. The inspection found that the aging wiring of the bathroom socket had caused a leakage. He replaced the aging wires and the waterproof socket, tested it, and left after it worked normally. The resident was an elderly person living alone. Before leaving, Lu Mingqiang specifically reminded the elderly person to pay attention to electrical safety and not to use high-power appliances at the same time.

events.description: At 12:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang put on his sneakers and walked briskly on the streets near his residential area for 35 minutes at a pace of about 9 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer. He put on Bluetooth earphones and listened to the second episode of Industrial Memories, which told the story of an old electrician working on construction in the borderlands, reminding him of his father's experiences.

events.name: After the lunch break, buy this month's medicated patches for mother

Her knee rheumatism was an old problem; it ached dully whenever the weather was overcast or rainy. He chose two boxes of plasters and a bottle of huoluo oil, paid with his medical insurance card, and carefully put them into his backpack, planning to bring them when he visited his parents on the weekend.

He and his wife Wang Lijuan sat on the living room sofa to discuss and decided to reduce eating out this month and cook at home as much as possible. Both husband and wife felt reassured by this meticulous planning.

During the lunch break, he still insisted on brisk walking, but shortened it to 20 minutes to avoid overexertion. Before leaving work in the afternoon, team leader Zhang called the team together for a short meeting to inform them of the Qingming Festival schedule adjustment and the installation task at Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza after the holiday. The two worked in good coordination: Lu Mingqiang was responsible for main circuit wiring, while Chen Jianguo handled secondary circuits and control component installation. The workshop was very hot; two large fans blew hot air noisily, and the two stopped every hour to drink water and wipe off sweat. During the noon break, Chen Jianguo handed him a popsicle, and they sat at the workshop entrance eating popsicles and chatting about how their children were doing. The pre-installation task went smoothly, and by the end of the afternoon they had completed the main assembly of two cabinets.

Lu Mingqiang carefully noted down the key points and deadlines in his phone memo, already starting to plan the installation approach in his head. Team Leader Zhang also praised his efficiency and attitude in handling an emergency fault last month.
