events.description: After coming home from work, his wife Wang Lijuan had already prepared a table of dishes. Today she had specially made his favorite Hainanese chicken rice. The golden chicken skin glistened with oil, and the dipping sauce contained sand ginger and lime, an authentic Hainan flavor. Lu Mingqiang washed his hands, sat down, and began eating heartily, praising his wife's cooking as he ate. After dinner, his younger son Lu Zihan pulled him over to play with building blocks. He sat on the living room floor with his son and built a “big bridge.” The little guy clapped and cheered happily.

events.name: Kept up squash training but reduced the intensity
events.description: Despite being exhausted, Lu Mingqiang still drove to the Power Fitness Club for Wednesday squash training. He mainly did stationary backhand drills, with his squash buddy Lin Feng feeding balls. After 40 minutes of practice, he stopped and did not play a match. Lin Feng pointed out that his body rotation was insufficient, and he carefully noted it down.

events.name: Search online for senior technician exam materials.
events.description: After training, he returned home. The children had already gone to bed. Lu Mingqiang sat in the living room using his phone to search for the "Electrician Senior Technician Exam Syllabus" and exam preparation experience posts. He browsed several electrician forums and training institution websites and learned that the exam consisted of three parts: written theory, practical operation, and thesis defense. The theory part covered advanced content such as power system analysis and automation control. He saved the useful webpages to his browser bookmarks and took screenshots of several exam syllabus images, planning to organize them into a study plan.

2025-04.daily_overview: Tomorrow is the Qingming Festival. Lu Mingqiang could clearly feel the approaching festive atmosphere at work today. Several colleagues were discussing their ancestor worship arrangements, and Squad Leader Zhang also let everyone knock off an hour early. After finishing the final touches on a distribution cabinet, Lu Mingqiang left work at 4 p.m. During his lunch break, he still insisted on a 30-minute brisk walk. After work, he rode his electric bike home to pick up his wife, and the two went to the Longhua District market to buy ancestor worship supplies. The market was crowded, and the stalls selling joss paper, incense, and candles were packed. The couple divided the work, selected joss paper, incense, candles, flowers, and fruit, and Lu Mingqiang also deliberately bought a bottle of Hainan local rice wine that his father liked. Back home in the evening, he discussed the departure time and route for the next day with his wife, and loaded the items to bring for ancestor worship into the trunk of the car in advance. Before going to bed, he completed his full set of core exercises.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6:10, Lu Mingqiang completed his regular core training in the living room: superman exercise 3 sets × 20 reps, glute bridges 3 sets × 25 reps, planks 3 sets × 70 seconds.

events.name: Final work wrap-up on the last day before the holiday.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang continued the installation finishing work on the distribution cabinet in the workshop, tightening the last screws and sticking labels on the cabinet that had been pre-assembled the previous day. Team leader Zhang, considering that the next day was Qingming Festival, told the whole team to knock off an hour early in the afternoon. Lu Mingqiang sped up and finished his tasks before noon, then helped his apprentice Zhao Qiang check the wiring of a small distribution box that Zhao Qiang was responsible for, pointing out a grounding hazard.

events.name: 30-minute brisk walk during lunch break.
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang did a brisk 30-minute walk on the streets near the company, keeping a steady pace.

events.name: Went with his wife to a market in Longhua District to purchase items for Qingming Festival ancestor worship.
events.description: After getting off work at 4 p.m., Lu Mingqiang hurried home on his electric bike to pick up his wife Wang Lijuan, who had been waiting. The two rode together to the largest vegetable market in Longhua District. The market was packed with people, and the festive atmosphere was strong. They first went to the incense and candle stall. Wang Lijuan skillfully selected a sufficient amount of joss paper, three-color incense, and a pair of big red candles, while Lu Mingqiang picked two bouquets of white chrysanthemums at the flower stall beside it. Then they bought apples, oranges, and a bunch of bananas. Before leaving, Lu Mingqiang thought of his father, so he stopped by a drinks stall and bought a bottle of local rice wine from Hainan. The two squeezed out of the crowd carrying bags and carefully loaded everything into the rear box and front basket of the electric bike.

events.name: Organized Qingming ancestor worship items and loaded them into the car ahead of time.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took the ancestor worship supplies purchased in the afternoon out of the electric bike and sorted them with Wang Lijuan in the living room. They wrapped joss paper and incense candles in plastic bags to keep them dry, put the flowers in a bottle of water to keep them fresh, and wiped the fruit clean before putting it in a cloth bag. He opened the trunk of the car and neatly arranged these items along with the bottle of rice wine, then checked the drinking water and the children's snacks for tomorrow. After everything was ready, he checked the route from home to his father's house in Meilan District on his phone map. The estimated drive was about 30 minutes, so he decided to set off at 7:30 the next morning. Only when all was ready did he go to wash up with peace of mind.

start_state.mood: Qingming Festival is approaching, and I feel a solemn sense of remembrance for my ancestors.

2025-04.daily_overview: During the Qingming Festival, Lu Mingqiang's family slowed down their pace and spent the day around traditional ancestor-worship customs. At 6:30 in the morning, the whole family got up early, and he still insisted on doing a simple core workout (holding a plank for 70 seconds). At 7:30 sharp, they set off. Lu Mingqiang drove the family car, carrying his wife and two children, heading to his father's home on Haifu Road in Meilan District. There were not many cars on the road, and the children chattered in the back seat about the small animals in the countryside. When they arrived at his father's house, his parents had already prepared homemade offerings. Two cars drove one after the other to the ancestral house on the outskirts of Meilan District. At the ancestral house, Lu Mingqiang led the whole family as they placed offerings one by one, lit incense and candles, and made three deep bows in front of the ancestral tablets. The whole process was solemn and dignified. After the worship, his father sat in the hall of the ancestral house and recalled the hard years when he worked as an electrician in his youth, and Lu Mingqiang listened with rapt attention. At noon, his mother and wife worked together in the simple kitchen of the ancestral house to cook a table of authentic Hainan dishes, and the whole family sat around together. In the afternoon, he helped his father make simple repairs to a loose window in the ancestral house, then cleaned up, said goodbye to his parents, and drove back to Longhua District. On the way back, his wife took the wheel, and he shared his feelings about the day with the children, filling the car with a warm atmosphere.

events.name: Early morning simplified core training
events.description: To save time, Lu Mingqiang only did 3 sets of planks, 70 seconds each, and quickly completed 2 sets each of superman exercises and glute bridges.

events.name: In the early morning, drive to meet up with family and head to the ancestral house to pay respects to ancestors.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan woke their two sleepy sons and got them washed and dressed. At 7:30, the family set off on time. Lu Mingqiang checked the trunk to confirm that the offerings bought the day before were all there, then started the car and drove toward Haifu Road in Meilan District. The drive took about thirty minutes, with few cars on the road and a quiet atmosphere. When they arrived at the building where his parents lived, his father Lu Jianguo and mother Chen Xiuying were already waiting downstairs carrying bags of offerings. His father had also specially brought along a set of old-style electrician tools, saying he wanted to leave them in the ancestral house as a keepsake. After the two families exchanged a few greetings, Lu Mingqiang had his parents get into his car, and they drove together to the ancestral house in the suburbs.

events.name: Held a solemn ancestor worship ceremony in the ancestral house.
events.description: After arriving at the ancestral house, Lu Mingqiang and his father worked together to push open the old wooden door. His mother and wife began cleaning the offering table, while Lu Mingqiang led his eldest son in placing the offerings one by one on the table — three plates of fruit, a bottle of rice wine, and two bunches of flowers, with incense and candles placed in the old bronze incense burner. His father lit the incense and candles, and wisps of smoke curled upward. Lu Mingqiang led the whole family to line up in front of the ancestral tablets. He stood at the front with a solemn expression and was the first to bow deeply three times. His wife followed behind, holding the younger son, while Lu Zixuan earnestly imitated his father's movements. Then his father stepped forward and quietly reported the family's recent situation to the ancestors in dialect. The whole process was quiet and solemn.

events.name: His father talked about his youthful experience as an electrician, and Lu Mingqiang felt a sense of passing on the craft.
events.description: After the memorial ceremony, his father Lu Jianguo moved an old bamboo chair to the front hall of the ancestral house. Sunlight poured through the courtyard skylight, shining on his gray hair. He waved for Lu Mingqiang and the children to gather around, and began to tell stories of his youth as an electrician at the power supply bureau. It was the early 1980s; Haikou was still small, with low tiled-roof houses everywhere. Every day he carried a heavy tool bag and rode a vintage 28-inch bicycle through narrow alleys to repair electricity meters and run wires. Once after a typhoon, the whole city lost power, and he worked continuously for three days and three nights, dozing off briefly under utility poles when sleepy. Lu Mingqiang listened quietly, silently comparing his father's experience with his own current equipment and standard construction procedures, and felt a surge of admiration for his father's generation and a sense of mission to carry on this craft.

events.name: A family lunch gathering, where warmth deepens family bonds
events.description: Near noon, his mother Chen Xiuying and his wife Wang Lijuan walked into the simple kitchen at the back of the ancestral house. His mother made several family-style Hainan home-cooked dishes: white-cut Wenchang chicken, stir-fried sweet potato leaves, winter melon and clam soup, and a small dish of homemade shrimp paste. His wife cooked a tomato and egg stir-fry that the children loved. The whole family sat together; although the dishes were simple, everyone's face beamed with satisfied smiles. As they ate and chatted, his mother brought up embarrassing childhood stories about Lu Mingqiang, causing the whole table to laugh heartily.

events.name: Help father repair the ancestral house windows and clean up the area.
events.description: After lunch, during a brief rest, his father mentioned that a window hinge on the east side of the ancestral house was loose, and since typhoon season was coming, he was afraid it might be blown off. Lu Mingqiang, without a word, took a small toolbox from the car trunk and found a suitable screwdriver and some wire. He carefully inspected the window hinge and latch, and found that several wood screws were stripped. He cut a few small wooden pieces into wedges, stuffed them into the screw holes, then tightened the screws again, and the window immediately became perfectly tight. He also reinforced the latch with wire. After fixing the window, Lu Mingqiang also took the initiative to sweep the fallen leaves in front of the ancestral house and tamped down several loose stone slabs in the yard.

events.name: Shared reflections on the way back, and the car was filled with warmth
events.description: A little after 4 p.m., the sunlight began to soften. Lu Mingqiang and his family packed up their belongings and said goodbye to his parents, who were reluctant to let them go. He started the car and slowly left the ancestral house. On the way back, his wife Wang Lijuan drove, Lu Mingqiang sat in the front passenger seat, and the children played in the back seat with the snacks their grandparents had stuffed into their hands. Lu Mingqiang took the initiative to share his feelings about the day with the children and asked them what they thought of paying respects to their ancestors. His eldest son, Lu Zixuan, said excitedly that his maternal grandfather's electrician stories were even cooler than he had imagined. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said, "It's fine to learn how to fix things, but you need to learn knowledge well first." The younger son, half understanding, echoed, "I want to fix things too." Looking at the lively faces of the two children in the rearview mirror, Lu Mingqiang's heart was filled with appreciation for his current life.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the Saturday after the Qingming Festival, Lu Mingqiang had a fulfilling and energetic day. After getting up in the early morning, he completed his daily core training and went for a 5 km morning run in Baishamen Park (pace 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer). In the morning, his workmate Chen Jianguo sent him a WeChat message strongly recommending the audio program "Industrial Memory". He downloaded it and listened to an episode, and was deeply fascinated. At noon, he took part in a 10 km charity run organized by his running buddy Chen Bin, finished smoothly in Wanlv Garden, and received sports gear. After returning home and resting in the afternoon, he took the whole family to the mall for a stroll. In the evening, he did a few sets of pull-ups by himself in the community fitness area. At night, he watched TV with his wife, and listened to another episode before going to bed.

events.name: Early morning core training and morning run.
events.description: Getting up at six, Lu Mingqiang first completed the full core training routine (superman exercise 3 sets x 20, glute bridge 3 sets x 25, plank 3 sets x 75 seconds), then drove to Baishamen Park for a 5 km morning run at a pace of 6:20/km. The park air was fresh in the early morning, and after the run he felt refreshed and energized.

events.name: Download and register for the Ximalaya app, and listen to the first episode of Industrial Memory
events.description: Just after 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang received a WeChat voice message from his co-worker Chen Jianguo at home, who strongly recommended the program "Industrial Memory." Lu Mingqiang decided to give it a try, downloaded the Ximalaya app from the app store, registered, searched for the program, and played the first episode. A weathered voice told the story of the construction of old factories in Northeast China in the early years of the People's Republic of China, with vivid details. He was deeply attracted and listened to the entire episode without realizing it. He replied to Chen Jianguo: "Good stuff! Thanks for the recommendation, brother." And he subscribed to the program in passing.

events.name: Participated in the 10K charity run, finished the race successfully, and received sports gear as a gift
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang, wearing running shoes and a sports T-shirt, came to Wanlv Park to join a small 10-kilometer charity run organized by his running buddy Chen Bin. There were about forty or fifty people on site, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. After a simple warm-up and check-in, he started running with the main group. He kept his comfortable pace, maintained steady splits throughout, and occasionally chatted with the runners beside him. After about one hour and seven minutes, he crossed the finish line smoothly. After the race, the sponsor gave each finisher a sports gift pack containing a quick-dry T-shirt, a pair of wristbands, and a pair of running socks, with a total value of about 200 yuan. He tried on the T-shirt on the spot and it fit very well.

events.name: Take the family to a mall near home
events.description: After finishing his run, Lu Mingqiang went home and took a shower, feeling refreshed all over. In the early evening, he suggested taking the whole family out for a stroll, and the children immediately cheered. He drove his wife and two children to a community commercial plaza near home. The children lingered in front of the toy store and finally each bought a small toy car. Wang Lijuan bought a week's worth of daily necessities, vegetables, and fruit at the supermarket, while Lu Mingqiang pushed the cart and carried the heavy items. He also looked at new smart rice cookers in the appliance section, but put one back in its box after seeing the price tag, thinking the old one was still usable. The family spent over an hour wandering around the mall.

events.name: Evening workout in the community fitness area
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang did not stay at home watching TV. Instead, he changed into sportswear and went downstairs alone to the fitness equipment area in the community. He did three sets of pull-ups on the horizontal bar, eight reps per set, and then several sets of crunches on the ab board. Uncle Wang from the next unit (Wang Jianguo) was taking a walk and saw him exercising, so he stopped to praise his health. The two stood and chatted briefly about the increase in the community property management fee, then went their separate ways. After exercising, he was slightly sweaty and felt his body was fully stretched, which was very comfortable.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang had a new experience that felt 'awkward but useful.' At nine in the morning, his sports buddy Lin Feng sent a message inviting him to a free Hatha yoga trial class at Power Fitness Club. Lu Mingqiang had never tried yoga and thought it was something girls practiced, but Lin Feng enthusiastically said it was great for stretching the lower back. Since he had been feeling stiffness in his lower back at work recently, he agreed with some hesitation. He drove for twenty minutes to the gym, and under Lin Feng's guidance changed into loose clothing and walked barefoot into the yoga studio. After the hour-long class, his back did feel much looser. Although many poses were not done correctly, the instructor was very patient. After class, Lin Feng also explained the basics of exercise anatomy. Lu Mingqiang only half-understood but silently noted a few stretching moves he could do at home. Returning home in the afternoon, he felt a bit tired, so he rested at home and watched an animated movie with the kids. In the early evening, a light rain fell, so he canceled the planned night run and instead listened to a new episode of 'Industrial Memory' on his phone at home, and did some simple full-body stretching (trying the Cat-Cow Pose and Child's Pose learned in the yoga class).

events.name: At the invitation of his playing partner Lin Feng, go to Power Fitness Club to try Hatha yoga.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Lu Mingqiang was watering potted plants on the balcony when he received a WeChat message from Lin Feng, who sent a course poster with the note: “Buddy, there’s a free Hatha Yoga trial class at noon today. The instructor is very professional and focuses on stretching the lower back. Since you do physical work, your back must be tight—come try it!” Lu Mingqiang’s first reaction to the word “yoga” was to refuse, but thinking about how his back had indeed been sore lately from bending over while tightening screws, and since Lin Feng was so insistent, he replied, “All right, I’ll come take a look.” At ten, after getting himself ready, he drove to the Power Fitness Club. Lin Feng, wearing a trainer uniform, was waiting at the door and handed him a clean T-shirt and shorts to change into. Walking into the yoga room, he saw seven or eight students, all women. Lu Mingqiang felt a bit awkward and found a spot in the back, muttering to himself, “What am I, a grown man, doing here?” But with an encouraging look from Lin Feng, he steeled himself and stayed.

events.name: Completed a 60-minute Hatha yoga class; the stiffness in the lower back was noticeably relieved.
events.description: As the class began, soft music played, and the instructor guided everyone to adjust their breathing in a gentle voice. Lu Mingqiang clumsily imitated downward-facing dog and cat-cow poses, nearly losing his balance several times, and sweat gradually beaded on his forehead. At first he felt awkward inside, but as the class went on, he gradually forgot everything around him and focused on the sensations in his body. During the spinal twist, he could clearly hear a slight cracking sound from his spine, and an unprecedented feeling of release spread from his lower back to his entire back. In a deep downward-facing dog, he felt the long-accumulated stiffness in his lower back seem to be gently kneaded open. The instructor came over, softly adjusted the angle of his shoulders, and whispered, “Your shoulder and back strength are good, but your hips are too tight; practice pigeon pose more.” Lu Mingqiang nodded, and his opinion of the exercise changed a little. After the class of more than sixty minutes, he felt light all over, and even his breathing became much smoother.

events.name: After class, listened to Lin Feng share sports anatomy knowledge and stretching advice
events.description: After the class ended, the trainees left one by one, but Lin Feng deliberately kept Lu Mingqiang behind. The two sat cross-legged on yoga mats. Lin Feng took out a human muscle anatomy chart, pointed at the posterior thigh muscles and the erector spinae, and explained in plain language: "For someone like you who does physical labor all day, these muscles are all tight, causing an anterior pelvic tilt, which leads to lower back pain. Spend ten minutes a day doing these movements—" He demonstrated child's pose, butterfly pose, and a wall-assisted leg stretch. Lu Mingqiang carefully filmed the movements with his phone. Although he only half understood terms like "erector spinae" and "hip flexors," he knew this knowledge was good for his body. Lin Feng added, "You'll also use this when playing squash later; better flexibility means a bigger backhand range." Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement, said he would try practicing on his own, and took the initiative to invite Lin Feng to have a meal together next week if he was free.

events.name: In the afternoon, stayed home with the children to watch a movie and enjoy some time at home.
events.description: After returning home from the gym, Lu Mingqiang took a hot shower and felt completely relaxed. In the afternoon, the sky gradually turned overcast, making it unsuitable for outdoor activities. His wife was preparing dinner ingredients in the kitchen, while the children were a little bored in the living room. On a whim, Lu Mingqiang pulled out a tablet, found an animated movie they liked, arranged the sofa cushions comfortably, and the family of four squeezed together on the sofa to watch it. His younger son nestled in his arms giggling, while his elder son discussed the plot with him. Rain began to patter against the window outside, but the room was warm and peaceful. This was one of his rare, pleasant moments of completely setting aside his phone and not thinking about work or study, devoting himself wholeheartedly to his family.

events.name: In the evening, tried yoga stretching poses at home.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and, following the moves he had learned during the day, did Cat-Cow and Child's Pose for 3 minutes each, feeling his lower back relax further. He also tried Pigeon Pose, and although his thighs hurt a little, he held it for 30 seconds. When he finished, he had worked up a light sweat and thought to himself that he should incorporate these stretches into his daily routine.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road.
end_state.mood: My body feels light and relaxed, my spirits are high, and I have a new understanding of yoga and stretching.

2025-04.daily_overview: A new week began, and Lu Mingqiang faced the first high-intensity workday after the holiday. It was the first day of the distribution cabinet installation task at Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza. He got up half an hour earlier than usual, waking at six to prepare, and did only one quick core workout (70-second plank x 3). After meeting his workmate Chen Jianguo at the company on Haisheng Road, the two took the company work vehicle to the Haixiu Road construction site. The site was a newly renovated mall electrical distribution room, not large but with high requirements. The two worked from 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., completing the positioning, drilling, and fixing of three newly installed distribution cabinets. During the lunch break, he simply ate a boxed lunch next to the site and did not go for a brisk walk. After work, he dragged his tired body home. After dinner, he sat in the living room with his wife Wang Lijuan for an important family discussion, talking about the division of household duties during his upcoming intensive pre-exam training course for the senior technician certificate. His wife said she would fully support him and take on housework and tutoring the children alone. This made him feel both moved and somewhat guilty, and he quietly resolved to do well in the exam. In the evening, he packed the tools he would need for the next day in advance and did some neck and shoulder stretches to relieve fatigue.

events.name: Simplify the morning core routine
events.description: Because he had to leave early, Lu Mingqiang only did three sets of planks (70 seconds each) to ensure core activation while saving time.

events.name: Partnered with fellow worker Chen Jianguo to start the installation of power distribution cabinets at Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza.
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang met Chen Jianguo at the construction site. Today they needed to complete the foundation installation of 3 new distribution cabinets—the critical first step of the whole project. The distribution room was still quite dusty, and the ventilation system was not fully set up, making it feel like a steamer. The two put on safety helmets and work clothes and split the work clearly. Lu Mingqiang checked the drawings, used an infrared level and tape measure to accurately mark the installation position of each cabinet on the ground, and then drilled holes in the concrete floor with expansion bolts and a hammer drill. The roar of drilling was deafening and dust flew everywhere. Both wore masks, but sweat still streamed down from under their helmets. Chen Jianguo worked with him to move the heavy cabinets (about 200 kg each) to the marked positions with a hydraulic cart. The two chanted work songs as they adjusted left and right, ensuring the cabinets were level and plumb within allowable tolerances. They kept working until almost noon, and all 3 cabinets were firmly fixed and neatly arranged. When they straightened up and looked at their work, although exhausted, they both showed satisfied smiles.

events.name: Discussed the follow-up installation plan and afternoon work with Chen Jianguo during lunch.
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo ate at a small fast-food restaurant next to the construction site. They each ordered a serving of pork knuckle rice and added a braised egg. Lu Mingqiang also bought a bottle of iced black tea. While eating, they discussed the afternoon work details. Chen Jianguo pointed at the circuit diagram on his phone and discussed the cabling plan starting the next day. Lu Mingqiang looked at the diagram carefully and proposed an optimized cable routing path that could save several meters of cable. Chen Jianguo slapped his thigh and said, OK, we'll do it your way. The simple lunch quickly replenished their energy, and at 1 p.m. they plunged back into the construction site.

events.name: Had an in-depth conversation with his wife after dinner and finalized the family division of labor plan during the intensive training period.
events.description: After getting home a little past seven in the evening, Lu Mingqiang finished dinner and took a shower, then sat in the living room with his wife Wang Lijuan. The children were playing in their room, leaving them space to talk. Lu Mingqiang explained in detail that the company was selecting him to attend an intensive pre-exam training course for senior technicians — from April 14 to 25, for two consecutive weeks, he would go to Haikou Electric Power School every evening after work for class until 9:30, and on weekends he would need to review. This meant he would hardly be able to take care of anything at home. After listening, Wang Lijuan was silent for a few seconds, then said firmly: “This is a big deal for your career, you must go. Don’t worry about home. I’ll check Zixuan’s homework and handle all the housework. You focus on your studies.” Lu Mingqiang held his wife’s hand, feeling a surge of warmth and deep gratitude. The two then refined their contingency plans: what to do if the children got sick, what to do if his wife suddenly got a housekeeping job, and finally they agreed that in an emergency his mother could come over to help. This conversation prepared both of them mentally for the tense two weeks ahead. Lu Mingqiang also explained to his wife that this training class was only the first step; the formal exam would not be until the end of the year, so he would need to keep reviewing after the intensive training ended, and he hoped she could understand. Wang Lijuan nodded and said: “One step at a time. Get through these two weeks first, and deal with what comes later when it comes.”

events.name: Pre-sleep shoulder and neck stretching
events.description: Before sleeping, Lu Mingqiang sat on the edge of the bed and did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches to relieve the shoulder tension from carrying heavy items, then fell into a deep sleep.

2025-04.daily_overview: Today was a day of both conflict and reconciliation. During the day, Lu Mingqiang continued wiring the power distribution cabinet at Haixiu Road Square and cooperated with Chen Jianguo to complete the main line installation, which went smoothly. However, what made him unhappy happened in the evening. After returning home, he took out his treasured bottle collection notebook, intending to organize the new knowledge he had recently learned from the forum. His wife Wang Lijuan, worried that he would be distracted from exam preparation, said, "Spending time on these bottles is a waste of time." He did not argue, but he felt blocked up and went out alone to get some air. At a Cantonese teahouse on Bo'ai South Road, he unexpectedly ran into his father Lu Jianguo, who was also there for tea. Seeing that he was in a low mood, his father shared his experience of tackling difficult technical problems in his youth and counseled him with the wisdom of experience. Those words made him suddenly enlightened. After returning home, he carefully placed the bottle collection notes at the bottom of his toolbox and decided to temporarily only browse the forum on his phone during lunch breaks as relaxation. He also confirmed by phone with the training institution that he had successfully enrolled in the first session of the electrician senior technician exam preparation class, and learned that the official exam was expected in November.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang got up at 6:10 and completed his routine core training: Superman exercise 3 sets × 20, glute bridge 3 sets × 25, plank 3 sets × 75 seconds.

events.name: Completed the connection of the main lines in the commercial plaza's power distribution cabinet and assisted with commissioning.
events.description: Today was the second day of the task, and the work entered the core wiring stage. Lu Mingqiang was mainly responsible for connecting the main circuits of three distribution cabinets, a heavy and delicate task. Wearing insulated shoes and protective gloves, and holding wire strippers and a crimping tool, he was busy around the cabinets. Thick copper-core cables were precisely stripped, crimped with copper lugs, and firmly connected to the switches and busbars in his hands. Every circuit had to be done strictly according to the drawings, with no room for error. The distribution room was extremely hot and stuffy, and his work clothes were already soaked through, but his attention remained highly focused. Chen Jianguo was beside him, preparing the commissioning equipment and checking the circuit numbers. Before knocking off in the afternoon, the two made an initial pre-power-on check of all the wiring. Almost everything was correct; only one wire's number label was pasted on the wrong line, and they quickly spotted and corrected it. When they knocked off, Team Leader Zhang came to inspect the site and praised their efficiency.

events.name: Browsed a liquor bottle collection forum on his phone during the lunch break.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang found a shady spot by the construction site, logged into the liquor bottle collecting forum on his phone, and quickly browsed a few new posts. When he saw someone post an old Hainan liquor bottle from the 1990s, he was full of envy, but he just looked and did not join the discussion.

events.name: Had a disagreement with his wife over bottle collection, went for a walk alone and ran into his father by chance.
events.description: Electrician question bank

events.name: Sitting opposite his father drinking Laoba tea, he listened to life wisdom and felt enlightened.
events.description: Both father and son were surprised and delighted by such an unexpected meeting. Lu Mingqiang sat down across from his father and also ordered a cup of Laoba tea. Seeing the expression on his face that said he was holding something back, his father said mildly, “If you have something to say, just say it. Isn’t it uncomfortable to hold it in?” Lu Mingqiang then briefly told him about what had happened that day, saying that he had a hobby of collecting wine bottles, but with the exam approaching, his family thought it was an idle pursuit. After hearing this, his father did not directly judge whether he was right or wrong. Instead, he took a sip of tea, looked out at the rain-soaked street, and slowly told a story from his youth. He said that when he first became an electrician, he fixed a fault that no one else could fix using an improvised method he had worked out on his own, but the supervisor did not accept it, saying that he had not followed the prescribed procedure. He had also felt upset, but later he came to understand: “Other people have their rules, but the skill is your own, and your energy should be used where it counts.” He patted the back of Lu Mingqiang’s hand and said earnestly, “Son, keep your hands steady and your heart broad. In this life, you will face many choices—not just about the relationship between skills and hobbies, but also about your relationship with your family. Keep your priorities clear, and putting something at the bottom of the box won’t make it run away.” His father’s words were like a key, removing the knot in Lu Mingqiang’s heart. He reflected that he had indeed been too absorbed, and had almost overlooked his family’s care and the importance of preparing for the exam.

events.name: After returning home, he calmed himself down and temporarily stored the wine bottle notes at the bottom of the toolbox.
events.description: He talked with his father for nearly an hour. The rain stopped, and Lu Mingqiang's mood brightened as well. When he got home, his wife was still waiting for him in the living room, with a trace of guilt on her face. He stepped forward and said calmly, "It's okay. You're right. This is a critical period, and I won't let my hobby distract me." Then he went into the study, picked up the carefully kept notebook on wine bottle culture, flipped through it one last time, opened his old toolbox, and carefully placed the notebook at the very bottom, covering it with a piece of flannel. The gesture was full of ritual, as if he had temporarily put a lock on his hobby in his heart. He told himself that after the exam, he would take it out again. For now, he just needed to browse the forum on his phone during lunch breaks to get his fix. After tidying up, he turned and saw his wife had made a cup of hot milk and put it on the table, smiling at him gently. The little unhappiness between the couple dissolved completely in silence.

events.name: Called the training institution to confirm successful registration for the exam preparatory tutoring class.
events.description: After composing himself in the study, Lu Mingqiang remembered there was still one important matter to handle. He called a vocational skills training institution in Haikou to confirm whether his application for the 'Senior Electrician Exam Preparation Tutoring Class (First Session),' which he had signed up for through his company last month, had been approved. The staff member on the other end verified his name and ID number, told him the registration was successful, and explained the arrangements in detail: from April 14 to 25, weekday evenings from 7:00 to 9:30 p.m., on the third floor of the practical training building at Haikou Electric Power School. He took out his notebook and carefully wrote it down, and also asked what study materials and tools he needed to bring. The staff member also said that this session mainly focused on a systematic review of the exam syllabus and mock training; the formal exam was expected to be held in November, and there would be an intensive pre-exam class then, so he should keep an eye on future notices. After hanging up, he let out a long breath. The previous sense of uncertainty disappeared, replaced by a sense of urgency about soon starting his studies. He specially marked the start and end dates of the tutoring class in his phone calendar to remind himself to arrange his time properly.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road.

2025-04.daily_overview: Today was a day full of human warmth and a sense of fulfillment. The main task during the day was to work with Chen Jianguo at the Haixiu Road Commercial Plaza to bring three days of hard work to a successful conclusion. In the afternoon, they powered on and commissioned the three installed power distribution cabinets. All functions worked normally, and the installation passed acceptance, ensuring the mall's power supply was turned on as scheduled. During the lunch break, he insisted on a brisk 25-minute walk. In the evening, instead of going straight home after work, he went to Xinhua Bookstore and bought the textbook, workbook, and a toolkit for the senior technician exam. When he returned to the residential area in the evening, a small incident warmed his heart. In the hallway, he came across his neighbor Uncle Wang (Wang Jianguo), who had fallen to the ground. He immediately helped him up, took him home, and voluntarily went downstairs to pick up a package for him. Uncle Wang was extremely grateful and gave him two boxes of homemade coconut cakes. In the evening, he brought the coconut cakes home, and the children ate them with relish. He sat under the lamp, stroking the newly bought textbook. The road of exam preparation ahead was clear and weighty, but he felt ready.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6:10, Lu Mingqiang completed his core training on time: 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 75-second planks.

events.name: 25-minute brisk walk during lunch break
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang brisk-walked for 25 minutes on the streets near the construction site, keeping his heart rate in the fat-burning zone while listening to half an episode of "Industrial Memory."

events.name: Completed the power-on commissioning of the distribution cabinet with Chen Jianguo, and the project passed acceptance smoothly.
events.description: In the afternoon, the critical moment of power-on commissioning finally arrived. Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo carefully checked all the wiring one last time. After confirming everything was in perfect order, Chen Jianguo gave the order at the main switch to energize. As the switch closed with a click, the indicator lights in the distribution cabinet lit up one by one, the numbers on the multi-function meter panel began to jump normally, and the cooling fan spun smoothly. Lu Mingqiang held his breath and listened carefully; there was no abnormal hum or burning smell. Then, following the commissioning procedure, they measured the voltage, current, and phase sequence of each circuit. Lu Mingqiang held a multimeter, skillfully touched the test points, and reported values all within the normal range, while Chen Jianguo recorded each one on the acceptance form. The whole process was smooth and successful. The three brand-new distribution cabinets ran steadily, providing solid power support for the mall's pre-opening preparations. Supervisor Liu, the head of the mall's engineering department, also came. After an on-site inspection, he thanked them for their efficient and professional installation over the past three days. Lu Mingqiang wiped the sweat from his forehead, feeling a weight lifted from his mind. The three days of high-intensity work had come to a successful end.

events.name: After work, he went to Xinhua Bookstore to buy study materials for the senior technician exam.
events.description: After the acceptance inspection ended, it was still early, so Lu Mingqiang did not go straight home. Instead, he rode his e-bike to the Haikou Xinhua Bookstore on Jiefang West Road. He went directly to the industrial technology section and carefully searched through several bookshelves on electrical engineering. He found a copy of the officially designated Training Textbook for Senior Electrician Technicians (Third Edition), a companion Collection of Simulated and Real Exam Questions, and a blue-covered Practical Examination Guide for Senior Electrician Technicians. Considering that he couldn't just study without practicing, he then went to the tools section and picked out a standard-configured practical tool kit containing a multimeter, a clamp meter, screwdrivers of various sizes, and pliers. Although he basically had all these tools, this one was specifically for the exam, and he wanted to use the most standard tools to adapt to the exam requirements. The total cost of the four items was not cheap. He hesitated for a moment but then paid decisively. Looking at the heavy package in his hands, he felt that he was indeed about to go into battle.

events.name: In the evening, he kindly helped his neighbor Uncle Wang, who had fallen in the stairwell.
events.description: A little after six in the evening, Lu Mingqiang returned to the Jinmao Middle Road residential area carrying books and his toolbox. As soon as he entered the building's stairwell, he found a figure huddled in the corner of the stairs. Taking a closer look, it was Uncle Wang (Wang Jianguo) from the next unit. He quickly put down his things, went over, crouched down, and asked: "Uncle Wang, what's wrong? Did you fall?" Uncle Wang frowned tightly and said that he had missed a step while coming down the stairs and twisted his ankle. He could not stand up on his own and was trying to rest for a moment. Lu Mingqiang immediately crouched down, put one hand under Uncle Wang's arm and the other supporting his waist, and carefully helped him up from the ground. He let Uncle Wang lean against him and first move his ankle against the wall. After confirming that Uncle Wang's foot could still move slightly and there were no signs of a fracture, he half-carried and half-supported Uncle Wang home. Uncle Wang lived on the second floor. Lu Mingqiang helped him up the stairs step by step, safely settled him on the sofa in the living room, and then went to the kitchen to pour him a cup of hot water.

events.name: Picked up a package for Uncle Wang and accepted the coconut cakes he gave in thanks
events.description: After getting Uncle Wang settled, Lu Mingqiang was about to take his leave when Uncle Wang suddenly remembered that he still had a package at the pickup point at the neighborhood entrance. He smiled bitterly and said he couldn't go get it himself now. Without a word, Lu Mingqiang asked Uncle Wang for the pickup code, and after going downstairs he didn't go home first but headed straight for the neighborhood entrance. He retrieved two parcels from the express locker and weighed them in his hand — they were quite heavy. When he delivered the packages to Uncle Wang's home, Uncle Wang had pulled himself together. He took two boxes of self-made, neatly pressed Hainan coconut cakes from the kitchen cabinet and insisted on giving them to Lu Mingqiang, saying his wife had made them in the morning and they were fresh, so he must try them. Lu Mingqiang declined a few times, but seeing Uncle Wang's insistence, he stopped being polite and accepted the heartfelt thank-you gift with both hands. He chatted with Uncle Wang about everyday things for a while, urged the old man to be careful going downstairs in the future, and then returned home with the books and coconut cakes. As soon as he entered, he put the coconut cakes on the table. The children curiously gathered around, and his wife Wang Lijuan tried a piece and praised it, saying it was much better than the ones sold outside. The kindness between neighbors made this ordinary evening especially warm.

2025-04.daily_overview: Today was a busy, fulfilling, and heartwarming day. In the morning, work hit a challenge: an old distribution cabinet developed an intermittent fault of unknown cause. Lu Mingqiang checked it repeatedly for two hours but still had no clue. Instead of forcing himself to continue, he decisively called his retired master, Master Li, for advice. Master Li came to the site without a word and, with his rich experience, quickly located and solved the problem. Afterwards, the master and apprentice went to Bo'ai South Road to drink Laoba tea. Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity to ask about exam experience, and his master patted him on the shoulder and gave him high recognition and encouragement, making him feel warm and confident. In the afternoon, payday arrived as usual; he received April wages and last month's overtime allowance totaling 4,200 yuan. Out of habit, he checked the amount on mobile banking, then recorded it in the family ledger and told his wife. After dinner, he used the evening to set up a clean and tidy study corner in the study, placed the textbooks and tools bought yesterday, and solemnly made a detailed review plan from today to before the intensive training.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6:05, Lu Mingqiang finished his core training: 3 sets of 20 superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 80-second planks (reaching 80 seconds for the first time).

events.name: Encountered a tricky fault in an old-fashioned distribution cabinet at work, asked my master for advice, and successfully solved it.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo were sent to an old machinery factory in Xiuying District to repair an old distribution cabinet that had been in service for more than twenty years. The fault was strange: sometimes it worked normally, and sometimes it tripped. Lu Mingqiang checked all the visible wires and components but found no problem, and was momentarily stuck. As time ticked by, sweat began to form on his forehead. He stepped aside, took out his phone, and called his master, Master Li. He roughly described the fault over the phone, and Master Li said, Wait there, I'm coming. Half an hour later, Master Li arrived on his old electric bike. He first walked around the cabinet, pressed his ear close to the door and listened, then asked Lu Mingqiang to cut the power. He opened the cabinet door himself, shone a flashlight, and pointed at a relay in an inconspicuous corner, saying, See this? The spring leaf on this relay has aged and doesn't make good contact. Sometimes it pulls in, sometimes it won't hold. That's why it looks fine when you check it, but it drops the ball under overload. And that was exactly it! After replacing the relay, the distribution cabinet immediately returned to normal. Lu Mingqiang watched his master's precise judgment and was full of admiration.

events.name: Had laoba tea with my master on Bo'ai South Road and received precious pre-exam encouragement.
events.description: After dealing with the fault, it was almost noon and raindrops began to fall. Lu Mingqiang insisted on treating his master to a meal, but Master Li waved his hand and said tea would be fine. The two braved the rain and went to a tea shop they often visited on Bo'ai South Road. There were few people in the shop. They ordered two pots of hot old man's tea, several plates of peanuts and turnip cake, and sat by the window. The raindrops pitter-pattered on the awning, creating a very good atmosphere for their conversation. Lu Mingqiang told his master that he was preparing to take the senior technician exam and sincerely asked for advice. Master Li put down his teacup and looked at him seriously, his eyes full of gratification. He said passing the technical part would be no problem for Lu Mingqiang, but the theory would be a big challenge. "Among the apprentices I have mentored, you are the most like me when I was young. You are not afraid of hardship or fatigue, and you understand techniques at the slightest hint. It is just that you have read too little. But it is not too late to catch up now!" The master patted him firmly on the shoulder, his tone determined. This affirmation and encouragement from his retired master made Lu Mingqiang feel warmer and more empowered than any praise, and his eyes even grew a little moist.

events.name: Received April wages and overtime allowance, totaling 4,200 yuan.
events.description: A little after two in the afternoon, the rain outside the window stopped and the sky gradually brightened. As soon as Lu Mingqiang returned to the company, his phone rang with a crisp text message notification. He tapped it open and saw a bank deposit reminder saying that the company had paid in his April basic salary and last month's overtime allowance, totaling 4,200 yuan. He opened the mobile banking app, checked the number repeatedly, and then looked at his previous balance. This incoming money was like timely rain for his family. The loan he had given to a fellow worker last month, the car insurance due this month, his son's shoe purchase, and the expense of the just-bought study materials had all made the family's cash flow very tight. The arrival of this payment, along with the sense of security it brought, immediately made him feel much more at ease.

events.name: Doing household bookkeeping and telling his wife they would plan finances together.
events.description: After getting off work and returning home, the first thing Lu Mingqiang did was to take out the somewhat worn family ledger from the living room drawer. This dark-blue notebook recorded every income and expense in dense handwriting. He opened the newest page and wrote neatly in the income column: 'April 10, wages + allowance, 4,200 yuan,' and noted the source in the remarks. Then he waved over his wife Wang Lijuan, who was hanging clothes on the balcony, and showed her the ledger along with the mobile banking notification of the incoming transfer. Wang Lijuan looked at it and a slight smile appeared on her face. After calculating, she said happily, 'This money is just right. After setting aside the money for the car insurance, annual inspection, and Zixuan's running shoes, we can still have a few hundred yuan left over this month.' The couple discussed the ledger for a short while and planned the upcoming essential expenses. That tacit understanding and trust in bearing family finances together made them feel once again that they were each other's most reliable comrades.

events.name: Tidied up the study area in the study room and made a review plan for exam preparation.
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang began tidying up his study. He cleared out a corner of the desk that was usually piled with miscellaneous items, put the clutter into boxes, and wiped the desktop clean with a rag. Then he took out the textbooks and exercise books he had bought yesterday one by one and neatly stacked them on the left side of the desk; on the right he placed a newly purchased tool bag and a desk lamp. He sat down and felt the focused atmosphere of the new "study area." Next, he opened a new notebook and began making a plan for his review. Working backward from the start date of the intensive training, he designated the three days from now until the class began as the "preview period," focusing on the basic theory in the first two chapters of the textbook. He set a small goal: to spend at least one and a half hours studying every evening, with a 10-minute break in between. He pasted the plan squarely on the wall in front of the desk so that he could see it every time he looked up, as a reminder and motivation for himself. After everything was arranged, he felt like an engine that was fully charged and ready to start running.

events.name: Simple evening stretching
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang did a set of Cat-Cow and Child's Pose learned from yoga class, holding each posture for 30 seconds to relax his lower back.

2025-04.daily_overview: Today was a day to be proud of and celebrate his son. Lu Mingqiang took a day off from the company and went specially to the Haikou Primary School Track and Field Games to cheer on his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, who was competing in the 400-meter race. Early in the morning, he still completed his core training. When he saw his son running hard on the track and finally standing on the podium in third place, he was so excited that he had clapped until his palms were red. This small achievement immersed the whole family in great joy. After the competition, he took his wife and two children to a nice restaurant for a celebration dinner, and the table was filled with laughter and cheerful conversation. To reward his son's efforts, he also went to a sporting goods store and bought Lu Zixuan a pair of professional running shoes and a set of sportswear at his own expense, spending 400 yuan in total. This extra expenditure caused a slight fluctuation in the family budget, but after returning home in the evening, his wife Wang Lijuan volunteered to reduce her clothing shopping this month, and Lu Mingqiang also decided to cut his wine bottle purchase budget next month. This tacit understanding, which needed no words, made their relationship stronger.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: Even though he took the day off, Lu Mingqiang still got up at 6:30 to complete core training: superman exercises 3 sets × 20, glute bridges 3 sets × 25, and planks 3 sets × 80 seconds.

events.name: Took leave to go to the city primary school track and field meet to cheer on his eldest son.
events.description: Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove to the Haikou Sports Center with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and younger son Lu Zihan. Lu Zixuan was going to compete in the 400-meter race at the city primary school track and field meet that day; it was his first time participating in such a big municipal event, and he was both nervous and excited. Lu Mingqiang had specially taken a day of personal leave from the company and put on a clean polo shirt; the whole family was Lu Zixuan's cheering squad. Before the race, he knelt on one knee to help his son tie his shoelaces tight and said in a tone that only father and son understood: Relax and run, just like when you run with me on weekends. Treat it as a normal training run. When you finish, Dad will take you out for something good. Lu Zixuan nodded hard and went off to warm up seriously. The moment the starting gun sounded, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan squeezed together in the stands, and he felt more nervous than his son.

events.name: Eldest son Lu Zixuan took third place in the 400-meter race.
events.description: The competition was held in groups. When Lu Zixuan's group was called, the sun was shining brightly. Eight children crouched at the starting line; Lu Zixuan was in lane three. As soon as the gun went off, he shot out like an arrow from a bow. At the first curve, he was still in the middle of the pack; on the straightaway, he began to accelerate; by the second curve, he had left several opponents behind and was closely chasing the two leaders. The final 100 meters was a test of will and physical endurance. Lu Zixuan's little face flushed red, and he swung his arms with all his might, trying to close the gap with the two runners ahead. In the stands, Lu Mingqiang completely forgot about his image, waving his fists and shouting, "Go Zixuan! Go!" while Wang Lijuan nervously covered her mouth. In the end, Lu Zixuan crossed the finish line third, with a time of 1 minute 12 seconds. He won third place! When the announcer read the results, Lu Zixuan waved excitedly to the stands. Lu Mingqiang, deeply moved, used his phone to capture the moment his son stepped onto the podium and received the bronze medal, his eyes squinting into slits from smiling.

events.name: The whole family went out for a celebration meal, and the parent-child bond grew warmer through laughter.
events.description: After the competition, it was already past 1 p.m. when the family left the stadium. Lu Mingqiang kept his promise and drove to a barbecue buffet restaurant his son had always wanted to try. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere, and many families were dining there. His younger son Lu Zihan was especially interested in the ice cream machine and dragged his mother over to get him some ice cream. Lu Mingqiang sat with his eldest son, helping him grill meat while listening to the boy excitedly retell every detail of the game. Lu Zixuan said that when he was most tired, he remembered what his father had said when he took him running in Evergreen Park: "Perseverance is victory." Lu Mingqiang patted his head with gratification. Although it was only third place, in his eyes this fighting spirit was the most precious gold medal. The whole family's plates were piled high, and amid the laughter and cheerful talk, all the stress accumulated from work and life seemed to vanish into thin air.

events.name: Bought sports equipment worth 400 yuan for his son at his own expense.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang noticed that the sneakers on Lu Zixuan's feet were already a little old and the soles were nearly worn out. Thinking of the talent and enthusiasm his son had shown in the competition, he didn't hesitate and drove the whole family to a nearby sporting goods discount store. In the store, Lu Zixuan picked a pair of professional lightweight running shoes with very springy soles, and also chose a breathable tracksuit. His father took the gear to the cashier and paid; the total was exactly 400 yuan, which was a considerable expense for Lu Mingqiang. But seeing how carefully his son wore the new shoes and the joy on his face, he felt the money was well spent. It was the most direct support he could give as a father to the sport his son loved.

events.name: After returning home, he and his wife had a tacit discussion about a plan to deal with the temporary expense.
events.description: In the evening, after returning home, the children, who had been excited all day, soon fell asleep. Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan sat in the living room and began to go over the day's expenses. The 400 yuan sports gear purchase, plus the cost of dining out, clearly exceeded this month's budget. Lu Mingqiang felt a bit apologetic, but before he could explain, Wang Lijuan spoke first: 'I've been wanting to buy a decent pair of running shoes for the kids for a while—you bought well. I was planning to buy a dress online this month, but I won't now; that can make up the difference.' Lu Mingqiang waved his hand: 'You can't always be the one to save. I was thinking of collecting a nice liquor bottle next month, but I won't now—that saves a bit too.' The two smiled at each other. Without any back-and-forth, a solution was reached so easily. This long-term marital tacit understanding of quickly reaching consensus in unexpected situations was something they had developed through countless storms together, and it was incredibly precious.

2025-04.daily_overview: Saturday was Lu Mingqiang's hobby day and also a new starting point for skill improvement. In the morning, he rested at home. After completing core training, he listened to a previously downloaded radio program about the historical development of a local Hainan distillery on his phone. He found it very interesting and immediately thought of some old liquor bottles in his collection, so he searched online for more relevant information and carefully enriched his bottle collection notes (electronic version). In the afternoon, he had the weekly internal squash club mini-tournament. He won match after match, but because his opponent firmly targeted his backhand weakness, he unfortunately stopped in the quarterfinals. However, this loss did not discourage him; instead, it ignited his fighting spirit. After the match, he formally asked his squash partner Lin Feng to systematically coach his backhand technique. Lin Feng readily agreed, immediately designed a set of split training drills for him, and also shared a lot of knowledge on sports injury prevention. In the evening, he made a reservation call to the vehicle inspection station to prepare for the next day's annual vehicle inspection.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 7 a.m., after getting up, Lu Mingqiang completed his core training: superman exercise 3 sets × 20, glute bridges 3 sets × 25, and planks 3 sets × 80 seconds.

events.name: Listened to a program about the development history of a local Hainan distillery and did further research online.
events.description: A little after 10 in the morning, the children were watching cartoons in the living room. Lu Mingqiang, wearing earphones, was half-lying in the chair in his study, listening to a program called "The Rise and Fall of Hainan Distilleries" produced by a local radio station on the Ximalaya app. The program detailed the rise and fall of several old state-owned distilleries such as Haikou Distillery and Qiongshan Distillery in the 1980s, and particularly mentioned the past and present of several out-of-print liquor bottles in his collection. After the program ended, still wanting more, he immediately opened his mobile browser and searched for the packaging evolution history of old brands such as "Haikou Daqu" and "Yedao Deer Turtle Wine" mentioned in the program. On a liquor bottle collecting forum, he found a post that summarized product bottle design images from various periods. He was overjoyed and immediately took screenshots and saved them.

events.name: Enriched the electronic version of the liquor bottle collection notes, turning it into online cultural research.
events.description: After browsing a large number of images and articles, Lu Mingqiang created a new folder on his computer and sorted all the pictures and materials he had found that day into categories. In an article about Haikou Daqu, he discovered that a blue-and-white porcelain-style wine bottle in his collection was actually a commemorative edition specially produced in the 1990s to celebrate the establishment of Hainan Province, which excited him greatly. He recorded this new finding, supplementing the cultural background of this collectible. This way of replacing physical collecting with online research and material organization satisfied his inner needs without violating his commitment to study.

events.name: Participated in a small internal squash club competition and was eliminated in the quarterfinals due to technical weaknesses.
events.description: At 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived on time at his usual squash club. Today was the elimination round of the club's internal mini tournament, and the atmosphere was a bit more tense than during usual practice. His first three matches went fairly smoothly, and he won them with his steady forehand and abundant stamina. But in the quarterfinal match, he met an old rival with a comparable record. The opponent had clearly studied his strengths and weaknesses, deliberately sending every ball to his backhand throughout the match, with low and tricky shots. Lu Mingqiang found it very difficult to handle with his backhand; he often could only barely return the ball to midcourt, and then the opponent would smash it for a point. He tried adjusting his footwork and stepping around early to use his forehand, but the pace on the squash court was too fast, and the results were not ideal. In the end, he lost two straight games and stopped in the quarterfinals. After coming off the court, he wiped his sweat and gasped for breath, feeling very frustrated about his backhand weakness. But a loss was a loss; he admitted he had no one to blame for this setback.

events.name: After the match, he officially hired Lin Feng as his mentor and formulated a specialized backhand training plan.
events.description: After the match, Lu Mingqiang sat thoughtfully by the court for a while, then walked straight to Lin Feng, who was watching from the sideline. He told Lin Feng how he felt about the match and said very sincerely, "Lin Feng, my backhand really isn't good enough. I can't fix it just by practicing blindly on my own. You're a professional—could you spare some time to coach me?" Lin Feng smiled, patted him on the shoulder, and agreed without hesitation. The two found an open court. Lin Feng had him do a few basic backhand swing motions, then recorded them with his phone and played them back for him, pointing out problems such as not rotating his body enough and hitting the ball too far from his body. Then Lin Feng designed a "three-step" breakdown training plan on the spot and agreed to add an extra half hour of practice after their weekly Wednesday squash session specifically to polish his backhand. As a professional fitness trainer, Lin Feng also reminded him of the potential risk of injury from overusing his wrist, and taught him a few exercises to strengthen his wrist and forearm muscles. Lu Mingqiang took out his phone and carefully noted down the key points, feeling more confident about improving his technique than ever before.

events.name: Call the vehicle inspection station to schedule an appointment for the annual inspection service.
events.description: Back home in the evening, Lu Mingqiang remembered that his car's annual inspection was coming due. He took out the vehicle registration certificate and saw that it expired this month. He immediately called a vehicle inspection station near his home and asked whether an inspection could be done on Saturday. The staff told him that tomorrow, Sunday, inspections were only available in the morning and required an advance appointment. So he completed the appointment process over the phone and booked a time slot for 10 a.m. the next morning. The staff reminded him to bring the vehicle registration certificate, compulsory traffic accident liability insurance policy, and the owner's ID card, and to make sure the tires, lights, and other conditions of the vehicle were normal. After hanging up, he set a reminder in his phone calendar, then deliberately went downstairs to check his car to make sure everything was in order before going upstairs to rest.

events.name: Bedtime stretching routine.
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang did cat-cow and child's pose stretches for 3 minutes each to relieve the muscle tension from the competition.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road.

2025-04.daily_overview: Today is the second Sunday of April. Lu Mingqiang efficiently handled several important family matters and also enjoyed precious quality time with his children. The morning schedule was tight and smooth. He drove alone to the reserved vehicle inspection station and completed the annual inspection of his car. All indicators were up to standard. He successfully received the new inspection sticker and renewed the next year's insurance through a mobile app. On the way back, he stopped at a gas station to check and top up the tire pressure. In the afternoon, there was a brief shower, but it soon cleared up. The air was fresh after the rain. He took out his improved traditional swallow kite, brought his wife and two sons, and drove to Wanlv Garden. On the breezy lawn, he taught his eldest son how to judge wind direction and adjust the bridle line. Watching the kite fly steadily in the blue sky and listening to the children's laughter echoing around him, he sat beside his wife, briefly letting go of all his worries about work and study. After returning home in the evening, he realized that the intensive training would start the next day, so he deliberately went to the supermarket to buy a foot-soaking bucket and sleep-aid essential oil to prepare for adjusting his routine.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At seven in the morning, Lu Mingqiang completed core training: 3 sets of 20 Superman exercises, 3 sets of 25 glute bridges, and 3 sets of 80-second planks.

events.name: Drove alone to the inspection station to complete the annual vehicle inspection
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang took his prepared documents and drove alone to the vehicle inspection station in Xiuying District. Although it was Sunday, the process went quickly because he had booked an appointment. He drove the car onto the inspection line, and under the guidance of the staff, the vehicle underwent strict checks one by one, including exhaust emissions, braking system, light intensity, and chassis. He waited patiently outside the yellow line. About half an hour later, the inspection was fully completed, and the staff told him all items had passed. He felt relieved. He paid the 300 yuan inspection fee in the service hall and successfully received the new vehicle annual inspection qualification label.

events.name: Renew the next year’s compulsory traffic accident liability insurance and third-party liability insurance.
events.description: After the annual inspection, Lu Mingqiang got into his car but didn't drive away right away. He checked the date on the insurance sticker on the windshield; it was almost due. So he decided to strike while the iron was hot and opened the insurance company's app on his phone. After carefully reviewing the terms, he chose the standard renewal plan with compulsory traffic insurance and 500,000 yuan of third-party liability coverage. The system showed a total cost of 1,850 yuan. After the payment went through, the electronic policy was quickly sent to his email and in-app inbox. Out of habit, he saved the policy PDF to his phone's album and also uploaded a copy to his phone's cloud drive for backup. Once that was done, he took out the brand-new inspection qualification sticker he had just received from the inspection station, and carefully stuck it on the upper right corner of the windshield next to the old one. Seeing the neatly aligned stickers, he felt a wave of relief. Finally, he set a recurring annual inspection reminder on his phone calendar for April 13, 2026, to prevent forgetting in the future.

events.name: On the way back, check the tire pressure and top it up if needed, and check the tools in the vehicle.
events.description: On the way home from the inspection station, Lu Mingqiang turned into a gas station along the way. He parked the car and took out the portable tire pressure gauge and air pump he carried in the trunk (it was a professional habit—having tools with him put his mind at ease). After checking the tire pressure of all four wheels one by one, he found that the other three were normal, but the right rear tire was low, at only 1.9 bar, below the standard 2.3 bar. He connected the air pump and, with a slight hum, brought the tire pressure up to the standard value. After inflating, he remembered that the traffic broadcast he had heard on the road was reminding drivers that summer is a peak season for tire blowouts, so he took extra care and carefully checked the spare tire, jack, and warning triangle in the trunk, confirming that they were all there and fully functional. At the time he felt this careful act was just a routine check, and had no idea it would come in handy later.

events.name: After the afternoon rain, took the family to Wanlv Garden to fly kites and enjoy quality family time.
events.description: A little after 2 p.m., after a brief sun shower, the sky quickly cleared, the air became exceptionally fresh, and a faint rainbow appeared. With weather this good, how could anyone stay at home? Lu Mingqiang took out his traditional sand-swallow kite, which he had modified many times. The kite's frame was made of bamboo strips he had whittled himself, and the wings had been painted by his son. He asked his wife Wang Lijuan to bring water and snacks, and the family of four drove to Wanlv Garden in high spirits. After the rain, Wanlv Garden's lawn gleamed green and the breeze was pleasant — perfect weather for kite flying. Lu Mingqiang first got the kite into the air, then showed his eldest son Lu Zixuan step by step how to let out the line bit by bit and how to feel the wind's strength through the line. "See, when the wind is strong, pull in a little; when it's weak, run two steps against it." Lu Zixuan quickly got the hang of it and excitedly took over the reel, watching the kite fly steadily in the blue sky with a huge sense of achievement. The younger son chased butterflies on the lawn, and his wife sat on a picnic mat, smiling at the scene. Lu Mingqiang sat down beside his wife, enjoying this rare moment of leisure; the upcoming two weeks of intense training seemed to drift far beyond the clouds for the moment.

events.name: Bought a foot soaking bucket and sleep aids to adjust his daily routine.
events.description: In the evening, after returning home from Wanlv Garden, everyone still felt they hadn't had enough. After dinner, Lu Mingqiang remembered that starting next Monday he would be entering intensive training, staying up late every night to study, and that the high level of mental excitement would definitely affect his sleep. To plan ahead, he went downstairs alone to the supermarket outside the community and bought a deep foot-soaking bucket, then bought a small bottle of lavender essential oil from the pharmacy next door. Back home, he also used his phone to buy an album of light relaxing music. He placed these 'new tools' in the bathroom and decided that starting tomorrow, on the night before the intensive training, he would soak his feet and listen to soft music to help himself relax and fall asleep. This gesture marked the beginning of his attempt to manage his energy and physical condition more proactively.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road.
