2025-04.daily_overview: Today was the first day of a major shift in Lu Mingqiang's daily routine. The preparatory tutoring class for the senior technician certification officially began. It was a systematic training program recommended by the company, designed to help key technical staff sort out the exam syllabus in advance and strengthen weak areas. He got up at 6:05 in the morning and completed the full set of core exercises in one go (superman stretch, glute bridge, plank), then spent 5 minutes tending to the vegetables on the balcony. During the day, he worked normally at the company, handling the daily maintenance work orders. During the lunch break, he insisted on a brisk 30-minute walk for the last time (because starting tomorrow, the intensive training would interrupt the lunchtime brisk walk). In the afternoon, he consciously reduced the amount of strong tea he drank and switched to warm milk to adjust his body for the evening class ahead. After work, instead of going straight home as usual, he had a quick dinner at the company cafeteria, then headed to Haikou Electric School with his books. From 7:00 to 9:30, he concentrated on studying theoretical knowledge in the classroom for two and a half hours, covering advanced modules such as power system analysis and automation control, which made him feel both challenged and excited. After class, he got home at nearly 10:30. His wife and children had already gone to bed, and on the table was a glass of warm milk his wife had prepared for him, along with a note that read "Keep going". Following the plan he had started last night, he soaked his feet for 15 minutes in the new foot bath bucket he had bought, listened to some light music to relax his tense nerves, and finally went to bed at nearly 11:30.

events.name: In the early morning, completed core training in one go and tended to the balcony vegetables.
events.description: At 6:05, Lu Mingqiang completed a full set of core training in the living room all at once: superman exercise 3 sets x 20, glute bridges 3 sets x 25, and planks 3 sets of 80 seconds. Then he went to the balcony to water and loosen the soil for the lettuce and tomatoes and observed their growth. The lettuce was ready to pick, and he planned to have his wife pick some tomorrow to make a salad.

events.name: Last brisk walk during lunch break (before intensive training).
events.description: At noon, Lu Mingqiang took a 30-minute brisk walk around the construction site. Knowing this might be the last lunch-break brisk walk during the intensive training, he deliberately walked a bit faster, at a pace of about 9 minutes per kilometer.

events.name: Begin reducing caffeine intake and implement the sleep improvement plan
events.description: After work started in the morning, during a break Lu Mingqiang watched his coworkers brewing tea, but he held back. He took out a large bottle of plain water and a carton of warm milk he had deliberately bought at the supermarket that morning, and mixed them to drink. In the afternoon, when drowsiness hit, he instinctively wanted to brew a strong cup of tea. His hand had even reached the tea canister, but remembering the misery of insomnia the night before, he forced himself to put it back and instead went to the water dispenser to pour a cup of warm water. His coworker Chen Jianguo saw him not drinking tea and asked in surprise what was wrong. He said he had class in the evening and wouldn't be able to sleep if he drank tea. This was a small change he proactively made based on his physical sensations. Although it felt a bit awkward at first, he told himself it was worth it to ensure his energy for the evening and the next day.

events.name: Left work on time and hurried to Haikou Electrical School for the first lesson of the exam preparation tutoring class.
events.description: As soon as 5:30 p.m. arrived, Lu Mingqiang packed up his tools neatly, said goodbye to Team Leader Zhang, and became the first person in the team to leave. After eating dinner at a nearby fast-food restaurant, he carried his schoolbag containing textbooks and notebooks and rode his electric bike to Haikou Electric Power School. The training building was brightly lit, and the participants in the intensive training were all technical backbone from various companies, around their thirties or forties. At the start, the teacher explained the training framework: the course would last two weeks, covering the core modules of theory and practice, but the more in-depth content would require everyone to review independently after returning, in order to prepare long-term for the formal exam at the end of the year. The two-and-a-half-hour class was very intense. The instructor was a retired senior engineer, and he taught the mathematical model of steady-state analysis of power systems, with many formulas and abstract concepts. Lu Mingqiang had a weak foundation in middle school mathematics and found it somewhat difficult to follow, but he did not let his attention wander. He tried hard to take notes using simple metaphors and stick-figure drawings he could understand, and put a big question mark next to anything he did not understand, planning to ask the teacher after class. At the end of the class, the teacher gave a mock quiz. Lu Mingqiang did well in the practical part, but he still got several questions wrong in the theory part, which made him realize that theory was a tough nut to crack. But he also understood that now was the right time to tackle it; cramming right before the exam would be too late.

events.name: After class, I went home and, in the quiet of the night, relaxed by soaking my feet and listening to music alone.
events.description: At nearly ten o'clock, Lu Mingqiang gently opened the door, exhausted. The house was silent, with only a small lamp still on in the living room. On the dining table sat a glass of milk that had gone cold and a note in his wife's elegant handwriting: 'Remember to warm the milk before drinking. Keep it up!' He smiled, and his heart felt warm. He finished washing up quietly, then took out the newly bought foot-soaking bucket, poured in hot water, added a few drops of lavender essential oil, and soaked his sore, swollen feet. The heat of the water spread from the soles of his feet throughout his body, and his tense nerves gradually relaxed. He put on his earphones and played the light music he had downloaded the night before. The melodious piano sound shut out outside distractions. In this atmosphere, the abstract formulas and tongue-twisting terms from class gradually settled in his mind and were no longer a jumble. He was no longer the worker sweating on the construction site during the day, nor the student writing furiously at the desk just now; he was just a middle-aged man in need of rest. Fifteen minutes later, he dried his feet, walked quietly into the bedroom, and fell into a deep sleep amid the steady breathing of his wife and children.

end_state.location: Bedroom at home, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road.
end_state.mood: Extreme exhaustion after intense mental excitement, yet feeling fulfilled inside from gaining new knowledge.

2025-04.daily_overview: Today was the second day of the intensive training, and Lu Mingqiang's life continued to accelerate on the high-intensity track of work and study. He got up at 6:10 in the morning and completed the full set of core exercises in one go (superman, glute bridges, planks), and took care of the balcony vegetables, picking the first batch of ripe lettuce. In the morning, during the break before lunch, he noticed the sky had turned cloudy and the air humidity had increased, and immediately thought of his mother's knee affected by rheumatism. He went to the changing room to get his phone, made a WeChat call to his mother, and patiently urged her to apply heat and take her medication promptly, and taught her the simple joint stretching movements he had learned from yoga class and from Lin Feng. His mother's happy laughter on the other end of the line warmed his heart. Meanwhile, his wife's reminder a few days ago that he looked unwell had made him take notice. Today, before leaving the company after work, he deliberately went to the supermarket and personally bought high-quality protein foods such as chicken breast, eggs, broccoli, and milk, officially starting his "nutritional supplement plan" to store up energy for the upcoming intensive exam preparation and physical work. In the evening, a thunderstorm suddenly hit Haikou, but he did not back down. He put on his raincoat and continued riding to the electrical school. In class, he fought against the fatigue brought on by the day's physical labor, focusing his attention on the complex practical operation flowcharts. After class, he rode home through the light rain, washed up quickly, did a few yoga stretching poses (cat-cow pose, child's pose), then soaked his feet to help himself sleep, and fell asleep at 23:45.

events.name: In the early morning, completed core training in one go and tended to the balcony vegetables.
events.description: At 6:10, Lu Mingqiang completed the full set of core training in the living room in one go: Superman exercise 3 sets × 20, glute bridge 3 sets × 25, plank 3 sets × 80 seconds. Then he went to the balcony, picked the ripe lettuce, and handed it to his wife to make a breakfast salad. He also watered all the vegetables as he went. The tomato seedlings had grown a bit taller.

events.name: Before the lunch break, call Mother to ask about her old rheumatic condition and teach her some stretching methods.
events.description: After 11 a.m., Lu Mingqiang was drinking water in the rest room when he noticed the sky outside growing darker and the air becoming muggy and humid. It suddenly occurred to him that this kind of weather was most likely to trigger his mother's rheumatic joint pain. He immediately picked up his phone, went to a quiet place, and called his mother. When the call connected, his mother Chen Xiuying sounded pleasantly surprised. Lu Mingqiang first asked with concern whether her knees hurt today and whether she had applied the medicated patch on time. His mother said with a laugh that they didn't hurt, but felt a little tight. Lu Mingqiang immediately thought of the yoga class and the stretching principles Lin Feng had explained to him later, so he guided his mother over the phone: "Mom, I've learned a few new tricks. Put a hot towel on your knees, rub on some of that warming oil, and then slowly stretch your fingers and wrists like this. That can relieve the stiffness..." As he spoke, he demonstrated with his own movements. Afraid his mother wouldn't understand, he later sent her a few simple stretching diagrams via WeChat. This care, born from his own learning experience, made his mother particularly surprised and happy, and she repeatedly praised her son for knowing more and more now.

events.name: After work, heading to the supermarket to buy healthy ingredients and start the nutrition improvement plan.
events.description: The physical toll of the intensive training was far greater than he had imagined, and combined with the heavy manual labor during the day, after two straight days Lu Mingqiang felt his body could barely keep up. He remembered his wife saying a few days earlier that he looked "worn out," and decided to start with his diet. After knocking off work in the afternoon, instead of grabbing fast food like yesterday, he rode his e-bike to a large supermarket near home. He pushed a shopping cart through the fresh food section and carefully picked out items. He bought a box of fresh chicken breast, two trays of free-range eggs, and two cartons of pure milk; then in the vegetable section he grabbed two fresh heads of broccoli and a few tomatoes. He planned to have his wife add two extra eggs to breakfast, use the chicken breast from the night before to stir-fry with broccoli for a lunchbox, and drink milk in the morning and evening as a nutritional supplement. It was the first time he had shopped so purposefully to "replenish his energy and improve his mental state." Carrying the fully packed shopping bags out of the supermarket, he felt like a soldier about to set off, tending to his armor and dry rations.

events.name: Rushed to the electrical school in the rain to attend the second day of the intensive training course.
events.description: In the early evening, a sudden thundershower hit Haikou. The rain was so heavy that it rattled against the roof. Looking at the pouring rain outside the window, his wife urged him sympathetically to take the night off. Lu Mingqiang shook his head and said that every class in the intensive training course was crucial; missing one lesson might be impossible to make up. He put on a thick raincoat, carefully wrapped his books in several layers of plastic bags to keep them from getting wet, put on his helmet, and rode into the curtain of rain. When he arrived at the classroom, his trousers and shoes were soaked, but his backpack and the books inside were dry. That evening's lesson covered the process analysis for the practical assessment and PLC control technology; the teacher explained step by step with drawings, and it was very important. Lu Mingqiang did not have time to dry his hair; he took out his notebook and threw himself into the intense lecture. During the break, he exchanged wry smiles with several other trainees who were also soaked. The feeling of going all out for a shared goal reminded him of his drive as an apprentice.

events.name: Simple stretching and foot soaking before bed.
events.description: It was almost 10:30 p.m. when he got home from class. Lu Mingqiang washed up quickly. Because he had to get up early the next day, he only did two minutes each of Cat-Cow and Child's Pose stretching beside the bed, then soaked his feet for 10 minutes with lavender essential oil and listened to some light music. After relaxing, he got into bed immediately and soon fell asleep.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the third day of intensive training, Lu Mingqiang was constantly busy between work and training. In the early morning he stuck to core training; during work he used his lunch break to listen to audio programs to decompress; in the evening he first attended special squash backhand training, then rushed to the electrical school for intensive training until late at night. Though extremely tired, he felt a sense of fulfillment from systematic reinforcement.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6 a.m. sharp, Lu Mingqiang laid out a yoga mat in the living room and, as planned, completed 3 sets of superman exercises (20 reps each), 3 sets of glute bridges (25 reps each), and 3 sets of planks (75 seconds each), taking about 25 minutes. Since the intensive training took up his evenings, he moved the workout to early morning and finished it in one session.

events.name: Listened to an audio program during lunch break to relieve stress.
events.description: At noon in the rest shed on the construction site, Lu Mingqiang opened the Ximalaya app and continued listening to the Industrial Memory series about frontline electricians in the 1970s. He was drawn by the protagonist's experience of overcoming technical difficulties, and thinking of his own preparation for the senior technician exam, he felt much of his mental exhaustion fade away.

events.name: Squash backhand intensive training
events.description: After work, instead of going straight home, Lu Mingqiang hurried to the squash court at Dynamic Fitness Club. Lin Feng had been waiting for a while. The two did targeted feeding and footwork adjustment drills for the backhand position. Lin Feng pointed out that his contact point was too low and demonstrated a more efficient way to generate power through body rotation. The intensive one-hour training left Lu Mingqiang drenched in sweat, but it also temporarily made him forget the fatigue of work.

events.name: In the evening, rushed to the electrical school to participate in intensive training.
events.description: After squash training, Lu Mingqiang bought two steamed buns from a street-side stall to fill his stomach, then immediately drove to Haikou Electric School. The 18:30 to 21:30 course covered transformer parallel operation conditions and hands-on wiring practice. He listened and took notes as he went, raising his hand to ask questions whenever he hit a difficult point. After class, he also asked the teacher to clarify a few doubts until the teaching building was about to lock up before leaving.

start_state.mood: Drowsy but mentally tense, knowing that today would be another tough battle.

end_state.mood: Extremely tired, physically and mentally drained, but I feel grounded because I completed my training and studies.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the fourth day of intensive training, Lu Mingqiang gradually adapted to the high-intensity pace, but the accumulated fatigue was still obvious. The support of his wife Wang Lijuan was his strongest backing. A bowl of Qingbuliang late at night warmed his stomach and, even more, his heart.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: Woke up at 6:05. As usual, Lu Mingqiang did his three core exercises in the living room. Today the last 10 seconds of the plank were a bit tough, but he gritted his teeth and held on, knowing that his physical fitness was being put to the test during this period.

events.name: Continue attending the intensive training class after work
events.description: After finishing a full day of electrical equipment maintenance work, Lu Mingqiang changed out of his work uniform and rode his electric bike to the electrical school. Tonight's course focused on cable head manufacturing techniques and insulation testing standards. After the teacher demonstrated, he operated the process himself. He messed up one piece of material, then under the master's guidance reworked it to pass. He deeply realized the truth that practice leads to true knowledge.

events.name: Returned home late at night and his wife had prepared a midnight snack
events.description: At 9:30 p.m., he returned home in Longhua District. His wife, Wang Lijuan, brought him a bowl of warm qingbuliang from the kitchen, saying that she had specially cooked it because he had been suffering from internal heat lately. Lu Mingqiang's eyes welled up. While eating, he briefly told his wife about the day's study, and she urged him not to push himself too hard and to rest early.

This pleasant surprise eased the tension of exam preparation. In the evening, the relay protection topic reminded him again of his knowledge gaps, but also made the final sprint direction clearer.

events.name: Early morning core workout.

events.name: After work, checked the growth of the lettuce on the balcony
events.description: It was already 6 p.m. when he got home. Lu Mingqiang didn't even bother changing his shoes; he first went to the balcony to look at the lettuce in the styrofoam box. After nearly a month of care, the first crop had leaves that were fully spread out and bright green, and it had reached maturity. He gently pinched a leaf with his fingers and called out contentedly to his wife in the kitchen — the lettuce can be picked, tomorrow we'll eat it fresh! — She smiled and told him to hurry up and take a shower and have dinner, so he wouldn't be late for class.

events.name: In the evening, rushed to the electrical school to participate in intensive training.
events.description: After finishing the Hainanese chicken rice prepared by his wife, Lu Mingqiang took his notebook and drove to Haikou Electric Power School. There was a traffic jam near Nanda Bridge today and he was almost late. The evening course was a special topic on relay protection principles, with an introduction to new smart grid technologies interspersed. He found this area of knowledge relatively weak, so he listened attentively in class and filled five full pages of notes. He decided to take time over the weekend to digest it again.

end_state.mood: Tired but looking forward to weekend family time.

2025-04.daily_overview: The intensive training class had a rare day off, so Lu Mingqiang devoted the entire day to his family. In the morning, he helped with homework; in the afternoon, he and his son harvested vegetables and brought fresh lettuce to his parents to taste. The family's lettuce dinner became the warmest moment of stress relief during high-pressure exam preparation.

events.name: Early morning core workout and stretching.
events.description: Although it was a day off, Lu Mingqiang still got up at 7 a.m. He first completed core training, then did a few yoga stretching moves, and felt much lighter.

events.name: In the study, tutored the eldest son as he reviewed his schoolwork.
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang went to the study to help his eldest son Lu Zixuan review the week's Chinese and math. He patiently explained the problems and found that his son was not yet fluent in the multiplication tables, so he made up a few word problems using examples of parts from his own repair work. Zixuan quickly understood, and the father and son took turns asking and answering questions in a relaxed atmosphere.

events.name: Took his eldest son to pick mature lettuce and explained plant growth.
events.description: After the afternoon nap, Lu Mingqiang called Zixuan to the balcony, gave his son a pair of small scissors, and taught him how to harvest lettuce from the outer leaves without damaging the roots. He pointed at the roots, stems, and leaves and explained the roles of sunlight and watering. Zixuan listened with great interest and asked whether they could plant water spinach, his favorite vegetable. Lu Mingqiang promised to plant it together with him next sowing season.

events.name: Bring lettuce to visit parents
events.description: After picking a basket of lettuce, Lu Mingqiang decided to take some to his parents, who live in Meilan District, while it was still fresh. He drove there with Lu Zixuan. His father, Lu Jianguo, was playing chess in the residential compound and was very happy to see his grandson. His mother, Chen Xiuying, took the lettuce and praised how well it had grown, then bustled about trying to keep them for dinner. Lu Mingqiang said they had already prepared dinner at home. After chatting for half an hour, they took their leave. As they were leaving, his mother insisted on giving him a box of her homemade Hainan rice noodles.

events.name: Washed lettuce with his wife and prepared dinner.
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan trimmed and rinsed vegetables together in the kitchen. Wang Lijuan suggested mixing lettuce with minced garlic and oyster sauce, stewing a pork rib soup, and pan-frying the fish to make a hearty dinner. Lu Mingqiang nodded in agreement, rolled up his sleeves, and helped smash garlic and mix the sauce.

events.name: The whole family shared a lettuce dinner
events.description: At 6:30 in the evening, the dining table was full of dishes. The homegrown lettuce was crisp and slightly sweet, and the two sons were vying for it. Lu Mingqiang watched, feeling satisfied. His wife smiled and said, “This is even fresher than what you buy at the market. From now on, our family doesn't need to buy leafy vegetables.” The younger son said innocently that he would water them again tomorrow, making everyone laugh.

events.name: Family chat after dinner.
events.description: After dinner, the whole family sat in the living room. Lu Zixuan curiously asked how plants grow from seeds. Lu Mingqiang searched for a popular science animation about seed germination on his phone, and used the opportunity to tell his son that besides sunlight, water, and soil, one also needs patience. Wang Lijuan also talked about interesting stories of growing vegetables in their hometown. The family of four chatted and laughed until almost nine o'clock. During the tense days of exam preparation, such a relaxed evening was especially precious.

events.name: Take photos to record the first harvest and plan future planting
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang took a few photos of the plate of green lettuce, sent them to the family WeChat group, and also logged them in his phone memo, noting the harvest date, texture, and suggested seasonings. He planned to buy seeds next week to grow water spinach and amaranth, and keep tending the balcony vegetable garden.

start_state.mood: Since he could rest for a day, he felt relaxed in body and mind.

end_state.mood: Content and happy, deeply feeling that family is his recharging station.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core training and stretching, light activities such as picking and housework

2025-04.daily_overview: After an intense squash training session on Sunday morning, he went home and reviewed; in the afternoon he continued intensive training; in the evening he completed the annual individual income tax reconciliation. Lu Mingqiang noticed obvious improvement in his squash backhand, and the intensive training knowledge was gradually being absorbed; the unexpected tax refund made the whole family happy.

events.name: Squash backhand strengthening training
events.description: At 7 a.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived at Dynamic Fitness Club as promised and practiced squash with Lin Feng for one hour. The focus today was backhand line changes. Lin Feng kept feeding balls from different angles, and Lu Mingqiang gradually mastered the technique of changing the direction of his returns by adjusting his wrist. The two agreed to keep reinforcing it next week.

events.name: In the morning, reviewed training camp notes alone at home.
events.description: After squash training, Lu Mingqiang took a shower. While his two sons were still sleeping, he spread out all of this week's handouts and notes in the study and went through the key formulas and operating procedures in order—from transformer parallel operation and cable termination to relay protection—circling with a red pen the points he still did not fully understand, planning to ask the teacher during the afternoon break. Meanwhile, his wife Wang Lijuan aired the quilts on the balcony, then cleaned the kitchen and thawed chicken breast in preparation for tomorrow's lunchbox.

events.name: In the afternoon, hurried to the electric power school to attend the intensive training course.
events.description: After a simple lunch of rice noodles stir-fried by his wife, Lu Mingqiang drove to Haikou Electric Power School. The afternoon class was hands-on wiring of inverters and photovoltaic systems. He practiced repeatedly on the simulation panel three times and finally reduced his wiring error rate to zero. During the break, he also asked the teacher about the problems he had circled in the morning and received clear answers, suddenly feeling enlightened.

events.name: After the evening course, completed the annual individual income tax reconciliation with his wife's help.
events.description: The evening training ended at 9 p.m. After returning home and taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang sat on the sofa with his wife and opened the individual income tax app. With Wang Lijuan's prompting, he checked the special additional deductions for supporting parents and children's education, confirmed that nothing was missing, and submitted the declaration. The system showed a tax refund of 120 yuan. He was pleasantly surprised, as he had previously thought there would be no refund. His wife smiled and said that this gave them enough money for two extra grilled fish meals. Lu Mingqiang also remarked that the tax process is now transparent and convenient, and that tax awareness has indeed improved.

start_state.mood: Energy is still fine; plan to use the morning to consolidate the learning content.

end_state.mood: Felt at ease because the tax refund came through and knowledge gaps were filled.

state.daily_exercise: Backhand squash training for 1 hour (core training simplified to one set).

2025-04.daily_overview: A new week began. Lu Mingqiang worked normally during the day, chatted with coworkers about tax refund matters during the lunch break, and focused on complex circuit analysis during evening training. Although it burned quite a few brain cells, the team received praise, which gave him more confidence in the theory exam.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: He got up at 6:10, and Lu Mingqiang completed his usual core training. Since his legs had fully recovered, he tried adding a few sets of bodyweight squats today, but it felt a little out of practice.

events.name: Confirmed tax refund application status and communicated with co-workers.
events.description: During the morning work break, Lu Mingqiang opened the individual income tax app and saw that the tax refund application status was still under review. He chatted about the tax refund with his coworker Chen Jianguo, who said he had also received more than 100 yuan back. The two exchanged details on how to fill in the forms. Zhao Qiang had never heard of individual income tax reconciliation, so Lu Mingqiang gave him a brief explanation.

events.name: Received a phone call from Chen Zhiqiang, my wife's younger brother.
events.description: In the afternoon, while working at the construction site, his phone vibrated—it was a video call from Chen Zhiqiang, his wife's younger brother, in Shenzhen. Chen Zhiqiang said he had seen the lettuce photos his sister posted and praised how hardworking she was. The two chatted about family matters for more than ten minutes. Chen Zhiqiang also encouraged him to get a technician certificate, saying he would treat him to a big meal once he got it. Lu Mingqiang smiled and agreed.

events.name: Evening intensive training to tackle high-frequency difficult points
events.description: In the evening, the electrical school course covered advanced content such as complex circuit analysis and fault diagnosis. The teacher used a real distribution cabinet case to explain equivalent circuit simplification methods, followed by group discussion. Lu Mingqiang's group took on a fault simulation problem. The group members each expressed their views. Drawing on his field experience, he sketched a circuit diagram, and the group was the first to answer correctly. The teacher praised his clear logic, which greatly boosted his confidence.

start_state.mood: Stable, and aware of today's task schedule.

end_state.mood: It was mentally exhausting, but there was a slight sense of accomplishment after the team received praise.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core training and bodyweight squat attempt

2025-04.daily_overview: The weather was hot. During the day, Lu Mingqiang took his apprentice through hands-on practice, and his clothes were soaked with sweat several times over. In the evening intensive training, he finally mastered the cable termination work that had given him the most trouble. Even the blisters on his hands did not hurt.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6:10, Lu Mingqiang completed his core workout in the living room. Today's plank time was extended by another 5 seconds, reaching 80 seconds; his core strength was visibly increasing.

events.name: During the day at work, guiding apprentice Zhao Qiang through hands-on practice
events.description: In the morning, at an old residential community in Xiuying District, Lu Mingqiang replaced a power distribution cabinet. He had his apprentice Zhao Qiang handle part of the wiring while he supervised from the side. Zhao Qiang was slow, but he followed the specifications at every step. When the wiring was done, he checked it all and everything was up to standard. Lu Mingqiang patted his apprentice on the shoulder and said, Not bad. I'll treat you to coconut water tonight. Zhao Qiang grinned sheepishly.

events.name: Evening intensive training with hands-on practice enhancement and one-on-one guidance
events.description: The evening training session focused on hands-on reinforcement of electrical equipment installation and maintenance. Lu Mingqiang chose cold-shrink cable terminal production, which he dreaded most. On the first attempt, the dimensions were off. The instructor corrected him hands-on, explaining the stress points and cutting techniques. He did it four times in a row until it fully met the standard. The wire stripping knife raised a blister on the web of his thumb, but he didn't mind at all and felt it was worth it.

events.name: Rain delayed the trip home after the training session
events.description: When class ended, it was raining moderately outside. Lu Mingqiang had not brought rain gear, so he waited for half an hour in the entrance hall of the teaching building. In the meantime, he discussed practical exam precautions with a fellow professional. He got home considerably later than usual.

start_state.mood: Just a few more days of intensive training and it will be over; grit your teeth and hold on.

end_state.mood: Tired but with the refreshing satisfaction of having overcome a difficult point.

state.daily_exercise: Early morning core workout.

2025-04.daily_overview: The intensive training class organized a full mock exam. Lu Mingqiang did well in the practical operation but lost many points in the theory section, like a bucket of cold water over his head. But he didn't get downcast. He took the initiative to ask the teacher for advice, and in the evening he went to the squash court to practice his backhand hard to vent stress. After returning home, he buried himself in sorting out wrong answers until late at night, determined to make a comeback in the final days.

events.name: Early morning simplified core training
events.description: Because he had to rush to the mock exam, Lu Mingqiang got up at 6 o'clock, did only two sets of superman stretches and planks, and then went out, silently thinking that he must do well on the exam today.

events.name: Took a full mock exam.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang took the practical assessment in the training lab at Haikou Electric Power School. He drew the fault diagnosis of a low-voltage distribution cabinet and line restoration. He detected, isolated, replaced components, and restored power according to the procedure, completing the whole sequence cleanly. The examiner nodded. In the afternoon, the theory exam moved to a classroom. The questions covered electrical basics, safety regulations, and new technologies. In the latter part, he clearly felt that many knowledge points were fuzzy in his memory. He answered as best he could and felt uncertain after handing in the paper.

events.name: Proactively asked the teacher about the wrong questions.
events.description: As soon as the mock exam ended, Lu Mingqiang took the test paper to the training teacher and asked about each marked wrong question one by one. The teacher patiently explained the calculation of three-phase unbalanced current, the requirements for lightning protection grounding resistance, and other topics, and pointed out that he had mainly lost points on data memorization and the newly added chapters, suggesting that he copy the relevant standard tables several times when he got home. Lu Mingqiang nodded and immediately noted down all the key points in his phone's memo app.

events.name: Focused squash backhand training to relieve stress
events.description: After coming out of the electrical school, Lu Mingqiang felt chest tightness and drove straight to Dongli Fitness Club. Lin Feng hadn't arrived yet, so he spent half an hour hitting backhands hard against the wall by himself, and after Lin Feng arrived, they practiced together for another half hour. After venting, he felt much calmer and told himself there was still time to make up for it.

events.name: Going home to organize the mistake notebook
events.description: It was already 9:30 pm when he got home. After taking a shower, he spread open a notebook in the study. He copied the wrong questions from the mock exam and the key points the teacher had explained, categorizing them under 'Electric Power Basics', 'Safety Regulations', and 'New Technologies'. He marked the easily confused numbers and formulas with a red pen and wrote his own understanding next to them. His wife Wang Lijuan quietly refilled his cup with chrysanthemum tea and placed it on the desk.

events.name: Made a final sprint review plan
events.description: He sorted out the wrong questions until 11 p.m. Lu Mingqiang compared the distribution of the wrong questions and wrote a two-day sprint plan in his phone memo: on the 24th, review and memorize standards and formulas all day; on the 25th, focus on past exam papers and retest the wrong questions. He told himself not to panic—hands steady, mind open.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous, knowing that today is the testing stage

end_state.mood: Initially frustrated, but this has turned into clear motivation to improve; after playing squash, his mindset has become steadier.

state.daily_exercise: Early morning simplified core training, and about 1 hour of special squash backhand training.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the mock exam review day, Lu Mingqiang braved the rain to get to the electrical school. He listened attentively all evening, using his mistake notebook to identify and fill gaps. The previously vague standard clauses finally became clear, giving him the thrill of clearing away obstacles.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6:05, Lu Mingqiang did not slack off because of staying up late the previous day. He completed his core training as usual, but reduced the number of reps per set to prevent fatigue.

events.name: Listen to the mock exam review and supplement the wrong-question notebook.
events.description: At six in the evening, with rain showers outside, Lu Mingqiang rode his bike to the electrical school wearing a raincoat. The teacher used a projector to analyze typical wrong answers one by one. When he explained the standard values for grounding resistance tests, Lu Mingqiang suddenly understood and quickly added annotations in his mistake notebook. The review session lasted two and a half hours, and he watched intently the whole time. After class, he pulled the teacher aside to confirm several qualitative judgments he had been uncertain about, and did not leave until the building closed.

events.name: After returning home, sort out the wrong questions and do some mental adjustment.
events.description: He got home at 9:30. Lu Mingqiang added a few knowledge points newly discovered during the review to his mistake notebook, then covered the answers for all the wrong questions and answered them aloud himself. The accuracy rate rose to 80%. He told himself that theory was not a bone too hard to chew. Before bed, he rarely relaxed by listening to some light music and fell asleep before 11.

start_state.mood: With a mindset of checking for omissions and filling gaps.

end_state.mood: The joy of clearing knowledge blind spots.

state.daily_exercise: Early morning core workout.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the last day of the intensive training, Lu Mingqiang wrapped up with a knowledge review and pre-exam psychological counseling, while also feeling his energy return thanks to the dietary changes. In the evening, after sharing these changes with his wife, he accepted several classmates' invitation to go out for a late-night snack and indulged a little, adding a lively, earthy full stop to two weeks of hard studying. Back home, he created a new folder called "Exam Countdown" in his phone's notes app, photographed and saved the review outline the teacher had given that day, and planned to start making a long-term study schedule the next day.

events.name: Early morning core workout.
events.description: At 6:10, Lu Mingqiang completed a full core workout. Today he deliberately added pigeon pose stretching, and the soreness in his lower back was relieved significantly.

events.name: Discussed the effects of dietary improvement with his wife
events.description: While eating breakfast, Lu Mingqiang looked in the mirror and noticed that his complexion was rosier than a week ago. Breakfast was still eggs, milk, and the whole-wheat steamed buns his wife had made. He smiled and said to Wang Lijuan that eating well recently had really given him more energy for work, and that he could make it through this intensive training thanks to the logistical support. Wang Lijuan was pleased too and said that from then on, breakfast would be kept to this standard, and he should continue bringing a packed lunch at noon and eat less greasy food outside.

events.name: Attended the last day of the intensive training course.
events.description: In the last class of the evening, the teacher walked everyone through the entire exam syllabus for the senior technician certification, emphasizing the practical safety specifications and high-frequency theory exam points. Then he gave a brief pre-exam psychological adjustment, reminding everyone not to get stuck on tricky points and to allocate time wisely during the exam. Before class ended, Lu Mingqiang checked his ID card, admission ticket, calculator, electrician tool kit, and other exam supplies, confirmed everything was in order, and then left after exchanging words of encouragement with several fellow trainees. At the end of the lesson, the teacher wrote a sentence on the blackboard: "Today is only the starting point; true masters are honed by time." Lu Mingqiang copied it onto the flyleaf of his notebook, knowing full well that the two weeks of training had just opened the door to exam preparation; the real key was the independent review that followed.

events.name: Celebrated with training classmates over a late-night snack
events.description: After class, a few close classmates suggested going for a late-night snack. Lu Mingqiang, thinking he had not relaxed for two weeks, readily agreed. The group went to a food stall on Bo'ai South Road and ordered grilled fish, stir-fried snails, and a few small dishes. Lu Mingqiang drank a bottle of beer and chatted with everyone about their exam preparation experiences, with laughter ringing out. When the gathering broke up, it was nearly 11 p.m. He took a taxi home, slightly tipsy, feeling that the past ten days had been like a battle.

events.name: Review the beverage adjustment and confirm sleep improvement
events.description: After returning home and taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang made himself a cup of warm water. He remembered that he had not had strong tea or coffee in the afternoon for two consecutive weeks, and he had indeed been falling asleep much faster. Although it was a bit later tonight, he was in a good mood, and he decided to officially say goodbye to strong afternoon tea. From now on, he would only drink chrysanthemum tea or plain water and make this habit permanent.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the end of the intensive training, while feeling a little pressure about the upcoming official exam.

end_state.mood: Relieved, relaxed and joyful, full of confidence in the future.

state.daily_exercise: Early-morning core workout and pigeon-pose stretching.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the first rest day after the training camp, Lu Mingqiang resumed his morning run. In the morning, he drove to Jiuzhou Town to buy free-range eggs, but on the way back he got a flat tire. He changed to the spare tire himself and got out of trouble. In the evening, he still found time to practice squash, and at night he agreed with his running buddy Chen Bin to resume joint training in May. Life has become colorful again.

events.name: Early morning core workout and stretching.
events.description: Got up at 6 o'clock. Lu Mingqiang first did a simplified core training set, then carefully did 10 minutes of yoga stretching and felt his body loosen up. Then he changed into running shoes and went out.

events.name: Early morning run at Baishamen Park.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang jogs 5 kilometers at Baishamen Park at a pace of about 6:20 per kilometer. After two weeks without running, he feels a bit out of breath, but after finishing, he is sweaty and feels great. At the park gate, he has a bowl of Hainan noodle soup and feels energized.

events.name: Drove alone to Jiuzhou Town to buy free-range eggs from a farm.
events.description: At nine in the morning, Lu Mingqiang left his home in Longhua District and drove along the East Line Expressway toward Jiuzhou Town in Qiongshan District. There was a farmhouse there that a friend had recommended; the eggs from their free-range chickens were small but had rich, fragrant yolks. He bought five jin of free-range eggs, wrapped them in newspaper, and put them in the trunk. He also chatted with the farmer about the ins and outs of raising chickens, planning to refer colleagues to buy from there in the future.

events.name: On the way back, the right rear tire was punctured, and he replaced it with the spare tire himself.
events.description: On the way back in the afternoon, about ten kilometers from the city center, the dashboard suddenly showed low tire pressure in the right rear wheel. Lu Mingqiang quickly pulled over, got out, and found a nail embedded in the tread. He turned on the hazard lights, took out the jack and spare tire from the trunk, and struggled quite a bit to remove the damaged wheel with the wrench because the bolts were too tight, sweat breaking out on his forehead. It took about twenty minutes in total to change the spare tire. He joked that after repairing machines for over a dozen years, he was a little out of practice removing his own car's wheels.

events.name: Drove the vehicle safely back home
events.description: After changing to the spare tire, Lu Mingqiang carefully drove back to Longhua District at no more than 60 km/h, arriving home close to six o'clock. Seeing him sweating, his wife asked what happened and then gently scolded him for being careless, but her eyes were full of concern. He chuckled and said it was nothing, that he would just get the tire patched tomorrow.

events.name: Squash backhand strengthening training
events.description: After a shower and rest, Lu Mingqiang felt he still had energy, so he hurried to Dynamic Fitness Club for a 1-hour squash training session with Lin Feng. Today's focus was backhand returns of kill shots. Lin Feng fed many tricky shots; he retrieved most of them, and his backhand defense significantly improved.

events.name: WeChat interaction with running partner Chen Bin
events.description: While changing the tire, Lu Mingqiang took a photo of the spare tire and posted it on WeChat Moments. His running friend Chen Bin commented with concern, and the two then chatted on WeChat. Chen Bin said he had also been getting back into training and suggested a 10-kilometer run together on the first weekend of May. Lu Mingqiang gladly agreed, and they happily settled it.

events.name: Did housework with the family and went to the supermarket to buy daily necessities
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang, his wife, and their eldest son Lu Zixuan went to a nearby supermarket together and bought daily necessities such as toilet paper, laundry detergent, and plastic wrap. They also bought some erasers and pencils for the children's studies. After returning home, the family tidied up the living room and put some thick winter clothes into storage bins, restoring a relaxed weekend evening routine at home.

start_state.mood: The long-missed urge to exercise and a sense of relaxation

end_state.mood: Although I encountered a small accident, I felt a great sense of accomplishment after solving it myself, and I made an appointment with friends to reignite my passion for running.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core training and stretching, 5 km morning run, 1 hour of squash backhand training.

2025-04.daily_overview: Sunday was full and warm. In the morning, Lu Mingqiang cleaned the air conditioner and earned his wife's praise. In the afternoon, after fixing a flat tire, he also practiced squash. In the evening, the whole family went out for grilled fish to celebrate the end of the intensive training. Amid laughter and cheerful talk, his weight also went up a little.

events.name: Early morning core workout and stretching.
events.description: Got up at 6 o'clock. Lu Mingqiang completed the full core training and a 10-minute stretch, and felt his core was more stable.

events.name: Early morning run at Baishamen Park.
events.description: The weather was good today. Lu Mingqiang ran 5 kilometers in the park, and his pace improved to 6 minutes 15 seconds, showing a clear recovery in form. After the run, he did his usual stretching. Seeing the morning light spreading across the sea, he felt overjoyed.

events.name: Preparing air conditioner cleaning tools and checking the cleaning agent.
events.description: After breakfast, Lu Mingqiang got out a screwdriver, a soft-bristled brush, a bucket, and the bottle of air conditioner cleaner left over from last year. He shook it—there was still half a bottle, enough. After confirming he had all the tools, he brought over a ladder and got ready to start cleaning.

events.name: Cleaned the air conditioner filters and cooling fins in the master bedroom and living room.
events.description: He first removed the front panel of the wall-mounted unit in the master bedroom, pulled out the dusty filter, and took it to the bathroom to scrub it back and forth with a soft brush dipped in water until it returned to its original color. Then he sprayed it with air conditioner cleaner to disinfect and sanitize it, and placed it in a ventilated area to drain. Next, he opened the intake grille of the cabinet air conditioner in the living room, took out the two filters and rinsed them the same way, wiped the cabinet panel, and also checked whether the drain pipe was clear, pouring out some accumulated water. The whole process took nearly an hour.

events.name: Clean the heat-dissipation fins of the outdoor unit of the air conditioner.
events.description: Putting on his gloves, Lu Mingqiang went to the equipment platform on the balcony. Using a soft brush with a special cleaning agent, he carefully brushed away the dust and fluff accumulated on the heat-dissipation fins on the back of the outdoor unit. While cleaning, he told his second son Lu Zihan, who had run over curiously to watch, that the air conditioner also needs a bath—once it is clean, it can be cooler. Zihan nodded, half understanding.

events.name: Reinstalled the filter screen, tested the machine, and received praise from his wife.
events.description: After the filters were completely dry, Lu Mingqiang accurately reinstalled them into the air conditioners in the master bedroom and living room, closed the panels, plugged in the power, and turned them on for a test. The airflow became strong and the room temperature quickly dropped. His wife Wang Lijuan came out of the kitchen, tried the cool air, and praised him for being professional and meticulous, saying it was more reliable than calling a repairman. Lu Mingqiang said something modest but felt delighted inside.

events.name: Go to the auto repair shop to patch the tire
events.description: At two in the afternoon, he drove to an auto repair shop near home with the tire that had been punctured the day before. The mechanic inspected it and then plugged it from the inside with a mushroom plug, charging 50 yuan. Lu Mingqiang squatted nearby watching the mechanic work, chatted a bit about tire repair knowledge, and thought that he could also keep a simple tire repair kit in the car in the future.

events.name: Squash backhand strengthening training
events.description: After getting the tire patched, it was still early. Lu Mingqiang and Lin Feng had agreed to go to the club to practice at four. Today, they added backhand stroke practice while moving. Lin Feng sent 20 low, flat balls in a row, and Lu Mingqiang returned all of them. Lin Feng gave a thumbs up. After an hour of training, his backhand became more and more confident.

events.name: Family grilled fish dinner
events.description: After returning home from training, Lu Mingqiang suggested the whole family go out for grilled fish to celebrate the successful conclusion of the intensive training and the clear weather, and his wife agreed with a smile. The family of four went to a food stall near the community and ordered spicy grilled fish and several side dishes. The two sons happily drank coconut juice, and the couple chatted about their small plans for the future. Lu Mingqiang felt that although such days were ordinary, they were happy.

events.name: Organized the intensive training notes in the study and thought about application.
events.description: After returning from the evening dinner, he asked his wife to take the children to bed first, while he stayed in the study and organized all the notes and handouts from the training into three folders: "Theory," "Hands-on Practice," and "Safety Regulations." He used a highlighter to mark techniques that could be immediately applied to daily maintenance work, such as making a checklist of the cold-shrink termination production process, which could also be used later when mentoring apprentices. After sorting everything out until ten o'clock, he put down his pen with satisfaction.

start_state.mood: Energetic; planning to use Sunday for some housework and self-improvement.

end_state.mood: A sense of fulfillment and calm after completing multiple plans in an orderly manner, and the satisfaction brought by the family dinner.

state.daily_exercise: Morning core training and stretching, 5 km morning run, 1 hour of squash backhand practice, and household chores

2025-04.daily_overview: On Monday, Lu Mingqiang returned to work and started his morning comprehensive training routine, and resumed brisk walking during his lunch break. In the evening, after tutoring his eldest son's homework, he noticed that thunderstorms were becoming more frequent, so he launched an electrical circuit safety inspection plan, checking for gaps and preparing materials.

events.name: Morning comprehensive workout (core + stretching)
events.description: After getting up at 6:10, Lu Mingqiang combined core training with stretching: after 2 sets of superman exercises, 2 sets of glute bridges, and 2 sets of planks, he did full-body stretches such as cat-cow and pigeon pose, for a total of 15 minutes. This routine made him feel that the waking effect was very good.

events.name: Lunch break recovery brisk walk.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang put on his hat and briskly walked for 30 minutes on the streets around the construction site, at a pace of about 10 minutes per kilometer. He hadn't walked for two weeks, so his legs felt a bit heavy, but it cleared his mind and felt great.

events.name: After work, tutored the eldest son in his homework and helped him get back into a study routine
events.description: When he got home at six in the evening, Lu Mingqiang first checked Lu Zixuan's homework log, focusing on the word problems in the math workbook and the Chinese character dictation. He asked his son to first recall how the teacher had explained in class, and then he added his own explanations—this worked better than directly giving him the answers. After an hour of tutoring, Zixuan gradually found his study rhythm again.

events.name: Checked the weather forecast and confirmed frequent thunderstorms
events.description: After helping with homework, Lu Mingqiang opened the weather app on his phone and saw that the Haikou forecast for the coming week had thunderstorm icons almost every day, with humidity steadily rising. He realized thunderstorm season had arrived. Although the electrical wiring at home had been checked last year, he had to thoroughly inspect it again this year before he could feel at ease.

events.name: Made a circuit safety inspection plan and listed it in a memo.
events.description: He immediately wrote in his phone memo: "End-of-month circuit check: 1. Check whether all switches and outlets in the house are loose or overheated; 2. Test whether the residual current device can trip and reset properly; 3. Check the outdoor air conditioner and wiring conduits for damage, and reinforce with insulating tape if necessary." He set a reminder for the day after tomorrow and planned to buy the materials tomorrow.

events.name: Discussed arrangements with his wife and explained electrical safety during the thunderstorm season.
events.description: During dinner, Lu Mingqiang told Wang Lijuan about the inspection plan, suggested finding time to do it in the next day or two, and reminded her to unplug unnecessary appliance plugs during thunderstorms, especially the router and the TV. Wang Lijuan said she would cooperate, adding that last time the TV suddenly went black during a thunderstorm and gave her a scare, so it would be safer to have it checked sooner.

events.name: Checked the toolbox and found that insulating tape was missing.
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang opened his toolbox and looked through it: the voltage tester, screwdrivers, wire strippers, and insulating gloves were all there, but only less than one roll of insulating tape remained, and it was a bit aged and sticky. He decided to buy new tape at the hardware store after work tomorrow to make sure he wouldn't run short of materials during the inspection.

start_state.mood: Energy restored, clear-headed

end_state.mood: The sense of security after preparing the safety plan.

state.daily_exercise: Morning comprehensive training (core + stretching), 30 minutes of brisk walking during lunch break.

2025-04.daily_overview: On Tuesday, Lu Mingqiang discussed thunderstorm season safety matters with his workmates during the day, continued tutoring his son in the evening, and also found time to deliver rheumatism patches to his father. After work, he bought all the insulating tape he needed. Everything was ready for the next day's safety inspection.

events.name: Morning comprehensive workout (core + stretching)
events.description: Lu Mingqiang got up at 6:10 and completed a 15-minute fitness wake-up routine. Today he held a plank for 90 seconds, and his core strength continues to improve.

events.name: Brisk-walking recovery training during lunch break.
events.description: After eating his boxed lunch at the construction site, Lu Mingqiang took a brisk 30-minute walk along the nearby streets. Although it had rained and the air was humid, letting his mind go blank during the walk actually made him feel more productive in the afternoon.

events.name: During the lunch break, talked with Chen Jianguo about work safety in the thunderstorm season.
events.description: After finishing the walk, he returned to the rest shed and chatted with his workmate Chen Jianguo about the weather forecast. Both knew very well how dangerous thunderstorms are for outdoor electrical work. Chen Jianguo said that during an emergency repair two years ago he was nearly struck by lightning, and he still felt scared thinking about it. Lu Mingqiang then mentioned his company's rule requiring suspension of work at heights and live-line operations during thunderstorms. Both agreed that safety cannot be overemphasized.

events.name: After work, continued to tutor the eldest son in his weak subjects.
events.description: Today, when checking Lu Zixuan's Chinese reading comprehension, Lu Mingqiang found that his summaries of the main idea kept going off track. Lu Mingqiang patiently taught him to summarize using the formula "who + what they did + what the result was," practicing with three or four texts from the textbook as examples. Zixuan finally got it. His wife watched the father and son from the side, quietly peeled a mango and handed it to him.

events.name: On the way, drop off rheumatic pain patches for father.
events.description: After helping with homework, Lu Mingqiang remembered that his mother had said last week that his father's knee hurt a bit, so he first went to the pharmacy to buy four boxes of rheumatism patches, then rode his e-bike to his parents' home in Meilan District. His father was watching TV. He took the medicine and said it was a waste of money, but his eyes showed happiness. Lu Mingqiang sat for half an hour, talking about his upcoming technician certification exam. His father told him to go steadily and not panic.

events.name: Went to the hardware store to buy insulating tape and other materials.
events.description: After leaving his parents' house, Lu Mingqiang, while the hardware store was still open, bought four rolls of red, black, and yellow-green two-color electrical tape and one roll of waterproof mastic, and also bought some wiring terminals for spare outlets. He thought, since he was going to check anyway, he might as well replace the possibly aging wire connections with new ones and do it all at once.

start_state.mood: Clear goals, methodical progress.

end_state.mood: Fully prepared, looking forward to a thorough inspection tomorrow.

state.daily_exercise: Morning comprehensive training (core + stretching), 30 minutes of brisk walking during lunch break.

2025-04.daily_overview: On the last day of the month, Lu Mingqiang completed the whole-house electrical safety inspection as planned and felt relieved after confirming everything was normal. In the evening, during squash training, he felt his backhand had become systematic. After returning home, he organized his note cards and discussed May's family priorities with his wife, bringing a fulfilling and busy April to a satisfactory close.

events.name: Morning comprehensive workout (core + stretching)
events.description: Got up at 6:15. Lu Mingqiang used 15 minutes to complete 2 sets of Superman exercises, 2 sets of glute bridges, 2 sets of planks, and cat-cow and pigeon stretches, feeling great all over.

events.name: Lunch break recovery brisk walk.
events.description: After lunch, Lu Mingqiang took a brisk 30-minute walk around the construction site with a light step. He plans to make the lunch break walk a regular three-times-a-week habit starting in May.

events.name: After work, thoroughly inspect the electrical circuits throughout the house
events.description: Home at 5:30 p.m. Lu Mingqiang took the newly bought insulating tape and tools and began a circuit safety inspection. He first checked every wall switch and socket one by one, feeling for temperature with the back of his hand and using a screwdriver to tighten a loose terminal screw on a living-room socket. Then, at the main distribution box, he repeatedly pressed the test button of the residual current circuit breaker and saw with his own eyes that it tripped reliably and reset. Finally, despite the light rain, he went to the balcony and reinforced the outdoor wiring conduit joints of the air-conditioner outdoor unit and the water heater with insulating tape and waterproof putty, rewrapping two loose conduit sections. The whole inspection took one and a half hours. After all the tests came back normal, he put three checkmarks in his memo.

events.name: Squash backhand strengthening training
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang drove to Dynamic Fitness Club and had his first squash practice session of the week with Lin Feng. Today was entirely focused on actual play. Lin Feng simulated match tempo, forcing him to use his backhand while on the move. Lu Mingqiang was able to control his shots and change lines steadily, and Lin Feng marveled at his rapid progress. After an hour of training, the two agreed to play again after the technician exam.

events.name: After dinner, organized the index cards for training camp notes.
events.description: After returning from squash training and taking a shower, Lu Mingqiang sat at his desk and copied summaries of the intensive training notes onto palm-sized index cards, writing keywords on the front and key data on the back for easy carrying and quick review. He planned to put these cards in his work clothes pocket so he could glance at them whenever he had free time at work.

events.name: Discuss next week's family arrangements with his wife
events.description: After putting away his notes, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan sat on the sofa and talked about plans for May. His wife said there was a parent-child activity at school next Monday and hoped he could attend. Lu Mingqiang checked his work schedule and agreed to try to take compensatory leave to join. The two also reviewed April's expenses and found that although they had spent a little extra during the training session, after adjusting their diet they actually saved on takeout fees, so their finances were acceptable. They agreed to stay frugal in May and spend more time with the children.

start_state.mood: Wrapping up the plan, calm and unhurried.

end_state.mood: A huge weight has been lifted from my mind; I feel at ease and fulfilled, and full of expectation for the future.

state.daily_exercise: Morning comprehensive training (core + stretching), 30-minute brisk walk during lunch break, 1 hour of squash backhand training
