2025-06.daily_overview: On Children's Day (June 1), Lu Mingqiang spent the day with his eldest son in a distinctive hands-on way. He first went to the pharmacy to get a full month's supply of medicinal plasters for his mother, then took Lu Zixuan to a hardware store and let his son use a shopping card to choose tools and experiment kits. After returning home, father and son worked together to repair an old desk lamp. Lu Mingqiang guided his son hand by hand through checking for breaks in the circuit and soldering with an electric soldering iron. The moment the lamp lit up again, Lu Zixuan shouted excitedly, and both father and son felt genuine satisfaction. In the evening the family had a simple meal, and Lu Zixuan was still immersed in the joy of the successful repair, repeatedly telling his mother and younger brother about the process. This day became a typical practice of Lu Mingqiang transforming his professional identity into family education resources, and the eldest son's interest and confidence in hands-on repairing grew significantly.

events.name: Simple stretching and balcony check in the early morning.
events.description: After getting up, Lu Mingqiang habitually walked to the balcony, checked the chili seedlings he had planted a few days ago, and then did five minutes of simple waist and leg stretches. Although he had not scheduled any formal exercise, this little ritual made him feel that a new day had begun.

events.name: Went to the pharmacy to buy this month's medicated patches for his mother
events.description: Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang used the first free time of his day off to walk to the pharmacy near his home to buy the pain-relief patches for his mother Chen Xiuying's chronic cold-leg pain that she needed this month. He greeted the pharmacy staff warmly, confirmed the brand and quantity of the patches to make sure the supply wouldn't run out, and on the way also bought two small bottles of medical alcohol for backup. After buying them, he took them home directly, following the backup quantity list his parents had mentioned during their last visit, and planned to bring them along next weekend when he went to Meilan District.

events.name: Take the eldest son to the hardware store to choose tools.
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang took out the shopping cards he had accumulated at the beginning of the year from a drawer at home and set off with the expectant Lu Zixuan to a hardware store near Jinmao Middle Road. Along the way, he told his son that today he could pick out tools himself like an adult. After arriving at the hardware store, Lu Zixuan carefully compared screwdrivers of different sizes and circuit experiment kits under his father's guidance, and finally chose a small Phillips-head screwdriver and a beginner-friendly circuit experiment set, paying with the shopping card balance. When the father and son left the store, Lu Zixuan hugged the new tools tightly, his face beaming with joy.

events.name: Father and son collaborated to take apart and repair the old desk lamp
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang dug out from the storage room an old desk lamp that had been idle for a long time, along with tools such as a soldering iron, solder wire, and a multimeter. He had Lu Zixuan open the packaging of the newly bought tools, and spread old newspapers on the tabletop to prepare for the repair. He first explained common desk lamp faults, then taught Lu Zixuan hand by hand to unscrew the shell screws, identify the switch and circuit structure, and use the multimeter to test continuity. Together they located the hidden breakpoint in the internal wire at a bent point. Then Lu Mingqiang demonstrated the correct grip of the soldering iron and welding techniques, and with full supervision and guidance at his side, Lu Zixuan completed the soldering operation himself. After the repair was done, Lu Mingqiang connected the power. The moment the lamp lit up normally, Lu Zixuan raised both hands and shouted excitedly, 'I fixed it!' Lu Mingqiang patted his son on the shoulder, feeling deep satisfaction as a father and professional pride as an electrician.

events.name: Packing up tools and sharing a summary.
events.description: After the repair was finished, the father and son wiped the table with a damp cloth and put the tools, such as screwdrivers and the soldering iron, back into the toolbox one by one. Lu Mingqiang placed the repaired old desk lamp on Lu Zixuan's desk and told him that from now on the lamp was his to use. At dinner, Lu Zixuan excitedly told his mother Wang Lijuan and his younger brother Lu Zihan how he found the break point and soldered it himself, while Lu Mingqiang added explanations. The whole family shared the sense of accomplishment brought by hands-on practice and the special warmth of Children's Day.

start_state.mood: Composed but expectant, preparing to spend Children's Day with the eldest son in a special way

end_state.mood: Content and gratified; the father-son relationship grew closer through completing the repair together.

state.daily_exercise: No formal exercise; a simple 5-minute stretch in the early morning, with standing and bending movements during repair activities.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast with showers, southeast wind gradually strengthening, temperature 26-31°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: On the make-up workday for the Dragon Boat Festival, the sky was overcast, and showers brought by the typhoon's outer circulation came and went. After getting up in the early morning, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan picked the peppers that had recently ripened on the balcony, preparing for making chili sauce later. Because rain was falling outside, he could not go for his morning run, so he did a 15-minute core training session in the living room instead. Then he went to work on time as usual, but in the morning he received an urgent company notice requiring all employees to attend a typhoon-season safety meeting. He immediately set about organizing the recent inspection records and the condition of several pieces of old equipment, preparing for the reports and discussions at the meeting. At the afternoon safety meeting, Manager Liu solemnly assigned flood-control and typhoon-prevention tasks. Lu Mingqiang took the emergency duty roster from Team Leader Zhang and confirmed that he had been assigned to Emergency Rescue Team 1 and needed to be on 24-hour standby. On the way home from work, he had already started figuring out how to explain the pace of emergency work over the coming months to his family.

events.name: Picked balcony chili peppers with his wife
events.description: At 6:30 in the morning, as the pre-typhoon-season showers paused briefly, Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan took advantage of the time before work to go to their balcony and pick the fresh chili peppers that had been ripening recently in the slightly muggy morning breeze. The couple carefully selected the red, fully ripe peppers and put them into a bamboo basket. Wang Lijuan said this batch was enough to make two jars of chili sauce, while Lu Mingqiang helped trim the extra branches and leaves. Working in harmony, the couple made preparations for homemade seasonings for cold dishes.

events.name: Morning core training at home
events.description: When the picking was done, a light drizzle began to fall again. Lu Mingqiang changed into a sports vest, spread a yoga mat in the middle of the living room, and completed a 15-minute core workout: 3 sets of planks for 45 seconds each, 20 glute bridges, and 10 bird-dogs per side. Although it was not an outdoor run, sweat still oozed slightly, and he felt his body was activated, lessening the guilt of having skipped a day of running.

events.name: Received urgent notice of a typhoon season safety meeting.
events.description: Just after 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang received urgent notices, first in the company's internal WeChat group and then through a phone call from Team Leader Zhang, requiring all staff to attend the typhoon season safety meeting. The notice explicitly stated that a mobilization meeting would be held at 2 p.m. in the company's main meeting room, and no one was allowed to be absent. Lu Mingqiang glanced at the increasingly gloomy sky outside the window and realized that the pressure of typhoon season had arrived.

events.name: Organize work records to prepare for the safety meeting
events.description: After receiving the notice, Lu Mingqiang immediately stopped his routine tasks, took out the inspection records and work logs from the past few months from the tool cabinet, and methodically copied the operating data of several aging transformer boxes in his jurisdiction, recent line fault cases he had handled, and potential hidden hazards in some equipment into his notebook, making solid preparations for possible reports and discussions at the afternoon meeting.

events.name: Attended the company's typhoon-season safety meeting.
events.description: At two in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang and all his colleagues gathered in the company's main meeting room. Manager Liu stood in front of the projection screen and led the meeting. He first reviewed the emergency response experience and lessons from last year's typhoon season, then with a serious expression stressed the importance of this year's typhoon season emergency response, and finally assigned the specific flood control and typhoon prevention tasks and division of labor one by one. Lu Mingqiang took careful notes and sketched in his mind the areas he was responsible for and the potential risk points.

events.name: Pick up the emergency duty roster and confirm the team grouping.
events.description: After the meeting ended and the crowd dispersed, Lu Mingqiang walked to Team Leader Zhang's desk and picked up a printed copy of his personal emergency duty schedule and duty descriptions. After reading it carefully, he confirmed he had been assigned to Emergency Duty Group One, on 24-hour standby, mainly responsible for line rescue and equipment repair during typhoons. He signed the form, folded the duty schedule, and put it into his work clothes pocket, gaining a clear understanding of the high-intensity standby mode about to begin.

start_state.mood: A faint sense of urgency beneath the calm; the worsening weather makes him anticipate changes at work.

end_state.mood: He consciously accepted the pressure brought by emergency work during typhoon season and has already started planning family time allocation.

state.daily_exercise: 15 minutes of morning core training (plank, glute bridge, bird-dog)

2025-06.daily_overview: With heavy rain pouring from the outer bands of the typhoon, the entire city of Haikou was shrouded in a curtain of rain. Lu Mingqiang got up early in the morning and found he could not go outside, so he completed 20 minutes of bodyweight core training in the corner of the living room, including planks, wall sits, and back stretches. He then met up with his coworker Chen Jianguo at the work unit, picked up a full set of inspection tools including an infrared thermometer from the warehouse, and carefully confirmed the two key distribution boxes A1 and A2 that needed priority inspection that day against the distribution box layout map of the area. The two put on raincoats and inspected the equipment one by one during breaks in the downpour, using the instruments to check operating temperatures and wiring conditions, and recorded several minor abnormalities. Working in the heavy rain was extremely hard, but the two cooperated well, and Lu Mingqiang completed every procedure professionally and rigorously. After getting home from work, he felt his lower back slightly tight, realized the consecutive days of heavy rain had interrupted his morning runs, but was too exhausted to do any indoor activity and went to bed early.

events.name: Indoor morning core and back stretching
events.description: At six in the morning, rain was pouring outside like arrows. Lu Mingqiang decided to move his exercise plan indoors. He spread out the mat and completed 45-second planks ×3, 1-minute wall sits ×3, and focused on cat-cow stretches and foam rolling for the upper back. After 20 minutes of practice, his body felt slightly warm, and the stiffness in his lower back seemed to have been awakened.

events.name: Pick up inspection tools and confirm the inspection route.
events.description: At 7:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang and his workmate Chen Jianguo gathered at the entrance of the unit's tool warehouse. Following the distribution map of the district's transformer boxes issued by their work team, they applied for and checked out one by one the supplies needed for the inspection, including an infrared thermometer, wrenches, a screwdriver set, a notebook, and walkie-talkies. Then, with a marker, they circled the locations of the two transformer boxes, A1 and A2, that needed priority inspection that day. After confirming the inspection route and safety precautions, they put on their raincoats and set off in the rain.

events.name: Inspect transformer boxes A1 and A2 and record any abnormalities.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo arrived one after another at the two key distribution boxes, numbered A1 and A2, in their jurisdiction. In the heavy rain, the two men operated with difficulty under umbrellas. Lu Mingqiang used an infrared thermometer to carefully measure the operating temperature of each phase line, while bending down to check whether the wiring terminals were tight and whether there were signs of oxidation, blackening, or looseness. Chen Jianguo recorded the data and took photos for the archive. Lu Mingqiang found that the C-phase terminal temperature in box A1 was slightly above the standard value, with slight signs of oxidation. He noted it in detail in his record book and marked it as requiring follow-up.

events.name: Returning in the rainstorm and simple cleanup.
events.description: After finishing the inspection of two transformer boxes, the rain suddenly intensified, and the two decided to pause the field work and return to the company first. Back in the team's rest room, Lu Mingqiang used a dry towel to wipe his rain-dampened hair and work clothes, then hung up his soaked raincoat to dry. While drinking hot water to warm up, he transcribed the abnormal data he had just recorded into the official inspection form, preparing to include it in a later report.

start_state.mood: Felt somewhat subdued by the heavy rain, but quickly switched into work mode and prepared for the inspection challenge.

end_state.mood: Tired but fulfilled, yet slightly worried about the interruption in exercise and tightness in the lower back.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of indoor core and back stretching; walking and bending movements during inspections

date_attribute.weather: Heavy rain turning to showers, wind slightly weaker, temperature 26-30°C

2025-06.daily_overview: Effects from the periphery of the typhoon were still ongoing. Although the rain had eased somewhat compared with the day before, the city remained humid and muggy. In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo continued their inspection rounds, checking the third and fourth distribution boxes one by one, measuring the load current of each phase, tightening several loose screws with a screwdriver, and carefully inspecting the box sealing strips to prevent typhoon rainwater from seeping in. The intense daytime work made his body feel heavy, and the tightness in his back and waist was more noticeable than the day before. After work in the evening, he still set out on time for the squash club and played the scheduled regular Wednesday training session with his playing partner Lin Feng, focusing on backhand technique and playing three practice matches. On the court, he sweated profusely, and the pressure of work and the dullness caused by the running hiatus were released somewhat with each swing. After training, he showered and went home, feeling that the stuffiness that had built up over the past few days from lack of aerobic exercise had finally found an outlet.

events.name: Continue inspecting the third and fourth transformer boxes.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo, wearing raincoats that were not yet completely dry, continued to inspect the third and fourth key distribution transformer boxes in their area one by one. Lu Mingqiang used an infrared thermometer and a clamp ammeter to measure the operating temperature and load current of each phase. He found that two terminal screws in the fourth box were slightly loose, and he immediately tightened them with a screwdriver and re-measured to confirm the indicators had returned to normal. At the same time, he paid special attention to checking the sealing strips and drain holes of each box, confirming there were no signs of water accumulation or leakage, and took on-site photos as baseline records before the typhoon season.

events.name: Squash club routine training to release stress
events.description: At seven in the evening, Lu Mingqiang felt physically tired but still changed into his sports gear and went to the squash club. He and his playing partner Lin Feng did their regular weekly Wednesday training as agreed. They first warmed up and stretched for ten minutes, then focused on practicing the power angle and footwork of backhand shots. In the latter half of the training, they played three practice matches. Lin Feng's aggressive style forced Lu Mingqiang to constantly adjust his footwork. Although he made more errors on the backhand side, he gradually found his rhythm in the third game. After an hour of sweating exercise, he felt the work pressure drain away with his sweat; his body was tired, but his mind was much lighter. After training, they briefly exchanged thoughts on playing skills and left separately.

start_state.mood: He felt slightly weary from the prolonged rainy weather, but remained focused on work.

end_state.mood: After squash, experienced a brief mental release; the tightness in the lower back remained, but mood improved.

state.daily_exercise: Squash training about 60 minutes (including warm-up stretching, backhand practice, and actual match play).

2025-06.daily_overview: After days of heavy rain, the weather finally eased in the afternoon, with sunlight occasionally breaking through the gaps between clouds. Before work that morning, Lu Mingqiang packed the chili sauce his wife had made from peppers grown on the balcony into his lunch bag and brought it to the company. At noon, in the work shed, he took out the chili sauce and shared it with his team members. Chen Jianguo tasted it and jokingly called him the 'electrician gardener,' and the atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. Zhao Qiang also repeatedly praised the sauce for its authentic taste. In the afternoon, he and Chen Jianguo went to the last key distribution box to complete the final inspection. After all checks were finished, they returned to the company, systematically organized the inspection records and abnormal data accumulated over the past three days, classified them into the 'Summer Inspection Report for Distribution Boxes,' and submitted it to Squad Leader Zhang, providing a solid basis for the emergency response plan for typhoon season. After coming home from work, Lu Mingqiang still felt some stiffness in his lower back, so he did a 10-minute stretch on the balcony, and the cat stretch made him feel more comfortable.

events.name: Took his wife's homemade chili sauce to the company.
events.description: Before leaving in the morning, Lu Mingqiang took two jars of chili sauce that Wang Lijuan had just made from peppers picked a couple of days earlier, wrapped them carefully, and put them in his lunch bag. His wife reminded him at the kitchen door to be sure to let all his coworkers have a taste. He agreed with a smile, picked up his work bag and lunch bag, and walked out the door, planning to have the workers evaluate the family's cooking at lunch.

events.name: Shared chili sauce with coworkers during lunch and strengthened their bond.
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang and his workmates from the crew sat around in the workshed eating lunch. He deliberately brought out the two jars of chili sauce and put them on the table, inviting Chen Jianguo, Zhao Qiang, and several other workmates to taste it. Chen Jianguo picked up a little with his chopsticks and took a taste; his eyes lit up, and he jokingly called Lu Mingqiang 'the electrician gardener', saying that with such skill he could open a food store. Zhao Qiang also repeatedly praised the sauce, saying it tasted authentic and more aromatic than store-bought. Lu Mingqiang smiled modestly, saying the credit went to his wife. As they ate, they chatted about fun things about planting at home and recent work, and the crew's atmosphere was harmonious and cheerful.

events.name: Completed the inspection of the last transformer box and organized the report.
events.description: In the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang and his partner Chen Jianguo went to the last key transformer box in their area for a closing inspection. During a break in the showers, he completed the temperature measurement, fastening, and sealing checks according to procedure and confirmed that there were no abnormal issues. After the inspection, the two returned to the company. Lu Mingqiang spread all the inspection logs from the past three days on his desk, checked the data and on-site photos one by one, and accurately classified and entered into the Summer Transformer Box Inspection Report the abnormal conditions, including the oxidized C-phase terminal of the A1 box and the loose wiring in the fourth transformer box, while also noting suggestions for follow-up handling. After finishing, he handed the report directly to Team Leader Zhang, providing first-hand evidence for emergency preparations for the typhoon season.

events.name: Stretch on the balcony in the evening to relieve back discomfort.
events.description: Before dinner, while there was still good light, Lu Mingqiang laid out a mat on the balcony and did 10 minutes of stretching. He focused on cat stretch, child's pose, and a simple seated forward bend. During it, he could clearly feel the pulling sensation in the muscles on both sides of his lower back; after finishing, the soreness eased. He decided to find time to stretch every day from now on.

start_state.mood: Going to work with a little expectation of sharing family achievements with colleagues.

end_state.mood: A sense of fulfillment from completing the three-day inspection task mixed with the warmth of sharing with his workmates, and his lower back discomfort had eased.

state.daily_exercise: Evening balcony stretching for 10 minutes; work involved a lot of walking and inspection operations.

2025-06.daily_overview: The peripheral rain from the typhoon finally stopped completely, and the sky cleared in Haikou. Lu Mingqiang's pace at work today was slightly lighter, mainly routine maintenance of electrical equipment and a few small and medium repair tasks. After several consecutive days of heavy rain and inspection work, his body was obviously tired, and his lower back still felt a bit tight. During the lunch break he called his mother Chen Xiuying to tell her that the medicated patches had been bought and he would bring them over on Saturday. On the phone, his mother reminded him that his old problems tend to flare up in wet weather and to take care of himself. The afternoon work was relatively easy. After getting off work, he deliberately stretched his waist and legs at the entrance of the unit. After dinner, he pulled out his electrician theory textbook and began to systematically review the basics of the "transformer maintenance" chapter. This was his first focused study session since formally starting his exam preparation plan. Although his brain felt foggy and he was inefficient, he still managed to take five pages of notes. He knew this was a long-term battle. The start today was difficult, but he had to take the first step. Before nine o'clock, drowsiness swept over him overwhelmingly; he closed the book and went to bed early, thinking about taking the whole family to his parents' home tomorrow, and also quietly hoping that his body would recover once he resumed exercise.

events.name: Daily equipment maintenance and repair tasks
events.description: His full-day work mainly involved routine maintenance of electrical equipment. Under the arrangement of Team Leader Zhang, Lu Mingqiang handled two small repair requests from users near the company, mainly replacing old air switches and re-tightening several loose wire connections. He operated skillfully, completing each repair task in less than half an hour, but was somewhat concerned by the slightly tired look he saw on his face in the mirror.

events.name: Called his mother at noon to let her know the medicated patches were ready.
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang took the opportunity while eating to call his mother, Chen Xiuying. He told her that this month's medicated patches had already been bought and left at home, and that on Saturday he would drive the family to deliver them to Meilan District. On the phone, his mother urged him to be extra careful going to work during typhoon season, said the weather forecast called for more rain, and told him to stay safe. She also reminded him that the damp weather was making her knees ache faintly, and asked him to take good care of himself. Lu Mingqiang readily agreed and felt warm inside after hanging up.

events.name: Started systematic exam review in the evening
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang opened the theoretical textbook for the senior technician exam and began systematically reviewing the basic knowledge in the Transformer Maintenance chapter. This was his first focused study session since formally starting the exam preparation plan. Although his brain felt foggy from days of fatigue and efficiency was low, he persisted and took five pages of notes. He knew this was a long battle; today's start was difficult, but he had to take that step.

start_state.mood: Slightly relieved that the weather has cleared up, but with an obvious sense of physical fatigue

end_state.mood: Fatigue mixed with anticipation for the weekend family reunion, and a vague unease about the interrupted exercise habit.

state.daily_exercise: None; a little walking at work, and casually moving my waist and legs after work

2025-06.daily_overview: During a brief break in the typhoon season, Saturday was sunny. Early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove with his wife Wang Lijuan and their two sons from their home in Longhua District to his parents' home in Meilan District, bringing the prepared medicated plasters and some fruit. His mother, Chen Xiuying, prepared a generous lunch, including Lu Mingqiang's favorite Hainanese chicken rice and several seasonal dishes. At the table, his father, Lu Jianguo, seriously asked how his typhoon-season preparations were going and, with his experience as an old electrician, gave him several safety rules. After lunch, the whole family sat together drinking tea and chatting; three generations played chess on the balcony, creating a warm and harmonious atmosphere. Because his mother's cooking was excellent, Lu Mingqiang could not resist adding another half bowl of rice and ate two pieces of the taro cake she had made herself. As they said goodbye in the evening, his mother pressed homemade glutinous rice cakes into his grandchildren's hands. It was already evening when they returned home in Longhua District, and the family ended the day with a lingering sense of family warmth.

events.name: Drove with the whole family to his parents' home in Meilan District
events.description: At nine in the morning, Lu Mingqiang loaded the medicated patches and a few bags of fruit into the car and set off from his home on Jinmao Middle Road with his wife Wang Lijuan, his eldest son Lu Zixuan, and his younger son Lu Zihan, driving to the old residential community in Meilan District where his parents live. On the way, Lu Zixuan excitedly asked whether Grandpa would play chess today, while Lu Zihan sat quietly in the back seat watching the street scene outside the window. About twenty minutes later, they arrived at the destination. His mother Chen Xiuying was already waiting downstairs.

events.name: Hearty family lunch and father-son work conversation.
events.description: After arriving at his parents' home, his mother Chen Xiuying prepared a rich lunch. Besides Lu Mingqiang's favorite Hainanese chicken rice, there were steamed fish, stir-fried vegetables, taro cake, and several tasty side dishes. Lu Mingqiang had a good appetite and went for two more helpings of rice. During the meal, his father Lu Jianguo put down his chopsticks and seriously asked Lu Mingqiang about the recent preparedness for power supply guarantees during the typhoon season. Lu Mingqiang explained in detail that he had been assigned to emergency rescue team one and was responsible for line repairs. His father nodded frequently and, drawing on his years of experience as an electrician at the power supply bureau, reminded him of several safety rules: be sure to check the safety rope for wear before climbing a pole, and never work alone during emergency repairs. Father and son had an especially deep exchange because of their shared professional background.

events.name: The whole family drank tea and chatted, enjoying a warm and happy time
events.description: After lunch, the whole family sat around in the living room drinking tea. Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan chatted with his parents about recent daily trivia and shared an amusing story about making chili sauce a few days earlier and sharing it with colleagues. His mother Chen Xiuying smiled and praised her daughter-in-law for being handy, and then asked about the two grandsons' studies and growth. Wang Lijuan said Lu Zixuan had recently become very interested in fixing things. Lu Mingqiang added the story of fixing a desk lamp on Children's Day, which made the old people laugh heartily.

events.name: Three generations playing chess on the balcony.
events.description: While drinking tea and chatting, Lu Zixuan and Lu Zihan followed their grandfather Lu Jianguo to the small chess table on the balcony. Their grandfather patiently taught his two grandsons the basic moves of Chinese chess. Lu Zixuan learned quickly, while Lu Zihan was attracted by the shapes of the pieces and occasionally picked them up to play with. The grandfather guided them and told stories of learning chess in his youth. In the afternoon sunlight, the three generations interacted warmly, with laughter ringing out.

events.name: Saying goodbye in the evening and mother's thoughtful gift of food.
events.description: In the evening, the family of four prepared to leave. His mother, Chen Xiuying, took out several pieces of homemade glutinous rice cakes wrapped in plastic bags from the kitchen and pressed them into her grandson's hands, telling Lu Mingqiang to drive carefully and to pay attention to safety when working outside during typhoon season. Lu Mingqiang took the food and, looking at his mother's gray hair and caring eyes, felt a surge of warmth. Driving his family back to Longhua District, he silently savored the warm feeling of three generations being together that day.

start_state.mood: Filled with anticipation of a family reunion, the fatigue of a week's work was temporarily forgotten.

end_state.mood: Warm and content; the psychological comfort brought by the family support network was evident, but he felt a little bloated after eating too much.

state.daily_exercise: None; full-day family activities with a small amount of walking.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, muggy, scattered convective cloud clusters developing in the afternoon, temperature 29-34°C

2025-06.daily_overview: On Sunday morning, Lu Mingqiang did some light activity at home, played with building blocks with the two children for a while, and squeezed in 10 minutes of lower back and waist stretches. A little after 2 p.m., he received an urgent repair call—a large-area circuit trip in an old residential building near Jinmao Middle Road. He immediately packed his repair tool kit and drove to the scene quickly. Inspection showed that the high summer temperatures had caused many households to turn on air conditioners at the same time, overloading the lines; in addition, some wiring terminals had aged and loosened. Lu Mingqiang calmly switched off the main circuit breaker, redistributed the load, and replaced the aging terminals and fuses. The whole process took about 30 minutes. Because the meter room was cramped, he worked in a bent-over position for a long time, and when he stood up he clearly felt stiffness and swelling in the muscles on both sides of his lower back. After closing the breaker, he checked door to door to confirm power had returned to normal, and the residents thanked him gratefully. When he finished and got home it was already past 4 p.m. He took a cool shower, had a simple dinner with his family, and before bed asked his wife to help apply a soothing pain patch, then went to bed early.

events.name: At home in the morning, resting and accompanying the children.
events.description: On Sunday morning, Lu Mingqiang had no special plans. He helped his wife tidy up the chili plants on the balcony, then did a 10-minute lower back stretch in the living room (cat-cow stretch and child's pose). Afterwards, he played with building blocks with his two sons; Lu Zixuan built a bridge with the blocks and proudly showed it to his father, while Lu Zihan quietly flipped through a picture book nearby. Lu Mingqiang enjoyed this rare leisure time, but he was well aware that being on standby during typhoon season meant it could be interrupted at any moment.

events.name: Received an emergency repair call and quickly prepared.
events.description: Just after 2 p.m., Lu Mingqiang's phone rang. It was a repair call from Wang Jianguo, the property management contact for the old residential building on Jinmao Middle Road, saying that several units in the building had tripped and lost power at the same time. Lu Mingqiang immediately switched into work mode. He picked up his usual emergency repair toolkit from beside the shoe cabinet, quickly checked the clamp meter, screwdriver set, spare circuit breaker, insulating tape, and other necessary tools and parts, and after confirming nothing was missing, put on his work clothes and left.

events.name: Drove quickly to the fault site.
events.description: Since the fault location was right near Jinmao Middle Road, Lu Mingqiang reached that old residential building in less than fifteen minutes by car. Several residents were already waiting anxiously in the hallway. When they saw the repairman arrive, they crowded around to describe the situation. Lu Mingqiang reassured them briefly, picked up his tool bag, and walked quickly into the meter room to start troubleshooting.

events.name: Troubleshoot and confirm the circuit overload fault.
events.description: Lu Mingqiang opened the main breaker box and used a clamp meter to measure the current in each phase one by one. He quickly found that one phase was severely overloaded. Following the circuit, he discovered that because of the hot weather, multiple households had turned on air conditioners at the same time, and some connection terminals on the building's main line had oxidized and loosened from aging over the years, causing that phase to trip from overload and cut power to several households. He calmly explained the cause of the fault to the residents watching, then began to deal with it.

events.name: Redistribute the load and replace aging components.
events.description: After confirming the fault point, Lu Mingqiang turned off the main breaker and started working under the light of the headlamp in his tool bag. The cramped meter room forced him to work bent over for a long time. He carefully moved some high-power air-conditioning circuits to the lightly loaded backup phase lines to balance the load. At the same time, he used a screwdriver and wrench to remove several visibly oxidized and loose wiring terminals, replaced them with new copper terminals and thermal fuses, and retightened every screw to ensure solid and reliable connections. The whole procedure was skilled and efficient, and took less than half an hour.

events.name: Close the breaker to confirm power restoration and receive residents' thanks.
events.description: After the repair was completed, Lu Mingqiang closed the main switch, then went floor by floor and door to door to confirm that power had been restored. At every door he knocked on, he made sure with his own eyes that the lights were on and the air conditioner was running before he felt reassured. The residents thanked him one after another; an elderly woman even insisted on staying to have a bowl of mung bean soup. Lu Mingqiang smiled and declined politely, not forgetting to remind the residents to avoid using high-power appliances at the same time during the summer peak electricity season. As he packed up his tools and left, he felt a noticeable ache in his lower back. When he got back to the car, he first pounded his lower back with his fist before starting the engine.

start_state.mood: The relaxed state of weekend leisure at home

end_state.mood: Although the rest was interrupted by an unexpected task, the efficient emergency repair brought a sense of professional satisfaction. Mild stiffness appeared in the lower back muscles, and a medicated patch was applied.

state.daily_exercise: Stretched my lower back for 10 minutes in the morning; the emergency repair involved heavy physical work.

date_attribute.weather: Overcast turning to heavy rain; rain intensified in the afternoon; temperature 25-29°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: The new week began with heavy rain returning. When Lu Mingqiang got up in the morning, he saw torrential rain outside the window, and the morning run plan was dashed again. He had to do 20 minutes of bodyweight core training in the living room, but during the plank he felt more obvious soreness in his lower back than in the past few days, and his holding time was shortened by 10 seconds. During the day he handled several indoor equipment maintenance tasks at the company, but his body felt an inexplicable heaviness. During the lunch break, he chatted with Chen Jianguo and mentioned that after stopping running for a week, he felt something off all over. Jianguo laughed, saying he was hooked on running, and advised him to run as soon as the rain stopped. After work, the rain did not let up, so he could only head home feeling depressed. In the evening, after helping his wife tutor Lu Zixuan's Chinese homework, he lay in bed and took longer to fall asleep, still feeling a pulling sensation in his lower back when lying flat.

events.name: Heavy rain interrupted the morning run plan again, so indoor training was the only option.
events.description: When the alarm went off at 6:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang heard the dense sound of rain outside the window. He got up and pulled open the curtain, seeing that the roads in the community were already flooded. He sighed, realizing that his morning run was impossible again. He spread out a mat in the living room and planned to do 20 minutes of core training. But during the plank, the muscles on both sides of his lower back were clearly sore. In the first set he could only hold for 35 seconds before his hips sagged, so he had to switch to wall sits and glute bridges to finish the workout.

events.name: Indoor equipment repair work
events.description: Daytime work was mainly concentrated on equipment maintenance at the company and in a nearby indoor power distribution room. Lu Mingqiang completed several circuit breaker replacements and line tests in a dry environment. Although he avoided the hardship of outdoor work in the heavy rain, he always felt a lingering dullness and fatigue in his body.

events.name: Noticed lower back discomfort and confided in a co-worker
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang told his coworker Chen Jianguo that after a week off from running, his lower back felt tight and his sleep had grown shallower. Jianguo joked that he was hooked on running and advised him to get back to it as soon as the rain stopped and he would feel better. He also shared his own experience of doing 'little swallow' exercises when he had back soreness before. Lu Mingqiang smiled wryly and nodded, knowing deep down that regular exercise was necessary to maintain his physical condition.

start_state.mood: Frustrated because heavy rain interrupted exercise again, and the stiffness in his lower back became more noticeable.

end_state.mood: Realized the negative effects of stopping running on his body, and his anxiety about being unable to resume exercise increased.

state.daily_exercise: 20 minutes of indoor core training (but plank quality decreased)

date_attribute.weather: Showers turning to cloudy; the rain stopped in the early morning, with intermittent sunshine in the afternoon; temperature 26-31°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: In the early morning, the rain finally stopped. Lu Mingqiang unhesitatingly put on his running shoes and went out to complete a much-missed 5 km morning run. Because he had not run systematically for a week, his pace had noticeably dropped, ending up with an average of 6 min 15 sec/km. But after the exhilarating run, he keenly compared the differences in his body before and after the break — the tightness in his lower back had eased considerably, and his mind was much clearer. With the abundant energy from exercise, he went to work as usual, but in the morning he was told an awkward piece of news: his fellow worker Chen Jianguo, who urgently needed money for home renovation, asked him for a loan again. After an inner struggle, Lu Mingqiang reluctantly declined, because he had already lent 10,000 yuan in March, and this month's expenses for his eldest son's tutoring class and new running shoes had already made the family's cash flow tight. He proactively offered to help him raise money from other fellow workers, and Jianguo eventually raised the funds elsewhere. After their conversation, their friendship remained unaffected. After work, he returned home and completed another 20-minute core training session on the balcony to strengthen his lower back. While doing wall sits, he felt his muscles trembling and signals of recovery.

events.name: Post-rain recovery 5 km morning run.
events.description: At six in the morning, Lu Mingqiang saw that the rain outside the window had stopped and the road was wet but without puddles, so he immediately changed into running shorts and old running shoes and went downstairs. He ran a full five kilometers along a familiar route around the neighborhood. But because of a week's interruption in systematic training, his pace had slipped from 6:05 per kilometer at the end of May to 6:15. Sweat mixed with the post-rain humidity. After the run, he wiped his sweat and felt the stiffness in his lower back gradually loosen during the run. Although his gait was a bit heavy, his body had finally come alive again.

events.name: Co-worker Chen Jianguo made a loan request.
events.description: During a break at the construction site in the morning, fellow worker Chen Jianguo, with a troubled look on his face, pulled Lu Mingqiang aside and said in a low voice that his home renovation was in urgent need of cash, and asked whether he could borrow some more money to tide him over. Lu Mingqiang's heart sank when he heard this. He understood Jianguo's situation, but he was also well aware of his own current financial condition.

events.name: Politely declined the loan request and proactively offered other help.
events.description: After a moment of silence, Lu Mingqiang candidly told Jianguo that he had already lent out 10,000 yuan in March, and recently the family had enrolled his eldest son in a math tutoring class, and he himself planned to buy a pair of professional running shoes, so he was really tight on cash and couldn't lend a second sum. He apologized sincerely, but immediately offered to contact other co-workers to see if they could help with the cash flow, and right there called several co-workers he knew well to ask around. Jianguo patted him on the shoulder and said he understood — brothers are still brothers.

events.name: Evening bodyweight core-strengthening workout on the balcony.
events.description: After getting off work, Lu Mingqiang unrolled a yoga mat on the balcony before dinner and completed a 20-minute bodyweight core workout, including planks, crunches, wall sits, and bird dog exercises. He paid special attention to strengthening his lower back, feeling a soreness that was different from the previous stiffness—it was a normal post-workout response. After finishing, he was sweating profusely and felt more confident about getting back into his exercise routine.

start_state.mood: The rain stopping brought a strong urge to resume exercising, eager to shake off the dullness of not running

end_state.mood: The refreshed feeling after recovery from exercise was mixed with the complicated emotions of politely turning down the loan request, but the back discomfort was noticeably relieved, and his resolve to strengthen exercise management became clearer.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km (pace 6:15 per km), 20 minutes of core training on the balcony

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy with scattered showers, light wind, temperature 27-32°C

2025-06.daily_overview: It was rainless on Wednesday morning, so Lu Mingqiang went for a morning run for the second consecutive day. His 5 km pace was stable at about 6:15 per kilometer, and after returning he did the usual 5-minute stretch. During the day he worked normally, helping Team Leader Zhang handle several routine maintenance work orders, including upgrading an electrical circuit for the appliance repair shop of old customer Li Jianguo. It was a small job booked a few days earlier, and Boss Li was full of praise for Lu Mingqiang's skills. After work he was in good spirits and, as usual, went to the squash club for routine training with his playing partner Lin Feng. Tonight's training focused on consolidating backhand technique, and the two also played four high-quality practice matches. Running and swinging the racket on court, Lu Mingqiang felt his footwork was a bit lighter than last week. Though his stamina had not yet returned to its peak from the end of May, his backhand placement was accurate. After training, Lin Feng praised him for reacting quickly today. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said, 'Being able to run is happiness.' After the game, he took a shower and changed clothes, then went home under the night sky, feeling that two consecutive days of regular training were bringing his body back on track.

events.name: Early morning 5 km run
events.description: At six in the morning, seeing only a light drizzle outside the window, Lu Mingqiang put on his old running shoes without hesitation and headed out. He ran 5 km along the riverside route at a pace of 6 minutes 14 seconds per kilometer and felt it was easier than yesterday; after the run, he had almost no stiffness in his lower back. When he got home, he did a simple 5-minute stretch at the elevator entrance before going inside.

events.name: Upgrade the store's electrical circuit for long-time customer Li Jianguo.
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang arrived at Li Jianguo's electrical appliance repair shop in Meilan District as scheduled to lay a dedicated circuit for his newly purchased testing equipment. He skillfully ran the wiring and installed an air switch, and at Boss Li's request checked the electrical safety of the entire shop. Li Jianguo handed him tea and, during casual conversation, mentioned the importance of industry certificates, encouraging Lu Mingqiang to hurry and take the senior technician exam, saying that he had the skill and was only missing the certificate. This remark strengthened Lu Mingqiang's determination to prepare for the exam.

events.name: Squash club routine training sees a return of touch
events.description: At 7 p.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived at the squash club on time to meet Lin Feng. They first did a set of dynamic stretches for the shoulders, back, and legs, followed by special backhand practice. Lu Mingqiang repeatedly hit the ball against the wall to practice backhand placement, and his touch was noticeably better than last week. Then they played four games of actual competition, and his footwork was much quicker, allowing him to save several tricky shots from Lin Feng. When Lin Feng stopped to wipe his sweat, he praised Lu Mingqiang for having his form back today. Lu Mingqiang smiled and said resuming morning runs really worked. The one-hour training session ended in a thoroughly satisfying sweat.

start_state.mood: Feeling better in spirits after resuming exercise two days ago, and the pace at work has been steady.

end_state.mood: Good performance on the court boosted his confidence, and the client's encouragement injected motivation into his exam preparation.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 km (pace 6'14"), squash training about 60 minutes

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, temperature 28-33°C, high humidity

2025-06.daily_overview: Weather continued to be fine and sunny. Lu Mingqiang ran another 5 kilometers in the morning, and his pace slightly recovered to 6 minutes 12 seconds per kilometer. He did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up before the run, and extended the post-run stretching to 8 minutes. His body felt better and better, but when he weighed himself, he found he had reached 72 kg. He knew that it was the result of relaxed eating and not running in the previous days. The pace of work during the day was steady, and he completed routine maintenance tasks as usual. During the lunch break, he reviewed the core formulas in the transformer protection chapter and tried to organize the logic with a mind map. In the evening, after a light dinner at home, he sat alone on the sofa browsing on his phone. He deliberately searched for several instructional videos on professional running warm-up and stretching, learned the lunge twist and ankle activation techniques, and recorded them in his memo. Then he repeatedly compared several professional shock-absorbing running shoes on e-commerce sites and saved options priced between 300 and 500 yuan as candidates, planning in his mind the budget allocation after his salary at the end of the month. He also sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Bin, asking to meet on the weekend for advice on running shoes.

events.name: Scientific morning run at dawn.
events.description: At 6:00 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his old running shoes and went out, but this time he first did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up downstairs (high knees, lunge twists, and ankle circles) before starting a 5-kilometer jog. Along the way he paid attention to his cadence and breathing, and finished with a pace of 6:12 per kilometer. After the run, he deliberately did 8 minutes of static stretching in the community garden, including stretches for the iliotibial band and quadriceps, which he had learned from a video yesterday.

events.name: Review notes and mind maps during lunch break.
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang did not rest immediately. Instead, he took out the notes he had organized the night before and reviewed the five core formulas in the transformer protection chapter. He tried using the mind-mapping method his son had taught him a few days earlier to draw the logical relationships among the formulas on draft paper. In just 20 minutes, several previously vague concepts became much clearer. He decided to apply this visualization method to all subsequent chapters.

events.name: Search online for warm-up and stretching tutorial videos
events.description: At nine in the evening, the family had all settled in. Lu Mingqiang leaned on the living room sofa and used his phone to go online. He first searched for professional videos on running warm-up and stretching, carefully watched a 15-minute dynamic warm-up tutorial for runners, and noted down key movement points in his phone memo, such as “lunge twists 12 reps per side, ankle activation circles.” He muttered to himself that he had to get rid of the habit of just running casually and needed to protect his body, which was about to turn 36.

events.name: Browsing and selecting professional running shoes, and contacting running buddies
events.description: After watching the instructional video, Lu Mingqiang searched for professional shock-absorbing running shoes on a shopping website. He compared styles and reviews across several brands and favorited three or four candidates priced between 300 and 500 yuan. He roughly worked out how to allocate his end-of-month salary—tutoring fees, household expenses, plus a pair of running shoes—it would be tight, but he could manage. He then sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Bin, suggesting they go to a physical store together on Saturday morning to try them on. Chen Bin quickly replied that it was no problem.

start_state.mood: Energetic after the morning run, and motivated to study sports science knowledge.

end_state.mood: He was worried about his weight creeping back up, but the fulfilling study and the prospect of getting new running shoes soon tempered his anxiety.

state.daily_exercise: Morning run 5 km (including 10 minutes of dynamic warm-up and 8 minutes of post-run stretching)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 29-34°C, with obvious summer heat and humidity.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Friday it was hot and humid. After his morning run, Lu Mingqiang weighed himself on the electronic scale at home. The number jumped to 72.3 kg, meaning his BMI was close to 25. He frowned at the number for a while, recalling his diet that week: family dinners, unrestricted snacking, and finishing every bowl of rice at dinner. Although his back was no longer in pain, his stamina was clearly worse than at the end of May. During the workday, he deliberately took half a portion less rice at the construction site lunch and turned down the soda offered by a coworker. After returning home in the evening and having dinner with his wife Wang Lijuan, he solemnly confessed his concerns to her, saying that during these two weeks of stopping running because of the heavy rain, his weight and physical stamina had been quietly declining. The couple sat at the table and seriously discussed the matter, then decided to systematically adjust the family dinner structure starting the next day: cut rice in half, replace the main dishes with stir-fried vegetables and boiled chicken breast, use homegrown chili peppers to make a healthy dipping sauce instead of greasy seasonings, and give up late-night snacks. Wang Lijuan fully supported him and said she would go to the market the next day to buy groceries. Watching his wife cooperate so seriously, Lu Mingqiang felt even more determined to have his family's support. Before going to bed, he also wrote a line in his memo: "Goal: get back to 71 kg by the end of June, and pass the July exam."

events.name: After his morning run, he weighed himself and found that his weight had continued to rebound.
events.description: After finishing his morning 5K run (pace 6:13 per km), Lu Mingqiang stepped barefoot onto the electronic scale on the balcony, and the number showed 72.3 kg. He silently calculated his BMI as 24.8—just a hair away from the overweight threshold of 25. Standing in front of the mirror, he pinched his waist and found that the waistline that had disappeared a few days earlier due to stopping running had not returned. Realizing that just two weeks of slack had greatly undermined his weight-loss results, he resolved to intervene strictly.

events.name: At lunch, he actively controlled his food intake.
events.description: At noon, while eating a boxed lunch at the construction site, Lu Mingqiang asked the auntie serving food to give him only half a portion of rice and an extra spoonful of stir-fried greens. Zhao Qiang beside him asked in surprise whether he was trying to lose weight. Lu Mingqiang smiled wryly and nodded, saying he couldn't get any fatter. He declined the iced cola Zhao Qiang offered and drank the plain water he had brought instead.

events.name: Discussed family diet structure adjustment with wife
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang asked his wife to sit for a moment and frankly told her about his recent weight rebound and declining physical fitness. He proposed adjusting the dinner structure starting tomorrow—cutting the rice portion in half for each meal, replacing the main dishes with stir-fried seasonal vegetables and boiled chicken breast, using homegrown chili peppers as dipping sauce, and changing his late-night snacking habit to drinking warm water. Wang Lijuan listened carefully and immediately expressed support, saying she would go to the market early the next morning to buy more chicken breast and greens, adding, “It’s good for the kids to eat healthier too.” After the couple reached agreement, Lu Mingqiang felt much more at ease about the health issue weighing on his mind.

start_state.mood: After the morning run, his spirits were still good, but the weight data added a layer of caution to his mood.

end_state.mood: Determined to adjust my diet structure, and my family's support makes the decision hopeful
