2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, at the invitation of fellow collector Chen Jianguo, Lu Mingqiang carefully packed the five Hainan old distillery bottles from his collection and the bottle culture notes he had been organizing for over half a year, and delivered them to the Haikou Mass Art Center, where he confirmed the layout details for the Hainan Folk Old Objects Collection Exhibition. After leaving the art center, he sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Bin, postponing the trial run of the running shoes to next weekend. Seeing his collections placed in the display case, he felt a sense of pride that his collection was recognized. Since his body still felt somewhat heavy, he did not schedule a morning run, but slept until 6:30, got up, and did simple stretches on the balcony. In the afternoon, to relieve recent education anxiety and financial pressure, he took out a traditional kite and spool from the cabinet and walked alone to Wanlv Garden. On the grass, he skillfully flew the kite high into the sky, watching it circle steadily in the blue sky, and his inner restlessness gradually calmed. While reeling in the kite string, he happened to meet his kite-circle friend Chen Jie. The two sat on the grass and chatted for a while. Lu Mingqiang, uncharacteristically, confided some recent pressures to him: worry about his eldest son's math decline, guilt over being unable to lend money to a fellow worker, and the dual burden of exam preparation and work. Chen Jie listened patiently, shared his own experience facing similar pressure in the past, and advised him not to bear it alone. After venting, he felt much lighter. He said goodbye to Chen Jie and walked home. In the evening, he took out his bottle collection notes, carefully wiped several old wine bottles usually hidden at the back of the cabinet, and muttered to himself that he would properly organize these treasures and cultural notes, rekindling the cultural bond that originated from his father's old distillery stories.

events.name: Deliver collection items to the art gallery to confirm exhibition details
events.description: At nine in the morning, Lu Mingqiang carefully wrapped the five Hainan Old Distillery liquor bottles he had prepared in advance in old newspapers, put them in a cardboard box, and loaded them into the car along with the cultural notes he had compiled over the past half year. He drove to the Haikou Mass Art Center and confirmed with the staff the details of the display case location and the exhibit label text. When the staff placed the bottles one by one into the display case and displayed enlarged copies of his handwritten cultural notes beside them, Lu Mingqiang stood in front of the case for a long time, feeling a surge of pride at being recognized and a sense of responsibility for cultural compilation.

events.name: Notify running buddies via WeChat of the reschedule
events.description: After leaving the art museum, Lu Mingqiang checked the time and found most of the morning was already gone. He still planned to go to Wanlv Garden in the afternoon to fly a kite to relieve stress, so he sent a WeChat message to his running buddy Chen Bin, honestly telling him that today's schedule was full and that trying on running shoes would be postponed to next weekend. Chen Bin replied that he understood and agreed to get in touch then.

events.name: Went alone to Wanlv Garden to fly a kite to relieve anxiety.
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang took out the traditional kite and line spool that had accompanied him for years from the cabinet at home. After carefully checking the frame and bridle to make sure they were secure, he walked alone to the nearby Wanlv Park. A gentle breeze blew across the afternoon lawn. He found an open patch of grass, skillfully handled the kite line, and let the kite rise steadily into the sky. As he looked up at the kite circling steadily in the air, the lingering anxiety and the various pressures of the past week were released inch by inch as he let out the line, and his mood gradually eased and calmed.

events.name: Ran into Chen Jie and confided in him at length.
events.description: While reeling in the kite line, Lu Mingqiang happened to run into his friend Chen Jie, who had also come to fly a kite. The two had known each other for years, and as they reeled in, they sat down on the grass. Chen Jie handed him a bottle of water. After taking a couple of sips, Lu Mingqiang, who rarely opened up, began to pour out his recent anxieties: his eldest son's slipping math grades, his guilt over being unable to help a fellow worker who had asked for a loan, and his exhaustion under the pressure of typhoon season. Chen Jie listened quietly, then patted him on the shoulder and said he had gone through similar days when his own son was rebellious. He advised him not to keep everything bottled up, but to talk more with his wife or trusted friends. Lu Mingqiang nodded, feeling much lighter. They agreed to come flying kites together again the next time it was sunny, then packed up their gear and said goodbye.

events.name: In the evening, organize the bottle collection and rediscover a cultural hobby
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang took down from the bookshelf the wine bottle collection notebook whose corners were already slightly curled, and paged through the origin, age, and old stories of the Hainan distillery behind each bottle he had recorded. Then he took several gleaming old wine bottles from the cabinet, placed them on the table, and carefully wiped away the fine dust with a soft cloth, muttering to himself that he wanted to reorganize all the treasures and cultural notes while taking the opportunity of this exhibition. This hobby, tied to memories of his father's early days at the distillery, once again took a solid place in his heart after the exhibition and the shared reminiscences.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the collection being exhibited, while also needing to release the stress accumulated recently.

end_state.mood: Flying kites and talking things out effectively eased the stress, and cultural hobbies once again brought spiritual comfort.

state.daily_exercise: Morning: 10 minutes of stretching on the balcony, about 40 minutes of walking round trip to Wanlv Garden, and about an hour of kite flying.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, slightly hot in the afternoon, temperature 29-34°C

2025-06.daily_overview: Lu Mingqiang spent Father's Day in a special way. Early in the morning, he called his mother, Chen Xiuying, and carefully reminded her to keep applying hot compresses to her knees before the rainy weather in June to relieve joint pain. Since it was Sunday and he had been working at high intensity for several consecutive days, he did not schedule a morning run and got up a little later. At 10 a.m., he drove his wife, Wang Lijuan, and his two sons to the Haikou Mass Art Center to formally visit the "Hainan Folk Old Objects Collection Exhibition". When the family reached his liquor bottle display case, his eldest son, Lu Zixuan, was surprised to find that his father's collection and the enlarged cultural notes on display were exhibited in a gallery-like hall, and he kept praising his dad for being amazing. His wife, Wang Lijuan, also publicly affirmed for the first time the cultural significance of his collection, saying that these bottles and notes really recorded a piece of Hainan's local history. Standing in front of the display case, Lu Mingqiang felt full of pride and warmth from being recognized by his family and himself. After the visit, the family had a simple meal outside and drove home in the evening. At night, the whole family continued discussing the exhibition, and the children vied to retell the other interesting old objects they had seen. This day became a spiritual highlight in Lu Mingqiang's collecting career, and an important milestone in the deepening of the couple's relationship from mutual support in daily life to spiritual recognition.

events.name: Called to remind his mother to apply a warm compress to her knee before the rainy weather
events.description: After getting up early in the morning, Lu Mingqiang thought of the recent rainy weather and called his mother, Chen Xiuying. He carefully asked whether her knees had been hurting again and reminded her to use a hot water bottle on her knees while the weather was still fine, which could ease the joint pain during the coming rainy days. His mother laughed and said she knew, and in turn told him not to splurge on a Father's Day gift. After hanging up, Lu Mingqiang felt warm inside.

events.name: Visited an exhibition of vintage collectibles with the whole family.
events.description: At ten o'clock in the morning, Lu Mingqiang, along with his wife Wang Lijuan, eldest son Lu Zixuan, and second son Lu Zihan, set off from their home on Jinmao Middle Road and drove to the Haikou Mass Art Museum to visit the 'Hainan Folk Old Objects Collection Exhibition'. After entering the hall, Lu Mingqiang led his family to his display case, where five old Hainan liquor bottles were lit by warm colored lights. On the adjacent panel, the cultural notes he had written by hand were enlarged. Lu Zixuan's eyes widened, and he said loudly, 'Dad's bottles are in the exhibition!', his tone full of surprise and pride.

events.name: Wife's first public affirmation of the cultural significance of the collection
events.description: Standing in front of the display case, Wang Lijuan carefully read the notes on the display board, then turned to Lu Mingqiang and said softly, “These bottles have so many stories. The material you put together is really interesting and quite meaningful.” It was the first time his wife had praised his collecting hobby in a formal public setting. Lu Mingqiang listened and nodded with a smile, his heart surging with immense satisfaction at being understood and acknowledged by the person closest to him. This acknowledgment carried more weight than any exhibition certificate.

events.name: Family discussed exhibition content together, sharing a warm moment
events.description: After returning home in the evening, the family continued discussing the day's exhibition with great interest during dinner and while sitting around afterward. Lu Zixuan excitedly described several old objects he had seen at the exhibition, and Lu Zihan also imitated in a baby voice, saying, "Daddy's bottle." Wang Lijuan smiled and added a few interesting folk items she had seen. Lu Mingqiang listened quietly to the family's discussion and deeply felt that this Father's Day gift was not any physical object, but his family's sincere regard and genuine recognition of his inner world.

start_state.mood: Feeling warm anticipation for the Father's Day family activity, and calm at heart because of yesterday's tidying up.

end_state.mood: Filled with pride and emotion, he found that his family's recognition made his collection hobby and Father's Day extraordinarily meaningful.

state.daily_exercise: None. Visiting the exhibition involved a lot of walking; stood and moved around all day

date_attribute.weather: Partly sunny, scattered afternoon showers, temperature 28–34°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Monday, a working day, Lu Mingqiang resumed his morning run, but his pace dropped due to lower back pain. During the day, he completed the inspection and repair of the distribution box. In the evening, he encountered difficulty memorizing formulas during theoretical review and began to consider asking his son for help. Before bed, he persisted with his diet records, and the weight control plan got on track.

events.name: Early morning 5 km recovery run.
events.description: At 6:05 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his old running shoes and ran a 5 km round trip along Haisheng Road and Yongwan Road. Because he had stopped running for several days, his muscles were tight, and his pace was only 6'15''. After the run, he did simple stretching; the stiffness in his lower back eased slightly but did not disappear.

events.name: Routine electrical inspection and maintenance work.
events.description: At 8:00 AM, Team Leader Zhang assigned Lu Mingqiang and Chen Jianguo to work as a team, going to an old residential community in Xiuying District to replace aging switches in two low-voltage distribution boxes. The work lasted until 4:30 PM. In the high heat, the two took turns operating and reminded each other to hydrate.

events.name: Evening theory review and memory challenges
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang flipped through an advanced electrician textbook. He stumbled several times while writing out three-phase power formulas from memory, realized that rote memorization alone was inefficient, remembered that his son had mentioned mind maps, and decided to ask for help another day.

events.name: Keep up the food diary.
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang recorded his three meals in a note on his phone. For dinner he only had half a bowl of rice and a lot of water spinach, which met his weight control requirements.

start_state.mood: Stable, slightly tired

end_state.mood: Slightly worried about the review bottleneck, but has the idea of seeking help

state.daily_exercise: Morning run of 5 kilometers (pace 6'15'')

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, no rain in the afternoon, maximum temperature 35°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Tuesday, during a high-temperature outdoor inspection, Lu Mingqiang coached Zhao Qiang on using the testing equipment. At noon, coworkers exchanged weight-loss tips. After work, he noticed that his eldest son's math grades had seriously declined. He held back his emotions, patiently tutored him, and discussed a summer tutoring plan with his wife, but it was not yet decided because of the cost.

events.name: High-temperature outdoor line inspection
events.description: In the morning, he and Zhao Qiang conducted a summer safety inspection of the temporary power supply lines at the construction sites along Haisheng Road. Lu Mingqiang personally taught Zhao Qiang how to use an infrared thermometer to check cable joints for overheating, and reminded him of the risk of insulation softening in the high-temperature season.

events.name: Midday coworker discussion on weight management
events.description: During the lunch break, Chen Jianguo shared iced Qingbuliang. Zhao Qiang asked Lu Mingqiang how to control weight. He shared his experience of morning running and controlling staple foods at dinner. Jianguo also encouraged him to take the senior technician exam and exercise together.

events.name: Noticed the eldest son's math declining and made an initial plan.
events.description: After dinner, Wang Lijuan took out Lu Zixuan's math test paper with a score of 78. Lu Mingqiang calmly went through the wrong questions, then used the floor tiles at home for half an hour to explain area conversion. Afterward, the couple discussed dividing up the daily tutoring duties, and considered signing up for a summer tutoring class, but it was not finalized due to the extra monthly expense of 300 yuan.

start_state.mood: Okay, preparing to cope with the high temperature.

end_state.mood: Slight concern about his son's studies.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to thundershowers; the rain stopped in the evening, 28-33°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: Wednesday's squash training became a pressure release valve, and Lu Mingqiang's form picked up on the court. After returning home, he asked his eldest son to teach him a mind-mapping app. The father-son role reversal was warm and efficient. Not only did they organize formula mind maps, but it also boosted Lu Mingqiang's confidence for exam preparation. He fell asleep a little later than usual that night because of excitement.

events.name: Regular squash training
events.description: After the rain stopped in the evening, Lu Mingqiang went to the squash court and trained with Lin Feng for an hour and a half. He first focused on 50 sets of backhand straight shots, then narrowly won a three-game match 2:1. His footwork felt a bit lighter due to his weight loss.

events.name: Discussed stress management with Lin Feng
events.description: While changing clothes, Lin Feng talked about the pressure of sales performance. Lu Mingqiang shared his stress-relieving method of flying kites, and the two agreed to go running together next time.

events.name: Father-son mind map teaching
events.description: After playing squash, he went home and took a shower. Lu Mingqiang walked over to Lu Zixuan, who was using a tablet, and honestly said that he was struggling to memorize formulas and asked for help. His son skillfully demonstrated a mind map app. Lu Mingqiang clumsily imitated him, organizing formulas such as three-phase power and transformer ratio into a clear mind map. He joked that Old Lu should learn from Little Lu. Father and son high-fived and agreed to update it every week. Before bed, Lu Mingqiang was too excited to fall asleep, but he still controlled his emotions and lay down before 23:00.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to the evening squash

end_state.mood: Gained new respect for his son and strengthened confidence in exam preparation.

state.daily_exercise: Squash for 1.5 hours (backhand-focused practice + match play)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny with occasional clouds, brief showers in the afternoon, 29-34°C

2025-06.daily_overview: On Thursday, Lu Mingqiang practiced the mind map review method and improved his efficiency. In the evening, he had a small argument with his wife because exam preparation had made him neglect the family. After communicating, they agreed that he would put down his books at least one day a week to spend time with family, and the relationship was repaired.

events.name: Routine maintenance of the power distribution room and the use of mind maps.
events.description: Wake up the eldest son and remind him of his programming plan

events.name: Evening couple's quarrel and reconciliation
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang wanted to review directly, but Wang Lijuan complained that he had been too focused on exam preparation lately and had neglected household chores and the children. The two got into an argument. After calming down, Lu Mingqiang apologized, took the initiative to wash the dishes, and promised not to touch a book every Sunday and to focus on accompanying the family. Wang Lijuan's expression warmed.

events.name: Call with parents
events.description: Before bed, Lu Mingqiang called his parents in Meilan District. His mother answered and they chatted about family matters; his father reminded him to stay safe working in high temperatures. Lu Mingqiang promised to visit on the weekend.

start_state.mood: Calm, and a bit curious about the new tool.

end_state.mood: Relieved after reconciliation, family bond strengthened

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, with thundershowers in the evening, 27-35°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: Friday was dramatic: Lu Mingqiang discussed with his mentor initiating a technical exchange meeting, extending his professional role outward; in the evening, he learned that his eldest son's math score in the final exam had dropped significantly, and the family atmosphere suddenly became tense; late at night, he searched online for running shoe information and posted on a running forum asking for advice, making preparations for buying shoes over the weekend.

events.name: Discussed the technical exchange meeting with his mentor at noon
events.description: At noon in the cafeteria, he saw complaints in the technician group about inconsistent standards in the power distribution renovation. Lu Mingqiang called Master Li and suggested organizing a small technical exchange meeting to share troubleshooting experience. Master Li supported the idea and suggested using a familiar teahouse as the venue, and promised to help notify old colleagues. Lu Mingqiang felt very encouraged.

events.name: Crisis over eldest son's final grades and the family's urgent response
events.description: At 6:30 p.m., he returned home. His wife showed him Lu Zixuan's math final exam paper with a score of 75. Lu Mingqiang suppressed his anger and talked with his son alone. After learning that his son could not understand the word problems, he blamed himself for neglecting his son and apologized to him. Then the couple discussed in the kitchen and reluctantly decided to set aside 300 yuan each month to enroll him in a community math tutoring class. They also adjusted their division of labor: Lu Mingqiang would take charge of math, and Wang Lijuan would handle communication with the tutoring class.

events.name: Posted on a forum late at night asking for advice on running shoes.
events.description: After settling the children down, Lu Mingqiang leaned against the headboard and used his phone to post on a local running forum asking for running shoe recommendations for heavier runners. Soon he received several replies recommending domestic cushioned models. He wrote down the models and store addresses to prepare for Sunday's shopping trip. He fell asleep at nearly 23:10.

start_state.mood: Full of energy and focused on work.

end_state.mood: Complex: anxious about his son's studies, yet excited about the prototype of the exchange meeting; gained some sense of control by planning running shoes.

state.daily_exercise: None

2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday morning, Lu Mingqiang accompanied his eldest son to the end-of-term presentation of the programming interest class. The son confidently demonstrated a game and won applause from the whole audience, and the father reflected in a mix of pride and guilt. That evening, the couple talked in bed and decided to encourage the programming talent and adjust the approach to math tutoring. The family's relationship became more harmonious through celebration and communication.

events.name: Took his son to the programming showcase and encouraged him
events.description: At 8:30 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang drove Lu Zixuan to the programming training center. On the way, he bought pork floss buns and milk, and half-jokingly said that his legs also shook when he went on stage as a kid, to ease his son's nervousness.

events.name: Attend a programming showcase
events.description: At the training center's end-of-term exhibition, Lu Zixuan went on stage a little shyly and demonstrated the Scratch game “Kitten Catches Fish” he had programmed. His operations were smooth and his explanation clear, and the random obstacle logic drew quiet admiration from the parents, finally winning warm applause. Sitting in the back row, Lu Mingqiang went from nervously folding his arms to nodding repeatedly, his eyes slightly moist.

events.name: After the presentation, father and son talked and the family celebrated.
events.description: After the demonstration, in the corridor, Lu Mingqiang squatted down and patted his son on the shoulder, saying seriously that he had done an excellent job and admitting that he had previously underestimated these skills. After they got home, Wang Lijuan had prepared cooling dessert soup and fruit. The whole family sat together to celebrate their son, talking about fun programming stories and temporarily setting aside the topic of schoolwork.

events.name: Couple's late-night talk about adjusting their parenting strategy.
events.description: After the child fell asleep at night, Lu Mingqiang and Wang Lijuan had an in-depth talk. They agreed that they shouldn't only push math while suppressing the interest in programming, and decided to let their son continue the programming class during summer vacation, with math tutoring focusing on understanding rather than rote problem drilling. The two reached a consensus in a harmonious atmosphere.

start_state.mood: A mix of anticipation and lingering melancholy over his son's math scores

end_state.mood: Feeling proud of the eldest son, but with guilt deepening; however, the shared educational consensus brings hope.

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise.

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, gentle breeze in the evening, 30-36°C

2025-06.daily_overview: On Sunday, Lu Mingqiang turned his investment focus to his own health: he visited his parents in the morning, and in the afternoon, accompanied by his running friend Chen Bin, he carefully selected his first pair of professional shock-absorbing running shoes. This consumer decision marked a shift in his exercise mindset from casual to scientific. After returning home, he downloaded a running app and tried recording data, preparing for tomorrow's first run.

events.name: Morning at home and visiting parents
events.description: In the morning, Lu Mingqiang repaired the loose door stop at home and helped his wife tidy the chili pepper pots on the balcony. At nearly 10 o'clock, he drove alone to his parents' home in Meilan District for a short visit. His mother offered him a meal, but he politely declined, though he packed a few yiba cakes. His father asked about work, and Lu Mingqiang mentioned taking the senior technician exam; his father nodded approvingly.

events.name: Invited Chen Bin to accompany him in choosing professional cushioned running shoes
events.description: At 3 p.m., Lu Mingqiang messaged his running partner Chen Bin on WeChat, inviting him to go to the sporting goods store on Jinmao West Road in the evening, saying he had taken a liking to a domestic shock-absorbing model recommended on the forum. Chen Bin readily agreed.

events.name: Tried on and selected running shoes and accessories.
events.description: At 6 p.m. the two met at the specialty store. Chen Bin helped choose a breathable mesh style. Lu Mingqiang tried three brands and finally selected a pair of domestically made cushioning running shoes at 400 yuan after discount. The bounce was obvious when he jumped, so he paid promptly. Chen Bin also recommended a pair of quick-drying running socks, and Lu Mingqiang bought them as well.

events.name: Exchange insights after buying shoes
events.description: After leaving the shop, they each got an iced lemon tea at a roadside tea stall. Chen Bin shared his experience of losing 2 kg per month by running, and Lu Mingqiang talked about the financial pressure of his son's tutoring classes but felt that running shoes were a long-term health investment. The two agreed to run together at Baishamen Park early next Saturday morning. After returning home, Lu Mingqiang downloaded the recommended running app, registered, and briefly explored its tracking feature.

start_state.mood: Relaxing weekend morning

end_state.mood: Satisfied; looking forward to how the new running shoes will improve the running experience.

state.daily_exercise: None (rest day)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny, 28-34°C, suitable for a morning run.

2025-06.daily_overview: The first run in the new running shoes was a great success: pace improved to 6'00'' and there was no knee discomfort. Lu Mingqiang was deeply encouraged and decided to upgrade his training. During the day, he used the first aid knowledge from yesterday's training to help a coworker suffering from heatstroke and was praised by the team leader; in the evening, he systematically recorded the data and planned interval runs for the next month, and the concept of scientific exercise took root.

events.name: First test run of new running shoes: 5 km.
events.description: At 5:55 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang put on his new cushioned running shoes and completed a 5 km run in Baishamen Park, testing the cushioning effect on mixed surfaces. The overall pace was 6'00'', 15 seconds faster than before. After the run, he felt no discomfort in his knees or soles, and he was very satisfied.

events.name: Record the data and decide to add variable-speed running
events.description: After returning home from his morning run, Lu Mingqiang noted down his pace, heart rate feelings, and weight in a memo on his phone. After analyzing changes in his running volume, he concluded that steady-pace running was no longer likely to lead to breakthroughs, so he decided to schedule at least one interval run training session per month starting in July (alternating fast and slow 400 meters x 8 sets) and wrote it into his training plan.

events.name: Sharing running shoe experience and helping a fellow worker during a work break
events.description: After arriving at the team in the morning, Chen Jianguo noticed the new shoes. Lu Mingqiang took them off and let him try the shock absorption. Zhao Qiang asked the price and stuck out his tongue. Later, during outdoor work, Zhao Qiang felt dizzy from the heat. Lu Mingqiang immediately helped him to a shady spot per the training guidelines, loosened his clothes, and cooled him down with a wet towel, while telling Jianguo to call the company medical staff. Team Leader Zhang arrived and praised Lu Mingqiang for handling it properly.

events.name: Running app check-in and dropping social features
events.description: During the lunch break, Lu Mingqiang used the newly downloaded running app to upload his morning run data and received likes and cheers from a few stranger runners. He browsed the running club feature, but felt it was too social and time-consuming, so he decided to use only the recording function and turned off message notifications.

start_state.mood: Excited and eager to try on the shoes.

end_state.mood: Strong sense of accomplishment, confident about continued progress

state.daily_exercise: Morning 5 km run (pace 6'00'')

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy with showers, turning overcast in the afternoon, 27-31°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: On Tuesday, outdoor running was impossible due to rain, so Lu Mingqiang systematically studied videos on pre-run warm-up and post-run stretching, and practiced the movements properly. In the evening, he helped his neighbor Uncle Wang replace a light bulb and received some snacks in return. At home, the little one imitated the stretching moves, fell down, and made everyone laugh — warm and amusing.

events.name: Search for and learn from warm-up and stretching videos
events.description: At 8 p.m., it was still drizzling outside the window. Lu Mingqiang used his phone to search for pre-run dynamic warm-up and post-run stretching videos, selected two high-quality tutorials, and cast them to the TV. He watched them carefully twice and noted the muscle activation sequence and the duration of each movement.

events.name: Practice standard movements on your own.
events.description: After watching the video, Lu Mingqiang did a full set of pre-run dynamic warm-ups (high knees, side lunges, butt kicks, etc.) and post-run static stretches (quadriceps, hamstrings, calves) in the open area of the living room. Some movements were difficult due to insufficient flexibility, but he adjusted repeatedly to ensure proper form.

events.name: Family episodes and neighborhood mutual aid
events.description: During practice, his youngest son Lu Zihan imitated the movement, fell onto the mat, and started crying. Lu Mingqiang picked him up and comforted him, and the whole family laughed. Then Uncle Wang from next door knocked and said the kitchen light wasn't working. Lu Mingqiang took a voltage tester and found the bulb socket had poor contact, so he replaced and tightened it. Uncle Wang gratefully gave him a box of homemade coconut cakes.

start_state.mood: Feeling a little gloomy because of the rain.

end_state.mood: Fulfilling; learned new knowledge and helped a neighbor.

state.daily_exercise: 30 minutes of indoor warm-up and stretching exercises.

2025-06.daily_overview: Wednesday was squash day. Lu Mingqiang practiced a new warm-up routine and deliberately controlled the intensity because of the hot weather. After training, he politely declined a squash buddy's late-night snack invitation. When he got home, he searched for PLC programming, a newly added exam topic, and found it more difficult; his study pressure increased slightly, but it did not affect his exercise rhythm.

events.name: Received the monthly safety training notice
events.description: At 10 a.m., Team Leader Zhang notified in the team WeChat group that the safety training at 9 a.m. the next day would focus on heat protection and heatstroke first aid, and required all members to attend. Lu Mingqiang replied that he had received the notice.

events.name: Regular squash training and warm-up practice
events.description: At 6 p.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived early at the squash court and did a 10-minute activation using the dynamic warm-up he learned on Tuesday. Lin Feng was surprised at how professional he had become. The two focused on practicing near-wall volleys. Lu Mingqiang kept a low center of gravity and engaged his core. Afterward, they played three competitive games. Because it was stuffy and hot, they reminded each other several times to drink water.

events.name: Politely declined the late-night snack and shared stretching exercises.
events.description: After playing ball, while changing clothes, Lin Feng suggested going for some ice-cold beer. Lu Mingqiang politely declined, citing weight loss and exam preparation. The two did stretching at the court, and Lin Feng said he also wanted to learn this routine.

events.name: Search PLC exam points
events.description: After returning home, Lu Mingqiang looked up the senior technician exam syllabus online and found that the practical assessment included PLC programming and debugging of programmable logic controllers — a new field he had little exposure to in his daily work. He realized this was an obvious gap in his knowledge system, downloaded several introductory instructional videos, and decided to focus on mastering this content from July.

start_state.mood: Have some sense of preparation for tomorrow's training.

end_state.mood: Physically tired but mentally fulfilled, experiencing the value of knowledge transfer.

state.daily_exercise: Squash for 1.5 hours (including proper warm-up and stretching)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny and hot, with afternoon temperatures reaching 36°C. Take precautions against heatstroke.

2025-06.daily_overview: Thursday morning, Lu Mingqiang attended the company's high-temperature protection training and received praise for his serious hands-on CPR practice. After the meeting, Manager Liu talked with him, encouraging him to take the technician exam and hinting that he might be promoted to team leader, which brought him both motivation and pressure. In the evening, he shared this with his wife and gained family support.

events.name: Attend high-temperature protection safety training
events.description: At 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang arrived punctually at the company meeting room with his notebook. The safety supervisor, Lao Zhou, analyzed heatstroke cases and emphasized drinking water every 20 minutes. Lu Mingqiang drew a flowchart.

events.name: Hands-on practice of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR)
events.description: After the theory part, it was Lu Mingqiang's turn. He knelt beside the manikin and performed 30 compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths in standard form. Old Zhou commented that the rhythm was steady and the force met the standard. Zhao Qiang was flustered during his practice, and Lu Mingqiang quietly reminded him from the side.

events.name: Conversation with Manager Liu and career encouragement.
events.description: After the training, Manager Liu called Lu Mingqiang into the office, affirmed his performance as a key technical staff member, encouraged him to obtain a senior technician certification, and hinted that if the team expanded, he might be promoted to deputy team leader. Lu Mingqiang was surprised and excited, but also worried about his lack of leadership experience.

events.name: Evening family sharing
events.description: After dinner, Lu Mingqiang told Wang Lijuan about the conversation with Manager Liu. His wife was very supportive and said she could share more household chores and child care so he could focus on exam preparation. Lu Mingqiang felt even more motivated.

start_state.mood: Take the training seriously.

end_state.mood: New expectations for career development

state.daily_exercise: No dedicated exercise (training day)

date_attribute.weather: Partly cloudy, cool in the evening with a sea breeze, 29-34°C.

2025-06.daily_overview: The Friday evening family outing to Baishamen Park became the key to repairing their relationship: the quick repair of the air conditioner showcased his skills, the seaside play and chance encounter with a neighbor who shared information about the children's reading room, and the family time over qingbuliang dispelled the recent academic stress and brought them close again.

events.name: Repairing the home air conditioner
events.description: In the afternoon, just before going out, he found that the living room air conditioner was not cooling. Lu Mingqiang took it apart and found that the start capacitor was bulging. He immediately rode his electric bike to the hardware store, bought a capacitor of the same specification, and replaced it. Half an hour later, the air conditioner was working normally again. Wang Lijuan said it was really convenient to have an electrician at home.

events.name: Strolling in the park and playing on the beach
events.description: After changing clothes, the family of four drove to Baishamen Park. They followed the coconut grove trail to the sandy beach, where the two boys took off their shoes and dug sandcastles while Lu Mingqiang and his wife sat on a bench chatting, letting the sea breeze blow away their stress. Before long, they ran into their neighbor Uncle Wang, who was there with his grandson. Uncle Wang suggested that during summer vacation they could borrow books for free at the city children's reading room.

events.name: Bought Qingbuliang and shared it with the family.
events.description: As it got dark, the family packed up and left the park, bought four servings of low-sugar qingbuliang from a cooked food stall near the park, and went home. While sitting around eating the dessert, Lu Zixuan voluntarily mentioned his small progress at the tutoring class. Lu Mingqiang patted his head and said, 'Take it step by step.' The atmosphere was relaxed.

start_state.mood: Looking forward to family time in the evening.

end_state.mood: Relaxed and warm, family cohesion rebounded

state.daily_exercise: None (mainly walking)

2025-06.daily_overview: On Saturday, Lu Mingqiang successfully attempted variable-speed running for the first time. Although his calves were sore, it marked an upgrade in his training. He spent the whole day preparing a speech for the technical exchange meeting, distilling a three-step troubleshooting method from past logs. While tutoring his younger son, he unexpectedly created a prototype of a solid geometry teaching aid, adding a new tool to family education. The minor issue of the remote presentation pen failure was solved with his phone.

events.name: First early-morning interval run training
events.description: At 6 a.m., Lu Mingqiang tried interval running at Baishamen Park: after jogging 400 meters (pace 6'30'') he sprinted 200 meters (pace 4'50''), repeated for 6 sets. His muscles were sore, but the warm-up and stretching were thorough, and the experience was good. After the run, his calves were sore, so he relieved the pain with newly learned stretching moves.

events.name: Organized maintenance logs and refined the troubleshooting method
events.description: Starting at 9 a.m., Lu Mingqiang spread out two years of maintenance logs, selected 9 typical cases of poor contact in distribution cabinets, and summarized a three-step troubleshooting method: look (checking for oxidation and discoloration), smell (sniffing for a burnt odor), and measure (testing contact resistance). He took photos with his phone to prepare a PPT. He gave a solo trial presentation for about 15 minutes and was well prepared.

events.name: Encountered a small obstacle while preparing for the exchange meeting
events.description: While preparing for the presentation, he found that the PPT remote control pen had been damaged by battery leakage, so Lu Mingqiang simply switched to a phone remote control app instead. After testing, everything was normal.

events.name: Parent-child teaching aid making
events.description: After the afternoon nap, Lu Mingqiang played with his younger son carving cuboids and cubes out of foam blocks. He suddenly thought he could make solid geometry teaching aids for his eldest son, so he made a few extra, planning to formally paste colored paper with formulas tomorrow. The two sons had a great time working together.

start_state.mood: Focus and meet the challenge.

end_state.mood: Fully prepared and looking forward to the exchange

state.daily_exercise: Variable-speed run training (6 sets of 400m slow + 200m fast)

date_attribute.weather: Sunny turning cloudy, hot in the afternoon, 31-36°C

2025-06.daily_overview: Sunday was a milestone in Lu Mingqiang's career: he successfully initiated and led the first cross-company technical exchange session, evolving from an executor into a sharer of experience. At the teahouse, he exchanged ideas with like-minded peers and expanded his network. In the evening, his older brother called to congratulate him. After returning home, he refined a geometry teaching aid together with his eldest son. His confidence in both career and family grew.

events.name: Going to the training center to attend a technical exchange meeting
events.description: At 1:30 p.m., Lu Mingqiang brought a USB drive and an outline, rode an electric bike to the Longhua District Training Center, and helped set up tables and chairs. Participants included Master Li, 12 colleagues, and several young workers.

events.name: Lecture: Three-Step Troubleshooting Method for Poor Contact in Power Distribution Cabinets
events.description: At 2 o'clock sharp, Lu Mingqiang opened, explaining in detail the look-listen-touch troubleshooting method with projected case photos, while weaving in a dramatic first-hand repair experience. Colleagues in the audience frequently took photos and notes. The presentation ended with warm applause.

events.name: Facilitated free discussion and exchanged contact information
events.description: After the explanation, Lu Mingqiang raised the tricky problem of nuisance tripping caused by loop leakage protection and led a discussion. The atmosphere was lively, and the technicians from various companies shared their tips. Lu Mingqiang took careful notes and exchanged contact information with everyone. Many hoped it would be held regularly. Master Li patted him on the shoulder and said, "You've completed your apprenticeship."

events.name: Exchange with teahouse friends and call from elder brother.
events.description: After the meeting, Lu Mingqiang invited a few key colleagues to the teahouse recommended by Master Li for tea, exchanging views on industry prospects and personal development. They suggested he set up his own studio affiliated with a company. In the evening after returning home, Lu Mingqiang posted photos of the exchange meeting on Moments. His elder brother, Lu Minghua, called to congratulate him and share career insights, which made him feel very warm.

events.name: Evening: refined teaching aids and engaged in parent-child interaction
events.description: In the evening, Lu Mingqiang cut and sanded yesterday's foam blocks, covered them with colored paper, and made teaching aids such as cubes and rectangular prisms, with formulas labeled on them. Lu Zixuan took the initiative to help. As they worked, the father and son chatted about solid geometry concepts, and Lu Mingqiang turned the confidence he had gained that day into motivation for teaching.

start_state.mood: Slightly nervous but highly focused

end_state.mood: Peak sense of achievement, greatly improved professional self-identity.

state.daily_exercise: None (spent the whole day on the exchange meeting and with family)

2025-06.daily_overview: On a showery day at the end of the month, Lu Mingqiang adapted to the weather and did simple stretching indoors. He was pleasantly surprised to confirm that his weight had dropped to 71.8 kg and his back discomfort had disappeared. He reviewed the exchange meeting notes, expanded his mind map, made a July study plan, and received an invitation to a skills competition; he also checked his eldest son's summer homework and demonstrated the wrong problems with teaching aids, getting a steady start for the second half of the year.

events.name: Weight drop confirmed and physical satisfaction.
events.description: At 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 71.8 kg, down 1.2 kg from the month's highest point. The stiffness in his waist and back had completely disappeared. Reviewing this month's diet and exercise records, he confirmed that the strategy of eating less rice, more vegetables, and no snacks after dinner was effective, and he decided to use this as the family health baseline.

events.name: Formulate a July theoretical study plan for the senior technician.
events.description: He set the main focus for the first two weeks of July as circuit analysis and an introduction to PLCs, planning to memorize five key formulas and complete ten chapter exercises every day, and to use his commute time to play downloaded instructional videos. He told himself that once the foundation was solid, he would have the strength for the sprint later.

events.name: Supplementing the exchange meeting notes and future studio concepts
events.description: After making the plan, Lu Mingqiang opened his exchange meeting notes, added key discussion points such as the discrimination method for false tripping of old oil-immersed transformers to his mind map, and saved it in the future studio technical library folder. The prototype of his dream gradually became clear.

events.name: Checked his eldest son's summer homework and provided tutoring.
events.description: Before taking a break, Lu Mingqiang went into Lu Zixuan's room and looked through the first 8 pages of his summer math homework. He patiently pointed out two mistakes in area problems and demonstrated with the teaching aids from last night. After the child understood, he corrected them on his own.

events.name: Unexpected skill competition invitation
events.description: After tutoring, he received a call from Master Li, who told him that the Municipal Federation of Trade Unions would hold an electrician skills competition and suggested he participate on behalf of the company. Lu Mingqiang thought it was a good opportunity to test his skills and decided to ask Manager Liu to sign him up tomorrow.

start_state.mood: Woke up a little later because of the rain, feeling calm inside

end_state.mood: Satisfied; a good start to health and learning for the second half of the year.

state.daily_exercise: Because of rain, no outdoor exercise; did simple indoor stretching with breathing exercises.

date_attribute.weather: Cloudy turning to showers, 27–34°C, high humidity.

2025-06.daily_overview: On the first day of August, Lu Mingqiang tried resuming his morning run to test his lower back. Later, at work, he began meticulous family financial management for the month and prepared medicated patches for his mother. After work, he started making an eco-friendly toy car with his eldest son and explained circuit principles via phone video for the first time. In the evening, he finalized the August budget in detail with his wife, started keeping daily accounts, and continued reviewing theory for the Senior Technician exam. Life shifted into a fulfilling, orderly new rhythm.

events.name: Morning core rehabilitation training and adaptive jogging.
events.description: After getting up at 5:50 in the morning, Lu Mingqiang first completed 15 minutes of lower back and core rehabilitation stretching in the living room at home - superman, plank, and glute bridge, 3 sets each. Feeling that his lower back moved freely, he went to Wanlv Park and tried a 2 km slow jog, with a pace of about 7 minutes per kilometer, paying attention to the feeling in his lower back the whole time. After the run, he stretched thoroughly and confirmed there was no discomfort, greatly boosting his confidence in returning to running.

events.name: Buy medicated patches for mother before going to work.
events.description: After his morning run, he came home and took a shower, then stopped by the pharmacy near the neighborhood to buy the joint pain relief plasters his mother Chen Xiuying needed this month. He deliberately chose the brand his mother usually used and bought two extra boxes as backup, so that she could change them promptly when her knees hurt in rainy or damp weather.

events.name: Review basic electrical theory during lunch break
events.description: Using half an hour of his lunch break, Lu Mingqiang opened the vocational skills learning app in the company break room, specifically reviewed the DC circuit calculation and electromagnetic induction chapters of basic electrical theory, and did 10 supporting multiple-choice questions, scoring 9/10.

events.name: Formulate supermarket construction plan during work breaks
events.description: Back in the company in the afternoon, Lu Mingqiang, based on the site survey data from the previous days and the supermarket's operating hours requirements, worked out a detailed circuit renovation construction schedule on the office computer, calculated the required cable specifications, switch models, and distribution box capacity, and made a complete procurement materials list, which he submitted to Team Leader Zhang for review. Team Leader Zhang nodded and approved it, and reminded him to pay attention to safety.

events.name: After dinner, collected model materials with the eldest son and explained the principles.
events.description: After returning home from work and eating dinner in the evening, Lu Mingqiang and his eldest son Lu Zixuan searched for discarded items on the home balcony together, collecting materials such as an old electric toothbrush motor, plastic bottles, wire, and bottle caps. The father and son sat on the floor, and Lu Mingqiang played a simple animation on his phone, explaining to his son the basic working principle of an electric toy car: the battery supplies power to make the motor spin, which drives the wheels forward. Lu Zixuan listened with great interest, frequently asking why.

events.name: The couple discussed and confirmed the August family budget.
events.description: After settling the second son to sleep shortly after 8 p.m., Lu Mingqiang and his wife Wang Lijuan sat at the living room coffee table, took out paper and pen, and itemized August's fixed and special expenses one by one: the birthday gift for his mother's 60th birthday, a gift for their tenth wedding anniversary, a planned phone replacement, the cost of a scheduled comprehensive physical examination, and the renewal of the eldest son's parent-child swimming class. After repeated discussions, the two finally set the total family budget for August at 8,000 yuan.

events.name: Started daily expense tracking for August.
events.description: After discussing the budget, Lu Mingqiang took out a brand-new notebook from the drawer, neatly wrote "August Household Expenses" and the total budget on the title page, then recalled the day's small expenses together with his wife—morning breakfast, medicated plasters, groceries, and so on—recording each item and calculating the remaining amount. The two agreed to check the day's accounts every night before going to bed from then on.

events.name: Review variable frequency drive principles and take notes before bed.
events.description: Before going to bed, Lu Mingqiang walked into the small study and, as planned, used the learning app to review the basic difference between V/F control and vector control in the principles of variable-frequency drives. He took out his notebook and carefully recorded the concepts that were easy to confuse, and marked the braking unit section that needed more work. The study session lasted about 30 minutes.

start_state.location: Home bedroom, No. 15 Jinmao Middle Road, Longhua District, Haikou City
start_state.mood: Slightly nervous; looking forward to resuming running to test my lower back.

end_state.mood: Feeling solid and content; the physical test went smoothly, and the family finances now have a clear direction

state.daily_exercise: Morning core stretching for 15 minutes, jogging 2 kilometers, walking commute to and from work.
